declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSmoothOverIntegers_curvesNodal
declarations.doc:
The morphism `Curves^{nodal} → Spec(ℤ)` is smooth. Here `Curves^{nodal}` is the open substack
of the algebraic stack of curves (Stacks 0D5A) of the families of curves which are at-worst-nodal
of relative dimension one (Stacks 0DSY).
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmoothOverIntegers_curvesNodal :
    IsSmoothOverIntegers B hZ (C1590Private.isAlgebraicStack_curvesFiberedCategory.{u, w} B hZ)
      (isOpenCurvesLocus_isAtWorstNodal B hZ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReduced_localRing_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E01.** For a point `x` of an algebraic space, the local ring of the space at
`x` is reduced exactly when the stalk at some geometric point above `x` is reduced, and
exactly when the stalk at every geometric point above `x` is reduced.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReduced_localRing_tfae (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (x : points B S hS F) :
    List.TFAE
      [HasLocalRingPropertyAtPoint B S hS F hF x
          (fun (R : Type u) ↦ fun [CommRing R] ↦ _root_.IsReduced R)
          isReduced_localization_etale_invariant,
        ∃ xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS F, xbar.LiesOver x ∧
          _root_.IsReduced (etaleLocalRing B S hS F xbar),
        ∀ xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS F, xbar.LiesOver x →
          _root_.IsReduced (etaleLocalRing B S hS F xbar)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGeometricallyReduced_of_isReduced
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E02, part (2).** Over a perfect field a reduced algebraic space is geometrically
reduced: by Stacks 0DMS it suffices that every étale scheme chart is geometrically reduced,
which over a perfect field is Stacks 020I.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyReduced_of_isReduced [PerfectField k]
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (hred : HasEtaleLocalProperty B (Spec (.of k)) hk X (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced Y)) :
    IsGeometricallyReduced k B hk X hX
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGeometricallyReducedAt_of_isReduced_etaleLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E02, part (1).** Let `X` be an algebraic space over a perfect field `k`, for
example a field of characteristic zero. If the étale local ring `𝒪_{X, x̄}` at a geometric
point `x̄` above `x` is reduced, then `X` is geometrically reduced at `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyReducedAt_of_isReduced_etaleLocalRing
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (x : points B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (xbar : GeometricPoint B (Spec (.of k)) hk X) (hxbar : xbar.LiesOver x)
    (hred : _root_.IsReduced (etaleLocalRing B (Spec (.of k)) hk X xbar)) :
    IsGeometricallyReducedAt k B hk X hX x
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGeometricallyReduced_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E03.** Let `k` be a field of exponential characteristic `p` and let `X` be an
algebraic space over `k`. Then `X` is geometrically reduced over `k` if and only if `X_{k'}`
is reduced for every field extension `k'/k`, if and only if `X_{k'}` is reduced for every
finite purely inseparable extension `k'/k`, if and only if each of `X_{k^{1/p}}`,
`X_{k^{perf}}` and `X_{k̄}` is reduced.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyReduced_tfae (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
    (X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of k)) hk)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (kperf : Type u) [Field kperf] [Algebra k kperf] [ExpChar kperf p] [PerfectRing kperf p]
    [IsPerfectClosure (algebraMap k kperf) p]
    (kbar : Type u) [Field kbar] [Algebra k kbar] [IsAlgClosure k kbar] :
    let isReducedBaseChange := fun (k' : Type u) [Field k'] [Algebra k k'] ↦
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of k)) hk) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
        IsEtale B (Spec (.of k)) hk a →
          IsReduced (pullback (B.inclusion.map U.hom)
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))))
    List.TFAE
      [ IsGeometricallyReduced k B hk X hX,
        ∀ (k' : Type u) [Field k'] [Algebra k k'], isReducedBaseChange k',
        ∀ (k' : Type u) [Field k'] [Algebra k k'] [FiniteDimensional k k']
          [IsPurelyInseparable k k'], isReducedBaseChange k',
        isReducedBaseChange (AdjoinPthRoots k),
        isReducedBaseChange kperf,
        isReducedBaseChange kbar ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGeometricallyReducedAt_relocalizeRestrict_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E04, pointwise statement.** An algebraic space over a field `k` is geometrically
reduced at a point `x` exactly when its base change to a field extension `k'/k` is
geometrically reduced at any point `x'` lying over `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyReducedAt_relocalizeRestrict_iff
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (x : points B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (x' : points B (Spec (.of k')) hk'
      ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict (fieldExtensionMap B k k' hk hk')).obj X))
    (hx : pointsOfRelocalizeRestrict B (Spec (.of k')) (Spec (.of k)) hk' hk
      (fieldExtensionMap B k k' hk hk') X x' = x) :
    IsGeometricallyReducedAt k B hk X hX x ↔
      IsGeometricallyReducedAt k' B hk'
        ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict (fieldExtensionMap B k k' hk hk')).obj X)
        (isAlgebraicSpace_relocalizeRestrict B (Spec (.of k')) (Spec (.of k)) hk' hk
          (fieldExtensionMap B k k' hk hk') X hX) x'
declarations.comment: pointwise equivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGeometricallyReduced_relocalizeRestrict_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E04, global statement.** An algebraic space over a field `k` is geometrically
reduced over `k` exactly when its base change to a field extension `k'/k` is geometrically
reduced over `k'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyReduced_relocalizeRestrict_iff
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X) :
    IsGeometricallyReduced k B hk X hX ↔
      IsGeometricallyReduced k' B hk'
        ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict (fieldExtensionMap B k k' hk hk')).obj X)
        (isAlgebraicSpace_relocalizeRestrict B (Spec (.of k')) (Spec (.of k)) hk' hk
          (fieldExtensionMap B k k' hk hk') X hX)
declarations.comment: global equivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGeometricallyReducedAt_iff_of_isEtaleAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E05, part (1).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over a field
`k` and let `x` be a point of `X` with image `y`. If `f` is étale at `x`, then `X` is
geometrically reduced at `x` if and only if `Y` is geometrically reduced at `y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyReducedAt_iff_of_isEtaleAt
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of k)) hk)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (hf : IsEtaleAt B (Spec (.of k)) hk f x) :
    IsGeometricallyReducedAt k B hk X hX x ↔
      IsGeometricallyReducedAt k B hk Y hY (pointsMap B (Spec (.of k)) hk X f x)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGeometricallyReduced_iff_of_surjective_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E05, part (2).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a surjective étale morphism of algebraic
spaces over a field `k`. Then `X` is geometrically reduced if and only if `Y` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyReduced_iff_of_surjective_isEtale
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of k)) hk)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsEtale B (Spec (.of k)) hk f)
    (hs : IsSurjective B (Spec (.of k)) hk f) :
    IsGeometricallyReduced k B hk X hX ↔ IsGeometricallyReduced k B hk Y hY
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGeometricallyReducedFibre_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E07.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` and a point `y`
of `|Y|` the following are equivalent: (1) the fibre `X_k` is geometrically reduced over `k`
for *some* morphism `Spec k ⟶ Y` in the equivalence class of `y`; (2) the same for *every*
such morphism; (3) the fibre `X_k` is reduced for every such morphism.

Conditions (1) and (2) agree because geometric reducedness of the fibre only depends on the
point of `|Y|` represented by the field-valued point, two representatives of one point having
a common extension. Condition (3) implies (2) because every representative is dominated by
one whose field of definition is algebraically closed, hence perfect, where reducedness of
the fibre already gives geometric reducedness.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyReducedFibre_tfae (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (y : points B S hS Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [ ∃ p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS Y, p.class B S hS Y = y ∧
          IsGeometricallyReducedFibre B S hS f hX hY p,
        ∀ p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS Y, p.class B S hS Y = y →
          IsGeometricallyReducedFibre B S hS f hX hY p,
        ∀ p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS Y, p.class B S hS Y = y →
          HasEtaleLocalProperty B (Spec (.of p.carrier)) p.contained
            (fibreOverFieldValuedPoint B S hS f p) (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T) ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsGeometricallyReducedFibreAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E08.** The fibre of `f : X ⟶ Y` at a point `y` of `|Y|` is *geometrically reduced*
when the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0E07 hold: the fibre over some — equivalently, every —
field-valued representative of `y` is geometrically reduced over the field of that
representative.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsGeometricallyReducedFibreAt (y : points B S hS Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricallyReducedFibreLocus_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E09.** The locus of points with geometrically reduced fibre commutes with base
change: the fibre of the base change `X ×_Y Y' ⟶ Y'` over a point of `|Y'|` is geometrically
reduced exactly when the fibre of `f` over the image of that point in `|Y|` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem geometricallyReducedFibreLocus_pullback {Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y') :
    geometricallyReducedFibreLocus B S hS (pullback.snd f g)
        (isAlgebraicSpace_pullback B S hS f g hX hY' hY) hY' =
      pointsMap B S hS Y' g ⁻¹' geometricallyReducedFibreLocus B S hS f hX hY

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtaleLocallyConstructible_geometricallyReducedFibreLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0A.** For a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is
locally of finite presentation, the set of points of `|Y|` whose fibre is geometrically reduced
is étale locally constructible.

Constructibility is tested on an affine étale chart `h_V ⟶ Y`. There the locus is, by
Stacks 0E09, the locus of the base change `X ×_Y h_V ⟶ h_V`, which is a quasi-compact algebraic
space and so has an affine surjective étale chart `h_A ⟶ X ×_Y h_V`. The induced morphism of
affine schemes `A ⟶ V` is of finite presentation, its scheme-theoretic fibres are surjective
étale charts of the fibres of the base change, and so the locus is the geometrically reduced
fibre locus of `A ⟶ V`; that set is locally constructible by Stacks 0579.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtaleLocallyConstructible_geometricallyReducedFibreLocus
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f) (hfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f) :
    IsEtaleLocallyConstructible B S hS Y (geometricallyReducedFibreLocus B S hS f hX hY)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReduced_of_isReduced_specialFiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0B.** A proper flat algebraic space over a discrete valuation ring is reduced
when its special fibre is reduced.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isReduced_of_isReduced_specialFiber
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hR : B.Contains (Spec (.of R)))
    (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))))
    (X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of R)) hR)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of R)) hR X)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hR))))
    (hproper : IsProper B (Spec (.of R)) hR f)
    (hflat : IsFlat B (Spec (.of R)) hR f)
    (hspecial :
      let g : B.obj hk ⟶ B.obj hR :=
        B.inclusion.preimage
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue R)))
      HasEtaleLocalProperty B
        (Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))) hk
        ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict g).obj X)
        (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T)) :
    HasEtaleLocalProperty B (Spec (.of R)) hR X
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T)
declarations.comment: total space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReduced_genericFiber_of_isReduced_specialFiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0B.** The generic fibre of a proper flat algebraic space over a discrete
valuation ring with reduced special fibre is reduced.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isReduced_genericFiber_of_isReduced_specialFiber
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hR : B.Contains (Spec (.of R)))
    (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))))
    (hK : B.Contains (Spec (.of (FractionRing R))))
    (X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of R)) hR)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of R)) hR X)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hR))))
    (hproper : IsProper B (Spec (.of R)) hR f)
    (hflat : IsFlat B (Spec (.of R)) hR f)
    (hspecial :
      let g : B.obj hk ⟶ B.obj hR :=
        B.inclusion.preimage
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue R)))
      HasEtaleLocalProperty B
        (Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))) hk
        ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict g).obj X)
        (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T)) :
    let g : B.obj hK ⟶ B.obj hR :=
      B.inclusion.preimage
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (FractionRing R))))
    HasEtaleLocalProperty B (Spec (.of (FractionRing R))) hK
      ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict g).obj X)
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T)
declarations.comment: generic fibre

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_geometricallyReducedFibreLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0C.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is flat,
proper and of finite presentation. Then the set of points of `|Y|` at which the fibre of `f` is
geometrically reduced is open in `|Y|`.

The locus is étale locally constructible, Stacks 0E0A, and on every étale scheme chart its
inverse image is stable under generalization,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.stableUnderGeneralization_preimage_geometricallyReducedFibreLocus`;
so `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_geometricallyReducedFibreLocus_of_chart_generalization`
applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpen_geometricallyReducedFibreLocus
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) (hproper : IsProper B S hS f)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f) :
    IsOpen (geometricallyReducedFibreLocus B S hS f hX hY)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinite_and_isEtale_normalizationInQcqsHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0D.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, and let
`X ⟶ Y' ⟶ Y` be its Stein factorization (Stacks 0A1C): `Y'` is the normalization of `Y` in `X`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.normalizationInQcqs`, with structure morphism
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.normalizationInQcqsHom`.  If `f` is of finite presentation, flat, with
geometrically reduced fibres (Stacks 0E08), then `Y' ⟶ Y` is finite étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinite_and_isEtale_normalizationInQcqsHom
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hred : ∀ y, IsGeometricallyReducedFibreAt B S hS f.hom X.2 Y.2 y) :
    let h := isQuasiCompact_isQuasiSeparated_of_isProper B S hS f hf
    IsFinite B S hS (normalizationInQcqsHom B S hS f h.1 h.2).hom ∧
      IsEtale B S hS (normalizationInQcqsHom B S hS f h.1 h.2).hom
declarations.comment: for the Stein factorization X ⟶ Y' ⟶ Y of 0A1C, Y' the normalization of Y in X: Y' ⟶ Y is finite and étale when f is proper, flat, of finite presentation, with geometrically reduced fibres

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_and_factors_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0E.** For a property `P` of families of curves satisfying condition (o):
`Curves^P ⊂ Curves` is an open substack — `P` is invariant under isomorphism, and the inclusion
is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion — and the classifying morphism of a
family factors through `Curves^P` exactly when the family has `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_and_factors_iff
    (hP : IsOpenCurvesLocus B hZ P) :
    (P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ P hP.prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ P hP.prop_of_hom)) ∧
    ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ P.FullSubcategory, z ⋙ P.ι = y) ↔
        P (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))
declarations.comment: the open substack Curves^P cut out by a property P with condition (o), and its universal property (1); part (2) is the special case of (1) at the family of a proper scheme of dimension at most one over a field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGeomred_isOpenSubstack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0G, the open substack.** `Curves^{geomred}`, the strictly full subcategory of
families of curves whose fibres are geometrically reduced (Stacks 0E08), is an open substack of
`Curves`: its inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesGeomred_isOpenSubstack :
    ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ _ (isOpenCurvesLocus_curvesGeomred B hZ).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ _ (isOpenCurvesLocus_curvesGeomred B hZ).prop_of_hom)
declarations.comment: the open substack Curves^{geomred} of Curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_curvesGeomred_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0G, part (1).** The classifying morphism of a family of curves `X ⟶ S` factors
through `Curves^{geomred}` exactly when the fibres of `X ⟶ S` are geometrically reduced
(Stacks 0E08).
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_curvesGeomred_iff (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom) :
    (∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ).FullSubcategory,
        z ⋙ (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ).ι = y) ↔
      IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)))
declarations.comment: part (1): the classifying morphism of a family of curves factors through Curves^{geomred} iff the fibres of the family are geometrically reduced

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_curvesGeomred_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0G, part (2).** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension at most one over a field
`k` (with `Spec k` in the site, so that the classifying morphism `Spec k ⟶ Curves` of `X`
exists). The classifying morphism of `X` factors through `Curves^{geomred}` exactly when `X` is
geometrically reduced over `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_curvesGeomred_over_field_iff
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
    (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom)
    (e : y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) :
    (∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ).FullSubcategory,
        z ⋙ (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ).ι = y) ↔
      IsGeometricallyReducedOver X.hom
declarations.comment: part (2): for a proper scheme of dimension at most one over a field, the classifying morphism factors through Curves^{geomred} iff the scheme is geometrically reduced over the field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGeomred_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0G.** There is an open substack `Curves^{geomred} ⊂ Curves` — the strictly full
subcategory of families of curves with geometrically reduced fibres, whose inclusion is
representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion — such that (1) the classifying morphism
of a family of curves `X ⟶ S` factors through it exactly when the fibres of `X ⟶ S` are
geometrically reduced (Stacks 0E08), and (2) for a proper scheme `X` of dimension at most one
over a field `k`, the classifying morphism of `X` factors through it exactly when `X` is
geometrically reduced over `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesGeomred_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff :
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ _ (isOpenCurvesLocus_curvesGeomred B hZ).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ _ (isOpenCurvesLocus_curvesGeomred B hZ).prop_of_hom)) ∧
    (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ).FullSubcategory,
          z ⋙ (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ).ι = y) ↔
        IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
      (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
      (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ).FullSubcategory,
          z ⋙ (IsGeometricallyReducedFamily B hZ).ι = y) ↔
        IsGeometricallyReducedOver X.hom))
declarations.comment: the whole statement: the open substack Curves^{geomred} and parts (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isOpen_cohenMacaulayBaseLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0I.** The locus of points of the base of a family of curves over which the
family is Cohen–Macaulay is open.

The family is flat and locally of finite presentation, so its Cohen–Macaulay locus in the
total space is open by Tag 0E10, and it is proper, so the image of the complement of that
locus is closed in the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.isOpen_cohenMacaulayBaseLocus (X : CurveFamily B hZ) :
    IsOpen (Space.cohenMacaulayBaseLocus B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom)
declarations.comment: the open locus in the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.preimage_cohenMacaulayBaseLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0I.** The open locus in the base over which a family of curves is
Cohen–Macaulay commutes with base change: for a morphism of families of curves, the locus of
the source is the inverse image of the locus of the target under the morphism of base
schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.preimage_cohenMacaulayBaseLocus {X Y : CurveFamily B hZ} (φ : X ⟶ Y) :
    Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ (schemeSpace X.base).obj (schemeSpaceMap φ.baseMap).hom ⁻¹'
        Space.cohenMacaulayBaseLocus B integerBase hZ Y.toBase.hom =
      Space.cohenMacaulayBaseLocus B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom
declarations.comment: base change of the open locus in the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesCM_isStrictlyFull
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0I.** The condition that a family of curves be Cohen–Macaulay is invariant under
isomorphism, so `Curves^{CM}` is a strictly full subcategory of the category of families of
curves: the first of the three conditions making it an open substack.

An isomorphism of families of curves is a morphism of families, so this is base-change
invariance of Cohen–Macaulayness applied to the inverse isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesCM_isStrictlyFull :
    (show ObjectProperty (CurveFamily B hZ) from
      IsCohenMacaulayFamily B hZ).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms
declarations.comment: strict fullness of the Cohen–Macaulay subcategory

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurvesCM
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0I.** The subcategory `Curves^{CM}`: the strictly full subcategory of families
of curves whose structure morphism is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement: abbrev CurvesCM
declarations.comment: the Cohen–Macaulay subcategory of the category of curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_cohenMacaulayCurves_openSubstack
declarations.doc:
There is an open substack `Curves^{CM} ⊂ Curves` such that

1. for a family of curves `X → S`, the classifying morphism `S → Curves` factors through
   `Curves^{CM}` if and only if `X → S` is Cohen–Macaulay;
2. for a scheme `X` proper over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1`, the classifying morphism
   `Spec(k) → Curves` factors through `Curves^{CM}` if and only if `X` is Cohen–Macaulay.

`Curves` is the category fibred in groupoids of families of curves of Stacks 0D4Z,
`AlgebraicGeometry.curvesFiberedCategory`, over the big fppf site of `Spec(ℤ)`, and an open
substack is an `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FiberedOpenSubstack`: a strictly full subcategory, fibred
in groupoids (so closed under base change), whose inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces
and an open immersion. That is Stacks 04YM without its clause "`Curves^{CM}` is an algebraic
stack", which for an algebraic `Curves` follows from the others by Stacks 05UM, so that the two
notions agree there (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.openSubstackEquivFibered`); the source produces the
open substack by the method of Section 109.6, which only uses the open locus in the base and its
compatibility with base change, and nothing here depends on `Curves` being algebraic (Stacks
0D5A).

The classifying morphism of a family `F` factoring through `Curves^{CM}` is `F` lying in the image
on objects of the inclusion `Curves^{CM} → Curves`; in part (2) the family is
`AlgebraicGeometry.curveFamilyOfProperOverFieldEqSpec`, the family `X → Spec(k)` attached to a
proper morphism `g` of the site onto the spectrum of a field, and dimension is topological Krull
dimension.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_cohenMacaulayCurves_openSubstack :
    ∃ U : Stack.FiberedOpenSubstack (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ),
      (∀ F : CurveFamily B hZ,
        (∃ Y : U.toFibered.val.obj, (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor U.inclusion).obj Y = F) ↔
          IsCohenMacaulayFamily B hZ F) ∧
      (∀ {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
          (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
          (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
          (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1),
        (∃ Y : U.toFibered.val.obj, (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor U.inclusion).obj Y =
            curveFamilyOfProperOverFieldEqSpec B hZ g k hW hproper hdim) ↔
          IsCohenMacaulay ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperFlatStructureSheaf.isIso_c_and_isIso_c_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E0L.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be proper, flat and of finite presentation, with
geometric fibres reduced and connected. Then `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, i.e. `f.c : 𝒪_S ⟶ f_*𝒪_X` is
invertible, and this holds after any base change: for every cartesian square
```
X' --g'--> X
|f'        |f
v          v
S' --g---> S
```
the comparison `f'.c : 𝒪_{S'} ⟶ f'_*𝒪_{X'}` is invertible.

Finite presentation is `LocallyOfFinitePresentation f` together with quasi-compactness and
quasi-separatedness, which properness supplies. The geometric fibres being reduced and connected
is `GeometricallyReduced f` and `GeometricallyConnected f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_c_and_isIso_c_of_isPullback [IsProper f] [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [GeometricallyReduced f] [GeometricallyConnected f] :
    IsIso f.c ∧ ∀ {X' S' : Scheme.{u}} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'},
      IsPullback g' f' f g → IsIso f'.c
declarations.comment: both conclusions: f_*O_X = O_S, as invertibility of the comparison f.c of sheaves of rings, and the same for every base change, stated for every cartesian square over S.

declarations.name: Stacks.SteinFactorization.finite_preimage_singleton_fromNormalization
declarations.doc:
For a universally closed, quasi-separated morphism `f` that is locally of finite type, the
fibres of the second map `π` of the factorization `X ⟶ f.normalization ⟶ S` are finite.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_preimage_singleton_fromNormalization (s : S) :
    (f.fromNormalization ⁻¹' {s}).Finite
declarations.comment: finite_fibre

declarations.name: Stacks.SteinFactorization.finite_residueFieldMap_fromNormalization
declarations.doc:
For a universally closed, quasi-separated morphism `f` that is locally of finite type, the
residue field of `f.normalization` at a point is a finite extension of the residue field of `S` at
its image under the second map `π` of the factorization: the ring map `κ(π s') ⟶ κ(s')` makes
`κ(s')` a finite `κ(π s')`-module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_residueFieldMap_fromNormalization (s' : f.normalization) :
    (f.fromNormalization.residueFieldMap s').hom.Finite
declarations.comment: finite_residue_extensions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyConstant_numGeometricConnectedComponents
declarations.doc:
**The number of geometric connected components of the fibres is locally constant**, for
`f : X ⟶ S` proper, flat, of finite presentation, with geometrically reduced fibres.

It is lower semicontinuous by [Stacks, Tag 0BUI], and it is the degree-zero derived-fibre Betti
function of the perfect object `Rf_*𝒪_X` (`numGeometricConnectedComponents_eq_derivedFiberBetti`),
which is upper semicontinuous by part (2) of [Stacks, Tag 0BDI]
(`DerivedFibreBetti.upperSemicontinuous_derivedFiberBetti`). The hypothesis `hred` that the
geometric fibres are reduced asks this of the base change of `f` to the spectrum of every
algebraically closed field; it gives Mathlib's `GeometricallyReduced f`, reducedness after base
change to every field, by `geometricallyReduced_iff_forall_isAlgClosed`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_numGeometricConnectedComponents
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hred : ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (s : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S),
      IsReduced (pullback f s)) :
    IsLocallyConstant (numGeometricConnectedComponents f)

declarations.name: Dualizing.isDualizingComplex_derivedExtensionScalars_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E0P.** Let `k ⊆ K` be an extension of fields and let `A` be a
`k`-algebra of finite type.  The derived base change of a dualizing complex for `A` along
`A → A_K = K ⊗_k A` is a dualizing complex for `A_K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDualizingComplex_derivedExtensionScalars_fieldExtension
    {ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)}
    (hω : letI : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k A
      IsDualizingComplex ω) :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing (TensorProduct k K A) :=
      Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing K (TensorProduct k K A)
    IsDualizingComplex
      ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u}
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          A →ₐ[k] TensorProduct k K A).toRingHom).functor.obj ω)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.setOf_isGorensteinAt_pullback_eq_preimage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E0Q.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be flat and locally of finite type, and let
`g : Y' ⟶ Y` be an arbitrary morphism. Then the set of points of `X ×_Y Y'` at which the base
change of `f` along `g` is Gorenstein is the inverse image, under the projection to `X`, of the
set of points of `X` at which `f` is Gorenstein; that is, formation of the Gorenstein locus of
`f` commutes with arbitrary base change.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.setOf_isGorensteinAt_pullback_eq_preimage_of_locallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be flat and locally of finite type and let `g : Y' ⟶ Y` be an arbitrary
morphism of schemes. Then the set of points of `X ×_Y Y'` at which the base change of `f` along
`g` is Gorenstein is the inverse image, under the projection to `X`, of the set of points of `X`
at which `f` is Gorenstein: formation of the Gorenstein locus of `f` commutes with arbitrary base
change. The locally Noetherian fibres that the Gorenstein-at-a-point predicate needs as data are
theorems here, so nothing is assumed beyond flatness of `f` and its being locally of finite
type.
declarations.statement:
public theorem setOf_isGorensteinAt_pullback_eq_preimage_of_locallyOfFiniteType
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] :
    {x' : (pullback f g : Scheme.{u}) |
        IsGorensteinAt (pullback.snd f g)
          (fun y' => LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian
            ((pullback.snd f g).fiberToSpecResidueField y')) x'} =
      (pullback.fst f g).base ⁻¹'
        {x : X |
          IsGorensteinAt f
            (fun y => LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian
              (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y)) x}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fibreBetti_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0R, part (1): the formation of `β_i` commutes with arbitrary base change.** For
`f : X ⟶ Y` proper and of finite presentation, `𝓕` of finite presentation and flat over `Y`,
and any morphism `g : Y' ⟶ Y` of schemes of the site, the `i`-th Betti-number function of the
base change `(X ×_Y Y' ⟶ Y', 𝓕_{Y'})` is `β_i ∘ g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem fibreBetti_baseChange (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hFfp : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hF : IsFlatOver B S hS X.2 f.hom F)
    {U' : BigFppfOver B S hS} (g : U' ⟶ U) (i : ℤ) :
    fibreBetti (pullback.snd f (representedSpaceMap B S hS g))
        ((modulePullback B S hS (pullback.fst f (representedSpaceMap B S hS g))).obj F) i =
      fibreBetti f F i ∘ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g).base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.upperSemicontinuous_fibreBetti
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0R, part (2): the Betti numbers of the fibres are upper semicontinuous.** For
`f : X ⟶ Y` proper and of finite presentation and `𝓕` of finite presentation and flat over `Y`,
the function `y ↦ dim_{κ(y)} Hⁱ(X_y, 𝓕_y)` is upper semicontinuous on `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem upperSemicontinuous_fibreBetti (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hFfp : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hF : IsFlatOver B S hS X.2 f.hom F) (i : ℤ) :
    UpperSemicontinuous (fibreBetti f F i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyConstructible_fibreBetti_preimage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0R, part (3): the level sets of the Betti numbers of the fibres are locally
constructible.** For `f : X ⟶ Y` proper and of finite presentation and `𝓕` of finite
presentation and flat over `Y`, each set `{y | dim_{κ(y)} Hⁱ(X_y, 𝓕_y) = n}` is locally
constructible in `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyConstructible_fibreBetti_preimage (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hFfp : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hF : IsFlatOver B S hS X.2 f.hom F) (i : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    Topology.IsLocallyConstructible (fibreBetti f F i ⁻¹' {n})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ProperFlatStein.isLocallyConstructible_fibreBetti_preimage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0R, part (3): the level sets of the Betti numbers of the fibres are locally
constructible.** For `f : X ⟶ Y` proper and of finite presentation and `𝓕` of finite
presentation and flat over `Y`, each set `{y | dim_{κ(y)} Hⁱ(X_y, 𝓕_y) = n}` is locally
constructible in `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyConstructible_fibreBetti_preimage (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hFfp : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hF : IsFlatOver B S hS X.2 f.hom F) (i : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    Topology.IsLocallyConstructible (fibreBettiFunction f F i ⁻¹' {n})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ProperFlatStein.fibreBetti_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0R, part (1): the formation of `β_i` commutes with arbitrary base change.** For
`f : X ⟶ Y` proper and of finite presentation, `𝓕` of finite presentation and flat over `Y`,
and any morphism `g : Y' ⟶ Y` of schemes of the site, the `i`-th Betti-number function of the
base change `(X ×_Y Y' ⟶ Y', 𝓕_{Y'})` is `β_i ∘ g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem fibreBetti_baseChange (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hFfp : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hF : IsFlatOver B S hS X.2 f.hom F)
    {U' : BigFppfOver B S hS} (g : U' ⟶ U) (i : ℤ) :
    fibreBettiFunction (pullback.snd f (representedSpaceMap B S hS g))
        ((modulePullback B S hS (pullback.fst f (representedSpaceMap B S hS g))).obj F) i =
      fibreBettiFunction f F i ∘ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g).base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ProperFlatStein.upperSemicontinuous_fibreBetti
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0R, part (2): the Betti numbers of the fibres are upper semicontinuous.** For
`f : X ⟶ Y` proper and of finite presentation and `𝓕` of finite presentation and flat over `Y`,
the function `y ↦ dim_{κ(y)} Hⁱ(X_y, 𝓕_y)` is upper semicontinuous on `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem upperSemicontinuous_fibreBetti (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hFfp : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hF : IsFlatOver B S hS X.2 f.hom F) (i : ℤ) :
    UpperSemicontinuous (fibreBettiFunction f F i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_structureSharp_and_baseChange_of_geometricFibres
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces which is proper, flat and of finite
presentation, and whose geometric fibres are reduced and connected. Then `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_Y` — the
structure map `𝒪_Y ⟶ f_*𝒪_X` is an isomorphism — and this holds after any base change
`Y' ⟶ Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_structureSharp_and_baseChange_of_geometricFibres (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (hred : ∀ y : GeometricPoint B S hS Y.1,
      HasEtaleLocalProperty B (Spec (.of y.1.carrier)) y.1.contained
        (fibreOverFieldValuedPoint B S hS f.hom y.1)
        (fun T : Scheme.{u} => _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced T))
    (hconn : ∀ y : GeometricPoint B S hS Y.1,
      ConnectedPoints B (Spec (.of y.1.carrier)) y.1.contained
        (fibreOverFieldValuedPoint B S hS f.hom y.1)) :
    IsIso (structureSharp B S hS f) ∧
      ∀ (Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (g : Y' ⟶ Y),
        IsIso (structureSharp B S hS (pullback.snd f g))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasCohenMacaulayFiberLocalRing_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
Having a Noetherian and Cohen–Macaulay local ring of the fibre is étale local on the source
and target germs.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsCohenMacaulayAt
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *Cohen–Macaulay at* a point `x` of its source
when it is flat at `x` and the local ring of its fibre is Noetherian and Cohen–Macaulay in every
pointed étale scheme chart at `x`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsCohenMacaulayAt (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1): at a point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsCohenMacaulay
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *Cohen–Macaulay* when it is Cohen–Macaulay at
every point of its source.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsCohenMacaulay (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2): morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasCohenMacaulayFibersOnChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0W.** The fibres of `f` over the points of the étale scheme chart
`g : h_V ⟶ Y` are Cohen–Macaulay algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
abbrev HasCohenMacaulayFibersOnChart {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) : Prop
declarations.comment: the fibre condition on an étale scheme chart of the target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulay_tfae_etaleCharts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0W.** For a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with locally Noetherian
fibres, Cohen–Macaulayness is equivalent to flatness together with Cohen–Macaulayness of the
fibres after some, equivalently after every, étale scheme chart of the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulay_tfae_etaleCharts (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibers B S hS f) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsCohenMacaulay B S hS f,
      IsFlat B S hS f ∧
        ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
          (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
            (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
          IsEtale B S hS g ∧ HasCohenMacaulayFibersOnChart B S hS f V g,
      IsFlat B S hS f ∧
        ∀ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
          IsEtale B S hS g → HasCohenMacaulayFibersOnChart B S hS f V g]
declarations.comment: equivalence of conditions (1), (2) and (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayAt_iff_etaleLocalRingMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0W.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is Cohen–Macaulay at the image of
a geometric point `x` of its source exactly when the canonical homomorphism of étale local
rings at `x` is flat and its local fibre ring is Noetherian, local and Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_iff_etaleLocalRingMap (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X) :
    IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS f x.image ↔
      ((etaleLocalRingMap hX f x).Flat ∧
        ∃ (hN : IsNoetherianRing
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS X x ⧸ etaleLocalFiberIdeal B S hS hX hY f x))
          (hL : IsLocalRing
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS X x ⧸ etaleLocalFiberIdeal B S hS hX hY f x)),
          @IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS X x ⧸ etaleLocalFiberIdeal B S hS hX hY f x) _ hN hL)
declarations.comment: equivalence of conditions (a) and (b)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayAt_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0X, part (1).** The composite of two morphisms of algebraic spaces with
locally Noetherian fibres is Cohen–Macaulay at a point of its source as soon as the first
is Cohen–Macaulay there and the second is Cohen–Macaulay at the image of that point.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_comp
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS g)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (x : points B S hS X) (hfx : IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS f x)
    (hgy : IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS g (pointsMap B S hS X f x)) :
    IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS (f ≫ g) x
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulay_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0X, part (2).** The composite of two Cohen–Macaulay morphisms of algebraic
spaces with locally Noetherian fibres is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulay_comp
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS g)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (hfm : IsCohenMacaulay B S hS f) (hgm : IsCohenMacaulay B S hS g) :
    IsCohenMacaulay B S hS (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayAt_left_of_comp_of_isFlatAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0X, part (3), first conclusion.** If the composite is Cohen–Macaulay at `x`
and the first morphism is flat at `x`, then the first morphism is Cohen–Macaulay at `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_left_of_comp_of_isFlatAt
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}

    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (x : points B S hS X) (hcomp : IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS (f ≫ g) x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayAt_right_of_comp_of_isFlatAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0X, part (3), second conclusion.** If the composite is Cohen–Macaulay at `x`
and the first morphism is flat at `x`, then the second morphism is Cohen–Macaulay at the
image of `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_right_of_comp_of_isFlatAt
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hg : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS g)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (x : points B S hS X) (hcomp : IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS (f ≫ g) x)

    IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS g (pointsMap B S hS X f x)
declarations.comment: part (3), second conclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulay_left_of_comp_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0X, part (4), first conclusion.** If the composite is Cohen–Macaulay and the
first morphism is flat, then the first morphism is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulay_left_of_comp_of_isFlat
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (hcomp : IsCohenMacaulay B S hS (f ≫ g)) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) :
    IsCohenMacaulay B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (4), first conclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayAt_right_of_comp_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0X, part (4), second conclusion.** If the composite is Cohen–Macaulay and the
first morphism is flat, then the second morphism is Cohen–Macaulay at every point in the image
of the first.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_right_of_comp_of_isFlat
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
