declarations.comment: part (4), second conclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulay_of_isCohenMacaulay_source
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0Y.** A flat morphism of locally Noetherian algebraic spaces over `S` whose
source is a Cohen–Macaulay algebraic space is a Cohen–Macaulay morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulay_of_isCohenMacaulay_source (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hNX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hNY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hCM : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsCohenMacaulay T))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFlat B S hS f) :
    IsCohenMacaulay B S hS f
declarations.comment: the morphism is Cohen-Macaulay

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayLocalRing_etaleLocalRing_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0Y.** For a flat morphism of locally Noetherian algebraic spaces over `S` whose
source is a Cohen–Macaulay algebraic space, the étale local ring of the target at the image of
any geometric point of the source is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayLocalRing_etaleLocalRing_target (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hNX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hNY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hCM : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsCohenMacaulay T))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFlat B S hS f) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f x)) :=
      isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS Y hY (geometricPointMap f x)
    letI : IsNoetherianRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f x)) :=
      isNoetherianRing_etaleLocalRing_of_isLocallyNoetherian B S hS Y hY hNY
        (geometricPointMap f x)
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f x))
declarations.comment: the target étale local rings are Cohen-Macaulay

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayAt_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0Z, part (1).** Cohen–Macaulayness of a morphism of algebraic spaces with
locally Noetherian fibres at a point is preserved by base change along a morphism locally of
finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_pullback_snd
    {X Y Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y') (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) (x' : points B S hS (pullback f g))
    (hcm : IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS f
      (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.fst f g) x')) :
    IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS (pullback.snd f g) x'
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayAt_of_pullback_snd_of_isFlatAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0Z, part (2).** Cohen–Macaulayness descends from the base change when the
original morphism is flat at the point in question.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_of_pullback_snd_of_isFlatAt
    {X Y Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y') (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) (x' : points B S hS (pullback f g))
    (hflat : IsFlatAt B S hS f (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.fst f g) x'))
    (hcm : IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS (pullback.snd f g) x') :
    IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS f
      (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.fst f g) x')
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayAt_of_pullback_snd_of_isFlatAt_base
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E0Z, part (3).** Cohen–Macaulayness descends from the base change when the base
morphism is flat at the corresponding point.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_of_pullback_snd_of_isFlatAt_base
    {X Y Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y') (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) (x' : points B S hS (pullback f g))
    (hflat : IsFlatAt B S hS g (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.snd f g) x'))
    (hcm : IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS (pullback.snd f g) x') :
    IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS f
      (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.fst f g) x')
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_setOf_isCohenMacaulayAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E10.** The Cohen–Macaulay locus of a flat morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`
which is locally of finite presentation is open in the canonical topology of Tag 03BX on the
point space of its source.
declarations.comment: openness of the Cohen–Macaulay locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulayAt_pullback_locus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E10.** The Cohen–Macaulay locus of a flat morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`
which is locally of finite presentation commutes with arbitrary base change: the locus of the
base change `X ×_Y Y' ⟶ Y'` is the inverse image of the locus of `f : X ⟶ Y` under the
projection to `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_pullback_locus {X Y Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (hf_flat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hf_lfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) :
    {x' : points B S hS (pullback f.hom g.hom) |
        IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS (pullback.snd f.hom g.hom) x'} =
      pointsMap B S hS (pullback f.hom g.hom) (pullback.fst f.hom g.hom) ⁻¹'
        {x : points B S hS X.1 | IsCohenMacaulayAt B S hS f.hom x}
declarations.comment: base change of the Cohen–Macaulay locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_clopen_relativeDimension_decomposition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E11.** A locally finitely presented Cohen–Macaulay morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S` decomposes its source into open-and-closed subspaces of constant relative dimension:
there is a family `Xd : ℕ → Subfunctor X` of subfunctors which are both open and closed
subspaces of `X` in the sense of Tag 02YU, whose point sets cover the point space of `X` and are
pairwise disjoint, and such that the restriction of `f` to the `d`-th piece has relative
dimension `d`.

The pieces are given by their point sets rather than by a supremum of subfunctors: the ranges of
their inclusions are subpresheaves, so a section over a test object which the decomposition
splits into several pieces lies in no single piece before refinement.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_clopen_relativeDimension_decomposition (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f) (hCM : IsCohenMacaulay B S hS f) :
    ∃ Xd : ℕ → Subfunctor X,
      (∀ d : ℕ, IsOpenSubspace B S hS (Xd d) ∧ IsClosedSubspace B S hS (Xd d)) ∧
      (∀ x : points B S hS X, ∃ d : ℕ,
        x ∈ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (Xd d).toFunctor (Xd d).ι)) ∧
      Pairwise (Disjoint on fun d : ℕ =>
        Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (Xd d).toFunctor (Xd d).ι)) ∧
      (∀ d : ℕ, HasRelativeDimension d B S hS ((Xd d).ι ≫ f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasGorensteinFiberLocalRing_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E13.** Having a Noetherian and Gorenstein
local ring of the fibre is étale local on the source and target germs.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsGorensteinAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E14, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *Gorenstein at* a
point `x` of its source when it is flat at `x` and the local ring of its fibre is Noetherian
and Gorenstein in every pointed étale scheme chart at `x`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsGorensteinAt (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1): at a point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsGorenstein
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E14, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *Gorenstein* when
it is Gorenstein at every point of its source.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsGorenstein (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2): morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorenstein_tfae_etaleCharts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E15.** For a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with locally Noetherian fibres,
Gorensteinness is equivalent to flatness together with Gorensteinness of the fibres after some,
equivalently after every, étale scheme chart of the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorenstein_tfae_etaleCharts (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibers B S hS f) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsGorenstein B S hS f,
      IsFlat B S hS f ∧
        ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
          (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
            (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
          IsEtale B S hS g ∧ HasGorensteinFibersOnChart B S hS f V g,
      IsFlat B S hS f ∧
        ∀ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
          IsEtale B S hS g → HasGorensteinFibersOnChart B S hS f V g]
declarations.comment: global_gorenstein_equivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinAt_iff_etaleLocalRingMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E15.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is Gorenstein at the image of a
geometric point `x` of its source exactly when the canonical homomorphism of étale local rings
at `x` is flat and its local fibre ring is Noetherian, local and Gorenstein.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinAt_iff_etaleLocalRingMap (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X) :
    IsGorensteinAt B S hS f x.image ↔
      ((etaleLocalRingMap hX f x).Flat ∧
        ∃ (hN : IsNoetherianRing
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS X x ⧸ etaleLocalFiberIdeal B S hS hX hY f x))
          (hL : IsLocalRing
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS X x ⧸ etaleLocalFiberIdeal B S hS hX hY f x)),
          @Dualizing.IsGorensteinLocalRing
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS X x ⧸ etaleLocalFiberIdeal B S hS hX hY f x) _ hN hL)
declarations.comment: etale_local_ring_criterion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinAt_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E16, part (1).** The composite of two morphisms of algebraic spaces with locally
Noetherian fibres is Gorenstein at a point of its source as soon as the first is Gorenstein
there and the second is Gorenstein at the image of that point.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinAt_comp
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS g)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (x : points B S hS X) (hfx : IsGorensteinAt B S hS f x)
    (hgy : IsGorensteinAt B S hS g (pointsMap B S hS X f x)) :
    IsGorensteinAt B S hS (f ≫ g) x
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorenstein_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E16, part (2).** The composite of two Gorenstein morphisms of algebraic spaces
with locally Noetherian fibres is Gorenstein.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorenstein_comp
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS g)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (hfm : IsGorenstein B S hS f) (hgm : IsGorenstein B S hS g) :
    IsGorenstein B S hS (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinAt_left_of_comp_of_isFlatAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E16, part (3), first conclusion.** If the composite is Gorenstein at `x` and the
first morphism is flat at `x`, then the first morphism is Gorenstein at `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinAt_left_of_comp_of_isFlatAt
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS g)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (x : points B S hS X) (hcomp : IsGorensteinAt B S hS (f ≫ g) x)
    (hflat : IsFlatAt B S hS f x) : IsGorensteinAt B S hS f x
declarations.comment: part (3), first conclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinAt_right_of_comp_of_isFlatAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E16, part (3), second conclusion.** If the composite is Gorenstein at `x` and the
first morphism is flat at `x`, then the second morphism is Gorenstein at the image of `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinAt_right_of_comp_of_isFlatAt
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS g)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (x : points B S hS X) (hcomp : IsGorensteinAt B S hS (f ≫ g) x)
    (hflat : IsFlatAt B S hS f x) :
    IsGorensteinAt B S hS g (pointsMap B S hS X f x)
declarations.comment: part (3), second conclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorenstein_left_of_comp_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E16, part (4), first conclusion.** If the composite is Gorenstein and the first
morphism is flat, then the first morphism is Gorenstein.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorenstein_left_of_comp_of_isFlat
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS g)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (hcomp : IsGorenstein B S hS (f ≫ g)) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) :
    IsGorenstein B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (4), first conclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinAt_right_of_comp_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E16, part (4), second conclusion.** If the composite is Gorenstein and the first
morphism is flat, then the second morphism is Gorenstein at every point in the image of the
first.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinAt_right_of_comp_of_isFlat
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS g)
    (hgf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (hcomp : IsGorenstein B S hS (f ≫ g)) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f)
    (x : points B S hS X) :
    IsGorensteinAt B S hS g (pointsMap B S hS X f x)
declarations.comment: part (4), second conclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorenstein_of_isGorenstein_source
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E17.** A flat morphism of locally Noetherian algebraic spaces over `S` whose
source is a Gorenstein algebraic space is a Gorenstein morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorenstein_of_isGorenstein_source (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hNX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hNY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hG : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsGorenstein T))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFlat B S hS f) :
    IsGorenstein B S hS f
declarations.comment: the morphism is Gorenstein

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinLocalRing_etaleLocalRing_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E17.** For a flat morphism of locally Noetherian algebraic spaces over `S` whose
source is a Gorenstein algebraic space, the étale local ring of the target at the image of any
geometric point of the source is Gorenstein.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinLocalRing_etaleLocalRing_target (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hNX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hNY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hG : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsGorenstein T))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFlat B S hS f) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f x)) :=
      isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS Y hY (geometricPointMap f x)
    letI : IsNoetherianRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f x)) :=
      isNoetherianRing_etaleLocalRing_of_isLocallyNoetherian B S hS Y hY hNY
        (geometricPointMap f x)
    Dualizing.IsGorensteinLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f x))
declarations.comment: the target étale local rings are Gorenstein

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinAt_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E18, part (1).** Gorensteinness of a morphism of algebraic spaces with locally
Noetherian fibres at a point is preserved by base change along a morphism locally of finite
type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinAt_pullback_snd
    {X Y Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y') (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) (x' : points B S hS (pullback f g))
    (hgor : IsGorensteinAt B S hS f
      (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.fst f g) x')) :
    IsGorensteinAt B S hS (pullback.snd f g) x'
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinAt_of_pullback_snd_of_isFlatAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E18, part (2).** Gorensteinness descends from the base change when the original
morphism is flat at the point in question.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinAt_of_pullback_snd_of_isFlatAt
    {X Y Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y') (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) (x' : points B S hS (pullback f g))
    (hflat : IsFlatAt B S hS f (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.fst f g) x'))
    (hgor : IsGorensteinAt B S hS (pullback.snd f g) x') :
    IsGorensteinAt B S hS f
      (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.fst f g) x')
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinAt_of_pullback_snd_of_isFlatAt_base
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E18, part (3).** Gorensteinness descends from the base change when the base
morphism is flat at the corresponding point.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinAt_of_pullback_snd_of_isFlatAt_base
    {X Y Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y') (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : HasLocallyNoetherianFibersAtPoints B S hS f)
    (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) (x' : points B S hS (pullback f g))
    (hflat : IsFlatAt B S hS g (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.snd f g) x'))
    (hgor : IsGorensteinAt B S hS (pullback.snd f g) x') :
    IsGorensteinAt B S hS f
      (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f g) (pullback.fst f g) x')
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_setOf_isGorensteinAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E19.** The Gorenstein locus of a flat morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which
is locally of finite presentation is open in the canonical topology of Tag 03BX on the point
space of its source.
declarations.comment: openness of the Gorenstein locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGorensteinAt_pullback_locus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E19.** The Gorenstein locus of a flat morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which
is locally of finite presentation commutes with arbitrary base change: the locus of the base
change `X ×_Y Y' ⟶ Y'` is the inverse image of the locus of `f : X ⟶ Y` under the projection
to `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinAt_pullback_locus {X Y Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (hf_flat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hf_lfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) :
    {x' : points B S hS (pullback f.hom g.hom) |
        IsGorensteinAt B S hS (pullback.snd f.hom g.hom) x'} =
      pointsMap B S hS (pullback f.hom g.hom) (pullback.fst f.hom g.hom) ⁻¹'
        {x : points B S hS X.1 | IsGorensteinAt B S hS f.hom x}
declarations.comment: base change of the Gorenstein locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.numberGeometricConnectedComponents_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1B.** The number of geometric connected components of the fibres of a morphism
of algebraic spaces is, at the image of a geometric point, the number of connected components
of the fibre over that geometric point. In particular the defining infimum is attained at every
geometric representative.
declarations.statement:
theorem numberGeometricConnectedComponents_eq (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (f : F ⟶ G) (p : GeometricPoint B S hS G) :
    numberGeometricConnectedComponents B S hS f p.image =
      geometricFiberComponentCount B S hS f p.val
declarations.comment: well-definedness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.numberGeometricConnectedComponents_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1B.** Formation of the number of geometric connected components of the fibres
commutes with arbitrary base change: the function attached to the projection `F ×_G H ⟶ H` is
the function attached to `f : F ⟶ G` composed with the map `|H| → |G|` on points.
declarations.statement:
theorem numberGeometricConnectedComponents_baseChange
    {H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H) (f : F ⟶ G) (g : H ⟶ G) :
    numberGeometricConnectedComponents B S hS (pullback.snd f g) =
      numberGeometricConnectedComponents B S hS f ∘ pointsMap B S hS H g
declarations.comment: base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.numberGeometricConnectedComponents
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1B.** The number of geometric connected components of the fibres of a morphism
of algebraic spaces: the function on the points of the target whose value at `y` is the number
of connected components of the fibre over any geometric point representing `y`.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_geometricRepresentative` the set whose infimum is taken is
nonempty, and the source lemma is that all of its elements agree.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def numberGeometricConnectedComponents
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G) : points B S hS G → ℕ∞
declarations.comment: function

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isAffine_finite_fibres_normalizationInQcqs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1C.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a universally closed and quasi-separated morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S` and `X ⟶ Y' ⟶ Y` its Stein factorization of Stacks 0A19, the
normalization `π : Y' ⟶ Y` of `Y` in `X`.  Assume in addition that `f` is locally of finite type
and that `Y` is affine, represented by an affine `T`.  Then `Y'` is represented by an affine
`T'`, with `π` represented by `p : T' ⟶ T`, and for every point `y` of `Y` the fibre
`π⁻¹({y})` is finite and the residue field extension `κ(y')/κ(y)` is finite for every `y'` in
it.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAffine_finite_fibres_normalizationInQcqs {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (huc : UniversallyClosed B S hS f.hom) (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hlft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (hT : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T))
    (eY : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y.obj) [IsIso eY] :
    ∃ (T' : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : T' ⟶ T)
      (e : yoneda.obj T' ⟶ (normalizationInQcqs B S hS f
        (isQuasiCompact_of_universallyClosed B S hS X.property Y.property f.hom huc) hfqs).obj),
      IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T') ∧ IsIso e ∧
      yoneda.map p ≫ eY = e ≫ (normalizationInQcqsHom B S hS f
        (isQuasiCompact_of_universallyClosed B S hS X.property Y.property f.hom huc) hfqs).hom ∧
      ∀ y : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T,
        (((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map p) ⁻¹' {y}).Finite ∧
        ∀ y' ∈ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map p) ⁻¹' {y},
          (((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map p).residueFieldMap y').hom.Finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.lowerSemicontinuous_numberGeometricConnectedComponents
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1D.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is proper,
flat and of finite presentation.  Then the function `n_{X/Y} : |Y| → ℕ∞` counting the geometric
connected components of the fibres of `f` (Stacks 0E1B,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.numberGeometricConnectedComponents`) is lower semicontinuous.
declarations.statement:
theorem lowerSemicontinuous_numberGeometricConnectedComponents
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hproper : IsProper B S hS f)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f) :
    LowerSemicontinuous (numberGeometricConnectedComponents B S hS f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyConstant_numberGeometricConnectedComponents
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1E.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is proper,
flat and of finite presentation, and whose geometric fibres are reduced. Then the function
`n_{X/Y} : |Y| → ℕ∞` counting the geometric connected components of the fibres of `f`
(Stacks 0E1B) is locally constant.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_numberGeometricConnectedComponents
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f) (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f) (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f)
    (hred : ∀ y, IsGeometricallyReducedFibreAt B S hS f hX hY y) :
    IsLocallyConstant (numberGeometricConnectedComponents B S hS f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.preimage_cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1F.** The locus in the base over which a family of curves is Cohen–Macaulay and
has relative dimension one commutes with base change: for a morphism of families of curves, the
locus of the source is the inverse image of the locus of the target under the morphism of base
schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.preimage_cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus {X Y : CurveFamily B hZ} (φ : X ⟶ Y) :
    Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ (schemeSpace X.base).obj (schemeSpaceMap φ.baseMap).hom ⁻¹'
        CurveFamily.cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus B hZ Y =
      CurveFamily.cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus B hZ X
declarations.comment: base change of the locus in the base of Cohen–Macaulay relative dimension one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isOpen_relativeDimensionOneBaseLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1F.** For a Cohen–Macaulay family of curves the locus in the base over which the
family has relative dimension one is open.

By Tag 0E11 the total space is the disjoint union of open-and-closed subspaces of constant
relative dimension, and since relative dimension at a point is unique the locus of relative
dimension one in the total space is the point set of the piece of relative dimension one. That
set is open, so its complement is closed, and the family is proper, so the image of that
complement — the complement of the locus in the base — is closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.isOpen_relativeDimensionOneBaseLocus (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hX : IsCohenMacaulayFamily B hZ X) :
    IsOpen (CurveFamily.relativeDimensionOneBaseLocus B hZ X)
declarations.comment: the open locus in the base of relative dimension one, for a Cohen–Macaulay family

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isOpen_cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1F.** For a Cohen–Macaulay family of curves the locus in the base over which the
family is Cohen–Macaulay and has relative dimension one is open: the Cohen–Macaulay locus is
then the whole base.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.isOpen_cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hX : IsCohenMacaulayFamily B hZ X) :
    IsOpen (CurveFamily.cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus B hZ X)
declarations.comment: the open locus in the base of Cohen–Macaulay relative dimension one, for a CM family

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesCM1_isStrictlyFull
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1F.** The condition that a family of curves be Cohen–Macaulay of relative
dimension one is invariant under isomorphism, so `Curves^{CM,1}` is a strictly full subcategory
of the category of families of curves: the first of the three conditions making it an open
substack.

An isomorphism of families of curves is a morphism of families, so this is base-change
invariance of the condition applied to the inverse isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesCM1_isStrictlyFull :
    (show ObjectProperty (CurveFamily B hZ) from
      IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms
declarations.comment: strict fullness of the Cohen–Macaulay subcategory of relative dimension one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurvesCM1
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1F.** The subcategory `Curves^{CM,1}`: the strictly full subcategory of families
of curves whose structure morphism is Cohen–Macaulay of relative dimension one.
declarations.statement: abbrev CurvesCM1
declarations.comment: the Cohen–Macaulay subcategory of relative dimension one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus_isOpen
declarations.doc:
**The locus of Cohen–Macaulay relative dimension one is open.** For every family of curves
`f : X → S`, the set of points of `S` over which `f` is Cohen–Macaulay and has relative
dimension one is open.

The set of points of the total space at which `f` is Cohen–Macaulay of relative dimension one is
open (Tags 0E10 and 0E11), and `f` is proper, so the image of its complement — the complement
of the locus — is closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus_isOpen (X : CurveFamily B hZ) :
    IsOpen (CurveFamily.cohenMacaulayDimOneBaseLocus B hZ X)
declarations.comment: the open locus in the base of Cohen–Macaulay relative dimension one, for an arbitrary family

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenCurvesLocus_isCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily
declarations.doc:
**Condition (o) of Section 0E0E for `Curves^{CM,1}`.** For every family of curves `X → S`
there is an open subset `S'` of the base such that a family of curves mapping to `X → S` is
Cohen–Macaulay of relative dimension one exactly when its base maps into `S'`: the locus of
Cohen–Macaulay relative dimension one, which is open for every family and commutes with base
change.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenCurvesLocus_isCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily :
    IsOpenCurvesLocus B hZ (IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ)
declarations.comment: condition (o) of 0E0E: the open locus in the base, for an arbitrary family

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily_curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism_iff
declarations.doc:
**Part (2) of Stacks 0E1F, on the family.** Let `g : T ⟶ U` be a morphism of the big fppf
site of the integers whose target scheme is the spectrum of a field `k`, whose underlying
morphism of schemes is proper, and whose source scheme has dimension at most one. Then the
family of curves of `g` is Cohen–Macaulay of relative dimension one exactly when the source
scheme is Cohen–Macaulay and equidimensional of dimension one, every irreducible component of it
having dimension one.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily_curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism_iff
    {T U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ U) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (hU : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj U = Spec (.of k))
    (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1) :
    IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ
        (curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g
          (flat_of_eq_spec_field _ k hU) hproper
          (locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_eq_spec_field _ k hU)
          (Space.isQuasiCompact_yoneda_map B integerBase hZ g inferInstance)
          ((Space.isSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance)
          ((Space.isQuasiSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance)
          hdim) ↔
      (IsCohenMacaulay ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ∧
        TopologicalSpace.Equidimensional ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ∧
        ∀ W ∈ irreducibleComponents ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T),
          topologicalKrullDim W = (1 : WithBot ℕ∞))
declarations.comment: part (2), on the family of curves of the proper scheme: Cohen–Macaulay and equidimensional of dimension one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_cohenMacaulayDimOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1F, `Curves^{CM,1}` is open in `Curves`.** The inclusion into the category fibred
in groupoids of families of curves of the full subcategory `Curves^{CM,1}` of the families which
are Cohen–Macaulay of relative dimension one is representable by algebraic spaces and an open
immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_cohenMacaulayDimOne :
    Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ)
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_isCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ)
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_isCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ).prop_of_hom)
declarations.comment: the inclusion of Curves^{CM,1} into Curves is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_cohenMacaulayDimOne_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1F, part (1).** Let `X → S` be a family of curves and `z : (Sch/S) → Curves` a
classifying morphism for it, a scheme-valued point together with an isomorphism `z(S) ≅ X`.
Then `z` factors through `Curves^{CM,1}`, over the site and up to a 2-isomorphism, if and only if
`X → S` is Cohen–Macaulay and has relative dimension one.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_cohenMacaulayDimOne_iff
    (S : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (z : BigFppfOver B S.left.1 S.left.2 ⥤ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.p = Over.map S.hom)
    (X : CurveFamily B hZ) (ξ : z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 S.left)) ≅ X) :
    (∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map S.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          Stack.objectPropertySubcategory B integerBase hZ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val
            (IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ),
        Nonempty (g.comp (Stack.objectPropertyInclusion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ)) ≅
            { toFunctor := z, w := hz })) ↔
      Space.IsCohenMacaulay B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom ∧
        Space.HasRelativeDimension 1 B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_cohenMacaulayDimOne_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1F, part (2).** Let `g : T ⟶ W` be a morphism of the big fppf site of the integers
whose target scheme is the spectrum of a field `k`, whose underlying morphism of schemes is
proper, and whose source scheme `X` has dimension at most one, and let `z : (Sch/Spec(k)) →
Curves` classify the family of curves of `g`. Then `z` factors through `Curves^{CM,1}` if and only
if `X` is Cohen–Macaulay and equidimensional of dimension one, every irreducible component of it
having dimension one.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_cohenMacaulayDimOne_over_field_iff
    {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
    (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
    (z : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.p = Over.map W.hom)
    (ξ : z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 W.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g
      (flat_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW) hproper
      (locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW)
      (Space.isQuasiCompact_yoneda_map B integerBase hZ g inferInstance)
      ((Space.isSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance)
      ((Space.isQuasiSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance) hdim) :
    (∃ q : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          Stack.objectPropertySubcategory B integerBase hZ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val
            (IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ),
        Nonempty (q.comp (Stack.objectPropertyInclusion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ)) ≅
            { toFunctor := z, w := hz })) ↔
      (IsCohenMacaulay ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ∧
        TopologicalSpace.Equidimensional ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ∧
        ∀ C ∈ irreducibleComponents ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T),
          topologicalKrullDim C = (1 : WithBot ℕ∞))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulay_of_geometricallyReduced_of_topologicalKrullDim_le_one
declarations.doc:
**A geometrically reduced curve is Cohen–Macaulay.** A scheme of dimension at most one which
is locally of finite type and geometrically reduced over a field is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulay_of_geometricallyReduced_of_topologicalKrullDim_le_one {k : Type u}
    [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [GeometricallyReduced f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (hX : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1) :
    IsCohenMacaulay X
declarations.comment: the inclusion read on a curve over a field, the curves being the objects of the stack parametrized by a field-valued point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulay_fiber_of_geometricallyReduced_of_topologicalKrullDim_le_one
declarations.doc:
**A geometrically reduced fibre of dimension at most one is Cohen–Macaulay.** For a morphism
of schemes which is locally of finite type with geometrically reduced fibres, every fibre of
dimension at most one is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCohenMacaulay_fiber_of_geometricallyReduced_of_topologicalKrullDim_le_one
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [GeometricallyReduced f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (s : S)
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber s) ≤ 1) :
    IsCohenMacaulay (f.fiber s)
declarations.comment: the inclusion read fibrewise on a family of curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCohenMacaulay_schemeSpaceMap_of_geometricallyReduced
declarations.doc:
**A geometrically reduced family of curves over a field is Cohen–Macaulay.** Let
`g : T ⟶ U` be a morphism of the big fppf site of the integers which is flat and locally of
finite type, whose target scheme is the spectrum of a field, and whose source scheme is
geometrically reduced of dimension at most one. Then the induced morphism of algebraic spaces is
Cohen–Macaulay, which is the defining condition of `Curves^{CM}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Space.isCohenMacaulay_schemeSpaceMap_of_geometricallyReduced
    {T U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ U) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (hU : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj U = Spec (.of k))
    [Flat ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g)]
    [GeometricallyReduced ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g)]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1) :
    Space.IsCohenMacaulay B integerBase hZ (schemeSpaceMap g).hom
declarations.comment: the inclusion read on the structure morphism of a family of curves over a field, whose Cohen–Macaulayness is the defining condition of the Cohen–Macaulay open substack

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGeomred_le_curvesCM
declarations.doc:
`Curves^{geomred} ⊂ Curves^{CM}`: a family of curves whose fibres are geometrically reduced
is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesGeomred_le_curvesCM :
    (show ObjectProperty (CurveFamily B hZ) from IsGeometricallyReducedCurveFamily B hZ) ≤
      (show ObjectProperty (CurveFamily B hZ) from IsCohenMacaulayFamily B hZ)
declarations.comment: the inclusion of the conditions cutting the two subcategories out of the category of families of curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGrc1_isOpenSubstack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1I, the open substack.** `Curves^{grc,1}`, the strictly full subcategory of
families of curves whose geometric fibres are reduced, connected and of dimension `1`, is an open
substack of `Curves`: its inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces and an open
immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesGrc1_isOpenSubstack :
    ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ)
          isOpenCurvesLocus_isGrc1CurveFamily.prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ)
          isOpenCurvesLocus_isGrc1CurveFamily.prop_of_hom)
declarations.comment: the open substack Curves^{grc,1} of Curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_curvesGrc1_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1I, part (1).** The classifying morphism of a family of curves `X ⟶ S` factors
through `Curves^{grc,1}` exactly when the geometric fibres of `X ⟶ S` are reduced, connected and
of dimension `1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_curvesGrc1_iff (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom) :
    (∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ),
        z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
      IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)))
declarations.comment: part (1): the classifying morphism of a family of curves factors through Curves^{grc,1} iff its geometric fibres are reduced, connected and of dimension 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_curvesGrc1_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1I, part (2).** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension at most one over a field
`k` (with `Spec k` in the site, so that the classifying morphism `Spec k ⟶ Curves` of `X`
exists), and let `y` be a scheme-valued point of `Curves` over `U` classifying the family of
curves of `X`. Then `y` factors through `Curves^{grc,1}` exactly when `X` is geometrically
reduced over `k`, geometrically connected over `k`, and of dimension `1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_curvesGrc1_over_field_iff (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k))) (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1) (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom)
    (e : y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) :
    (∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ),
        z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
      GeometricallyReduced X.hom ∧ GeometricallyConnected X.hom ∧
        topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1
declarations.comment: part (2): for a proper scheme of dimension at most one over a field, the classifying morphism factors through Curves^{grc,1} iff the scheme is geometrically reduced, geometrically connected and of dimension 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGrc1_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1I.** There is an open substack `Curves^{grc,1} ⊂ Curves` — the strictly full
subcategory of families of curves whose geometric fibres are reduced, connected and of dimension
`1`, whose inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion — such that
(1) the classifying morphism of a family of curves `X ⟶ S` factors through it exactly when the
geometric fibres of `X ⟶ S` are reduced, connected and of dimension `1`, and (2) for a proper
scheme `X` of dimension at most one over a field `k`, the classifying morphism of `X` factors
through it exactly when `X` is geometrically reduced, geometrically connected and of
dimension `1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesGrc1_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff :
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ)
          isOpenCurvesLocus_isGrc1CurveFamily.prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ)
          isOpenCurvesLocus_isGrc1CurveFamily.prop_of_hom)) ∧
    (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k))) (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
      [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1) (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        GeometricallyReduced X.hom ∧ GeometricallyConnected X.hom ∧
          topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1))
declarations.comment: the whole statement: the open substack Curves^{grc,1} and parts (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isIso_structureSharp_and_baseChange_of_residueField
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X → S` be a family of curves with `κ(s) = H⁰(X_s, 𝒪_{X_s})` for every point `s ∈ S`.
Then `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S` — the structure map `𝒪_S ⟶ f_*𝒪_X` is an isomorphism — and this holds
universally: the same is true of the base change of `f` along every morphism `Y ⟶ S` from an
algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_structureSharp_and_baseChange_of_residueField (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (h : X.HasResidueFieldGlobalFunctions) :
    IsIso (Space.structureSharp B integerBase hZ X.toBase) ∧
      ∀ (Y : AlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ) (g : Y ⟶ schemeSpace X.base),
        IsIso (Space.structureSharp B integerBase hZ (pullback.snd X.toBase g))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_firstDirectImage_of_residueField
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X → S` be a family of curves with `κ(s) = H⁰(X_s, 𝒪_{X_s})` for every point `s ∈ S`.
Then `R¹f_*𝒪_X` is a finite locally free `𝒪_S`-module: every object of the small étale site of
`S` has a covering on whose members it is finite free (Stacks 03DL (2)).
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_firstDirectImage_of_residueField (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (h : X.HasResidueFieldGlobalFunctions) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (X.firstDirectImage B hZ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.nonempty_modulePullback_firstDirectImage_iso_of_residueField
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X → S` be a family of curves with `κ(s) = H⁰(X_s, 𝒪_{X_s})` for every point `s ∈ S`.
For every morphism `h : S' → S`, with `f' : X' → S'` the base change — that is, for every
morphism of families of curves `a : X' ⟶ X`, whose square is cartesian, over `h = a.baseMap` —
we have `h^*(R¹f_*𝒪_X) ≅ R¹f'_*𝒪_{X'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_modulePullback_firstDirectImage_iso_of_residueField (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (h : X.HasResidueFieldGlobalFunctions) (F : CurveFamily B hZ) (a : F ⟶ X) :
    Nonempty ((Space.modulePullback B integerBase hZ (schemeSpaceMap a.baseMap)).obj
        (X.firstDirectImage B hZ) ≅ F.firstDirectImage B hZ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGrcDimOne_genus_decomposition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1K.** There is a decomposition into open and closed substacks
`Curves^{grc,1} = ∐_{g ≥ 0} Curves^{grc,1}_g`, where `Curves^{grc,1}` is the stack of families
of curves whose geometric fibres are reduced, connected and of dimension `1`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGrcDimOne`) and `Curves^{grc,1}_g` its full subcategory
`AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGrcDimOneOfGenus`:

* each `Curves^{grc,1}_g ⊂ Curves^{grc,1}` is an open and closed substack — strictly full, with
  inclusion representable by algebraic spaces, an open immersion and a closed immersion;
* they decompose `Curves^{grc,1}`: over the base `S` of every family in `Curves^{grc,1}` their
  loci are open and closed, pairwise disjoint and cover `S`, and a family mapping to it lies in
  `Curves^{grc,1}_g` exactly when its base maps into the locus of `g`;
* (1) the classifying morphism `S → Curves` of a family of curves `f : X → S` factors through
  `Curves^{grc,1}_g` exactly when the geometric fibres of `f` are reduced, connected, of
  dimension `1` and `R¹f_*𝒪_X` is a locally free `𝒪_S`-module of rank `g`;
* (2) for a proper scheme `X` over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1`, the classifying morphism
  `Spec(k) → Curves` factors through `Curves^{grc,1}_g` exactly when `X` is geometrically
  reduced, geometrically connected, of dimension `1` and of genus `g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesGrcDimOne_genus_decomposition :
    (∀ g : ℕ, (IsGrcDimOneFibreGenus B hZ g).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesGrcDimOneOfGenusInclusion B hZ g).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ (curvesGrcDimOneOfGenusInclusion B hZ g) ∧
      Stack.IsClosedImmersion B integerBase hZ (curvesGrcDimOneOfGenusInclusion B hZ g)) ∧
    (∀ X : (IsGrcDimOneFamily B hZ).FullSubcategory,
      (∀ g, IsClopen (CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ X.obj g)) ∧
      Pairwise (fun g g' => Disjoint (CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ X.obj g)
        (CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ X.obj g')) ∧
      (⋃ g, CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ X.obj g) = Set.univ ∧
      ∀ (g : ℕ) (F : (IsGrcDimOneFamily B hZ).FullSubcategory) (a : F ⟶ X),
        (IsGrcDimOneFibreGenus B hZ g F ↔
          Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ (schemeSpace F.obj.base).obj
            (schemeSpaceMap a.hom.baseMap).hom) ⊆ CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ X.obj g)) ∧
    (∀ (g : ℕ) (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ (IsGrcDimOneFibreGenus B hZ g).FullSubcategory,
          z ⋙ (IsGrcDimOneFibreGenus B hZ g).ι ⋙ (IsGrcDimOneFamily B hZ).ι = y) ↔
        IsGrcDimOneFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))) ∧
          CurveFamily.HasGenus B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))) g)) ∧
    (∀ (g : ℕ) (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
      (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
      (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ (IsGrcDimOneFibreGenus B hZ g).FullSubcategory,
          z ⋙ (IsGrcDimOneFibreGenus B hZ g).ι ⋙ (IsGrcDimOneFamily B hZ).ι = y) ↔
        IsGeometricallyReducedOver X.hom ∧ GeometricallyConnected X.hom ∧
          topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧ genus X.hom = g))
declarations.comment: the decomposition Curves^{grc,1} = ∐_g Curves^{grc,1}_g into open and closed substacks (each inclusion representable, an open and a closed immersion; on the base of every object the genus loci are clopen, disjoint and covering), with the characterizations (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_gorenstein
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1M, `Curves^{Gorenstein}` is open in `Curves`.** The inclusion into the category
fibred in groupoids of families of curves of the full subcategory `Curves^{Gorenstein}` of the
Gorenstein families is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_gorenstein :
    Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGorensteinFamily B hZ)
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_isGorensteinFamily B hZ).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGorensteinFamily B hZ)
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_isGorensteinFamily B hZ).prop_of_hom)
declarations.comment: the inclusion of Curves^{Gorenstein} into Curves is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_gorenstein_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1M, part (1).** Let `X → S` be a family of curves and `z : (Sch/S) → Curves` a
classifying morphism for it, a scheme-valued point together with an isomorphism `z(S) ≅ X`.
Then `z` factors through `Curves^{Gorenstein}`, over the site and up to a 2-isomorphism, if and
only if `X → S` is Gorenstein.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_gorenstein_iff
    (S : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (z : BigFppfOver B S.left.1 S.left.2 ⥤ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.p = Over.map S.hom)
    (X : CurveFamily B hZ) (ξ : z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 S.left)) ≅ X) :
    (∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map S.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          Stack.objectPropertySubcategory B integerBase hZ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val
            (IsGorensteinFamily B hZ),
        Nonempty (g.comp (Stack.objectPropertyInclusion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsGorensteinFamily B hZ)) ≅
            { toFunctor := z, w := hz })) ↔
      Space.IsGorenstein B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_gorenstein_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1M, part (2).** Let `g : T ⟶ W` be a morphism of the big fppf site of the integers
whose target scheme is the spectrum of a field `k`, whose underlying morphism of schemes is
proper, and whose source scheme `X` has dimension at most one, and let `z : (Sch/Spec(k)) →
Curves` classify the family of curves of `g`. Then `z` factors through `Curves^{Gorenstein}` if
and only if `X` is Gorenstein.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_gorenstein_over_field_iff
    {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
    (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
    (z : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.p = Over.map W.hom)
    (ξ : z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 W.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g
      (flat_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW) hproper
      (locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW)
      (Space.isQuasiCompact_yoneda_map B integerBase hZ g inferInstance)
      ((Space.isSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance)
      ((Space.isQuasiSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance) hdim) :
    (∃ q : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          Stack.objectPropertySubcategory B integerBase hZ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val
            (IsGorensteinFamily B hZ),
        Nonempty (q.comp (Stack.objectPropertyInclusion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsGorensteinFamily B hZ)) ≅
            { toFunctor := z, w := hz })) ↔
      IsGorenstein ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSmoothOverIntegers_isSmoothFamily
declarations.doc:
The morphism `Curves^{smooth} → Spec(ℤ)` is smooth: the open substack of the algebraic stack
of curves (Stacks 0D5A) where the family of curves is smooth, followed by the structure morphism
to `Spec(ℤ)`, is a smooth morphism of algebraic stacks.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmoothOverIntegers_isSmoothFamily :
    IsSmoothOverIntegers B hZ (C1590Private.isAlgebraicStack_curvesFiberedCategory.{u, w} B hZ)
      (isOpenCurvesLocus_isSmoothFamily B hZ)
declarations.comment: Curves^{smooth} → Spec(ℤ) is smooth, on the algebraic stack of curves

declarations.name: quasiIso_of_isRightResolution
declarations.doc:
Let `M^•` be a cochain complex of abelian groups and let
`0 → M^• → A_0^• → A_1^• → …` be an exact complex of complexes of abelian
groups (encoded as a half-plane double complex with augmentation `f`). Then
the induced map `g : M^• → Tot(A^{•,•})` is a quasi-isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasiIso_of_isRightResolution
    (M : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat ℤ)
    (A : HomologicalComplex₂ AddCommGrpCat 𝕀 𝕀) [A.HasTotal 𝕀]
    (f : M ⟶ A.X 0)
    (hA_vanish : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (A.X p))
    (hExact : IsRightResolution M A f)
    (g : M ⟶ A.total 𝕀) (hg : InducedFromColumnZero f g) :
    QuasiIso g

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.pseudoCoherent_tfae_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
For a surjection `B → A` of flat, finitely presented `R`-algebras, absolute
pseudo-coherence in `D(A)`, relative pseudo-coherence over `R` and over `A`, and the two
analogous conditions after restriction of scalars to `B` are equivalent; the same holds for
`m`-pseudo-coherence.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pseudoCoherent_tfae_of_surjective
    {R : Type u} {B : Type u} {A : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra B A] [Algebra R A] [IsScalarTower R B A]
    [Module.Flat R B] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    [Module.Flat R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap B A))
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) (m : ℤ) :
    let Kₑ := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap B A)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K
    List.TFAE [
      IsPseudoCoherent K,
      IsRelativelyPseudoCoherent (R := R) K,
      IsRelativelyPseudoCoherent (R := A) K,
      IsPseudoCoherent Kₑ,
      IsRelativelyPseudoCoherent (R := R) Kₑ] ∧
    List.TFAE [
      IsPseudoCoherentFrom K m,
      IsRelativelyPseudoCoherentFrom (R := R) K m,
      IsRelativelyPseudoCoherentFrom (R := A) K m,
      IsPseudoCoherentFrom Kₑ m,
      IsRelativelyPseudoCoherentFrom (R := R) Kₑ m]

declarations.name: StacksDraft.RelativelyPerfect.exists_homComplex_representation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1U.** For a flat map `R → A`, a pseudo-coherent complex `K` and a
complex `L` of finite Tor-dimension over `R` admit representatives `P` and `F` for which
`Homᴬ(P, F)` is a bounded-below complex of `R`-flat `A`-modules computing derived Hom.
The construction commutes with every base change `R → R'`. If `A` is finitely presented
over `R` and `L` is perfect relative to `R`, the terms of `F` and of the Hom complex may moreover
be chosen finitely presented over `A`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_homComplex_representation
    (R : Type uR) (A : Type uA) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Module.Flat R A]
    (K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A) ℤ) :
    letI : HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R)
    letI : HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A)
    (∀ m : ℤ, IsPseudoCoherentFrom ((DerivedCategory.Q).obj K) m) →
    (∃ a b : ℤ,
      StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.FaithfullyFlat.HasTorAmplitude
        (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((algebraMap R A).comp
            (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{max uA uM} R ≃+* R).toRingHom)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj L)
        a b) →
    ∃ (P F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A) ℤ)
      (_eP : (DerivedCategory.Q).obj P ≅ (DerivedCategory.Q).obj K)
      (_eF : (DerivedCategory.Q).obj F ≅ (DerivedCategory.Q).obj L),
      (∃ d : ℤ, P.IsStrictlyLE d) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X i) ∧ Module.Free A (P.X i)) ∧
      (∃ a b : ℤ, F.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ F.IsStrictlyLE b) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Flat R
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).obj (F.X i))) ∧
      (∃ c : ℤ, (CochainComplex.HomComplexR A P F).IsStrictlyGE c) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Flat R
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).obj
          ((CochainComplex.HomComplexR A P F).X i))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Function.Bijective
        (fun (z : CochainComplex.HomComplex.CohomologyClass P F n) ↦
          DerivedCategory.Qh.map
            (CochainComplex.HomComplex.CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv z))) ∧
      (∀ (R' : Type uB) [CommRing R'] [Algebra R R'],
        let A' := A ⊗[R] R'
        let f : A →+* A' := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
        let Ext := (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uA, max uA uB, max uR uA uM} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
        let P' := Ext.obj P
        let F' := Ext.obj F
        let E' := Ext.obj (CochainComplex.HomComplexR A P F)
        letI : HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM uB} A') :=
          HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM uB} A')
        ∃! e : E' ≅ CochainComplex.HomComplexR A' P' F',
          IsCanonicalHomComplexBaseChangeIso f P F e ∧
            ∀ n : ℤ,
              IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap e.hom n) ∧
                Function.Bijective
                  (fun (z : CochainComplex.HomComplex.CohomologyClass P' F' n) ↦
                    DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv z))) ∧
      (Algebra.FinitePresentation R A →
        (∀ m : ℤ, IsPseudoCoherentFrom (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) m) →
        (∀ i : ℤ, Module.FinitePresentation A (F.X i)) ∧
          ∀ n : ℤ,
            Module.FinitePresentation A ((CochainComplex.HomComplexR A P F).X n))

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedHom.ExtensionOfScalars.derivedHomBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1X.** The canonical derived-module base-change map
`RHom_R(K, M) ⊗ᴸ_R A ⟶ RHom_A(K ⊗ᴸ_R A, M ⊗ᴸ_R A)`.
It is the mate of the unit-induced map under the adjunction of Stacks 0GMT, using
exactly the change-of-rings identification of Stacks 0E1W.
declarations.statement:
public def derivedHomBaseChange
    {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (f : R →+* A) :
    letI : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uA, max uR uA uM} f).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA} f).isLeftAdjoint
    letI : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM, uR, uA} f).IsRightAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA} f).isRightAdjoint
    letI : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM, uR, uA} f).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA} f).isLeftAdjoint
    ∀ (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A))
    (comparison : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uA, max uR uA uM} f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    [F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor comparison
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (K M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R)),
    F.obj ((_root_.Stacks.DerivedHom.ScalarTransportedInternalHom.hom.{uR, max uR uA uM} R).obj
      (Opposite.op K, M)) ⟶
      (_root_.Stacks.DerivedHom.ScalarTransportedInternalHom.hom.{uA, max uR uA uM} A).obj
        (Opposite.op (F.obj K), F.obj M)
declarations.comment: the derived base-change map for derived hom

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedHom.BaseChangeIso.isIso_derivedHomBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0A6A.** The canonical derived-Hom base-change morphism
`RHom_R(K, M) ⊗ᴸ_R A ⟶ RHom_A(K ⊗ᴸ_R A, M ⊗ᴸ_R A)` of Stacks 0E1X is an isomorphism in each of
four cases: `K` is perfect; `A` is perfect as an `R`-module; the ring map is flat, `K` is
pseudo-coherent and `M` is bounded below; or `A` has finite Tor dimension over `R`, `K` is
pseudo-coherent and `M` is bounded below.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_derivedHomBaseChange
    {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (f : R →+* A) :
    letI : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uA, max uR uA uM} f).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA} f).isLeftAdjoint
    letI : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM, uR, uA} f).IsRightAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA} f).isRightAdjoint
    letI : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM, uR, uA} f).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA} f).isLeftAdjoint
    ∀ (F : Functor (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R))
      (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A)))
    (comparison : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uA, max uR uA uM} f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    [F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor comparison
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (K M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R))
    (h : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect K ∨
      StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R) 0).obj
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars f).obj (ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{max uR uM} A)))) ∨
      (f.Flat ∧ StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent K ∧
        ∃ b : ℤ, DerivedCategory.IsGE M b) ∨
      ((let e := moduleUniverseEquiv.{uR, max uA uM} R
        letI : e.functor.Additive :=
          inferInstanceAs (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM, max uR uA uM, uR}
            (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{max uA uM} R ≃+* R).toRingHom).Additive
        ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ (N : ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R) (i : ℤ), i < a →
          IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} (ULift.{max uA uM} R)) i).obj
            ((canonTensorMod
                (e.functor.obj N)).obj
              (e.functor.mapDerivedCategory.obj
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R) 0).obj
                  ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars f).obj
                    (ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{max uR uM} A)))))))) ∧
        StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent K ∧
        ∃ b : ℤ, DerivedCategory.IsGE M b)),
    IsIso (Stacks.DerivedHom.ExtensionOfScalars.derivedHomBaseChange.{uR, uA, uM} f F comparison K
      M)
declarations.comment: invertibility of the base-change map in each of the four cases

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedHom.BaseChange.derivedHomRestrictScalarsNatIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1W.** The canonical change-of-rings isomorphism for derived Hom, natural in
the object of `D(R)` in the contravariant variable and the object of `D(A)` in the covariant
variable. Its right-hand side uses any total left-derived extension-of-scalars functor; such a
functor is left adjoint to derived restriction of scalars by Stacks 0GMT.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def derivedHomRestrictScalarsNatIso
    {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (f : R →+* A) :
    letI : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uA, max uR uA uM} f).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA} f).isLeftAdjoint
    letI : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM, uR, uA} f).IsRightAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA} f).isRightAdjoint
    letI : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM, uR, uA} f).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA} f).isLeftAdjoint
    ∀ (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A))
    (comparison : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uA, max uR uA uM} f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    [F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor comparison
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))],
    Functor.prod
        (Functor.id (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} R))ᵒᵖ)
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM, uR, uA} f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        _root_.Stacks.DerivedHom.ScalarTransportedInternalHom.hom.{uR, max uR uA uM} R ≅
      Functor.prod F.op (Functor.id (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A))) ⋙
        _root_.Stacks.DerivedHom.ScalarTransportedInternalHom.hom.{uA, max uR uA uM} A ⋙
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM, uR, uA} f).mapDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: the change-of-rings isomorphism for derived hom
