declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_spaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_negOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Y, exactness at `H^{-1}(NL_{C/A})`.**  For morphisms `A ⟶ B ⟶ C` of sheaves of
commutative rings on a topological space the sequence

`H^{-1}(NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C) ⟶ H^{-1}(NL_{C/A}) ⟶ H^{-1}(NL_{C/B})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_spaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_negOne :
    (spaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence A B C a b (-1)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six-term sequence of cohomology sheaves at the node H^{-1}(NL_{C/A}), for the maps induced by the two canonical maps c_1 and g

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_spaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Y, exactness at `H⁰(NL_{C/A})`.**  For morphisms `A ⟶ B ⟶ C` of sheaves of
commutative rings on a topological space the sequence

`H⁰(NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C) ⟶ H⁰(NL_{C/A}) ⟶ H⁰(NL_{C/B})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_spaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_zero :
    (spaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence A B C a b 0).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six-term sequence of cohomology sheaves at the node H^0(NL_{C/A}), for the maps induced by the two canonical maps c_1 and g

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.epi_homologyMap_spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Y, the final `⟶ 0` of the six-term sequence**: the canonical map
`g : NL_{C/A} ⟶ NL_{C/B}` is surjective on `H⁰`, that is, the sequence of cohomology sheaves is
exact at `H⁰(NL_{C/B})`.

Epimorphy is stalkwise, and at a stalk this is the surjectivity clause of Algebra, Lemma 00S2
over the canonical presentations of the stalk rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_homologyMap_spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap_zero :
    Epi (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap A B C a b) 0)
declarations.comment: the final `-> 0` of the six-term sequence of cohomology sheaves, that is, its exactness at H^0(NL_{C/B}): the map induced by the canonical map g is surjective

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.spaceJacobiZariskiConnecting
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Y, the connecting morphism of the six-term sequence**
`∂ : H^{-1}(NL_{C/B}) ⟶ H⁰(NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C)`, for morphisms `A ⟶ B ⟶ C` of sheaves of
commutative rings on a topological space.

It is the connecting morphism of the long exact sequence of the cone of
`g : NL_{C/A} ⟶ NL_{C/B}`, whose target `H⁰(C(g)[-1])` is identified with
`H⁰(NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C)` by the canonical map `c` of Stacks 0E1Y, an isomorphism on `H⁰` by
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isIso_homologyMap_spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_zero`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def spaceJacobiZariskiConnecting
declarations.comment: the connecting morphism H^{-1}(NL_{C/B}) -> H^0(NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_spaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Y, exactness at `H⁰(NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C)`.**  For morphisms `A ⟶ B ⟶ C` of sheaves of
commutative rings on a topological space the sequence

`H^{-1}(NL_{C/B}) --∂--> H⁰(NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C) ⟶ H⁰(NL_{C/A})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.

This is the exactness of the long exact sequence of the cone at `H⁰(C(g)[-1])`
(`Stacks.SheafOfModules.spaceNaiveCotangentCone_homology_exact_cone`), transported along the
isomorphism `H⁰(c)` of
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isIso_homologyMap_spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_zero`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_spaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_zero :
    (ShortComplex.mk (spaceJacobiZariskiConnecting A B C a b)
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (spaceBaseChangeNaiveCotangentMap A B C a b) 0)
      (spaceJacobiZariskiConnecting_comp_homologyMap A B C a b)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six-term sequence at H^0(NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_spaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_negOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Y, exactness at `H^{-1}(NL_{C/B})`.**  For morphisms `A ⟶ B ⟶ C` of sheaves of
commutative rings on a topological space the sequence

`H^{-1}(NL_{C/A}) ⟶ H^{-1}(NL_{C/B}) --∂--> H⁰(NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C)`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.

This is the exactness of the long exact sequence of the cone at `H^{-1}(NL_{C/B})`
(`Stacks.SheafOfModules.spaceNaiveCotangentCone_homology_exact_target`), transported along the
isomorphism `H⁰(c)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_spaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_negOne :
    (ShortComplex.mk
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap A B C a b) (-1))
      (spaceJacobiZariskiConnecting A B C a b)
      (homologyMap_comp_spaceJacobiZariskiConnecting A B C a b)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six-term sequence at H^{-1}(NL_{C/B})

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Y, the canonical map.**  For morphisms `A ⟶ B ⟶ C` of sheaves of commutative
rings on a topological space, the canonical map

`c : NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C ⟶ C(NL_{C/A} ⟶ NL_{C/B})[-1]`

of complexes of sheaves of `C`-modules, lifting the canonical map
`c₁ : NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C ⟶ NL_{C/A}` through the projection of the shifted cone.

All six assertions of the six-term exact sequence of cohomology sheaves are covered: exactness
at `H^{-1}(NL_{C/A})`, at `H^0(NL_{C/A})` and at `H^0(NL_{C/B})` (the final `→ 0`) by
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_spaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_negOne`, `_zero` and
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.epi_homologyMap_spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap_zero`; exactness at
`H^{-1}(NL_{C/B})` and at `H^0(NL_{B/A} ⊗ C)`, and the connecting map, by
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_spaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_negOne`, `_zero` and
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.spaceJacobiZariskiConnecting`, which rest on
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isIso_homologyMap_spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_zero`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap
declarations.comment: the canonical map NL_{B/A} ⊗ C -> C(g)[-1] to the shifted cone

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_pShift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Y, the defining property of the canonical map.**  The canonical map `c`
composed with the projection `C(g)[-1] ⟶ NL_{C/A}` of the shifted cone is the canonical map
`c₁ : NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C ⟶ NL_{C/A}`.

The six assertions of the six-term exact sequence drawn from this map are all covered; see the
docstring of `Stacks.SheafOfModules.spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap` for where each one is.
declarations.statement:
theorem spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_pShift :
    spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap A B C a b ≫
        pShift (spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap A B C a b) =
      spaceBaseChangeNaiveCotangentMap A B C a b
declarations.comment: the defining property of the canonical map: composed with the cone projection it is c_1

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Y, the canonical map.**  The canonical map `c` composed with the degree `-1`
projection `C(g)[-1] ⟶ NL_{C/B}` of the shifted cone is the explicit null homotopy of
`c₁ ≫ g`.  This is the second of the two components out of which Stacks 08RI (2) builds `c`,
and together with `spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_pShift` it determines `c`.

The six assertions of the six-term exact sequence drawn from this map are all covered; see the
docstring of `Stacks.SheafOfModules.spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap` for where each one is.
declarations.statement:
theorem spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_snd :
    (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom
          (spaceNaiveCotangentConeMap A B C a b)).comp
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.snd
            (spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap A B C a b)).leftShift (-1) (-1)
          (by omega)) (by omega) =
      CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHomotopy
        (spaceBaseChangeRelativeNullHomotopy A B C a b)
declarations.comment: the second defining property of the canonical map: its degree -1 component is the explicit homotopy

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_negOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Z, exactness at `H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z})`.**  For composable morphisms of ringed spaces
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` the sequence

`H^{-1}(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) ⟶ H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z}) ⟶ H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_negOne :
    (ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence f g (-1)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six-term sequence of cohomology sheaves at the node H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z}), for the maps induced by the canonical maps f^*NL_{Y/Z} -> NL_{X/Z} and NL_{X/Z} -> NL_{X/Y}

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Z, exactness at `H⁰(NL_{X/Z})`.**  For composable morphisms of ringed spaces
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` the sequence

`H⁰(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) ⟶ H⁰(NL_{X/Z}) ⟶ H⁰(NL_{X/Y})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_zero :
    (ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence f g 0).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six-term sequence of cohomology sheaves at the node H^0(NL_{X/Z}), for the maps induced by the canonical maps f^*NL_{Y/Z} -> NL_{X/Z} and NL_{X/Z} -> NL_{X/Y}

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.epi_homologyMap_ringedSpaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Z, the final `⟶ 0` of the six-term sequence**: the canonical map
`NL_{X/Z} ⟶ NL_{X/Y}` is surjective on `H⁰`, that is, the sequence of cohomology sheaves is exact
at `H⁰(NL_{X/Y})`.  This is the statement of Stacks 0E1Y for the tower
`(g ∘ f)⁻¹O_Z ⟶ f⁻¹O_Y ⟶ O_X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_homologyMap_ringedSpaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap_zero :
    Epi (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap
      (inverseImageBaseRing f g) (inverseImageMiddleRing f) X.sheaf
      (inverseImageFirstRingMap f g) (ringedSpaceStructureMap f)) 0)
declarations.comment: the final `-> 0` of the six-term sequence of cohomology sheaves, that is, its exactness at H^0(NL_{X/Y}): the map induced by the canonical map NL_{X/Z} -> NL_{X/Y} is surjective

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiConnecting
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Z, the connecting morphism of the six-term sequence**
`∂ : H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) ⟶ H⁰(f^*NL_{Y/Z})`, for composable morphisms of ringed spaces.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiConnecting
declarations.comment: the connecting morphism H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) -> H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z})

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Z, exactness at `H⁰(f^*NL_{Y/Z})`.**  For composable morphisms of ringed spaces
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` the sequence

`H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) --∂--> H⁰(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) ⟶ H⁰(NL_{X/Z})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_zero :
    (ShortComplex.mk (ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiConnecting f g)
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((pulledNaiveCotangentComparison f g).hom ≫
        spaceBaseChangeNaiveCotangentMap (inverseImageBaseRing f g)
          (inverseImageMiddleRing f) X.sheaf (inverseImageFirstRingMap f g)
          (ringedSpaceStructureMap f)) 0)
      (ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiConnecting_comp_homologyMap f g)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six-term sequence at H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z})

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_negOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Z, exactness at `H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y})`.**  For composable morphisms of ringed spaces
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` the sequence

`H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z}) ⟶ H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) --∂--> H⁰(f^*NL_{Y/Z})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_negOne :
    (ShortComplex.mk
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap
        (inverseImageBaseRing f g) (inverseImageMiddleRing f) X.sheaf
        (inverseImageFirstRingMap f g) (ringedSpaceStructureMap f)) (-1))
      (ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiConnecting f g)
      (homologyMap_comp_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiConnecting f g)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six-term sequence at H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y})

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Z, the canonical map.**  For composable morphisms of ringed spaces
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z`, the canonical map

`f^*NL_{Y/Z} ⟶ C(NL_{X/Z} ⟶ NL_{X/Y})[-1]`

of complexes of `O_X`-modules: the canonical map of Stacks 0E1Y for the sheaves of rings
`(g ∘ f)⁻¹O_Z ⟶ f⁻¹O_Y ⟶ O_X` on `X`, precomposed with the identification of `f^*NL_{Y/Z}`
with the base change of `NL_{f⁻¹O_Y/(g ∘ f)⁻¹O_Z}`.

All six assertions of the six-term exact sequence of cohomology sheaves are covered: exactness
at `H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z})`, at `H^0(NL_{X/Z})` and at `H^0(NL_{X/Y})` (the final `→ 0`) by
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiHomologySequence_negOne`, `_zero` and
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.epi_homologyMap_ringedSpaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap_zero`;
exactness at `H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y})` and at `H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z})`, and the connecting map, by
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.exact_ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiSixTerm_negOne`, `_zero` and
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.ringedSpaceJacobiZariskiConnecting`, which rest on
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isIso_homologyMap_ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_zero`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap :
    pulledNaiveCotangentComplex f g ⟶
      (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor
          (CochainComplex (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u}
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology (X : TopCat))
              X.sheaf)) ℤ) (-1 : ℤ)).obj
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone (spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap
          (inverseImageBaseRing f g) (inverseImageMiddleRing f) X.sheaf
          (inverseImageFirstRingMap f g) (ringedSpaceStructureMap f)))
declarations.comment: the canonical map f^*NL_{Y/Z} -> C(NL_{X/Z} -> NL_{X/Y})[-1] to the shifted cone

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_pShift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Z, the canonical map.**  The canonical map
`f^*NL_{Y/Z} ⟶ C(NL_{X/Z} ⟶ NL_{X/Y})[-1]`, composed with the projection of the shifted cone
onto `NL_{X/Z}`, is the canonical map `f^*NL_{Y/Z} ⟶ NL_{X/Z}`.

The six assertions of the six-term exact sequence drawn from this map are all covered; see the
docstring of `Stacks.SheafOfModules.ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap` for where each one is.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_pShift :
    ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap f g ≫
        pShift (spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap (inverseImageBaseRing f g)
          (inverseImageMiddleRing f) X.sheaf (inverseImageFirstRingMap f g)
          (ringedSpaceStructureMap f)) =
      (pulledNaiveCotangentComparison f g).hom ≫
        spaceBaseChangeNaiveCotangentMap (inverseImageBaseRing f g)
          (inverseImageMiddleRing f) X.sheaf (inverseImageFirstRingMap f g)
          (ringedSpaceStructureMap f)
declarations.comment: the defining property of the canonical map: composed with the cone projection it is the map f^*NL_{Y/Z} -> NL_{X/Z}

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E1Z, the canonical map.**  The canonical map
`f^*NL_{Y/Z} ⟶ C(NL_{X/Z} ⟶ NL_{X/Y})[-1]`, composed with the degree `-1` projection of the
shifted cone onto `NL_{X/Y}`, is the identification `f^*NL_{Y/Z} ≅ NL_{f⁻¹O_Y/(g ∘ f)⁻¹O_Z} ⊗ O_X`
followed by the explicit null homotopy of the proof of Stacks 0E1Y for the tower
`(g ∘ f)⁻¹O_Z ⟶ f⁻¹O_Y ⟶ O_X`.  Together with
`ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_pShift` this determines the canonical map.

The six assertions of the six-term exact sequence drawn from this map are all covered; see the
docstring of `Stacks.SheafOfModules.ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap` for where each one is.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap_comp_snd :
    (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom
          (ringedSpaceNaiveCotangentConeMap f g)).comp
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.snd
            (spaceRelativeNaiveCotangentComplexMap (inverseImageBaseRing f g)
              (inverseImageMiddleRing f) X.sheaf (inverseImageFirstRingMap f g)
              (ringedSpaceStructureMap f))).leftShift (-1) (-1) (by omega)) (by omega) =
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom
            (pulledNaiveCotangentComparison f g).hom).comp
        (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHomotopy
          (ringedSpaceBaseChangeRelativeNullHomotopy f g)) (zero_add (-1))
declarations.comment: the second defining property of the canonical map: its degree -1 component is the explicit homotopy

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_iSup_sum_components
declarations.doc:
The geometric branches at a point are the geometric branches of its reduced irreducible
components through that point, counted with multiplicity one per component.
declarations.statement:
public theorem numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_iSup_sum_components
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) :
    numberOfGeometricBranches X x =
      ⨆ s : Finset {Z : Set X // Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X ∧ x ∈ Z},
        ∑ Z ∈ s,
        let C : Closeds X :=
          ⟨Z.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z.1 Z.property.1⟩
        let I := Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal C
        numberOfGeometricBranches I.subscheme
          (⟨x, by
            change x ∈ ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal C).support : Set X)
            have h := Scheme.IdealSheafData.coe_support_vanishingIdeal C
            exact h.symm ▸ (show x ∈ (C : Set X) from Z.property.2)⟩ : I.subscheme)
declarations.comment: geometric_branches_sum

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfBranches_eq_iSup_sum_components
declarations.doc:
The branches at a point are the branches of its reduced irreducible components through that
point, counted with multiplicity one per component.
declarations.statement:
public theorem numberOfBranches_eq_iSup_sum_components
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) :
    numberOfBranches X x =
      ⨆ s : Finset {Z : Set X // Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X ∧ x ∈ Z},
        ∑ Z ∈ s,
        let C : Closeds X :=
          ⟨Z.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z.1 Z.property.1⟩
        let I := Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal C
        numberOfBranches I.subscheme
          (⟨x, by
            change x ∈ ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal C).support : Set X)
            have h := Scheme.IdealSheafData.coe_support_vanishingIdeal C
            exact h.symm ▸ (show x ∈ (C : Set X) from Z.property.2)⟩ : I.subscheme)
declarations.comment: branches_sum

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_affine_nonvanishingOpen_factorsThrough
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E21].**

Let `L` be an ample invertible sheaf on a scheme `X`, let `W ⊆ X` be open and let
`Spec A ⟶ W` be a family of points of `W` parametrised by an integral algebra `A` over a field
`k`. Then there is an `n > 0` and a global section `s` of `L ^ ⊗ n` whose nonvanishing open `X_s`
is affine, is contained in `W`, and is such that `Spec A ⟶ W` factors through `X_s`.

This is `exists_affine_nonvanishingOpen_factorsThrough_of_isOneAffineOpenStep` with its one
remaining hypothesis discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.FiniteTypeApproximation.isOneAffineOpenStep`, the single-affine step of
Noetherian approximation relative to a quasi-compact open ([Stacks, Tag 07RN]).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_nonvanishingOpen_factorsThrough
    (k : Type v) (A : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.IsIntegral k A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules)
    [hLinv : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
      (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L]
    (hL : IsAmple X L)
    (W : X.Opens) (f : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u})) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧
      ∃ s : (tensorPower X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
        (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L (n : ℤ)).sections,
      ∃ U : X.Opens,
        U = nonvanishingOpen
          (tensorPower X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
            (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L (n : ℤ)) s ∧
        IsAffineOpen U ∧ U ≤ W ∧
        ∃ g : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ (U : Scheme.{u}), g ≫ U.ι = f ≫ W.ι

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_globalSections_or_isTrivial_of_invertibleCurveDegree_nonpos
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field and `X` a proper scheme over `k` which is reduced, connected and
equidimensional of dimension one, and let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module whose restriction to
every irreducible component of `X` has degree `≤ 0`. Then either `H⁰(X, ℒ) = 0` or `ℒ ≅ 𝒪_X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_globalSections_or_isTrivial_of_invertibleCurveDegree_nonpos [IsReduced X]
    [ConnectedSpace X] (_hequi : TopologicalSpace.Equidimensional (X : Type u))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (X : Type u) = 1) (L : X.Modules)
    [hL : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (hdeg : ∀ (C : Set X) (hC : C ∈ irreducibleComponents (X : Type u)),
      haveI : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            ⟨C, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents C hC⟩).subscheme.presheaf
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            ⟨C, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents C hC⟩).subscheme.ringCatSheaf.2
          ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback
            (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
              ⟨C, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents C hC⟩).subschemeι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
            L) :=
        RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback_isInvertible_scheme _ L
      invertibleCurveDegree k
          ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            ⟨C, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents C hC⟩).subschemeι ≫ f)
          ((StacksTag09NX.topologicalKrullDim_le_of_isClosedImmersion
            (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
              ⟨C, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents C hC⟩).subschemeι).trans hdim.le)
          ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback
            (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
              ⟨C, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents C hC⟩).subschemeι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
            L) ≤ 0) :
    Subsingleton Γ(L, ⊤) ∨ SheafOfModules.IsTrivial X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ClosedImmersionBaseChange.isIso_derivedBaseChangeSquare_of_torIndependent
declarations.doc:
In a cartesian square of schemes with `i` a closed immersion and `Z`, `X'` Tor independent
over `X`, the canonical morphism of functors `Ri_* ⋙ Lf^* ⟶ Lg^* ⋙ Ri'_*` of Stacks 08HY is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedBaseChangeSquare_of_torIndependent (sq : IsPullback i' g f i)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion i] (htor : AlgebraicGeometry.TorIndependent i f) :
    IsIso (derivedBaseChangeSquare g.toLRSHom.toShHom i'.toLRSHom.toShHom i.toLRSHom.toShHom
      f.toLRSHom.toShHom (comp_toShHom_of_isPullback sq))
declarations.comment: the canonical base change map Lf^* ∘ Ri_* ⟶ Ri'_* ∘ Lg^* is invertible

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ClosedImmersionBaseChange.derivedBaseChangeSquareIso
declarations.doc:
**Tor-independent base change along a closed immersion.**  For a cartesian square with `i` a
closed immersion and `Z`, `X'` Tor independent over `X`, the functors `Lf^* ∘ Ri_*` and
`Ri'_* ∘ Lg^*` from `D(𝒪_Z)` to `D(𝒪_{X'})` are isomorphic, by the canonical derived base change
map of Stacks 08HY.
declarations.statement:
def derivedBaseChangeSquareIso (sq : IsPullback i' g f i)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion i] (htor : AlgebraicGeometry.TorIndependent i f) :
    Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward i.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
        Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom ≅
      Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
        Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward
          i'.toLRSHom.toShHom

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ClosedImmersionBaseChange.derivedBaseChangeSquareAsIso
declarations.doc:
**Tor-independent base change along a closed immersion.**  For a cartesian square of schemes
with `i` a closed immersion and `Z`, `X'` Tor independent over `X`, the functors `Lf^* ∘ Ri_*` and
`Ri'_* ∘ Lg^*` from `D(𝒪_Z)` to `D(𝒪_{X'})` are isomorphic, by the canonical derived base change
map of Stacks 08HY.
declarations.statement:
def derivedBaseChangeSquareAsIso (sq : IsPullback i' g f i)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion i] (htor : AlgebraicGeometry.TorIndependent i f) :
    derivedPushforward i.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙ derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom ≅
      derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙ derivedPushforward i'.toLRSHom.toShHom
declarations.comment: Lf^* ∘ Ri_* ≅ Ri'_* ∘ Lg^* on D(𝒪_Z), by the canonical base change map

declarations.name: Stacks.PicardFibreTrivial.pullback_injective_and_exists_pullback_iso_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E24.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism onto a Noetherian scheme
such that `f_* 𝒪_X = 𝒪_Y`, such that the fibres of `f` have dimension at most one, and such
that `H¹(X_y, 𝒪_{X_y}) = 0` for every `y ∈ Y`. Then `f^* : Pic(Y) ⟶ Pic(X)` is a bijection
onto the subgroup of classes of invertible `𝒪_X`-modules `ℒ` with `ℒ|_{X_y} ≅ 𝒪_{X_y}` for all
`y ∈ Y`: on isomorphism classes of invertible modules `f^*` is injective, and an invertible `ℒ`
is isomorphic to a pullback `f^* 𝒩` of an invertible `𝒪_Y`-module exactly when it is trivial on
every fibre.

The source also asks for `X` to be Noetherian; that follows from the other hypotheses (`f` is
proper over a Noetherian base) and is not needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullback_injective_and_exists_pullback_iso_iff (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hO : IsIso (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom))
    (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ 1)
    (hH1 : ∀ y : Y, IsZero (cohomologyOverField (Y.residueField y) (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y)
      (SheafOfModules.unit (f.fiber y).ringCatSheaf) 1)) :
    (∀ M N : Y.Modules,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible Y.presheaf
        (structureSheafRing Y.toRingedSpace).property M →
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible Y.presheaf
        (structureSheafRing Y.toRingedSpace).property N →
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N) →
      Nonempty (M ≅ N)) ∧
    ∀ L : X.Modules,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf
        (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L →
      ((∃ M : Y.Modules,
          Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible Y.presheaf
            (structureSheafRing Y.toRingedSpace).property M ∧
          Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M ≅ L)) ↔
        ∀ y : Y, Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι y)).obj L ≅
          SheafOfModules.unit (f.fiber y).ringCatSheaf))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pushoutStructureSheaf_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E25.** On every open of the pushout, its ring of sections is the fibre
product of the rings of sections on `Y` and `X` over the corresponding ring on `Z`.

These are the component squares, after applying `CategoryTheory.sheafToPresheaf`, of the source's
square of sheaves of rings: its natural transformations have components `b.app U`, `a.app U`,
`j.app (b ⁻¹ᵁ U)`, and the transported map `i.app (a ⁻¹ᵁ U)` occurring below.  The equivalence
with the sheaf-level pullback is `CategoryTheory.IsPullback.iff_app` together with reflection of
limits along the fully faithful `CategoryTheory.sheafToPresheaf`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushoutStructureSheaf_isPullback
    (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u})
    (U : (pushoutScheme s).Opens) :
    let e : s.i ⁻¹ᵁ (pushoutInl s ⁻¹ᵁ U) =
        s.j ⁻¹ᵁ (pushoutInr s ⁻¹ᵁ U) :=
      congrArg (fun f : s.Z ⟶ pushoutScheme s ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (pushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegral s).isPushout.w
    IsPullback (pushoutInr s |>.app U) (pushoutInl s |>.app U)
      (s.j.app (pushoutInr s ⁻¹ᵁ U))
      (s.i.app (pushoutInl s ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun V ↦ Γ(s.Z, V)) e))
declarations.comment: the structure sheaf
