declarations.name: Dualizing.derivedHomBaseChange
declarations.doc:
The canonical base-change map
`RHom_R(A, -) ⊗ᴸ_A (A ⊗_R R') ⟶ RHom_{R'}(A ⊗_R R', - ⊗ᴸ_R R')`,
functorial in the object of `D(R)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedHomBaseChange
    {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} {R' : Type uRp} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R R']
    (hTor : RingTheory.TorIndependence.TorIndependent R A R')
    (baseChangeR :
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA uRp} R) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA uRp} R'))
    (comparisonR :
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ baseChangeR ⟶
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uRp, max v uR uA uRp}
          (algebraMap R R')).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (isLeftDerivedR : baseChangeR.IsLeftDerivedFunctor comparisonR
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA uRp} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (baseChangeA :
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA uRp} A) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA uRp} (TensorProduct R A R')))
    (comparisonA :
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ baseChangeA ⟶
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uA, max uA uRp, max v uR uA uRp}
          (algebraMap A (TensorProduct R A R'))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (isLeftDerivedA : baseChangeA.IsLeftDerivedFunctor comparisonA
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA uRp} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    :
    derivedHom.{uR, max v uRp, uA} (algebraMap R A) ⋙ baseChangeA ⟶
      baseChangeR ⋙ derivedHom.{uRp, max v uR, max uA uRp}
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          R' →ₐ[R] TensorProduct R A R').toRingHom

declarations.name: Dualizing.derivedHomBaseChangeCanonical
declarations.doc:
The canonical base-change map
`RHom_R(A, -) ⊗ᴸ_A (A ⊗_R R') ⟶ RHom_{R'}(A ⊗_R R', - ⊗ᴸ_R R')`
of [Stacks, Equation 47.14.0.1], functorial in the object of `D(R)`, with the two derived
extensions of scalars taken to be the constructed functor
`StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.extendScalarsDerived` rather than certified parameters.

All three rings and the module size live in the single universe `u`, which is the generality
`extendScalarsDerived` is available in.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedHomBaseChangeCanonical
    {R : Type u} {A : Type u} {R' : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R R']
    (hTor : RingTheory.TorIndependence.TorIndependent R A R') :
    derivedHom.{u, u, u} (algebraMap R A) ⋙
        extendScalarsDerived (algebraMap A (TensorProduct R A R')) ⟶
      extendScalarsDerived (algebraMap R R') ⋙ derivedHom.{u, u, u}
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          R' →ₐ[R] TensorProduct R A R').toRingHom
declarations.comment: at the constructed derived extensions of scalars; one universe for all rings

declarations.name: Dualizing.isIso_derivedHomBaseChange_app_iff_diagonal
declarations.doc:
For `R → A` and `R → R'` with `A` and `R'` Tor independent over `R`, and `A' = A ⊗_R R'`, the
base-change morphism `RHom_R(A, K) ⊗ᴸ_A A' ⟶ RHom_{R'}(A', K ⊗ᴸ_R R')` of Stacks 0E29 is an
isomorphism exactly when the morphism `RHom_R(A, K) ⊗ᴸ_R R' ⟶ RHom_R(A, K ⊗ᴸ_R R')` of Stacks 0BYN
is, read over `ULift R` through the scalar equivalence of Stacks 0E1W.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedHomBaseChange_app_iff_diagonal
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA uRp} R)) :
    IsIso ((derivedHomBaseChange.{uR, uA, uRp, v} hTor baseChangeR comparisonR isLeftDerivedR
        baseChangeA comparisonA isLeftDerivedA).app K) ↔
      (let E := Stacks.DerivedHom.ScalarTransportedInternalHom.scalarEquivalence.{uR, max v uR uA
        uRp} R
       IsIso (StacksDraft.DerivedHom.derivedTensorHomDiagonal
         (E.functor.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA uRp} R) 0).obj
           ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R R')).obj
             (ModuleCat.of R' (ULift.{max v uR uA} R')))))
         (E.functor.obj K)
         (E.functor.obj (derivedAlgebraSingle.{uR, uA, max v uRp} (algebraMap R A)))) : Prop)

declarations.name: Dualizing.IsRelativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2C.** A relative dualizing complex for a flat, finitely
presented map `R → A` is an `R`-perfect object `K` of `D(A)` such that
`RHom_{A ⊗[R] A}(A, K ⊗[A]ᴸ (A ⊗[R] A))` is isomorphic to `A`.
declarations.statement:
structure IsRelativeDualizingComplex (R A : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra R A] [Module.Flat R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) : Prop

declarations.name: Dualizing.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.nonempty_iso
declarations.doc:
Let `R → A` be a flat ring map of finite presentation. Any two relative dualizing complexes
for `R → A` are isomorphic.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsRelativeDualizingComplex.nonempty_iso {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra R A] [Module.Flat R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    {K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)}
    (hK : IsRelativeDualizingComplex R A K) (hL : IsRelativeDualizingComplex R A L) :
    Nonempty (K ≅ L)

declarations.name: Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation.relativeDualizingComplex_isRelativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2E.**  Let `φ : R → A` be a flat homomorphism of finite type of
Noetherian rings.  Then the relative dualizing complex `ω^•_{A/R} = φ^!(R)` is a relative
dualizing complex in the sense of [stacks 0E2C]; here `φ^!` is read at `p`, which is an arbitrary
polynomial presentation of `φ`.

Relative perfection is [stacks 0BZW] (2)(a),
`Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation.relativeDualizingComplex_isRelativelyPerfect`, and the diagonal
condition is `Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation.relativeDualizingComplex_diagonalDerivedHom`, from
flat base change [stacks 0BZN], the composition [stacks 0BZT] and the independence of the
presentation [stacks 0BZJ].  Finite presentation of `φ`, which [stacks 0E2C] is stated for, is
not a hypothesis: a flat map of finite type of Noetherian rings is of finite presentation, and a
polynomial presentation exists only for a map of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeDualizingComplex_isRelativeDualizingComplex
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (p : PolynomialPresentation (algebraMap R A)) (hflat : (algebraMap R A).Flat) :
    letI : Module.Flat R A := RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mp hflat
    letI : Algebra.FinitePresentation R A :=
      Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp (RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mp p.finiteType)
    IsRelativeDualizingComplex R A
      (p.upperShriekFunctor.{u, 0}.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of R R)))

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isRelativeDualizingComplex_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2F (1).** A flat ring map of finite presentation `R → A` admits a
relative dualizing complex.

The source's proof: a Noetherian model `R₀ → A₀` of `R → A` has the relative dualizing complex
`φ₀^!(R₀)` of [stacks 0E2E], and its derived base change to `A` is one by (2) at the model and
transitivity of derived base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isRelativeDualizingComplex_of_flat (R A : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra R A] [Module.Flat R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A] :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsRelativeDualizingComplex R A K

declarations.name: Dualizing.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2F (2).** Let `R → A` be a flat ring map of finite presentation, `K`
a relative dualizing complex for `R → A` and `R → R'` any ring map. Then
`K' = K ⊗ᴸ_A (A ⊗_R R')` is a relative dualizing complex for `R' → A ⊗_R R'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsRelativeDualizingComplex.baseChange {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra R A] [Module.Flat R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    {K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)} (hK : IsRelativeDualizingComplex R A K)
    (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra R R'] :
    letI : Module.Flat R' (A ⊗[R] R') := flat_baseChange R A R'
    letI : Algebra.FinitePresentation R' (A ⊗[R] R') :=
      Algebra.FinitePresentation.equiv (baseChangeComm R A R')
    IsRelativeDualizingComplex R' (A ⊗[R] R')
      ((CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u}
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom : A →+* A ⊗[R] R')).functor.obj K)

declarations.name: Dualizing.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.span_derivedBaseChange_diagonalGenerator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2F, the "moreover" clause.** Let `R → A` be flat of finite
presentation, `K` a relative dualizing complex for `R → A`, and `ξ : A ⟶ K ⊗ᴸ_A (A ⊗_R A)` a
generator of the cyclic module `Hom_{D(A ⊗_R A)}(A, K ⊗ᴸ_A (A ⊗_R A))`. For every `R → R'` the
derived base change of `ξ` along `A ⊗_R A → A' ⊗_{R'} A'` generates
`Hom_{D(A' ⊗_{R'} A')}(A', K' ⊗ᴸ_{A'} (A' ⊗_{R'} A'))`, through any identifications `eΔ` of the
base change of `A` with `A'` and `eM` of the base change of `K ⊗ᴸ_A (A ⊗_R A)` with
`K' ⊗ᴸ_{A'} (A' ⊗_{R'} A')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsRelativeDualizingComplex.span_derivedBaseChange_diagonalGenerator {R A : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Module.Flat R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    {K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)} (hK : IsRelativeDualizingComplex R A K)
    (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra R R']
    (ξ : diagonalSingle R A ⟶ (diagonalDerivedExtension R A).obj K)
    (hξ : Submodule.span (A ⊗[R] A) ({ξ} : Set _) = ⊤) :
    letI : Module.Flat R' (A ⊗[R] R') := flat_baseChange R A R'
    ∀ (eΔ : (CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u}
            (envelopingBaseChangeRingHom R A R')).functor.obj (diagonalSingle R A) ≅
          diagonalSingle R' (A ⊗[R] R'))
      (eM : (CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u}
            (envelopingBaseChangeRingHom R A R')).functor.obj
              ((diagonalDerivedExtension R A).obj K) ≅
          (diagonalDerivedExtension R' (A ⊗[R] R')).obj
            ((CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u}
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom : A →+* A ⊗[R] R')).functor.obj K)),
      Submodule.span ((A ⊗[R] R') ⊗[R'] (A ⊗[R] R'))
        ({eΔ.inv ≫ (CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u}
          (envelopingBaseChangeRingHom R A R')).functor.map ξ ≫ eM.hom} : Set _) = ⊤
declarations.comment: moreover clause

declarations.name: Dualizing.isIso_relativeHomothety_of_isRelativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2G.**  Let `R → A` be a flat ring map of finite presentation and let
`K` be a relative dualizing complex for `R → A` ([stacks 0E2C]).  Then the canonical map
`A ⟶ RHom_A(K, K)` is an isomorphism.

This is `Dualizing.isIso_relativeHomothety_of_isRelativeDualizingComplex_of_uniqueness` with the
uniqueness of relative dualizing complexes supplied by [stacks 0E2D],
`Dualizing.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.nonempty_iso`.  The proof is the source's: reduction to a
Noetherian model by [stacks 02JO], the Noetherian case through [stacks 0E2E], [stacks 0E2F] and
[stacks 0BZW], and the passage to an arbitrary base by [stacks 0DHX]; see the module
documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_relativeHomothety_of_isRelativeDualizingComplex
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Module.Flat R A]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hK : IsRelativeDualizingComplex R A K) :
    IsIso (relativeHomothety A K)

declarations.name: Dualizing.isRelativeDualizingComplex_derivedTensorProductOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E2H.**  Let `R → A → B` be ring maps which are flat and of finite presentation,
let `K_{A/R}` be a relative dualizing complex for `R → A` and `K_{B/A}` one for `A → B`.  Then
`K = K_{A/R} ⊗ᴸ_A K_{B/A}` is a relative dualizing complex for `R → B`.

Clause (1) of [stacks 0E2C] is `Dualizing.relativelyPerfectOverBase_derivedTensorProductOver`
and clause (2) follows from the isomorphism (★),
`Dualizing.diagonalQuotientDerivedHom_derivedTensorProductOver`; see the module
documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeDualizingComplex_derivedTensorProductOver
    (KA : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) (KB : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B))
    (hKA : IsRelativeDualizingComplex R A KA)
    (hKB : IsRelativeDualizingComplex A B KB) :
    letI : Module.Flat R B := Module.Flat.trans R A B
    letI : Algebra.FinitePresentation R B := Algebra.FinitePresentation.trans R A B
    IsRelativeDualizingComplex R B
      ((derivedTensorProductOver.{u, u} (algebraMap A B) KB).obj KA)

declarations.name: RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.ClosedQuotientMorphismOfRingedSpaces.derivedSheafHomDerivedModulePushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2I.** For `M` in `D(𝒪_Z)` and `K` in `D(𝒪_X)`,

`R ℋom_{𝒪_X}(Ri_* M, K) ≅ Ri_* R ℋom_{𝒪_Z}(M, R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K))` in `D(𝒪_X)`,

granted the underived identification `hom` of internal Hom complexes. The representatives used
are the chosen K-injective models of `M` and `K`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSheafHomDerivedModulePushforwardIso
    (hom : ∀ (N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.closedSite.O)) ℤ)
      (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.ambientSite.O)) ℤ),
      (S.siteModulePushforward.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (RingedSite.sheafHomComplex S.closedSite N
            ((S.siteSheafHomExactSupport.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)).obj ≅
        (RingedSite.sheafHomComplex S.ambientSite
          ((S.siteModulePushforward.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N) I).obj)
    (M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.closedSite.O)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.ambientSite.O))) :
    ((RingedSite.derivedSheafHomBifunctor S.ambientSite).obj
          (op (S.siteModulePushforward.mapDerivedCategory.obj M))).obj K ≅
      S.siteModulePushforward.mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (((RingedSite.derivedSheafHomBifunctor S.closedSite).obj (op M)).obj
          (S.siteDerivedSheafHomExactSupport.obj K))
declarations.comment: the derived isomorphism, granted the underived internal Hom identification

declarations.name: RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.ClosedQuotientMorphismOfRingedSpaces.derivedSheafHomPushforwardNatIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2I.** For every object `M` of `D(𝒪_Z)`, the derived internal Hom out
of the derived pushforward `Ri_* M` is derived sheaf Hom with exact support, followed by the
derived internal Hom out of `M` on `Z`, followed by derived pushforward:
`R ℰom_X(Ri_* M, -) ≅ Ri_* R ℰom_Z(M, R ℰom(𝒪_Z, -))`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSheafHomPushforwardNatIso
    (M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.Z))) :
    (Stacks.SheafOfModules.derivedSheafHom S.X.sheaf).obj
        (op ((modulePushforward S.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)) ≅
      S.derivedSheafHomExactSupport ⋙
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.derivedSheafHom S.Z.sheaf).obj (op M) ⋙
          (modulePushforward S.i).mapDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: the derived isomorphism, unconditionally

declarations.name: Stacks.ClosedImmersion.exists_closedImmersionDerivedPushforwardComparison
declarations.doc:
The exact-functor and right-derived-functor models of pushforward along a closed immersion
of schemes have a comparison isomorphism compatible with their maps from the homotopy
category of complexes of sheaves of modules.

Pushforward along a closed immersion is exact
(`preservesFiniteColimits_modulePushforward_of_isClosedImmersion`), so it induces a functor on
derived categories which is its own total right derived functor; the comparison is the
uniqueness isomorphism of `exists_mapDerivedCategoryIsoTotalRightDerived`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersionDerivedPushforwardComparison {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion i] :
    ∃ e : (modulePushforward i.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapDerivedCategory ≅
        ((modulePushforward i.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)),
      ∀ M,
        ((modulePushforward i.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app M) ≫
          e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj M) =
        (((modulePushforward i.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerivedUnit DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Z.toRingedSpace))
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ))).app M
declarations.comment: the comparison of the exact-functor and right-derived-functor models of pushforward along a closed immersion

declarations.name: Stacks.ClosedImmersion.isClosedEmbedding_base_toShHom
declarations.doc:
The map of underlying topological spaces of a closed immersion of schemes remains a closed
embedding after forgetting the scheme structure down to presheafed spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedEmbedding_base_toShHom {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion i] :
    Topology.IsClosedEmbedding
      (((SheafedSpace.forgetToPresheafedSpace (C := CommRingCat)).map
        i.toLRSHom.toShHom).base)
declarations.comment: the closed-embedding half of the closed quotient of ringed spaces underlying a closed immersion

declarations.name: Stacks.ClosedImmersion.isLocallySurjective_c_toShHom
declarations.doc:
The structure-sheaf comorphism `𝒪_X ⟶ i_* 𝒪_Z` of a closed immersion of schemes is locally
surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_c_toShHom {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion i] :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      (((SheafedSpace.forgetToPresheafedSpace (C := CommRingCat)).map
        i.toLRSHom.toShHom).c)
declarations.comment: the surjectivity half of the closed quotient of ringed spaces underlying a closed immersion

declarations.name: RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.ClosedQuotientBaseChange.rightAdjointBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2K.** The base change map
`Lg^* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)` for the right adjoint of pushforward along a
closed quotient morphism: the transpose, under the derived adjunction
`Ri'_* ⊣ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, -)` of [Stacks, Tag 0A76], of the identification `e` of
[Stacks, Tag 0E23] followed by `Lf^*` of the counit `Ri_* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ K`.
declarations.comment: the map (48.10.0.1), granted the base change isomorphism `Ri'_* ∘ Lg^* ≅ Lf^* ∘ Ri_*` of Stacks 0E23 as a named hypothesis

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.ExactSupportBaseChange.baseChangeSheafHomExactSupport
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2K.** The canonical base-change map

`Lg^* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)`

in `D(𝒪_{Z'})`, for a cartesian square whose right-hand column `i` is a closed immersion and
whose corners `Z`, `X'` are Tor independent over `X`.

It is the map corresponding, under the adjunction `Ri'_* ⊣ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, -)` of
[Stacks, Tag 0A76] on the left-hand column, to the composite

`Ri'_* Lg^* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) = Lf^* Ri_* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ Lf^*K`

whose equality is the inverse of the derived base-change map of [Stacks, Tag 08HY], invertible
by [Stacks, Tag 0E23], and whose arrow is `Lf^*` of the counit of [Stacks, Tag 0A76]. The two
occurrences of `derivedPushforwardComparison` pass between the exact-functor and the total
right derived models of pushforward, which the adjunction and the base-change map are
respectively stated for. The stalkwise identification `hst` is the hypothesis [Stacks,
Tag 0E23] carries in this library.
declarations.statement:
def baseChangeSheafHomExactSupport (sq : IsPullback i' g f i) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (htor : AlgebraicGeometry.TorIndependent i f) (hst : DerivedStalkBaseChangeEqKFlat sq)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))) :
    (derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        ((closedQuotientOfClosedImmersion i).derivedSheafHomExactSupport.obj K) ⟶
      (closedQuotientOfBaseChange sq).derivedSheafHomExactSupport.obj
        ((derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K)
declarations.comment: the canonical base-change map

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.ExactSupportBaseChange.baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2K.** The canonical base-change map

`Lg^* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)`

in `D(𝒪_{Z'})`, functorial in `K ∈ D(𝒪_X)`, for a cartesian square whose right-hand column `i`
is a closed immersion and whose corners `Z`, `X'` are Tor independent over `X`.

Its component at `K` corresponds, under the adjunction `Ri'_* ⊣ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, -)` of
[Stacks, Tag 0A76] on the left-hand column, to the composite

`Ri'_* Lg^* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) = Lf^* Ri_* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ Lf^*K`

whose equality is the Tor-independent base-change isomorphism of [Stacks, Tag 0E23]
(`pushforwardBaseChangeIso`), and whose arrow is `Lf^*` of the counit of [Stacks, Tag 0A76];
`baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap_app` spells this out.
declarations.statement:
def baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap (sq : IsPullback i' g f i) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (htor : AlgebraicGeometry.TorIndependent i f) :
    (closedQuotientOfClosedImmersion i).derivedSheafHomExactSupport ⋙
        derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom ⟶
      derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
        (closedQuotientOfBaseChange sq).derivedSheafHomExactSupport
declarations.comment: the canonical base-change map, functorial in K

declarations.name: RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.ClosedQuotientBaseChange.isIso_rightAdjointBaseChangeMap_iff_of_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2L.** The map `Lg^* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)` of
[Stacks, Tag 0E2K] is an isomorphism if and only if a base change map
`ψ : Lf^* R SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R SheafHom_{𝒪_{X'}}(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)` whose pushforward
square it fills is an isomorphism.

Both directions: `Ri'_*` carries isomorphisms to isomorphisms, and it reflects them, being
exact and fully faithful.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_rightAdjointBaseChangeMap_iff_of_eq
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X)))
    (ψ : Lf.obj (S.derivedHomSheafFromPushforwardStructureSheaf.obj K) ⟶
      S'.derivedHomSheafFromPushforwardStructureSheaf.obj (Lf.obj K))
    (hψ : (modulePushforward S'.i).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (rightAdjointBaseChangeMap S S' Lf Lg e K) =
      (pushforwardSourceIso S S' Lf Lg e K).hom ≫ ψ ≫
        (pushforwardTargetIso S S' Lf K).inv) :
    IsIso (rightAdjointBaseChangeMap S S' Lf Lg e K) ↔ IsIso ψ
declarations.comment: both directions, for a base change map filling the pushforward square; its identification with the map of Cohomology, Remark 08I3, which the source omits, is the hypothesis `hψ`, and the base change isomorphism `Ri'_* ∘ Lg^* ≅ Lf^* ∘ Ri_*` of Stacks 0E23 is the named hypothesis `e`

declarations.name: RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.ClosedQuotientBaseChange.isIso_rightAdjointBaseChangeMap_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2L.** The map `Lg^* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)` of
[Stacks, Tag 0E2K] is an isomorphism if and only if the base change map
`Lf^* R SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R SheafHom_{𝒪_{X'}}(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)` it induces is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_rightAdjointBaseChangeMap_iff
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X))) :
    IsIso (rightAdjointBaseChangeMap S S' Lf Lg e K) ↔
      IsIso (derivedSheafHomBaseChangeMap S S' Lf Lg e K)
declarations.comment: both directions, for the base change map induced by Stacks 0E2K; the base change isomorphism `Ri'_* ∘ Lg^* ≅ Lf^* ∘ Ri_*` of Stacks 0E23 is the named hypothesis `e`

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.ExactSupportBaseChange.isIso_baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap_app_iff_isIso_derivedPullbackSheafHomMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2L.** Consider a cartesian square of schemes

```
Z' --i'--> X'
|g         |f
Z --i----> X
```

with `i` a closed immersion and `Z`, `X'` Tor independent over `X`, and `K ∈ D(𝒪_X)`. The base
change map `Lg^* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)` of [Stacks, Tag 0E2K] is an isomorphism
if and only if the base change map

`Lf^* R SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R SheafHom_{𝒪_{X'}}(Lf^*𝒪_Z, Lf^*K)`

of Cohomology, Remark [Stacks, Tag 08I3] is an isomorphism, `𝒪_Z` standing for `Ri_*𝒪_Z[0]`.
The source writes the target as `R SheafHom_{𝒪_{X'}}(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)`, through
`𝒪_{Z'} = Lf^*𝒪_Z` (Tor independence); the map of [Stacks, Tag 08I3] has `Lf^*𝒪_Z` there, and
that is the map stated here.

The source proves this by applying `Ri'_*` and omits the verification that the result is the map
of [Stacks, Tag 08I3]. Here that verification is
`isIso_mate_iff_isIso_homComparison_of_projection`: both maps are read off the projection formula
of [Stacks, Tag 0B55] in its right-handed form, whose compatibility with base change is the
right-handed [Stacks, Tag 0B6B].
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap_app_iff_isIso_derivedPullbackSheafHomMap
    (sq : IsPullback i' g f i) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (htor : AlgebraicGeometry.TorIndependent i f) :
    IsIso ((baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap sq htor).app K) ↔
      IsIso (derivedPullbackSheafHomMap f.toLRSHom.toShHom
        ((derivedPushforward i.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (unitObject Z.toSheafedSpace)) K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.ExactSupportBaseChange.isIso_baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap_app_iff_isIso_derivedPullbackSheafHomMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2L**, with the target written as the source writes it. In the
situation of
`isIso_baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap_app_iff_isIso_derivedPullbackSheafHomMap`, the map of
[Stacks, Tag 0E2K] is an isomorphism if and only if the base change map

`Lf^* R SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R SheafHom_{𝒪_{X'}}(Lf^*𝒪_Z, Lf^*K)`
`= R SheafHom_{𝒪_{X'}}(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)`

of Cohomology, Remark [Stacks, Tag 08I3] is, the equality being the identification
`pushforwardStructureSheafBaseChangeIso` of `𝒪_{Z'}` with `Lf^*𝒪_Z` by Tor independence.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap_app_iff_isIso_derivedPullbackSheafHomMap_comp
    (sq : IsPullback i' g f i) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (htor : AlgebraicGeometry.TorIndependent i f) :
    IsIso ((baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap sq htor).app K) ↔
      IsIso (derivedPullbackSheafHomMap f.toLRSHom.toShHom
          ((derivedPushforward i.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (unitObject Z.toSheafedSpace)) K ≫
        ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.derivedSheafHom X'.toSheafedSpace.sheaf).map
          (pushforwardStructureSheafBaseChangeIso sq htor).hom.op).app
          ((derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K))
declarations.comment: the same statement, with the target written R SheafHom(O_{Z'}, Lf^*K) through the identification O_{Z'} = Lf^*O_Z of Tor independence, as the source writes it

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.ExactSupportBaseChange.baseChangeSheafHomExactSupport_isIso_of_flat_pseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2M, in part.** In the situation of [Stacks, Tag 0E2J] — a cartesian
square whose right-hand column `i` is a closed immersion, with `Z` and `X'` Tor independent over
`X` — assume `f` flat and `i` pseudo-coherent. Then the map of [Stacks, Tag 0E2K] is an
isomorphism for `K` in `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, which is `_hbb` together with `_hqc`.

**What is assumed rather than derived.** The hypothesis `hpush` says the map is already
invertible after derived pushforward along `i'`, and the proof is only the reduction
`isIso_of_isIso_modulePushforward_map`, that is, the step "since `i'_*` is exact and faithful it
suffices to show the map is an isomorphism after applying `Ri'_*`" of the source's proof of
[Stacks, Tag 0E2L]. The flatness of `f`, the pseudo-coherence of `i`, the boundedness `_hbb`
and the quasi-coherence `_hqc` are stated, so the statement is the tag's own and no hypothesis
of it has been dropped or weakened, but they are not consumed: discharging `hpush` from them is
precisely the remaining content of [Stacks, Tag 0E2M], and the module docstring names the three
steps it takes.

The attribute's clause string is deliberately narrow, and it is worth being explicit about why.
Read as an implication this statement is close to circular: `hpush` is invertibility of the map
after `Ri'_*`, the proof is conservativity of `Ri'_*`, and that conservativity is exactly what
makes `hpush` and the conclusion interchangeable. What the clause claims is therefore not that
the map is invertible — the tag's assertion, which is **not** proved here — but only that the
source's reduction step for [Stacks, Tag 0E2L], "since `i'_*` is exact and faithful it suffices
to show the map is an isomorphism after applying `Ri'_*`", is available in this library.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeSheafHomExactSupport_isIso_of_flat_pseudoCoherent
    (sq : IsPullback i' g f i) [IsClosedImmersion i] [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat f]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.PseudoCoherent i]
    (htor : AlgebraicGeometry.TorIndependent i f) (hst : DerivedStalkBaseChangeEqKFlat sq)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)))
    (_hbb : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K)
    (_hqc : @Stacks.DerivedQCoh.IsDQCoh _ _ _
      (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace) _ _ _ _ _ K)
    (hpush : IsIso ((modulePushforward (closedQuotientOfBaseChange sq).i).mapDerivedCategory.map
      (baseChangeSheafHomExactSupport sq htor hst K))) :
    IsIso (baseChangeSheafHomExactSupport sq htor hst K)
declarations.comment: only the reduction to invertibility after Ri'_*; see the docstring

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.ExactSupportBaseChange.baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap_isIso_of_flat_pseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2M.** Consider a cartesian square of schemes

```
Z' --i'--> X'
|g         |f
Z --i----> X
```

with `i` a closed immersion, and assume `f` is flat and `i` pseudo-coherent. Then the canonical
base change map of [Stacks, Tag 0E2K]

`Lg^* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_{Z'}, Lf^*K)`

is an isomorphism for `K` in `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, which is `hbb` together with `_hqc`.

The Tor independence of `Z` and `X'` over `X` that the map is built from is not a hypothesis: it
is supplied by the flatness of `f`, `AlgebraicGeometry.torIndependent_of_flat_right`. The proof
uses only that `K` is bounded below, as the footnote to the source's second proof records;
`isIso_baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap_app_of_flat_of_isBoundedBelow` is that statement.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap_isIso_of_flat_pseudoCoherent
    (sq : IsPullback i' g f i) [IsClosedImmersion i] [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat f]
    [PseudoCoherent i]
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)))
    (hbb : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K)
    (_hqc : @Stacks.DerivedQCoh.IsDQCoh _ _ _
      (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace) _ _ _ _ _ K) :
    IsIso ((baseChangeSheafHomExactSupportMap sq
      (AlgebraicGeometry.torIndependent_of_flat_right i f)).app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.TensorHomTorAmplitude.isIso_tensorDerivedSheafHomModelMap_of_closedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E2N].** Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a pseudo-coherent closed immersion of schemes, let
`M ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` locally have Tor amplitude in `[a, ∞)` and let `K ∈ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_X)`. Then the
canonical map

`R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⊗^L_{𝒪_Z} Li^*M ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} M)`

is an isomorphism in `D(𝒪_Z)`. The quasi-coherence hypotheses on `K` and `M` are part of the
statement and are not used.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_tensorDerivedSheafHomModelMap_of_closedImmersion {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : AlgebraicGeometry.PseudoCoherent i)
    (K M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
        (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))) (a : ℤ)
    (_hMq : @Stacks.DerivedQCoh.IsDQCoh _ _ _
        (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace) _ _ _ _ _ M)
    (hM : Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.LocallyHasTorAmplitudeGE X.toRingedSpace M a)
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K)
    (_hKq : @Stacks.DerivedQCoh.IsDQCoh _ _ _
        (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace) _ _ _ _ _ K) :
    IsIso (tensorDerivedSheafHomModelMap
      (Stacks.ClosedImmersion.closedQuotientOfClosedImmersion i) K M)
declarations.comment: the canonical map is `tensorDerivedSheafHomModelMap`: on a K-injective model `I` of `K` and a K-flat model `A` of `M` it is the class of the morphism of complexes whose pushforward is the inverse projection formula followed by the interchange of 0BYR, `phi (x) a |-> (s |-> phi(s) (x) a)`, that is the counit `Ri_* R Hom(O_Z, K) -> K` tensored with `M`; the quasi-coherence of `K` and `M` is part of the statement and is not used

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.relativeDualizingComplexRigidity
declarations.doc:
**Rigidity, [Stacks, Tag 0E2P].** Let `Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and
`f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite presentation, with relative dualizing complex
`ω = a(𝒪_Y)` ([Stacks, Tag 0B6S]), and let `c` be the right adjoint of `RΔ_*` on `D_QCoh` for the
diagonal `Δ : X ⟶ X ×_Y X` ([Stacks, Tag 0A9E]). There are canonical isomorphisms
`𝒪_X ≅ c(Lpr₁^*ω)`, `𝒪_X ≅ c(Lpr₂^*ω)` (Equation 0E2Q) and `ω ≅ c(Lpr₁^*ω ⊗ᴸ Lpr₂^*ω)`
(Equation 0E2R).
declarations.statement:
def relativeDualizingComplexRigidity {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : CompactSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) :=
      QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (pullback.snd f f)
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) :=
      quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f f)
    ((DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf X ≅
        (twistedInverseImage (pullback.diagonal f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (pullback.diagonal f))).obj
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.fst f f)).obj
            ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y)))) ×
      (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf X ≅
        (twistedInverseImage (pullback.diagonal f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (pullback.diagonal f))).obj
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.snd f f)).obj
            ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y))))) ×
      (((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
          (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ≅
        (twistedInverseImage (pullback.diagonal f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (pullback.diagonal f))).obj
          (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor (pullback f f)).obj
            ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.fst f f)).obj
              ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
              (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y)))).obj
            ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.snd f f)).obj
              ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
              (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y)))))

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.structureSheafIsoDiagonalTwistedInverseImagePullbackFst
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E2Q], first projection**: `𝒪_X ≅ c(L pr₁^* ω_{X/Y}^•)`; this is the first
isomorphism of [Stacks, Tag 0E2P], where
`ω_{X/Y}^• = a(𝒪_Y)` is the relative dualizing complex and `c` the twisted inverse image of the
diagonal `Δ : X ⟶ X ×_Y X`. With `b'` the twisted inverse image of `pr₂`, `𝒪_X = c(b'(𝒪_X))` as
`pr₂ ∘ Δ = id`, and `b'(𝒪_X) = L pr₁^* a(𝒪_Y)` by flat base change.
declarations.statement:
def structureSheafIsoDiagonalTwistedInverseImagePullbackFst :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : CompactSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) :=
      QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (pullback.fst f f)
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated
      (pullback.fst f f)
    derivedStructureSheaf X ≅
      (twistedInverseImage (pullback.diagonal f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (pullback.diagonal f))).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.fst f f)).obj
          ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (derivedStructureSheaf Y)))
declarations.comment: first projection: 𝒪_X ≅ c(L pr₁^* ω_{X/Y}^•)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.structureSheafIsoDiagonalTwistedInverseImagePullbackSnd
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E2Q], second projection**: `𝒪_X ≅ c(L pr₂^* ω_{X/Y}^•)`; this is the second
isomorphism of [Stacks, Tag 0E2P]. With `b` the twisted
inverse image of `pr₁`, `𝒪_X = c(b(𝒪_X))` as `pr₁ ∘ Δ = id`, and `b(𝒪_X) = L pr₂^* a(𝒪_Y)` by
flat base change.
declarations.statement:
def structureSheafIsoDiagonalTwistedInverseImagePullbackSnd :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : CompactSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) :=
      QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (pullback.fst f f)
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated
      (pullback.fst f f)
    derivedStructureSheaf X ≅
      (twistedInverseImage (pullback.diagonal f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (pullback.diagonal f))).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.snd f f)).obj
          ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (derivedStructureSheaf Y)))
declarations.comment: second projection: 𝒪_X ≅ c(L pr₂^* ω_{X/Y}^•)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.nonempty_twistedInverseImage_diagonal_pullback_relativeDualizingComplex_iso
declarations.doc:
**Equation (0E2Q) of [Stacks, Tag 0E2P].** Let `Y` be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and
`f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite presentation, with relative dualizing complex
`ω_{X/Y}^• = a(𝒪_Y)` ([Stacks, Remark 0B6S]). Then, `c` being the right adjoint of `RΔ_*` for the
diagonal `Δ : X ⟶ X ×_Y X` ([Stacks, Tag 0A9E]),

`𝒪_X ≅ c(L pr₁^* ω_{X/Y}^•)` and `𝒪_X ≅ c(L pr₂^* ω_{X/Y}^•)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_twistedInverseImage_diagonal_pullback_relativeDualizingComplex_iso :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (pullback.snd f f)
    haveI := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f f)
    Nonempty (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf X ≅
      (twistedInverseImage (pullback.diagonal f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (pullback.diagonal f))).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.fst f f)).obj
          (relativeDualizingComplex f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y)))) ∧
    Nonempty (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf X ≅
      (twistedInverseImage (pullback.diagonal f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (pullback.diagonal f))).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.snd f f)).obj
          (relativeDualizingComplex f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y))))

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.relativeDualizingComplexRigidityIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E2R], the rigidity isomorphism**; this is the isomorphism of
[Stacks, Tag 0E2P] in Equation 0E2R:
`ω_{X/Y}^• ≅ c(L pr₁^* ω_{X/Y}^• ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_{X ×_Y X}} L pr₂^* ω_{X/Y}^•)`, where
`ω_{X/Y}^• = a(𝒪_Y)` is the relative dualizing complex of [Stacks, Tag 0B6S] and `c` the twisted
inverse image of the diagonal `Δ : X ⟶ X ×_Y X`. With `b` the twisted inverse image of `pr₁`:
`ω = c(b(ω))` as `pr₁ ∘ Δ = id`, `b(ω) = L pr₁^*ω ⊗ᴸ b(𝒪_X)` by [Stacks, Tag 0E4K], and
`b(𝒪_X) = L pr₂^* a(𝒪_Y)` by [Stacks, Tag 0AAB].
declarations.statement:
def relativeDualizingComplexRigidityIso :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : CompactSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) :=
      QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (pullback.fst f f)
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated
      (pullback.fst f f)
    (twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
        (derivedStructureSheaf Y) ≅
      (twistedInverseImage (pullback.diagonal f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (pullback.diagonal f))).obj
        (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor (pullback f f : Scheme.{u})).obj
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.fst f f)).obj
            ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
              (derivedStructureSheaf Y)))).obj
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (pullback.snd f f)).obj
            ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
              (derivedStructureSheaf Y))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E2T.** A relative dualizing complex for a flat, locally finitely presented
morphism `f : X ⟶ S`, relative to an open `W ⊆ X ×_S X` through which the relative diagonal
factors as a closed immersion `Δ : X ⟶ W`: a pair `(K, ξ)` consisting of an object `K` of
`D(𝒪_X)` and a map `ξ : Δ_*𝒪_X ⟶ L pr₁^*K|_W` in `D(𝒪_W)` such that `K` is `S`-perfect and
`ξ` defines an isomorphism of `Δ_*𝒪_X` with
`R SheafHom_{𝒪_W}(Δ_*𝒪_X, L pr₁^*K|_W)`.

The derived tensor product over the inverse-image ringed space is the family of certificates
`Dten`, as in the definition of relative perfectness.
declarations.statement:
structure IsRelativeDualizingComplex [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (Dten : ∀ U : TopologicalSpace.Opens
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base).carrier,
      RingedSpace.CertifiedDerivedSheafTensoring.{d', u}
        ((RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding))
    (D : DiagonalOpen f) (K : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace))
    (ξ : D.diagonalObject ⟶ D.derivedPullbackProj K) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingPair
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E2T.** A relative dualizing complex for a flat, locally finitely presented
morphism `f : X ⟶ S`, relative to an open `W ⊆ X ×_S X` through which the relative diagonal
factors as a closed immersion `Δ : X ⟶ W`: a pair `(K, ξ)` consisting of an object `K` of
`D(𝒪_X)` and a map `ξ : Δ_*𝒪_X ⟶ L pr₁^*K|_W` in `D(𝒪_W)` such that `K` is `S`-perfect
(Stacks 0DI0) and `ξ` defines an isomorphism of `Δ_*𝒪_X` with
`R SheafHom_{𝒪_W}(Δ_*𝒪_X, L pr₁^*K|_W)`.
declarations.statement:
structure IsRelativeDualizingPair [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (D : DiagonalOpen f) (K : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace))
    (ξ : D.diagonalObject ⟶ D.derivedPullbackProj K) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isRelativeDualizingComplex_derivedSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E2U.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be flat and locally of finite presentation and let
`(K, ξ)` be a relative dualizing complex for `f` relative to an open `W ⊆ X ×_S X` through which
the relative diagonal factors as a closed immersion. Let `U ⊆ X` be an affine open lying over an
affine open `V ⊆ S`, and put `R = Γ(S, V)` and `A = Γ(X, U)`, an `R`-algebra through `f`. Then
`RΓ(U, K)`, the object of `D(A)` corresponding to `K|_U` under Stacks 06Z0, is a relative
dualizing complex for `R → A` in the sense of Stacks 0E2C.

Two cited inputs are carried. `hTor` is the Tor-dimension clause of Stacks 0DI2, at every object
of `D(𝒪_X)`: the affine comparison of Stacks 0DHY part (2) together with the affine-locality
assembly that the Tor-dimension half of Stacks 0DI2 still lacks. `cmp` is the affine comparison
of `Δ_*𝒪_X`, `L pr₁^*` and `R SheafHom_{𝒪_W}` at a chart of `W` over `A ⊗_R A`, that is
Stacks 08DW part (2) and Stacks 0A6H (3)(a). The pseudo-coherence clause and the condition on
`ξ` are proved. The statement at the source's hypotheses, at the derived tensor product of
Stacks 06YU, is `isRelativeDualizingComplex_derivedSections` in the namespace
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingComplex`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeDualizingComplex_derivedSections [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (Dten : ∀ U : TopologicalSpace.Opens
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base).carrier,
      RingedSpace.CertifiedDerivedSheafTensoring.{d', u}
        ((RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding))
    (D : DiagonalOpen f) (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (ξ : D.diagonalObject ⟶ D.derivedPullbackProj K)
    (hK : IsRelativeDualizingComplex f Dten D K ξ)
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {V : S.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hUV : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    [Algebra ↑Γ(S, V) ↑Γ(X, U)] [Module.Flat ↑Γ(S, V) ↑Γ(X, U)]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation ↑Γ(S, V) ↑Γ(X, U)]
    (_halg : algebraMap ↑Γ(S, V) ↑Γ(X, U) = (f.appLE V U hUV).hom)
    (hTor : ∀ E : DerivedCategory X.Modules,
      RingedSpace.LocallyHasFiniteTorDimension
          (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base) Dten
          ((derivedScalarRestriction f).obj E) →
        StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.HasFiniteTorDimension
          (CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct ↑Γ(S, V)).tensor
          (StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.canonicalTensorComparison ↑Γ(S, V))
          (StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.canonicalTensorIsLeftDerived ↑Γ(S, V))
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap ↑Γ(S, V) ↑Γ(X, U))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            ((derivedSectionsUnbounded X U).obj E)))
    (cmp : D.AffineDiagonalComparison U ↑Γ(S, V)) :
    Dualizing.IsRelativeDualizingComplex ↑Γ(S, V) ↑Γ(X, U)
      ((derivedSectionsUnbounded X U).obj K)
declarations.comment: variant: for an arbitrary family of certified tensorings, given the Tor-dimension clause of Tag 0DI2 at every object and an affine diagonal comparison datum; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.isRelativeDualizingComplex_derivedSections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.isRelativeDualizingComplex_derivedSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E2U.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be flat and locally of finite presentation and let `(K, ξ)`
be a relative dualizing complex for `f` (Stacks 0E2T), relative to an open `W ⊆ X ×_S X` through
which the relative diagonal factors as a closed immersion. Let `U ⊆ X` be an affine open lying
over an affine open `V ⊆ S`, and put `R = Γ(S, V)` and `A = Γ(X, U)`, an `R`-algebra through `f`.
Then `RΓ(U, K)`, the object of `D(A)` corresponding to `K|_U` under Stacks 06Z0, is a relative
dualizing complex for `R → A` in the sense of Stacks 0E2C.

`S`-perfectness is read at the derived tensor product of Stacks 06YU on the open subspaces of
`(X, f⁻¹𝒪_S)`, as in Stacks 0DI2.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeDualizingComplex_derivedSections {D : DiagonalOpen f}
    {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} {ξ : D.diagonalObject ⟶ D.derivedPullbackProj K}
    (hK : IsRelativeDualizingComplex f
      (RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base)) D K ξ)
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {V : S.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hUV : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) := (f.appLE V U hUV).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Module.Flat Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) := moduleFlat_appLE f hV hU hUV rfl
    letI : Algebra.FinitePresentation Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) :=
      algebraFinitePresentation_appLE f hV hU hUV rfl
    Dualizing.IsRelativeDualizingComplex Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U)
      ((derivedSectionsUnbounded X U).obj K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.isIso_derivedSheafHomothety
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E2V.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be flat and locally of finite presentation and let `(K, ξ)`
be a relative dualizing complex for `f` (Stacks 0E2T), relative to an open `W ⊆ X ×_S X` through
which the relative diagonal factors as a closed immersion. Then the homothety
`𝒪_X ⟶ R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(K, K)` is an isomorphism.

`S`-perfectness is read at the derived tensor product of Stacks 06YU on the open subspaces of
`(X, f⁻¹𝒪_S)`, as in Stacks 0DI2 and Stacks 0E2U. The proof is the source's: on every compatible
pair of affine opens `RΓ(U, K)` is a relative dualizing complex for `Γ(S, V) → Γ(X, U)` by
Stacks 0E2U, and the algebraic case is Stacks 0E2G.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.existsUnique_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E2W.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be flat and locally of finite presentation, and let `W` be an
open of `X ×_S X` through which the relative diagonal factors as a closed immersion
`Δ : X ⟶ W`. If `(K, ξ)` and `(L, η)` are relative dualizing complexes on `X/S` relative to `W`
(Stacks 0E2T), then there is a unique isomorphism `α : K ≅ L` sending `ξ` to `η`, that is with
`ξ ≫ L pr₁^*α|_W = η`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.exists_isRelativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E2X.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be flat and locally of finite presentation. There exists a
relative dualizing complex `(K, ξ)` (Stacks 0E2T), relative to any open `W ⊆ X ×_S X` through
which the relative diagonal factors as a closed immersion: `K ∈ D(𝒪_X)` is `S`-perfect and
`ξ : Δ_*𝒪_X ⟶ L pr₁^*K|_W` defines an isomorphism
`Δ_*𝒪_X ≅ R SheafHom_{𝒪_W}(Δ_*𝒪_X, L pr₁^*K|_W)`.

`S`-perfectness is read at a family `Dten` of derived tensor products on the open subspaces of
`(X, f⁻¹𝒪_S)` whose underived tensor products are those of sheaves of modules, so that it is
Stacks 0DI0 (`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isPerfectRelativeTo_iff_isRelativelyPerfect`).

The derived categories of the inverse-image ringed spaces `(X, f⁻¹𝒪_S)|_U` are those of
`CategoryTheory.HasDerivedCategory.standard`, the model at which the chart step (Stacks 0E2F read
through Stacks 0E2U, `exists_isRelativeDualizingComplex_chart`), the restriction of relative
dualizing complexes and Stacks 0E2W are stated. They cannot be left arbitrary: the Tor clause of
`S`-perfectness is read on `(derivedScalarRestriction f).obj K` in the chosen model of
`D(f⁻¹𝒪_S)`, and carrying it from one model to another needs the comparison of the two models of
the derived category, which the library does not provide.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isRelativeDualizingComplex [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (Dten : ∀ U : TopologicalSpace.Opens
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base).carrier,
      RingedSpace.CertifiedDerivedSheafTensoring
        ((RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding))
    (hD : IsGenuineRelativeTensorFamily f Dten) (D : DiagonalOpen f) :
    ∃ (K : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace))
      (ξ : D.diagonalObject ⟶ D.derivedPullbackProj K),
      IsRelativeDualizingComplex f Dten D K ξ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E2Y: base change of a relative dualizing complex.** Let `X' = X ×_S S'` with
projections `g' : X' ⟶ X` and `f' : X' ⟶ S'`, `f` flat and locally of finite presentation, and
let `(K, ξ)` be a relative dualizing complex for `f` relative to a diagonal open `W`. For a
diagonal open `W'` of `f'` with `(g' × g')(W') ⊆ W` and `w : W' ⟶ W` the induced morphism, set
`K' = L(g')^*K` and let `ξ'` be the derived base change of `ξ`: `Lw^*ξ` read through
`Lw^*Δ_*𝒪_X = Δ'_*𝒪_{X'}` (the base change of `Δ_*` across the Tor independent diagonal square)
and transitivity of derived pullback. Then `(K', ξ')` is a relative dualizing complex for `f'`
relative to `W'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChange (hpb : IsPullback g' f' f g) {D : DiagonalOpen f}
    {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} {ξ : D.diagonalObject ⟶ D.derivedPullbackProj K}
    (hK : IsRelativeDualizingComplex f
      (RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base)) D K ξ)
    (D' : DiagonalOpen f') (w : D'.W ⟶ D.W)
    (hw : w ≫ D.ι = D'.ι ≫ pullbackMapOfIsPullback hpb) :
    haveI : Flat f' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @Flat) hpb (inferInstance : Flat f)
    haveI : LocallyOfFinitePresentation f' :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @LocallyOfFinitePresentation) hpb
        (inferInstance : LocallyOfFinitePresentation f)
    IsRelativeDualizingComplex f'
      (RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S'.toRingedSpace f'.base)) D'
      (DiagonalOpen.baseChangeComplex g' K)
      (D.baseChangeDiagonalMap D' g' w (DiagonalOpen.proj_baseChange hpb D D' w hw)
        (DiagonalOpen.baseChangeDiagonalIso hpb D D' w hw) K ξ)
declarations.comment:
As in the source's proof, `W'` is any diagonal open of `f'` with
`(g' × g')(W') ⊆ W`, and `w : W' ⟶ W` is the induced morphism.

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isRelativeDualizingComplex_relativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E2Z.** Let `S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and let
`f : X ⟶ S` be a proper, flat morphism of finite presentation. The relative dualizing complex
`ω_{X/S}^• = a(𝒪_S)` of [Stacks, Remark 0B6S]
(`Stacks.Duality.StandardModel.relativeDualizingComplex`) together with the map
`ξ : Δ_*𝒪_X ⟶ L pr₁^*ω_{X/S}^•` coming from the isomorphism `𝒪_X ≅ c(L pr₁^*ω_{X/S}^•)` of
[Stacks, Tag 0E2Q] (`Stacks.Duality.relativeDualizingComplexDiagonalMap`) is a relative
dualizing complex in the sense of [Stacks, Definition 0E2T], for the open `W = X ×_S X` (the
morphism being separated) and the derived tensor product of sheaves of modules.

Of finite presentation is `LocallyOfFinitePresentation f` together with the quasi-compactness and
quasi-separatedness that properness includes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeDualizingComplex_relativeDualizingComplex {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsProper f] [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : CompactSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) :=
      QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (pullback.fst f f)
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback f f : Scheme.{u}) :=
      quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.fst f f)
    @Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingComplex X S f (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)
      (fun _ => HasDerivedCategory.standard _) _ _
      (@RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base) (fun _ => HasDerivedCategory.standard _))
      (Scheme.Hom.DiagonalOpen.ofIsSeparated f) (StandardModel.relativeDualizingComplex f).obj
      (relativeDualizingComplexDiagonalMap f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativeDualizingComplex.comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E30.** Let `f : Y ⟶ X` and `g : X ⟶ S` be flat and locally of finite
presentation, and let `(K, ξ)` and `(M, η)` be relative dualizing complexes for `g` and `f`.
Then `(M ⊗ᴸ Lf^*K, ζ)` is a relative dualizing complex for `f ≫ g`, for a suitable `ζ`, on the
diagonal open `W' = Dg.comp Df` of the source's proof.

The source's proof applies Stacks 0E2N with tensor factor `Lq^*M` over `𝒪_{Y ×_S Y}`, which
needs Tor amplitude of `Lq^*M` over `𝒪_{Y ×_S Y}`; this fails for `X = S = Spec k`,
`Y = Spec B`, `B` Artinian non-Gorenstein, `M = ω_B`. The proof here uses instead the Tor
amplitude of `Lq^*M` relative to `f × f`, as the algebraic version 0E2H does over `A ⊗_R A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsRelativeDualizingComplex.comp {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ S) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [Flat g] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    {Dg : DiagonalOpen g} {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules}
    {ξ : Dg.diagonalObject ⟶ Dg.derivedPullbackProj K}
    (hK : IsRelativeDualizingComplex g (RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily _)
      Dg K ξ)
    {Df : DiagonalOpen f} {M : DerivedCategory Y.Modules}
    {η : Df.diagonalObject ⟶ Df.derivedPullbackProj M}
    (hM : IsRelativeDualizingComplex f (RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily _)
      Df M η) :
    ∃ ζ, IsRelativeDualizingComplex (f ≫ g)
      (RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily _) (Dg.comp Df)
      (((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor
        Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj M).obj
        ((derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K)) ζ

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.nonempty_dualizingComplexOverField_baseChange_iso
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a proper scheme over a field `k`, let `K/k` be a field extension and `X' = X_K`
the base change, with projection `g'`. Then the pullbacks of `ω_X^•` and `ω_X` to `X'` are the
dualizing complex and the dualizing sheaf of [Stacks, Tag 0BS2] for `X' ⟶ Spec K`:
`L(g')^*ω_X^• ≅ ω_{X'}^•` and `(g')^*ω_X ≅ ω_{X'}`. No hypothesis on `dim X` is needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_dualizingComplexOverField_baseChange_iso :
    haveI := isProper_of_isPullback_specMapAlgebraMap k K g' f' f h
    Nonempty ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g').obj (dualizingComplexOverField f) ≅
        dualizingComplexOverField f') ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj (dualizingSheafOverField f) ≅
        dualizingSheafOverField f')
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.dualizingComplexOverFieldFactorIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E32], part (1).** Let `X` be proper over a field `k` and suppose
`X ⟶ Spec k` factors as `X ⟶ Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` for a field `k'`. Then the dualizing complex
`ω_X^•` of `X` over `k` is the dualizing complex of `X` over `k'`; hence `ω_X^•` and `ω_X`
satisfy the properties of [Stacks, Tag 0BS2] with `k` replaced by `k'`.

As in the source, `k'/k` is finite because `k' ⊆ H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`
(`Stacks.Duality.finite_of_isProper_comp`), and the two dualizing complexes both represent
`K ↦ Hom(H⁰(X, K), -)`, the `k`-dual and the `k'`-dual corresponding through a nonzero
`k`-linear form on `k'` (`Stacks.Duality.dualizingComplexOverFieldChangeIsoOfForm`).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def dualizingComplexOverFieldFactorIso (hf : f' ≫ Spec.map φ = f) :
    haveI := isProper_of_comp_eq f φ f' hf
    dualizingComplexOverField f ≅ dualizingComplexOverField f'
declarations.comment: part (1), in the form the proof states it: omega_X^bullet over k is omega_X^bullet over k', along which the properties of Tag 0BS2 over k' transfer; omega_X is dualizingSheafOverFieldFactorIso and clause (4) over k' is extDualityAddEquivOfFactor

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.dualizingComplexOverField_closedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E33.** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension at most one over a
field `k` and let `i : Y ⟶ X` be a closed immersion, with dualizing complexes and dualizing
sheaves `ω_X^•, ω_X, ω_Y^•, ω_Y` as in [Stacks, Tag 0BS2]. Then
1. `ω_Y^• = R𝓗om(𝒪_Y, ω_X^•)`;
2. `ω_Y = 𝓗om(𝒪_Y, ω_X)` and `i_*ω_Y = 𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(i_*𝒪_Y, ω_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dualizingComplexOverField_closedImmersion
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (1 : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    Nonempty ((dualizingComplexOverField (i ≫ f)).obj ≅
        (LocallySmall.derivedSheafHomExactSupport i).obj (dualizingComplexOverField f).obj) ∧
      Nonempty (dualizingSheafOverField (i ≫ f) ≅
        (closedQuotient i).sheafHomExactSupport.obj (dualizingSheafOverField f)) ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (dualizingSheafOverField (i ≫ f)) ≅
        (closedQuotient i).homSheafFromPushforwardStructureSheaf.obj
          (dualizingSheafOverField f))

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.dualizingSheafOverField_closedSubcurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E34.** Let `X` be a proper scheme over a field which is Gorenstein,
reduced, and equidimensional of dimension one. Let `C` cut out a reduced closed subscheme
`i : Y ⟶ X` equidimensional of dimension one, let `j : Z ⟶ X` be the scheme-theoretic closure of
`X \ Y`, cut out by `𝓙 = complementaryCurveIdeal C`, and let `Y ∩ Z` be cut out by `𝓘 ⊔ 𝓙`. With
`𝓘'` and `𝓙'` the ideals of `Y ∩ Z` in `Z` and in `Y`:
1. `Y` and `Z` are Cohen–Macaulay;
2. `𝓘 = j_*𝓘'` and `𝓙 = i_*𝓙'`, read on affine opens;
3. `ω_Y ≅ 𝓙'(i^*ω_X)` and `i_*ω_Y ≅ 𝓙ω_X`;
4. `ω_Z ≅ 𝓘'(j^*ω_X)` and `j_*ω_Z ≅ 𝓘ω_X`;
5. the six short exact sequences of
   `Stacks.Curves.dualizingSheafOverField_closedSubcurve_of_isInvertible`.

Since `X` is Gorenstein and its closed points have one-dimensional local rings, `ω_X` is
invertible (`AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField`), and the statement is
`Stacks.Curves.dualizingSheafOverField_closedSubcurve_of_isInvertible`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dualizingSheafOverField_closedSubcurve [IsReduced X] [IsGorenstein X]
    (hXeq : TopologicalSpace.Equidimensional X) (hXdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced C.subscheme]
    (hYeq : TopologicalSpace.Equidimensional C.subscheme)
    (hYdim : topologicalKrullDim C.subscheme = 1) :
    -- (1)
    (IsCohenMacaulay C.subscheme ∧ IsCohenMacaulay (complementaryCurve C)) ∧
    -- (2)
    (∀ U : X.affineOpens,
      Set.BijOn ((complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι.app U.1) (C.ideal U)
        ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
            (le_sup_right : complementaryCurveIdeal C ≤
              intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C)).ker.ideal
          ⟨(complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage _⟩) ∧
      Set.BijOn (C.subschemeι.app U.1) ((complementaryCurveIdeal C).ideal U)
        ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
            (le_sup_left : C ≤ intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C)).ker.ideal
          ⟨C.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage _⟩)) ∧
    -- (3)
    (Nonempty (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (C.subschemeι ≫ f) ≅
        (Stacks.Algebraization.idealPowerMultiple
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
            (le_sup_left : C ≤ intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C)).ker 1
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.subschemeι).obj
            (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f))).toSheafOfModules) ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.subschemeι).obj
          (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (C.subschemeι ≫ f)) ≅
        (Stacks.Algebraization.idealPowerMultiple (complementaryCurveIdeal C) 1
          (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)).toSheafOfModules)) ∧
    -- (4)
    (Nonempty (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField
          ((complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι ≫ f) ≅
        (Stacks.Algebraization.idealPowerMultiple
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
            (le_sup_right : complementaryCurveIdeal C ≤
              intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C)).ker 1
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f))).toSheafOfModules) ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
          (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField ((complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι ≫ f)) ≅
        (Stacks.Algebraization.idealPowerMultiple C 1
          (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)).toSheafOfModules)) ∧
    -- (5)
    ((∃ (a : Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.subschemeι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.subschemeι).obj
              (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)) ⊞
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
              (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)))
        (b : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.subschemeι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.subschemeι).obj
              (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)) ⊞
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
              (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)) ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C).ringCatSheaf))
        (w : a ≫ b = 0), (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) ∧
      (∃ (a : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.subschemeι).obj
            (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (C.subschemeι ≫ f)) ⟶
            Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)
        (b : Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
              (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)))
        (w : a ≫ b = 0), (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) ∧
      (∃ (a : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField ((complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι ≫ f)) ⟶
            Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)
        (b : Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.subschemeι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.subschemeι).obj (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)))
        (w : a ≫ b = 0), (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) ∧
      (∃ (a : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.subschemeι).obj
            (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (C.subschemeι ≫ f)) ⊞
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField ((complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι ≫ f)) ⟶
            Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f)
        (b : Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C).ringCatSheaf))
        (w : a ≫ b = 0), (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) ∧
      (∃ (a : Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (C.subschemeι ≫ f) ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.subschemeι).obj (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f))
        (b : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.subschemeι).obj (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f) ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
            (le_sup_left : C ≤ intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C))).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C).ringCatSheaf))
        (w : a ≫ b = 0), (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) ∧
      (∃ (a : Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField
            ((complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι ≫ f) ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f))
        (b : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (complementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι).obj
            (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField f) ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
            (le_sup_right : complementaryCurveIdeal C ≤
              intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C))).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C).ringCatSheaf))
        (w : a ≫ b = 0), (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact))
declarations.comment:
in (2) and (4) the source swaps the roles of i and j: the forms stated are
I = j_* I', J = i_* J', omega_Z = I'(j^* omega_X) and j_* omega_Z = I omega_X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvePushoutSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E35.** The four conditions of the section — `X` separated of finite
type over the field `k` of dimension `≤ 1`, `i` a closed immersion, `Z` and `Y` finite over
`Spec k`, and `j` surjective — put the diagram in the standing situation of
[Stacks Project, Tag 0ECI], so that the pushout `Y ⨿_Z X` of [Stacks Project, Tag 0E25] and
everything derived from it apply.

The content is the verification of the two assumptions of [Stacks Project, Tag 0ECI] that are not
hypotheses here: that `j` is integral, and that every fibre of `j` maps under `i` into a single
affine open of `X`.  The latter is [Stacks Project, Tag 09NN].
declarations.statement:
def curvePushoutSituation
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (pX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (pY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (pZ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z ⟶ Y) (hi : i ≫ pX = pZ) (hj : j ≫ pY = pZ)
    [IsSeparated pX] [LocallyOfFiniteType pX] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsFinite pY] [IsFinite pZ] [Surjective j] :
    PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u}
declarations.comment: the assumptions of More on Morphisms, Proposition 0E25 are satisfied

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_curvePushoutCompletedLocalRing_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E36.**  Stated in the situation of [Stacks Project, Tag 0E35] itself:
`k` is a field, `X` is separated of finite type over `k` of dimension `≤ 1`, `i : Z ⟶ X` is a
closed immersion, `Z` and `Y` are finite over `Spec k` and `j : Z ⟶ Y` is surjective.  Let `Y` be
the spectrum of a field `k'` and `Z` the spectrum of a product of finite extensions `k'_i/k'`,
let `x` be the image of `Y` in the pushout `Y ⨿_Z X` and `x'_i` the image of `Spec (k'_i)` in `X`.
Then the completed local ring at `x` is the fibre product of the product of the completed local
rings at the `x'_i` and the field `k'` over the product of the `k'_i`, the horizontal maps being
the maps to the residue fields.

The equations following the pullback assertion pin down the four maps in the diagram.

Against the notation of [Stacks Project, Tag 0E35] the translation is `Z = Z'`, `X = X'` and
`Y = Z`, following the library's `PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation`.  The standing
situation of [Stacks Project, Tag 0ECI] is *derived* from the four conditions here, by
`curvePushoutSituation` ([Stacks Project, Tag 0E35]), rather than assumed; the locally Noetherian
hypothesis of `exists_pushoutCompletedLocalRing_isPullback` is discharged along the way through
[Stacks Project, Tag 0E27].
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_curvePushoutCompletedLocalRing_isPullback
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (pX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (pY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (pZ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z ⟶ Y) (hi : i ≫ pX = pZ) (hj : j ≫ pY = pZ)
    [IsSeparated pX] [LocallyOfFiniteType pX] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsFinite pY] [IsFinite pZ] [Surjective j]
    (n : ℕ) (k' : Type u) (k'_i : Fin n → Type u)
    [Field k'] [∀ a, Field (k'_i a)]
    [∀ a, Algebra k' (k'_i a)] [∀ a, Module.Finite k' (k'_i a)]
    (eZ : Z ≅ Spec (.of (∀ a, k'_i a)))
    (eY : Y ≅ Spec (.of k'))
    (hjeq : j = eZ.hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.pi fun a ↦ algebraMap k' (k'_i a))) ≫ eY.inv) :
    let s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u} :=
      curvePushoutSituation k pX pY pZ i j hi hj hdim
    let y : Y := eY.inv (closedPoint k')
    let specPoint : ∀ a, Spec (.of (k'_i a)) ⟶ Z := fun a ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Pi.evalRingHom k'_i a)) ≫ eZ.inv
    let z : Fin n → Z := fun a ↦ specPoint a (closedPoint (k'_i a))
    let x : pushoutScheme s := pushoutInr s y
    let x' : Fin n → X := fun a ↦ i (z a)
    ∃ (hx : ∀ a, pushoutInl s (x' a) = x)
      (completionMap : Scheme.completedLocalRing (pushoutScheme s) x →+*
        (∀ a, Scheme.completedLocalRing X (x' a)))
      (bottomResidueMap : Scheme.completedLocalRing (pushoutScheme s) x →+* k')
      (componentResidueMap : ∀ a, Scheme.completedLocalRing X (x' a) →+* k'_i a),
      let topResidueMap : (∀ a, Scheme.completedLocalRing X (x' a)) →+* (∀ a, k'_i a) :=
        RingHom.pi fun a ↦ (componentResidueMap a).comp (Pi.evalRingHom _ a)
      (∀ a, ((Pi.evalRingHom _ a).comp completionMap).comp
          (algebraMap ((pushoutScheme s).presheaf.stalk x)
            (Scheme.completedLocalRing (pushoutScheme s) x)) =
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (x' a)) (Scheme.completedLocalRing X (x' a))).comp
          ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun p ↦ (pushoutScheme s).presheaf.stalk p)
            (hx a).symm) ≫ (pushoutInl s).stalkMap (x' a)).hom)) ∧
      (bottomResidueMap.comp
          (algebraMap ((pushoutScheme s).presheaf.stalk x)
            (Scheme.completedLocalRing (pushoutScheme s) x)) =
        (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (eY.inv ≫ pushoutInr s)).hom) ∧
      (∀ a, (componentResidueMap a).comp
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (x' a))
            (Scheme.completedLocalRing X (x' a))) =
        (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (specPoint a ≫ i)).hom) ∧
      IsPullback
        (CommRingCat.ofHom bottomResidueMap)
        (CommRingCat.ofHom completionMap)
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.pi fun a ↦ algebraMap k' (k'_i a)))
        (CommRingCat.ofHom topResidueMap)
