declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.exists_iso_sigma_spec_intersectionWithComplementaryCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E38, clause (2)(a).** Let `X` be a one-dimensional equidimensional
curve locally of finite type over a field `k` with at worst nodal singularities, let `Y ⊆ X` be a
reduced equidimensional closed subscheme of dimension one, and let `Z` be the scheme-theoretic
closure of `X ∖ Y`. Then the scheme-theoretic intersection `Y ∩ Z` is, over `k`, a disjoint union
of spectra of finite separable extensions of `k`.

At each point of `Y ∩ Z` the stalks of the ideal sheaves of `Y` and `Z` are the two minimal primes
of the local ring of the node there
(`Stacks.Curves.exists_stalk_eq_of_mem_support_of_mem_support_complementaryCurveIdeal`), and these
sum to the maximal ideal, the delta invariant being one
(`Ring.sup_eq_maximalIdeal_of_deltaInvariant_eq_one`). So every local ring of `Y ∩ Z` is a field:
`Y ∩ Z` is reduced, and its points are closed, so it is discrete. Each `Spec κ(w) ⟶ Y ∩ Z` is then
an open and closed immersion, and together they present `Y ∩ Z` as the coproduct of the spectra
of its residue fields, which are finite (closed points) and separable (nodes) over `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_sigma_spec_intersectionWithComplementaryCurve
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hX_equidimensional : Equidimensional X)
    (hX_dimension : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hX_nodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced I.subscheme]
    (hY_equidimensional : Equidimensional I.subscheme)
    (hY_dimension : topologicalKrullDim I.subscheme = 1) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (K : ι → Type u) (_ : ∀ i, Field (K i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra k (K i)),
      (∀ i, Module.Finite k (K i) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable k (K i)) ∧
      ∃ e : (∐ fun i => Spec (.of (K i))) ≅ intersectionWithComplementaryCurve I,
        ∀ i, Limits.Sigma.ι (fun i => Spec (.of (K i))) i ≫ e.hom ≫
            (intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal I).subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (K i)))
declarations.comment: intersection_is_disjoint_union_of_spectra_of_finite_separable_extensions

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isFiniteSeparable_residueField_of_mem_intersection_complementaryCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E38, part (2)(a): the residue field at a point where a reduced closed subcurve meets
the closure of its complement is a finite separable extension of the base field.** Such a point is
a node of `X` by part (2)(b), and the residue field extension at a node is separable (Tag 0C4D)
and finite because the point is closed and `X` is locally of finite type over `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteSeparable_residueField_of_mem_intersection_complementaryCurve
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hX_equidimensional : Equidimensional X)
    (hX_dimension : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hX_nodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced I.subscheme]
    (hY_equidimensional : Equidimensional I.subscheme)
    (hY_dimension : topologicalKrullDim I.subscheme = 1)
    {x : X} (hxI : x ∈ (I.support : Set X))
    (hxJ : x ∈ ((complementaryCurveIdeal I).support : Set X)) :
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    Module.Finite k (X.residueField x) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x)
declarations.comment: part (2)(a), the residue fields of the intersection are finite separable over k

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.smoothAt_of_mem_support_complementaryCurveIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E38, part (2)(c): a reduced closed subcurve of a one-dimensional equidimensional
at-worst-nodal curve is smooth over the base field at every point where it meets the closure of
its complement.** At such a point the local ring of `X` is reduced with delta invariant one and
exactly two minimal primes, and the stalk of the ideal sheaf of the subcurve is one of them; the
quotient of such a local ring by a minimal prime is a discrete valuation ring, hence a regular
local ring, and over a field regularity with separable residue field is smoothness.
declarations.statement:
theorem smoothAt_of_mem_support_complementaryCurveIdeal
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hX_equidimensional : Equidimensional X)
    (hX_dimension : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hX_nodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced I.subscheme]
    (hY_equidimensional : Equidimensional I.subscheme)
    (hY_dimension : topologicalKrullDim I.subscheme = 1)
    (y : I.subscheme)
    (hy : I.subschemeι.base y ∈ ((complementaryCurveIdeal I).support : Set X)) :
    InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt (I.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) y
declarations.comment: part (2)(c)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isDiscrete_and_residueField_intersectionWithComplementaryCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E38, part (2)(a): the scheme-theoretic intersection of a reduced closed subcurve with
the closure of its complement is the disjoint union of the spectra of finite separable extensions
of the base field.** Its underlying space is discrete, so it is the disjoint union of its points;
at each point the stalk of the ideal sheaf cutting it out is the maximal ideal of the local ring of
`X`, so the local ring there is the residue field `κ(x)`; and that residue field is a finite
separable extension of `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDiscrete_and_residueField_intersectionWithComplementaryCurve
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hX_equidimensional : Equidimensional X)
    (hX_dimension : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hX_nodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced I.subscheme]
    (hY_equidimensional : Equidimensional I.subscheme)
    (hY_dimension : topologicalKrullDim I.subscheme = 1) :
    DiscreteTopology ((intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal I).subscheme : Type u) ∧
      ∀ w : (intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal I).subscheme,
        let x := (intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal I).subschemeι.base w
        let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
            X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
        letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
        letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
        IdealSheafData.stalk (intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal I) x =
            IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
          Module.Finite k (X.residueField x) ∧
            Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x)
declarations.comment: part (2)(a)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.hasAtWorstNodalSingularities_subscheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E38, part (1): a reduced closed subscheme, equidimensional of dimension one, of a
one-dimensional equidimensional locally algebraic curve with at-worst-nodal singularities again has
at-worst-nodal singularities.** At a point where the subcurve meets the closure of its complement
it is in fact smooth over the base field, by part (2)(c). At any other point the subcurve agrees
with the ambient curve on an open neighbourhood, and the dichotomy "smooth over `k` or a node"
transports along the two étale morphisms from that open subscheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasAtWorstNodalSingularities_subscheme
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hX_equidimensional : Equidimensional X)
    (hX_dimension : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hX_nodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced I.subscheme]
    (hY_equidimensional : Equidimensional I.subscheme)
    (hY_dimension : topologicalKrullDim I.subscheme = 1) :
    letI : I.subscheme.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨I.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))⟩
    HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k I.subscheme
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_of_mem_intersection_complementaryCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E38.** Every point where a reduced equidimensional closed subcurve
meets the scheme-theoretic closure of its complement, in a one-dimensional equidimensional curve
over a field with at worst nodal singularities, is a node of the ambient curve.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_of_mem_intersection_complementaryCurve
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hX_equidimensional : Equidimensional X)
    (hX_dimension : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hX_nodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced I.subscheme]
    (hY_equidimensional : Equidimensional I.subscheme)
    (hY_dimension : topologicalKrullDim I.subscheme = 1) :
    let U : X.Opens := ⟨I.supportᶜ, I.support.isClosed.isOpen_compl⟩
    ∀ y : (I ⊔ U.ι.ker).subscheme, IsNode k X ((I ⊔ U.ι.ker).subschemeι.base y)
declarations.comment: intersection_points_are_nodes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CohenMacaulayCurveSituation.invertibleCurveDegree_le_and_lt_or_nonempty_iso_of_not_isZero_cohomology_idealTwist
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3A.** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0B5D] assume `X` is integral of genus
`g`. Let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subscheme of dimension at
most zero with ideal sheaf `ℐ`. If `H^1(X, ℐℒ) ≠ 0`, then

  `deg(ℒ) ≤ 2g - 2 + deg(Z)`,

with strict inequality unless `ℐℒ ≅ ω_X`. Here `ℐℒ` is `ℒ ⊗ ℐ`, `deg(Z) = dim_k Γ(Z, 𝒪_Z)` and
`ω_X` is the dualizing sheaf of [Stacks, Tag 0BS2].
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleCurveDegree_le_and_lt_or_nonempty_iso_of_not_isZero_cohomology_idealTwist
    [IsIntegral S.X] (L : S.X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible S.X.presheaf S.X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (Z : S.X.IdealSheafData) (hZ : topologicalKrullDim Z.subscheme ≤ 0)
    (h : ¬ IsZero (cohomologyOverField S.k S.f (S.idealTwist Z L) 1)) :
    invertibleCurveDegree S.k S.f (le_of_eq S.dimension_one) L ≤
        2 * (genus S.f : ℤ) - 2 + (S.subschemeDegree Z : ℤ) ∧
      (invertibleCurveDegree S.k S.f (le_of_eq S.dimension_one) L <
          2 * (genus S.f : ℤ) - 2 + (S.subschemeDegree Z : ℤ) ∨
        Nonempty (S.idealTwist Z L ≅ Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField S.f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CohenMacaulayCurveSituation.isZero_cohomology_one_idealTwist_of_lt
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E3B], the vanishing.** If `deg(ℒ) > 2g - 2 + deg(Z)` then
`H¹(X, ℐℒ) = 0`: a nonzero `H¹(X, ℐℒ)` would force `deg(ℒ) ≤ 2g - 2 + deg(Z)` by
[Stacks, Tag 0E3A].
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomology_one_idealTwist_of_lt (hZ : topologicalKrullDim Z.subscheme ≤ 0)
    (hdeg : 2 * (genus S.f : ℤ) - 2 + (S.subschemeDegree Z : ℤ) <
      invertibleCurveDegree S.k S.f (le_of_eq S.dimension_one) L) :
    IsZero (cohomologyOverField S.k S.f (S.idealTwist Z L) 1)
declarations.comment: the vanishing of H^1(X, IL)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CohenMacaulayCurveSituation.not_isZero_cohomology_zero_idealTwist_or_of_lt
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E3B], the alternative.** If `deg(ℒ) > 2g - 2 + deg(Z)` then either
`H⁰(X, ℐℒ) ≠ 0`, or `g = 0` and `deg(ℒ) = deg(Z) - 1`. When `H⁰(X, ℐℒ) = 0` the Euler
characteristic `χ(X, ℐℒ) = deg(ℒ) + 1 - g - deg(Z)` vanishes, `H¹(X, ℐℒ)` vanishing as well.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isZero_cohomology_zero_idealTwist_or_of_lt (hZ : topologicalKrullDim Z.subscheme ≤ 0)
    (hdeg : 2 * (genus S.f : ℤ) - 2 + (S.subschemeDegree Z : ℤ) <
      invertibleCurveDegree S.k S.f (le_of_eq S.dimension_one) L) :
    ¬ IsZero (cohomologyOverField S.k S.f (S.idealTwist Z L) 0) ∨
      (genus S.f = 0 ∧ invertibleCurveDegree S.k S.f (le_of_eq S.dimension_one) L =
        (S.subschemeDegree Z : ℤ) - 1)
declarations.comment: possibilities (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CohenMacaulayCurveSituation.exists_isIso_projectiveLine_of_genus_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E3B], case (2) with `Z = ∅`.** If `g = 0` and `deg(ℒ) = -1`, then `X ≅ 𝐏¹_k`
over `k`, and under this isomorphism `ℒ^{⊗ -1}` is the pullback of `𝒪(1)`, i.e. `ℒ` corresponds to
`𝒪_{𝐏¹}(-1)`. The invertible module `ℒ^{⊗ -1}` has degree one, so a basis of its two-dimensional
space of global sections defines an isomorphism `X ⟶ 𝐏¹_k` ([Stacks, Tag 0C6T]) along which
`𝒪(1)` pulls back to `ℒ^{⊗ -1}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isIso_projectiveLine_of_genus_eq_zero
    (hgenus : genus S.f = 0)
    (hdeg : invertibleCurveDegree S.k S.f (le_of_eq S.dimension_one) L = -1) :
    ∃ p : S.X ⟶ projectiveSpaceOver 1 (Spec (.of S.k)),
      IsIso p ∧
      p ≫ Limits.pullback.fst (Limits.terminal.from (Spec (.of S.k)))
          (Limits.terminal.from (projectiveSpaceAtUniverse.{u} 1)) = S.f ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (p ≫ projectiveSpaceOver.toIntegralAtUniverse 1 (Spec (.of S.k)))).obj
            (Stacks.AmpleProjectiveImmersion.twistingSheafAtUniverse.{u} 1) ≅
          tensorPowerModule L (-1))
declarations.comment: in case (2) with Z empty, X is P^1_k and L corresponds to O(-1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CohenMacaulayCurveSituation.isGeneratedByGlobalSections_of_two_mul_genus_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3C.** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0B5D] assume `X` is integral of genus
`g`, and let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module. If `deg(ℒ) ≥ 2g`, then `ℒ` is generated by its
global sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeneratedByGlobalSections_of_two_mul_genus_le [IsIntegral S.X] (L : S.X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible S.X.presheaf S.X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (hL : 2 * (genus S.f : ℤ) ≤ invertibleCurveDegree S.k S.f (le_of_eq S.dimension_one) L) :
    SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections L

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CohenMacaulayCurveSituation.isGeneratedByGlobalSections_and_surjective_subschemeRestrictionπ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3D.** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0B5D] assume `X` is integral of genus
`g`, let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and let `Z ⊆ X` be a nonempty `0`-dimensional closed
subscheme. If `deg(ℒ) ≥ 2g - 1 + deg(Z)`, then `ℒ` is generated by its global sections and
`H⁰(X, ℒ) ⟶ H⁰(X, ℒ|_Z)` is surjective.

Here `deg(Z) = dim_k Γ(Z, 𝒪_Z)` and `ℒ|_Z = ℒ ⊗ i_* 𝒪_Z`. Global generation is [Stacks, Tag 0E3C],
as `deg(Z) ≥ 1`; the surjectivity follows from `H¹(X, ℐ_Z ℒ) = 0`, which is [Stacks, Tag 0E3A]
since `deg(ℒ) > 2g - 2 + deg(Z)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeneratedByGlobalSections_and_surjective_subschemeRestrictionπ [IsIntegral S.X]
    (L : S.X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible S.X.presheaf S.X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (Z : S.X.IdealSheafData) (hZ : topologicalKrullDim Z.subscheme ≤ 0)
    (hZne : Nonempty Z.subscheme)
    (hL : 2 * (genus S.f : ℤ) - 1 + (S.subschemeDegree Z : ℤ) ≤
      invertibleCurveDegree S.k S.f (le_of_eq S.dimension_one) L) :
    SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections L ∧
      Function.Surjective (cohomologyOverFieldMap S.k S.f (S.subschemeRestrictionπ Z L) 0)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_subcurve_invertibleCurveDegree_le_of_not_isZero_cohomology_idealTwist
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3E.** Let `k` be a field and `X` a proper scheme over `k` which is
reduced and of dimension `1`. Let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and `Z ⊆ X` a closed subscheme
of dimension at most zero with ideal sheaf `ℐ`. If `H¹(X, ℐℒ) ≠ 0`, then there is a reduced
connected closed subscheme `Y ⊆ X` of dimension `1` with

  `deg(ℒ|_Y) ≤ -2 χ(Y, 𝒪_Y) + deg(Z ∩ Y)`,

where `Z ∩ Y` is the scheme-theoretic intersection `Z ⊔ Y` and `deg(Z ∩ Y) = dim_k Γ(Z ∩ Y, 𝒪)`.
Here `ℐℒ` is `ℒ ⊗ ℐ`, as in [Stacks, Tag 0E3A]; the source's hypothesis that `X` is connected is
not needed.

A nonzero map `ℐℒ ⟶ ω_X` from duality ([Stacks, Tag 0BS2]) kills nothing more than the zero
module, `X` being reduced, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_le_invertibleCurveDegree_le_of_ne_zero` applies with `T₀ = X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_subcurve_invertibleCurveDegree_le_of_not_isZero_cohomology_idealTwist
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] [IsReduced X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (L : X.Modules)
    [hL : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hZ : topologicalKrullDim Z.subscheme ≤ 0)
    (h : ¬ IsZero (cohomologyOverField k f
      ((((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, u, u, u, u}
            ⟨X.toRingedSpace.presheaf, X.toRingedSpace.IsSheaf⟩).obj L).obj
          (Stacks.ClosedImmersion.idealSheaf Z.subschemeι.toLRSHom.toShHom))) 1)) :
    ∃ (Y : X.IdealSheafData) (_ : IsReduced Y.subscheme) (_ : ConnectedSpace Y.subscheme)
      (hY : topologicalKrullDim Y.subscheme = 1),
      letI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag09NY.isInvertible_modulePullback Y.subschemeι L hL
      letI : Algebra k Γ((Z ⊔ Y).subscheme, ⊤) :=
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ ((Z ⊔ Y).subschemeι ≫ f).appTop).hom.toAlgebra
      invertibleCurveDegree k (Y.subschemeι ≫ f) hY.le
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback Y.subschemeι).obj L) ≤
        -2 * (∑ᶠ n : ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ n * (Module.finrank k (cohomologyOverField k
          (Y.subschemeι ≫ f) (SheafOfModules.unit Y.subscheme.ringCatSheaf) n) : ℤ)) +
          (Module.finrank k Γ((Z ⊔ Y).subscheme, ⊤) : ℤ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGeneratedByGlobalSections_of_forall_subcurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3F.** Let `k` be a field and `X` a proper scheme over `k` which is
reduced and of dimension `1`, and let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module such that
`deg(ℒ|_Y) ≥ 2 dim_k H¹(Y, 𝒪_Y)` for every reduced connected closed subscheme `Y ⊆ X` of
dimension `1`. Then `ℒ` is globally generated. The source's hypothesis that `X` is connected is
not needed.

As `h⁰(Y, 𝒪_Y) ≥ 1`, the bound gives `-2 χ(Y, 𝒪_Y) < deg(ℒ|_Y)` and
`h¹(Y, 𝒪_Y) < deg(ℒ|_Y) + χ(Y, 𝒪_Y)`, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.isGeneratedByGlobalSections_of_forall_subcurve_lt` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeneratedByGlobalSections_of_forall_subcurve (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    [IsReduced X] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (L : X.Modules)
    [hL : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (h : ∀ (Y : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced Y.subscheme] [ConnectedSpace Y.subscheme]
      (hY : topologicalKrullDim Y.subscheme = 1),
      letI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag09NY.isInvertible_modulePullback Y.subschemeι L hL
      2 * (Module.finrank k (cohomologyOverField k (Y.subschemeι ≫ f)
        (SheafOfModules.unit Y.subscheme.ringCatSheaf) 1) : ℤ) ≤
        invertibleCurveDegree k (Y.subschemeι ≫ f) hY.le
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback Y.subschemeι).obj L)) :
    _root_.SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections L

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isProper_complementaryCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E3H.** The scheme-theoretic closure of the complement of a closed subscheme of a
proper scheme over a field is again proper over that field. For a rational tail this is the
assertion that `X'` is proper over `k`; no rational-tail hypothesis is needed for it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_complementaryCurve
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (C : X.IdealSheafData) :
    IsProper (complementaryCurveι C ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))
declarations.comment: complementary_curve_is_proper

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.topologicalKrullDim_complementaryCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E3H.** The scheme-theoretic closure `X'` of the complement of a rational tail of
a proper one-dimensional curve over a field with only constant global functions is again of
dimension one.
declarations.statement:
theorem topologicalKrullDim_complementaryCurve
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    topologicalKrullDim (complementaryCurve C) = 1
declarations.comment: complementary_curve_has_dimension_one

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isIso_globalSections_complementaryCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E3H.** The scheme-theoretic closure `X'` of the complement of a rational tail of
a proper one-dimensional nodal curve over a field with only constant global functions again has
only constant global functions: `H⁰(X', 𝒪_{X'}) = k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalSections_complementaryCurve
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
      (complementaryCurveι C ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))).appTop)
declarations.comment: complementary_curve_has_constant_global_functions

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.existsUnique_contractionOfRationalTail
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E3H.** A rational tail of a proper one-dimensional nodal curve over a field with
only constant global functions admits exactly one contraction onto the scheme-theoretic closure
of its complement.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_contractionOfRationalTail
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
      (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    ∃! c : X ⟶ complementaryCurve C, IsContractionOfRationalTail hC c
declarations.comment: canonical_contraction

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isIso_structureSheaf_to_pushforward_canonicalContraction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E3H.** The canonical contraction `c : X ⟶ X'` of a rational tail induces an
isomorphism `𝒪_{X'} ⟶ c_*𝒪_X` of sheaves of rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_structureSheaf_to_pushforward_canonicalContraction
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
      (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    IsIso (canonicalContraction k X hdim hnodal C hC).toRingCatSheafHom
declarations.comment: pushforward_structure_sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.smoothAt_or_isNode_complementaryCurve_of_notMem_support
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E3H, the at-worst-nodal singularities of `X'` away from the attaching point.** Let
`X` be a proper one-dimensional scheme over a field `k` with at-worst-nodal singularities and
only constant global functions, let `C ⊆ X` be a rational tail and let `X'` be the
scheme-theoretic closure of the complement of `C`. Every closed point of `X'` whose image in `X`
lies outside `C` is smooth over `k` or is a node of `X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem smoothAt_or_isNode_complementaryCurve_of_notMem_support
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalTail k X C)
    (y : complementaryCurve C) (hyc : IsClosed ({y} : Set (complementaryCurve C)))
    (hy : (complementaryCurveι C).base y ∈ (C.support.compl : X.Opens)) :
    letI : (complementaryCurve C).Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
      ⟨complementaryCurveι C ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))⟩
    InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt (complementaryCurveι C ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) y ∨
      IsNode k (complementaryCurve C) y
declarations.comment: at_worst_nodal_away_from_the_attaching_point

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.nodal_complementaryCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E3H: the scheme-theoretic closure of the complement of a rational tail of a proper
one-dimensional nodal curve with only constant global functions again has at-worst-nodal
singularities.** Away from the attaching point this is the étale transport of
`Stacks.Curves.smoothAt_or_isNode_complementaryCurve_of_notMem_support`; at the attaching point
the closure is in fact *smooth* over `k`, by
`Stacks.Curves.smoothAt_complementaryCurve_attachingPoint`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nodal_complementaryCurve
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    letI : (complementaryCurve C).Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
      ⟨complementaryCurveι C ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))⟩
    HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k (complementaryCurve C)
declarations.comment: complementary_curve_has_at_worst_nodal_singularities

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.tail_inf_complementaryCurveIdeal_eq_bot
declarations.doc:
A rational tail `C` on a proper one-dimensional scheme over a field with at-worst-nodal
singularities and with only constant global functions, together with the scheme-theoretic closure
of its complement, has scheme-theoretic union the entire curve. Reducedness of the curve comes
from the nodality hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem tail_inf_complementaryCurveIdeal_eq_bot (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (_hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X) (C : X.IdealSheafData)
    (_hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    C ⊓ complementaryCurveIdeal C = ⊥
declarations.comment: scheme_theoretic_union

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_attachingPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E3H.** The attaching point of a rational tail — where it meets the closure of
its complement — is a node of the ambient curve.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_attachingPoint
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    IsNode k X (C.subschemeι hC.attachingPoint)
declarations.comment: attaching_point_is_node

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isFiniteSeparable_residueField_attachingPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E3H.** At the attaching point of a rational tail, the extension of the residue
field by the residue field of the node (in the sense of `Stacks.Curves.IsNode`) is finite and
separable.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteSeparable_residueField_attachingPoint
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    let x := C.subschemeι hC.attachingPoint
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    Module.Finite k (X.residueField x) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x)
declarations.comment: finite_separable_residue_field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsContractionOfRationalTail
declarations.doc: A morphism contracting a rational tail onto its complementary curve.
declarations.comment: contraction_of_a_rational_tail

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsRationalTail
declarations.doc:
An integral irreducible component `C` of a scheme over `k` is a rational tail when the
closure of its complement is nonempty, its intersection with `C` is one reduced point, the
global functions on `C` map isomorphically to the residue field of that point, and `C` has
genus zero.
declarations.statement:
def IsRationalTail (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) : Prop
declarations.comment: rational_tail

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.genus_complementaryCurve
declarations.doc:
**Contracting a rational tail does not change the genus**: for `X` proper over `k` of
dimension one with at worst nodal singularities and only constant global functions, and `C ⊆ X`
a rational tail, the scheme-theoretic closure `X'` of the complement of `C` has the genus of `X`.

This is the genus clause of [Stacks, Tag 0E3H], with no hypothesis beyond that tag's own. It is
`Stacks.Curves.contractionCohomologyObjIso` at the canonical contraction, restricted further
along the structure map of `X'` — which identifies the two `k`-module structures by
`Stacks.Curves.structureMap_appTop_comp_appTop` — and then read as an equality of dimensions.

The attribute registers Tag 0E3H with the sub-label `"complementary_curve"`, and not the bare
tag: [Stacks, Tag 0E3H] makes several separate assertions about `X'` and this declaration
proves only the one about the genus, so no single declaration states the whole example.
declarations.statement:
theorem genus_complementaryCurve
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    genus (complementaryCurveι C ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) = genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
declarations.comment: complementary_curve

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isZero_rightDerived_one_pushforward_ambientStructureSheaf
declarations.doc:
**`R ¹ c_* 𝒪_X = 0` for a contraction `c` of a rational tail on a nodal curve.**

This is the direct-image vanishing clause of [Stacks, Tag 0E3H], at that tag's standing
hypotheses: `X` is proper and one-dimensional over `k` with only constant global functions and
at worst nodal singularities. Those hypotheses enter only through
`Stacks.Curves.tail_inf_complementaryCurveIdeal_eq_bot`, which says that the tail and the
closure of its complement cover `X` scheme-theoretically, so that the union term of
`Stacks.Curves.isZero_rightDerived_one_pushforward_schemeTheoreticUnion` is the structure sheaf
of `X` itself.

The genus equality that [Stacks, Tag 0E3H] ultimately asserts is downstream of this and is not
claimed here; the scoped sub-label registers the direct-image clause alone.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_rightDerived_one_pushforward_ambientStructureSheaf
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    {hC : IsRationalTail k X C} {c : X ⟶ complementaryCurve C}
    (hc : IsContractionOfRationalTail hC c) :
    Limits.IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward c).rightDerived 1).obj
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ambientStructureSheaf X))
declarations.comment: higher_direct_image_vanishing

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_sigma_isRationalTail_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E3I].** Let `X` be a proper scheme over a field `k` of dimension one with
`H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at-worst-nodal singularities, and let `C ⊆ X` be a rational tail. For every
field extension `K/k` the base change `C_K ⊆ X_K` is a finite disjoint union of rational tails
of `X_K`: there are finitely many rational tails `Dᵢ` of `X_K` and an isomorphism
`∐ᵢ Dᵢ ≅ C_K` compatible with the closed immersions into `X_K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_sigma_isRationalTail_baseChange
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    let g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Spec (.of k) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
    let Y := (pullback (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g : Scheme.{u})
    let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g
    letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of K)) := ⟨pullback.snd (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g⟩
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Finite ι) (D : ι → Y.IdealSheafData)
        (_ : ∀ i, IsRationalTail K Y (D i))
        (e : (∐ fun i ↦ (D i).subscheme) ≅ (C.comap p).subscheme),
      e.hom ≫ (C.comap p).subschemeι =
        Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (D i).subschemeι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finrank_cohomologyOverField_one_le_invertibleCurveDegree_of_forall_not_isRationalTail
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3J.** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a field `k`
with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at-worst-nodal singularities. If `X` has no rational tail, then for
every reduced connected closed subscheme `Y ⊆ X`, `Y ≠ X`, of dimension one,
`deg(ω_X|_Y) ≥ dim_k H¹(Y, 𝒪_Y)`.

Here `ω_X` is invertible
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities`). If
the inequality failed, then `deg(ω_X|_Y) < 0`; for `Y` irreducible this makes `Y` a rational
tail, and otherwise some one-dimensional component `C` of `Y` has `deg(ω_X|_C) < 0`
([Stacks, Tag 0AYW]) and is a rational tail by the same analysis.
declarations.statement:
theorem finrank_cohomologyOverField_one_le_invertibleCurveDegree_of_forall_not_isRationalTail
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (htail : ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X C)
    (Y : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced Y.subscheme] [ConnectedSpace Y.subscheme]
    (hY : topologicalKrullDim Y.subscheme = 1) (hYX : Y ≠ ⊥) :
    haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
    letI hω := isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X hdim
      hnodal
    letI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag09NY.isInvertible_modulePullback Y.subschemeι
      (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) hω
    (Module.finrank k (cohomologyOverField k (Y.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))
        (SheafOfModules.unit Y.subscheme.ringCatSheaf) 1) : ℤ) ≤
      invertibleCurveDegree k (Y.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) hY.le
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback Y.subschemeι).obj
          (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_planeCurveData_deg_two_of_forall_not_isRationalTail
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3K, part (1).** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a
field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`, with at-worst-nodal singularities and no rational tail. If `X`
has genus `0`, then `X` is isomorphic to an irreducible plane conic and `ω_X^{⊗ -1}` is very
ample.

`ω_X` is invertible of degree `2g - 2 = -2` ([Stacks, Tag 0E37], [Stacks, Tag 0C19]) and
satisfies the subcurve bound of [Stacks, Tag 0E3J], so
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_planeCurveData_deg_two_of_subcurve_bound` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_planeCurveData_deg_two_of_forall_not_isRationalTail
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (htail : ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X C)
    (hgenus : genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) = 0) :
    (∃ C : ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.PlaneCurveData k, C.deg = 2 ∧ IrreducibleSpace C.Z ∧
      ∃ e : X ≅ C.Z, e.hom ≫ C.toSpec = X ↘ Spec (.of k)) ∧
    haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
    letI := isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X hdim hnodal
    letI := tensorPower_isInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2
      (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) (-1)
    Stacks.Tag01VMVeryAmple.IsRelativelyVeryAmple (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
      (tensorPower X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2
        (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) (-1))
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_dualizingSheafOverField_iso_unit_of_forall_not_isRationalTail
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3K, part (2).** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a
field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`, with at-worst-nodal singularities and no rational tail. If `X`
has genus `1`, then `ω_X ≅ 𝒪_X`.

`ω_X` is invertible of degree `2g - 2 = 0` with `h⁰(ω_X) = g = 1`, and satisfies the subcurve
bound of [Stacks, Tag 0E3J]; so every component degree is nonnegative, they sum to `0`
([Stacks, Tag 0AYW]), and [Stacks, Tag 0E22] applies
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isTrivial_of_subcurve_bound`).
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_dualizingSheafOverField_iso_unit_of_forall_not_isRationalTail
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (htail : ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X C)
    (hgenus : genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) = 1) :
    Nonempty (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGeneratedByGlobalSections_tensorPower_dualizingSheafOverField_of_forall_not_isRationalTail
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3K, part (3).** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a
field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`, with at-worst-nodal singularities and no rational tail. If the
genus of `X` is at least `2`, then `ω_X^{⊗ m}` is globally generated for every `m ≥ 2`.

`ω_X` is invertible of degree `2g - 2` and satisfies the subcurve bound of [Stacks, Tag 0E3J],
which with `g ≥ 2` and `m ≥ 2` gives the inequalities of [Stacks, Tag 0E3F]
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isGeneratedByGlobalSections_tensorPower_of_subcurve_bound`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeneratedByGlobalSections_tensorPower_dualizingSheafOverField_of_forall_not_isRationalTail
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (htail : ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X C)
    (hgenus : 2 ≤ genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
    letI := isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X hdim hnodal
    SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections
      (tensorPower X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2
        (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) m)
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails.exists_planeCurveData_deg_two
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3L, part (1).** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a
field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at-worst-nodal singularities, and `X → X'` a chain of
contractions of rational tails after which none are left. If `X` has genus `0`, then `X'` is an
irreducible plane conic over `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_planeCurveData_deg_two (hgenus : genus fX = 0) :
    ∃ C : ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.PlaneCurveData k, C.deg = 2 ∧ IrreducibleSpace C.Z ∧
      ∃ e : Y ≅ C.Z, e.hom ≫ C.toSpec = fY
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails.nonempty_dualizingSheafOverField_iso_unit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3L, part (2).** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a
field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at-worst-nodal singularities, and `X → X'` a chain of
contractions of rational tails after which none are left. If `X` has genus `1`, then
`ω_{X'} ≅ 𝒪_{X'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_dualizingSheafOverField_iso_unit (hgenus : genus fX = 1) :
    haveI : IsProper fY := isProper_target hseq hdim hnodal
    Nonempty (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField fY ≅ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails.isGeneratedByGlobalSections_tensorPower_dualizingSheafOverField
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3L, part (3).** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a
field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at-worst-nodal singularities, and `X → X'` a chain of
contractions of rational tails after which none are left. If the genus of `X` is at least `2`,
then `ω_{X'}` is invertible and `ω_{X'}^{⊗ m}` is globally generated for every `m ≥ 2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeneratedByGlobalSections_tensorPower_dualizingSheafOverField
    (hgenus : 2 ≤ genus fX) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fY⟩
    haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ fY.appTop) :=
      isIso_globalSections_target hseq hdim hnodal
    haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k fY
    haveI : IsProper fY := isProper_target hseq hdim hnodal
    letI : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible Y.presheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.2
        (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField fY) :=
      @isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k _ Y _ this _
        (topologicalKrullDim_target hseq hdim hnodal)
        (hasAtWorstNodalSingularities_target hseq hdim hnodal)
    SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections
      (tensorPower Y.presheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.2 (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField fY) m)
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails.existsUnique_iso_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3L, compatibility with extension of the ground field.** Let `X` be a
proper scheme of dimension one over a field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`, at-worst-nodal singularities
and genus at least one, `c : X ⟶ Y` a chain of contractions of rational tails after which none
are left, and `K/k` a field extension. For every chain `d : X_K ⟶ Z` of contractions of rational
tails of `X_K` after which none are left, there is a unique isomorphism `e : Y_K ≅ Z` with
`c_K ≫ e = d`: the formation of the contraction of all rational tails commutes with the base
change to `K`.

`d` factors through `c_K`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails.exists_comp_eq_baseChange`, using
[Stacks, Tag 0E3I]). Conversely `Y_K` is a nodal curve of positive genus without rational tails
(`AlgebraicGeometry.forall_not_isRationalTail_baseChange`) and `𝒪_{Y_K} = (c_K)_*𝒪_{X_K}` by flat
base change, so `c_K` factors through `d`
(`IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails.exists_comp_eq_of_forall_not_isRationalTail`).
The two factorizations are mutually inverse, `c_K` and `d` being dominant onto reduced curves.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails.existsUnique_iso_baseChange (k K : Type u) [Field k]
    [Field K] [Algebra k K] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {fX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)} {fY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)}
    {c : X ⟶ Y} [IsProper fX] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ fX.appTop)]
    (hnodal : letI : X.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fX⟩
      Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (hgenus : 1 ≤ genus fX)
    (hseq : IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails k fX fY c)
    (hterminal : ∀ C : Y.IdealSheafData, ¬ @IsRationalTail k _ Y ⟨fY⟩ C)
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} {fZ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of K)} {d : pullback fX (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k K))) ⟶ Z}
    (hd : IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails K (pullback.snd fX (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k K)))) fZ d)
    (hdterminal : ∀ C : Z.IdealSheafData, ¬ @IsRationalTail K _ Z ⟨fZ⟩ C) :
    ∃! e : pullback fY (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) ≅ Z,
      pullback.map fX (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) fY (Spec.map
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) c (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
        (by rw [Category.comp_id, hseq.comp_structureMap]) (by simp) ≫ e.hom = d
declarations.comment: compatibility with base field extensions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails.existsUnique_iso
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`,
at-worst-nodal singularities and genus at least one. For two chains `c₁ : X ⟶ Y₁` and
`c₂ : X ⟶ Y₂` of contractions of rational tails after which none are left, there is a unique
isomorphism `e : Y₁ ≅ Y₂` with `c₁ ≫ e = c₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_iso {X Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}} {fX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)}
    {fY₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (.of k)} {fY₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (.of k)} {c₁ : X ⟶ Y₁} {c₂ : X ⟶ Y₂}
    [IsProper fX] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ fX.appTop)]
    (hnodal : letI : X.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fX⟩
      Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (hgenus : 1 ≤ genus fX)
    (hseq₁ : IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails k fX fY₁ c₁)
    (hterminal₁ : ∀ C : Y₁.IdealSheafData, ¬ @IsRationalTail k _ Y₁ ⟨fY₁⟩ C)
    (hseq₂ : IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails k fX fY₂ c₂)
    (hterminal₂ : ∀ C : Y₂.IdealSheafData, ¬ @IsRationalTail k _ Y₂ ⟨fY₂⟩ C) :
    ∃! e : Y₁ ≅ Y₂, c₁ ≫ e.hom = c₂
declarations.comment: independence of choices

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsRationalBridge
declarations.doc:
An integral irreducible component is a rational bridge if the closure of its complement is
nonempty, the intersection has degree two over its global functions, and its genus is zero.
declarations.statement:
def IsRationalBridge (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (C : X.IdealSheafData) : Prop
declarations.comment: rational_bridge

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.exists_isProper_structureMorphism_and_genus_eq_contraction_bridge
declarations.doc:
**The target of a contraction of a rational bridge is a proper scheme over `k` of dimension
one with `H⁰(Y, 𝒪_Y) = k` and the genus of `X`.** That is, there is a morphism
`g : Y ⟶ Spec k` with `c ≫ g` the structure morphism of `X` which has these properties.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isProper_structureMorphism_and_genus_eq_contraction_bridge
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (c : X ⟶ Y) (hc : IsContractionOfRationalBridge hC c) :
    ∃ g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k), c ≫ g = X ↘ Spec (.of k) ∧ IsProper g ∧
      topologicalKrullDim Y = 1 ∧ IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ g.appTop) ∧
      genus g = genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
declarations.comment: Y is proper over k of dimension one with H⁰(Y, 𝒪_Y) = k and the genus of X

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.hasAtWorstNodalSingularities_pushoutScheme_bridge
declarations.doc:
The singularities of the contraction `Y` of a rational bridge, the pushout
`AlgebraicGeometry.pushoutScheme` of `Stacks.Curves.bridgePushoutSituation` over `k` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.pushoutToBase`, are at-worst-nodal.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasAtWorstNodalSingularities_pushoutScheme_bridge
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    {C : X.IdealSheafData} (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C) :
    letI : (pushoutScheme (bridgePushoutSituation hdim hnodal hC)).Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
      ⟨pushoutToBase (bridgePushoutSituation hdim hnodal hC)⟩
    HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k (pushoutScheme (bridgePushoutSituation hdim hnodal hC))
declarations.comment: the singularities of Y are at-worst-nodal

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isField_globalSections_bridge
declarations.doc:
**The ring of global functions on a rational bridge is a field**: the bridge is an integral
scheme proper over `k`, so its global functions form a field ([Stacks, Tag 0BUG]).
declarations.statement:
theorem isField_globalSections_bridge (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (_hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (_hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C) :
    IsField Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤)
declarations.comment: k' = H⁰(C, 𝒪_C) is a field

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_of_mem_intersection_bridge
declarations.doc:
**Every point of the intersection of a rational bridge with the closure of its complement is
a node of the ambient curve.**  At least two irreducible components of `X` pass through each
such point, so [Stacks, Tag 0E38] applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_of_mem_intersection_bridge (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C)
    (w : intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C) :
    IsNode k X ((intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C).subschemeι.base w)
declarations.comment: the points of C ∩ X' are nodes of X

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.moduleFinite_and_isSeparable_globalSections_bridge
declarations.doc:
**The field of global functions on a rational bridge is a finite separable extension of the
base field.**  This is the assertion "`k'/k` is a finite separable extension of fields" of
[Stacks, Tag 0E3M], for `C ⊆ X` a rational bridge of a proper one-dimensional at-worst-nodal
curve over `k` with only constant global functions and `k' = Γ(C, 𝒪_C)`.

Finiteness is clause (1) of [Stacks, Tag 0BUG]
(`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperSectionsGeom.moduleFinite_globalSections_of_isProper`): the
bridge is a closed subscheme of `X`, hence proper over `k`.  Separability is the source's appeal
to [Stacks, Tag 0C4D] at a point `w` of `C ∩ X'`, which is nonempty
(`Stacks.Curves.nonempty_intersection_bridge`): that point is a node of `X`, so the residue field
there is separable over `k`
(`Stacks.Curves.isSeparableExtension_residueField_intersection_bridge`), hence geometrically
reduced over `k` by Tag 030W; the evaluation of global functions of the bridge at `w` embeds `k'`
in that residue field, `k'` being a field, so `k'` is geometrically reduced over `k` too and
therefore separable, which for the finite extension `k'/k` is separability in the sense of
`Algebra.IsSeparable`.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleFinite_and_isSeparable_globalSections_bridge
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C) :
    letI : IsIntegral C.subscheme := hC.isIntegral
    letI : Field Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) :=
      (isField_of_universallyClosed k (C.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).toField
    letI : Algebra k Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
        (C.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))).appTop).hom.toAlgebra
    Module.Finite k Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable k Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤)
declarations.comment: k'/k is a finite separable extension of fields

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isField_and_isSeparable_or_algEquiv_prod_intersectionSections_bridge
declarations.doc:
**The degree two extension `k''/k'` of [Stacks, Tag 0E3M] is either a separable field
extension or the square of `k'`.**  Here `C ⊆ X` is a rational bridge of a proper one-dimensional
at-worst-nodal curve over `k` with only constant global functions, `X'` is the scheme-theoretic
closure of `X \ C`, and `k' = Γ(C, 𝒪_C)`, `k'' = Γ(C ∩ X', 𝒪)`.

The intersection is geometrically reduced over `k`
(`Stacks.Curves.geometricallyReduced_intersection_bridge`), so `k''` is a finite etale
`k`-algebra, and the degree of `k''` over `k'` is two by the defining condition of a rational
bridge; the dichotomy is then
`Stacks.Curves.isField_and_isSeparable_or_algEquiv_prod_of_etale_of_finrank_eq_two`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isField_and_isSeparable_or_algEquiv_prod_intersectionSections_bridge
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C) :
    letI : IsIntegral C.subscheme := hC.isIntegral
    letI : Field Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) :=
      (isField_of_universallyClosed k (C.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).toField
    letI : Algebra Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) Γ(intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C, ⊤) :=
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
        (le_sup_left : C ≤ intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C)).appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    (IsField Γ(intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C, ⊤) ∧
          Module.finrank Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) Γ(intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C, ⊤) = 2 ∧
          Algebra.IsSeparable Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) Γ(intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C, ⊤)) ∨
        Nonempty (Γ(intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C, ⊤) ≃ₐ[Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤)]
          (Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) × Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤)))
declarations.comment: k''/k' is either a degree two separable extension of fields or k'' = k' × k'

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.exists_ringEquiv_completedLocalRing_contraction_bridge
declarations.doc:
**The completed local ring of the contraction of a rational bridge at the image of
`Spec k'`.**  Let `k` be a field, `X` a proper scheme over `k` of dimension one with
`H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at-worst-nodal singularities, and `C ⊆ X` a rational bridge; let `X'` be the
scheme-theoretic closure of `X \ C`, `k' = Γ(C, 𝒪_C)`, `k'' = Γ(C ∩ X', 𝒪)` and `Y` the pushout
of `C ∩ X' ⟶ X'` along `C ∩ X' ⟶ Spec k'`.  Let `y ∈ Y` be the image of `Spec k'`, the image of
every point of that spectrum.  Then
```
𝒪^∧_{Y, y} ≅ {f ∈ k''⟦s⟧ : f(0) ∈ k'},
```
and `𝒪^∧_{Y, y} ≅ k'⟦s, t⟧/(st)` when `C ∩ X'` has two points, that is when `k'' = k' × k'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_ringEquiv_completedLocalRing_contraction_bridge
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C) :
    letI : IsIntegral C.subscheme := hC.isIntegral
    letI : Field Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) :=
      (isField_of_universallyClosed k (C.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).toField
    letI : Algebra Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) Γ(intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C, ⊤) :=
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
        (le_sup_left : C ≤ intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C)).appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ y : pushoutScheme (bridgePushoutSituation hdim hnodal hC),
      (∀ p : (bridgePushoutSituation hdim hnodal hC).Y,
          pushoutInr (bridgePushoutSituation hdim hnodal hC) p = y) ∧
        Nonempty (Scheme.completedLocalRing
            (pushoutScheme (bridgePushoutSituation hdim hnodal hC)) y ≃+*
          ↥(PowerSeries.constantCoeffInBase (Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) : Type u)
            (Γ(intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C, ⊤) : Type u))) ∧
        (Nonempty (Γ(intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C, ⊤) ≃ₐ[(Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) : Type u)]
            ((Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) : Type u) × (Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) : Type u))) →
          Nonempty (Scheme.completedLocalRing
              (pushoutScheme (bridgePushoutSituation hdim hnodal hC)) y ≃+*
            (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) : Type u) ⧸
              Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 :
                              MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) : Type u)) *
                            MvPowerSeries.X 1})))

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.exists_pushout_contraction_bridge
declarations.doc:
**The pushout of a rational bridge exists and carries a contraction of the bridge.**  The
pushout square
```
C ∩ X' ⟶ X'
  ↓        ↓ a
Spec k' ⟶  Y
```
is [Stacks, Tag 0E25] applied to `Stacks.Curves.bridgePushoutSituation`, and the contraction is
the one produced by `Stacks.Curves.exists_contraction_pushoutScheme_bridge`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_pushout_contraction_bridge
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    {C : X.IdealSheafData} (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (c : X ⟶ Y), IsContractionOfRationalBridge hC c
declarations.comment: the pushout Y along C ∩ X' ⟶ Spec k' exists and receives the contraction c : X ⟶ Y

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.smoothAt_bridge_and_complementaryCurve_of_mem_intersection
declarations.doc:
**The points of `C ∩ X'` are smooth points on both `C` and `X'`.** This is the clause of
[Stacks, Tag 0E3M] which the source draws from [Stacks, Tag 0E38] after observing that the
points of the intersection are nodes of `X`: a node has two branches, and here they are the
bridge and the closure of the complement, each smooth at the point.
declarations.statement:
theorem smoothAt_bridge_and_complementaryCurve_of_mem_intersection
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C)
    (w : intersectionWithComplementaryCurve C) :
    InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt (C.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))
        ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
          (le_sup_left : C ≤ intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C)).base w) ∧
      InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt (complementaryCurveι C ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))
        ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
          (le_sup_right : complementaryCurveIdeal C ≤
            intersectionWithComplementaryCurveIdeal C)).base w)
declarations.comment: the points of C ∩ X' are smooth points of C and of X'

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isIso_structureSheafToPushforward_and_isZero_rightDerived_one_contraction_bridge
declarations.doc:
**The direct images of `𝒪_X` along a contraction of a rational bridge**: the canonical map
`𝒪_Y ⟶ c_* 𝒪_X` is an isomorphism and `R ¹ c_* 𝒪_X = 0`. This is the clause of
[Stacks, Tag 0E3M] that reads "we claim that `c_* 𝒪_X = 𝒪_Y` and `R ¹ c_* 𝒪_X = 0`".
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_structureSheafToPushforward_and_isZero_rightDerived_one_contraction_bridge
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (c : X ⟶ Y) (hc : IsContractionOfRationalBridge hC c) :
    IsIso (structureSheafToPushforward c) ∧
      IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward c).rightDerived 1).obj (structureSheafModule X))
declarations.comment: c_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_Y and R¹c_*𝒪_X = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.nonempty_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_iso_contraction_bridge
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a proper scheme over `k` of dimension one with
`H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at-worst-nodal singularities, let `C ⊆ X` be a rational bridge and let
`c : X ⟶ Y` be the contraction of `C`, with `Y` over `k` through `g`, compatibly with `c`. Then
`c^* ω_Y ≅ ω_X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_iso_contraction_bridge
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    {C : X.IdealSheafData} {hC : IsRationalBridge k X C} {Y : Scheme.{u}} {c : X ⟶ Y}
    (hc : IsContractionOfRationalBridge hC c) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (hcg : c ≫ g = X ↘ Spec (.of k)) :
    haveI := isProper_structureMorphism_of_isContractionOfRationalBridge hdim hnodal hc hcg
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c).obj (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField g) ≅
      Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAmple_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field and let `X` be a proper scheme over `k` of dimension one with
`H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`. If the singularities of `X` are at worst nodal, `X` has no rational tail and no
rational bridge, and the genus of `X` is at least two, then `ω_X` is an invertible `𝒪_X`-module
and it is ample.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAmple_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (htail : ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X C)
    (hbridge : ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalBridge k X C)
    (hg : 2 ≤ genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) :
    ∃ _ : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
        (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property
        (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k))),
      Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalBridges.isStableContraction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3Q: `ω_{X'}` is ample.** Let `X` be a proper scheme over a field `k`
of dimension one with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`, genus `g ≥ 2`, at-worst-nodal singularities and no
rational tails, and let `c : X ⟶ X'` be the composite of a sequence of contractions of rational
bridges (Tag 0E3M) such that `X'` has no rational bridge. Then `ω_{X'}` is invertible and ample;
more precisely `c` satisfies the conditions of Tag 0E7Q: `X'` is proper of dimension one with
at-worst-nodal singularities, `𝒪_{X'} = c_* 𝒪_X`, `R¹ c_* 𝒪_X = 0`, and `ω_{X'}` is ample.

The target has no rational tails
(`Stacks.Curves.forall_not_isRationalTail_of_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_iso`, from
`c^* ω_{X'} ≅ ω_X`), so Tag 0E3P applies to it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStableContraction
    (htail : letI : X.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fX⟩
      ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X C)
    (hg : 2 ≤ genus fX)
    (hterminal : ∀ C : Y.IdealSheafData,
      letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fY⟩
      ∀ _ : IsProper (Y ↘ Spec (.of k)), ¬ IsRationalBridge k Y C) :
    Stacks.Curves.StableModel.IsStableContraction fX fY c
declarations.comment: ω_{X'} is ample

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalBridges.existsUnique_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3Q: the morphism `X ⟶ X'` is independent of choices.** Under the
hypotheses of `AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalBridges.isStableContraction`, if
`c₂ : X ⟶ X'₂` is the composite of a second sequence of contractions of rational bridges such that
`X'₂` has no rational bridge, then there is a unique isomorphism `e : X' ≅ X'₂` with
`c ≫ e.hom = c₂`. Both composites are stable contractions pulling the dualizing sheaves back to
`ω_X` (Tag 0E3N along each chain), so
`Stacks.Curves.StableModel.existsUnique_iso_of_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_iso` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_iso
    (htail : letI : X.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fX⟩
      ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X C)
    (hg : 2 ≤ genus fX)
    (hterminal : ∀ C : Y.IdealSheafData,
      letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fY⟩
      ∀ _ : IsProper (Y ↘ Spec (.of k)), ¬ IsRationalBridge k Y C)
    {Y₂ : Scheme.{u}} {fY₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (.of k)} {c₂ : X ⟶ Y₂}
    (hseq₂ : IsIteratedContractionOfRationalBridges k fX fY₂ c₂)
    (hterminal₂ : ∀ C : Y₂.IdealSheafData,
      letI : Y₂.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fY₂⟩
      ∀ _ : IsProper (Y₂ ↘ Spec (.of k)), ¬ IsRationalBridge k Y₂ C) :
    ∃! e : Y ≅ Y₂, c ≫ e.hom = c₂
declarations.comment: the morphism X ⟶ X' is independent of choices

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalBridges.existsUnique_iso_baseChange
declarations.doc:
Formation of the contraction `c : X ⟶ Y` commutes with base field extensions: under the
hypotheses of `AlgebraicGeometry.IsIteratedContractionOfRationalBridges.isStableContraction`, let
`K/k` be a field extension, `X_K = X ×_k K` and `Y_K = Y ×_k K` over `K`, and `c_K : X_K ⟶ Y_K` the
base change of `c`. For every sequence `d : X_K ⟶ Z` of contractions of rational bridges of `X_K`
over `K` such that `Z` has no rational bridge, there is a unique isomorphism `e : Y_K ≅ Z` with
`c_K ≫ e.hom = d`: the morphism the construction produces for `X_K` is the base change of the one
for `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_iso_baseChange
    (htail : letI : X.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fX⟩
      ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X C)
    (hg : 2 ≤ genus fX)
    (hterminal : ∀ C : Y.IdealSheafData,
      letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨fY⟩
      ∀ _ : IsProper (Y ↘ Spec (.of k)), ¬ IsRationalBridge k Y C)
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] {Z : Scheme.{u}} {fZ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of K)}
    {d : pullback fX (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) ⟶ Z}
    (hd : IsIteratedContractionOfRationalBridges K
      (pullback.snd fX (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) fZ d)
    (hdterminal : ∀ C : Z.IdealSheafData,
      letI : Z.Over (Spec (.of K)) := ⟨fZ⟩
      ∀ _ : IsProper (Z ↘ Spec (.of K)), ¬ IsRationalBridge K Z C) :
    ∃! e : pullback fY (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) ≅ Z,
      pullback.map fX (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) fY
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) c (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
          (by rw [Category.comp_id, hseq.comp_structureMorphism]) (by simp) ≫ e.hom = d
declarations.comment: formation of the morphism X ⟶ X' commutes with base field extensions

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_of_differential_surjective_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E3R.** A morphism of deformation categories is smooth if its
differential is surjective and its composite with another morphism is smooth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_of_differential_surjective_of_comp
    {𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k)}
    {𝓖 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k)}
    {𝓗 : BasedCategory.{v₃, u₃} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k)}
    (h𝓕 : IsDeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (h𝓖 : IsDeformationCategory 𝓖.p)
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖) (ψ : BasedFunctor 𝓖 𝓗)
    (hd : Function.Surjective
      (differential h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered
        h𝓖.predeformation.cofibered φ))
    (hsmooth : IsSmooth (BasedFunctor.comp φ ψ)) :
    IsSmooth φ

abbrev schemeMorphismDeformationCategory {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
