declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.satisfiesRS_flatAlgebraicSpaceFamilyFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E40.** The category of flat families of algebraic spaces over `𝒞_Λ` of
Example 0E3Z satisfies the Rim-Schlessinger condition (RS).

For a cospan `X₁ ⟶ X ⟵ X₂` of flat families over `A₁ ⟶ A ⟵ A₂` with `A₂ ⟶ A` surjective, the
pushout of algebraic spaces `X₂ ⨿_X X₁` (Stacks 07VX), with its morphism to the spectrum of
`A₁ ×_A A₂`, is a flat family (Stacks 07W3, clause (2)) restricting to `X₁` and `X₂` (Stacks
07W0); it is a fibre product of flat families because any flat family over `A₁ ×_A A₂` is the
pushout of its two restrictions (the counit assertion of Stacks 07W3).
declarations.statement:
theorem satisfiesRS_flatAlgebraicSpaceFamilyFunctor :
    SatisfiesRS (flatAlgebraicSpaceFamilyFunctor B hΛ hSpec)
declarations.comment: condition (RS) for the category of flat families of algebraic spaces of Example 0E3Z

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E40**, the in-particular clause. The deformation category of an
algebraic space `X` over the residue field `k` is a deformation category: a predeformation
category satisfying (RS).

It is the category of flat families lying over the family `(k, X)`, which lies over the residue
field, a terminal object of `𝒞_Λ`; condition (RS) for the category of all flat families is
`Deformation.Examples.satisfiesRS_flatAlgebraicSpaceFamilyFunctor`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection
    (X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ X)
    (toK : X ⟶ yoneda.obj (spaceBaseOver B hΛ hSpec (residueFieldBase Λ k))) :
    IsDeformationCategory.{u, u, u} (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)
declarations.comment: the in-particular clause: the deformation category of an algebraic space over k is a deformation category

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.spaceInfinitesimalAutomorphismGroupChain
declarations.doc:
**The first display of [Stacks Project, Tag 0E41].**  In Example 0E3Z, let `X` be an
algebraic space over the field `k`.  Then

`Inf(𝓓_X) = Ext⁰_{𝒪_X}(NL_{X/k}, 𝒪_X) = Hom_{𝒪_X}(Ω_{X/k}, 𝒪_X) = Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X)`,

given as the identifications of those four groups.  `Inf(𝓓_X)` is the infinitesimal
automorphism group `Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup` of [Stacks Project, Tag 06JS] of
the deformation category of `X`, a predeformation category
(`Deformation.Examples.isPredeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection`), formed at an
arbitrary point `x₀` over `k`, an arbitrary pushforward `i : x₀ ⟶ xε` of it along a dual-number
pair `k → k[ε] → k` — the automorphisms of the deformation `X'` of `X` over `k[ε]` (the trivial
one, `X ×_{Spec k} Spec k[ε]`) which are the identity modulo `ε`.

`k` acts on `𝒪_X`-modules, and so on `Ext⁰`, on `Hom_{𝒪_X}(Ω_{X/k}, 𝒪_X)` and on
`Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X)`, through the pullback of functions along the structure morphism `X ⟶ Spec k`
(`Deformation.Examples.spaceResidueFieldRingHom`).

* The first component identifies `Inf(𝓓_X)` with `Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X)` as **groups**, composition of
  automorphisms corresponding to addition of derivations; through the other two it is
  `Ext⁰_{𝒪_X}(NL_{X/k}, 𝒪_X)`.
* The second is `Ext⁰_{𝒪_X}(NL_{X/k}, 𝒪_X) = Hom_{𝒪_X}(Ω_{X/k}, 𝒪_X)`, `k`-linearly, from
  `H⁰(NL_{X/k}) = Ω_{X/k}` (Stacks 0D0Y).
* The third is `Hom_{𝒪_X}(Ω_{X/k}, 𝒪_X) = Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X)`, `k`-linearly, postcomposition with
  the universal derivation of Stacks 04CT, as Modules on Sites, Definition 04BN defines `Ω`.
declarations.statement:
def spaceInfinitesimalAutomorphismGroupChain
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (NaiveCotangentModules B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ (spaceOf B hΛ X hX))]
    {Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, u, u} Λ k}
    {x₀ : (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).Fiber
      (residueFieldObject.{u, u, u} Λ k)}
    {xε : (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).Fiber Aε}
    (g : residueFieldObject.{u, u, u} Λ k ⟶ Aε) (e : Aε ⟶ residueFieldObject.{u, u, u} Λ k)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1)
    (hi : (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).IsHomLift g i) :
    letI := naiveCotangentModulesLinear B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ (X := spaceOf B hΛ X hX)
      (spaceResidueFieldRingHom B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)
    letI := modulesLinearOfRingHom B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ (X := spaceOf B hΛ X hX)
      (spaceResidueFieldRingHom B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)
    letI : Module k (SpaceDerivations B hΛ (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)) :=
      derivationModuleOfRingHom B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ (X := spaceOf B hΛ X hX)
        (spaceResidueFieldRingHom B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)
        (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK) (spaceStructureModule B hΛ (spaceOf B hΛ X hX))
    (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
        (isPredeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK) g e hpair i hi ≃*
      Multiplicative (SpaceDerivations B hΛ (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK))) ×
    (DerivedCategory.Ext (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (naiveCotangentComplex B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ
        (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (naiveCotangentCoefficient B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ
            (spaceStructureModule B hΛ (spaceOf B hΛ X hX)))) 0 ≃ₗ[k]
      (sheafOfDifferentials B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK) ⟶
        spaceStructureModule B hΛ (spaceOf B hΛ X hX))) ×
    ((sheafOfDifferentials B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK) ⟶
        spaceStructureModule B hΛ (spaceOf B hΛ X hX)) ≃ₗ[k]
      SpaceDerivations B hΛ (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK))
declarations.comment: first display: for an algebraic space X over the field k, Inf(Def_X) = Ext^0(NL_{X/k}, O_X) = Hom(Omega_{X/k}, O_X) = Der_k(O_X, O_X), as three identifications at every point x0 over k and every pushforward x0 -> x_eps along a dual-number pair (06JS): Inf(Def_X) is isomorphic as a group to Der_k(O_X, O_X), Ext^0 out of the naive cotangent complex is k-linearly Hom(Omega_{X/k}, O_X), and Hom(Omega_{X/k}, O_X) is k-linearly Der_k(O_X, O_X), k acting through the structure morphism X -> Spec k. The second display, T Def_X = Ext^1(NL_{X/k}, O_X), is registered separately

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.spaceInfinitesimalAutomorphismGroup_linearEquivDerivations
declarations.doc:
**The first display of [Stacks Project, Tag 0E41], `k`-linearly: `Inf(𝓓_X) = Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X)`
as `k`-vector spaces.**  In Example 0E3Z, let `X` be an algebraic space over the field `k`.  At
every point `x₀` of the deformation category of `X` over `k`, every pushforward `i : x₀ ⟶ xε` of
it along a dual-number pair `k → k[ε] → k` and every predeformation-category structure, the
infinitesimal automorphism group `Inf(𝓓_X)` of [Stacks Project, Tag 06JS] carries the
`k`-vector-space structure of [Stacks Project, Tag 06JV]:

* addition is composition of infinitesimal automorphisms;
* a scalar `c` acts by pushforward along `ε ↦ c ε`: for every endomorphism `s` of the base which is
  `ε ↦ c ε` in a dual-number coordinate and every arrow `j : xε ⟶ xε` over `s` fixing `i`, `c • a`
  is the pushforward of `a` along `j`;

and the first identification of the first display,
`Deformation.Examples.spaceInfinitesimalAutomorphismGroupMulEquivDerivations`, is a `k`-linear
isomorphism onto `Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X)`, `k` acting on derivations through the structure morphism
`X ⟶ Spec k`.  The remaining identifications of the display,
`Ext⁰_{𝒪_X}(NL_{X/k}, 𝒪_X) = Hom_{𝒪_X}(Ω_{X/k}, 𝒪_X) = Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X)`, are `k`-linear by
`Deformation.Examples.spaceInfinitesimalAutomorphismGroupChain`.
declarations.statement:
theorem spaceInfinitesimalAutomorphismGroup_linearEquivDerivations :
    letI : Module k (SpaceDerivations B hΛ (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)) :=
      derivationModuleOfRingHom B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ (X := spaceOf B hΛ X hX)
        (spaceResidueFieldRingHom B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)
        (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK) (spaceStructureModule B hΛ (spaceOf B hΛ X hX))
    ∃ A : AddCommGroup (Additive (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi)),
      letI := A
      ∃ M : Module k (Additive (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi)),
        letI := M
        (∀ a b : infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi,
          Additive.ofMul a + Additive.ofMul b = Additive.ofMul (a * b)) ∧
        (∀ (c : k) (s : Aε ⟶ Aε),
          (∃ φ : Aε ≃ₐ[Λ] DualNumber k,
            (∀ t : Aε, (φ t).1 = Aε.residueEquiv (IsLocalRing.residue Aε t)) ∧
            (∀ t : k, φ (s.hom (φ.symm (TrivSqZeroExt.inl t))) = TrivSqZeroExt.inl t) ∧
            φ (s.hom (φ.symm DualNumber.eps)) = c • DualNumber.eps) →
          ∀ (j : xε.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hj : (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).IsHomLift s j),
            i ≫ j = i → ∀ a : infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi,
              ∃ b : infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi,
                b.val = pushforwardAutomorphismHom hp.cofibered s j hj a.val ∧
                  c • Additive.ofMul a = Additive.ofMul b) ∧
        ∃ E : Additive (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi) ≃ₗ[k]
            SpaceDerivations B hΛ (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK),
          ∀ a : infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi,
            DFunLike.coe
              (F := Additive (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi) ≃ₗ[k]
                SpaceDerivations B hΛ (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)) E
              (Additive.ofMul a) =
            Multiplicative.toAdd
              (spaceInfinitesimalAutomorphismGroupMulEquivDerivations B hΛ hSpec X hX toK hpair i
                hp hi a)
declarations.comment: first display, k-linear form: for an algebraic space X over the field k, Inf(Def_X) with the vector space structure of 06JV (addition is composition; c acts by pushforward along eps -> c eps, along every arrow over such a rescaling fixing the pushforward x0 -> x_eps) is k-linearly isomorphic to Der_k(O_X, O_X), k acting through the structure morphism X -> Spec k, by the first identification of the first display, at every point x0 over k and every pushforward along a dual-number pair

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.spaceTangentSpaceLinearEquivExt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E41, second display.** In Example 0E3Z let `X` be an algebraic space over `k`. Then
`T Def_X = Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(NL_{X/k}, 𝒪_X)`: the tangent space of the deformation category `Def_X` (the
isomorphism classes of flat deformations of `X` over `k[ε]`, with the vector-space structure of
Stacks 06IH) is `k`-linearly isomorphic to `Ext¹` of the naive cotangent complex `NL_{X/k}` of
Stacks 0D0V into `𝒪_X` (sections raised to the universe of `NL_{X/k}`, any model of the derived
category), `k` acting through the structure morphism `X ⟶ Spec k`. A deformation `X'` goes to the
class (Stacks 0GQ5) of the extension `0 ⟶ 𝒪_X ⟶ 𝒪_{X'} ⟶ 𝒪_X ⟶ 0`
(`Deformation.Examples.spaceTangentSpaceLinearEquivExtModel_apply`).
declarations.statement:
def spaceTangentSpaceLinearEquivExt
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Space.NaiveCotangentModules B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ (spaceOf B hΛ X hX))] :
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)).p) :=
      ⟨(isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK))
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX
          toK).predeformation.cofibered))) :=
      ⟨Artin.schlessingerConditionS2_isomorphismClasses_of_isDeformationCategory
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK))
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)⟩
    letI := Space.naiveCotangentModulesLinear B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ (X := spaceOf B hΛ X hX)
      (spaceResidueFieldRingHom B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)
    artinianTangentSpace Λ k (isomorphismClasses
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK))
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX
          toK).predeformation.cofibered) ≃ₗ[k]
      DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (Space.naiveCotangentComplex B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ
          (spaceStructureMap B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (Space.naiveCotangentCoefficient B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ
            (spaceStructureModule B hΛ (spaceOf B hΛ X hX)))) 1
declarations.comment: second display: for an algebraic space X over the field k, T Def_X = Ext^1(NL_{X/k}, O_X) as k-vector spaces, from the tangent space of the deformation category of X (isomorphism classes of flat deformations of X over k[eps], with the canonical vector space structure of 06IH) onto Ext^1_{O_X}(NL_{X/k}, O_X) of the naive cotangent complex of 0D0V, k acting through the structure morphism X -> Spec k; a deformation goes to the 0GQ5 class of the extension 0 -> O_X -> O_X' -> O_X -> 0. The first display is registered separately

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.spaceInfinitesimalAutomorphisms_finiteDimensional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E42, the infinitesimal automorphisms.**  In Example 0E3Z, let `X` be an algebraic
space over the field `k` which is proper over `k`.  Then `Inf(𝓓_X)` is a finite-dimensional
`k`-vector space: at every point `x₀` of `𝓓_X` over `k` and every pushforward `i : x₀ ⟶ xε` of it
along a dual-number pair `k → Aε → k`, the infinitesimal automorphism group of Stacks 06JS carries
a `k`-vector-space structure

* whose addition is composition of infinitesimal automorphisms, and
* in which a scalar `c` acts by pushforward along `ε ↦ c ε`: for every endomorphism `s` of `Aε`
  which is `ε ↦ c ε` in a dual-number coordinate of `Aε` (and the identity on the residue field)
  and every arrow `j : xε ⟶ xε` over `s` fixing `i`, `c • a` is the pushforward of `a` along `j`,

and this vector space is finite dimensional.  The predeformation-category structure of `𝓓_X` is
that of Stacks 0E40 (`Deformation.Examples.isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection`).
declarations.statement:
theorem spaceInfinitesimalAutomorphisms_finiteDimensional
    (hproper : Space.IsProper B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ toK)
    {Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, u, u} Λ k}
    {x₀ : (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).Fiber
      (residueFieldObject.{u, u, u} Λ k)}
    {xε : (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).Fiber Aε}
    (g : residueFieldObject.{u, u, u} Λ k ⟶ Aε) (e : Aε ⟶ residueFieldObject.{u, u, u} Λ k)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e) (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1)
    (hi : (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).IsHomLift g i) :
    ∃ hA : AddCommGroup (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).predeformation g e
        hpair i hi),
      letI := hA
      ∃ hM : Module k (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).predeformation g e
        hpair i hi),
        letI := hM
        (∀ a b : (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).predeformation g e
        hpair i hi), a + b = a * b) ∧
        (∀ (c : k) (s : Aε ⟶ Aε),
            IsDualNumberScaling c s →
            s ≫ e = e →
            ∀ (j : xε.1 ⟶ xε.1)
                (hj : (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).IsHomLift s j),
              i ≫ j = i → ∀ a : (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).predeformation g e
        hpair i hi),
                ∃ b : (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).predeformation g e
        hpair i hi),
                  b.val = pushforwardAutomorphismHom
                    (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX
                      toK).predeformation.cofibered s j hj a.val ∧ c • a = b) ∧
        FiniteDimensional k (infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).predeformation g e
        hpair i hi)
declarations.comment: infinitesimal automorphisms: for an algebraic space X proper over the field k, Inf(Def_X), with the vector space structure of 06JV (addition is composition; c acts by pushforward along eps -> c eps), is finite dimensional over k, at every point x0 over k and every pushforward x0 -> x_eps along a dual-number pair

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.spaceTangentSpace_finiteDimensional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E42, the tangent space.** In Lemma 0E41, if the algebraic space `X` is proper over
`k`, then `T Def_X` (with the vector-space structure of Stacks 06IH) is finite dimensional over
`k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem spaceTangentSpace_finiteDimensional (hproper : Space.IsProper B (Spec (.of Λ)) hΛ toK) :
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)).p) :=
      ⟨(isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK).predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK))
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX
          toK).predeformation.cofibered))) :=
      ⟨Artin.schlessingerConditionS2_isomorphismClasses_of_isDeformationCategory
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK))
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK)⟩
    FiniteDimensional k (artinianTangentSpace Λ k (isomorphismClasses
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX toK))
        (isDeformationCategory_spaceDeformationProjection B hΛ hSpec X hX
          toK).predeformation.cofibered))
declarations.comment: tangent space: for an algebraic space X proper over the field k, the tangent space T Def_X of its deformation category (isomorphism classes of flat deformations over k[eps], with the canonical vector space structure of 06IH) is finite dimensional over k. The clause on Inf(Def_X) is registered separately

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.pullbackToTotalMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, the second arrow.**  The canonical map `f^*NL_{Y/Z} ⟶ NL_{X/Z}` of a pair of
composable morphisms of schemes: the canonical map of Stacks 0E1Z of the underlying morphisms of
ringed spaces, read on `NL_{X/Z} = NL_{f ≫ g}` through `totalCompIso`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pullbackToTotalMap :
    pullbackNaiveCotangentComplex f g ⟶ Scheme.naiveCotangentComplex (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: the canonical map f^*NL_{Y/Z} -> NL_{X/Z}, the chain map inducing the first and fourth arrows of the six term sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.totalToRelativeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, the third arrow.**  The canonical map `NL_{X/Z} ⟶ NL_{X/Y}` of a pair of
composable morphisms of schemes.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalToRelativeMap :
    Scheme.naiveCotangentComplex (f ≫ g) ⟶ Scheme.naiveCotangentComplex f
declarations.comment: the canonical map NL_{X/Z} -> NL_{X/Y}, the chain map inducing the second and fifth arrows of the six term sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.exact_sixTerm_negOne_total
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, exactness at `H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z})`.**  For morphisms of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and
`g : Y ⟶ Z` the sequence

`H^{-1}(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) ⟶ H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z}) ⟶ H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.  This is the corresponding assertion of
Stacks 0E1Z for the underlying morphisms of ringed spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_sixTerm_negOne_total :
    (ShortComplex.mk (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (pullbackToTotalMap f g) (-1))
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (totalToRelativeMap f g) (-1))
      (homologyMap_pullbackToTotalMap_comp_totalToRelativeMap f g (-1))).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six term sequence at its second term, H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z})

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.jacobiZariskiConnecting
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, the connecting map** `∂ : H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) ⟶ H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z})` of the six
term sequence, for morphisms of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z`: the connecting map of
Stacks 0E1Z of the underlying morphisms of ringed spaces.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def jacobiZariskiConnecting :
    (Scheme.naiveCotangentComplex f).homology (-1) ⟶
      (pullbackNaiveCotangentComplex f g).homology 0
declarations.comment: the connecting map H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) -> H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z}), the third arrow of the six term sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.exact_sixTerm_negOne_relative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, exactness at `H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y})`.**  For morphisms of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and
`g : Y ⟶ Z` the sequence

`H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z}) ⟶ H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) --∂--> H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_sixTerm_negOne_relative :
    (ShortComplex.mk (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (totalToRelativeMap f g) (-1))
      (jacobiZariskiConnecting f g)
      (homologyMap_totalToRelativeMap_comp_connecting f g)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six term sequence at its third term, H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y})

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.pullbackHomologyZeroIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, the fourth term.**  The degree `0` cohomology sheaf of `f^*NL_{Y/Z}` is
`f^*Ω_{Y/Z}`.

The pullback is the one of Stacks 08TM and 0E1Z, the inverse image with scalars extended, which
is the model the first four terms of the sequence are written over; `pullbackComplexIso`
identifies it with Mathlib's `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback`, for which the degree
`0` identification is
`Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.modulePullbackNaiveCotangentComplexHomologyZeroIso`.  It is
this identification that makes the connecting map land in `f^*Ω_{Y/Z}`, so that the three terms
proved here and the three degree `0` terms are one sequence.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pullbackHomologyZeroIso :
    (pullbackNaiveCotangentComplex f g).homology 0 ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials g)
declarations.comment: the fourth term: the identification H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) = f^*Omega_{Y/Z} for the inverse-image-then-extend-scalars model of the pullback, the model the first four terms are written over

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.connectingDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, the third arrow with its target written as `f^*Ω_{Y/Z}`.**  The connecting
map of the six term sequence, read through the identification of its target `H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z})`
with `f^*Ω_{Y/Z}`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def connectingDifferentials :
    (Scheme.naiveCotangentComplex f).homology (-1) ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials g)
declarations.comment: the connecting map with its target written as f^*Omega_{Y/Z}

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.exact_sixTerm_zero_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, exactness at `H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z})`.**  For morphisms of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and
`g : Y ⟶ Z` the sequence

`H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) --∂--> H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) ⟶ H^0(NL_{X/Z})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_sixTerm_zero_pullback :
    (ShortComplex.mk (jacobiZariskiConnecting f g)
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (pullbackToTotalMap f g) 0)
      (connecting_comp_homologyMap_pullbackToTotalMap f g)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six term sequence at its fourth term, H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) = f^*Omega_{Y/Z}

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.exact_sixTerm_zero_total
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, exactness at `H^0(NL_{X/Z})`.**  For morphisms of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and
`g : Y ⟶ Z` the sequence

`H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) ⟶ H^0(NL_{X/Z}) ⟶ H^0(NL_{X/Y})`

of cohomology sheaves is exact at the middle term.  With the degree `0` identifications of
Stacks 0D0J and `pullbackHomologyZeroIso` this is exactness at `Ω_{X/Z}`; it is stated on the
cohomology sheaves so that it is the same sequence as the three nodes above.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_sixTerm_zero_total :
    (ShortComplex.mk (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (pullbackToTotalMap f g) 0)
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (totalToRelativeMap f g) 0)
      (homologyMap_pullbackToTotalMap_comp_totalToRelativeMap f g 0)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness of the six term sequence at its fifth term, H^0(NL_{X/Z}) = Omega_{X/Z}

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.epi_homologyMap_totalToRelativeMap_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, the final `⟶ 0`.**  The canonical map `NL_{X/Z} ⟶ NL_{X/Y}` is surjective on
degree `0` cohomology sheaves, that is, the six term sequence is exact at `H^0(NL_{X/Y})`.  With
the degree `0` identification of Stacks 0D0J this is exactness at `Ω_{X/Y}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_homologyMap_totalToRelativeMap_zero :
    Epi (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (totalToRelativeMap f g) 0)
declarations.comment: the final `-> 0` of the six term sequence, its exactness at H^0(NL_{X/Y}) = Omega_{X/Y}

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.isZero_homology_modulePullbackNaiveCotangentComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, the extent of the sequence.** The cohomology sheaves of `f^*NL_{Y/Z}` vanish
outside degrees `-1` and `0`.  Together with the same statement for `NL_{X/Z}` and `NL_{X/Y}`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isZero_homology_naiveCotangentComplex`) this is why the sequence of
Stacks 0E44 has six terms, starting at `H^{-1}(f^*NL_{Y/Z})` and ending at `0` after the degree
`0` cohomology sheaf of `NL_{X/Y}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_homology_modulePullbackNaiveCotangentComplex (i : ℤ) (hneg : i ≠ -1)
    (hzero : i ≠ 0) :
    IsZero ((modulePullbackNaiveCotangentComplex f g).homology i)
declarations.comment: the vanishing of H^i(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) outside degrees -1 and 0 only

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.modulePullbackNaiveCotangentComplexHomologyZeroIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, the fourth term.** The degree `0` cohomology sheaf of `f^*NL_{Y/Z}` is
`f^*Ω_{Y/Z}`.  The pullback of sheaves of modules along `f` is a left adjoint, hence preserves
the cokernel that computes the degree `0` cohomology sheaf of a complex with nothing above
degree `0`, and `H^0(NL_{Y/Z})` is `Ω_{Y/Z}` by Stacks 0D0J.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def modulePullbackNaiveCotangentComplexHomologyZeroIso :
    (modulePullbackNaiveCotangentComplex f g).homology 0 ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials g)
declarations.comment: the fourth term for Mathlib's model of the pullback: the identification H^0(f^*NL_{Y/Z}) = f^*Omega_{Y/Z}, which Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.pullbackHomologyZeroIso carries to the model the sequence itself is written over

declarations.name: Stacks.NaiveCotangentSixTermSequence.differentialsSequence_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E44, the last three terms.** For morphisms of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z`
the last three terms of the six term sequence of cohomology sheaves,

`f^*Ω_{Y/Z} ⟶ Ω_{X/Z} ⟶ Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ 0`,

form an exact sequence: the composite of the two canonical maps of relative differentials is
zero, the resulting short complex is exact at `Ω_{X/Z}`, and the second map is an epimorphism.
The three terms are the degree `0` cohomology sheaves of `f^*NL_{Y/Z}`, of `NL_{X/Z}` and of
`NL_{X/Y}`, by `modulePullbackNaiveCotangentComplexHomologyZeroIso` and by Stacks 0D0J.
declarations.statement:
theorem differentialsSequence_exact :
    ∃ h : Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialsMap f g (f ≫ g) (𝟙 Z)
        (Category.comp_id (f ≫ g)).symm ≫ f.toRelativeDifferentials g = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk _ _ h).Exact ∧ Epi (f.toRelativeDifferentials g)
declarations.comment: the last three terms and their exactness, for the canonical maps of relative differentials of 01UX; the six term sequence itself, with the arrows induced by the canonical maps of naive cotangent complexes throughout, is in StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.MoreMorphisms.NaiveCotangentSixTermFirstTerms

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChangePasting.derivedBaseChangeMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**The vertical pasting law, for ringed topoi presented by morphisms of sites.**  For two
vertically composable commutative squares of ringed topoi whose arrows come from morphisms of the
underlying sites, the composite of the derived base change maps of the two squares, read through
the composition isomorphisms for the derived pushforward along the two composite vertical legs, is
the derived base change map of the outer rectangle.

Stacks 0E46 for arbitrary morphisms of ringed topoi is
`Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChangeOfToposHom.derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso_vertical`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedBaseChangeMap_comp (htop : l.comp f' = f.comp k) (hbot : m.comp g' = g.comp l)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf B.O))) :
    (derivedPullback m).map ((derivedPushforwardCompIso f g hmosf hmosg).inv.app K) ≫
        derivedBaseChangeMap g l g' m hmosg hmosl hmosg' hmosm hbot
          ((derivedPushforward f).obj K) ≫
        (derivedPushforward g').map
          (derivedBaseChangeMap f k f' l hmosf hmosk hmosf' hmosl htop K) ≫
        (derivedPushforwardCompIso f' g' hmosf' hmosg').hom.app ((derivedPullback k).obj K) =
      derivedBaseChangeMap (g.comp f) k (g'.comp f') m
        (RingedToposSiteHom.isMorphismOfSites_comp_u f g hmosf hmosg) hmosk
        (RingedToposSiteHom.isMorphismOfSites_comp_u f' g' hmosf' hmosg') hmosm
        (comp_stack f g f' g' k l m htop hbot) K
declarations.comment:
variant: the special case of squares of morphisms of ringed topoi presented by
morphisms of sites; the tag for arbitrary morphisms of ringed topoi is
Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChangeOfToposHom.derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso_vertical

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChangeOfToposHom.derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso_vertical
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E46.**  Consider a commutative diagram of ringed topoi

```
                 k
  (Sh(B'), 𝒪) ———→ (Sh(B), 𝒪)
       │ f'              │ f
       v        l        v
  (Sh(C'), 𝒪) ———→ (Sh(C), 𝒪)
       │ g'              │ g
       v                 v
  (Sh(D'), 𝒪) ———→ (Sh(D), 𝒪)
                 m
```

in which each square commutes up to the given 2-isomorphism (Stacks 04IC):
`st : l ∘ f' ≅ f ∘ k` and `sb : m ∘ g' ≅ g ∘ l`, the outer rectangle commuting up to their
pasting `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.TwoIso.pasteVertical st sb`.  Then the base change
maps of Remark 07A7 for the two squares compose to the base change map of the rectangle: for
`K` in `D(𝒪_B)`, the composite

`Lm^* R(g ∘ f)_* K = Lm^* Rg_* Rf_* K ⟶ Rg'_* Ll^* Rf_* K ⟶ Rg'_* Rf'_* Lk^* K
  = R(g' ∘ f')_* Lk^* K`

is the base change map of the rectangle.  The two identifications `=` are the composition
isomorphisms of Stacks 0D6E, `derivedPushforwardCompIsoOfAdjoints`.

The seven morphisms are arbitrary morphisms of ringed topoi in the sense of Stacks 01D3,
part (2), the two 2-isomorphisms are arbitrary, and the eighteen universes of the six ringed topoi
are free.  As for the base change map of Remark 07A7 itself (`derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso`), the
module categories of the ringed topoi at the sources of the vertical arrows carry the instance
`CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian` at their section universes, which is what makes the
unbounded derived pushforwards exist at free universes (see the implementation notes of
`StacksFrontier/CategoryTheory/Sites/Cohomology/DerivedPushforward/Existence.lean`).
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso_vertical
    (st : RingedToposHom.TwoIso (l.comp f') (f.comp k))
    (sb : RingedToposHom.TwoIso (m.comp g') (g.comp l)) (K :
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wB} (SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf B.O))) :
    (derivedPullback m).map ((derivedPushforwardCompIsoOfAdjoints f g).inv.app K) ≫
        derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso g l g' m sb ((derivedPushforward f).obj K) ≫
        (derivedPushforward g').map (derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso f k f' l st K) ≫
        (derivedPushforwardCompIsoOfAdjoints f' g').hom.app ((derivedPullback k).obj K) =
      derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso (g.comp f) k (g'.comp f') m
        (RingedToposHom.TwoIso.pasteVertical st sb) K

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChangeOfToposHom.derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso_horizontal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E47.**  Consider a commutative diagram of ringed topoi

```
            g'              g
  (Sh(C''), 𝒪) ———→ (Sh(C'), 𝒪) ———→ (Sh(C), 𝒪)
       │ f''              │ f'              │ f
       v                  v                 v
  (Sh(D''), 𝒪) ———→ (Sh(D'), 𝒪) ———→ (Sh(D), 𝒪)
            h'              h
```

in which each square commutes up to the given 2-isomorphism (Stacks 04IC):
`s : h ∘ f' ≅ f ∘ g` and `s' : h' ∘ f'' ≅ f' ∘ g'`, the outer rectangle commuting up to their
pasting `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.TwoIso.pasteHorizontal s s'`.  Then the base change
maps of Remark 07A7 for the two squares compose to the base change map of the rectangle: for
`K` in `D(𝒪_C)`, the composite

`L(h ∘ h')^* Rf_* K = L(h')^* Lh^* Rf_* K ⟶ L(h')^* Rf'_* Lg^* K ⟶ Rf''_* L(g')^* Lg^* K
  = Rf''_* L(g ∘ g')^* K`

is the base change map of the rectangle.  The two identifications `=` are the composition
isomorphisms of Stacks 0D6D.

The six morphisms are arbitrary morphisms of ringed topoi in the sense of Stacks 01D3,
part (2), the two 2-isomorphisms are arbitrary, and the eighteen universes of the six ringed topoi
are free.  As for the base change map of Remark 07A7 itself (`derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso`), the
module categories of the three upper ringed topoi carry the instance
`CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian` at their section universes, which is what makes the
unbounded `Rf_*` exist at free universes (see the implementation notes of
`StacksFrontier/CategoryTheory/Sites/Cohomology/DerivedPushforward/Existence.lean`).
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso_horizontal
    (s : RingedToposHom.TwoIso (h.comp f') (f.comp g))
    (s' : RingedToposHom.TwoIso (h'.comp f'') (f'.comp g')) (K :
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wC} (SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) :
    (derivedPullbackCompIso h' h).inv.app ((derivedPushforward f).obj K) ≫
        (derivedPullback h').map (derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso f g f' h s K) ≫
        derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso f' g' f'' h' s' ((derivedPullback g).obj K) ≫
        (derivedPushforward f'').map ((derivedPullbackCompIso g' g).hom.app K) =
      derivedBaseChangeMapOfTwoIso f (g.comp g') f'' (h.comp h')
        (RingedToposHom.TwoIso.pasteHorizontal s s') K

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChangePasting.derivedBaseChangeMap_horizontal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E47.**  For two horizontally composable commutative squares of ringed topoi, the
composite of the derived base change maps of the two squares, read through the composition
isomorphisms of Stacks 0D6D for the two composite horizontal legs, is the derived base change map
of the outer rectangle.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedBaseChangeMap_horizontal (hmosf : f.u.IsMorphismOfSites Y.J X.J)
    (hmosf' : f'.u.IsMorphismOfSites Y'.J X'.J) (hmosf'' : f''.u.IsMorphismOfSites Y''.J X''.J)
    (hmosg' : g'.u.IsMorphismOfSites X.J X'.J) (hmosg'' : g''.u.IsMorphismOfSites X'.J X''.J)
    (hmosg : g.u.IsMorphismOfSites Y.J Y'.J) (hmosh : h.u.IsMorphismOfSites Y'.J Y''.J)
    (sq : g.comp f' = f.comp g') (sq' : h.comp f'' = f'.comp g'')
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) :
    (derivedPullbackCompIso h g hmosh hmosg).inv.app ((derivedPushforward f).obj K) ≫
        (derivedPullback h).map
          (derivedBaseChangeMap f g' f' g hmosf hmosg' hmosf' hmosg sq K) ≫
        derivedBaseChangeMap f' g'' f'' h hmosf' hmosg'' hmosf'' hmosh sq'
          ((derivedPullback g').obj K) ≫
        (derivedPushforward f'').map
          ((derivedPullbackCompIso g'' g' hmosg'' hmosg').hom.app K) =
      derivedBaseChangeMap f (g'.comp g'') f'' (g.comp h) hmosf
        (RingedToposSiteHom.isMorphismOfSites_comp_u g'' g' hmosg'' hmosg') hmosf''
        (RingedToposSiteHom.isMorphismOfSites_comp_u h g hmosh hmosg)
        (comp_rectangle f f' f'' g' g'' g h sq sq') K

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ProjectionFormulaOfToposHom.projectionFormulaMap_baseChange_square
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E48].**  For a commutative square of morphisms of ringed topoi

```
             g'
  (Sh(C'), 𝒪_{C'}) --→ (Sh(C), 𝒪_C)
      |  f'                |  f
      v                    v
  (Sh(D'), 𝒪_{D'}) --→ (Sh(D), 𝒪_D)
             g
```

and `E` in `D(𝒪_C)`, `K` in `D(𝒪_D)`, the map `p` of Equation 21.50.0.1 is compatible with the
base change map `b` of [Stacks, Tag 07A7]: going down the left (`t`, the comparison of
[Stacks, Tag 07A4] for `g`, then `b ⊗ 1`, then `p` for `f'`) equals going down the right (`Lg^*`
of `p` for `f`, then `b`, then `R(f')_*` of `t` for `g'` followed by `1 ⊗ c`, where
`c : L(g')^*Lf^*K ⟶ L(f')^*Lg^*K` identifies the two iterated pullbacks around the square), as
maps `Lg^*(Rf_*E ⊗^L K) ⟶ R(f')_*(L(g')^*E ⊗^L L(f')^*Lg^*K)` in `D(𝒪_{D'})`.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectionFormulaMap_baseChange_square (h : g.comp f' = f.comp g')
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))) :
    (derivedPullbackTensorIso g).hom.app ((derivedPushforward f).obj E, K) ≫
        (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensorProductFunctor Y'.O)).map
            (derivedBaseChangeMap f g' f' g h E ×ₘ 𝟙 ((derivedPullback g).obj K)) ≫
          adjunctionTensorMap (derivedAdjunction f')
            (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensorProductFunctor Y'.O))
            (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensorProductFunctor X'.O))
            (derivedPullbackTensorIso f').hom
            ((derivedPullback g').obj E) ((derivedPullback g).obj K) =
      (derivedPullback g).map
          (adjunctionTensorMap (derivedAdjunction f)
            (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensorProductFunctor Y.O))
            (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensorProductFunctor X.O))
            (derivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom E K) ≫
        derivedBaseChangeMap f g' f' g h
            (((derivedTensorProductFunctor X.O).obj E).obj ((derivedPullback f).obj K)) ≫
          (derivedPushforward f').map
            ((derivedPullbackTensorIso g').hom.app (E, (derivedPullback f).obj K) ≫
              (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensorProductFunctor X'.O)).map
                (𝟙 ((derivedPullback g').obj E) ×ₘ
                  (Stacks.AffineProjectionFormula.squareCompositeIso
                    (derivedPullbackCompIsoLeft f' g)
                    (derivedPullbackCompIsoRight f g' f' g h)).inv.app K))

declarations.name: Dualizing.isDualizingComplex_of_faithfullyFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4A.** If a complex becomes dualizing after faithfully flat
base change between Noetherian rings, then it was already dualizing.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isDualizingComplex_of_faithfullyFlat
    {A : Type u} {B : Type w} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.FaithfullyFlat)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u w} A))
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex
      ((CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, v, w}
        f).functor.obj K)) :
    IsDualizingComplex K

declarations.name: Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation.isInvertible_upperShriekFunctor_obj_unit_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4B**, invertibility of the relative dualizing complex of a local complete
intersection homomorphism.  Let `φ : R → A` be a local complete intersection homomorphism with
`R` Noetherian and let `p` be any polynomial presentation of `φ`.  Then `ω_{A/R} = φ^!(R)` is an
invertible object of `D(A)`.

The kernel of one presentation is Koszul-regular by the definition of a local complete
intersection, hence the kernel of every presentation is, by [Stacks, Tag 07CZ]; so
`isInvertible_upperShriekFunctor_obj_unit_of_isKoszulRegular` applies to `p`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInvertible_upperShriekFunctor_obj_unit_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (p : PolynomialPresentation f)
    (hf : f.IsLocalCompleteIntersection) :
    letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
      ModuleCat.liftedModuleMonoidalStruct.{u, u}
    letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) := ModuleCat.liftedModuleMonoidal.{u, u}
    let R₀ := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj
      (MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    letI := (DerivedCategory.Invertible.derivedCategory_symmetricMonoidalCategory A).choose
    MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible (p.upperShriekFunctor.{u, u}.obj R₀)

declarations.name: Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation.upperShriekFunctor_iso_derivedTensorProduct_of_lci
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4B**, the formula for upper shriek.  Let `φ : R → A` be a local complete
intersection homomorphism and let `p` be a polynomial presentation of `φ`.
Then `φ^!(K) = K ⊗_R^L ω_{A/R}` with `ω_{A/R} = φ^!(R)`, naturally in `K` in `D(R)`.

A local complete intersection homomorphism is perfect by [Stacks, Tag 07EN], which is what the
tensor formula of [Stacks, Tag 0BZU] asks for, and that formula asks for nothing else: the
conclusion of [Stacks, Tag 0BZE] for the surjection of the presentation holds at the arbitrary
module universe `max v u` of this statement, by
`Dualizing.nonempty_derivedHom_iso_canonicalDerivedTensor_of_perfect_anyModuleUniverse`.
declarations.statement:
theorem upperShriekFunctor_iso_derivedTensorProduct_of_lci
    (p : PolynomialPresentation f)
    (hf : f.IsLocalCompleteIntersection) :
    letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max v u} R) :=
      ModuleCat.liftedModuleMonoidalStruct.{u, max v u}
    letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} R) :=
      ModuleCat.liftedModuleMonoidal.{u, max v u}
    let R₀ := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} R) 0).obj
      (MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorUnit (ModuleCat.{max v u} R))
    Nonempty (p.upperShriekFunctor.{u, v} ≅
      derivedTensorProductOver.{u, v} f (p.upperShriekFunctor.{u, v}.obj R₀))
declarations.comment: the formula φ^!(K) = K ⊗_R^L ω_{A/R}, at an arbitrary polynomial presentation and an arbitrary module universe

declarations.name: Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation.nonempty_upperShriekFunctor_iso_derivedTensorProduct_of_lci
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4B, with no carried hypothesis.** Let `φ : R → A` be a local complete intersection
homomorphism and `p` a polynomial presentation of it. Then
`φ^!(K) = K ⊗_R^L ω_{A/R}` with `ω_{A/R} = φ^!(R)`, naturally in `K`.

This is `Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation.upperShriekFunctor_iso_derivedTensorProduct_of_lci`
read at module universe equal to the ring universe; that statement holds at any module
universe.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_upperShriekFunctor_iso_derivedTensorProduct_of_lci
    (p : PolynomialPresentation f)
    (hf : f.IsLocalCompleteIntersection) :
    letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
      ModuleCat.liftedModuleMonoidalStruct.{u, u}
    letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
      ModuleCat.liftedModuleMonoidal.{u, u}
    let R₀ := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj
      (MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    Nonempty (p.upperShriekFunctor.{u, u} ≅
      derivedTensorProductOver.{u, u} f (p.upperShriekFunctor.{u, u}.obj R₀))
declarations.comment: the formula φ^!(K) = K ⊗_R^L ω_{A/R}, at an arbitrary polynomial presentation, at module universe equal to the ring universe; the same statement at an arbitrary module universe is Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation.upperShriekFunctor_iso_derivedTensorProduct_of_lci

declarations.name: Dualizing.isGorensteinRing_fiber_iff_isInvertible_upperShriekFunctor_unit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4C.**  Let `φ : R → A` be a flat homomorphism of finite type of
Noetherian rings.  Then the fibres `A ⊗_R κ(q)` are Gorenstein for every prime `q ⊆ R` if and
only if the relative dualizing complex `ω^•_{A/R} = φ^!(R)` is an invertible object of `D(A)`.

The statement is made for an arbitrary polynomial presentation `p` of `φ`, so it holds for every
model of `φ^!`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinRing_fiber_iff_isInvertible_upperShriekFunctor_unit
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Algebra R A] [Module.Flat R A] (p : PolynomialPresentation (algebraMap R A)) :
    letI := (DerivedCategory.Invertible.derivedCategory_symmetricMonoidalCategory A).choose
    (∀ (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime], letI := isNoetherianRing_baseChange q.ResidueField p
        IsGorensteinRing (q.Fiber A)) ↔
      MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible
        (p.upperShriekFunctor.{u, 0}.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of R R)))

declarations.name: Dualizing.isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedExtensionScalars_of_syntomic_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4D, case (1).**  Let `φ : A → B` be a syntomic homomorphism of
Noetherian rings which is surjective on spectra.  Then `K` in `D(A)` is a dualizing complex for
`A` if and only if `K ⊗_A^L B` is a dualizing complex for `B`.

Descent is [Stacks, Tag 0E4A] through the faithful flatness that syntomicity and surjectivity on
spectra give ([Stacks, Tag 07D3] and [Stacks, Tag 00HQ]).  Ascent is [Stacks, Tag 0BZL] at a
polynomial presentation of `φ`, which exists because a syntomic map is of finite type, together
with the two inputs proved above: syntomic is a local complete intersection, so
`Dualizing.isInvertible_relativeDualizingUnit_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection` supplies the
invertibility of `ω^•_{B/A}` and
`Dualizing.nonempty_upperShriekFunctor_obj_iso_derivedExtensionScalars_tensor_of_lci`
the tensor formula.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedExtensionScalars_of_syntomic_unconditional
    (f : A →+* B) (hsyn : letI := f.toAlgebra; Algebra.Syntomic A B)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap f))
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :
    IsDualizingComplex K ↔
      IsDualizingComplex ((derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, u, u} f).functor.obj K)
declarations.comment: case (1): A → B syntomic and surjective on spectra

declarations.name: Dualizing.isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedExtensionScalars_of_faithfullyFlat_lci_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4D, case (2).**  Let `φ : A → B` be a faithfully flat local complete
intersection homomorphism of Noetherian rings.  Then `K` in `D(A)` is a dualizing complex for `A`
if and only if `K ⊗_A^L B` is a dualizing complex for `B`.

Descent is [Stacks, Tag 0E4A] at the given faithful flatness.  Ascent is [Stacks, Tag 0BZL] at a
polynomial presentation of `φ`, which exists because a local complete intersection is of finite
type, together with the two inputs proved above from `hlci`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedExtensionScalars_of_faithfullyFlat_lci_unconditional
    (f : A →+* B) (hff : f.FaithfullyFlat)
    (hlci : RingHom.IsLocalCompleteIntersection f) (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :
    IsDualizingComplex K ↔
      IsDualizingComplex ((derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, u, u} f).functor.obj K)
declarations.comment: case (2): A → B faithfully flat and a local complete intersection

declarations.name: Dualizing.isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedExtensionScalars_of_gorensteinFibres_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4D, case (3).**  Let `A → B` be a faithfully flat homomorphism of
finite type of Noetherian rings and assume every fibre `B ⊗_A κ(q)` is Gorenstein.  Then `K` in
`D(A)` is a dualizing complex for `A` if and only if `K ⊗_A^L B` is a dualizing complex for `B`.

Descent is [Stacks, Tag 0E4A].  Ascent is [Stacks, Tag 0BZL] at a polynomial presentation `p`,
which exists by finite type, together with two inputs: the invertibility of `ω^•_{B/A}`, which
comes from the Gorenstein fibres by [Stacks, Tag 0E4C], and the tensor formula, whose only input
is perfectness of `B` over the polynomial algebra of `p`, supplied by the flatness contained in
`hff` through `Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation.isPerfectModule_of_flat`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedExtensionScalars_of_gorensteinFibres_unconditional
    [Algebra A B] (hff : (algebraMap A B).FaithfullyFlat) [Algebra.FiniteType A B]
    (hGor : ∀ (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime],
      letI := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing q.ResidueField (q.Fiber B)
      IsGorensteinRing (q.Fiber B))
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :
    IsDualizingComplex K ↔
      IsDualizingComplex
        ((derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, u, u} (algebraMap A B)).functor.obj K)
declarations.comment: case (3): A → B faithfully flat of finite type with Gorenstein fibres

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isInjectiveHull_tensorProduct
declarations.doc:
Under a flat local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings whose target maximal ideal is
extended from the source, the base change of an injective hull of the source residue field is an
injective hull of the target residue field.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isInjectiveHull_tensorProduct
    (A B E : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)] [Module.Flat A B]
    (hmax : Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module A E]
    (i : ModuleCat.of A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ⟶ ModuleCat.of A E) [Mono i]
    (hi : Module.IsInjectiveHull i) :
    ∃ j : ModuleCat.of B (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) ⟶
        ModuleCat.of B (TensorProduct A B E),
      ∃ _ : Mono j, Module.IsInjectiveHull j

declarations.name: Module.tensorProduct_injective_of_flat_of_map_comap_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4F.** A flat map of Noetherian rings for which, locally at every
prime of the target, that prime is generated by its contraction preserves injective modules
under base change.
declarations.statement:
public theorem tensorProduct_injective_of_flat_of_map_comap_eq
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [Algebra A B] [Module.Flat A B]
    (hprime : ∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime],
      Ideal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q))
          (Ideal.comap (algebraMap A B) q) =
        Ideal.map (algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime q)) q)
    (I : Type w) [AddCommGroup I] [Module A I] [Module.Injective A I] :
    Module.Injective B (TensorProduct A B I)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.preservesColimitsOfShape_rightAdjoint_quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward_of_flat
declarations.doc:
Let `Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be proper, flat and of
finite presentation, and let `a` be a right adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. Then
`a` commutes with direct sums.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesColimitsOfShape_rightAdjoint_quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward_of_flat
    {a : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y ⥤ quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X}
    (adj : quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f) ⊣ a) (J : Type u) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) a

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_flat_of_unbounded
declarations.doc:
Let `Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite
presentation, and `j : V ⟶ Y` the inclusion of a quasi-compact open, with base change
`j' : U ⟶ X`. The map `(j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9L] is an isomorphism at every
`K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_flat_of_unbounded
    (sq : IsPullback j' f' f j) (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion j' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq.flip inferInstance
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : CompactSpace V := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace j
    haveI : CompactSpace U := compactSpace_of_isPullback sq
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace V := j.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace U := j'.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    IsIso ((twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap j' f' f j
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j) (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j')
      sq).app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isZero_derivedRestrict_twistedInverseImage_of_flat
declarations.doc:
Let `Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of
finite presentation, with `a` the right adjoint of `Rf_*` on `D_QCoh`. For every closed `T ⊆ Y`,
if `Q ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` is supported on `T` then `a(Q)` is supported on `f⁻¹(T)`. Here `T` is the
complement of the open `W`, and "supported on `T`" is "restricts to zero on `W`".
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_derivedRestrict_twistedInverseImage_of_flat (W : Y.Opens)
    (Q : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) (hQ : IsZero ((derivedRestrict W.ι).obj Q.obj)) :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    IsZero ((derivedRestrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
      ((twistedInverseImage f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj Q).obj)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E4K].** Let `Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and
`f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite presentation. The map `Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)` of
Equation 48.8.0.1 is an isomorphism for every `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_of_flat (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    IsIso (twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback f
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom
      (quasiCoherentDerivedTensorRightUnitor Y) K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.StandardModel.isRelativelyPerfect_relativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E4L] (1).** Let `Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and
`f : X ⟶ Y` a proper, flat morphism of finite presentation, with relative dualizing complex
`ω_{X/Y} = a(𝒪_Y)` ([Stacks, Remark 0B6S]). Then `ω_{X/Y}` is a `Y`-perfect object of `D(𝒪_X)`.

Over an affine open `V ⊆ Y`, with `Spec Γ(V) ⟶ Y` the inclusion, the base change of `ω_{X/Y}` to
`f⁻¹V ⟶ Spec Γ(V)` is the relative dualizing complex of the base change
(`Stacks.Duality.StandardModel.pullbackRelativeDualizingComplexIso`), which is
`Spec Γ(V)`-perfect (`isRelativelyPerfect_relativeDualizingComplex_of_spec`); relative
perfectness is local on the source and on the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyPerfect_relativeDualizingComplex {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [IsProper f] [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    f.IsRelativelyPerfect (relativeDualizingComplex f).obj

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedPullback_of_syntomic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4N, case (1).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a syntomic surjection of locally
Noetherian schemes and let `K` be an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. Then `K` is a dualizing complex on
`Y` if and only if `Lf^*K` is a dualizing complex on `X`.

Over an affine open `U ⊆ Y` and an affine open `V ⊆ f⁻¹(U)` on which `f` is still surjective the
condition becomes the ring-level statement [Stacks, Tag 0E4D] for `f.appLE U V`, which is
syntomic and surjective on spectra; the two sides are compared by the affine comparison square of
[Stacks, Tag 08DW] and the globalisation is [Stacks, Tag 0A86].
declarations.statement:
theorem isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedPullback_of_syntomic [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Surjective f] (hf : Syntomic f)
    (p : ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hVU).hom)
    (hInv : ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
      letI := (DerivedCategory.Invertible.derivedCategory_symmetricMonoidalCategory
        Γ(X, V.1)).choose
      MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible (Dualizing.relativeDualizingUnit (p U V hVU)))
    (hTensor : ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1))),
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
      letI := (DerivedCategory.Invertible.derivedCategory_symmetricMonoidalCategory
        Γ(X, V.1)).choose
      Nonempty ((p U V hVU).upperShriekFunctor.{u, u}.obj M ≅
        ((derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, u, u}
            (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hVU).hom).functor.obj M) ⊗
          Dualizing.relativeDualizingUnit (p U V hVU)))
    (K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules)
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Y.Modules i).obj K).IsQuasicoherent) :
    IsDualizingComplex K ↔
      IsDualizingComplex ((derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K)
declarations.comment: variant: case (1) with a polynomial presentation p, the invertibility hInv and the tensor formula hTensor at each affine pair as explicit parameters; the tag is Stacks.Duality.isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedPullback_of_syntomic_of_surjective

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedPullback_of_flat_lci
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4N, case (2).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a surjective flat local complete
intersection morphism of locally Noetherian schemes and let `K` be an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
Then `K` is a dualizing complex on `Y` if and only if `Lf^*K` is a dualizing complex on `X`.

A flat local complete intersection morphism is syntomic by [Stacks, Tag 069K], so this is
case (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedPullback_of_flat_lci [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Surjective f] [Flat f]
    (hlci : IsLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism f)
    (p : ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hVU).hom)
    (hInv : ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
      letI := (DerivedCategory.Invertible.derivedCategory_symmetricMonoidalCategory
        Γ(X, V.1)).choose
      MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible (Dualizing.relativeDualizingUnit (p U V hVU)))
    (hTensor : ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1))),
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
      letI := (DerivedCategory.Invertible.derivedCategory_symmetricMonoidalCategory
        Γ(X, V.1)).choose
      Nonempty ((p U V hVU).upperShriekFunctor.{u, u}.obj M ≅
        ((derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, u, u}
            (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hVU).hom).functor.obj M) ⊗
          Dualizing.relativeDualizingUnit (p U V hVU)))
    (K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules)
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Y.Modules i).obj K).IsQuasicoherent) :
    IsDualizingComplex K ↔
      IsDualizingComplex ((derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K)
declarations.comment: variant: case (2) with a polynomial presentation p, the invertibility hInv and the tensor formula hTensor at each affine pair as explicit parameters; the tag is Stacks.Duality.isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedPullback_of_flat_lci_of_surjective

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedPullback_of_gorenstein
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4N, case (3).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a surjective Gorenstein morphism
of finite type of locally Noetherian schemes and let `K` be an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. Then `K`
is a dualizing complex on `Y` if and only if `Lf^*K` is a dualizing complex on `X`.

A Gorenstein morphism is flat, and of finite type over a locally Noetherian target it is of
finite presentation, so the reduction to affine pairs of case (1) applies verbatim; at an affine
pair the ring-level statement is [Stacks, Tag 0E4D] case (3).
declarations.statement:
theorem isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedPullback_of_gorenstein [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Surjective f] [QuasiCompact f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hF : ∀ y : Y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y)) (hGor : Scheme.Hom.IsGorenstein f hF)
    (p : ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(X, V.1) := (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hVU).hom.toAlgebra
      Dualizing.PolynomialPresentation (algebraMap Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(X, V.1)))
    (hGorRing : ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (q : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1)) [q.IsPrime],
      letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(X, V.1) := (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hVU).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := Dualizing.isNoetherianRing_baseChange q.ResidueField (p U V hVU)
      Dualizing.IsGorensteinRing (q.Fiber Γ(X, V.1)))
    (hTensor : ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1))),
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
      letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(X, V.1) := (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hVU).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (DerivedCategory.Invertible.derivedCategory_symmetricMonoidalCategory
        Γ(X, V.1)).choose
      Nonempty ((p U V hVU).upperShriekFunctor.{u, u}.obj M ≅
        ((derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, u, u}
            (algebraMap Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(X, V.1))).functor.obj M) ⊗
          Dualizing.relativeDualizingUnit (p U V hVU)))
    (K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules)
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Y.Modules i).obj K).IsQuasicoherent) :
    IsDualizingComplex K ↔
      IsDualizingComplex ((derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K)
declarations.comment: variant: case (3) with a polynomial presentation p, the fibre-ring Gorenstein property hGorRing and the tensor formula hTensor at each affine pair as explicit parameters; the tag is Stacks.Duality.isDualizingComplex_iff_derivedPullback_of_isGorenstein_of_surjective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.relativeDualizingComplex_baseChange_twistedInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**Relative dualizing complexes and base change.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be flat, proper and of
finite presentation, and let `W` be a diagonal open of `f`. There is a relative dualizing complex
`(ω_{X/S}^•, ξ)` for `f` relative to `W` (Stacks 0E2X), and for every such pair, every morphism
`g : S' ⟶ S` with `S'` quasi-compact and quasi-separated, with base change `f' : X' ⟶ S'` and
projection `g' : X' ⟶ X`, and every diagonal open `W'` of `f'` mapped into `W` by `g' × g'`,
there is a unique isomorphism `ω_{X'/S'}^• = a'(𝒪_{S'}) ≅ L(g')^*ω_{X/S}^•` compatible with the
map of Equation 0E2Q (restricted to `W'`) and the derived base change `L(g')^*ξ` of
Stacks 0E2Y.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeDualizingComplex_baseChange_twistedInverseImage {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (D : DiagonalOpen f) :
    (∃ (K : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace))
      (ξ : D.diagonalObject ⟶ D.derivedPullbackProj K),
      IsRelativeDualizingComplex f (RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base)) D K ξ) ∧
    ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace))
      (ξ : D.diagonalObject ⟶ D.derivedPullbackProj K),
      IsRelativeDualizingComplex f (RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base)) D K ξ →
      ∀ {X' S' : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace S'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S'] {g : S' ⟶ S}
        {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'} (hpb : IsPullback g' f' f g)
        (D' : DiagonalOpen f') (w : D'.W ⟶ D.W)
        (hw : w ≫ D.ι = D'.ι ≫ pullbackMapOfIsPullback hpb),
        haveI : IsProper f' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsProper) hpb inferInstance
        haveI : Flat f' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @Flat) hpb inferInstance
        haveI : LocallyOfFinitePresentation f' :=
          MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @LocallyOfFinitePresentation) hpb inferInstance
        haveI : CompactSpace X' := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f'
        haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X' := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f'
        haveI : CompactSpace (pullback f' f' : Scheme.{u}) :=
          QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (pullback.fst f' f')
        haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback f' f' : Scheme.{u}) :=
          quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.fst f' f')
        ∃! φ : (Stacks.Duality.StandardModel.relativeDualizingComplex f').obj ≅
            DiagonalOpen.baseChangeComplex g' K,
          (DiagonalOpen.ofIsSeparated f').restrictDiagonalMap D' D'.ι
              (DiagonalOpen.comp_ι_ofIsSeparated f' D')
              (Stacks.Duality.StandardModel.relativeDualizingComplex f').obj
              (Stacks.Duality.relativeDualizingComplexDiagonalMap f') ≫
              D'.derivedPullbackProjMap φ.hom =
            D.baseChangeDiagonalMap D' g' w (DiagonalOpen.proj_baseChange hpb D D' w hw)
              (DiagonalOpen.baseChangeDiagonalIso hpb D D' w hw) K ξ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_derivedTensorHomDiagonal_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:

with `M` perfect, the canonical morphism of Stacks 0BYU

`K ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} RSheafHom(M, L) ⟶ RSheafHom(M, K ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} L)`

with the tensor factor `K` perfect, the canonical morphism of Stacks 0BYU

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_derivedTensorHomDiagonal_of_isPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4Q case (3).** For objects `K`, `L`, `M` of `D(𝒪_X)` on an algebraic space `X`
with `M` pseudo-coherent, `L` cohomologically bounded below and `K` of finite Tor dimension,
the canonical morphism of Stacks 0BYU

`K ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} RSheafHom(M, L) ⟶ RSheafHom(M, K ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} L)`

is an isomorphism.

Nothing is assumed beyond the three conditions the source states; in particular
quasi-coherence of the cohomology sheaves is not used. Like the two cases above, this
specialises the corresponding part of Stacks 0ATN for an arbitrary ringed site —
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.isIso_derivedTensorHomDiagonal_of_isPseudoCoherent` — to the
model of the small étale ringed site of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedTensorHomDiagonal_of_isPseudoCoherent
    (K L M : DerivedCategory

        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleModelRingedSite B S hS F hF).O)))
    (hM : (smallEtaleModelRingedSite B S hS F hF).IsPseudoCoherent M)
    (hL : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow L)
    (hK : Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.HasFiniteTorDimension
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct
        (smallEtaleModelRingedSite B S hS F hF)) K) :
    IsIso (RingedSite.derivedTensorHomDiagonal
      (smallEtaleModelRingedSite B S hS F hF) K L M)
declarations.comment: case (3): M pseudo-coherent, L bounded below, K of finite Tor dimension

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.tfae_reflectsIsomorphisms_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_reflectsIsomorphisms_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom) (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (E : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2)
    (hE : ∀ K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2,
      IsZero K ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (E⟦n⟧ ⟶ K)) :
    List.TFAE [∀ K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2,
        IsZero ((quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS f hfqc hfqs).obj K) ↔ IsZero K,
      (quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS f hfqc hfqs).ReflectsIsomorphisms,
      ∀ K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2,
        IsZero K ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback f).obj E)⟦n⟧ ⟶ K)]
declarations.comment: the equivalence of (1), (2) and (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward_obj_iff_of_isAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4R, the case of an affine morphism.** For `f` affine, `Rf_*K = 0` if and only if
`K = 0`, for `K` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward_obj_iff_of_isAffineHom (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom) (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom) (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    IsZero ((quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS f hfqc hfqs).obj K) ↔ IsZero K
declarations.comment: the conditions hold if f is affine

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward_obj_iff_of_isOpenImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4R, the case of an open immersion.** For an open immersion `j`, `Rj_*K = 0` if and
only if `K = 0`: the restriction of `Rj_*K` to the open is `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward_obj_iff_of_isOpenImmersion (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom) (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hf : IsOpenImmersion B S hS f.hom)
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    IsZero ((quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS f hfqc hfqs).obj K) ↔ IsZero K
declarations.comment: the conditions hold if f is an open immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward_obj_iff_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4R, compositions.** If `Rf_*` and `Rg_*` detect zero objects of `D_QCoh`, then
so does `R(f ≫ g)_*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward_obj_iff_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom) (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hgqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS g.hom) (hgqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS g.hom)
    (hfgqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (f ≫ g).hom) (hfgqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS (f ≫ g).hom)
    (hf : ∀ K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2,
      IsZero ((quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS f hfqc hfqs).obj K) ↔ IsZero K)
    (hg : ∀ K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2,
      IsZero ((quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS g hgqc hgqs).obj K) ↔ IsZero K)
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    IsZero ((quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS (f ≫ g) hfgqc hfgqs).obj K) ↔ IsZero K
declarations.comment: the conditions are stable under composition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_globalDerivedHomBaseChangeMap_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4S, case (1).** Let `g : S' ⟶ S` be a morphism of affine schemes, `R = Γ(S, 𝒪)`,
`R' = Γ(S', 𝒪)`, and let `X' = X ×_S S'` for `f : X ⟶ S` quasi-compact and quasi-separated with
`X` and `S'` Tor independent over `S`. For `M ∈ D(𝒪_X)` perfect and `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` the
canonical map `RHom_X(M, K) ⊗^L_R R' ⟶ RHom_{X'}(L(g')^*M, L(g')^*K)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalDerivedHomBaseChangeMap_of_isPerfect
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (representedSpaceMap B S hS g))
    (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom) (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hTor : TorIndependent X.2 (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U')
      (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U) f.hom (representedSpaceMap B S hS g).hom)
    (M K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B S hS X)))
    (hM : RingedSite.IsPerfect (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2) M)
    (hK : QcohDerived B S hS X K) :
    IsIso (globalDerivedHomBaseChangeMap B S hS g f f' g' sq.w M K)
declarations.comment: case (1): M perfect, K in D_QCoh

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_globalDerivedHomBaseChangeMap_of_isPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4S, case (2).** Let `g : S' ⟶ S` be a morphism of affine schemes, `R = Γ(S, 𝒪)`,
`R' = Γ(S', 𝒪)`, and let `X' = X ×_S S'` for `f : X ⟶ S` quasi-compact and quasi-separated with
`X` and `S'` Tor independent over `S`. If `R'` has finite Tor dimension over `R`, then for
`M ∈ D(𝒪_X)` pseudo-coherent and `K ∈ D^+_QCoh(𝒪_X)` the canonical map
`RHom_X(M, K) ⊗^L_R R' ⟶ RHom_{X'}(L(g')^*M, L(g')^*K)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalDerivedHomBaseChangeMap_of_isPseudoCoherent
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (representedSpaceMap B S hS g))
    (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom) (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hTor : TorIndependent X.2 (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U')
      (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U) f.hom (representedSpaceMap B S hS g).hom)
    (hR' : AlgebraicGeometry.HasFiniteTorDimensionRingHom
      (representedAffineCommRingCatHom B S hS g).hom)
    (M K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B S hS X)))
    (hM : RingedSite.IsPseudoCoherent (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2) M)
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus
          (A := SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B S hS X))
          (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
            ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))) K) :
    IsIso (globalDerivedHomBaseChangeMap B S hS g f f' g' sq.w M K)
declarations.comment: case (2): M pseudo-coherent, K in D^+_QCoh, R' of finite tor dimension over R

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.globalDerivedHomBaseChangeMap_comp_map_counit
declarations.doc:
For `M ∈ D(𝒪_X)` and `L ∈ D(𝒪_{X'})`, the canonical map of Stacks 0E4S at `(M, Rg'_*L)`
followed by `RΓ(X', -)` of `R𝓗om(L(g')^*M, -)` of the counit `L(g')^*Rg'_*L ⟶ L` is the
multiplication map `K' ⊗^L_R R' ⟶ K'`, the counit of `- ⊗^L_R R' ⊣` restriction of scalars, at
`K' = RHom_{X'}(L(g')^*M, L)`, after the identification
`RHom_X(M, Rg'_*L) = RHom_{X'}(L(g')^*M, L)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem globalDerivedHomBaseChangeMap_comp_map_counit
    (M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B S hS X)))
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B S hS X'))) :
    globalDerivedHomBaseChangeMap B S hS g f f' g' w M
          ((derivedPushforward (X := smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X')
            (Y := smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X) (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS g')).obj L) ≫
        (representedAffineDerivedSections B S hS U').map ((derivedModulePushforward B S hS f').map
          (((smallEtaleDerivedSheafHom B S hS X').obj
            (op ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS g').obj M))).map
            ((smallEtaleDerivedModuleAdjunction B S hS g').counit.app L))) =
      (representedAffineDerivedExtension B S hS g).functor.map
          ((derivedModulePushforward B S hS f ⋙ representedAffineDerivedSections B S hS U).map
              ((derivedModulePushforwardSheafHomIso g' M).inv.app L) ≫
            (affineBaseDerivedSectionsPushforwardIso B S hS g f f' g' w).hom.app _) ≫
        (RingTheory.TorIndependence.totalDerivedExtensionScalarsAdjunction
      (representedAffineCommRingCatHom B S hS g).hom).counit.app _

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPerfect_derivedModulePushforward_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E4U.**  Let `S` be a scheme, let `Y` be a Noetherian algebraic space over `S`, let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect proper morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, and let `E` be a perfect
object of `D(𝒪_X)`.  Then `Rf_*E` is a perfect object of `D(𝒪_Y)`.

Perfectness is tested on the affine étale charts of `Y`, over which the restriction of `Rf_*E` is
the derived direct image along the base change of `f` (Stacks 08GE), and the affine case is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPerfect_derivedModulePushforward_of_isProper_of_isAffine`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_derivedModulePushforward_of_isProper
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsNoetherian B S hS hZ Y.1) (hfPerfect : IsPerfect B S hS f.hom)
    (hfProper : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2))
    (hE : (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).IsPerfect E) :
    (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2).IsPerfect
      ((Stacks.DerivedFunctor.totalRightDerived (modulePushforward B S hS f)).obj E)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_isDualizingOnChart_iff_exists_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4Y.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S` and
let `K` be an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`. Then the restriction `K|_U` is a dualizing complex on `U`,
in the sense of Stacks 0E4X, for every étale morphism `h_U ⟶ X` with `U` a scheme if and only if
it is one for some surjective such morphism.

The ascent from `U` to `U ×_X V` and the descent from there to `V` are Stacks 0E4N, applied to the
dualizing complex `ω_U` with `K|_U = ε^*ω_U` and to the complex `ω_V` with `K|_V = ε^*ω_V` that
Stacks 071Q provides; the two pullbacks to `U ×_X V` agree because `ε^*` commutes with étale
pullback and is fully faithful on `D_QCoh`.
declarations.statement:
theorem forall_isDualizingOnChart_iff_exists_surjective
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
