    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X hX) :
    (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X)
        (hφ : (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) φ),
        IsDualizingRestriction B S hS X hX hN K.obj U φ hφ) ↔
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X)
        (hφ : (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) φ),
        (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) φ ∧
          IsDualizingRestriction B S hS X hX hN K.obj U φ hφ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4Z.** An object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` on a locally Noetherian algebraic
space `X` over `S` is a *dualizing complex* when its restriction to every étale scheme chart of
`X` is a dualizing complex on that chart, in the sense of Stacks 0A87.

This is the chart-family formulation, written before the restriction of an object of `D(𝒪_X)` to
a chart was available: the object is presented by a family `L` of complexes on the Zariski sites
of the charts, `quasicoherent` and `pullback_compat` are what membership in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` says
about the family of its restrictions, and `isDualizingOnChart` is the every-chart condition of
Stacks 0E4Y. The notion phrased on an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` itself is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsDualizingComplexOnSpace`.
declarations.statement:
structure IsDualizingComplex (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (L : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) φ →
      DerivedCategory ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U).Modules) : Prop
declarations.comment: the every-chart condition of 0E4Y; the restrictions of K to the etale scheme charts of X are the family L

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsDualizingComplexOnSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E4Z.** An object `K` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` on a locally Noetherian algebraic
space `X` over `S` is a *dualizing complex* when it satisfies the equivalent conditions of Stacks
0E4Y: its restriction `K|_U` to every étale morphism `h_U ⟶ X` with `U` a scheme is a dualizing
complex on `U` in the sense of Stacks 0E4X, that is `K|_U = ε^*ω_U` for a dualizing complex `ω_U`
on `U` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsDualizingRestriction`). By
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_isDualizingOnChart_iff_exists_surjective` it is enough to ask this
for one surjective such morphism.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineEtaleDuality.isIso_comparison_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E50.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring and `X = Spec A`, let `𝒪_étale` be the
structure sheaf of the small étale site of `X`, and let `ε : (X_étale, 𝒪_étale) ⟶ (X, 𝒪_X)` be
the comparison morphism. For `K, L ∈ D(A)` with `K ∈ D_Coh(A)` and `L` of finite injective
dimension, the canonical map
`ε^* (R Hom_A(K, L))~ ⟶ R SheafHom_{𝒪_étale}(ε^* K̃, ε^* L̃)` is an isomorphism in `D(𝒪_étale)`.

The source is lifted to the module universe of the derived internal Hom, which on the small étale
site lands one universe up (`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.derivedSheafHomBifunctor`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_comparison_app [IsNoetherianRing A] (K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite A ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj K))
    (hL : StacksDraft.InjectiveDimension.HasFiniteInjectiveDimension L) :
    IsIso ((comparison A B hX).app (op K, L))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dualizingComplex_duality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E51.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space and `K` a dualizing complex
on `X` (Stacks 0E4Z). Then

* `K` is an object of `D_Coh(𝒪_X)`;
* `D = R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(-, K)` carries `D_Coh(𝒪_X)` to itself and induces an anti-equivalence
  `D : D_Coh(𝒪_X)ᵒᵖ ≌ D_Coh(𝒪_X)`, which comes equipped with the canonical isomorphism
  `id → D ∘ D` whose components are the biduality morphisms `L ⟶ R𝓗om(R𝓗om(L, K), K)`;
* if `X` is quasi-compact, `D` carries `D^+_Coh(𝒪_X)` to `D^-_Coh(𝒪_X)` and `D^-_Coh(𝒪_X)` to
  `D^+_Coh(𝒪_X)` (and induces an anti-equivalence between them), and induces an
  anti-equivalence `D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)ᵒᵖ ≌ D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dualizingComplex_duality (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS F hF)
    (hK : IsDualizingComplexOnSpace B S hS F hF hN K) :
    coherentDerived B S hS F hF K.obj ∧
    ∃ hD : ∀ L, coherentDerived B S hS F hF L →
        coherentDerived B S hS F hF ((dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj).obj (op L)),
      (∃ e : (coherentDerived B S hS F hF).FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ≌
          (coherentDerived B S hS F hF).FullSubcategory,
        e.functor = (coherentDerived B S hS F hF).lift
          ((coherentDerived B S hS F hF).ι.op ⋙ dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj)
          (fun L => hD _ L.unop.2)) ∧
      (∃ η : 𝟭 (coherentDerived B S hS F hF).FullSubcategory ≅
          ((coherentDerived B S hS F hF).lift
            ((coherentDerived B S hS F hF).ι.op ⋙ dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj)
            (fun L => hD _ L.unop.2)).rightOp ⋙
          (coherentDerived B S hS F hF).lift
            ((coherentDerived B S hS F hF).ι.op ⋙ dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj)
            (fun L => hD _ L.unop.2),
        ∀ L, (coherentDerived B S hS F hF).ι.map (η.hom.app L) =
          (derivedBiduality B S hS F hF K.obj).app L.1) ∧
      (IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS F →
        (∀ L, coherentDerivedPlus B S hS F hF L →
          coherentDerivedMinus B S hS F hF ((dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj).obj (op L))) ∧
        (∀ L, coherentDerivedMinus B S hS F hF L →
          coherentDerivedPlus B S hS F hF ((dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj).obj (op L))) ∧
        (∃ (hpm : ∀ L, coherentDerivedPlus B S hS F hF L →
            coherentDerivedMinus B S hS F hF ((dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj).obj (op L)))
          (e : (coherentDerivedPlus B S hS F hF).FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ≌
            (coherentDerivedMinus B S hS F hF).FullSubcategory),
          e.functor = (coherentDerivedMinus B S hS F hF).lift
            ((coherentDerivedPlus B S hS F hF).ι.op ⋙ dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj)
            (fun L => hpm _ L.unop.2)) ∧
        (∃ (hb : ∀ L, coherentDerivedBounded B S hS F hF L →
            coherentDerivedBounded B S hS F hF ((dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj).obj (op L)))
          (e : (coherentDerivedBounded B S hS F hF).FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ≌
            (coherentDerivedBounded B S hS F hF).FullSubcategory),
          e.functor = (coherentDerivedBounded B S hS F hF).lift
            ((coherentDerivedBounded B S hS F hF).ι.op ⋙ dualFunctor B S hS F hF K.obj)
            (fun L => hb _ L.unop.2)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isInvertible_tensor_iso_of_isDualizingComplexOnSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E52.** Let `S` be a scheme and `X` a locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S`. If
`K` and `K'` are dualizing complexes on `X` (Stacks 0E4Z), then `K'` is isomorphic to
`K ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} L` for some invertible object `L` of `D(𝒪_X)`.

`D(𝒪_X)` is the derived category of the `𝒪_X`-modules on the small étale site of `X`, and
`⊗^L_{𝒪_X}` with its unit `𝒪_X` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedMonoidalOfModel`, the derived
tensor product of Stacks 0FPT read on the equi-universe model of the small étale ringed site.
The proof is the source's: `R𝓗om(K', K)` is invertible because affine locally `K'` is a shift
of `K` (Stacks 0A7F, 0ATP) and `R𝓗om(K, K) = 𝒪_X`, and `K' ≅ R𝓗om(R𝓗om(K', K), K)` by
biduality (Stacks 0E51).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isInvertible_tensor_iso_of_isDualizingComplexOnSpace
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (K K' : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hK : IsDualizingComplexOnSpace B S hS X.1 X.2 hN K)
    (hK' : IsDualizingComplexOnSpace B S hS X.1 X.2 hN K') :
    letI := derivedMonoidalOfModel B S hS X.1 X.2
    ∃ L, IsInvertible L ∧ Nonempty (K'.obj ≅ K.obj ⊗ L)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_dimensionFunction_of_isDualizingComplex_chart
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a locally Noetherian quasi-separated algebraic space over a scheme `S` and let
`ω_X^•` be a dualizing complex on `X` (Stacks 0E4Z). Then the function `δ : |X| → ℤ` for which
`ω^•_{X, x̄}[-δ x]` is a normalized dualizing complex over `𝒪_{X, x̄}` at every geometric point
`x̄` of `X` over `x` is a dimension function on `|X|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_dimensionFunction_of_isDualizingComplex_chart
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal X)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (ω : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X hX)
    (hω : IsDualizingComplexOnSpace B S hS X hX hN ω)
    (δ : points B S hS X → ℤ)
    (hδ : IsNormalizingShiftAtGeometricPoints B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ hN ω.obj δ) :
    ∃ d : DimensionFunction (points B S hS X), ∀ x : points B S hS X, d x = δ x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_dimensionFunction_isNormalizedDualizingComplex_geometricDerivedStalk
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a locally Noetherian quasi-separated algebraic space over a scheme `S` and let
`ω_X^•` be a dualizing complex on `X` (Stacks 0E4Z). Then there is a dimension function `δ` on
`|X|` such that at every geometric point `x̄` of `X`, lying over `x ∈ |X|`, the stalk `ω_{X, x̄}^•`
is a dualizing complex over the étale local ring `𝒪_{X, x̄}` and `δ x` is the unique integer `n`
for which `ω_{X, x̄}^•[-n]` is a normalized dualizing complex. In particular the normalizing shift
exists at every geometric point and depends only on the point of `|X|` under it.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_dimensionFunction_isNormalizedDualizingComplex_geometricDerivedStalk
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal X)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (ω : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X hX)
    (hω : IsDualizingComplexOnSpace B S hS X hX hN ω) :
    ∃ δ : DimensionFunction (points B S hS X),
      ∀ x : GeometricPoint B S hS X,
        letI := isNoetherianRing_geometricStalkRing B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ hN x
        letI := isLocalRing_geometricStalkRing B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ x
        Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex ((geometricDerivedStalk B S hS (X := ⟨X, hX⟩) x).obj ω.obj) ∧
          ∀ n : ℤ, Dualizing.IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, u}
              ((geometricDerivedStalk B S hS (X := ⟨X, hX⟩) x).obj ω.obj⟦-n⟧) ↔ n = δ x.image

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.PushforwardTraceOnRingedTopoi.pushforwardTrace
declarations.doc:
**Equation 86.3.2.1 of [Stacks, Tag 0E57].**  For a morphism of ringed topoi
`f : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)`, a right adjoint `a` of `Rf_*`, and objects `L` of `D(O_C)`
and `K` of `D(O_D)`, the canonical map

`Rf_*RHom_{O_C}(L, a(K)) ⟶ RHom_{O_D}(Rf_*L, K)`.

It is the projection formula for derived internal Hom of [Stacks, Tag 0B6D] at `L` and `a(K)`,
followed by `RHom_{O_D}(Rf_*L, −)` applied to the counit `Rf_*a(K) ⟶ K` of `Rf_* ⊣ a`.
declarations.statement:
def pushforwardTrace
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))) :
    (derivedPushforward f).obj ((HX.obj (op L)).obj (a.obj K)) ⟶
      (HY.obj (op ((derivedPushforward f).obj L))).obj K

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.PushforwardTraceOnRingedTopoi.pushforwardTrace_eq
declarations.doc:
**The trace map is that composition.**  Equation 86.3.2.1 is the projection formula for
derived internal Hom of [Stacks, Tag 0B6D] followed by the derived internal Hom out of `Rf_*L`
of the counit `Rf_*a(K) ⟶ K`, and this records it as an equation, so a consumer never unfolds
the definition.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardTrace_eq
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))) :
    pushforwardTrace f hmos HX HY DX DY adj L K =
      projectionFormulaInternalHomMap f hmos HX HY DX.toTensorHomBijection
        DY.toTensorHomBijection L (a.obj K) ≫
        (HY.obj (op ((derivedPushforward f).obj L))).map (adj.counit.app K)
declarations.comment: the defining composition

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.PushforwardTraceOnRingedTopoi.pushforwardTrace_naturality_source
declarations.doc: **The trace map is contravariant in `L`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardTrace_naturality_source
    {L L' : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))}
    (g : L' ⟶ L)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))) :
    (derivedPushforward f).map ((HX.map g.op).app (a.obj K)) ≫
        pushforwardTrace f hmos HX HY DX DY adj L' K =
      pushforwardTrace f hmos HX HY DX DY adj L K ≫
        (HY.map ((derivedPushforward f).map g).op).app K
declarations.comment: naturality in the first variable

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.PushforwardTraceOnRingedTopoi.pushforwardTrace_naturality_target
declarations.doc: **The trace map is covariant in `K`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardTrace_naturality_target
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    {K K' : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))}
    (φ : K ⟶ K') :
    (derivedPushforward f).map ((HX.obj (op L)).map (a.map φ)) ≫
        pushforwardTrace f hmos HX HY DX DY adj L K' =
      pushforwardTrace f hmos HX HY DX DY adj L K ≫
        (HY.obj (op ((derivedPushforward f).obj L))).map φ
declarations.comment: naturality in the second variable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_coherator_map_smallEtalePushforwardTrace
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic spaces, `a` the
right adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, `L` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `K` in
`D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. Then the trace map `Rf_*R𝓗om(L, a(K)) ⟶ R𝓗om(Rf_*L, K)` becomes an isomorphism
after applying any right adjoint `DQ_Y` of the inclusion `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y) ⟶ D(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coherator_map_smallEtalePushforwardTrace
    {DQ : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) ⥤
      QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2}
    (adjQ : (QcohDerived B S hS Y).ι ⊣ DQ)
    (L : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    IsIso (DQ.map (smallEtalePushforwardTrace hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs L K))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_globalDerivedHomTrace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E59.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-separated and quasi-compact algebraic
spaces. For all `L` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `K` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` the map of Stacks 0E57 induces an
isomorphism `RHom_X(L, a(K)) ⟶ RHom_Y(Rf_*L, K)` of global derived homs.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalDerivedHomTrace (L : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    IsIso (globalDerivedHomTrace hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs L K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.TorIndependentBaseChangeSquare
declarations.doc:
A cartesian square of algebraic spaces over `S` whose upper right and
lower left corners are Tor independent over the lower right corner.
declarations.statement:
structure TorIndependentBaseChangeSquare (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S)
declarations.comment: the Tor-independent cartesian square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChange
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of algebraic spaces with `X` and `Y'` quasi-compact and
quasi-separated and `Y` quasi-separated, the transformation `Rg'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rg_*` between the
right adjoints `a`, `a'` of `Rf_*`, `Rf'_*` on `D_QCoh` (Stacks 0E55): the mate of the base change
map `Lg^* ∘ Rf_* ⟶ Rf'_* ∘ L(g')^*` of Stacks 07A7.
declarations.statement:
def quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChange :
    quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f'
          (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqc hYqs hY'qc)
          (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqs hY'qs) hY'qs ⋙
        quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS g'
          (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ X.2 hXqs
            (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqc hYqs hY'qc) g'.hom)
          (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ X'.2
            (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqs hY'qs) g'.hom) ⟶
      quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS g
          (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ Y.2 hYqs hY'qc g.hom)
          (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ Y'.2 hY'qs g.hom) ⋙
        quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5C.**  For a cartesian square of quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces
with `X` and `Y'` Tor independent over `Y`, the base change transformation
`Rg'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rg_*` of Stacks 0E5B is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChange :
    IsIso (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChange hZ sq hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.TorIndependentBaseChangeSquare.DualityData.twistedInverseImageBaseChange
declarations.doc:
The base change map `L(g')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ Lg^*` between twisted inverse
images, the composition of the unit of `Lg^* ⊣ Rg_*`, the inverse of the base change map
`Rg'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rg_*` between right adjoints, and the counit of `L(g')^* ⊣ Rg'_*`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def twistedInverseImageBaseChange (hbc : IsIso D.baseChange) :
    D.twistedInverseImage ⋙ D.pullbackG' ⟶ D.pullbackG ⋙ D.twistedInverseImage'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**The base change map `L(g')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ Lg^*`** (Stacks 0E5D) of a cartesian square of
quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces with `X` and `Y'` Tor independent over `Y`:
the unit of `Lg^* ⊣ Rg_*`, the inverse of the isomorphism of Stacks 0E5C, and the counit of
`L(g')^* ⊣ Rg'_*`.
declarations.statement:
def quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap :
    quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs ⋙ quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g' ⟶
      quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g ⋙
        quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f'
          (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqc hYqs hY'qc)
          (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqs hY'qs) hY'qs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_vertical
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5E.**  For two vertically stacked cartesian squares of quasi-compact
quasi-separated algebraic spaces, with `f` and `l` as well as `g` and `m` Tor independent, the
base change map of Stacks 0E5D for the outer rectangle is the composite of those of the two
squares, read through the identifications `a ∘ b = c` and `a' ∘ b' = c'` of the right adjoints
of `R(g ∘ f)_* = Rg_* ∘ Rf_*` and `R(g' ∘ f')_* = Rg'_* ∘ Rf'_*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_vertical (K) :
    (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ (sqt.paste_vert sqb) hXqc hXqs hZqs
        hZ'qc hZ'qs (torIndependent_rectangle_vertical sqb hTt hTb)).app K =
      (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback k).map
          ((RightAdjointBaseChange.rightAdjointCompIso (squareAdjF hZ hXqc hXqs hYqs)
            (squareAdjF hZ hYqc hYqs hZqs) (squareAdjF hZ hXqc hXqs hZqs)
            (quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardCompIso f g
              (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ Y.2 hYqs hXqc f.hom)
              (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ X.2 hXqs f.hom)
              (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ Z.2 hZqs hYqc g.hom)
              (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ Y.2 hYqs g.hom)
              (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ Z.2 hZqs hXqc (f ≫ g).hom)
              (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ X.2 hXqs
                (f ≫ g).hom))).inv.app K) ≫
        (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sqt hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs
          hTt).app ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ g hYqc hYqs hZqs).obj K) ≫
        (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f'
            (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sqt hXqc hYqs hY'qc)
            (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sqt hXqs hY'qs) hY'qs).map
          ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sqb hYqc hYqs hZqs hZ'qc hZ'qs
            hTb).app K) ≫
        (RightAdjointBaseChange.rightAdjointCompIso (squareAdjF' hZ sqt hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs)
          (squareAdjF' hZ sqb hYqc hYqs hZqs hZ'qc hZ'qs)
          (squareAdjF' hZ (sqt.paste_vert sqb) hXqc hXqs hZqs hZ'qc hZ'qs)
          (quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardCompIso f' g'
            (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ Y'.2 hY'qs
              (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sqt hXqc hYqs hY'qc) f'.hom)
            (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ X'.2
              (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sqt hXqs hY'qs) f'.hom)
            (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ Z'.2 hZ'qs hY'qc g'.hom)
            (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ Y'.2 hY'qs g'.hom)
            (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ Z'.2 hZ'qs
              (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sqt hXqc hYqs hY'qc) (f' ≫ g').hom)
            (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ X'.2
              (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sqt hXqs hY'qs)
              (f' ≫ g').hom))).hom.app ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback m).obj K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_horizontal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5F.**  For two horizontally composed cartesian squares of quasi-compact
quasi-separated algebraic spaces, with `f` and `h` as well as `f'` and `h'` Tor independent, the
base change map of Stacks 0E5D for the outer rectangle is the composite of those of the two
squares, read through `L(g ∘ g')^* = L(g')^* ∘ Lg^*` and `L(h ∘ h')^* = L(h')^* ∘ Lh^*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_horizontal (K) :
    (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ (sql.paste_horiz sqr) hXqc hXqs hYqs
        hY''qc hY''qs (torIndependent_rectangle_horizontal sqr hTr hTl)).app K =
      (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullbackCompIso g' g).inv.app
          ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs).obj K) ≫
        (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g').map
          ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sqr hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs
            hTr).app K) ≫
        (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sql hX'qc hX'qs hY'qs hY''qc
          hY''qs hTl).app ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback h).obj K) ≫
        (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f''
          (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ (sql.paste_horiz sqr) hXqc hYqs hY''qc)
          (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ (sql.paste_horiz sqr) hXqs hY''qs)
          hY''qs).map ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullbackCompIso h' h).hom.app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_grid
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5G.**  Let `S` be a scheme and consider a commutative diagram

```
X'' --k'--> X' --k--> X
 |f''        |f'       |f
 v           v         v
Y'' --l'--> Y' --l--> Y
 |g''        |g'       |g
 v           v         v
Z'' --m'--> Z' --m--> Z
```

of quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic spaces over `S` whose squares `A B / C D` are
cartesian, with `(f, l)`, `(g, m)`, `(f', l')`, `(g', m')` Tor independent pairs. Let `a`, `a'`,
`a''`, `b`, `b'`, `b''` be the right adjoints of Stacks 0E55 for `f`, `f'`, `f''`, `g`, `g'`, `g''`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint`). Then the two transformations
`(k')^* ∘ k^* ∘ a ∘ b ⟶ a'' ∘ b'' ∘ (m')^* ∘ m^*` built from the base change maps (Stacks 0E5D)
of the rectangles, `γ_{A+C} ∘ γ_{B+D}` (columns) and `γ_{C+D} ∘ γ_{A+B}` (rows), are equal. Here
the maps of the rectangles are read through the identifications of Stacks 0E5E and 0E5F
(`quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMapPasteVert`,
`quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMapPasteHoriz`), and the equality is stated at every
object `K` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_Z)`.

Of the source's standing hypothesis that all nine spaces are quasi-compact and quasi-separated,
two parts are not assumed: `X''` inherits both properties from the cartesian squares, and
quasi-compactness of `Z` is not used.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_grid (K) :
    (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback k').map
        ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMapPasteVert hZ sqB sqD hXqc hXqs hYqc hYqs
          hZqs hY'qc hY'qs hZ'qc hZ'qs hTB hTD).app K) ≫
      (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMapPasteVert hZ sqA sqC hX'qc hX'qs hY'qc hY'qs
        hZ'qs hY''qc hY''qs hZ''qc hZ''qs hTA hTC).app
          ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback m).obj K) =
    (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMapPasteHoriz hZ sqB sqA hXqc hXqs hYqs hY''qc
        hY''qs hTB hTA).app
          ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ g hYqc hYqs hZqs).obj K) ≫
      (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f''
          (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ (sqA.paste_horiz sqB) hXqc hYqs hY''qc)
          (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ (sqA.paste_horiz sqB) hXqs hY''qs)
          hY''qs).map
        ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMapPasteHoriz hZ sqD sqC hYqc hYqs hZqs
          hZ''qc hZ''qs hTD hTC).app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_app_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5I (2).** For a cartesian square
```
X' --g'--> X
|f'        |f
Y' --g---> Y
```
with `Y`, `Y'` affine, `Y` Noetherian, `f` proper and perfect, and `X`, `Y'` Tor independent over
`Y`, the base change map `L(g')^* a(K) ⟶ a'(Lg^*K)` of Stacks 0E5D is an isomorphism for every
`K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_app_of_isPerfect
    {X Y X' Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (hfp : IsPerfect B S hS f.hom)
    (hY : IsAffineSpace B S hS Y.1) (hYN : IsNoetherian B S hS hZ Y.1)
    (hY' : IsAffineSpace B S hS Y'.1) (hTor : TorIndependent X.2 Y'.2 Y.2 f.hom g.hom)
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    IsIso ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sq
      (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isQuasiCompact_hom_of_isAffineSpace B S hS f hf.2.1.2 hY)
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparated_hom_of_isAffineSpace B S hS hZ f
        (isQuasiSeparated_of_isSeparated B S hS hf.1) hY)
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isAffineSpace B S hS hZ hY) hY'.isQuasiCompactSpace
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isAffineSpace B S hS hZ hY') hTor).app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_app_of_hasFiniteTorDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5I (3).** Let `g : U' ⟶ U` be a morphism of affine schemes of finite Tor dimension,
with `U` Noetherian, and consider a cartesian square
```
X' --g'--> X
|f'        |f
U' --g---> U
```
with `f` proper and `X`, `U'` Tor independent over `U`. Then the base change map
`L(g')^* a(K) ⟶ a'(Lg^*K)` of Stacks 0E5D is an isomorphism for every `K ∈ D^+_QCoh(𝒪_U)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_app_of_hasFiniteTorDimension
    {U' U : BigFppfOver B S hS} [IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)]
    [IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U')] (g₀ : U' ⟶ U)
    {X X' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ ⟨yoneda.obj U, isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U⟩}
    {f' : X' ⟶ ⟨yoneda.obj U', isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U'⟩} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (representedSpaceMap B S hS g₀)) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hY : IsNoetherian B S hS hZ (yoneda.obj U))
    (hTor : TorIndependent X.2 (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U')
      (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U) f.hom (representedSpaceMap B S hS g₀).hom)
    (hg : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteTorDimension (representedSpaceMap B S hS g₀))
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS (yoneda.obj U)
      (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U))
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj) :
    IsIso ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sq
      (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isQuasiCompact_hom_of_isAffineSpace B S hS f hf.2.1.2
        (isAffineSpace_yoneda B S hS U inferInstance))
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparated_hom_of_isAffineSpace B S hS hZ f
        (isQuasiSeparated_of_isSeparated B S hS hf.1) (isAffineSpace_yoneda B S hS U inferInstance))
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isAffineSpace B S hS hZ
        (isAffineSpace_yoneda B S hS U inferInstance))
      (isAffineSpace_yoneda B S hS U' inferInstance).isQuasiCompactSpace
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isAffineSpace B S hS hZ
        (isAffineSpace_yoneda B S hS U' inferInstance)) hTor).app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_trace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5L.**  The trace maps and the base change maps agree: `Lg^*` of the trace
`Rf_* a K ⟶ K` is the base change map `β` at `a K`, followed by `Rf'_*` of the map `α` of
Stacks 0E5D and the trace `Rf'_* a' (Lg^* K) ⟶ Lg^* K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_trace (K) :
    (squareBaseChange hZ sq hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs).app
          ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs).obj K) ≫
        (quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS f'
          (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ Y'.2 hY'qs
            (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqc hYqs hY'qc) f'.hom)
          (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ X'.2
            (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqs hY'qs) f'.hom)).map
          ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sq hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs
            hTor).app K) ≫
        (squareAdjF' hZ sq hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs).counit.app
          ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g).obj K) =
      (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g).map
        ((squareAdjF hZ hXqc hXqs hYqs).counit.app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_unit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5M.**  The units and the base change maps agree: `L(g')^*` of the unit
`K ⟶ a (Rf_* K)`, followed by the map `α` of Stacks 0E5D at `Rf_* K` and by `a'` of the base
change map `β`, is the unit `L(g')^* K ⟶ a' (Rf'_* L(g')^* K)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap_unit (K) :
    (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g').map ((squareAdjF hZ hXqc hXqs hYqs).unit.app K) ≫
        (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sq hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs
          hTor).app ((quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS f
            (isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace B S hS hZ Y.2 hYqs hXqc f.hom)
            (isQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_source B S hS hZ X.2 hXqs
              f.hom)).obj K) ≫
        (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f'
          (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqc hYqs hY'qc)
          (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqs hY'qs) hY'qs).map
          ((squareBaseChange hZ sq hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs).app K) =
      (squareAdjF' hZ sq hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs).unit.app
        ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g').obj K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.compareWithPullbackTensor
declarations.doc:
**The two-variable comparison map of [Stacks, Tag 0E5P]**:
`Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(L) ⟶ a(K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} L)`, for a right adjoint `a` of
`Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. It is the map adjoint to the inverse of the projection
formula `Rf_*(Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(L)) ≅ K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} Rf_*(a(L))` followed by the identity of `K`
tensored with the trace map `adja.counit.app L : Rf_*(a(L)) ⟶ L`.
declarations.statement:
def compareWithPullbackTensor (K L : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    (D.tensorX.obj (D.pullback.obj K)).obj (a.obj L) ⟶ a.obj ((D.tensorY.obj K).obj L)
declarations.comment: two-variable construction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.homEquiv_symm_compareWithPullbackTensor
declarations.doc:
The adjoint transpose of the two-variable comparison map is the inverse projection formula
followed by the identity of `K` tensored with the trace map.
declarations.statement:
theorem homEquiv_symm_compareWithPullbackTensor
    (K L : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    (adja.homEquiv _ _).symm (D.compareWithPullbackTensor adja K L) =
      inv (D.projectionFormulaMap (a.obj L) K) ≫
        (D.tensorY.obj K).map (adja.counit.app L)
declarations.comment: two-variable adjunction characterization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.projectionFormulaMap_comp_map_compareWithPullbackTensor_comp_counit
declarations.doc:
**The two-variable comparison map as the source constructs it**: the projection formula,
followed by `Rf_*` of the comparison map and the trace map, is the identity of `K` tensored with
the trace map. This is the characterization with no inverse in it.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectionFormulaMap_comp_map_compareWithPullbackTensor_comp_counit
    (K L : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    D.projectionFormulaMap (a.obj L) K ≫
        D.pushforward.map (D.compareWithPullbackTensor adja K L) ≫
          adja.counit.app ((D.tensorY.obj K).obj L) =
      (D.tensorY.obj K).map (adja.counit.app L)
declarations.comment: two-variable characterization without the inverse

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.compareWithPullbackTensor_naturality
declarations.doc: The two-variable comparison map is natural in `K` and `L` jointly.
declarations.statement:
theorem compareWithPullbackTensor_naturality
    {K K' L L' : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2} (h : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L') :
    (D.tensorX.map (D.pullback.map h)).app (a.obj L) ≫
        (D.tensorX.obj (D.pullback.obj K')).map (a.map g) ≫
          D.compareWithPullbackTensor adja K' L' =
      D.compareWithPullbackTensor adja K L ≫
        a.map ((D.tensorY.map h).app L ≫ (D.tensorY.obj K').map g)
declarations.comment: two-variable naturality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.compareWithPullback
declarations.doc:
**Equation 86.7.0.1 of [Stacks, Tag 0E5P]**: the comparison map
`Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)`, the two-variable comparison map at `L = 𝒪_Y` followed by `a`
applied to the right unitor `K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} 𝒪_Y ≅ K`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.projectionFormulaMap_comp_map_compareWithPullback_comp_counit
declarations.doc:
**Equation 86.7.0.1 as the source constructs it**: the projection formula, followed by `Rf_*`
of the displayed comparison map and the trace map, is the identity of `K` tensored with the trace
map at `𝒪_Y`, followed by the right unitor.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectionFormulaMap_comp_map_compareWithPullback_comp_counit
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    D.projectionFormulaMap (a.obj (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2)) K ≫
        D.pushforward.map (D.compareWithPullback adja ρ K) ≫ adja.counit.app K =
      (D.tensorY.obj K).map (adja.counit.app (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2)) ≫
        ρ.hom.app K
declarations.comment: characterization without the inverse

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.compareWithPullback_naturality
declarations.doc: Equation 86.7.0.1 is functorial in `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem compareWithPullback_naturality
    {K K' : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2} (h : K ⟶ K') :
    (D.tensorX.map (D.pullback.map h)).app
          (a.obj (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2)) ≫
        D.compareWithPullback adja ρ K' =
      D.compareWithPullback adja ρ K ≫ a.map h
declarations.comment: functoriality in K

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.compareWithPullbackNatTrans
declarations.doc:
Equation 86.7.0.1 as a natural transformation of functors of `K`, which is its
functoriality in `K`.
declarations.statement:
def compareWithPullbackNatTrans :
    D.compareWithPullbackSource (a.obj (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2)) ⟶ a
declarations.comment: functoriality in K, as a natural transformation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.compareWithPullbackNatTrans_commShift
declarations.doc:
**Compatibility of Equation 86.7.0.1 with distinguished triangles**: the displayed comparison
map commutes with translation, so it carries the third morphism of a distinguished triangle of
`D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` to the third morphism of its image.
declarations.statement:
theorem compareWithPullbackNatTrans_commShift :
    NatTrans.CommShift (D.compareWithPullbackNatTrans adja ρ) ℤ
declarations.comment: compatibility with distinguished triangles

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PullbackComparisonData.compareWithPullback_shift
declarations.doc: Equation 86.7.0.1 at a translate of `K`, which is that compatibility componentwise.
declarations.statement:
theorem compareWithPullback_shift (n : ℤ)
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    D.compareWithPullback adja ρ ((shiftFunctor _ n).obj K) =
      ((D.compareWithPullbackSource
          (a.obj (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2))).commShiftIso n).hom.app K ≫
        (shiftFunctor _ n).map (D.compareWithPullback adja ρ K) ≫
          (a.commShiftIso n).inv.app K
declarations.comment: compatibility with distinguished triangles, componentwise

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5P.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic
spaces over `S` and let `a` be the right adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`
(Stacks 0E55). The map `Lf^*K ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)`, the two-variable map at `L = 𝒪_Y`
followed by `a` of the unitor, is functorial in `K`.
declarations.statement:
def quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback :
    quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback f ⋙ (quasicoherentDerivedTensor B S hS X).flip.obj
        ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs).obj
          (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2)) ⟶
      quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback_commShift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5P, compatibility with distinguished triangles.** The map
`Lf^*K ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)` commutes with the shift, so it carries the third morphism of a
distinguished triangle in `K` to the third morphism of its image.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback_commShift :
    NatTrans.CommShift (quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs) ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullbackTensor_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5Q.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic
spaces and `a` the right adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. For `K, L ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`
with `K` perfect, the map `Lf^*K ⊗^L a(L) ⟶ a(K ⊗^L L)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullbackTensor_of_isPerfect
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2)
    (hK : RingedSite.IsPerfect (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2) K.obj)
    (L : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    IsIso (quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullbackTensor hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs K L)
declarations.comment: the map Lf^*K ⊗ a(L) → a(K ⊗ L) is an isomorphism for K perfect

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback_app_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5Q, in particular.** For `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` perfect, the map
`Lf^*K ⊗^L a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)` of Stacks 0E5P is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback_app_of_isPerfect
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2)
    (hK : RingedSite.IsPerfect (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2) K.obj) :
    IsIso ((quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs).app K)
declarations.comment: in particular, the map (0E5P) Lf^*K ⊗ a(O_Y) → a(K) is an isomorphism for K perfect

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback_baseChange
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces
with `X` and `Y'` Tor independent over `Y` and `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, the square

`L(g')^*(Lf^*K ⊗^L a(𝒪_Y)) ⟶ L(g')^*a(K) ⟶ a'(Lg^*K)` (`L(g')^*` of Stacks 0E5P, then the base
change map of Stacks 0E5D)

equals `L(g')^*(Lf^*K ⊗^L a(𝒪_Y)) ⟶ L(g')^*Lf^*K ⊗^L L(g')^*a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ L(f')^*Lg^*K ⊗^L a'(𝒪_{Y'})
⟶ a'(Lg^*K)`: Stacks 07A4 for `g'`, the identification of the two iterated pullbacks around the
square and Stacks 0E5D at `𝒪_Y` followed by `a'(Lg^*𝒪_Y ≅ 𝒪_{Y'})`, then Stacks 0E5P for `f'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback_baseChange
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g').map
          ((quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs).app K) ≫
        (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sq hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs
          hTor).app K =
      (quasicoherentDerivedPullbackTensorComparison g').app
          ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs).obj
            (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2), (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback f).obj K) ≫
        ((quasicoherentDerivedTensor B S hS X').map
            (ObjectProperty.homMk
              ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullbackSquareIso B S hS f g f' g' sq.w).hom.app K.obj ≫
                (smallEtaleDerivedModulePullbackCompIso B S hS f' g).inv.app K.obj) :
              (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g').obj
                  ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback f).obj K) ⟶
                (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback f').obj
                  ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g).obj K))).app
            ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g').obj
              ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f hXqc hXqs hYqs).obj
                (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2))) ≫
          ((quasicoherentDerivedTensor B S hS X').obj ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback f').obj
              ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g).obj K))).map
            ((quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjointBaseChangeMap hZ sq hXqc hXqs hYqs hY'qc hY'qs
                hTor).app (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2) ≫
              (quasicoherentDerivedRightAdjoint hZ f'
                (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqc hYqs hY'qc)
                (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqs hY'qs) hY'qs).map
                (ObjectProperty.homMk
                  (smallEtaleDerivedModulePullbackUnitIso (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) g).hom :
                  (quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g).obj
                      (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2) ⟶
                    derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y'.1 Y'.2)) ≫
            (quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback hZ f'
              (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqc hYqs hY'qc)
              (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isPullback hZ sq hXqs hY'qs) hY'qs).app
              ((quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback g).obj K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preservesCoproducts_rightAdjoint_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
Let `Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space and
`f : X ⟶ Y` a proper, flat morphism of finite presentation. Then the right adjoint `a` of
`Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` (Stacks 0E55) commutes with direct sums.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesCoproducts_rightAdjoint_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward_of_isProper
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hYqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS Y.1)
    (hYqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ Y.1) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom) (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) :
    haveI := isLeftAdjoint_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward hZ f
      (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isQuasiCompact B S hS Y.2 hYqc f.hom hfp.2.1)
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.2 hYqs hfp.2.2) hYqs
    ∀ I : Type u, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
      (quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS f hfp.2.1 hfp.2.2).rightAdjoint

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback_app_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
Let `Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space and `f : X ⟶ Y` a proper,
flat morphism of finite presentation, with right adjoint `a` of
`Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` (Stacks 0E55). The map `Lf^*K ⊗^L a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)` of
Stacks 0E5P is an isomorphism for every `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback_app_of_isProper
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hYqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS Y.1)
    (hYqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ Y.1) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom) (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (K : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    IsIso ((quasicoherentDerivedCompareWithPullback hZ f
      (isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isQuasiCompact B S hS Y.2 hYqc f.hom hfp.2.1)
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.2 hYqs hfp.2.2) hYqs).app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLE_derivedModulePushforward_affineRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5V (2).** For `Y` affine and `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite
presentation, `Rf_* a(𝒪_Y)` has vanishing cohomology sheaves in positive degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLE_derivedModulePushforward_affineRightAdjoint (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom) (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (hY : IsAffineSpace B S hS Y.1) :
    ((derivedModulePushforward B S hS f).obj
      ((affineRightAdjoint hZ f hfp hY).obj
        (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2)).obj).IsLE 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPerfectRelativeToCanonical_affineRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5V (1).** For `Y` affine and `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite
presentation, with `a` the right adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, the object
`a(𝒪_Y)` of `D(𝒪_X)` is `Y`-perfect.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfectRelativeToCanonical_affineRightAdjoint {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (hY : IsAffineSpace B S hS Y.1) :
    IsPerfectRelativeToCanonical.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B S hS f hfl hfp.1
      ((affineRightAdjoint hZ f hfp hY).obj (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2)).obj

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_smallEtaleDerivedHomothety_affineRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5V (3).** For `Y` affine and `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite
presentation, with `a` the right adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, the map
`𝒪_X ⟶ R𝓗om(a(𝒪_Y), a(𝒪_Y))` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_smallEtaleDerivedHomothety_affineRightAdjoint {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (hY : IsAffineSpace B S hS Y.1) :
    IsIso (smallEtaleDerivedHomothety B S hS X
      ((affineRightAdjoint hZ f hfp hY).obj (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y.1 Y.2)).obj)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper, flat morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` of finite
presentation. A *relative dualizing complex* for `X/Y` is a pair `(ω, τ)` of a `Y`-perfect object
`ω` of `D(𝒪_X)` and a map `τ : Rf_* ω ⟶ 𝒪_Y` such that for every cartesian square
`g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g` with `Y'` an affine scheme, the pair `(L(g')^* ω, Lg^* τ)` is isomorphic to the
pair `(a'(𝒪_{Y'}), Tr_{f', 𝒪_{Y'}})` of the right adjoint `a'` of `Rf'_*` (Stacks 0E55) and its
trace map (Stacks 0E5K).
declarations.statement:
structure RelativeDualizingComplex {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) extends RelativeDualizingPair f hfl hfp

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeDualizingComplex.isIso_smallEtaleDerivedHomothety_and_isLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5Y.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper, flat morphism of algebraic spaces of finite
presentation. For a relative dualizing complex `(ω, τ)`, the map `𝒪_X ⟶ R𝓗om(ω, ω)` is an
isomorphism and `Rf_* ω` has vanishing cohomology sheaves in positive degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_smallEtaleDerivedHomothety_and_isLE (ω : RelativeDualizingComplex hZ f hf hfl hfp) :
    IsIso (smallEtaleDerivedHomothety B S hS X ω.ω) ∧
      ((derivedModulePushforward B S hS f).obj ω.ω).IsLE 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeDualizingComplex.existsUnique_iso_of_relativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E5Z.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper, flat morphism of algebraic spaces of finite
presentation. Two relative dualizing complexes `(ω₁, τ₁)`, `(ω₂, τ₂)` on `X/Y` have a unique
isomorphism of pairs: a unique `e : ω₁ ≅ ω₂` with `τ₂ ∘ Rf_* e = τ₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_iso_of_relativeDualizingComplex
    (D₁ D₂ : RelativeDualizingComplex hZ f hf hfl hfp) :
    ∃! e : D₁.ω ≅ D₂.ω, (derivedModulePushforward B S hS f).map e.hom ≫ D₂.τ = D₁.τ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeDualizingPair.isAffineBaseChangePair_of_isEtaleCovering_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E60.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper, flat morphism of algebraic spaces of finite
presentation, `(ω, τ)` a pair of a `Y`-perfect object of `D(𝒪_X)` and a map
`τ : Rf_* ω ⟶ 𝒪_Y`, and `X_i ⟶ Y_i` the base changes of `f` to the members of an étale covering
`{Y_i ⟶ Y}` by affines, over which `(ω, τ)` is isomorphic to `(a_i(𝒪_{Y_i}), Tr)`. Then
`(ω, τ)` is a relative dualizing complex: its base change to every affine `Y'` is isomorphic to
`(a'(𝒪_{Y'}), Tr)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineBaseChangePair_of_isEtaleCovering_of_isProper
    (P : RelativeDualizingPair f hfl hfp) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    {ι : Type v} {Yi Xi : ι → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ Yi i}
    {gi : ∀ i, Yi i ⟶ Y} {g'i : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X} (sqi : ∀ i, IsPullback (g'i i) (fi i) f (gi i))
    (hYi : ∀ i, IsAffineSpace B S hS (Yi i).1)
    (hcov : IsEtaleCovering B S hS (fun i => (Yi i).1) (fun i => (gi i).hom))
    (hi : ∀ i, IsAffineBaseChangePair hZ (sqi i) hfp (hYi i) P.ω P.τ)
    ⦃X' Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (hY' : IsAffineSpace B S hS Y'.1) :
    IsAffineBaseChangePair hZ sq hfp hY' P.ω P.τ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeDualizingComplex.nonempty
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E61: existence of relative dualizing complexes.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper,
flat morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is of finite presentation. Then there exists a
relative dualizing complex `(ω_{X/Y}, τ)` for `X/Y` (Stacks 0E5X).
declarations.statement:
theorem RelativeDualizingComplex.nonempty (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom) (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) :
    Nonempty (RelativeDualizingComplex hZ f hf hfl hfp)

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.UnitSplitting.exists_localization_iso_single_homology_biprod_truncGE
declarations.doc:
**The affine-local algebraic form of part (b) of [Stacks, Tag 0E62].**

Let `R` be a commutative ring, `p ⊂ R` a prime, and `K` a pseudo-coherent object of `D(R)` --
standing for `E = Rf_*𝒪_X` restricted to an affine open of `S`. Assume

* `Hⁱ(K) = 0` for `i < 0` and `H^{-1}(K ⊗_R^L κ(p)) = 0`, and
* `H⁰(K) ⊗_R κ(p) → H⁰(K ⊗_R^L κ(p))` is surjective.

Then there is `g ∈ R`, `g ∉ p`, such that over `R_g` the localization `K_g = K ⊗_R R_g` splits as

`K_g ≅ H⁰(K)_g[0] ⊕ τ_{≥1}K_g`,

where `H⁰(K)_g` is a finite free `R_g`-module and `τ_{≥1}K_g` is a perfect object of `D(R_g)` of
Tor amplitude in `[1, ∞)`, recorded by a bounded complex of finite projective `R_g`-modules
concentrated in degrees `≥ 1` representing it whose termwise tensor products have no cohomology
below degree `1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_localization_iso_single_homology_biprod_truncGE
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R))
    (hK : StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent K)
    (hneg : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) i).obj K))
    (hfib : FibreCohomologyVanishes.{u, v} p K (-1))
    (hbase : CohomologyBaseChangeSurjective.{u, v} p K 0) :
    ∃ g : R, g ∉ p ∧
      let Rg := Localization.Away g
      let Kg := (PseudoCoherence.localizationAwayFunctorAux.{u, v} g).obj K
      let upper := (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE 1).obj Kg
      let H0g := (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R Rg)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) 0).obj K)
      Module.Finite Rg H0g ∧ Module.Free Rg H0g ∧ IsPerfect upper ∧
        (∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} Rg) ℤ) (b : ℤ),
          P.IsStrictlyGE 1 ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
            (∀ j : ℤ, Module.Finite Rg (P.X j)) ∧
            (∀ j : ℤ, Module.Projective Rg (P.X j)) ∧
            Nonempty (upper ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ∧
            ∀ (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} Rg) (j : ℤ), j < 1 →
              IsZero ((TorAmplitude.tensorComplex P M).homology j)) ∧
        Nonempty (Kg ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} Rg) 0).obj H0g ⊞ upper)
declarations.comment: PART (b) ONLY, and only in its AFFINE-LOCAL ALGEBRAIC FORM: the statement is about an abstract pseudo-coherent object K of D(R) for a commutative ring R, standing for E = Rf_*O_X restricted to an affine open of S, and NOTHING HERE IDENTIFIES K WITH A DERIVED DIRECT IMAGE. The source's proof has four steps and the first, geometric one is NOT performed: cohomology and base change (Tag 0B91), which gives that E is perfect and that its formation commutes with arbitrary base change, is not invoked at all. What is assumed of K instead is exactly what the source's remaining three steps use of E: pseudo-coherence (the part of perfectness Tag 0A1U asks for); the vanishing of H^i(K) for i < 0 and of H^{-1}(K tensor^L k(p)), which are the two consequences of `E has tor amplitude in [0, infinity)` that the source uses, taken as two separate vanishing statements because StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.HasTorAmplitude carries the derived tensor product, its comparison and its universal property as explicit parameters and nothing stronger is needed; and surjectivity of H^0(K) tensor k(p) --> H^0(K tensor^L k(p)) at p, which is the source's second step. WITHIN part (b), THE FIRST SUMMAND IS NOT IDENTIFIED WITH O_S. What is delivered is the splitting K_g = H^0(K)_g[0] (+) tau_{>=1}K_g after localizing away from a single element g outside p, with tau_{>=1}K_g perfect of tor amplitude in [1, infinity) -- the source's step 3, Tag 0A1U -- and with H^0(K)_g FINITE FREE over R_g, which is the half of the source's step 4 that Tags 0658 and 00NX supply. The remaining half of step 4, that the unit O_S --> H^0(E) is an isomorphism, is NOT carried, and that is also exactly PART (a) of this tag, `f_*O_X = O_S and this holds after any base change`, WHICH IS NOT DELIVERED ANYWHERE in this file: carrying it needs the map H^0(epsilon) : R --> H^0(K) induced by a unit epsilon : R[0] --> K, which this statement does not take as data, and then the transport of the fibrewise bijectivity of that map from the primes of R to the primes of R_g so that the isomorphism locus of Algebra Tag 00O0 (3) can be read at the prime of R_g above p; that locus result IS carried in this library, as Stacks.FiniteProjective.MapLocus.isOpen_isoLocus_and_localized, but neither the induced map nor the transport is written here. The statement is algebraic rather than geometric because Tags 0A1U and 0A1V are carried in this library only over a commutative ring, as StacksDraft.Perfect results about D(R) in StacksFrontier/Homology/Perfect/FibreCriterion.lean -- no declaration anywhere in the library carries either tag for the derived category of modules on a scheme -- so the geometric statement would need in addition the affine-local comparison of D(O_S)|_U with D(R) for U = Spec R an affine open, and the identification of H^0(E tensor^L k(s)) with H^0(X_s, O_{X_s}), which the module documentation of StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Perfect/ProperFlatFibreEulerCharacteristic.lean records as absent from this library. What is PROVED here, assuming nothing beyond the stated hypotheses on K: that the degree -1 base-change map is surjective because its target vanishes, so that Tag 0A1V applies at degree 0; that the vanishing of H^i(K) below degree 0 places the localization K_g in degrees >= 0 and so kills the summand tau_{<=-1}K_g of the three-term decomposition of Tag 0A1V; and the assembly of the remaining two summands into the two-term splitting the source states

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperFlatStructureSheafSplitting.properFlat_structureSheaf_splitting
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E62].** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes which is proper, flat and of
finite presentation, and assume that for every `s ∈ S` the canonical map
`κ(s) → H⁰(X_s, 𝒪_{X_s})` is bijective. Then

* (a) `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, and this holds after any base change: for every cartesian square
  `X' = X ×_S S'` the comparison `𝒪_{S'} ⟶ f'_*𝒪_{X'}` of sheaves of rings is an isomorphism;
* (b) locally on `S` we have `Rf_*𝒪_X ≅ 𝒪_S ⊕ P` in `D(𝒪_S)` with `P` perfect of Tor amplitude
  in `[1, ∞)`: every point of `S` lies in the image of an open immersion `ι : V ⟶ S` over which
  the restriction of `Rf_*𝒪_X` is isomorphic to `𝒪_V ⊕ P` with `P` a perfect object of `D(𝒪_V)`
  of Tor amplitude in `[1, b]` for some `b`.
declarations.statement:
theorem properFlat_structureSheaf_splitting {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] [Flat f]
    (hfp : FinitePresentation f)
    (hfib : ∀ s : S, Function.Bijective ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (S.residueField s)).inv ≫
      (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s).appTop)) :
    (IsIso f.c ∧
      ∀ {X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g' : X' ⟶ X),
        IsPullback g' f' f g → IsIso f'.c) ∧
    ∀ s : S, ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (ι : V ⟶ S) (_ : IsOpenImmersion ι)
      (P : DerivedCategory V.Modules),
      s ∈ Set.range ι ∧ RingedSpace.IsPerfect (X := V.toRingedSpace) P ∧
      (∃ b : ℤ, Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.HasTorAmplitude V.toRingedSpace P 1 b) ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((derivedPushforward f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj (Scheme.unitModule X))) ≅
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor V.Modules 0).obj (Scheme.unitModule V) ⊞ P :
          DerivedCategory V.Modules))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.invertibleCurveDegree_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_neg_of_isRationalTail
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E63.** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a field `k`
with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at-worst-nodal singularities, and let `C ⊆ X` be a rational tail. Then
`deg(ω_X|_C) < 0`.

Here `ω_X` is invertible
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities`). The
sequence `0 ⟶ ω_C ⟶ ω_X|_C ⟶ 𝒪_{C ∩ X'} ⟶ 0` of [Stacks, Tag 0E34] gives
`deg(ω_X|_C) = -[k' : k]` with `k' = Γ(C, 𝒪_C)`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.invertibleCurveDegree_eq_neg_of_isRationalTail`).
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleCurveDegree_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_neg_of_isRationalTail
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalTail k X C) :
    haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
    letI hω := isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X hdim
      hnodal
    letI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag09NY.isInvertible_modulePullback C.subschemeι
      (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) hω
    invertibleCurveDegree k (C.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))
        (Stacks.Curves.topologicalKrullDim_subscheme_eq_one_of_isRationalTail k X hdim C hC).le
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.subschemeι).obj
          (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))) < 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.invertibleCurveDegree_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_eq_zero_of_isRationalBridge
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension one over a field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and
at-worst-nodal singularities, and let `C ⊆ X` be a rational bridge. Then `deg(ω_X|_C) = 0`, where
`ω_X` is invertible by `isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleCurveDegree_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_eq_zero_of_isRationalBridge
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C) :
    haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
    letI hω := isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X hdim
      hnodal
    letI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag09NY.isInvertible_modulePullback C.subschemeι
      (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) hω
    invertibleCurveDegree k (C.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))
        (Stacks.Curves.topologicalKrullDim_subscheme_eq_one_of_isRationalBridge k X hdim hC).le
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.subschemeι).obj
          (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))) = 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_sigma_isRationalBridge_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**The disjoint decomposition of a geometrically integral rational bridge.** Let `X` be a
proper one-dimensional scheme over a field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at-worst-nodal
singularities, and let `C ⊆ X` be a rational bridge that is geometrically integral over its field
of global functions. For every field extension `K/k` the inverse image of `C` in `X_K` is a finite
disjoint union of rational bridges of `X_K`, compatibly with their closed immersions into `X_K`.

Geometric integrality of the bridge is an extra assumption beyond those of [Stacks, Tag 0E65],
and the disjointness of the decomposition is false without it: the module docstring above exhibits
the plane curve `X = V(T₂(T₀² + T₁²)) ⊂ P²_ℝ` whose component `C = V(T₀² + T₁²)` is a rational
bridge with `C_ℂ` connected and reducible, and
`Stacks.Curves.DegenerateConic.not_exists_iso_sigma_isRationalBridge_degenerateConic` proves that
the conclusion below fails for it. So the tag itself is registered on
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finset_isRationalBridge_baseChange`, which reaches the
scheme-theoretic-union form of the conclusion from the tag's own hypotheses.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_iso_sigma_isRationalBridge_baseChange
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C)
    (hgeom :
      letI : IsIntegral C.subscheme := hC.isIntegral
      letI : Field Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) :=
        (isField_of_universallyClosed k
          (C.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).toField
      GeometricallyIntegral C.subscheme.toSpecΓ) :
    let g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Spec (.of k) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
    let Y := (pullback (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g : Scheme.{u})
    let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g
    letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of K)) := ⟨pullback.snd (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g⟩
    letI : IsProper (Y ↘ Spec (.of K)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (IsProper (pullback.snd (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g))
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Finite ι) (D : ι → Y.IdealSheafData)
        (_ : ∀ i, IsRationalBridge K Y (D i))
        (e : (∐ fun i ↦ (D i).subscheme) ≅ (C.comap p).subscheme),
      e.hom ≫ (C.comap p).subschemeι =
        Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (D i).subschemeι)
declarations.comment:
CONDITIONALLY -- this is not an unconditional proof of 0E65: the binder `hgeom`,
geometric integrality of the bridge over its field of global functions, is not a hypothesis of the
tag. It cannot be discharged, because the tag's conclusion as stated -- a DISJOINT union -- is
false without it, refuted by
`Stacks.Curves.DegenerateConic.not_exists_iso_sigma_isRationalBridge_degenerateConic` for the
rational bridge `V(T₀² + T₁²)` of `V(T₂(T₀² + T₁²)) ⊂ P²_ℝ`. The tag at its own hypotheses, with
the disjointness dropped from the conclusion, is proved unconditionally as
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finset_isRationalBridge_baseChange` in
`ContractingRationalBridges/BaseChangeUnion.lean`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_sigma_isRationalBridge_baseChange_of_perfectField
declarations.doc:
**The disjoint decomposition over a perfect ground field.** Specialisation of
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_sigma_isRationalBridge_baseChange` to a perfect `k`.

The general statement no longer carries the two hypotheses this specialisation was introduced to
discharge — geometric reducedness of `X` over `k` and separability over `k` of the field of global
functions of the bridge are now derived from nodality for an arbitrary ground field, see the
implementation notes above — so nothing beyond perfectness of `k` separates the two, and the
proof is an application. It is kept because it is the form in which the perfect-field case is
cited elsewhere.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_iso_sigma_isRationalBridge_baseChange_of_perfectField
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [PerfectField k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C)
    (hgeom :
      letI : IsIntegral C.subscheme := hC.isIntegral
      letI : Field Γ(C.subscheme, ⊤) :=
        (isField_of_universallyClosed k
          (C.subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).toField
      GeometricallyIntegral C.subscheme.toSpecΓ) :
    let g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Spec (.of k) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
    let Y := (pullback (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g : Scheme.{u})
    let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g
    letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of K)) := ⟨pullback.snd (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g⟩
    letI : IsProper (Y ↘ Spec (.of K)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (IsProper (pullback.snd (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) g))
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Finite ι) (D : ι → Y.IdealSheafData)
        (_ : ∀ i, IsRationalBridge K Y (D i))
        (e : (∐ fun i ↦ (D i).subscheme) ≅ (C.comap p).subscheme),
      e.hom ≫ (C.comap p).subschemeι =
        Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (D i).subschemeι)
declarations.comment:
CONDITIONALLY -- this is not an unconditional proof of 0E65: the binder `hgeom`,
geometric integrality of the bridge over its field of global functions, is not a hypothesis of the
tag, and `[PerfectField k]` is not either. Both are inherited from
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_sigma_isRationalBridge_baseChange`, which this specialises; see the
disclosure there. The tag at its own hypotheses, with the disjointness dropped from the
conclusion, is proved unconditionally as
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finset_isRationalBridge_baseChange` in
`ContractingRationalBridges/BaseChangeUnion.lean`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finset_isRationalBridge_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E65] in the union form.** Let `X` be a proper one-dimensional scheme over a
field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and at worst nodal singularities, and let `C ⊆ X` be a rational
bridge. For an arbitrary field extension `K/k` — no normality, separability, algebraicity or
finiteness is assumed — the inverse image of `C` in the base change `X_K` is the
scheme-theoretic *union* of a finite set of rational bridges of `X_K`, namely of the reduced
structures on the irreducible components of `X_K` lying over `C`.

The tag asserts a *disjoint* union, which is false; that erratum is recorded at
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_sigma_isRationalBridge_baseChange`, which proves the disjoint form
under the extra hypothesis that the bridge is geometrically integral over its field of global
functions `k' = Γ(C, 𝒪_C)`. The dichotomy behind the repair is this: a rational bridge is either
geometrically integral over `k'` — exactly the hypothesis that earlier statement carries, and
then `C_K` really is a disjoint union of `[k' ⊗_k K : K]`-many bridges — or it acquires precisely
two geometric components, meeting in one point and carrying one point of `C ∩ X'` each. In the
second case the two components of `C_K` meet, so no disjoint decomposition exists, while the
union form is still correct and is what this statement proves.

What makes each component come out with complementary degree exactly two is a symmetry: over a
separably closed extension the components of `C_Ω` all have the same image in `X` and are
therefore conjugate, so their complementary degrees agree
(`Stacks.Curves.finrank_sup_complementaryCurveIdeal_eq_of_image_eq`). The counting identity
`Stacks.Curves.sum_finrank_sup_complementaryCurveIdeal_eq` alone does not suffice: it only says
that the complementary degrees sum to twice the number of components, which a chain of three
components with degrees `(1, 4, 1)` satisfies just as well.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finset_isRationalBridge_baseChange
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)]
    (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X)
    (C : X.IdealSheafData) (hC : IsRationalBridge k X C) :
    letI : (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}).Over (Spec (.of K)) :=
      ⟨pullback.snd _ _⟩
    letI : IsProper ((pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}) ↘ Spec (.of K)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (IsProper (pullback.snd (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))))
    ∃ Λ : Finset (Set (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u})),
      (∀ Z ∈ Λ, IsRationalBridge K (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            (TopologicalSpace.Closeds.closure Z))) ∧
        C.comap (pullback.fst (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
          = Λ.inf fun Z => Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
              (TopologicalSpace.Closeds.closure Z)
declarations.comment: base_change_union

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.SheafDerivation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E66.** `Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X)`: the `k`-linear derivations of the structure sheaf of a
`k`-scheme `X` into itself. These are the vector fields on `X` of Section 53.26.
declarations.statement: abbrev SheafDerivation (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.SheafDerivation.smoothCurve_genus_cases
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E67]**: let `X` be a smooth proper curve of genus `g` over an algebraically
closed field `k` (a curve is integral, so connected). If `g ≥ 2` then `Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X) = 0`; if
`g = 1` a nonzero vector field fixes no closed point; if `g = 0` a nonzero vector field fixes at
most two closed points.
declarations.statement:
theorem SheafDerivation.smoothCurve_genus_cases [IsAlgClosed k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsCurve k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [Smooth (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] :
    (2 ≤ genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) → ∀ D : SheafDerivation k X, D = 0) ∧
    (genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) = 1 → ∀ D : SheafDerivation k X, D ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)), ¬ D.Fixes x hx) ∧
    (genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) = 0 → ∀ D : SheafDerivation k X, D ≠ 0 →
      {x : X | ∃ hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X), D.Fixes x hx}.encard ≤ 2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.NodalVectorFields.range_branchPair
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E68.** Let `k` be an algebraically closed field, let `X` be a proper
one-dimensional `k`-scheme with at worst nodal singularities, let `ν : X^ν ⟶ X` be its
normalization and let `S ⊆ X^ν` be the set of points where `ν` is not an isomorphism: the points
`y` such that `ν` restricts to an isomorphism over no open neighbourhood of `ν(y)`. Then
```
Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X) = {D' ∈ Der_k(𝒪_{X^ν}, 𝒪_{X^ν}) | D' fixes every x^ν ∈ S},
```
the equality being read through the injection `ν^♯` of `𝒪_X` into `ν_* 𝒪_{X^ν}`. The first
clause says that every vector field `D` on `X` has a unique extension `D'` to `X^ν`, that is a
vector field with `D' (ν^♯ s) = ν^♯ (D s)` for every local section `s`, and that `D'` fixes every
point of `S`; the second says that every vector field on `X^ν` fixing every point of `S` is the
extension of a unique vector field on `X`. "Fixes" is the notion of Section 53.26,
`Stacks.Curves.SheafDerivationOf.Fixes`: the point is closed and its ideal sheaf is carried into
itself.

`S` is exactly the set of points above the nodes of `X`
(`Stacks.Curves.not_exists_isIso_normalization_restrict_iff`): away from the nodes `X` is smooth,
hence normal, and `ν` is an isomorphism over every normal open; over no neighbourhood of a node
is it one, because the local ring at a node is not a normal domain. The points of `S` are closed
(`Stacks.Curves.isClosed_singleton_of_isNode`).

The normalization is formed with the finiteness of irreducible components of quasi-compact opens
that every scheme locally of finite type over a field enjoys
(`AlgebraicGeometry.finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType`). The source also
assumes `X` connected; the statement holds without it. The proof derives from properness and
nodality what `Stacks.Curves.derivations_eq_normalization_derivations_fixing_nodes` needs: `X`
is reduced (`Stacks.Curves.isReduced_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities`) and, being separated over
the affine scheme `Spec k`, has affine diagonal. That lemma states the fixing condition on the
stalks of `ν_* 𝒪_{X^ν}` at the nodes, and the two are exchanged by
`Stacks.Curves.fixes_of_forall_fixes_stalkDerivation` and
`Stacks.Curves.forall_fixes_stalkDerivation_of_forall_fixes`, `ν` being finite
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isFinite_normalizationOverField`).
declarations.statement:
theorem NodalVectorFields.range_branchPair (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X) :
    (∀ D : SheafDerivationOf (X ↘ Spec (.of k)),
        ∃! D' : SheafDerivationOf (Scheme.normalization X
            (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) ≫
              (X ↘ Spec (.of k))),
          (∀ (U : X.Opens) (s : Γ(X, U)),
              D'.onSections ((Scheme.normalization X
                  (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k
                    (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).app U |>.hom s) =
                ((Scheme.normalization X
                  (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k
                    (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).app U).hom (D.onSections s)) ∧
            ∀ y : Scheme.normalizationScheme X
                (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))),
              (¬ ∃ U : X.Opens,
                (Scheme.normalization X
                  (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k
                    (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).base y ∈ U ∧
                IsIso (Scheme.normalization X
                  (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k
                    (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) ∣_ U)) →
              ∃ hy : IsClosed ({y} : Set _), D'.Fixes y hy) ∧
      ∀ D' : SheafDerivationOf (Scheme.normalization X
          (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) ≫
            (X ↘ Spec (.of k))),
        (∀ y : Scheme.normalizationScheme X
            (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))),
          (¬ ∃ U : X.Opens,
            (Scheme.normalization X
              (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k
                (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).base y ∈ U ∧
            IsIso (Scheme.normalization X
              (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k
                (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) ∣_ U)) →
          ∃ hy : IsClosed ({y} : Set _), D'.Fixes y hy) →
          ∃! D : SheafDerivationOf (X ↘ Spec (.of k)), ∀ (U : X.Opens) (s : Γ(X, U)),
            D'.onSections ((Scheme.normalization X
