                (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k
                  (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).app U |>.hom s) =
              ((Scheme.normalization X
                (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k
                  (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))).app U).hom (D.onSections s)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.SheafDerivation.eq_zero_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E69]**: let `X` be an at-worst-nodal, proper, connected, one-dimensional
scheme over an algebraically closed field `k`, of genus at least two, with no rational tails and
no rational bridges. Then `Der_k(𝒪_X, 𝒪_X) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem SheafDerivation.eq_zero_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [IsAlgClosed k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [ConnectedSpace X] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hnodal : HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X) (hg : 2 ≤ genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))
    (htail : ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X C)
    (hbridge : ∀ C : X.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalBridge k X C) (D : SheafDerivation k X) :
    D = 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_presieve_isPerfect_hasTorAmplitudeGE_iso_etaleRestrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E6B, part (b).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be proper, flat and of finite presentation, such
that `k = H⁰(X_k, 𝒪_{X_k})` for every morphism `Spec k ⟶ Y` from the spectrum of a field. Then
étale locally on `Y` we have `Rf_*𝒪_X ≅ 𝒪_Y ⊕ P` in `D(𝒪_Y)` with `P` perfect of Tor amplitude in
`[1, ∞)`: every étale chart `U` of `Y` has a covering family of charts `V` over which the
restrictions satisfy `(Rf_*𝒪_X)|_V ≅ 𝒪_Y|_V ⊕ P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_presieve_isPerfect_hasTorAmplitudeGE_iso_etaleRestrict (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (h : ∀ p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS Y.1, Function.Bijective (algebraMap p.carrier
      (globalFunctions B (Spec (.of p.carrier)) p.contained
        (fibreOverFieldValuedPoint B S hS f.hom p))))
    (U : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1) :
    ∃ R : Presieve U, Sieve.generate R ∈ SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1 U ∧
      ∀ ⦃V : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1⦄ (g : V ⟶ U), R g →
        ∃ P : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (chartSpace B S hS Y V).1
            (chartSpace B S hS Y V).2),
          (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS (chartSpace B S hS Y V).1
            (chartSpace B S hS Y V).2).IsPerfect P ∧
          Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.HasTorAmplitudeGE
            (smallEtaleDerivedTensorProduct B S hS (chartSpace B S hS Y V)) P 1 ∧
          Nonempty ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (chartToSpace B S hS Y V)
              (isEtale_chartToSpace B S hS Y V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((derivedModulePushforward B S hS f).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (structureModule X))) ≅
            (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (chartToSpace B S hS Y V)
              (isEtale_chartToSpace B S hS Y V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (structureModule Y)) ⊞ P)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_structureSharp_and_baseChange_of_bijective_algebraMap_fibre
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces which is proper, flat and of finite
presentation, such that `k = H⁰(X_k, 𝒪_{X_k})` for every morphism `Spec k ⟶ Y` with `k` a field.
Then `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_Y` — the structure map `𝒪_Y ⟶ f_*𝒪_X` is an isomorphism — and this holds after
any base change `Y' ⟶ Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_structureSharp_and_baseChange_of_bijective_algebraMap_fibre (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (h : ∀ p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS Y.1, Function.Bijective (algebraMap p.carrier
      (globalFunctions B (Spec (.of p.carrier)) p.contained
        (fibreOverFieldValuedPoint B S hS f.hom p)))) :
    IsIso (structureSharp B S hS f) ∧
      ∀ (Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (g : Y' ⟶ Y),
        IsIso (structureSharp B S hS (pullback.snd f g))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeDualizingComplex.baseChange_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E6C.** Let `g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g` be a cartesian square of algebraic spaces over `S`
with `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite presentation, and let `(ω, τ)` be a relative
dualizing complex for `f`. Then `(L(g')^* ω, Lg^* τ)` is a relative dualizing complex for `f'`:
`L(g')^* ω` is `Y'`-perfect, and the map `τ' : Rf'_* L(g')^* ω ⟶ 𝒪_{Y'}` which is `Lg^* τ`
through the base change map has the base change property of Stacks 0E5X.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChange_spec :
    IsPerfectRelativeToCanonical.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B S hS f'
        ((isFlat_isStableUnderBaseChange B S hS).of_isPullback sq hfl)
        ((isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_isStableUnderBaseChange B S hS).of_isPullback sq
          hfp.1)
        ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS g').obj D.ω) ∧
      ∃ τ' : (derivedModulePushforward B S hS f').obj
          ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS g').obj D.ω) ⟶
            (derivedStructureSheaf B S hS Y'.1 Y'.2).obj,
        smallEtaleDerivedModuleBaseChangeMap B S hS f g f' g' sq.w D.ω ≫ τ' =
            (smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS g).map D.τ ≫
              (smallEtaleDerivedModulePullbackUnitIso (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) g).hom ∧
          ∀ ⦃X'' Y'' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f'' : X'' ⟶ Y'') (h : Y'' ⟶ Y')
            (g'' : X'' ⟶ X') (sq₂ : IsPullback g'' f'' f' h) (hY'' : IsAffineSpace B S hS Y''.1),
            IsAffineBaseChangePair hZ sq₂
              ((isFinitePresentation_isStableUnderBaseChange B S hS).of_isPullback sq hfp)
              hY'' ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS g').obj D.ω) τ'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.representedRightAdjointIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E6E.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be the morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated
representable algebraic spaces over `S` represented by a morphism `g : T' ⟶ T` of the big fppf
site, with underlying morphism of schemes `f_0 = g_0 : X_0 ⟶ Y_0`.  Let `a` be the right adjoint
of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` of Stacks 0E55 and `a_0` the right adjoint of
`Rf_{0,*} : D_QCoh(𝒪_{X_0}) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_{Y_0})` of Stacks 0A9E.  Then `a_0` and `a` correspond
under the equivalences `D_QCoh(𝒪_{X_0}) ≌ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, `D_QCoh(𝒪_{Y_0}) ≌ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` of
Stacks 071Q.
declarations.statement:
def representedRightAdjointIso :
    haveI : CompactSpace (B.inclusion.obj T'.left) :=
      compactSpace_of_isQuasiCompactSpace_yoneda_obj B S hS hXqc
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (B.inclusion.obj T'.left) :=
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_yoneda_iff_quasiSeparatedSpace B S hS hZ T').1 hXqs
    haveI : CompactSpace (B.inclusion.obj T.left) :=
      compactSpace_of_isQuasiCompactSpace_yoneda_obj B S hS hYqc
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (B.inclusion.obj T.left) :=
      (isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_yoneda_iff_quasiSeparatedSpace B S hS hZ T).1 hYqs
    haveI :=
      Stacks.Duality.DerivedPushforward.isLeftAdjoint_qcqsRestrictedDerivedPushforward_of_qcqs
        (B.inclusion.map g.left)
    haveI := isLeftAdjoint_quasicoherentDerivedPushforward hZ (representedSpaceMap B S hS g)
      hXqc hXqs hYqs
    (Stacks.Duality.DerivedPushforward.qcqsRestrictedDerivedPushforward
        (B.inclusion.map g.left)).rightAdjoint ⋙
        (representedDualityQuasicoherentDerivedEquivalence B S hS T').functor ≅
      (representedDualityQuasicoherentDerivedEquivalence B S hS T).functor ⋙
        (quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g)
          (representedSpaceMap_isQuasiCompact hZ g hXqc hYqs)
          (representedSpaceMap_isQuasiSeparated hZ g hXqs)).rightAdjoint

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.exists_etaleCovering_isPullback_isProjectiveMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Families of curves are étale locally H-projective schemes.** Let `X ⟶ S` be a family of
curves. Then there is an étale covering `{S_j ⟶ S}` (a family of étale morphisms of the site whose
images cover `S`) such that each `X_j = X ×_S S_j` is a scheme `Z` — a cartesian square of
algebraic spaces with `schemeSpace Z` at its corner — and `Z ⟶ S_j` is H-projective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCovering_isPullback_isProjectiveMorphism (X : CurveFamily B hZ) :
    ∃ (J : Type u) (U : J → BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ) (φ : ∀ j, U j ⟶ X.base),
      (∀ j, Etale ((𝒯).map (φ j))) ∧
      (∀ s : (𝒯).obj X.base, ∃ j, s ∈ Set.range ((𝒯).map (φ j))) ∧
      ∀ j, ∃ (Z : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ) (p : schemeSpace Z ⟶ X.total) (q : Z ⟶ U j),
        IsPullback p (schemeSpaceMap q) X.toBase (schemeSpaceMap (φ j)) ∧
        IsProjectiveMorphism ((𝒯).map q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesH01_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
There is an open substack `Curves^{h0,1} ⊂ Curves` of the stack of curves — the strictly full
subcategory of families with `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S` universally and fibres of dimension `1` is invariant
under isomorphism and its inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion —
such that
1. the classifying morphism of a family of curves `f : X → S` factors through `Curves^{h0,1}`
   exactly when `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, this holds after arbitrary base change, and the fibres of `f`
   have dimension `1`;
2. for a scheme `X` proper over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1`, the classifying morphism
   `Spec k → Curves` of `X` factors through `Curves^{h0,1}` exactly when `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k` and
   `dim(X) = 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesH01_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_over_field_iff :
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ)
          (CurveFamily.isOpenCurvesLocus_isH01CurveFamily (B := B) (hZ := hZ)).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ)
          (CurveFamily.isOpenCurvesLocus_isH01CurveFamily (B := B) (hZ := hZ)).prop_of_hom)) ∧
    (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        IsH01CurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))) ∧
    (∀ {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
      (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
      (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
      (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
      (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅
        curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g (flat_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW) hproper
          (locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW)
          (Space.isQuasiCompact_yoneda_map B integerBase hZ g inferInstance)
          ((Space.isSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance)
          ((Space.isQuasiSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance) hdim) →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        Function.Bijective ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW).appTop ∧
          topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) = 1))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesH01_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_properOverField_iff
declarations.doc:
`Curves^{h0,1}`, the strictly full subcategory of `Curves` of families of curves `f : X → S`
with `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, this holding after arbitrary base change, and whose fibres have dimension `1`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.IsH01CurveFamily`), is an open substack of `Curves`: it is closed under
isomorphisms and its inclusion `curvesSubstackInclusion` is representable by algebraic spaces and
an open immersion. Moreover
1. for a family of curves over a scheme `S = U`, classified by `y` (a morphism over `U` from the
   site of `U` to `Curves`), the classifying morphism factors through `Curves^{h0,1}` if and only
   if the family `y(U)` has `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, universally, and fibres of dimension `1`;
2. for a scheme `X = T` proper over a field `k` (the scheme of `W` being `Spec k`) with
   `dim(X) ≤ 1`, and `y` a classifying morphism `Spec(k) → Curves` of the attached family of
   curves, `y` factors through `Curves^{h0,1}` if and only if `k ⟶ H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)` is bijective and
   `dim(X) = 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesH01_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_properOverField_iff :
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isOpenCurvesLocus_isH01CurveFamily.prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isOpenCurvesLocus_isH01CurveFamily.prop_of_hom)) ∧
    (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        IsH01CurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))) ∧
    (∀ {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
      (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
      (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
      (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
      (y : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map W.hom →
      (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 W.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfProperOverFieldEqSpec B hZ g k hW hproper hdim) →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        Function.Bijective ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
            ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW).appTop) ∧
          topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) = 1))
declarations.comment: the open substack Curves^{h0,1} of Curves (closed under isomorphisms, inclusion representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion), with (1) for a family of curves f : X → S, the classifying morphism factors through it iff f_*O_X = O_S, universally, and the fibres have dimension 1, and (2) for a scheme X proper over a field k with dim(X) ≤ 1, the classifying morphism Spec(k) → Curves factors through it iff H^0(X, O_X) = k and dim(X) = 1. Unconditional: 0E0R at i = 0 and 0E6B (a) are proved, not assumed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily_of_hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E6J.** `Curves^{h0,1} ⊂ Curves^{CM,1}`: a family of curves `f : X ⟶ S` with
`f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, universally, and all of whose fibres have dimension one is Cohen–Macaulay of
relative dimension one.

At a point of `X` the family is the base change of the family over the spectrum of a field
representing the image point; that family is again of this kind, and is Cohen–Macaulay of
relative dimension one by Tag 0BY5
(`AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily_of_base_eq_spec`). Both properties at a
point are read off a base change along the cartesian square (Tags 0E10 and 04NS).
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.isCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily_of_hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions
    (X : CurveFamily B hZ) (hΓ : HasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions B hZ X)
    (hdim : ∀ y, Space.fiberDimension B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom y = 1) :
    IsCohenMacaulayDimOneFamily B hZ X
declarations.comment: the objects of Curves^{h0,1} (f_*O_X = O_S universally and fibres of dimension 1) lie in Curves^{CM,1} (Cohen-Macaulay of relative dimension 1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGenus_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_decomposition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E6K.** There is a decomposition into open and closed substacks
`Curves^{h0,1} = ∐_{g ≥ 0} Curves_g`, where
(1) the classifying morphism of a family of curves `f : X → S` factors through `Curves_g` exactly
when `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, this holds after arbitrary base change, the fibres of `f` have dimension `1`,
and `R¹f_*𝒪_X` is a locally free `𝒪_S`-module of rank `g`; and
(2) for a scheme `X` proper over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1`, the classifying morphism
`Spec(k) → Curves` factors through `Curves_g` exactly when `dim(X) = 1`, `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)` and the
genus of `X` is `g`.

In the statement: `Curves^{h0,1}` and each `Curves_g` are open substacks of `Curves` (strictly full
subcategories whose inclusions are representable by algebraic spaces and open immersions), each
`Curves_g` lies in `Curves^{h0,1}`, parts (1) and (2) are the factorization criteria, and the
decomposition is read on every family `G` over a scheme `S` in `Curves^{h0,1}`: the loci in `|S|`
of the `Curves_g` are open and closed, pairwise disjoint and cover `|S|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesGenus_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_decomposition :
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isOpenCurvesLocus_isH01CurveFamily.prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isOpenCurvesLocus_isH01CurveFamily.prop_of_hom)) ∧
    (∀ g : ℕ,
      (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g) ∧
        Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
          (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g)
            (isGenusCurveFamily_of_hom g)).hom ∧
        Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g)
            (isGenusCurveFamily_of_hom g))) ∧
      (∀ X : CurveFamily B hZ, IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g X → IsH01CurveFamily B hZ X) ∧
      (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
        (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
        y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
        ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
            ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g),
            z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g) = y) ↔
          IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))) ∧
      (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
        (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
        (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
        (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
        y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
        (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) →
        ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
            ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g),
            z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g) = y) ↔
          (topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧ Function.Bijective X.hom.appTop) ∧
            genus X.hom = g))) ∧
    ∀ G : CurveFamily B hZ, IsH01CurveFamily B hZ G →
      ∃ Ω : ℕ → Set (Space.points B integerBase hZ (schemeSpace G.base).obj),
        (∀ g, IsOpen (Ω g) ∧ IsClosed (Ω g)) ∧ Pairwise (fun g g' => Disjoint (Ω g) (Ω g')) ∧
          (⋃ g, Ω g) = Set.univ ∧
          ∀ (g : ℕ) (F : CurveFamily B hZ) (a : F ⟶ G),
            IsGenusCurveFamily B hZ g F ↔
              Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ (schemeSpace F.base).obj
                (schemeSpaceMap a.baseMap).hom) ⊆ Ω g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesGrc1_le_curvesH01_isOpenSubstack_and_firstHigherDirectImage
declarations.doc:
`Curves^{grc,1}` and `Curves^{h0,1}` are open substacks of `Curves` (each is closed under
isomorphisms, and its inclusion into `Curves` is representable by algebraic spaces and an open
immersion), and `Curves^{grc,1} ⊂ Curves^{h0,1}`. In particular, for a family of curves `f : X → S`
whose geometric fibres are reduced, connected and of dimension `1`, `R¹f_*𝒪_X` is a finite locally
free `𝒪_S`-module whose formation commutes with arbitrary base change: for every morphism
`h : S' → S` of base schemes, `h^*(R¹f_*𝒪_X) ≅ R¹f'_*𝒪_{X'}` where `f' : X' → S'` is the base
change.

The conclusions are stated for the defining properties of the substacks:
`IsGrc1CurveFamily` and `IsH01CurveFamily`, the strictly full subcategories of `Curves` they
cut out, and `curvesSubstackInclusion` their inclusions.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesGrc1_le_curvesH01_isOpenSubstack_and_firstHigherDirectImage :
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ)
          isOpenCurvesLocus_isGrc1CurveFamily.prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ)
          isOpenCurvesLocus_isGrc1CurveFamily.prop_of_hom)) ∧
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isOpenCurvesLocus_isH01CurveFamily.prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsH01CurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isOpenCurvesLocus_isH01CurveFamily.prop_of_hom)) ∧
    IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ ≤ IsH01CurveFamily B hZ ∧
    ∀ X : CurveFamily B hZ, IsGrc1CurveFamily B hZ X →
      X.HasFiniteLocallyFreeFirstHigherDirectImage ∧
        X.FirstHigherDirectImageCommutesWithBaseChange

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_gorensteinDimOne
declarations.doc:
**`Curves^{Gorenstein,1}` is open in `Curves`.** The inclusion into the category fibred in
groupoids of families of curves of the full subcategory `Curves^{Gorenstein,1}` of the families
which are Gorenstein of relative dimension one is representable by algebraic spaces and an open
immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_gorensteinDimOne :
    Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGorensteinDimOneFamily B hZ)
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_isGorensteinDimOneFamily B hZ
            (isOpenCurvesLocus_isGorensteinFamily_and_over_field_iff B hZ)).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsGorensteinDimOneFamily B hZ)
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_isGorensteinDimOneFamily B hZ
            (isOpenCurvesLocus_isGorensteinFamily_and_over_field_iff B hZ)).prop_of_hom)
declarations.comment: the inclusion of Curves^{Gorenstein,1} into Curves is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_gorensteinDimOne_iff
declarations.doc:
Let `X → S` be a family of curves and `z : (Sch/S) → Curves` a classifying morphism for it, a
scheme-valued point together with an isomorphism `z(S) ≅ X`. Then `z` factors through
`Curves^{Gorenstein,1}`, over the site and up to a 2-isomorphism, if and only if `X → S` is
Gorenstein and has relative dimension one.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_gorensteinDimOne_iff
    (S : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (z : BigFppfOver B S.left.1 S.left.2 ⥤ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.p = Over.map S.hom)
    (X : CurveFamily B hZ) (ξ : z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 S.left)) ≅ X) :
    (∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map S.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          Stack.objectPropertySubcategory B integerBase hZ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val
            (IsGorensteinDimOneFamily B hZ),
        Nonempty (g.comp (Stack.objectPropertyInclusion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsGorensteinDimOneFamily B hZ)) ≅
            { toFunctor := z, w := hz })) ↔
      Space.IsGorenstein B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom ∧
        Space.HasRelativeDimension 1 B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_gorensteinDimOne_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
Let `g : T ⟶ W` be a morphism of the big fppf site of the integers whose target scheme is the
spectrum of a field `k`, whose underlying morphism of schemes is proper, and whose source scheme
`X` has dimension at most one, and let `z : (Sch/Spec(k)) → Curves` classify the family of curves
of `g`. Then `z` factors through `Curves^{Gorenstein,1}` if and only if `X` is Gorenstein and
equidimensional of dimension one, every irreducible component of it having dimension one.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_gorensteinDimOne_over_field_iff
    {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
    (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
    (z : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.p = Over.map W.hom)
    (ξ : z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 W.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g
      (flat_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW) hproper
      (locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW)
      (Space.isQuasiCompact_yoneda_map B integerBase hZ g inferInstance)
      ((Space.isSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance)
      ((Space.isQuasiSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance) hdim) :
    (∃ q : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          Stack.objectPropertySubcategory B integerBase hZ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val
            (IsGorensteinDimOneFamily B hZ),
        Nonempty (q.comp (Stack.objectPropertyInclusion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsGorensteinDimOneFamily B hZ)) ≅
            { toFunctor := z, w := hz })) ↔
      (IsGorenstein ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ∧
        TopologicalSpace.Equidimensional ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ∧
        ∀ C ∈ irreducibleComponents ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T),
          topologicalKrullDim C = (1 : WithBot ℕ∞))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.exists_iso_shift_relativeDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a family of curves with Cohen–Macaulay fibres equidimensional of
dimension one (Stacks 0E1F: `f` is Cohen–Macaulay in the sense of Stacks 0E0V and has relative
dimension one in the sense of part (2) of Stacks 06LR), and let `(ω^•_{X/S}, τ)` be a relative
dualizing complex of `f` (Stacks 0E5X). Then `ω^•_{X/S} = ω_{X/S}[1]` for a pseudo-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module `ω_{X/S}` flat over `S` whose formation commutes with arbitrary base change: for
every morphism of families of curves `X' ⟶ X` over `S' ⟶ S` (a cartesian square), every relative
dualizing complex of `X'/S'` is `(g'^*ω_{X/S})[1]`, `g' : X' ⟶ X` the projection.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.exists_iso_shift_relativeDualizingComplex (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hcm : Space.IsCohenMacaulay B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom)
    (hdim : Space.HasRelativeDimension 1 B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom)
    (D : RelativeDualizingComplex B.contains_terminal X.toBase X.proper X.flat
      X.finitePresentation) :
    ∃ F : Space.Modules.{u, u} B integerBase hZ X.total.1 X.total.2,
      Nonempty (D.ω ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ∧
      (Space.smallEtaleRingedSite B integerBase hZ X.total.1 X.total.2).IsPseudoCoherent
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F) ∧
      Space.IsFlatOver B integerBase hZ X.total.2 X.toBase.hom F ∧
      ∀ {X' : CurveFamily B hZ} (φ : X' ⟶ X)
        (D' : RelativeDualizingComplex B.contains_terminal X'.toBase X'.proper X'.flat
          X'.finitePresentation),
        Nonempty (D'.ω ≅ (smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B integerBase hZ φ.totalMap).obj
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)) ∧
        Nonempty ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B integerBase hZ φ.totalMap).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B integerBase hZ X.total))
                0).obj F) ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B integerBase hZ X'.total)) 0).obj
            ((modulePullback B integerBase hZ φ.totalMap).obj F))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.relativeDualizingSheaf
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a family of curves and `(ω^•_{X/S}, τ)` its relative dualizing complex
(Stacks 0E5X). The *relative dualizing sheaf* of `f` is the `𝒪_X`-module
`ω_{X/S} = H^{-1}(ω^•_{X/S})`. For a Cohen–Macaulay family of relative dimension one it is the
pseudo-coherent module flat over `S` of Stacks 0E6P, with `ω^•_{X/S} = ω_{X/S}[1]`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.exists_iso_shift_relativeDualizingComplex`).
declarations.statement:
def CurveFamily.relativeDualizingSheaf (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (D : RelativeDualizingComplex B.contains_terminal X.toBase X.proper X.flat
      X.finitePresentation) :
    Space.Modules.{u, u} B integerBase hZ X.total.1 X.total.2

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isInvertibleModule_relativeDualizingSheaf
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a family of curves with Gorenstein fibres equidimensional of dimension
one (`Curves^{Gorenstein, 1}` of Stacks 0E6M: `f` is Gorenstein in the sense of Stacks 0E14 and
has relative dimension one in the sense of part (2) of Stacks 06LR), and let `(ω^•_{X/S}, τ)` be
a relative dualizing complex (Stacks 0E5X). Then the relative dualizing sheaf
`ω_{X/S} = H^{-1}(ω^•_{X/S})` (Stacks 0E6Q) is an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and its formation
commutes with arbitrary base change: for every morphism of families of curves `X' ⟶ X` over
`S' ⟶ S` (a cartesian square) and every relative dualizing complex of `X'/S'`, the relative
dualizing sheaf of `X'/S'` is the pullback of `ω_{X/S}` along the projection `g' : X' ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.isInvertibleModule_relativeDualizingSheaf (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hX : IsGorensteinDimOneFamily B hZ X)
    (D : RelativeDualizingComplex B.contains_terminal X.toBase X.proper X.flat
      X.finitePresentation) :
    Space.IsInvertibleModule X.total (X.relativeDualizingSheaf D) ∧
      ∀ {X' : CurveFamily B hZ} (φ : X' ⟶ X)
        (D' : RelativeDualizingComplex B.contains_terminal X'.toBase X'.proper X'.flat
          X'.finitePresentation),
        Nonempty (X'.relativeDualizingSheaf D' ≅
          (modulePullback B integerBase hZ φ.totalMap).obj (X.relativeDualizingSheaf D))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsPrestableCurveFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E6T.** A family of curves is *prestable* when its structure morphism is
at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one and the direct image of its structure sheaf is the
structure sheaf of the base, universally.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsPrestableCurveFamily (X : CurveFamily B hZ) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_curvesPrestable_iff
declarations.doc:
The classifying morphism of a family of curves `X ⟶ S` factors through the strictly full
subcategory `Curves^{prestable}` of prestable families (Stacks 0E6T) exactly when `X ⟶ S` is
prestable: a scheme-valued point `y` of `Curves` over `U` lifts to `Curves^{prestable}` exactly
when the family `y(U)` it classifies is prestable.
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_curvesPrestable_iff (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom) :
    (∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ),
        z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
      IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)))
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_curvesPrestable_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a proper scheme over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1` (with `Spec k` in the site, so
that its classifying morphism `Spec k ⟶ Curves` exists). The classifying morphism of `X` factors
through `Curves^{prestable}` exactly when the singularities of `X` are at-worst-nodal,
`dim(X) = 1` and `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_curvesPrestable_over_field_iff
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
    (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom)
    (e : y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) :
    (∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ),
        z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
      ((letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩;
        Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left) ∧
        topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧ IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesPrestable_isOpenSubstack
declarations.doc:
`Curves^{prestable}`, the strictly full subcategory of prestable families of curves
(Stacks 0E6T), is an open substack of `Curves`: prestability is invariant under isomorphism, and
the inclusion `Curves^{prestable} ⟶ Curves` is representable by algebraic spaces and an open
immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesPrestable_isOpenSubstack :
    ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isPrestableCurveFamily_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isPrestableCurveFamily_of_hom)
declarations.comment: the open substack Curves^{prestable} of Curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesPrestable_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff
declarations.doc:
There is an open substack `Curves^{prestable} ⊂ Curves` — the strictly full subcategory of
prestable families of curves, whose inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces and an open
immersion — such that

1. the classifying morphism of a family of curves `X ⟶ S` factors through it exactly when
   `X ⟶ S` is a prestable family of curves, and
2. for a scheme `X` proper over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1`, the classifying morphism
   `Spec k ⟶ Curves` of `X` factors through it exactly when the singularities of `X` are
   at-worst-nodal, `dim(X) = 1` and `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesPrestable_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff :
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isPrestableCurveFamily_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isPrestableCurveFamily_of_hom)) ∧
    (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
      (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
      (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        ((letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩;
          Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left) ∧
          topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧
          IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop))))
declarations.comment: the whole statement: the open substack Curves^{prestable} and parts (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesPrestableGenus_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_decomposition_and_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E6V.** There is a decomposition
`Curves^{prestable} = ∐_{g ≥ 0} Curves^{prestable}_g` into open and closed substacks, where
1. the classifying morphism of a family of curves `f : X → S` factors through
   `Curves^{prestable}_g` exactly when `f` is a prestable family of curves and `R¹f_*𝒪_X` is a
   locally free `𝒪_S`-module of rank `g`;
2. for a scheme `X` proper over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1` (a proper morphism `p : T ⟶ W` of
   the site with `W = Spec k`), the classifying morphism `Spec k → Curves` of `X` factors through
   `Curves^{prestable}_g` exactly when the singularities of `X` are at-worst-nodal, `dim(X) = 1`,
   `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)` and the genus of `X` is `g`.

Each `Curves^{prestable}_g` is an open substack of `Curves` contained in `Curves^{prestable}`
(the first conjunct, with the second), and over every scheme-valued point of
`Curves^{prestable}` — a prestable family `G` over a scheme `S` — the loci `Ω_g ⊂ S` of the
`Curves^{prestable}_g` are open and closed, pairwise disjoint and cover `S`, a family mapping to
`G` lying in `Curves^{prestable}_g` exactly when its base maps into `Ω_g` (the third conjunct):
this is the decomposition into open and closed substacks.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesPrestableGenus_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_decomposition_and_over_field_iff :
    (∀ g : ℕ,
      (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsPrestableGenusCurveFamily B hZ g) ∧
        Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
          (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsPrestableGenusCurveFamily B hZ g)
            (isOpenCurvesLocus_isPrestableGenusCurveFamily g).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
        Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsPrestableGenusCurveFamily B hZ g)
            (isOpenCurvesLocus_isPrestableGenusCurveFamily g).prop_of_hom)) ∧
      (∀ X : CurveFamily B hZ, IsPrestableGenusCurveFamily B hZ g X →
        IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ X) ∧
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
        (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
        y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
        ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
            ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsPrestableGenusCurveFamily B hZ g),
            z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsPrestableGenusCurveFamily B hZ g) = y) ↔
          IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))) ∧
            RingedSite.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
              (Space.smallEtaleRingedSite B integerBase hZ
                (schemeSpace (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))).base).1
                (schemeSpace (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))).base).2)
              ((y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))).firstDirectImage B hZ) g)) ∧
    (∀ G : CurveFamily B hZ, IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ G →
      ∃ Ω : ℕ → Set (Space.points B integerBase hZ (schemeSpace G.base).obj),
        (∀ g, IsOpen (Ω g) ∧ IsClosed (Ω g)) ∧ Pairwise (fun g g' => Disjoint (Ω g) (Ω g')) ∧
          (⋃ g, Ω g) = Set.univ ∧
          ∀ (g : ℕ) (F : CurveFamily B hZ) (a : F ⟶ G),
            IsPrestableGenusCurveFamily B hZ g F ↔
              Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ (schemeSpace F.base).obj
                (schemeSpaceMap a.baseMap).hom) ⊆ Ω g) ∧
    (∀ (g : ℕ) (k : Type u) [Field k] {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (p : T ⟶ W)
      (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
      (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map p))
      (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
      (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOverFieldOfProper B hZ p k hW hproper hdim) →
      letI : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T).Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
        ⟨(BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map p ≫ eqToHom hW⟩
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsPrestableGenusCurveFamily B hZ g),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsPrestableGenusCurveFamily B hZ g) = y) ↔
        (Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k
            ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ∧
          topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) = 1 ∧
          Function.Bijective
            ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map p ≫ eqToHom hW).appTop ∧
          genus ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map p ≫ eqToHom hW) = g)))

theorem isSmoothOverIntegers_curvesPrestable :

theorem isSmoothOverIntegers_curvesPrestableOfGenus (g : ℕ) :

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.hasNoRationalTailFibre_iff_isCounitSurjectiveAbove
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X → S` be a prestable family of curves of genus `g ≥ 1`, with relative dualizing
complex `ω^•_{X/S}` and relative dualizing sheaf `ω_{X/S} = H^{-1}(ω^•_{X/S})`. Let `s ∈ S` and
`m ≥ 2`. The fibre `X_s` has no rational tail if and only if `f^*f_*ω_{X/S}^{⊗ m} ⟶ ω_{X/S}^{⊗ m}`
is surjective over `f⁻¹(U)` for some open `U ∋ s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasNoRationalTailFibre_iff_isCounitSurjectiveAbove (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hX : IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ X) {g : ℕ} (hg : X.HasGenus B hZ g) (hg1 : 1 ≤ g)
    (D : Space.RelativeDualizingComplex B.contains_terminal X.toBase X.proper X.flat
      X.finitePresentation)
    (s : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj X.base) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    X.HasNoRationalTailFibre B hZ (X.residueFieldPoint s) ↔
      X.IsCounitSurjectiveAbove
        (@Space.invertibleTensorPower B integerBase hZ X.total.1 X.total.2
          (X.dualizingSheafOfComplex D) (isInvertible_dualizingSheafOfComplex hX D) m) s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsSemistableCurveFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E6Z.** A family of curves is *semistable* when it is prestable and, for every
point of the base, its fibre there has genus at least one and no rational tail.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSemistableCurveFamily (X : CurveFamily B hZ) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesSemistable_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff
declarations.doc:
There is an open substack `Curves^{semistable} ⊂ Curves` — the strictly full subcategory of
semistable families of curves (Stacks 0E6Z), whose inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces
and an open immersion — such that

1. the classifying morphism of a family of curves `X ⟶ S` factors through it exactly when
   `X ⟶ S` is a semistable family of curves, and
2. for a scheme `X` proper over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1` (with `Spec k` in the site, so that
   its classifying morphism `Spec k ⟶ Curves` exists), the classifying morphism of `X` factors
   through it (a) exactly when (b) the singularities of `X` are at-worst-nodal, `dim(X) = 1`,
   `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`, the genus of `X` is at least one and `X` has no rational tail, and (a)
   exactly when (c) the singularities of `X` are at-worst-nodal, `dim(X) = 1`,
   `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)` and `ω_X^{⊗ m}` is globally generated for every `m ≥ 2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesSemistable_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff :
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ)
          (CurveFamily.isSemistableCurveFamily_of_hom B hZ)).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ)
          (CurveFamily.isSemistableCurveFamily_of_hom B hZ))) ∧
    (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
      (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
      (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
        Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧
          IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) ∧ 1 ≤ genus X.hom ∧
            ∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X.left C) ∧
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
        haveI : IsProper (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := inferInstanceAs (IsProper X.hom)
        ∃ (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left)
          (hdim1 : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
          (hΓ : IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop)),
          haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop) := hΓ
          haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))
          letI := isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left
            hdim1 hnodal
          ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections
            (tensorPower X.left.presheaf X.left.ringCatSheaf.2
              (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))) m)))
declarations.comment: the whole statement: the open substack Curves^{semistable} and parts (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesSemistableOfGenus_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff
declarations.doc:
For every `g`, `Curves^{semistable}_g` is an open substack of `Curves` contained in
`Curves^{semistable}`: its inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion.
Part (1): the classifying morphism of a family of curves `f : X → S` factors through
`Curves^{semistable}_g` exactly when `f` is semistable and `R¹f_*𝒪_X` is a locally free
`𝒪_S`-module of rank `g`. Over every semistable family with base `S`, the loci of the
`Curves^{semistable}_g` are open and closed subsets of `S`, pairwise disjoint, empty for `g = 0`
and covering `S` for `g ≥ 1`: so `Curves^{semistable} = ∐_{g ≥ 1} Curves^{semistable}_g` as open
and closed substacks.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesSemistableOfGenus_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff :
    (∀ g : ℕ,
      ((show ObjectProperty (CurveFamily B hZ) from
          IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧
        Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
          (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g)
            (isOpenCurvesLocus_isSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus
              (isOpenCurvesLocus_isSemistableCurveFamily_of
                (isOpenCurvesLocus_hasBijectiveGlobalFunctionsOnFieldFibres_of
                  (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
                (hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions_of (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
                (prestableSemistableFibresOpen B hZ))
              (prestableGenusLociOpen_of (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ)) g).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
        Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g)
            (isOpenCurvesLocus_isSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus
              (isOpenCurvesLocus_isSemistableCurveFamily_of
                (isOpenCurvesLocus_hasBijectiveGlobalFunctionsOnFieldFibres_of
                  (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
                (hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions_of (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
                (prestableSemistableFibresOpen B hZ))
              (prestableGenusLociOpen_of (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ)) g).prop_of_hom)) ∧
      (∀ X : CurveFamily B hZ,
        IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g X → IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ X) ∧
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
        (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
        y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
        ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
            ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g),
            z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g) = y) ↔
          IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))) ∧
            CurveFamily.HasGenus B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))) g)) ∧
    ∀ G : CurveFamily B hZ, IsSemistableCurveFamily B hZ G →
      ∃ Ω : ℕ → Set ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj G.base),
        (∀ g, IsOpen (Ω g) ∧ IsClosed (Ω g)) ∧ Pairwise (fun g g' => Disjoint (Ω g) (Ω g')) ∧
          Ω 0 = ∅ ∧ ⋃ (g : ℕ) (_ : 1 ≤ g), Ω g = Set.univ ∧
          ∀ (g : ℕ) (F : CurveFamily B hZ) (a : F ⟶ G),
            IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g F ↔
              Set.range ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map a.baseMap) ⊆ Ω g
declarations.comment: the decomposition Curves^{semistable} = ∐_{g ≥ 1} Curves^{semistable}_g into open and closed substacks, and part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_curvesSemistableOfGenus_over_field_iff_noRationalTail_and_globallyGenerated
declarations.doc:
Let `g ≥ 1` and let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension at most one over a field `k` (with
`Spec k` in the site, so that the classifying morphism `Spec k ⟶ Curves` of `X` exists). The
classifying morphism of `X` factors through `Curves^{semistable}_g` (a) exactly when (b) the
singularities of `X` are at-worst-nodal, `dim X = 1`, `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`, the genus of `X` is `g`
and `X` has no rational tail, and (a) exactly when (c) the singularities of `X` are
at-worst-nodal, `dim X = 1`, `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`, the genus of `X` is `g` and `ω_X^{⊗m}` is globally
generated for every `m ≥ 2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_curvesSemistableOfGenus_over_field_iff_noRationalTail_and_globallyGenerated
    {g : ℕ} (hg : 1 ≤ g)
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom]
    (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k))) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
    (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ) (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom)
    (e : y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) :
    ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g),
        z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g) = y) ↔
      letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
      Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧
        IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) ∧ genus X.hom = g ∧
          ∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X.left C) ∧
    ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g),
        z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g) = y) ↔
      letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
      haveI : IsProper (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := inferInstanceAs (IsProper X.hom)
      ∃ (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left)
        (hdim1 : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
        (hΓ : IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop)),
        haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop) := hΓ
        haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))
        letI := isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left
          hdim1 hnodal
        genus X.hom = g ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections
          (tensorPower X.left.presheaf X.left.ringCatSheaf.2
            (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))) m))
declarations.comment: part (2): (a) ⇔ (b) and (a) ⇔ (c), for a proper scheme of dimension at most one over a field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSmoothOverIntegers_curvesSemistable_and_curvesSemistableOfGenus
declarations.doc:
The morphisms `Curves^{semistable} → Spec(ℤ)` and, for every `g`,
`Curves^{semistable}_g → Spec(ℤ)` are smooth. Here `Curves^{semistable}` and
`Curves^{semistable}_g` are the open substacks of the algebraic stack of curves (Stacks 0D5A) of
the semistable families and of the semistable families with all fibres of genus `g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmoothOverIntegers_curvesSemistable_and_curvesSemistableOfGenus :
    IsSmoothOverIntegers B hZ (isAlgebraicStack_curvesFiberedCategory.{u, w} B hZ)
        (isOpenCurvesLocus_isSemistableCurveFamily_of
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_hasBijectiveGlobalFunctionsOnFieldFibres_of
            (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
          (hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions_of (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
          (prestableSemistableFibresOpen B hZ)) ∧
      ∀ g : ℕ, IsSmoothOverIntegers B hZ (isAlgebraicStack_curvesFiberedCategory.{u, w} B hZ)
        (isOpenCurvesLocus_isSemistableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_isSemistableCurveFamily_of
            (isOpenCurvesLocus_hasBijectiveGlobalFunctionsOnFieldFibres_of
              (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
            (hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions_of (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
            (prestableSemistableFibresOpen B hZ))
          (prestableGenusLociOpen_of (hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ)) g)
declarations.comment: both morphisms Curves^{semistable} → Spec(ℤ) and Curves^{semistable}_g → Spec(ℤ), for every g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.hasNoRationalTailNoRationalBridge_iff_exists_isAffineOpen_isRelativelyAmple
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X → S` be a prestable family of curves of genus `g ≥ 2` (genus `g` read as in
Stacks 0E6V: `R¹f_*𝒪_X` finite locally free of rank `g`) and let `s ∈ S`. The following are
equivalent:

1. the fibre `X_s` has no rational tail and no rational bridge (Stacks 0E3H, 0E3M); the fibre is
   presented by a scheme `V` of the site with a cartesian square over `Spec κ(s) → S`, as in
   Stacks 0E75;
2. for some affine open `U ∋ s`, the relative dualizing sheaf `ω_{f⁻¹(U)/U}`
   (`AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.relativeDualizingSheafOver`) is ample on `f⁻¹(U)` relative to
   `U`, for every presentation `X₁ = f⁻¹(U)` of the restricted family by a cartesian square.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasNoRationalTailNoRationalBridge_iff_exists_isAffineOpen_isRelativelyAmple
    (X : CurveFamily B hZ) (hX : IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ X) (g : ℕ)
    (hgen : CurveFamily.HasGenus B hZ X g) (hg : 2 ≤ g)
    (s : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj X.base) :
    (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ) (v : V ⟶ X.residuePoint B hZ s)
        (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ X.total.obj),
        X.IsFibrePresentation B hZ s v q ∧
          HasNoRationalTailNoRationalBridge
            (((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj X.base).residueField s)
            (X.fibreMap B hZ s v)) ↔
      ∃ U : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj X.base).Opens,
        ∃ hU : IsAffineOpen U, s ∈ U ∧
        ∀ ⦃X₁ : AlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ⦄ (p₁ : X₁ ⟶ X.total)
          (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ schemeSpace (Space.openSub X.base U))
          (h : IsPullback p₁ f₁ X.toBase (schemeSpaceMap (Space.openSubHom X.base U))),
            Space.IsRelativelyAmple B integerBase hZ f₁ (X.relativeDualizingSheafOver hU h)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsStableCurveFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E75.** A family of curves is *stable* when it is prestable and, for every point
of the base, its fibre there has genus at least two and has neither a rational tail nor a
rational bridge.

The constituents. The family is an `AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily`: flat, proper, of finite
presentation and of relative dimension at most one, from an algebraic space to a scheme of the
site. Prestability is `AlgebraicGeometry.IsPrestableCurveFamily`. A point of the base is an
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FieldValuedPoint`, a field `p.carrier` together with a morphism from
its spectrum to the base, and the `CategoryTheory.IsPullback` clause exhibits the scheme `V` of
the site as the fibre of the family over that point. The conditions on the fibre are collected
in `AlgebraicGeometry.HasGenusTwoNoRationalTailNoRationalBridge`: its
`AlgebraicGeometry.genus` over `p.carrier` is at least two, no ideal sheaf of `V` satisfies
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsRationalTail`, and none satisfies
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsRationalBridge`.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsStableCurveFamily (X : CurveFamily B hZ) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesStable_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff
declarations.doc:
There is an open substack `Curves^{stable} ⊂ Curves` — the strictly full
subcategory of stable families of curves (Stacks 0E75), invariant under isomorphism, whose
inclusion into `Curves` is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion — such that

1. given a family of curves `f : X → U`, the classifying morphism `U → Curves` factors through
   `Curves^{stable}` if and only if `X → U` is a stable family of curves: a scheme-valued point
   `y` of `Curves` over `U` lifts to `Curves^{stable}` exactly when the family `y(U)` it
   classifies is stable;
2. given a scheme `X` proper over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1`, the following are equivalent:
   * (a) the classifying morphism `Spec(k) → Curves` of `X` factors through `Curves^{stable}`
     (every scheme-valued point `y` with `y(U) ≅ X` lifts);
   * (b) the singularities of `X` are at-worst-nodal, `dim(X) = 1`, `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`, the genus
     of `X` is at least two, and `X` has no rational tails and no rational bridges;
   * (c) the singularities of `X` are at-worst-nodal, `dim(X) = 1`, `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`, and the
     dualizing sheaf `ω_X` is ample.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesStable_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff :
    (ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsStableCurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsStableCurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isStableCurveFamily_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsStableCurveFamily B hZ)
          CurveFamily.isStableCurveFamily_of_hom)) ∧
    (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsStableCurveFamily B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsStableCurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
        IsStableCurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))) ∧
    ∀ {k : Type u} [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
      (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1),
      (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
        (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
        y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
        (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) →
        ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
            ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsStableCurveFamily B hZ),
            z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsStableCurveFamily B hZ) = y) ↔
          letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
          haveI : IsProper (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := inferInstanceAs (IsProper X.hom)
          Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧
            IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) ∧ 2 ≤ genus X.hom ∧
            (∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X.left C) ∧
            ∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalBridge k X.left C)) ∧
      ((letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
        haveI : IsProper (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := inferInstanceAs (IsProper X.hom)
        Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧
          IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) ∧ 2 ≤ genus X.hom ∧
          (∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X.left C) ∧
          ∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalBridge k X.left C) ↔
        letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
        haveI : IsProper (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := inferInstanceAs (IsProper X.hom)
        ∃ (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left)
          (hdim1 : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
          (hH0 : IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)),
            haveI := hH0
            haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))
            letI := isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left
              hdim1 hnodal
            Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X.left
              (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduliStableCurves
declarations.doc:
**The moduli stack `𝓜̄ = Curves^{stable}` of stable curves**: the substack of the stack of
curves of the families of curves which are stable (Stacks 0E75), as a category fibred in groupoids
over the big fppf site of `Spec(ℤ)`.
declarations.statement:
def moduliStableCurves :
    CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
declarations.comment: the moduli stack of stable curves, 𝓜̄ = Curves^{stable}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduliStableCurvesOfGenus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E77, `𝓜̄_g`.** The moduli stack `𝓜̄_g` of stable curves of genus `g`: the substack of
the stack of curves of the families `f : X → S` which are stable (Stacks 0E75) and whose fibre
over every point of `S` has genus `g`, as a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of
`Spec(ℤ)`. It lies in `𝓜̄ = AlgebraicGeometry.moduliStableCurves`, and its points are the stable
curves of genus `g` over fields, as in part (2) of Stacks 0E78.
declarations.statement:
def moduliStableCurvesOfGenus (g : ℕ) :
    CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
declarations.comment: the moduli stack of stable curves of genus g, 𝓜̄_g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduliStableCurves_decomposition_moduliStableCurvesOfGenus
declarations.doc:
**The decomposition of `𝓜̄` by the genus.** The moduli stack of stable curves decomposes into
open and closed substacks `𝓜̄ = ∐_{g ≥ 2} 𝓜̄_g` (`AlgebraicGeometry.moduliStableCurves`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.moduliStableCurvesOfGenus`), and:

* **Decomposition.** For every scheme-valued point of `𝓜̄`, that is every stable family of curves
  `G` over a scheme `S`, the loci `fibreGenusLocus G g` of the points of `S` whose fibre has genus
  `g` are open and closed in `S`; for `g ≥ 2` they are pairwise disjoint and cover `S`; and an
  object `F ⟶ G` of `𝓜̄` over `S` lies in `𝓜̄_g` exactly when its base lands in the locus of `g`.
  So `𝓜̄_g ×_{𝓜̄} S` is the open and closed subscheme of `S` on that locus.
* **(1)** Given a family of curves `f : X → U`, its classifying morphism `U → Curves` factors
  through `𝓜̄_g` if and only if `X → U` is a stable family of curves and `R¹f_*𝒪_X` is a locally
  free `𝒪_U`-module of rank `g`.
* **(2)** Given a proper scheme `X` over a field `k` with `dim(X) ≤ 1`, the following are
  equivalent: (a) the classifying morphism `Spec(k) → Curves` factors through `𝓜̄_g`; (b) the
  singularities of `X` are at-worst-nodal, `dim(X) = 1`, `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`, the genus of `X` is
  `g`, and `X` has no rational tails or bridges; (c) the singularities of `X` are at-worst-nodal,
  `dim(X) = 1`, `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`, the genus of `X` is `g`, and `ω_X` is ample.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduliStableCurves_decomposition_moduliStableCurvesOfGenus :
    (∀ G : CurveFamily B hZ, IsStableCurveFamily B hZ G →
      (∀ g : ℕ, IsClopen (CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g)) ∧
        Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint
          fun g : {g : ℕ // 2 ≤ g} => CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g) ∧
        ⋃ g : {g : ℕ // 2 ≤ g}, CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g = Set.univ ∧
        ∀ (g : ℕ) (F : CurveFamily B hZ) (a : F ⟶ G),
          (IsStableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g F ↔
            Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ (schemeSpace F.base).obj
              (schemeSpaceMap a.baseMap).hom) ⊆ CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g)) ∧
    (∀ (g : ℕ) (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsStableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsStableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g) = y) ↔
        IsStableCurveFamily B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))) ∧
          CurveFamily.HasGenus B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))) g)) ∧
    ∀ {g : ℕ} (_hg : 2 ≤ g) {k : Type u} [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
      (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1),
      (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
        (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
        y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
        (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) →
        ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
            ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsStableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g),
            z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsStableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g) = y) ↔
          letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
          haveI : IsProper (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := inferInstanceAs (IsProper X.hom)
          Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧
            IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) ∧ genus X.hom = g ∧
            (∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X.left C) ∧
            ∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalBridge k X.left C)) ∧
      ((letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
        haveI : IsProper (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := inferInstanceAs (IsProper X.hom)
        Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧
          IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) ∧ genus X.hom = g ∧
          (∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalTail k X.left C) ∧
          ∀ C : X.left.IdealSheafData, ¬ IsRationalBridge k X.left C) ↔
        letI : X.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨X.hom⟩
        haveI : IsProper (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := inferInstanceAs (IsProper X.hom)
        ∃ (hnodal : Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left)
          (hdim1 : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
          (hH0 : IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop)),
          genus X.hom = g ∧
            haveI := hH0
            haveI := connectedSpace_of_isIso_globalSections k (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))
            letI := isInvertible_dualizingSheafOverField_of_hasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X.left
              hdim1 hnodal
            Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X.left
              (Stacks.Duality.dualizingSheafOverField (X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))))
declarations.comment: the decomposition of the moduli stack of stable curves into the open and closed substacks of stable curves of genus g >= 2, read on the scheme-valued points of the moduli stack, together with parts (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSmoothOverIntegers_moduliStableCurves_and_moduliStableCurvesOfGenus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E79.** The morphisms `𝓜̄ → Spec(ℤ)` and, for every `g`, `𝓜̄_g → Spec(ℤ)` are smooth.
Here `𝓜̄` is the open substack of the algebraic stack of curves (Stacks 0D5A) of the stable
families (Stacks 0E76), and `𝓜̄_g` is its open substack of the stable families of genus `g`. The
second conjunct states smoothness of `𝓜̄_g` in both forms of its families: stable with `R¹f_*𝒪_X`
locally free of rank `g` (part (1) of Stacks 0E78, `AlgebraicGeometry.IsStableCurveFamilyOfGenus`),
and stable with every fibre of genus `g` (Stacks 0E77,
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsStableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus`); the two properties of families agree
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isStableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus_iff_isStableCurveFamilyOfGenus`),
so they cut out the same open substack. Both `𝓜̄` and `𝓜̄_g` are open substacks of
`Curves^{nodal}`, which is smooth over `Spec(ℤ)` (Stacks 0E00).

The statement assumes nothing beyond the site `B` containing `Spec(ℤ)`; the algebraicity
of `Curves` (Stacks 0D5A), its limit preservation (Stacks 0D55) and the openness of `𝓜̄` and
`𝓜̄_g` are all proved.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmoothOverIntegers_moduliStableCurves_and_moduliStableCurvesOfGenus :
    IsSmoothOverIntegers B hZ (isAlgebraicStack_curvesFiberedCategory.{u, w} B hZ)
        (isOpenCurvesLocus_isStableCurveFamily B hZ) ∧
      ∀ g : ℕ,
        IsSmoothOverIntegers B hZ (isAlgebraicStack_curvesFiberedCategory.{u, w} B hZ)
            (isOpenCurvesLocus_isStableCurveFamilyOfGenus_of_fibreGenus B hZ g) ∧
          IsSmoothOverIntegers B hZ (isAlgebraicStack_curvesFiberedCategory.{u, w} B hZ)
            (isOpenCurvesLocus_isStableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g)
declarations.comment: both morphisms: 𝓜̄ → Spec(ℤ) (first conjunct) and 𝓜̄_g → Spec(ℤ) for every g (second conjunct, for 𝓜̄_g cut out by R¹f_*𝒪_X locally free of rank g as in 0E78 (1), and by all fibres of genus g as in 0E77) are smooth

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesSmall.moduliStableCurves_isOpenSubstack_curvesDM
declarations.doc:
The stacks `𝓜̄` and `𝓜̄_g` are open substacks of `Curves^{DM}`; in particular they are DM
(Stacks 050D) and Deligne–Mumford stacks (Stacks 03YO).

In the statement, `Curves` is the algebraic stack `AlgebraicGeometry.curvesAlgebraicStack` (the
small model of the stack of curves, equivalent over the site to the category of families of
curves through `AlgebraicGeometry.curvesSmallEquivalence`), algebraic by Stacks 0D5A
(`AlgebraicGeometry.curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack`). `W` is `Curves^{DM}`: the open
substack whose objects are those of the Deligne–Mumford locus `Stack.dmLocus` (Stacks 0DSW), and
it is DM. `M` is `𝓜̄`: an open substack of `Curves` whose objects are exactly the stable families
of curves (Stacks 0E75), the families of `AlgebraicGeometry.moduliStableCurves`; `M_g` is `𝓜̄_g`:
an open substack whose objects are exactly the stable families whose fibre over every point has
genus `g`, the families of `AlgebraicGeometry.moduliStableCurvesOfGenus` (Stacks 0E77, 0E78).
Both are contained in `W` (an open substack of `Curves` contained in the open substack `W` is an
open substack of `W`), DM, and Deligne–Mumford stacks.

The statement holds for every `g`, not only in the range `g ≥ 2` of Stacks 0E77.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduliStableCurves_isOpenSubstack_curvesDM (g : ℕ) :
    ∃ W M Mg : Stack.OpenSubstack
        (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)),
      (W.property =
          Stack.dmLocus B integerBase hZ B.contains_terminal
            (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)) ∧
        Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyDM B integerBase hZ B.contains_terminal
          W.toAlgebraicStack) ∧
      ((∀ F : CurveFamily B hZ,
          M.property ((curvesSmallEquivalence B hZ
            (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).functor.obj F) ↔
            IsStableCurveFamily B hZ F) ∧
        M.property ≤ W.property ∧
        Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyDM B integerBase hZ B.contains_terminal
          M.toAlgebraicStack ∧
        Stack.IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B integerBase hZ M.toAlgebraicStack.val.val) ∧
      ((∀ F : CurveFamily B hZ,
          Mg.property ((curvesSmallEquivalence B hZ
            (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).functor.obj F) ↔
            IsStableCurveFamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g F) ∧
        Mg.property ≤ W.property ∧
        Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyDM B integerBase hZ B.contains_terminal
          Mg.toAlgebraicStack ∧
        Stack.IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B integerBase hZ Mg.toAlgebraicStack.val.val)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_contraction
declarations.doc:
Let `F` be a family of curves (Stacks 0D4Z) over a scheme `S` of the site, `s ∈ S`, `X₀` the
fibre of `F` over `s` (the cartesian square `ι` over `Spec κ(s) ⟶ S`; the fibre of a family of
curves over a field is a scheme, Stacks 0ADD), and `h₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀` a morphism over `κ(s)` to a
proper scheme `Y₀` over `κ(s)` with `𝒪_{Y₀} = h₀,*𝒪_{X₀}` and `R¹h₀,*𝒪_{X₀} = 0`. Then there are an
elementary étale neighbourhood `(U, u)` of `(S, s)`, with the lift `t : Spec κ(s) ⟶ U` of `s` onto
`u` which identifies `κ(u)` with `κ(s)`, a family of curves `G` over `U` and a morphism `h` over
`U` from the total space of the base change `F_U` to that of `G` whose fibre in `u` is isomorphic
to `h₀`: `X₀` and `Y₀` are the fibres of `F_U` and `G` over `t` (the cartesian squares `ιU` and
`j`, with `ιU` lying over `ι`), and `h` restricts to `h₀`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_contraction {S : Scheme.{u}} (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : CurveFamily B hZ) (hF : F.base = integerSiteObject B hZ hS) (s : S)
    {X₀ : Scheme.{u}} (hX₀ : B.Contains X₀) (pX₀ : X₀ ⟶ Spec (.of (S.residueField s)))
    (ι : yoneda.obj (integerSiteObject B hZ hX₀) ⟶ F.total.obj)
    (hι : IsPullback ι (yoneda.map (integerSiteMap B hZ hX₀
        (BigFppfSite.residueField_spec_contains B hS s) pX₀)) (F.toBaseYonedaOfEq hF)
      (yoneda.map (integerSiteMap B hZ (BigFppfSite.residueField_spec_contains B hS s) hS
        (S.fromSpecResidueField s))))
    {Y₀ : Scheme.{u}} (pY₀ : Y₀ ⟶ Spec (.of (S.residueField s))) [IsProper pY₀]
    (h₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) (hh₀ : h₀ ≫ pY₀ = pX₀)

      (SheafOfModules.unit X₀.ringCatSheaf))) :

      ∃ (hU : B.Contains U.scheme) (t : Spec (.of (S.residueField s)) ⟶ U.scheme),

            G.total.obj),

            ((F.ofBaseEq hF).pullback (integerSiteMap B hZ hU hS U.toBase)).toBaseYoneda ∧
          ∃ ιU : yoneda.obj (integerSiteObject B hZ hX₀) ⟶

            ιU ≫ ((F.ofBaseEq hF).pullbackHom

                (BigFppfSite.residueField_spec_contains B hS s) pX₀))
              ((F.ofBaseEq hF).pullback (integerSiteMap B hZ hU hS U.toBase)).toBaseYoneda
              (yoneda.map (integerSiteMap B hZ (BigFppfSite.residueField_spec_contains B hS s)
                hU t)) ∧

                (Scheme.size_lt_of_locallyOfFiniteType_of_quasiCompact pY₀
                  (BigFppfSite.residueField_spec_contains B hS s))) ⟶ G.total.obj,
              IsPullback j (yoneda.map (integerSiteMap B hZ
                  (Scheme.size_lt_of_locallyOfFiniteType_of_quasiCompact pY₀
                    (BigFppfSite.residueField_spec_contains B hS s))
                  (BigFppfSite.residueField_spec_contains B hS s) pY₀))
                (G.toBaseYonedaOfEq hG)

                  hU t)) ∧
