declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.exists_isAffineOpen_topDegreeBaseChange_of_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7D] part (2).** For `f : X ⟶ Y` proper and `y ∈ Y` whose fibre has
topological Krull dimension at most `d`, the point `y` has an affine open neighbourhood `V` such
that `f ∣_ V : f ⁻¹ V ⟶ V` and `d` satisfy

* the hypotheses of [Stacks, Tag 0EX3]: `f ⁻¹ V` and `V` are quasi-compact and
  quasi-separated, and `Rⁱ (f ∣_ V)_* F = 0` for `i > d` and every quasi-coherent `F`;
* conclusion (a) of [Stacks, Tag 0EX3]: for every cartesian square
  `X' ⟶ f ⁻¹ V`, `f' : X' ⟶ Y'`, `Y' ⟶ V`, `Rⁱ f'_* F' = 0` for `i > d` and every
  quasi-coherent `F'` on `X'`;
* conclusion (b) of [Stacks, Tag 0EX3]: for every such square and quasi-coherent `F'` on `X'`
  and `G'` on `Y'`, `Rᵈ f'_*(F' ⊗ (f')^* G') ≅ Rᵈ f'_* F' ⊗ G'`, with `Rᵈ f'_*` read as the
  degree-`d` cohomology of the derived direct image of a module placed in degree `0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAffineOpen_topDegreeBaseChange_of_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (y : Y) (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens,
      y ∈ V ∧ IsAffineOpen V ∧
      CompactSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ∧
      QuasiSeparatedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ∧
      CompactSpace V.toScheme ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace V.toScheme ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ), (d : ℤ) < i →
        ∀ (F : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Modules), F.IsQuasicoherent →
          IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ V)).rightDerivedPlus i).obj F)) ∧
      (∀ {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
          (g : Y' ⟶ V.toScheme), IsPullback g' f' (f ∣_ V) g →
        ∀ (i : ℤ), (d : ℤ) < i → ∀ (F' : X'.Modules), F'.IsQuasicoherent →
          IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').rightDerivedPlus i).obj F')) ∧
      (∀ {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
          (g : Y' ⟶ V.toScheme), IsPullback g' f' (f ∣_ V) g →
        ∀ (F' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X'.toRingedSpace)), F'.IsQuasicoherent →
        ∀ (G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y'.toRingedSpace)), G'.IsQuasicoherent →
          Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y'.toRingedSpace)) (d : ℤ)).obj
              ((derivedPushforward f'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                  (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor X'.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj F').obj
                    ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback f'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
                      G')))) ≅
            ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor Y'.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y'.toRingedSpace)) (d : ℤ)).obj
                ((derivedPushforward f'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                    (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj F')))).obj
              G'))
declarations.comment: part (2): the hypotheses of Tag 0EX3 and its conclusions (a) and (b)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.exists_isAffineOpen_topDegreeBaseChangeConclusions_of_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7D] part (2), with every conclusion of Tag 0EX3.** For `f : X ⟶ Y` proper
and `y ∈ Y` whose fibre has topological Krull dimension at most `d`, the point `y` has an affine
open neighbourhood `V` such that `f ∣_ V : f ⁻¹ V ⟶ V` and `d` satisfy the hypotheses of
[Stacks, Tag 0EX3] (`f ⁻¹ V` and `V` quasi-compact and quasi-separated, `Rⁱ (f ∣_ V)_* F = 0` for
`i > d` and quasi-coherent `F`) and, for every cartesian square `X' ⟶ f ⁻¹ V`, `f' : X' ⟶ Y'`,
`Y' ⟶ V`, its conclusions:

* (a) `Rⁱ f'_* F' = 0` for `i > d` and every quasi-coherent `F'` on `X'`;
* (b) `Rᵈ f'_*(F' ⊗ (f')^* G') ≅ Rᵈ f'_* F' ⊗ G'` for quasi-coherent `F'` on `X'` and `G'` on
  `Y'`;
* (c) for every further cartesian square `X'' ⟶ X'`, `f'' : X'' ⟶ Y''`, `h : Y'' ⟶ Y'` and every
  quasi-coherent `F'` on `X'`, the canonical map `h^* Rᵈ f'_* F' ⟶ Rᵈ f''_* (h')^* F'` is an
  isomorphism.

theorem exists_isAffineOpen_topDegreeBaseChangeConclusions_of_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (y : Y) (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    letI : ∀ (C : Type (u + 1)) [Category.{u} C] [Abelian C], HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} C :=
      fun C _ _ => HasDerivedCategory.standard C
    ∃ (V : Y.Opens) (_ : y ∈ V) (_ : IsAffineOpen V)
      (hcX : CompactSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (hqX : QuasiSeparatedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
      (hcY : CompactSpace V.toScheme) (hqY : QuasiSeparatedSpace V.toScheme)
      (hvan : ∀ (i : ℤ), (d : ℤ) < i →
        ∀ (F : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Modules), F.IsQuasicoherent →
          IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ V)).rightDerivedPlus i).obj F)),
      (∀ {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
          (g : Y' ⟶ V.toScheme), IsPullback g' f' (f ∣_ V) g →
        ∀ (i : ℤ), (d : ℤ) < i → ∀ (F' : X'.Modules), F'.IsQuasicoherent →
          IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').rightDerivedPlus i).obj F')) ∧
      (∀ {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
          (g : Y' ⟶ V.toScheme), IsPullback g' f' (f ∣_ V) g →
        ∀ (F' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X'.toRingedSpace)), F'.IsQuasicoherent →
        ∀ (G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y'.toRingedSpace)), G'.IsQuasicoherent →
          Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y'.toRingedSpace)) (d : ℤ)).obj
              ((derivedPushforward f'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                  (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor X'.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj F').obj
                    ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback f'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
                      G')))) ≅
            ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor Y'.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y'.toRingedSpace)) (d : ℤ)).obj
                ((derivedPushforward f'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                    (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj F')))).obj
              G')) ∧
      (∀ {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
          (g : Y' ⟶ V.toScheme) (sq : IsPullback g' f' (f ∣_ V) g),
        let S : Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChangeSituation.{u} :=
          { X := (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme, Y := V.toScheme, f := f ∣_ V, d := d
            isCompact_X := hcX, isQuasiSeparated_X := hqX
            isCompact_Y := hcY, isQuasiSeparated_Y := hqY
            vanishes_above := hvan
            X' := X', Y' := Y', g' := g', f' := f', g := g, isPullback := sq }
        ∀ (F' : X'.Modules) [F'.IsQuasicoherent]
          {X'' Y'' : Scheme.{u}} (h' : X'' ⟶ X') (f'' : X'' ⟶ Y'') (h : Y'' ⟶ Y')
          (sq' : IsPullback h' f'' f' h),
        IsIso (topDirectImageBaseChangeMap S F' h' f'' h
          (toShHom_comm_of_isPullback (S := S) h' f'' h sq')))
declarations.comment: part (2), with all conclusions of Tag 0EX3

**[Stacks, Tag 0E7G].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be proper and let `y ∈ Y` be a point whose fibre has
dimension at most one and satisfies `H¹(X_y, 𝒪_{X_y}) = 0`. Then there is an open `V ∋ y` with
`R¹ f_* 𝒪_X|_V = 0`, and `R¹ f'_* 𝒪_{X'} = 0` for the base change along every `g : Y' ⟶ V`.

The hypothesis on the fibre makes `R¹ (f_y)_* 𝒪_{X_y}` vanish over the affine base `Spec κ(y)`,
hence by `hbc` the pullback of `R¹ f_* 𝒪_X` along `Spec κ(y) ⟶ Y`; so `y` misses the support of
`R¹ f_* 𝒪_X` by [Stacks, Tag 056J]. The support is closed because of the finite-type clause
`hft`, which gives the neighbourhood `V`. Universality after base change is `hbc` again, applied
to `g ≫ V.ι` and read through the compatibility of pullback with composition.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_isZero_restrict_firstDirectImage_of_isZero_cohomologyOne_fiber
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (y : Y)
    (_hdim : topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hft : (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f).IsFiniteType)
    (hbc : FirstDirectImageCommutesBaseChange f)
    (hH : IsZero (firstCohomologyStructureSheaf (f.fiber y))) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, y ∈ V ∧
      IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f)) ∧
      ∀ (Y' : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y' ⟶ V.toScheme),
        IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf (pullback.snd f (g ≫ V.ι)))
declarations.comment: the clauses of Tags 0EX4 and 0EX3 (b) are the hypotheses `hft`, `hbc`

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.exists_isOpen_isZero_restrict_firstDirectImage_of_isPullback_of_isZero_cohomologyOne_fiber
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7G].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be proper and let `y ∈ Y` be a point with
`dim(X_y) ≤ 1` and `H¹(X_y, 𝒪_{X_y}) = 0`. Then there is an open neighbourhood `V` of `y` such
that `R¹ f_* 𝒪_X|_V = 0`, and the same holds after base change by any `Y' ⟶ V`: for every
cartesian square `X' ⟶ X`, `f' : X' ⟶ Y'`, `g : Y' ⟶ Y` over `f` with `g(Y') ⊆ V`,
`R¹ f'_* 𝒪_{X'} = 0`.

The source's proof: shrink to an open `W ∋ y` over which all fibres have dimension at most one
([Stacks, Tag 02FZ]); there `R¹ f_* 𝒪_X` is of finite type ([Stacks, Tag 0EX4],
`firstDirectImageFiniteTypeOfFibreDimensionOne`) and its pullback to `Spec κ(y)` is `R¹` of the
fibre, which vanishes; so `y` is outside the closed support ([Stacks, Tag 056J]), and `V` is the
complement of the support in `W` (`exists_isOpen_firstDirectImage_vanishes_of_factor`). For a
base change along `g` into `V`, the pullback of `R¹ f_* 𝒪_X` along `g` factors through its
restriction to `V`, which is zero, and over `W` this pullback is `R¹ f'_* 𝒪_{X'}`
(`isZero_pullback_firstDirectImage_iff_of_factor_of_isPullback`, the vanishing form of
[Stacks, Tag 0EX3]).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_isZero_restrict_firstDirectImage_of_isPullback_of_isZero_cohomologyOne_fiber
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (y : Y)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hH : IsZero (firstCohomologyStructureSheaf (f.fiber y))) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, y ∈ V ∧
      IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f)) ∧
      ∀ ⦃X' Y' : Scheme.{u}⦄ {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g : Y' ⟶ Y},
        IsPullback g' f' f g → Set.range g ⊆ V → IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f')

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.exists_isOpen_firstDirectImage_vanishes_universally
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7G].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be proper and let `y ∈ Y` be a point with
`dim(X_y) ≤ 1` and `H¹(X_y, 𝒪_{X_y}) = 0`. Then there is an open neighbourhood `V` of `y` such
that `R¹ f_* 𝒪_X|_V = 0`, and `R¹ f'_* 𝒪_{X'} = 0` for the base change `f'` of `f` along every
`Y' ⟶ V`.

The source's proof: shrink to an open `W ∋ y` over which all fibres have dimension at most one
([Stacks, Tag 02FZ]); there `R¹ f_* 𝒪_X` is of finite type ([Stacks, Tag 0EX4]) and its pullback
to `Spec κ(y)` is `R¹` of the fibre, which vanishes; so `y` is outside the closed support
([Stacks, Tag 056J]). This is
`exists_isOpen_isZero_restrict_firstDirectImage_of_isPullback_of_isZero_cohomologyOne_fiber`
read on the cartesian square of the chosen pullback along `g ≫ V.ι`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_firstDirectImage_vanishes_universally (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (y : Y)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hH : IsZero (firstCohomologyStructureSheaf (f.fiber y))) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, y ∈ V ∧
      IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f)) ∧
      ∀ (Y' : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y' ⟶ V.toScheme),
        IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf (pullback.snd f (g ≫ V.ι)))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.isZero_higherDirectImage_of_one_lt_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7H] clause (1).** For a proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` all of whose fibres
have dimension at most one and a quasi-coherent `ℱ` on `X`, `Rᵖ f_* ℱ = 0` for every `p > 1`.

This is [Stacks, Tag 0E7D] at `d = 1`. The tag's hypothesis `H¹(X_y, 𝒪_{X_y}) = 0` is not used
for this clause and is not imposed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_higherDirectImage_of_one_lt_of_isProper {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℤ) (hp : 1 < p) :
    IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F)
declarations.comment: clause (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.isZero_cohomology_of_notMem_zero_one_of_isAffine
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7H] clause (3).** For a proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` onto an affine scheme
all of whose fibres have dimension at most one and a quasi-coherent `ℱ` on `X`,
`Hᵖ(X, ℱ) = 0` for every `p ∉ {0, 1}`.

Negative degrees vanish for formal reasons, and degrees above one by [Stacks, Tag 0E7D] over an
affine base. The tag's hypothesis `H¹(X_y, 𝒪_{X_y}) = 0` is not used for this clause and is not
imposed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomology_of_notMem_zero_one_of_isAffine {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [IsAffine Y]
    (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℤ) (hp : p ∉ ({0, 1} : Set ℤ)) :
    IsZero (((Stacks.Cohomology.AffineBase.moduleGlobalSections X).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F)
declarations.comment: clause (3)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.isZero_cohomology_one_of_generatingSections_of_isAffine
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7H] clause (4).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism onto an affine
scheme such that `dim(X_y) ≤ 1` and `H¹(X_y, 𝒪_{X_y}) = 0` for every `y ∈ Y`, and let `ℱ` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module which is globally generated. Then `H¹(X, ℱ) = 0`.

`R¹ f_* 𝒪_X` is of finite type by [Stacks, Tag 0EX4] at `d = 1`
(`firstDirectImageFiniteTypeOfFibreDimensionOne`), and the rest is
`isZero_cohomology_one_of_generatingSections_of_isFiniteType`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomology_one_of_generatingSections_of_isAffine {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsAffine Y]
    (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hfib : ∀ y : Y, IsZero (firstCohomologyStructureSheaf (f.fiber y)))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (σ : SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections F) :
    IsZero (((Stacks.Cohomology.AffineBase.moduleGlobalSections X).rightDerivedPlus 1).obj F)
declarations.comment: clause (4)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.isZero_higherDirectImage_one_of_epi_pullback_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7H] clause (2).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism such that
`dim(X_y) ≤ 1` and `H¹(X_y, 𝒪_{X_y}) = 0` for every `y ∈ Y`, let `ℱ` be a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module, and suppose there is a surjection `f^*𝒢 ⟶ ℱ` with `𝒢` quasi-coherent on `Y`.
Then `R¹ f_* ℱ = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_higherDirectImage_one_of_epi_pullback_of_isProper {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hfib : ∀ y : Y, IsZero (firstCohomologyStructureSheaf (f.fiber y)))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (p : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G ⟶ F) (hp : Epi p) :
    IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus 1).obj F)
declarations.comment: clause (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.epi_unitToPushforwardUnit_of_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7I].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of schemes such that
`dim(X_y) ≤ 1` and `H¹(X_y, 𝒪_{X_y}) = 0` for every `y ∈ Y`, and suppose `𝒪_Y ⟶ f_* 𝒪_X` is
surjective. Then `𝒪_{Y'} ⟶ f'_* 𝒪_{X'}` is surjective for every base change `f'` of `f`.

Surjectivity is local on the base, and around each point of `Y'` there is an affine open mapping
into an affine open of `Y`; over such a pair the restricted base change is a base change of
`f ∣_ W` along a morphism of affine schemes, which factors as a closed immersion followed by a
flat morphism through the spectrum of a polynomial algebra. The flat half is
`surjective_appTop_of_flat_base`, and the closed-immersion half is
`surjective_appTop_of_closedImmersion_base`, where clause (4) of [Stacks, Tag 0E7H] is
applied to the ideal sheaf of the closed immersion.

Mathlib's `IsProper` is separated, universally closed and locally of finite type; universal
closedness gives quasi-compactness, so this is Stacks' notion of proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_unitToPushforwardUnit_of_baseChange
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hfib : ∀ y : Y, IsZero (firstCohomologyStructureSheaf (f.fiber y)))
    (hsurj : Epi (Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardUnit f))
    {Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) :
    Epi (Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardUnit (pullback.snd f g))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.exists_isOpen_flat_fibreDimension_vanishing_epi_near_specialFibre
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7J].** Let `X --f--> Y --q--> S` be morphisms of schemes and let `s ∈ S`.
Write `f_s : X_s ⟶ Y_s` for the induced morphism of fibres over `s` (in the two spellings
`Stacks.Flatness.fiberHom f q s` and `pullback.snd f (q.fiberι s)` of `X_s = X ×_Y Y_s`).
Assume

1. `X ⟶ S` is locally of finite presentation and flat at the points of `X_s`,
2. `f` is proper,
3. the fibres of `f_s` have dimension at most one and `R¹ f_{s,*} 𝒪_{X_s} = 0`,
4. `𝒪_{Y_s} ⟶ f_{s,*} 𝒪_{X_s}` is surjective.

Then there is an open `Y_s ⊆ V ⊆ Y` such that (a) `f⁻¹(V)` is flat over `S`, (b)
`dim(X_y) ≤ 1` for `y ∈ V`, (c) `R¹ f_* 𝒪_X|_V = 0`, (d) `𝒪_V ⟶ f_* 𝒪_X|_V` is surjective,
and (b), (c) and (d) remain true after base change of `f⁻¹(V) ⟶ V` by any `Y' ⟶ V`.

(a) and (b) are `exists_isOpen_flat_and_fibreDimension_le_one`; (c) and its persistence are
[Stacks, Tag 0E7G] along `Y_s` (`exists_isOpen_firstDirectImage_vanishes_of_factor`); (d) is
`exists_isOpen_notMem_supp_cokernel_unit` at every point of `Y_s`, and its persistence is
[Stacks, Tag 0E7I] (`epi_unitToPushforwardUnit_of_baseChange`), whose hypotheses on the fibres
follow from the persistence of (b) and (c).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_flat_fibreDimension_vanishing_epi_near_specialFibre (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (q : Y ⟶ S) (s : S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ≫ q)] [IsProper f]
    (hflat : ∀ x : X, (f ≫ q) x = s → IsFlatAt (f ≫ q).toLRSHom.toShHom x)
    (hdim : ∀ y : q.fiber s,
      topologicalKrullDim ((Stacks.Flatness.fiberHom f q s).fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hR : IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf (pullback.snd f (q.fiberι s))))
    (hsurj : Epi (Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardUnit (pullback.snd f (q.fiberι s)))) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, (∀ y : Y, q y = s → y ∈ V) ∧
      Flat ((f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ (f ≫ q)) ∧
      (∀ y : Y, y ∈ V → topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧
      IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f)) ∧
      Epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map (Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardUnit f)) ∧
      ∀ (Y' : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y' ⟶ V.toScheme),
        (∀ y' : Y', topologicalKrullDim ((pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) g).fiber y') ≤
          ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧
        IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) g)) ∧
        Epi (Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardUnit (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) g))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.isIso_directImageStructureSheafBaseChangeMap_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7K], clause (b).** Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ S` be a commutative triangle of schemes with
`X ⟶ S` flat, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be proper with `dim(X_y) ≤ 1` for every `y ∈ Y`, and suppose
`R¹ f_* 𝒪_X = 0`. Then formation of `f_* 𝒪_X` commutes with arbitrary base change `S' ⟶ S`:
for `Y' = Y ×_S S'` and `X' = X ×_Y Y'`, the canonical comparison
`(Y' ⟶ Y)^* f_* 𝒪_X ⟶ f'_* 𝒪_{X'}` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_directImageStructureSheafBaseChangeMap_of_flat {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (q : Y ⟶ S) [Flat (f ≫ q)] [IsProper f]
    (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hR : IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f)) {S' : Scheme.{u}} (h : S' ⟶ S) :
    IsIso (directImageStructureSheafBaseChangeMap f (pullback.fst q h))
declarations.comment: clause (b): formation of f_* 𝒪_X commutes with arbitrary base change S' ⟶ S

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.isFlatOver_directImageStructureSheaf_of_fibreDimension_le_one
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7K], clause (a).** Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ S` be a commutative triangle of schemes with
`X ⟶ S` flat, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be proper with `dim(X_y) ≤ 1` for every `y ∈ Y`, and suppose
`R¹ f_* 𝒪_X = 0`. Then `f_* 𝒪_X` is flat over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlatOver_directImageStructureSheaf_of_fibreDimension_le_one {X Y S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ S) [Flat (f ≫ q)] [IsProper f]
    (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hR : IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f)) :
    IsFlatOver q.toLRSHom.toShHom (directImageStructureSheaf f)
declarations.comment: clause (a): f_* 𝒪_X is flat over S

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.isFlatOver_directImageStructureSheaf
declarations.doc:
Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ S` be a commutative triangle of schemes with `X ⟶ S` flat, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be
proper with `dim(X_y) ≤ 1` for every `y ∈ Y`, and suppose `R¹ f_* 𝒪_X = 0`. Then `f_* 𝒪_X` is
flat over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlatOver_directImageStructureSheaf (hcoh : CohomologyVanishesAboveOne.{u})
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ S) [Flat (f ≫ q)] [IsProper f]
    (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hR : IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f)) :
    IsFlatOver q.toLRSHom.toShHom (directImageStructureSheaf f)
declarations.comment: clause (a): flatness of `f_* 𝒪_X` over the base

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TopDegreeBaseChange.exists_isOpen_isIso_unitToPushforwardUnit_of_specialFibre
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7L].** Let `X --f--> Y --q--> S` be a commutative triangle of schemes and
`s ∈ S`. Assume
1. `X ⟶ S` is locally of finite presentation and flat at the points of `X_s`,
2. `Y ⟶ S` is locally of finite presentation,
3. `f` is proper,
4. the fibres of `f_s : X_s ⟶ Y_s` have dimension `≤ 1` and `R¹f_{s,*}𝒪_{X_s} = 0`,
5. `𝒪_{Y_s} ⟶ f_{s,*}𝒪_{X_s}` is an isomorphism.

Then there is an open `Y_s ⊂ V ⊂ Y` such that (a) `V` is flat over `S`, (b) `f⁻¹(V)` is flat
over `S`, (c) `dim(X_y) ≤ 1` for `y ∈ V`, (d) `R¹f_*𝒪_X|_V = 0`, (e) `𝒪_V ⟶ f_*𝒪_X|_V` is an
isomorphism, and (a) – (e) remain true after base change of `f⁻¹(V) ⟶ V` by any `S' ⟶ S`
(for the base change `X' ⟶ V'` of `f⁻¹(V) ⟶ V`, the open of (a) – (e) being all of `V'`).

In the hypotheses, `f_s` is the base change of `f` along `Y_s ⟶ Y` for (4) on `R¹` and for (5),
and `(f ≫ q).fiber s ⟶ q.fiber s` for the dimension bound of (4); these are the same morphism
up to the canonical isomorphism `X ×_Y Y_s ≅ X_s`.

The proof is the source's. Near each `y ∈ Y_s` one restricts to affine opens of `Y` and `S`
over which `X` is flat; the situation is the base change of a Noetherian model
(`exists_noetherianModel`, [Stacks, Tags 01ZM, 081F, 04AI]), the special-fibre hypotheses
descend to the image point of the model base along a faithfully flat field extension, and over
the Noetherian model the stalk maps of `𝒪_Y ⟶ f_*𝒪_X` are bijective near the special fibre
(surjective by coherence of the cokernel, [Stacks, Tag 02O5], and Nakayama; injective by the
local flatness criterion, [Stacks, Tag 00ME]); this is carried back by [Stacks, Tag 0E7K] (b).
Conclusions (a) and (e) and the persistence then follow from [Stacks, Tag 0E7K] on `V`
(`conclusions_of_isOpen`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_isIso_unitToPushforwardUnit_of_specialFibre (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ S) (s : S)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ≫ q)]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation q] [IsProper f]
    (hflat : ∀ x : X, (f ≫ q) x = s → IsFlatAt (f ≫ q).toLRSHom.toShHom x)
    (hdim : ∀ y : q.fiber s, topologicalKrullDim ((Stacks.Flatness.fiberHom f q s).fiber y) ≤
      ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hR : IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf (pullback.snd f (q.fiberι s))))
    (hiso : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardUnit (pullback.snd f (q.fiberι s)))) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, (∀ y : Y, q y = s → y ∈ V) ∧
      Flat (V.ι ≫ q) ∧
      Flat ((f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ (f ≫ q)) ∧
      (∀ y : Y, y ∈ V → topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧
      IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf f)) ∧
      IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map (Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardUnit f)) ∧
      ∀ ⦃S' : Scheme.{u}⦄ (h : S' ⟶ S),
        Flat (pullback.snd (V.ι ≫ q) h) ∧
        Flat (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (pullback.fst (V.ι ≫ q) h) ≫ pullback.snd (V.ι ≫ q) h) ∧
        (∀ y' : (pullback (V.ι ≫ q) h : Scheme.{u}), topologicalKrullDim
          ((pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (pullback.fst (V.ι ≫ q) h)).fiber y') ≤
            ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧
        IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf
          (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (pullback.fst (V.ι ≫ q) h))) ∧
        IsIso (Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardUnit
          (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (pullback.fst (V.ι ≫ q) h)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.StableModel.exists_isStableContraction_comp_tails_bridges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E7N: contracting to a stable curve.** Let `X` be a proper scheme over a
field `k` of dimension one with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`, genus `g ≥ 2` and at-worst-nodal singularities.
Contract rational tails until none are left, `t : X ⟶ X₁` ([Stacks, Tag 0E3L]), and then rational
bridges until none are left, `d : X₁ ⟶ Y` ([Stacks, Tag 0E3Q]). The composite `c = t ≫ d` is a
morphism over `k` such that `Y` is proper over `k` of dimension one with at-worst-nodal
singularities, `H⁰(Y, 𝒪_Y) = k`, `Y` has genus `g`, `𝒪_Y = c_*𝒪_X`, `R¹c_*𝒪_X = 0`, and `ω_Y` is
ample. These conditions characterize `c` ([Stacks, Tag 0E7Q]): any `c' : X ⟶ Y'` satisfying the
conditions of `IsStableContraction` is related to `c` by exactly one isomorphism `e : Y ≅ Y'` with
`c ≫ e.hom = c'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isStableContraction_comp_tails_bridges (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop)]
    (hgenus : 2 ≤ genus f)
    (hnodal : letI : X.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨f⟩
      Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X) :
    ∃ (X₁ : Scheme.{u}) (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (t : X ⟶ X₁) (Y : Scheme.{u})
      (gY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (d : X₁ ⟶ Y),
      IsIteratedContractionOfRationalTails k f f₁ t ∧
      (∀ C : X₁.IdealSheafData, ¬ @IsRationalTail k _ X₁ ⟨f₁⟩ C) ∧
      IsIteratedContractionOfRationalBridges k f₁ gY d ∧
      (∀ C : Y.IdealSheafData,
        letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨gY⟩
        ∀ _ : IsProper (Y ↘ Spec (.of k)), ¬ IsRationalBridge k Y C) ∧
      IsStableContraction f gY (t ≫ d) ∧
      IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ gY.appTop) ∧
      genus gY = genus f ∧
      ∀ (Y' : Scheme.{u}) (gY' : Y' ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (c' : X ⟶ Y'),
        IsStableContraction f gY' c' → ∃! e : Y ≅ Y', (t ≫ d) ≫ e.hom = c'

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.DualizingPullback.nonempty_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E7P.** Let `c : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of proper schemes over a field
`k` with `𝒪_Y = c_*𝒪_X` and `R^1 c_*𝒪_X = 0`, where `X` and `Y` are reduced, Gorenstein and of
dimension one. If `H^1(X, ω_X^{⊗ m}) = 0` and `ω_X^{⊗ m}` is globally generated for some
`m ≥ 1`, then `c^*ω_Y ≅ ω_X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_pullback_dualizingSheafOverField_iso
    (c : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper (c ≫ g)] [IsProper g]
    (hO : IsIso (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit c.toRingCatSheafHom))
    (hR1 : IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward c).rightDerived 1).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)))
    [IsReduced X] [IsReduced Y] [IsGorenstein X] [IsGorenstein Y]
    (hdimX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (hdimY : topologicalKrullDim Y = 1)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hH1 : IsZero (cohomologyOverField k (c ≫ g)
      (tensorSheafNPow X.toRingedSpace (dualizingSheafOverField (c ≫ g)) m) 1))
    (hgen : SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections
      (tensorSheafNPow X.toRingedSpace (dualizingSheafOverField (c ≫ g)) m : X.Modules)) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c).obj (dualizingSheafOverField g) ≅
      dualizingSheafOverField (c ≫ g))

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.StableModel.existsUnique_isStableContraction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0E7Q.** Let `X` be a proper scheme over a field `k` of dimension one
with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`, genus `g ≥ 2` and at-worst-nodal singularities. There is a morphism
`c : X ⟶ Y` of schemes over `k` such that
1. `Y` is proper over `k`, `dim Y = 1`, and `Y` has at-worst-nodal singularities,
2. `𝒪_Y = c_*𝒪_X` and `R¹c_*𝒪_X = 0`, and
3. `ω_Y` is ample on `Y`

(`IsStableContraction f gY c`), and it is unique up to unique isomorphism: any two such
`c : X ⟶ Y`, `c' : X ⟶ Y'` are related by exactly one isomorphism `e : Y ≅ Y'` with
`c ≫ e = c'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_isStableContraction (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop)]
    (hgenus : 2 ≤ genus f)
    (hnodal : letI : X.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨f⟩
      Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X) :
    (∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (gY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (c : X ⟶ Y), IsStableContraction f gY c) ∧
      ∀ (Y Y' : Scheme.{u}) (gY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (gY' : Y' ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (c : X ⟶ Y)
        (c' : X ⟶ Y'), IsStableContraction f gY c → IsStableContraction f gY' c' →
        ∃! e : Y ≅ Y', c ≫ e.hom = c'
declarations.comment: Condition (3) includes that `ω_Y` is invertible, as ampleness is defined for invertible modules. Uniqueness up to unique isomorphism: any two such morphisms are related by exactly one isomorphism of targets under `X`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isProjective_algebraization_of_dimension_le_one
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7R], algebraization of formal curves.** Let `A` be a complete local
Noetherian ring, `S = Spec A`, `Sₙ = Spec (A / 𝔪 ^ (n + 1))`, and let `Xₙ ⟶ Sₙ` be algebraic spaces
with transition maps `iₙ : Xₙ ⟶ Xₙ₊₁` making every square over `Sₙ ⟶ Sₙ₊₁` cartesian. If
`X₀ ⟶ S₀` is proper and `dim X₀ ≤ 1`, there are a projective morphism of schemes `fY : Y ⟶ S`
and morphisms `kₙ : Xₙ ⟶ Y`, compatible with the `iₙ`, identifying each `Xₙ` with `Y ×_S Sₙ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isProjective_algebraization_of_dimension_le_one
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal A) A]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (Spec (.of A)))
    (X : ℕ → (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of A)) hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : ∀ n, IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of A)) hS (X n))
    (p : ∀ n, X n ⟶ yoneda.obj (adicThickeningObject A (maximalIdeal A) B hS
      (contains_adicThickening A (maximalIdeal A) B hS) n))
    (i : ∀ n, X n ⟶ X (n + 1))
    (hcart : ∀ n, IsPullback (i n) (p n) (p (n + 1))
      (yoneda.map (adicThickeningSuccMap A (maximalIdeal A) B hS
        (contains_adicThickening A (maximalIdeal A) B hS) n)))
    (hproper : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hS (p 0))
    (hdim : dimension B (Spec (.of A)) hS (X 0) (hX 0) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : B.Contains Y) (fY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)),
      IsProjective fY ∧ IsProjectiveMorphism fY ∧
      ∃ k : ∀ n, X n ⟶ yoneda.obj (siteObject B (Spec (.of A)) hS hY fY),
        (∀ n, i n ≫ k (n + 1) = k n) ∧
        ∀ n, IsPullback (k n) (p n) (yoneda.map (siteObjectToBase A B hS hY fY))
          (yoneda.map (adicThickeningMap A (maximalIdeal A) B hS
            (contains_adicThickening A (maximalIdeal A) B hS) n))

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.SmoothingCriterion.smooth_genericFibre_of_pow_mem_fittingIdeal
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, `S = Spec k⟦t⟧` and `Sₙ = Spec (k⟦t⟧/(t^n))`. Let `f : Y ⟶ S` be
proper and flat with Cohen–Macaulay special fibre, equidimensional of dimension `d`, and let
`Xₙ = Y ×_S Sₙ` with projections `pr` and `gₙ`. If for some `n ≥ 1` the `d`-th Fitting ideal of
`Ω_{Xₙ/Sₙ}` contains `t ^ (n - 1)`, then the generic fibre of `f`, taken over the residue field
of the generic point of `S`, is smooth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smooth_genericFibre_of_pow_mem_fittingIdeal (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of (PowerSeries k))) [IsProper f] [Flat f]
    (d n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hCM : IsCohenMacaulay (f.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (PowerSeries k))))
    (hequi : TopologicalSpace.Equidimensional
      (f.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (PowerSeries k))))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (PowerSeries k))) =
      (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    {Xₙ : Scheme.{u}} {pr : Xₙ ⟶ Y}
    {gₙ : Xₙ ⟶ Spec (.of (PowerSeries k ⧸ Ideal.span
      {(PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries k) ^ n}))}
    (hcart : IsPullback pr gₙ f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span {(PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries k) ^ n})))))
    (hfit : ∀ U : Xₙ.affineOpens,
      (pr ≫ f).appLE ⊤ U.1 (le_preimage_top (pr ≫ f) U.1)
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (PowerSeries k))).inv (PowerSeries.X ^ (n - 1))) ∈
        (fittingIdeal (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials gₙ) (d : ℤ)).ideal U) :
    Smooth (f.fiberToSpecResidueField
      (⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (PowerSeries k)))

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.Smoothing.exists_nonempty_open_smooth_projection
declarations.doc:
The generic affine-linear deformation is smooth over some nonempty open in
the affine space of its coefficients.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_nonempty_open_smooth_projection
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hcn : c ≤ n)
    (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) :
    let R := parameterRing k n c
    let A := deformedCoordinateRing k n c f
    let π : Spec (.of A) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    ∃ U : (Spec (.of R)).Opens,
      U ≠ ⊥ ∧ Smooth (π.resLE U (π ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl)

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.Smoothing.exists_flat_powerSeries_specialFiber_smooth_genericFiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E7V.** A global complete intersection `A` over a field `k` is the special fibre
`B/XB` of a flat finite type `k⟦X⟧`-algebra `B` whose generic fibre `k⸨X⸩ ⊗[k⟦X⟧] B` is smooth
over `k⸨X⸩`, and `B` carries a relative global complete intersection presentation whose number
of variables minus number of relations is the Krull dimension of `A` when `A` is nonzero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_flat_powerSeries_specialFiber_smooth_genericFiber
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (hA : IsGlobalCompleteIntersection k A) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra (PowerSeries k) B)
      (_ : Algebra k B) (_ : IsScalarTower k (PowerSeries k) B)
      (_ : Module.Flat (PowerSeries k) B) (_ : Algebra.FiniteType (PowerSeries k) B),
      Nonempty
          ((B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap (PowerSeries k) B PowerSeries.X} : Set B)) ≃ₐ[k] A) ∧
        Algebra.Smooth (LaurentSeries k)
          (TensorProduct (PowerSeries k) (LaurentSeries k) B) ∧
        ∃ (n c : ℕ) (P : Algebra.Presentation (PowerSeries k) B (Fin n) (Fin c)),
          P.IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection ∧
            (Nontrivial A → ringKrullDim A = ((n - c : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
declarations.comment: the smoothing of a global complete intersection

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.Smoothing.exists_finite_powerSeries_specialFiber_etale_genericFiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E7W.** A finite-dimensional local complete intersection `A` over a field `k` is
the special fibre `B/XB` of a finite flat `k⟦X⟧`-algebra `B` whose generic fibre
`k⸨X⸩ ⊗[k⟦X⟧] B` is étale over `k⸨X⸩`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finite_powerSeries_specialFiber_etale_genericFiber
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [FiniteDimensional k A] (hA : IsLocalCompleteIntersection k A) :
    ∃ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra (PowerSeries k) B)
      (_ : Algebra k B) (_ : IsScalarTower k (PowerSeries k) B),
      Module.Finite (PowerSeries k) B ∧ Module.Flat (PowerSeries k) B ∧
        Nonempty
          ((B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap (PowerSeries k) B PowerSeries.X} : Set B)) ≃ₐ[k] A) ∧
      Algebra.Etale (LaurentSeries k)
          (TensorProduct (PowerSeries k) (LaurentSeries k) B)
declarations.comment: the smoothing of a finite local complete intersection

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.Smoothing.exists_flat_essFiniteType_specialFiber_pow_mem_fittingIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E7X.** Let `k` be a field and let `A` be a local `k`-algebra, essentially of finite
type over `k` and a complete intersection over `k`. Then `A` is the special fibre `B/tB` of a flat
`k⟦t⟧`-algebra `B` essentially of finite type over `k⟦t⟧`, and for some `n` the element `t^n` lies
in the `d`-th Fitting ideal of `Ω_{B/k⟦t⟧}`, where `d = dim(A) + trdeg_k(κ)` for `κ` the residue
field of `A`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_flat_essFiniteType_specialFiber_pow_mem_fittingIdeal
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k A]
    (hA : IsCompleteIntersectionLocalRing k A) :
    ∃ (dimA trdegResidue n : ℕ),
      ringKrullDim A = (dimA : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) = trdegResidue ∧
      ∃ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra (PowerSeries k) B)
        (_ : Algebra.EssFiniteType (PowerSeries k) B) (_ : Module.Flat (PowerSeries k) B)
        (_ : Algebra k B) (_ : IsScalarTower k (PowerSeries k) B),
        Nonempty
          ((B ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap (PowerSeries k) B PowerSeries.X}) ≃ₐ[k] A) ∧
          algebraMap (PowerSeries k) B (PowerSeries.X ^ n) ∈
            fittingIdeal (M := KaehlerDifferential (PowerSeries k) B)
              ((dimA + trdegResidue : ℕ) : ℤ)

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.Smoothing.exists_flat_isProjective_smoothing_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7Y].** Let `X` be a scheme over a field `k`. Assume (1) `X` is proper over
`k`, (2) `X` is a local complete intersection over `k`, (3) `X` has dimension `≤ 1`, and (4)
`X → Spec(k)` is smooth except at finitely many points. Then there exists a flat projective
morphism `Y → Spec(k[[t]])` whose generic fibre is smooth and whose special fibre is isomorphic to
`X`.

The generic fibre is the fibre over the zero ideal of `k⟦t⟧`, smooth over its residue field. The
special fibre is the base change along `Spec k ⟶ Spec k⟦t⟧` given by the constant coefficient,
and the isomorphism with `X` is one of schemes over `Spec k`. Projectivity is
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjective`, [Stacks, Tag 01W8].
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flat_isProjective_smoothing_of_isProper {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsProper f] (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersectionOverField f) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1)
    (hfin : (f.smoothLocus : Set X)ᶜ.Finite) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of (PowerSeries k))),
      Flat g ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjective g ∧
      Smooth (g.fiberToSpecResidueField
        (⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (PowerSeries k))) ∧
      ∃ e : X ≅ pullback g
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))),
        e.hom ≫ pullback.snd g
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))) = f

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.Smoothing.exists_flat_separated_finiteType_smoothing
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0E7Z].** Let `k` be a field and let `X` be a scheme over `k`. Assume
(1) `X` is separated, finite type over `k` and `dim(X) ≤ 1`, (2) `X` is a local complete
intersection over `k`, and (3) `X → Spec(k)` is smooth except at finitely many points. Then there
exists a flat, separated, finite type morphism `Y → Spec(k[[t]])` whose generic fibre is smooth and
whose special fibre is isomorphic to `X`.

Finite type is `LocallyOfFiniteType` together with `QuasiCompact`. The generic fibre is the fibre
over the zero ideal of `k⟦t⟧`, smooth over its residue field. The special fibre is the base change
along `Spec k ⟶ Spec k⟦t⟧` given by the constant coefficient, and the isomorphism with `X` is one
of schemes over `Spec k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flat_separated_finiteType_smoothing {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1) (hlci : IsLocalCompleteIntersectionOverField f)
    (hfin : ((f.smoothLocus : Set X)ᶜ).Finite) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of (PowerSeries k))),
      Flat g ∧ IsSeparated g ∧ LocallyOfFiniteType g ∧ QuasiCompact g ∧
        Smooth (g.fiberToSpecResidueField
          (⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (PowerSeries k))) ∧
        ∃ e : X ≅
            pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))),
          e.hom ≫ pullback.snd g
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))) = f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isSeparated_of_discreteUniqueness
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E80, the Noetherian valuative criterion for separatedness.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a
1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` with `𝒴` locally Noetherian and `f` locally of finite type
and quasi-separated. If, for every valuative diagram for `f` whose valuation ring is a *discrete*
valuation ring, the category of dotted arrows is either empty or a setoid with exactly one
isomorphism class, then `f` is separated.

Separatedness is properness of `Δ_f` in the relative sense of Stacks 04XB, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isSeparated_of_discreteLift` reduces it, along a locally
Noetherian scheme chart of `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒳`, to the full valuative criterion at discrete valuation rings
for the algebraic spaces representing the base changes of `Δ_f`. Both halves of that criterion
come from the hypothesis through the two transfers of Stacks 0CLN and Stacks 0CLJ, each of which
carries a restriction on the valuation ring through unchanged:

* a lift exists by `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.nonempty_lift_baseChange_point`, whose input is a
  dotted arrow for a valuative *square* for `Δ_f` over the same valuation ring; reading that
  square as a valuative diagram, Stacks 0E8L builds it from the hypothesis through
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.nonempty_dottedArrow_relativeDiagonal_of_pred`;
* it is unique by `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.subsingleton_lift_baseChange_point`, whose input is the
  isomorphism of any two dotted arrows of a valuative diagram for `Δ_f`, which is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.nonempty_iso_dottedArrow_relativeDiagonal_of_pred`.

The valuation ring never changes along the way — no extension of the fraction field and no passage
to a dominating valuation ring — so "discrete" survives every step, which is the whole point of
the Noetherian form of the criterion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_of_discreteUniqueness (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hY : HasPropertyOnSomeSchemeAtlas B S hS (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T) 𝒴)
    (hft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f)
    (H : ValuativeCriterion.DiscreteUniqueness B S hS f) :
    IsSeparated B S hS f
declarations.comment:
a quasi-separated 1-morphism of algebraic stacks, locally of finite type over a
locally Noetherian target, is separated as soon as the uniqueness part of the valuative criterion
holds at every discrete valuation ring

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesSmoothH0_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_tfae
declarations.doc:
There is an open substack `Curves^{smooth,h0} ⊂ Curves` — the moduli stack
`𝓜 = AlgebraicGeometry.moduliSmoothCurves` of Stacks 0E82, the strictly full subcategory of
families of curves satisfying `AlgebraicGeometry.IsSmoothH0Family`; its inclusion
`AlgebraicGeometry.moduliSmoothCurvesInclusion` is representable by algebraic spaces and an open
immersion — such that:

1. for a family of curves `f : X → S`, classified by a scheme-valued point `y` of `Curves` over
   `S`, the classifying morphism factors through `Curves^{smooth,h0}` exactly when
   `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, this holding after any base change, and `f` is smooth of relative dimension
   `1` (`IsSmoothH0Family` of the family `y(S)`);
2. for a scheme `X = T` proper over a field `k = W` with `dim X ≤ 1`, classified by `y` over
   `Spec k`, the following are equivalent: (a) the classifying morphism factors through
   `Curves^{smooth,h0}`; (b) `X` is smooth, `dim X = 1` and `k = H⁰(X, 𝒪_X)`; (c) `X` is smooth,
   `dim X = 1` and geometrically connected; (d) `X` is smooth, `dim X = 1` and geometrically
   integral; (e) `X_{k̄}` is a smooth curve over an algebraic closure `k̄` of `k`.

Part (1)(a) of the source says "factors through `Curves^{smooth}`"; the substack meant is the one
constructed, `Curves^{smooth,h0}` (see the module documentation).
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesSmoothH0_isOpenSubstack_and_factors_iff_and_tfae :
    ((ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsSmoothH0Family B hZ) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (moduliSmoothCurvesInclusion B hZ).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ (moduliSmoothCurvesInclusion B hZ)) ∧
    ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSmoothH0Family B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSmoothH0Family B hZ) = y) ↔
        IsSmoothH0Family B hZ (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))))) ∧
    ∀ {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
      (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
      (hflat : Flat ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
      (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
      (hlfp : LocallyOfFinitePresentation ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
      (hqc : Space.IsQuasiCompact B integerBase hZ (schemeSpaceMap g).hom)
      (hsep : Space.IsSeparated B integerBase hZ (schemeSpaceMap g).hom)
      (hqsep : Space.IsQuasiSeparated B integerBase hZ (schemeSpaceMap g).hom)
      (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
      (y : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
      (_hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map W.hom)
      (_e : y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 W.left)) ≅
        curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g hflat hproper hlfp hqc hsep hqsep hdim),
      List.TFAE [
        ∃ z : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤
            ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSmoothH0Family B hZ),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSmoothH0Family B hZ) = y,
        Smooth ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW) ∧
          topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) = 1 ∧
          IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
            ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW).appTop),
        Smooth ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW) ∧
          topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) = 1 ∧
          GeometricallyConnected ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW),
        Smooth ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW) ∧
          topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) = 1 ∧
          GeometricallyIntegral ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW),
        Smooth (pullback.snd ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW)
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (AlgebraicClosure k))))) ∧
          IsCurve (AlgebraicClosure k)
            (pullback.snd ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g ≫ eqToHom hW)
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (AlgebraicClosure k)))))]
declarations.comment: the open substack Curves^{smooth,h0} (the moduli stack M of 0E82), its family characterization (1) and the five equivalent conditions (2) over a field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduliSmoothCurves
declarations.doc:
**The moduli stack `𝓜 = Curves^{smooth, h0}` of smooth proper curves**: the substack of the
stack of curves of the families of curves `f : X → S` which are smooth of relative dimension one
with `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, this holding after any base change (condition (1)(b) of Stacks 0E81), as a
category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `Spec(ℤ)`.
declarations.statement:
def moduliSmoothCurves :
    CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
declarations.comment: the moduli stack of smooth proper curves, 𝓜 = Curves^{smooth, h0}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus
declarations.doc:
The moduli stack `𝓜_g` of smooth proper curves of genus `g`: the substack of the stack of
curves of the families `f : X → S` which are smooth of relative dimension one with
`f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S`, universally, and whose fibre over every point of `S` has genus `g`, as a category
fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `Spec(ℤ)`. It lies in
`𝓜 = AlgebraicGeometry.moduliSmoothCurves`, and its points are the smooth proper curves of genus
`g` over fields, as in part (2) of Stacks 0E83.
declarations.statement:
def moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus (g : ℕ) :
    CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
declarations.comment: the moduli stack of smooth proper curves of genus g, 𝓜_g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduliSmoothCurves_openClosedDecomposition
declarations.doc:
**The decomposition `𝓜 = ∐_{g ≥ 0} 𝓜_g` into open and closed substacks.**
Let `G` be a family of curves in `𝓜` (`AlgebraicGeometry.moduliSmoothCurves`) over a scheme `S`,
that is, a scheme-valued point `S → 𝓜`. Then:

* the loci `S_g ⊂ S` of points whose fibre has genus `g` are open and closed in `S`, pairwise
  disjoint, and cover `S`;
* for every `g`, `𝓜_g ×_𝓜 S` is the open subscheme `S_g`: there is an open subspace `W` of `S`
  with points `S_g` such that a family `F` mapping to `G` (a base change of `G` along `T → S`)
  lies in `𝓜_g` (`AlgebraicGeometry.moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus`) exactly when `T → S` factors
  through `W`, exactly when `T → S` maps every point into `S_g`.

So each `𝓜_g ⊂ 𝓜` is an open and closed substack, these substacks are pairwise disjoint, and
together they cover `𝓜`.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduliSmoothCurves_openClosedDecomposition (G : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hG : IsSmoothH0Family B hZ G) :
    (∀ g : ℕ, IsClopen (CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g)) ∧
      Pairwise (fun g g' : ℕ => Disjoint (CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g)
        (CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g')) ∧
      (⋃ g : ℕ, CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g) = Set.univ ∧
      ∀ g : ℕ, ∃ W : Subfunctor (schemeSpace G.base).obj,
        Space.IsOpenSubspace B integerBase hZ W ∧
        Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ W.toFunctor W.ι) =
          CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g ∧
        ∀ (F : CurveFamily B hZ) (a : F ⟶ G),
          (IsSmoothH0FamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g F ↔
            ∃ t : (schemeSpace F.base).obj ⟶ W.toFunctor,
              t ≫ W.ι = (schemeSpaceMap a.baseMap).hom) ∧
          (IsSmoothH0FamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g F ↔
            Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ (schemeSpace F.base).obj
              (schemeSpaceMap a.baseMap).hom) ⊆ CurveFamily.fibreGenusLocus B hZ G g)
declarations.comment: the decomposition 𝓜 = ∐_{g ≥ 0} 𝓜_g into open and closed substacks, read on the scheme-valued points of 𝓜

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus_iff
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X → S` be a family of curves, classified by a
scheme-valued point `y` of the stack of curves over `S` with `y(S) ≅ X`. The following are
equivalent:

* (a) the classifying morphism `S → Curves` factors through `𝓜_g`
  (`AlgebraicGeometry.moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus`): `y` lifts to the full subcategory of the
  families of `𝓜_g`;
* (b) `X → S` is smooth of relative dimension one, `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S` and this holds after any base
  change, and `R¹f_*𝒪_X` is a locally free `𝒪_S`-module of rank `g`.

The source writes "smooth" in (b); with no relative dimension (b) ⟹ (a) fails for `g = 0`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.not_factors_moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus_zero_of_identity`), and (b) is stated
with the relative dimension one that membership in `𝓜` (Stacks 0E81) requires.
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus_iff (g : ℕ) (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
    (_hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom) (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (e : y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ X) :
    (∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSmoothH0FamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g),
        z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSmoothH0FamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g) = y) ↔
      IsSmoothDimOneFamily B hZ X ∧ HasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions B hZ X ∧
        CurveFamily.HasGenus B hZ X g
declarations.comment: part (1), with smooth of relative dimension one in (b): read with smooth of arbitrary relative dimension, (b) ⟹ (a) fails for g = 0, see not_factors_moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus_zero_of_identity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus_over_field_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus_over_field_iff (g : ℕ) {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k))) (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1) (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [IsAlgClosure k K] :
    (∀ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ),
      y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom →
      (y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfScheme X B hZ hk hdim) →
      ((∃ z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IsSmoothH0FamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g),
          z ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsSmoothH0FamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g) = y) ↔
        Smooth X.hom ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧
          IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) ∧ genus X.hom = g)) ∧
    List.TFAE [
      Smooth X.hom ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧
        IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) ∧ genus X.hom = g,
      Smooth X.hom ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧ GeometricallyConnected X.hom ∧
        genus X.hom = g,
      Smooth X.hom ∧ topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1 ∧ GeometricallyIntegral X.hom ∧
        genus X.hom = g,
      Smooth (pullback.snd X.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) ∧
        IsCurve K (pullback.snd X.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) ∧
        genus (pullback.snd X.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) = g]
declarations.comment: part (2): over a field, (a) the classifying morphism factors through 𝓜_g, (b)-(e) the conditions on X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSmoothOverIntegers_moduliSmoothCurves_and_moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus
declarations.doc:
The morphisms `𝓜 → Spec(ℤ)` and, for every `g`, `𝓜_g → Spec(ℤ)` are smooth. Here
`𝓜 = Curves^{smooth, h0}` and `𝓜_g` are the open substacks of the algebraic stack of curves (Stacks
0D5A) of the families smooth of relative dimension one with `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S` universally, and of
those with moreover all fibres of genus `g`. Both are open substacks of `Curves^{lci+}`, which is
smooth over `Spec(ℤ)` (Stacks 0DZX).
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmoothOverIntegers_moduliSmoothCurves_and_moduliSmoothCurvesOfGenus :
    IsSmoothOverIntegers B hZ (C1590Private.isAlgebraicStack_curvesFiberedCategory.{u, w} B hZ)
        (C1590Private.isOpenCurvesLocus_isSmoothH0Family_of B hZ
          (C1590Private.isOpenCurvesLocus_hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions_of
            (C1590Private.isOpenCurvesLocus_hasBijectiveGlobalFunctionsOnFieldFibres_of
              (C1590Private.hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
            (C1590Private.hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions_of
              (C1590Private.hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ)))) ∧
      ∀ g : ℕ, IsSmoothOverIntegers B hZ
        (C1590Private.isAlgebraicStack_curvesFiberedCategory.{u, w} B hZ)
        (IsOpenCurvesLocus.of_iff (Q := IsSmoothH0FamilyOfFibreGenus B hZ g)
          (C1590Private.isOpenCurvesLocus_isSmoothH0FamilyOfFibreGenus_of
            (C1590Private.isOpenCurvesLocus_hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions_of
              (C1590Private.isOpenCurvesLocus_hasBijectiveGlobalFunctionsOnFieldFibres_of
                (C1590Private.hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
              (C1590Private.hasUniversallyBijectiveGlobalFunctions_of
                (C1590Private.hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ)))
            (C1590Private.prestableGenusLociOpen_of (C1590Private.hasEtaleLocalSchemeCharts B hZ))
            g)
          fun _ => Iff.rfl)
declarations.comment: both morphisms 𝓜 → Spec(ℤ) and 𝓜_g → Spec(ℤ), for every g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesPointSet_smooth_isOpen_dense_in_lciPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E86.** The inclusion `|Curves^{smooth}| ⊂ |Curves^{lci+}|` is that of an open dense
subset.

`Curves^{smooth}` is the substack of the stack of curves of smooth families of curves, and
`Curves^{lci+}` that of families `X ⟶ S` which are local complete intersection morphisms whose
singular locus is finite over `S` (Stacks 0DZX); `|Curves^{smooth}|` and `|Curves^{lci+}|` are
their images in `|Curves|`, with the topology of Stacks 04Y8, and `|Curves^{lci+}|` carries the
subspace topology.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesPointSet_smooth_isOpen_dense_in_lciPlus :
    curvesPointSet B hZ (IsSmoothFamily B hZ) ⊆ curvesPointSet B hZ (IsLciPlusFamily B hZ) ∧
      IsOpen (Subtype.val ⁻¹' curvesPointSet B hZ (IsSmoothFamily B hZ) :
        Set (curvesPointSet B hZ (IsLciPlusFamily B hZ))) ∧
      Dense (Subtype.val ⁻¹' curvesPointSet B hZ (IsSmoothFamily B hZ) :
        Set (curvesPointSet B hZ (IsLciPlusFamily B hZ)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesPointSet_moduliSmoothOfGenus_isOpen_dense_in_stableOfGenus
declarations.doc:
Let `g ≥ 2`. The inclusion `|𝓜_g| ⊂ |𝓜̄_g|` is that of an open dense
subset.

`𝓜_g` is the substack of the stack of curves of families `f : X → S` which are smooth of relative
dimension one with `f_*𝒪_X = 𝒪_S` universally and `R¹f_*𝒪_X` locally free of rank `g`
(Stacks 0E83), and `𝓜̄_g` that of stable families with `R¹f_*𝒪_X` locally free of rank `g`
(Stacks 0E78); `|𝓜_g|` and `|𝓜̄_g|` are their images in `|Curves|`, with the topology of
Stacks 04Y8, and `|𝓜̄_g|` carries the subspace topology.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesPointSet_moduliSmoothOfGenus_isOpen_dense_in_stableOfGenus
    (g : ℕ) (hg : 2 ≤ g) :
    curvesPointSet B hZ (fun F => IsSmoothH0Family B hZ F ∧ CurveFamily.HasGenus B hZ F g) ⊆
        curvesPointSet B hZ (IsStableCurveFamilyOfGenus B hZ g) ∧
      IsOpen (Subtype.val ⁻¹' curvesPointSet B hZ
          (fun F => IsSmoothH0Family B hZ F ∧ CurveFamily.HasGenus B hZ F g) :
        Set (curvesPointSet B hZ (IsStableCurveFamilyOfGenus B hZ g))) ∧
      Dense (Subtype.val ⁻¹' curvesPointSet B hZ
          (fun F => IsSmoothH0Family B hZ F ∧ CurveFamily.HasGenus B hZ F g) :
        Set (curvesPointSet B hZ (IsStableCurveFamilyOfGenus B hZ g)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.exists_isOpen_forall_isStructureContraction_baseChange
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, `s ∈ S`, and `c : X ⟶ Y` a morphism over `S` of families of curves. If
`c_{s,*}𝒪_{X_s} = 𝒪_{Y_s}` and `R¹c_{s,*}𝒪_{X_s} = 0`, there is an open neighbourhood `W` of `s`
such that for every scheme `T ⟶ S` landing in `W` and every base change `c' : X_T ⟶ Y_T` of `c`,
`𝒪_{Y_T} = c'_*𝒪_{X_T}` and `R¹c'_*𝒪_{X_T} = 0`. Taking `T = W` gives the statement over `W`,
and the quantification over `T` is the persistence under base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_forall_isStructureContraction_baseChange
    (X Y : CurveFamily B hZ) (hb : Y.base = X.base) (c : X.total ⟶ Y.total)
    (hc : c ≫ Y.toBase ≫ eqToHom (congrArg schemeSpace hb) = X.toBase) (s : X.base.left.1)
    (hs : Space.IsStructureContraction B integerBase hZ
      (Space.structureContractionBaseChange B integerBase hZ c hc
        (schemeSpaceMap (Space.residueFieldMap B integerBase hZ X.base s
          (B.residueField_spec_contains X.base.left.property s))))) :
    ∃ W : X.base.left.1.Opens, s ∈ W ∧
      ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ) (h : T ⟶ X.base),
        (∀ t, ((𝒯).map h).base t ∈ W) →
        ∀ (X' Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ) (pX' : X' ⟶ X.total)
          (fX' : X' ⟶ schemeSpace T) (pY' : Y' ⟶ Y.total) (fY' : Y' ⟶ schemeSpace T)
          (c' : X' ⟶ Y'),
          IsPullback pX' fX' X.toBase (schemeSpaceMap h) →
          IsPullback pY' fY' (Y.toBase ≫ eqToHom (congrArg schemeSpace hb)) (schemeSpaceMap h) →
          c' ≫ pY' = pX' ≫ c → c' ≫ fY' = fX' →
          Space.IsStructureContraction B integerBase hZ c'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_iso_near_point_of_iso_fibre
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme and `s ∈ S` a point. Let `f : X ⟶ S` and `gᵢ : Yᵢ ⟶ S`, `i = 1, 2`, be
families of curves (algebraic spaces, flat, proper, of finite presentation and of relative
dimension at most one over `S`) and `cᵢ : X ⟶ Yᵢ` morphisms over `S`. Let `φ : Y₁,ₛ ≅ Y₂,ₛ` be an
isomorphism of the fibres over `Spec κ(s) ⟶ S` compatible with `c₁,ₛ` and `c₂,ₛ`. Suppose
`c₁,ₛ,* 𝒪_{Xₛ} = 𝒪_{Y₁,ₛ}` and `R¹c₁,ₛ,* 𝒪_{Xₛ} = 0`; these are read on the morphism of schemes
`a₁ : F_X ⟶ F₁` which `c₁,ₛ` is through presentations `e_X`, `e₁` of the fibres `Xₛ` and `Y₁,ₛ`
by schemes (the fibres of a family of curves over a field are schemes, [Stacks, Tag 0ADD],
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_presentation_of_curveFamilyConditions_of_field`). Then there are
an open neighbourhood `j : U ⟶ S` of `s` and an isomorphism `ψ : Y₁ ×_S U ≅ Y₂ ×_S U` over `U`,
compatible with `c₁` and `c₂` and with `φ` (through the factorisation `k` of `Spec κ(s) ⟶ S`
through `U`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_near_point_of_iso_fibre (S : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ) (s : (𝒯).obj S)
    {X Y₁ Y₂ : (BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B integerBase hZ X) (hY₁ : IsAlgebraicSpace B integerBase hZ Y₁)
    (hY₂ : IsAlgebraicSpace B integerBase hZ Y₂)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj S) (g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ yoneda.obj S) (g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ yoneda.obj S)
    (hfl : IsFlat B integerBase hZ f) (hpr : IsProper B integerBase hZ f)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B integerBase hZ f)
    (hd : HasRelativeDimensionLE 1 B integerBase hZ f)
    (hfl₁ : IsFlat B integerBase hZ g₁) (hpr₁ : IsProper B integerBase hZ g₁)
    (hfp₁ : IsFinitePresentation B integerBase hZ g₁)
    (hd₁ : HasRelativeDimensionLE 1 B integerBase hZ g₁)
    (hfl₂ : IsFlat B integerBase hZ g₂) (hpr₂ : IsProper B integerBase hZ g₂)
    (hfp₂ : IsFinitePresentation B integerBase hZ g₂)
    (hd₂ : HasRelativeDimensionLE 1 B integerBase hZ g₂)
    (c₁ : X ⟶ Y₁) (c₂ : X ⟶ Y₂) (hc₁ : c₁ ≫ g₁ = f) (hc₂ : c₂ ≫ g₂ = f)
    {FX F₁ : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ}
    (eX : yoneda.obj FX ≅ pullback f (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)))
    (e₁ : yoneda.obj F₁ ≅ pullback g₁ (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)))
    (tX : FX ⟶ pointFieldObject S s) (t₁ : F₁ ⟶ pointFieldObject S s)
    (heX : eX.hom ≫ pullback.snd f (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) = yoneda.map tX)
    (he₁ : e₁.hom ≫ pullback.snd g₁ (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) = yoneda.map t₁)
    (a₁ : FX ⟶ F₁)
    (ha₁ : yoneda.map a₁ ≫ e₁.hom =
      eX.hom ≫ pullback.map f (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) g₁
        (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) c₁ (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp [hc₁]) (by simp))
    (h0 : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardUnit ((𝒯).map a₁)))
    (hR : IsZero (firstDirectImageStructureSheaf ((𝒯).map a₁)))
    (φ : pullback g₁ (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) ≅
      pullback g₂ (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)))
    (hφ : φ.hom ≫ pullback.snd g₂ (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) =
      pullback.snd g₁ (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)))
    (hφc : pullback.map f (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) g₁
        (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) c₁ (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp [hc₁]) (by simp) ≫ φ.hom =
      pullback.map f (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) g₂
        (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) c₂ (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp [hc₂]) (by simp)) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ) (j : U ⟶ S),
      _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion ((𝒯).map j) ∧
      s ∈ Set.range ((𝒯).map j) ∧
      ∃ (ψ : pullback g₁ (yoneda.map j) ≅ pullback g₂ (yoneda.map j))
        (k : pointFieldObject S s ⟶ U),
        ψ.hom ≫ pullback.snd g₂ (yoneda.map j) = pullback.snd g₁ (yoneda.map j) ∧
        pullback.map f (yoneda.map j) g₁ (yoneda.map j) c₁ (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp [hc₁])
            (by simp) ≫ ψ.hom =
          pullback.map f (yoneda.map j) g₂ (yoneda.map j) c₂ (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp [hc₂])
            (by simp) ∧
        ∃ (hk : k ≫ j = pointFieldMap S s),
          pullback.map g₁ (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) g₁ (yoneda.map j) (𝟙 _) (yoneda.map k)
              (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by rw [Category.comp_id, ← Functor.map_comp, hk]) ≫ ψ.hom =
            φ.hom ≫ pullback.map g₂ (yoneda.map (pointFieldMap S s)) g₂ (yoneda.map j) (𝟙 _)
              (yoneda.map k) (𝟙 _) (by simp)
              (by rw [Category.comp_id, ← Functor.map_comp, hk])
declarations.comment: Families of curves are read as in `AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily` (Stacks 0D4Z): algebraic spaces `X`, `Y₁`, `Y₂` with morphisms to `S` which are flat, proper, of finite presentation and of relative dimension at most one. The fibres over `s` are the fibre products along `Spec κ(s) ⟶ S`; the hypotheses on `c₁,ₛ` are read on the morphism of schemes presenting it (the fibres being schemes by Stacks 0ADD).

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.exists_stabilization_and_existsUnique_iso
declarations.doc:
Let `X ⟶ S` be a prestable family of curves of genus `g ≥ 2`. Then there are a stable family
of curves `Y ⟶ S` and a morphism `c : X ⟶ Y` over `S` such that

1. `𝒪_Y = c_*𝒪_X` and `R¹c_*𝒪_X = 0`, and this remains true after base change by any morphism
   `S' ⟶ S`, and
2. for every field-valued point `s` of `S` the morphism `c_s : X_s ⟶ Y_s` is the contraction of
   rational tails and bridges (it satisfies the conditions of Stacks 0E7Q characterizing it).

Moreover `c` is unique up to unique isomorphism: for any two morphisms `cᵢ : X ⟶ Yᵢ` over `S` to
families of curves satisfying (1) and (2) there is exactly one isomorphism `e : Y₁ ≅ Y₂` over `S`
with `c₁ ≫ e = c₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_stabilization_and_existsUnique_iso
    {X : CurveFamily B hZ} (hX : IsPrestableCurveFamily B hZ X) {g : ℕ} (hg : 2 ≤ g)
    (hgen : X.HasFibresOfGenus g) :
    (∃ (Y : CurveFamily B hZ) (hb : Y.base = X.base) (c : X.total ⟶ Y.total),
      IsStableCurveFamily B hZ Y ∧ c ≫ Y.toBase ≫ eqToHom (congrArg schemeSpace hb) = X.toBase ∧
      X.IsUniversalStructureContraction B hZ Y hb c ∧ X.HasStableContractionFibres B hZ Y hb c) ∧
    ∀ (Y₁ Y₂ : CurveFamily B hZ) (hb₁ : Y₁.base = X.base) (hb₂ : Y₂.base = X.base)
      (c₁ : X.total ⟶ Y₁.total) (c₂ : X.total ⟶ Y₂.total),
      c₁ ≫ Y₁.toBase ≫ eqToHom (congrArg schemeSpace hb₁) = X.toBase →
      c₂ ≫ Y₂.toBase ≫ eqToHom (congrArg schemeSpace hb₂) = X.toBase →
      X.IsUniversalStructureContraction B hZ Y₁ hb₁ c₁ →
      X.IsUniversalStructureContraction B hZ Y₂ hb₂ c₂ →
      X.HasStableContractionFibres B hZ Y₁ hb₁ c₁ → X.HasStableContractionFibres B hZ Y₂ hb₂ c₂ →
      ∃! e : Y₁.total ≅ Y₂.total, c₁ ≫ e.hom = c₂ ∧
        e.hom ≫ Y₂.toBase ≫ eqToHom (congrArg schemeSpace hb₂) =
          Y₁.toBase ≫ eqToHom (congrArg schemeSpace hb₁)
declarations.comment: Existence and uniqueness in one statement. `X ⟶ S` is a prestable family of curves whose fibres over all field-valued points have genus `g ≥ 2` (`HasFibresOfGenus`, the genus of a prestable family, Stacks 0E6V). The factorization `X ⟶ Y ⟶ S` is a family of curves `Y` over `S` (same base, `hb`) with `c ≫ g = f`. Condition (1) is `IsUniversalStructureContraction`: for every scheme `S' ⟶ S` of the site and the base change `c' : X' ⟶ Y'`, `𝒪_{Y'} ⟶ c'_*𝒪_{X'}` is an isomorphism and `R¹c'_*𝒪_{X'} = 0` (S' = S gives the condition for c). Condition (2) is `HasStableContractionFibres`, asserted at every field-valued point of `S` (so at every `s ∈ S` through `Spec κ(s)`): the fibre `c_s` satisfies the three conditions of Stacks 0E7Q, which characterize the contraction of rational tails and bridges of Section 0E7N up to unique isomorphism (`exists_isStableContraction_comp_tails_bridges`). Uniqueness up to unique isomorphism: for any two such `cᵢ : X ⟶ Yᵢ` (the targets need not be assumed stable) there is exactly one isomorphism `e : Y₁ ≅ Y₂` over `S` with `c₁ ≫ e = c₂`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stabilizationMorphism
declarations.doc:
For `g ≥ 2`, the stabilization morphism `Curves^{prestable}_g ⟶ 𝓜̄_g` of stacks over `ℤ`, a
1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `Spec(ℤ)`. It sends a
prestable family of curves `X → S` of genus `g` to the stable family `Y → S` of Stacks 0E8A
(`AlgebraicGeometry.stabilizationMorphism_obj`).
declarations.statement:
def stabilizationMorphism (g : ℕ) (hg : 2 ≤ g) :
    curvesPrestableOfGenus B hZ g ⟶ moduliStableCurvesOfGenus B hZ g
declarations.comment: the stabilization morphism Curves^{prestable}_g → Mbar_g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stabilizationMorphism_obj
declarations.doc:
The stabilization morphism sends a prestable family of curves `X → S` of genus `g ≥ 2` to a
stable family `Y → S` over the same base together with a morphism `c : X → Y` over `S` which is the
stable model of Stacks 0E8A: `Y` is stable with fibres of genus `g`, `𝒪_Y = c_*𝒪_X` and
`R¹c_*𝒪_X = 0` after every base change, and on every fibre `c` is the contraction of rational tails
and bridges.
declarations.statement:
theorem stabilizationMorphism_obj (g : ℕ) (hg : 2 ≤ g)
    (X : (curvesPrestableOfGenus B hZ g).val.obj) :
    ∃ (h : ((stabilizationMorphism B hZ g hg).hom.obj X).obj.base = X.obj.base)
      (c : X.obj.total ⟶ ((stabilizationMorphism B hZ g hg).hom.obj X).obj.total),
      IsStableModel B hZ g (eqToHom h.symm) c
declarations.comment: it sends a prestable family X → S of genus g to its stable model Y → S of 0E8A

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.hasSemistableReduction_iff_exists_isStableCurveFamily
declarations.doc:
Let `R` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K` and `C` a smooth projective curve
over `K` with `H⁰(C, 𝒪_C) = K` of genus `g ≥ 2`. Then `C` has semistable reduction (Stacks 0CDH)
exactly when it is the generic fibre of a stable family of curves over `R`: a stable family `F`
over `Spec R` with a morphism of families of curves from `C ⟶ Spec K` to `F` lying over
`Spec K ⟶ Spec R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSemistableReduction_iff_exists_isStableCurveFamily
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hZ : B.Contains integerBase) (hR : B.Contains (Spec (.of R)))
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (c : C ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [IsCurve K c] [Smooth c] (hc : IsProjective c)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv ≫ c.appTop)] (hg : 2 ≤ genus c) :
    HasSemistableReduction R c hc ↔
      ∃ (F : CurveFamily B hZ) (ψ : F.base ≅ integerSiteObject B hZ hR)
        (φ : @curveFamilyOfScheme K _ (Over.mk c) hc.isProper B hZ
          (contains_spec_of_isFractionRing hR)
          (IsCurve.topologicalKrullDim_eq_one (k := K) (f := c)).le ⟶ F),
        IsStableCurveFamily B hZ F ∧
          φ.baseMap ≫ ψ.hom = integerSiteMap B hZ (contains_spec_of_isFractionRing hR) hR
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K)))
declarations.comment: `C ⟶ Spec K` is smooth, projective, a curve (`IsCurve`), with `H⁰(C, 𝒪_C) = K` and genus `≥ 2`. (1) is `HasSemistableReduction R c hc` (Semistable Reduction, Definition 0CDH). (2), a stable family of curves over `R` with generic fibre `C`, is a stable family of curves `F` (Stacks 0E75) whose base is identified with `Spec R` (`ψ`), with a morphism of families of curves (a cartesian square) from the family `C ⟶ Spec K` to `F` lying over `Spec K ⟶ Spec R`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.OverShriek.reflectsMonomorphisms_and_reflectsEpimorphisms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E8E.** Let `C` be a site and let `U` be an object of `C`. Let `L` be a left adjoint
of the restriction functor `j_U^{-1} = J.overPullback : Sh(C) ⥤ Sh(C/U)`, i.e. let `L` be
`j_{U!}`. Then `L` reflects monomorphisms and epimorphisms, that is (Stacks 00WN), if `j_{U!}φ` is
an injection of sheaves of sets then so is `φ`, and if `j_{U!}φ` is a surjection of sheaves of
sets then so is `φ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem reflectsMonomorphisms_and_reflectsEpimorphisms {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (U : C) [HasWeakSheafify J (Type v)]
    [HasWeakSheafify (J.over U) (Type v)] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective (Type v)]
    {L : Sheaf (J.over U) (Type v) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type v)} (adj : L ⊣ J.overPullback (Type v) U) :
    L.ReflectsMonomorphisms ∧ L.ReflectsEpimorphisms
declarations.comment: j_{U!} reflects injections and surjections of sheaves of sets.

declarations.name: CochainComplex.KFlat.kFlat_of_tensor_finitelyPresented_acyclic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E8F.** A cochain complex whose tensor product with every finitely presented module
is acyclic is K-flat.
declarations.statement:
public theorem kFlat_of_tensor_finitelyPresented_acyclic {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hK : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R, Module.FinitePresentation R M →
      (K ⊗ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj M).Acyclic) :
    K.KFlat

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.extensionByZero_exact_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E8G.** Extension by zero from the slice site reflects, as well as preserves,
exactness of complexes of sheaves of modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionByZero_exact_iff
    (S : ShortComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U))) :
    (S.map (SheafOfModules.pullback.{u} (F := Over.forget U)
      (𝟙 (R.over U) : (R.over U) ⟶ (R.over U)))).Exact ↔ S.Exact

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.OfEssentiallySmall.extensionByZero_exact_iff
declarations.doc:
Extension by zero from the slice site reflects, as well as preserves, exactness of
complexes of sheaves of modules, over a site whose objects need not lie in the universe of its
morphisms: objects in an arbitrary universe `c`, morphisms and modules in `u`, and `C`
essentially `u`-small.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionByZero_exact_iff
    (S : ShortComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U))) :
    (S.map (SheafOfModules.pullback.{u} (F := Over.forget U)
      (𝟙 (R.over U) : (R.over U) ⟶ (R.over U)))).Exact ↔ S.Exact
declarations.comment: for a site essentially u-small, objects in Type c, morphisms and modules in u

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.FreeModuleUniverse.extensionByZero_exact_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E8G at a free module universe.** Extension by zero from the slice site reflects,
as well as preserves, exactness of complexes of sheaves of modules, over a site whose module
sections need not lie in the universe of its morphisms.

The attribute records the universe shape: the objects of `C` in an arbitrary universe `u`, its
morphisms in `v`, the sections of `R` in `w` and the module sections in `max v a`. The tag is
carried in full by `Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.extensionByZero_exact_iff`, the
single-universe statement, which this one generalises; that registration stands and this one
does not replace it.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionByZero_exact_iff
    (S : ShortComplex (SheafOfModules.{max v a} (R.over U))) :
    (S.map (SheafOfModules.pullback.{max v a} (F := Over.forget U)
      (𝟙 (R.over U) : R.over U ⟶ R.over U))).Exact ↔ S.Exact
declarations.comment: objects in Type u, morphisms in v, ring sections in w, modules in max v a

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.InternalHom.internalHomOverIso
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0E8H.** Internal Hom commutes with restriction to the localized site over `U`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def internalHomOverIso
    (X : RingedSite.{u, v, w}) (U : X.C)
    (F G : _root_.SheafOfModules.{m} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) :
    (restrFun X.O.obj U).obj (internalHom X.O.obj F.val G.val) ≅
      internalHom (X.O.over U).obj
        ((restrFun X.O.obj U).obj F.val)
        ((restrFun X.O.obj U).obj G.val)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.InternalHom.internalHomOverIso_hom_app
declarations.doc:
At `V ⟶ U`, the isomorphism of Stacks 0E8H restricts a local morphism along the
iterated-slice functor `(C/U)/V ⥤ C/V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem internalHomOverIso_hom_app
    (X : RingedSite.{u, v, w}) (U : X.C)
    (F G : _root_.SheafOfModules.{m} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
    (V : (Over U)ᵒᵖ)
    (α : ((restrFun X.O.obj U).obj (internalHom X.O.obj F.val G.val)).obj V)
    (W : (Over V.unop)ᵒᵖ)
    (x : ((restrFun (X.O.over U).obj V.unop).obj
      ((restrFun X.O.obj U).obj F.val)).obj W) :
    ((((internalHomOverIso X U F G).hom.app V).hom α).app W).hom x =
      (α.app ((Over.iteratedSliceForward V.unop).op.obj W)).hom x
declarations.comment: canonical component on sections

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.OfEssentiallySmall.restrictionTensorIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0E8I over a site with large objects.** For a sheaf of modules `F` on `X`, the
extension by zero of `G ⊗ F|_U` is the extension by zero of `G`, tensored with `F`, naturally
in `G`.

The attribute records the shape at which this holds: the objects of `C` form a type in an
arbitrary universe `c`, but the morphisms, the structure sheaf and the modules all lie in one
universe `u`, and `C` is required to be essentially `u`-small. The tag is carried in full by
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.ExtensionByZero.extensionByZeroTensorIso`, where objects, morphisms,
ring and modules lie in a single universe — the faithful reading of the tag's ringed site, which
this statement specializes to at `c := u`; that registration stands and this one does not
replace it.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def restrictionTensorIso
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf X.O)) :
