declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_extendScalarsDerived_derivedGlobalSections_iso_of_etale
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [Etale f] :
    Nonempty ((StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.extendScalarsDerived
        (Stacks.LocalCohomology.frobeniusOfNatCastEqZero A p Fact.out hp0)).obj
        ((derivedGlobalSectionsOver f).obj (derivedStructureSheaf V)) ≅
      (derivedGlobalSectionsOver f).obj (derivedStructureSheaf V))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtalePuncturedSpectrum.exists_directSum_injectiveHull_residueField
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECB.** Let `A` be a regular local ring containing a field `k`, let
`f : V ⟶ Spec A` be étale and quasi-compact, and suppose `f` factors as `g ≫ U.ι` through the
punctured spectrum `U = Spec A ∖ V(𝔪)` with `g` affine. Then for every `i > 0` the `A`-module
`H ⁱ(V, 𝒪_V)` is a direct sum of copies of an injective hull `E` of the residue field of `A`.

The index set and the isomorphism are not determined by the statement.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_directSum_injectiveHull_residueField
    (A k E : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] [Field k] [Algebra k A]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module A E]
    {V : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [Etale f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (g : V ⟶ (complementZeroLocus A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) : Scheme)) [IsAffineHom g]
    (hg : g ≫ (complementZeroLocus A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)).ι = f)
    (i : ModuleCat.of A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ⟶ ModuleCat.of A E) [Mono i]
    (hi : Module.IsInjectiveHull i) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ J : Type u, Nonempty (structureSheafCohomology f n ≃ₗ[A] DirectSum J (fun _ => E))

declarations.name: Stacks.SpectralSequence.isZero_derivedTensorHomology_zero_singleHomology_zero
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_derivedTensorHomology_zero_singleHomology_zero
    (K L : DerivedCategory.Minus (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (habut : IsZero (derivedTensorHomology A K.1 L.1 0))
    (hneg : ∀ q : ℤ, q < 0 →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) q).obj K.1))
    (hTor : ∀ r : ℤ, 2 ≤ r →
      IsZero (derivedTensorHomology A (singleHomology A K.1 (r - 1)) L.1 (-r))) :
    IsZero (derivedTensorHomology A (singleHomology A K.1 0) L.1 0)
declarations.comment: the cohomological step: the tensor spectral sequence at the origin

declarations.name: Stacks.PuncturedSpectrum.isAffine_of_cohomologyOverBase_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0ECC], the proof assembled, with the source's own degree bound.** In the
situation of [Stacks, Tag 0ECB], write `d` for the Krull dimension of `A`. If
`H ⁿ(V, 𝒪_V) = 0` for every `n ≥ d - 1`, then `V` is affine.

Both inputs the source cites are discharged: the abutment `H⁰(RΓ(V, 𝒪_V) ⊗^L_A A/𝔪) = 0` by
`Stacks.PuncturedSpectrum.isZero_derivedTensor_derivedSectionsOverBase_residueField`, and the
vanishing of `Tor_r^A(H^{r-1}(V, 𝒪_V), A/𝔪)` for `2 ≤ r < d` by
`Stacks.PuncturedSpectrum.isZero_derivedTensorHomology_cohomologyOverBase_residueField`. See the
module documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffine_of_cohomologyOverBase_vanishing (A k : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsRegularLocalRing A] [Field k] [Algebra k A] {V : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : V ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [Etale f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (g : V ⟶ (Stacks.LocalCohomology.puncturedSpectrum (CommRingCat.of A) : Scheme))
    [IsAffineHom g]
    (hg : g ≫ (Stacks.LocalCohomology.puncturedSpectrum (CommRingCat.of A)).ι = f)
    (hvanish : ∀ n : ℕ, ((ringKrullDim A).unbotD 0).toNat - 1 ≤ n →
      IsZero (cohomologyOverBase A f (SheafOfModules.unit V.ringCatSheaf) n)) :
    IsAffine V
declarations.comment: the proof assembled under the source's own hypotheses: the cohomology vanishing above dim(A) - 1 is the hypothesis of the tag, and both cited inputs are proved — the abutment H⁰(RΓ(V,𝒪_V) ⊗^L_A A/𝔪) = 0 by computing the derived tensor product on an injective resolution against the Koszul complex of a generating family of the maximal ideal, which is acyclic because the standard opens of the generators cover V, and the Tor vanishing from Tags 0ECB and 0EBT

declarations.name: Stacks.PuncturedSpectrum.isAffine_of_subsingleton_quotTensor_globalSections
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0ECC], the final step of the proof.** In the situation of [Stacks, Tag 0ECB] —
`A` a regular local ring containing a field `k`, `f : V ⟶ Spec A` étale and quasi-compact, and
the structure morphism factored through the punctured spectrum `Spec A \ {𝔪}` by an affine
morphism `g` — if `H⁰(V, 𝒪_V) ⊗_A A/𝔪 = 0`, then `V` is affine.

This is the last paragraph of the source's proof: the vanishing of the residue tensor product
says that a system of generators of `𝔪` maps to a system of generators of the unit ideal of
`Γ(V, 𝒪_V)`, so the affine opens `V_{x_i}` cover `V`.

What the source derives this vanishing from — the hypothesis `H^i(V, 𝒪_V) = 0` for
`i ≥ dim(A) - 1`, Tag 0ECB, Tag 0EBT and cohomology and base change — is not formalized here;
see the module documentation.

The hypotheses of Tag 0ECB that this step does not use are nevertheless imposed, so that the
statement is literally in the situation of that lemma. The ambient algebra structure on
`Γ(V, 𝒪_V)` is required to be the one induced by `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffine_of_subsingleton_quotTensor_globalSections
    (A _k : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] [Field _k] [Algebra _k A]
    {V : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [Etale f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (g : V ⟶ (LocalCohomology.puncturedSpectrum (CommRingCat.of A) : Scheme)) [IsAffineHom g]
    (hg : g ≫ (LocalCohomology.puncturedSpectrum (CommRingCat.of A)).ι = f)
    [Algebra A Γ(V, ⊤)] (halg : algebraMap A Γ(V, ⊤) = baseHom f)
    (hzero : Subsingleton ((A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ⊗[A] Γ(V, ⊤))) :
    IsAffine V
declarations.comment: the final step: affineness once the residue field kills the global sections

declarations.name: Stacks.PuncturedSpectrum.isZero_derivedTensorHomology_cohomologyOverBase_residueField
declarations.doc:
**The incoming terms of the tensor spectral sequence of [Stacks, Tag 0ECC].** In the situation
of [Stacks, Tag 0ECB] — `A` a regular local ring containing a field `k`, `f : V ⟶ Spec A` étale
and quasi-compact, and the structure morphism factored through the punctured spectrum by an affine
morphism `g` — write `d` for the Krull dimension of `A`. Then for every `n > 0` and every
`r ≠ d`,
`Tor_r^A(H ⁿ(V, 𝒪_V), A ⧸ 𝔪) = 0`,
in the derived form `H ^{-r}(H ⁿ(V, 𝒪_V)[0] ⊗ᴸ_A (A ⧸ 𝔪)[0]) = 0`.

By [Stacks, Tag 0ECB] the cohomology is a direct sum of copies of an injective hull of the residue
field, by [Stacks, Tag 0EBT] each copy contributes nothing away from the dimension, and the
derived tensor product commutes with the direct sum.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_derivedTensorHomology_cohomologyOverBase_residueField (A k : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsRegularLocalRing A] [Field k] [Algebra k A] {V : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : V ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [Etale f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (g : V ⟶ (LocalCohomology.puncturedSpectrum (CommRingCat.of A) : Scheme)) [IsAffineHom g]
    (hg : g ≫ (LocalCohomology.puncturedSpectrum (CommRingCat.of A)).ι = f)
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim A = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (r : ℤ)
    (hr : r ≠ (d : ℤ)) :
    IsZero (derivedTensorHomology A
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
        (cohomologyOverBase A f (SheafOfModules.unit V.ringCatSheaf) n))
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))) (-r))
declarations.comment: the incoming terms of the tensor spectral sequence: Tor_r(H ⁿ(V,𝒪_V), A/𝔪) = 0 for n > 0 and r ≠ dim A, from Tags 0ECB and 0EBT

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.derivedSectionsMinus
declarations.doc:
**`RΓ(V, F)` as an object of the bounded above derived category `D⁻(A)`,** given a bound
above which the cohomology of `F` on `V` vanishes.

Together with `Stacks.LocalCohomology.nonempty_homology_derivedSectionsOverBase_iso` and
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.isGE_derivedSectionsOverBase` this is the complex `RΓ(V, 𝒪_V)` the proof
of [Stacks, Tag 0ECC] feeds to its spectral sequence: an object of `D⁻(A)` with no cohomology in
negative degrees whose cohomology in degree `p` is `H^p(V, 𝒪_V)`.

The attribute is qualified: this is the construction of that complex, not the whole tag. The
remaining steps need Tags 08IB, 0ECB and 0EBT, none of which the library carries; see the module
documentation.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSectionsMinus (f : V ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} V.ringCatSheaf) (a : ℤ)
    (hvanish : ∀ n : ℕ, a < (n : ℤ) → IsZero (cohomologyOverBase.{u, u} A f F n)) :
    DerivedCategory.Minus (ModuleCat.{u} A)
declarations.comment: the complex RΓ(V, 𝒪_V) of A-modules, bounded above and concentrated in degrees ≥ 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.MaximalEtaleOpen.isAffineHom_maximalEtaleOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECD.** Let `Y` be an excellent regular scheme over a field `k`, let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of finite type with `X` normal, and let `V ⊆ X` be the maximal open
subscheme on which `f` is étale. Then the inclusion `V ⟶ X` is affine.

`Y` regular is `AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular` ([Stacks, Tag 02IS]); `Y` excellent is the existence
around every point of an affine open neighbourhood whose ring of sections is excellent, which is
the definition of an excellent scheme; `Y` over a field is a morphism `g : Y ⟶ Spec k`; finite
type is `LocallyOfFiniteType` with `QuasiCompact`; `X` normal is `AlgebraicGeometry.IsNormal`
([Stacks, Tag 033I]); and "the maximal open subscheme where `f` is étale" is an open `V` that is
the greatest element of the set of opens `U` with `U.ι ≫ f` étale. The proof uses purity of the
ramification locus, `AlgebraicGeometry.etaleAt_of_etaleAt_codimensionOne` ([Stacks, Tag 0EA4]),
and [Stacks, Tag 0ECC], `Stacks.PuncturedSpectrum.isAffine_of_cohomologyOverBase_vanishing`; see
the module documentation. Quasi-compactness of `f` is not used by the argument.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_maximalEtaleOpen
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsNormal X]
    (hYregular : IsRegular Y)
    (hYexcellent : ∀ y : Y, ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, y ∈ U.1 ∧ IsExcellent Γ(Y, U))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsGreatest {U : X.Opens | Etale (U.ι ≫ f)} V) :
    IsAffineHom V.ι

declarations.name: universally_catenary
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a Noetherian ring such that every finite-type `A`-algebra has catenary spectrum.
Then every `A`-algebra `S` essentially of finite type is Noetherian, and every finite-type
`S`-algebra has catenary spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem universally_catenary
    (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hA : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.FiniteType A B],
            IrreducibleClosedsCodim.IsCatenarySpace (PrimeSpectrum B))
    (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra A S] [Algebra.EssFiniteType A S] :
    IsNoetherianRing S ∧
    (∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra S C] [Algebra.FiniteType S C],
       IrreducibleClosedsCodim.IsCatenarySpace (PrimeSpectrum C))

declarations.name: catenary_iff_isDimensionFunction
declarations.doc:
A Noetherian local ring `A` is catenary if and only if `p ↦ dim(A ⧸ p)` is a dimension function
on `PrimeSpectrum A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem catenary_iff_isDimensionFunction
    (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] :
    IsCatenaryRingSaturated A ↔ IsDimensionFunctionProp (X := PrimeSpectrum A) deltaDim

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDim_le_of_isIntegralHom
declarations.doc: The dimension of the source of an integral morphism is at most the dimension of its target.
declarations.statement:
lemma topologicalKrullDim_le_of_isIntegralHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsIntegralHom f] :
    topologicalKrullDim X ≤ topologicalKrullDim Y
declarations.comment: dimension inequality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegralHom_of_surjective
declarations.doc: A surjective integral morphism has source and target of the same dimension.
declarations.statement:
lemma topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegralHom_of_surjective {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsIntegralHom f] [Surjective f] :
    topologicalKrullDim X = topologicalKrullDim Y
declarations.comment: surjective case

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECI.** The standing situation for a pushout along a
closed immersion and an integral morphism.
declarations.statement: structure PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.exists_affineOpens_preimage_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECJ.**  Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion and `j : Z ⟶ Y` an
integral morphism such that every fibre of `j` maps under `i` into an affine open of `X`.  Then
every `y : Y` has an affine open neighbourhood `V` whose preimage under `j` is the preimage under
`i` of an affine open `U` of `X`.

The argument of the source, run twice.  Shrinking `Y` around `y` makes `j ⁻¹ᵁ V₀` land inside
`i ⁻¹ᵁ U₀`; separating the fibre by a basic open of `U₀` inside the open `W` with
`i ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ V₀` reverses that inclusion.  Shrinking a second time and pulling the resulting
function on `V₀` back along the closed immersion makes the two preimages equal, because the basic
open of the pullback of `g` is cut out of `i ⁻¹ᵁ U₁` by `j ⁻¹ᵁ (Y.basicOpen g)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affineOpens_preimage_eq (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [IsIntegralHom j]
    (hfib : ∀ y : Y, ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ ∀ z : Z, j z = y → i z ∈ U) (y : Y) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens), IsAffineOpen U ∧ IsAffineOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧
      i ⁻¹ᵁ U = j ⁻¹ᵁ V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.primedFiber_preimage_subset_affine
declarations.doc:
The primed span of a cartesian diagram satisfies the fibrewise affineness condition of a
pushout situation: every fibre of `j'` maps under `i'` into a single affine open of `X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem primedFiber_preimage_subset_affine
    (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u}) (d : CartesianDiagram s) :
    ∀ y : d.Y', ∃ U : d.X'.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∀ z : d.Z', d.j' z = y → d.i' z ∈ U
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pushoutMap_left_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECK, part (3).** The square relating the two canonical maps from `X`
and `X'` to the two pushouts is cartesian.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushoutMap_left_isPullback
    (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u}) (d : CartesianDiagram s) :
    IsPullback (pushoutInl (inducedSituation s d)) d.f (pushoutMap s d) (pushoutInl s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pushoutMap_right_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECK, part (3).** The square relating the two canonical maps from `Y`
and `Y'` to the two pushouts is cartesian.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushoutMap_right_isPullback
    (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u}) (d : CartesianDiagram s) :
    IsPullback (pushoutInr (inducedSituation s d)) d.g (pushoutMap s d) (pushoutInr s)
declarations.comment: part (3), the Y square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pushoutMap_isSeparated
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 0ECK, part (2).** The induced morphism of pushouts is separated.
declarations.statement:
instance pushoutMap_isSeparated
    (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u}) (d : CartesianDiagram s) :
    IsSeparated (pushoutMap s d)
declarations.comment: part (2), separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pushoutMap_locallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECK, part (2).** The induced morphism of pushouts is locally of finite
type.
declarations.statement:
instance pushoutMap_locallyOfFiniteType
    (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u}) (d : CartesianDiagram s) :

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pushoutMap_locallyQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECK, part (2).** The induced morphism of pushouts has locally
quasi-finite fibres.
declarations.statement:
instance pushoutMap_locallyQuasiFinite
    (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u}) (d : CartesianDiagram s) :

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_pushoutMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECL.** The morphism of pushouts induced by a cartesian triple whose
three vertical morphisms are flat is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_pushoutMap (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u})
    (d : CartesianDiagram s) [Flat d.f] [Flat d.g] [Flat d.h] :
    Flat (pushoutMap s d)
declarations.comment: flatness of the pushout map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etale_pushoutMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECL.** The morphism of pushouts induced by a cartesian triple whose
three vertical morphisms are étale is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem etale_pushoutMap (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u})
    (d : CartesianDiagram s) [Etale d.f] [Etale d.g] [Etale d.h] :
    Etale (pushoutMap s d)
declarations.comment: étaleness of the pushout map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flatTriple_pushout_equivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECL.** The pushout construction is an equivalence from the cartesian
triples with flat vertical morphisms to the flat, separated, locally quasi-finite schemes over
the pushout.  On objects it is the pushout of the triple together with its canonical morphism to
`Y ⨿_Z X`, and on morphisms it is the morphism of pushouts induced by the three components.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatTriple_pushout_equivalence
    (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u}) :
    ∃ F : FlatCartesianTriple s ⥤ flatSchemesOver s,
      F.IsEquivalence ∧
      (∀ d, (F.obj d).1 = Over.mk (pushoutMap s d.1)) ∧
      (∀ (d e : FlatCartesianTriple s) (m : CartesianTripleHom d.1 e.1),
        ∃ k : pushoutScheme (inducedSituation s d.1) ⟶
            pushoutScheme (inducedSituation s e.1),
          HEq (((F.map m).1).left) k ∧
          (pushoutInl (inducedSituation s d.1) ≫ k =
            m.x ≫ pushoutInl (inducedSituation s e.1)) ∧
          (pushoutInr (inducedSituation s d.1) ≫ k =
            m.y ≫ pushoutInr (inducedSituation s e.1)))
declarations.comment: flat equivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etaleTriple_pushout_equivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECL.** The pushout construction is an equivalence from the cartesian
triples with étale vertical morphisms to the étale, separated, locally quasi-finite schemes over
the pushout.  On objects it is the pushout of the triple together with its canonical morphism to
`Y ⨿_Z X`, and on morphisms it is the morphism of pushouts induced by the three components.
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleTriple_pushout_equivalence
    (s : PushoutAlongClosedImmersionAndIntegralSituation.{u}) :
    ∃ F : EtaleCartesianTriple s ⥤ etaleSchemesOver s,
      F.IsEquivalence ∧
      (∀ d, (F.obj d).1 = Over.mk (pushoutMap s d.1)) ∧
      (∀ (d e : EtaleCartesianTriple s) (m : CartesianTripleHom d.1 e.1),
        ∃ k : pushoutScheme (inducedSituation s d.1) ⟶
            pushoutScheme (inducedSituation s e.1),
          HEq (((F.map m).1).left) k ∧
          (pushoutInl (inducedSituation s d.1) ≫ k =
            m.x ≫ pushoutInl (inducedSituation s e.1)) ∧
          (pushoutInr (inducedSituation s d.1) ≫ k =
            m.y ≫ pushoutInr (inducedSituation s e.1)))
declarations.comment: étale equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.extSheaf_stalk_degree_range_of_isDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECM, clause (1).** For a coherent module `F` on a locally Noetherian
scheme and a dualizing complex `K` with associated dimension function `δ`, a nonzero stalk of the
Ext sheaf `𝓔ⁱ = 𝓔xt^{-i}(F, K)` at `x` forces `δ(x) ≤ i ≤ δ(x) + dim Supp(F_x)`; in particular that
dimension is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem extSheaf_stalk_degree_range_of_isDualizingComplex (F : X.Modules)
    [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F] {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules}
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) (x : X) (i : ℤ)
    (hi : Nontrivial ↑((extSheafOf F K i).presheaf.stalk x)) :
    associatedShiftFunction K x ≤ i ∧ ∃ d : ℕ,
      Module.supportDim ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x) ↑(F.presheaf.stalk x) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        i ≤ associatedShiftFunction K x + d
declarations.comment: clause (1): E^i_x ≠ 0 → δ(x) ≤ i ≤ δ(x) + dim Supp(F_x), for E^i the Ext sheaf Ext^{-i}(F, K) of a dualizing complex K with its associated dimension function δ

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.supportDim_extSheaf_stalk_le_of_isDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECM, clause (2).** The stalk of `𝓔^{i + δ(x)}` at `x` has support of
dimension at most `i`; for `i < 0` the bound is `⊥`, which says that the stalk vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportDim_extSheaf_stalk_le_of_isDualizingComplex (F : X.Modules)
    [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F] {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules}
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) (x : X) (i : ℤ) :
    Module.supportDim ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ↑((extSheafOf F K (i + associatedShiftFunction K x)).presheaf.stalk x) ≤
      if 0 ≤ i then ((i.toNat : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) else ⊥
declarations.comment: clause (2): dim Supp(E^{i + δ(x)}_x) ≤ i, for E^i the Ext sheaf Ext^{-i}(F, K) of a dualizing complex K with its associated dimension function δ

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.depth_stalk_eq_iInf_nontrivial_extSheaf_stalk_of_isDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECM, clause (3).** The depth of `F_x` is the least `i ≥ 0` for which the
stalk of `𝓔^{i + δ(x)}` at `x` is nonzero. If all of these stalks vanish, both sides are `⊤`.
declarations.statement:
theorem depth_stalk_eq_iInf_nontrivial_extSheaf_stalk_of_isDualizingComplex (F : X.Modules)
    [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F] {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules}
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) (x : X) :
    Module.depth ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x))
        ↑(F.presheaf.stalk x) =
      ⨅ (k : ℕ) (_ : Nontrivial
        ↑((extSheafOf F K ((k : ℤ) + associatedShiftFunction K x)).presheaf.stalk x)), (k : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: clause (3): depth(F_x) = least i ≥ 0 with E^{i + δ(x)}_x ≠ 0, for E^i the Ext sheaf Ext^{-i}(F, K) of a dualizing complex K with its associated dimension function δ

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.exists_nontrivial_extSheaf_stalk_iff_depth_add_le_of_isDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECM, clause (4).** A point `x` lies in the support of `⨁_{j ≤ i} 𝓔^j` —
that is, some `𝓔^j` with `j ≤ i` has nonzero stalk at `x` — exactly when the depth of `F_x` is
finite and `depth(F_x) + δ(x) ≤ i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_extSheaf_stalk_iff_depth_add_le_of_isDualizingComplex (F : X.Modules)
    [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F] {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules}
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) (x : X) (i : ℤ) :
    (∃ j : ℤ, j ≤ i ∧ Nontrivial ↑((extSheafOf F K j).presheaf.stalk x)) ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, Module.depth ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)) ↑(F.presheaf.stalk x) = (n : ℕ∞) ∧
          (n : ℤ) + associatedShiftFunction K x ≤ i
declarations.comment: clause (4): x ∈ Supp(⊕_{j ≤ i} E^j) ↔ depth(F_x) + δ(x) ≤ i, for E^i the Ext sheaf Ext^{-i}(F, K) of a dualizing complex K with its associated dimension function δ

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isCoherent_extSheafOf
declarations.doc:
**The first assertion of [Stacks, Tag 0ECM].** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme, `K` a
dualizing complex on `X` and `F` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module. Then every Ext sheaf
`𝓔ⁱ = 𝓔xt^{-i}_{𝒪_X}(F, K)` is a coherent `𝒪_X`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_extSheafOf (F : X.Modules) [hF : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F]
    {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) (i : ℤ) :
    _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent (extSheafOf F K i)
declarations.comment: the coherence assertion: for F coherent on a locally Noetherian scheme and K a dualizing complex, each Ext sheaf E^i = Ext^{-i}(F, K) is a coherent O_X-module

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.extSheaf_stalk_degree_range
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECM, clause (1).** For a coherent module `F` on a locally Noetherian
scheme and a dualizing complex `K` with dimension function `δ`, a nonzero stalk of the Ext sheaf
`𝓔ⁱ` at `x` forces `δ(x) ≤ i ≤ δ(x) + dim Supp(F_x)`; in particular that dimension is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem extSheaf_stalk_degree_range (F : X.Modules) [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F]
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (δ : X → ℤ) (E : ℤ → X.Modules)
    (hE : IsStalkwiseDualExt F K δ E) (x : X) (i : ℤ)
    (hi : Nontrivial ↑((E i).presheaf.stalk x)) :
    δ x ≤ i ∧ ∃ d : ℕ,
      Module.supportDim ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x) ↑(F.presheaf.stalk x) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        i ≤ δ x + d
declarations.comment: clause (1): E^i_x ≠ 0 → δ(x) ≤ i ≤ δ(x) + dim Supp(F_x), given IsStalkwiseDualExt

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.supportDim_extSheaf_stalk_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECM, clause (2).** The stalk of `𝓔^{i + δ(x)}` at `x` has support of
dimension at most `i`; for `i < 0` the bound is `⊥`, which says that the stalk vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportDim_extSheaf_stalk_le (F : X.Modules) [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F]
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (δ : X → ℤ) (E : ℤ → X.Modules)
    (hE : IsStalkwiseDualExt F K δ E) (x : X) (i : ℤ) :
    Module.supportDim ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x) ↑((E (i + δ x)).presheaf.stalk x) ≤
      if 0 ≤ i then ((i.toNat : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) else ⊥
declarations.comment: clause (2): dim Supp(E^{i + δ(x)}_x) ≤ i, given IsStalkwiseDualExt

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.depth_stalk_eq_iInf_nontrivial_extSheaf_stalk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECM, clause (3).** The depth of `F_x` is the least `i ≥ 0` for which
the stalk of `𝓔^{i + δ(x)}` at `x` is nonzero.  If all of these stalks vanish, both sides are
`⊤`.
declarations.statement:
theorem depth_stalk_eq_iInf_nontrivial_extSheaf_stalk (F : X.Modules)
    [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F] (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (δ : X → ℤ)
    (E : ℤ → X.Modules) (hE : IsStalkwiseDualExt F K δ E) (x : X) :
    Module.depth ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x))
        ↑(F.presheaf.stalk x) =
      ⨅ (k : ℕ) (_ : Nontrivial ↑((E ((k : ℤ) + δ x)).presheaf.stalk x)), (k : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: clause (3): depth(F_x) = least i ≥ 0 with E^{i + δ(x)}_x ≠ 0, given IsStalkwiseDualExt

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.exists_nontrivial_extSheaf_stalk_iff_depth_add_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECM, clause (4).** A point `x` lies in the support of
`⨁_{j ≤ i} 𝓔^j` — that is, some `𝓔^j` with `j ≤ i` has nonzero stalk at `x` — exactly when the
depth of `F_x` is finite and `depth(F_x) + δ(x) ≤ i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_extSheaf_stalk_iff_depth_add_le (F : X.Modules)
    [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F] (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (δ : X → ℤ)
    (E : ℤ → X.Modules) (hE : IsStalkwiseDualExt F K δ E) (x : X) (i : ℤ) :
    (∃ j : ℤ, j ≤ i ∧ Nontrivial ↑((E j).presheaf.stalk x)) ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, Module.depth ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)) ↑(F.presheaf.stalk x) = (n : ℕ∞) ∧
          (n : ℤ) + δ x ≤ i
declarations.comment: clause (4): x ∈ Supp(⊕_{j ≤ i} E^j) ↔ depth(F_x) + δ(x) ≤ i, given IsStalkwiseDualExt

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finite_setOf_depth_eq_and_lt_supportDim
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECN.**  Let `X` be a Noetherian scheme with a dualizing complex `K`,
let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let `k ≥ 0` be an integer.  If `F` satisfies Serre's
condition `(Sₖ)`, then there are only finitely many points `x ∈ X` with

`depth(F_x) = k` and `dim Supp(F_x) > k`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_setOf_depth_eq_and_lt_supportDim (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.Modules] {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules}
    (hK : Stacks.Duality.IsDualizingComplex K) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] (k : ℕ)
    (hF : SheafHasPropertySk X F k) :
    {x : X |
        Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
            (F.presheaf.stalk x) = (k : ℕ∞) ∧
          (k : WithBot ℕ∞) <
            Module.supportDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) (F.presheaf.stalk x)}.Finite

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_add_le
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0ECP].** For finitely generated ideals `I` and `J` of a commutative ring `A`,
the cohomological dimension of `I + J` is at most the sum of those of `I` and `J`, bounded below
by `-1` because a cohomological dimension always is.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_add_le (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I J : Ideal A)
    (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) :
    cohomologicalDimension A (I + J) (Submodule.FG.sup hI hJ) ≤
      max (-1 : ℤ) (cohomologicalDimension A I hI + cohomologicalDimension A J hJ)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isConnected_zeroLocus_diff_and_isConnected_puncturedSpectrum_quotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ECR** (Varbaro, Theorem 1.6). Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian complete
local ring and `I` a proper ideal of `A`. Set `X = Spec(A)` and `Y = V(I)`, and denote by

1. `d` the minimal dimension of an irreducible component of `X`
   (`minDimIrreducibleComponent`), and
2. `c` the minimal dimension of a closed subset `Z ⊆ X` such that `X ∖ Z` is disconnected
   (`minDimDisconnectingClosed`).

Then for `Z ⊆ Y` closed, `Y ∖ Z` is connected if `dim(Z) < min(c, d - 1) - cd(A, I)`. In
particular, the punctured spectrum of `A/I` is connected if `cd(A, I) < min(c, d - 1)`.

Both minima are attained (`exists_irreducibleComponent_topologicalKrullDim_eq_minDim`,
`exists_isClosed_not_isConnected_compl_topologicalKrullDim_eq_minDim`). The dimension of `Z` is
its Krull dimension, `⊥` for `Z = ∅`, compared with the integer `min(c, d - 1) - cd(A, I)` in the
extended integers. The punctured spectrum of `A/I` is the set of its non-maximal primes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConnected_zeroLocus_diff_and_isConnected_puncturedSpectrum_quotient
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal A) A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    (∀ Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum A), IsClosed Z → Z ⊆ zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
      krullDimToEInt (topologicalKrullDim Z) <
        ((min (minDimDisconnectingClosed (PrimeSpectrum A) : ℤ)
            ((minDimIrreducibleComponent (PrimeSpectrum A) : ℤ) - 1) -
          cohomologicalDimension A I I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing : ℤ) : EInt) →
      IsConnected (zeroLocus (I : Set A) \ Z)) ∧
    (cohomologicalDimension A I I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing <
        min (minDimDisconnectingClosed (PrimeSpectrum A) : ℤ)
          ((minDimIrreducibleComponent (PrimeSpectrum A) : ℤ) - 1) →
      IsConnected {p : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ I) | ¬ p.asIdeal.IsMaximal})
declarations.comment: both assertions: the connectedness of Y ∖ Z for closed Z ⊆ Y with dim(Z) < min(c, d - 1) - cd(A, I), and of the punctured spectrum of A/I when cd(A, I) < min(c, d - 1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_etale_iff_forall_affine_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ECT, conditions (1) and (2).** Étale-local constructibility can be tested on
affine étale charts, where it becomes constructibility.
declarations.statement:
theorem forall_etale_iff_forall_affine_etale :
    IsEtaleLocallyConstructible B S hS X E ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
        ∀ (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X), IsEtale B S hS f →
          IsConstructible (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) f ⁻¹' E)
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_etale_iff_exists_surjective_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ECT, conditions (1) and (3).** Étale-local constructibility holds as soon as it
holds on a single surjective étale chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem forall_etale_iff_exists_surjective_etale (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsEtaleLocallyConstructible B S hS X E ↔
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
        IsSurjective B S hS f ∧ IsEtale B S hS f ∧
          IsLocallyConstructible (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) f ⁻¹' E)
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsEtaleLocallyConstructible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ECU.** A subset of the points of a presheaf on the big fppf site of `S` is
*étale locally constructible* when its inverse image on every étale chart from a scheme is a
locally constructible subset of that chart.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsEtaleLocallyConstructible : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtaleLocallyConstructible_preimage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ECW.** The inverse image of an étale-locally constructible subset of the points
of an algebraic space over `S` under a morphism of algebraic spaces is étale locally
constructible.

A surjective étale chart `q : h_V ⟶ Y` of the target lifts by Stacks 02X1 to a surjective
étale chart `p : h_U ⟶ X` of the source together with a morphism `α : U ⟶ V` of the site over
`f`. Read through the homeomorphisms of Stacks 03BX, the inverse image of `E` on `U` is the
inverse image along the scheme morphism underlying `α` of the inverse image of `E` on `V`, so
it is locally constructible by Stacks 054I; one surjective chart suffices by Stacks 0ECT.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtaleLocallyConstructible_preimage
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (E : Set (points B S hS Y)) (hE : IsEtaleLocallyConstructible B S hS Y E) :
    IsEtaleLocallyConstructible B S hS X (pointsMap B S hS X f ⁻¹' E)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtaleLocallyConstructible_image
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ECX, Chevalley's theorem for algebraic spaces.** The image of an étale-locally
constructible subset of the points of an algebraic space over `S` under a quasi-compact
morphism locally of finite presentation is étale locally constructible.

By Stacks 0ECT it is enough to test the image on an affine étale chart `g : h_V ⟶ Y`. The
base change `h_V ×_Y X` is a quasi-compact algebraic space because `g` has quasi-compact
source and `f` is quasi-compact, so it has an affine surjective étale chart `t : h_T ⟶
h_V ×_Y X` by Stacks 03H6. The chart `T` sits over `V` by a morphism `q` of the site and over
`X` by an étale chart, so the inverse image of `E` on `T` is constructible, and `q` is a
morphism of affine schemes which is locally of finite presentation because `f` is; Chevalley's
theorem for schemes therefore makes its image constructible. That image is the inverse image
of the image of `E` under `g`, which is where Stacks 03H4 and surjectivity of `t` on points
are used.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtaleLocallyConstructible_image
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f) (hfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f)
    (E : Set (points B S hS X)) (hE : IsEtaleLocallyConstructible B S hS X E) :
    IsEtaleLocallyConstructible B S hS Y (pointsMap B S hS X f '' E)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasTranscendenceDegreeAt_zero_of_isFiniteTypePoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ECY.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is
locally of finite type, with `Y` Jacobson. Then the transcendence degree of a finite type
point `x` of `X` over its image is zero.

The Jacobson hypothesis is the étale-local property of Tag 03E6 for `JacobsonSpace`, written
out as one surjective étale atlas by a Jacobson scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTranscendenceDegreeAt_zero_of_isFiniteTypePoint
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hJac : ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) b ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) b ∧
      JacobsonSpace ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V))
    (x : points B S hS X) (hx : IsFiniteTypePoint B S hS X x) :
    HasTranscendenceDegreeAt B S hS f x 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtaleLocallyConstructible_iff_isLocallyConstructible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ECZ.** A subset of the point space of a quasi-separated algebraic space over `S`
is étale locally constructible exactly when it is locally constructible.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtaleLocallyConstructible_iff_isLocallyConstructible
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal X)
    (E : Set (points B S hS X)) :
    IsEtaleLocallyConstructible B S hS X E ↔ IsLocallyConstructible E

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dimension_le_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED0.** The dimension of the source of a locally quasi-finite morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S` is at most the dimension of its target.
declarations.statement:
theorem dimension_le_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f) :
    dimension B S hS X hX ≤ dimension B S hS Y hY

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.codimension_eq_localRingDimension
declarations.doc:
For an irreducible closed subset `T` of the point space of a decent algebraic space over `S`,
with generic point `ξ`, the codimension of `T` is the dimension of the local ring of the space
at `ξ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem codimension_eq_localRingDimension (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) (T : IrreducibleCloseds (points B S hS X))
    (ξ : points B S hS X) (hξ : IsGenericPoint ξ (T : Set (points B S hS X))) :
    codimension T = localRingDimension B S hS ξ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.stacksSober_properGeneralizations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED2, sobriety.** The proper generalizations of a point `x` of a decent
algebraic space over `S` form a sober topological space, sobriety being that of Stacks 004X:
every irreducible closed subset has a unique generic point.
declarations.comment: sobriety

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spectralSpace_properGeneralizations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED2, spectrality.** The proper generalizations of a point `x` of a decent
locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S` form a spectral topological space.
declarations.statement:
theorem spectralSpace_properGeneralizations (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun Y : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsLocallyNoetherian Y))
    (x : points B S hS X) :
    SpectralSpace {x' : points B S hS X // x' ⤳ x ∧ x' ≠ x}
declarations.comment: spectrality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.jacobsonSpace_properGeneralizations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED2, the Jacobson property.** The proper generalizations of a point `x` of a
decent locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S` form a Jacobson topological space.
declarations.statement:
theorem jacobsonSpace_properGeneralizations (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun Y : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsLocallyNoetherian Y))
    (x : points B S hS X) :
    JacobsonSpace {x' : points B S hS X // x' ⤳ x ∧ x' ≠ x}
declarations.comment: the Jacobson property

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.noetherianSpace_properGeneralizations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED2, the Noetherian property.** The proper generalizations of a point `x` of a
locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S` form a Noetherian topological space.
declarations.statement:
theorem noetherianSpace_properGeneralizations (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun Y : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsLocallyNoetherian Y))
    (x : points B S hS X) :
    NoetherianSpace {x' : points B S hS X // x' ⤳ x ∧ x' ≠ x}
declarations.comment: the Noetherian property

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsCatenary
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED4.** An algebraic space is catenary when its space of points, with the
topology of Tag 03BX, is a catenary topological space.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsCatenary (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.inducedDimensionValue_isDimensionFunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED5.** Let `T` be an object of the big fppf site over `S` whose underlying
scheme is locally Noetherian and universally catenary, and let `δ` be a dimension function on
that scheme. Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S`, locally of finite type over `T`, above
every point of which every étale chart by an affine scheme has a finite fibre. Then the
function sending a point `x` of `X` to the value of `δ` at the image of `x` plus the relative
transcendence degree of `x` over that image is a dimension function on the points of `X`.

The finiteness hypothesis is condition `(α)` of Stacks 03JX, which is weaker than the
condition (1) of Stacks 03JV through which Stacks 03I8 defines a decent algebraic space, and
which is all that the argument uses. Taking for `T` the terminal object
`Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hS))`, whose underlying scheme is `S`, gives the statement for the
structure morphism of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem inducedDimensionValue_isDimensionFunction
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {T : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T)]
    (hcat : Scheme.IsUniversallyCatenary ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T))
    (δ : TopologicalSpace.DimensionFunction ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T))
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hfib : HasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj T) (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    ∃ d : TopologicalSpace.DimensionFunction (points B S hS X), ∀ x : points B S hS X,
      d x = inducedDimensionValue B S hS
        (fun y ↦ δ (pointsToScheme B S hS T y)) f x
declarations.comment: with decency read as condition (alpha) of Stacks 03JX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCatenary_of_isDecentSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED6.** A decent algebraic space over `S` which is locally of finite type over an
object of the site whose scheme is locally Noetherian and universally catenary is catenary.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCatenary_of_isDecentSpace {T : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T)]
    (hcat : Scheme.IsUniversallyCatenary ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T))
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj T) (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsCatenary B S hS X hX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsUniversallyCatenary
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED7.** An algebraic space is universally catenary when every decent algebraic
space locally of finite type over it is catenary.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsUniversallyCatenary (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isUniversallyCatenary_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ED8.** An algebraic space locally of finite type over a universally catenary
algebraic space is universally catenary.

Universal catenarity of the target already quantifies over all decent algebraic spaces
locally of finite type over it, so the source needs no decency or local Noetherianity
hypothesis: a decent space locally of finite type over the source is locally of finite type
over the target by Stacks 03XG.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUniversallyCatenary_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hXcat : IsUniversallyCatenary B S hS X) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsUniversallyCatenary B S hS Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_dimensionFunction_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
Let `q : Z ⟶ X` be a surjective finite morphism of algebraic spaces and let `δ` be a function
on the points of `X`. If the pullback of `δ` along the map on points of `q` is a dimension
function, then `δ` is a dimension function.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_dimensionFunction_of_isFinite
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (q : Z ⟶ X) (hqfin : IsFinite B S hS q)
    (hqsurj : IsSurjective B S hS q) (δ : points B S hS X → ℤ)
    (hd : ∃ d : DimensionFunction (points B S hS Z), ∀ z : points B S hS Z,
      d z = δ (pointsMap B S hS Z q z)) :
    ∃ d : DimensionFunction (points B S hS X), ∀ x : points B S hS X, d x = δ x
declarations.comment: decency and local Noetherianity not needed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dimension_le_of_isIntegralHom
declarations.doc: An integral morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` does not increase the dimension.
declarations.statement:
theorem dimension_le_of_isIntegralHom (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f) :
    dimension B S hS X hX ≤ dimension B S hS Y hY
declarations.comment: dimension inequality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dimension_eq_of_isIntegralHom_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc: A surjective integral morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` preserves the dimension.
declarations.statement:
theorem dimension_eq_of_isIntegralHom_of_isSurjective (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f) :
    dimension B S hS X hX = dimension B S hS Y hY
declarations.comment: surjective case

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dimension_le_dimension_add_transcendenceDegree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDC, the dimension inequality.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a dominant morphism locally
of finite type of integral algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y` locally Noetherian, and let `x`
and `y` be generic points of `|X|` and `|Y|`. If the transcendence degree of `f` at `x` is
`r`, then `dim X ≤ dim Y + r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dimension_le_dimension_add_transcendenceDegree
    (s : IntegralDominantMorphismSituation B S hS) (r : ℕ∞)
    (hr : HasTranscendenceDegreeAt B S hS s.hom s.sourcePoint r) :
    dimension B S hS s.source s.isAlgebraicSpace_source ≤
      dimension B S hS s.target s.isAlgebraicSpace_target + (r : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: the dimension inequality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dimension_eq_dimension_add_transcendenceDegree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDC, equality for a proper morphism.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a dominant morphism
locally of finite type of integral algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y` locally Noetherian, and
let `x` and `y` be generic points of `|X|` and `|Y|`. If `f` is proper and the transcendence
degree of `f` at `x` is `r`, then `dim X = dim Y + r`.

The inequality `≤` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dimension_le_dimension_add_transcendenceDegree`.
For the reverse inequality both dimensions are read on one commuting pair of surjective étale
scheme charts `U → X` and `V → Y` (Stacks 0A4H and Stacks 02X1), so that each becomes a
topological Krull dimension and a bound on it is a chain of specializations. A chain of length
`d` in `V` gives one of length at least `d` in `|Y|` ending at `y`, since two points of an
étale chart with the same image, one a specialization of the other, are equal (Stacks 03K5);
properness makes `|f|` closed, so that chain lifts to `|X|` from any point above `y` (Stacks
0066). Below such a point
there are `r` further nontrivial specializations: the fibre of `U → V` through the chart point
above `x` has dimension at least the transcendence degree there by the dimension formula of
Stacks 02FX, and the resulting chain lies over `y`. The concatenation is a chain of length
`d + r` in `|X|`, and it lifts to the chart `U` by Stacks 03IL.
declarations.statement:
theorem dimension_eq_dimension_add_transcendenceDegree
    (s : IntegralDominantMorphismSituation B S hS) (hproper : IsProper B S hS s.hom) (r : ℕ∞)
    (hr : HasTranscendenceDegreeAt B S hS s.hom s.sourcePoint r) :
    dimension B S hS s.source s.isAlgebraicSpace_source =
      dimension B S hS s.target s.isAlgebraicSpace_target + (r : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: equality for a proper morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eulerCharacteristic_eq_finsum_eulerCharacteristic_higherDirectImage
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, `f : Y ⟶ X` a morphism of algebraic spaces proper over
`k` and `𝓖` a coherent `𝒪_Y`-module. Then only finitely many of the higher direct images
`Rⁱf_*𝓖` are nonzero, each is coherent, and
`χ(Y, 𝓖) = ∑ᵢ (-1)ⁱ χ(X, Rⁱf_*𝓖)`.

Here `𝓖` has sections in the universe of the structure sheaf, where `Rⁱf_*` exists, and both
Euler characteristics are taken of universe lifts.
declarations.statement:
theorem eulerCharacteristic_eq_finsum_eulerCharacteristic_higherDirectImage (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (πX : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk)) (hπX : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk πX)
    (πY : Y.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk)) (hπY : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk πY)
    (G : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y.1 Y.2)
    [hG : IsCoherent B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y.1 Y.2 G] :
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y.1 Y.2
    have := isCoherent_higherDirectImage_of_isProper_toBase k B hk f πX hπX πY hπY G
    {i : ℕ | ¬ IsZero (((modulePushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk f).rightDerived i).obj G)}.Finite ∧
      eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k B hk Y.1 Y.2 πY hπY
          (SheafOfModules.uliftForPresentation.{u + 1, u, u, u, max (u + 1) w} G) =
        ∑ᶠ i : ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i * eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k B hk X.1 X.2 πX hπX
          (SheafOfModules.uliftForPresentation.{u + 1, u, u, u, max (u + 1) w}
            (((modulePushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk f).rightDerived i).obj G))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_eulerCharacteristic_eq_finsum_eulerCharacteristic_higherDirectImage
declarations.doc:
For a coherent module `𝓖'` with sections in the universe of the Euler characteristic: `𝓖'` is
the universe lift of a coherent module `𝓖` with sections in the universe of the structure sheaf,
only finitely many `Rⁱf_*𝓖` are nonzero, and `χ(Y, 𝓖') = ∑ᵢ (-1)ⁱ χ(X, Rⁱf_*𝓖)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_eulerCharacteristic_eq_finsum_eulerCharacteristic_higherDirectImage (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (πX : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk)) (hπX : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk πX)
    (πY : Y.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk)) (hπY : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk πY)
    (G' : Modules.{u, max (u + 1) w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y.1 Y.2)
    [IsCoherent B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y.1 Y.2 G'] :
    ∃ (G : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y.1 Y.2)
      (_ : IsCoherent B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y.1 Y.2 G)
      (_ : SheafOfModules.uliftForPresentation.{u + 1, u, u, u, max (u + 1) w} G ≅ G'),
      have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y.1 Y.2
      have := isCoherent_higherDirectImage_of_isProper_toBase k B hk f πX hπX πY hπY G
      {i : ℕ | ¬ IsZero (((modulePushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk f).rightDerived i).obj G)}.Finite ∧
        eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k B hk Y.1 Y.2 πY hπY G' =
          ∑ᶠ i : ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i * eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k B hk X.1 X.2 πX hπX
            (SheafOfModules.uliftForPresentation.{u + 1, u, u, u, max (u + 1) w}
              (((modulePushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk f).rightDerived i).obj G))
declarations.comment: for a coherent module in the universe of the Euler characteristic, the higher direct images being taken of its descent to the universe of the structure sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_twistedEuler_sub_finsum_mul_twistedEuler_topDimensionalComponent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDE.**  Let `X` be proper over a field `k`, `F` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module and
`L₁, …, L_r` invertible `𝒪_X`-modules.  Let `Z_C` be the reduced closed subspace on an
irreducible component `C` of `Supp(F)` of dimension `d = dim Supp(F)`, `x̄_C` a geometric generic
point of `C` and `m_C = length_{𝒪_{X, x̄_C}}(F_{x̄_C})`.  Then
`χ(X, F ⊗ L₁^{⊗ n₁} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ L_r^{⊗ n_r}) - ∑_C m_C χ(Z_C, (L₁^{⊗ n₁} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ L_r^{⊗ n_r})|_{Z_C})`
is given by a rational polynomial in `n₁, …, n_r` which is zero or of total degree `< d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_twistedEuler_sub_finsum_mul_twistedEuler_topDimensionalComponent
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2) (hF : IsCoherent B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2 F)
    (x : irreducibleComponents (moduleSupportSet B (Spec (.of k)) hk X F) → GeometricPoint B (Spec
        (.of k)) hk X.1)
    (hx : ∀ C, IsGenericPoint (x C).image (Subtype.val '' (C : Set (moduleSupportSet B (Spec
        (.of k)) hk X F)))) :
    have hT : IsClosed (moduleSupportSet B (Spec (.of k)) hk X F) := isClosed_moduleSupportSet B
        (Spec (.of k)) hk X F hF
    have hW : ∀ C : irreducibleComponents (moduleSupportSet B (Spec (.of k)) hk X F),
        IsClosedSubspace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (reducedClosedSubspace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2 _
          (closedSetComponentPoints B (Spec (.of k)) hk (moduleSupportSet B (Spec
              (.of k)) hk X F) hT C).isClosed) := fun C =>
      isClosedSubspace_reducedClosedSubspace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2 _
        (closedSetComponentPoints B (Spec (.of k)) hk (moduleSupportSet B (Spec
            (.of k)) hk X F) hT C).isClosed
    have hfZ : ∀ C : irreducibleComponents (moduleSupportSet B (Spec (.of k)) hk X F),
        IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk ((closedSubfunctorι B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)).hom ≫ f) :=
      fun C => isProper_comp B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C).1 X.2
        (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B (Spec (.of k)) hk (baseObject k B hk)) _ f
        (isProper_of_isClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C).1 X.2 _ (hW C).2) hf
    ∃ P : MvPolynomial (Fin r) ℚ,
      (P = 0 ∨ (P.totalDegree : WithBot ℕ∞) < topologicalKrullDim (moduleSupportSet B (Spec
          (.of k)) hk X F)) ∧
      ∀ n : Fin r → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => (n j : ℚ)) P =
        (@eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k _ B hk X.1 X.2 f hf
          (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2 F L n)
          (isCoherent_twistedModuleUlift_of_isProper.{u, w} k B hk X f hf L F hF n) : ℚ) -
        ∑ᶠ C ∈ {C : irreducibleComponents (moduleSupportSet B (Spec (.of k)) hk X F) |
            topologicalKrullDim (Subtype.val '' (C : Set (moduleSupportSet B (Spec
                (.of k)) hk X F))) = topologicalKrullDim (moduleSupportSet B (Spec
                    (.of k)) hk X F)},
          haveI := fun j => stacksIsInvertible_modulePullback_obj B (Spec (.of k)) hk
            (closedSubfunctorι B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)) (L j)
          ((geometricLength B (Spec (.of k)) hk X (x C) F).toNat : ℚ) *
            (@eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k _ B hk (closedSubfunctorSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk
                (hW C)).1
              (closedSubfunctorSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)).2
              ((closedSubfunctorι B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)).hom ≫ f) (hfZ C)
              (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk
                (closedSubfunctorSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)).1
                (closedSubfunctorSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)).2
                (SheafOfModules.unit (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
                  (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk
                    (closedSubfunctorSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)).1
                    (closedSubfunctorSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)).2).O))
                (fun j => (modulePullback B (Spec (.of k)) hk
                  (closedSubfunctorι B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C))).obj (L j)) n)
              (isCoherent_twistedModuleUlift_of_isProper.{u, w} k B hk
                (closedSubfunctorSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C))
                ((closedSubfunctorι B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)).hom ≫ f) (hfZ C) _ _
                (isCoherent_unit_of_isClosedImmersion k B hk X
                  (closedSubfunctorSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)) f hf
                  (closedSubfunctorι B (Spec (.of k)) hk (hW C)) (hW C).2) n) : ℚ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDF.** The intersection number `(L₁ ⋯ L_d · Z)` of `d` invertible
`𝒪_X`-modules against a closed subspace `i : Z ⟶ X` of dimension `d` of a proper algebraic
space `X` over a field `k`: the coefficient of `n₁ ⋯ n_d` in the numerical polynomial
`χ(X, i_*𝒪_Z ⊗ L₁^{⊗ n₁} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ L_d^{⊗ n_d})`, computed as the `d`-fold mixed finite difference

`∑_{T ⊆ {1, …, d}} (-1)^{d - |T|} χ(X, i_*𝒪_Z ⊗ ⨂_{j ∈ T} L_j)`

of that function.  This is an honest integer: only finitely many values of the function are
used, so neither polynomiality nor a choice of representing polynomial enters.
declarations.statement:
def intersectionNumber (d : ℕ) (f : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk))
    (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk f) (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk i.hom)
    (_hd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 Z.2 = d)
    (L : Fin d → Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L j)] :
    ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_eq_coeff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDF, the coefficient of `n₁ ⋯ n_d`.**  If a rational polynomial `P` in `d`
variables of total degree at most `d` takes the Euler characteristics
`χ(X, i_*𝒪_Z ⊗ L₁^{⊗ n₁} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ L_d^{⊗ n_d})` as its values at the integral tuples, then the
intersection number `(L₁ ⋯ L_d · Z)` is the coefficient of `n₁ ⋯ n_d` in `P`.

This is the source's own description of the intersection number.  The existence of such a `P`,
which is Stacks 0DN4, is not assumed: the statement is unconditional in `P`, and the proof is
the monomial computation
`MvPolynomial.sum_neg_one_pow_mul_eval_indicator_eq_coeff_one`.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectionNumber_eq_coeff (d : ℕ) (f : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk))
    (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk f) (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk i.hom)
    (hd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 Z.2 = d)
    (L : Fin d → Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L j)]
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℚ)
    (hP : ∀ n : Fin d → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => (n j : ℚ)) P =
      ((@eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k _ B hk X.1 X.2 f hf
        (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
          (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i) L n)
          (isCoherent_twistedModuleUlift_structureSheafPushforward.{u, w}
            k B hk X Z f hf i hi L n) : ℤ) : ℚ))
    (hdeg : P.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    ((intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X Z d f hf i hi hd L : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      P.coeff (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun _ => 1)
declarations.comment: the coefficient of n_1 ⋯ n_d

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.selfIntersectionNumber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDF, the self-intersection notation `(L^d · Z)`.**  The intersection number of a
single invertible `𝒪_X`-module `L` repeated `d` times against a closed subspace `i : Z ⟶ X` of
dimension `d`.
declarations.statement:
def selfIntersectionNumber (d : ℕ) (f : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk))
