    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk i.hom)
    (hd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 Z.2 = d)
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property L] :
    ℤ
declarations.comment: the self-intersection notation (L^d · Z)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_eval_eq_eulerCharacteristic_and_exists_intCast_eq_coeff_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDG.**  In the situation of Definition 0EDF — `X` a proper algebraic space over a
field `k`, `i : Z ⟶ X` a closed subspace of dimension `d` and `L₁, …, L_d` invertible
`𝒪_X`-modules — the intersection number `(L₁ ⋯ L_d · Z)` is an integer: the function
`n ↦ χ(X, i_*𝒪_Z ⊗ L₁^{⊗ n₁} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ L_d^{⊗ n_d})` is the restriction to the integral tuples of a
rational polynomial of total degree at most `d`, and the coefficient of `n₁ ⋯ n_d` in any
rational polynomial with these values is the cast of an integer.

The first conjunct is Stacks 0DN4,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_representsTwistedEuler_structureSheafPushforward`, and it is
what makes the second one say something about *the* numerical polynomial of the source: a
rational polynomial is determined by its values at the integral tuples
(`MvPolynomial.eq_of_eval_intCast_eq`), so every polynomial with these values is that one, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_intCast_eq_coeff_one` applies to it, the integer being
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_eval_eq_eulerCharacteristic_and_exists_intCast_eq_coeff_one (d : ℕ)
    (f : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk f)
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (hi : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk i.hom)
    (hd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 Z.2 = d)
    (L : Fin d → Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L j)] :
    (∃ P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℚ, (∀ n : Fin d → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => (n j : ℚ)) P =
      ((@eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k _ B hk X.1 X.2 f hf
        (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
          (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i) L n)
          (isCoherent_twistedModuleUlift_structureSheafPushforward.{u, w}
            k B hk X Z f hf i hi L n) : ℤ) : ℚ)) ∧ P.totalDegree ≤ d) ∧
    ∀ P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℚ, (∀ n : Fin d → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => (n j : ℚ)) P =
      ((@eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k _ B hk X.1 X.2 f hf
        (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
          (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i) L n)
          (isCoherent_twistedModuleUlift_structureSheafPushforward.{u, w}
            k B hk X Z f hf i hi L n) : ℤ) : ℚ)) →
      ∃ m : ℤ, P.coeff (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun _ => 1) = (m : ℚ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_intCast_eq_coeff_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDG.**  The intersection number `(L₁ ⋯ L_d · Z)` is an integer: the coefficient of
`n₁ ⋯ n_d` in a rational polynomial of total degree at most `d` taking the Euler characteristics
`χ(X, i_*𝒪_Z ⊗ L₁^{⊗ n₁} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ L_d^{⊗ n_d})` as its values at the integral tuples is the cast of
an integer, namely of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber`.

That coefficient is a priori only rational, and integrality is special to it: a numerical
polynomial such as `n (n - 1) / 2` has coefficients which are not integers, and it is the degree
bound that makes the coefficient of the squarefree monomial a mixed finite difference of
finitely many integer values.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_intCast_eq_coeff_one (d : ℕ) (f : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk))
    (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk f) (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk i.hom)
    (hd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 Z.2 = d)
    (L : Fin d → Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L j)]
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℚ)
    (hP : ∀ n : Fin d → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => (n j : ℚ)) P =
      ((@eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k _ B hk X.1 X.2 f hf
        (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
          (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i) L n)
          (isCoherent_twistedModuleUlift_structureSheafPushforward.{u, w}
            k B hk X Z f hf i hi L n) : ℤ) : ℚ))
    (hdeg : P.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, P.coeff (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun _ => 1) = (m : ℚ)
declarations.comment: granted a representing numerical polynomial, whose existence is Tag 0DN4

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_eq_add_intersectionNumber_of_iso_tensorSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDH.**  In the situation of Definition 0EDF, the intersection number is additive
in each of its invertible modules: if `L_{i₀} ≅ L_{i₀}' ⊗ L_{i₀}''`, and `L'` and `L''` agree with
`L` away from `i₀`, then

`(L₁ ⋯ L_{i₀} ⋯ L_d · Z) = (L₁ ⋯ L_{i₀}' ⋯ L_d · Z) + (L₁ ⋯ L_{i₀}'' ⋯ L_d · Z)`.

The proof is the source's: by Stacks 0DN4
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_representsTwistedEuler_structureSheafPushforward`) the twisted
Euler characteristics of `i_*𝒪_Z` by the `d + 1` invertible modules
`L_{i₀}'', L_1', …, L_d'` are the values of a numerical polynomial of total degree at most `d`
in `d + 1` variables, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_eq_add_of_iso_tensorSheaf_of_totalDegree_le` reads
the three intersection numbers off it.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectionNumber_eq_add_intersectionNumber_of_iso_tensorSheaf (d : ℕ)
    (f : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk f)
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (hi : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk i.hom)
    (hd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 Z.2 = d) (i₀ : Fin d)
    (L L' L'' : Fin d → Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L j)]
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L' j)]
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L'' j)]
    (hL' : ∀ j, j ≠ i₀ → L' j = L j) (hL'' : ∀ j, j ≠ i₀ → L'' j = L j)
    (hL : L i₀ ≅ (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
      (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).obj (L' i₀)).obj (L'' i₀) :
        Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)) :
    intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X Z d f hf i hi hd L =
      intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X Z d f hf i hi hd L' +
        intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X Z d f hf i hi hd L''

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_eq_add_of_iso_tensorSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDH.**  Additivity of the intersection number in each of its invertible modules.
Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a proper algebraic space over `k`, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed
subspace of dimension `d` and let `L₁, …, L_d` be invertible `𝒪_X`-modules.  Let `L'` and `L''`
be two families agreeing with `L` away from one index `i₀` and satisfying
`L_{i₀} ≅ L_{i₀}' ⊗ L_{i₀}''`.  Then

`(L₁ ⋯ L_{i₀} ⋯ L_d · Z) = (L₁ ⋯ L_{i₀}' ⋯ L_d · Z) + (L₁ ⋯ L_{i₀}'' ⋯ L_d · Z)`.

The mechanism is the source's.  The Euler characteristics of the twists of `i_*𝒪_Z` by the
`d + 1` invertible modules `L_{i₀}'', L_1', …, L_d'` are the values of a rational polynomial `Q`
of total degree at most `d` in `d + 1` variables, which is Stacks 0DN4 and is the one thing
carried, as the hypotheses `Q`, `hQ` and `hQdeg`; the three intersection numbers are then the
three mixed finite differences of `Q` obtained by tying the two new variables together, by
setting the second to zero, and by setting the first to zero.  Their alternating combination is
the `(d + 1)`-fold mixed finite difference of `Q`, which vanishes because the squarefree monomial
in `d + 1` variables has degree `d + 1`;
this is `MvPolynomial.sum_neg_one_pow_mul_sub_eval_cons_eq_zero`.

The three comparisons of the twists by the split family with the twists by `L`, `L'` and `L''`
are proved: at the indicator tuples only the exponents `0` and `1` occur, where the constraints
of the sheaf tensor product suffice and no multiplication of tensor powers is needed.  See the
implementation notes.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectionNumber_eq_add_of_iso_tensorSheaf (d : ℕ)
    (f : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk f)
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (hi : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk i.hom)
    (hd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 Z.2 = d) (i₀ : Fin d)
    (L L' L'' : Fin d → Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L j)]
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L' j)]
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L'' j)]
    [∀ n : Fin d → ℤ, IsCoherent B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
      (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
        (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i) L n)]
    [∀ n : Fin d → ℤ, IsCoherent B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
      (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
        (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i) L' n)]
    [∀ n : Fin d → ℤ, IsCoherent B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
      (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
        (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i) L'' n)]
    [∀ m : Fin (d + 1) → ℤ, IsCoherent B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
      (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
        (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i) (Fin.cons (L'' i₀) L') m)]
    (hL' : ∀ j, j ≠ i₀ → L' j = L j) (hL'' : ∀ j, j ≠ i₀ → L'' j = L j)
    (hL : L i₀ ≅ (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
      (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).obj (L' i₀)).obj (L'' i₀) :
        Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2))
    (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1)) ℚ) (hQdeg : Q.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (hQ : ∀ m : Fin (d + 1) → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun p => (m p : ℚ)) Q =
      ((eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k B hk X.1 X.2 f hf
        (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
          (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i) (Fin.cons (L'' i₀) L') m) : ℤ) : ℚ)) :
    intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X Z d f hf i hi hd L =
      intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X Z d f hf i hi hd L' +
        intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X Z d f hf i hi hd L''
declarations.comment: with the numerical polynomial of Stacks 0DN4 for the split family of d + 1 invertible modules carried as a hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_eq_finsum_mul_intersectionNumber_irreducibleComponents
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDI.**  Let `k` be a field, `X` a proper algebraic space over `k`, `i : Z ⟶ X` a
closed subspace of dimension `d` and `L₁, …, L_d` invertible `𝒪_X`-modules.  Let `Z_C ⊆ Z` be the
irreducible components of `Z` of dimension `d` — the components `C` of the closed set
`|Z| ⊆ |X|` of Krull dimension `d`, each with its reduced induced structure (Stacks 03IQ) — let
`x̄_C` be a geometric generic point of `Z_C` and let
`m_C = length_{𝒪_{X, x̄_C}}(𝒪_{Z, x̄_C})`, the length of the stalk of `i_*𝒪_Z` at `x̄_C`.  Then

`(L₁ ⋯ L_d · Z) = ∑_C m_C (L₁ ⋯ L_d · Z_C)`.

As in the source this is immediate from Stacks 0EDE, in the form
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_twistedEuler_sub_finsum_mul_componentStructureSheaf` applied to
`F = i_*𝒪_Z`, whose support is `|Z|`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleSupportSet_structureSheafPushforward_of_isClosedImmersion`):
the difference of the Euler characteristics is a polynomial of total degree `< d`, so its
coefficient of `n₁ ⋯ n_d` vanishes, and comparing that coefficient is
`Space.intersectionNumber_eq_finsum_mul_of_eval_eq_sub_finsum_irreducibleComponents`.
The length `m_C` is a natural number by Stacks 0EE4.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectionNumber_eq_finsum_mul_intersectionNumber_irreducibleComponents (d : ℕ)
    (f : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk f)
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (hi : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk i.hom)
    (hd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 Z.2 = d)
    (L : Fin d → Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L j)]
    (x : irreducibleComponents (Set.range (pointsMap B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 i.hom)) →
      GeometricPoint B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
    (hx : ∀ C, IsGenericPoint (x C).image
      (Subtype.val '' (C : Set (Set.range (pointsMap B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 i.hom))))) :
    intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X Z d f hf i hi hd L =
      ∑ᶠ (C : {C : irreducibleComponents (Set.range (pointsMap B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 i.hom)) //
          topologicalKrullDim (Subtype.val ''
            (C : Set (Set.range (pointsMap B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 i.hom)))) = d}),
        ((geometricLength B (Spec (.of k)) hk X (x C.1)
            (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk i)).toNat : ℤ) *
          intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X
            (closedSubfunctorSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk
              (isClosedSubspace_reducedClosedSubspace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2 _
                (closedSetComponentPoints B (Spec (.of k)) hk _
                  (isClosed_range_pointsMap_of_isClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.2 i.hom hi)
                  C.1).isClosed)) d f hf
            (closedSubfunctorι B (Spec (.of k)) hk
              (isClosedSubspace_reducedClosedSubspace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2 _
                (closedSetComponentPoints B (Spec (.of k)) hk _
                  (isClosed_range_pointsMap_of_isClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.2 i.hom hi)
                  C.1).isClosed))
            (isClosedSubspace_reducedClosedSubspace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2 _
              (closedSetComponentPoints B (Spec (.of k)) hk _
                (isClosed_range_pointsMap_of_isClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.2 i.hom hi)
                C.1).isClosed).2
            ((dimension_reducedClosedSubspace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
              (isDecentSpace_of_isProper_baseObject k B hk X.1 X.2 f hf) _ _).trans C.2) L

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_modulePullback_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDJ.** Let `k` be a field, let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of algebraic spaces proper
over `k`, let `Z ⊂ Y` be an integral closed subspace of dimension `d` and let `L₁, …, L_d` be
invertible `𝒪_X`-modules. Let `f(Z) ⊂ X` be the image of `Z`: the integral closed subspace on the
closure of `f(|Z|)`, which is the scheme-theoretic image of `Z ⟶ X`, and has dimension at most
`d`. Then

`(f^*L₁ ⋯ f^*L_d · Z) = deg(Z/f(Z)) · (L₁ ⋯ L_d · f(Z))`

where `deg(Z/f(Z))` is the degree of Stacks 0AD6 if `dim f(Z) = d`, and the right hand side is
`0` if `dim f(Z) < d`.

The three conjuncts are: `f(Z)` is the scheme-theoretic image of `Z ⟶ X`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IntegralClosedSubspace.closureImage_subspace_eq_schemeTheoreticImage`,
Stacks 0830); `dim f(Z) ≤ d`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IntegralClosedSubspace.dimension_closureImage_le`, Stacks 0EDC); and
the formula, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_modulePullback_eq_degree_mul` when `dim f(Z) = d` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_modulePullback_eq_zero_of_dimension_lt` otherwise.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectionNumber_modulePullback_eq (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (Z : IntegralClosedSubspace B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y.1) {d : ℕ}
    (hZd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.subspace.toFunctor Z.isClosedSubspace.1 = d)
    (L : Fin d → Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [hL : ∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O).property (L j)] :
    let W := IntegralClosedSubspace.closureImage B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.2
      (isDecentSpace_of_isProper_baseObject k B hk X.1 X.2 pX hpX) f.hom Z
    W.subspace = schemeTheoreticImageSubfunctor B (Spec (.of k)) hk (Z.subspace.ι ≫ f.hom) ∧
      dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk W.subspace.toFunctor W.isClosedSubspace.1 ≤ d ∧
      @intersectionNumber.{u, w} k _ B hk Y
          (closedSubspaceToSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y ⟨Z.subspace, Z.isClosedSubspace⟩) d pY hpY
          (closedSubspaceInclusion B (Spec (.of k)) hk Y ⟨Z.subspace, Z.isClosedSubspace⟩)
          Z.isClosedSubspace.2 hZd
          (fun j => (modulePullback B (Spec (.of k)) hk f).obj (L j))
          (fun j => stacksIsInvertible_modulePullback_obj B (Spec (.of k)) hk f (L j)
            (hM := hL j)) =
        if hW : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk W.subspace.toFunctor W.isClosedSubspace.1 = d then
          (degree B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.isClosedSubspace.1 W.isClosedSubspace.1 Z.isIntegralSpace
              W.isIntegralSpace
              (IntegralClosedSubspace.toClosureImage B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.2
                (isDecentSpace_of_isProper_baseObject k B hk X.1 X.2 pX hpX) f.hom Z) : ℤ) *
            intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X
              (closedSubspaceToSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X ⟨W.subspace, W.isClosedSubspace⟩) d pX
              hpX (closedSubspaceInclusion B (Spec (.of k)) hk X ⟨W.subspace, W.isClosedSubspace⟩)
              W.isClosedSubspace.2 hW L
        else 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_eq_sum_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDK.**  Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a proper algebraic space over `k`, let
`i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed subspace of dimension `d + 1` and let `L₁, …, L_{d+1}` be invertible
`𝒪_X`-modules.  Let `D ⊆ Z` be an effective Cartier divisor with `L₁|_Z ≅ 𝒪_Z(D)`, and let
`j : D ⟶ X` be its inclusion into `X`.  Then

`(L₁ ⋯ L_{d+1} · Z) = (L₂ ⋯ L_{d+1} · D)`.

The right-hand side is written as the defining expression of Definition 0EDF,
`∑_{T ⊆ {2, …, d + 1}} (-1)^{d - |T|} χ(X, j_*𝒪_D ⊗ ⨂_{l ∈ T} L_l)`:

* (i) this is the intersection number of Definition 0EDF read for the closed subspace `D`, which
  has dimension at most `d` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dimension_le_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor`)
  but not necessarily exactly `d`;
* (ii) it is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber` of `D` by
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.intersectionNumber_eq_sum` whenever `dim D = d`, which is
  `intersectionNumber_eq_intersectionNumber_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_dimension_eq`;
* (iii) it is `0` when `dim D < d`, by Stacks 0DN4, which is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sum_eulerCharacteristic_eq_zero_of_dimension_lt`.

No hypothesis beyond the source's is taken.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectionNumber_eq_sum_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor (d : ℕ)
    (f : X.1 ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject k B hk)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of k)) hk f) (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of k)) hk i.hom)
    (hd : dimension B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1 Z.2 = d + 1)
    (Dv : ClosedSubspaces B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z.1)
    (hDv : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z Dv)
    (L : Fin (d + 1) → Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2)
    [∀ j, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2).O)).property (L j)]
    (hL : (modulePullback B (Spec (.of k)) hk i).obj (L 0) ≅
      associatedInvertibleSheaf B (Spec (.of k)) hk Z Dv hDv) :
    intersectionNumber.{u, w} k B hk X Z (d + 1) f hf i hi hd L =
      ∑ T : Finset (Fin d), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (d - T.card) *
        @eulerCharacteristic.{u, w} k _ B hk X.1 X.2 f hf
          (twistedModuleUlift.{u, w} B (Spec (.of k)) hk X.1 X.2
            (structureSheafPushforward B (Spec (.of k)) hk
              ((ObjectProperty.homMk Dv.1.ι :
                (⟨Dv.1.toFunctor, Dv.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B (Spec (.of k)) hk) ⟶ Z) ≫ i))
            (fun j => L j.succ) fun j => if j ∈ T then 1 else 0)
          (isCoherent_twistedModuleUlift_structureSheafPushforward.{u, w} k B hk X
            ⟨Dv.1.toFunctor, Dv.2.1⟩ f hf _
            (isClosedImmersion_comp B (Spec (.of k)) hk Dv.1.ι i.hom Dv.2.2 hi) _ _)
declarations.comment: the right-hand side as the defining sum of Definition 0EDF for D, of dimension at most d; it is intersectionNumber D when dim D = d and 0 when dim D < d

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_glueingSpace_factorization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDM.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an integral morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, and
let `y : Spec k ⟶ Y` be a closed immersion.  Then `f` factors as `X ⟶ X' ⟶ Y` with

1. `X' ⟶ Y` integral,
2. `X ⟶ X'` an isomorphism over the open complement `X' ∖ X'_y` of the fibre
   `X'_y = |h|⁻¹ {y}`,
3. `X'_y` a single point `p`, which is the point of a closed immersion `x' : Spec k ⟶ X'` over
   `y`, so that `κ(p) = k`,

and moreover `X' ⟶ Y` is finite when `f` is finite and `Y` is locally Noetherian.

The space `X'` is the quotient of the chart-level pushout over a separated étale chart of `Y`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleChartRelation.exists_of_isAlgebraicSpace`) by the étale
equivalence relation induced by the chart's kernel pair; the sheafification it needs is
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.hasSheafify_type`.  "Locally Noetherian" is the source's
definition for algebraic spaces, a locally Noetherian surjective étale atlas
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasEtaleLocalProperty`, Stacks 03E6), and it gives local
Noetherianity of the chosen chart by Stacks 03E8.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_glueingSpace_factorization {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (hk : B.Contains (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (σ : Spec (CommRingCat.of k) ⟶ S)
    (y : yoneda.obj (BigFppfOver.mk B S hS hk σ) ⟶ Y.1) (hy : IsClosedImmersion B S hS y) :
    ∃ (X' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (g : X ⟶ X') (h : X' ⟶ Y),
      g ≫ h = f ∧
      IsIntegralHom B S hS h.hom ∧
      IsIso (openComplementRestriction B S hS g.hom
        (pointsMap B S hS X'.1 h.hom ⁻¹'
          Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj (BigFppfOver.mk B S hS hk σ)) y))) ∧
      (∃ (x' : yoneda.obj (BigFppfOver.mk B S hS hk σ) ⟶ X'.1) (p : points B S hS X'.1),
        IsClosedImmersion B S hS x' ∧ x' ≫ h.hom = y ∧
        pointsMap B S hS X'.1 h.hom ⁻¹'
            Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj (BigFppfOver.mk B S hS hk σ)) y) = {p} ∧
        Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj (BigFppfOver.mk B S hS hk σ)) x') = {p}) ∧
      (IsFinite B S hS f.hom →
        HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y.1
          (fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦ _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian T) →
        IsFinite B S hS h.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_dimensionFunction_inducedDimensionValue
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDN.** Let `Y` be a decent, locally Noetherian, universally catenary algebraic
space and `δ` a dimension function on `|Y|`. If `X` is a decent algebraic space and `f : X ⟶ Y`
is locally of finite type, then `δ_X`, the value of `δ` at the image of a point plus the
transcendence degree of the point over its image, is a dimension function on `|X|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_dimensionFunction_inducedDimensionValue (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hYdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS Y)
    (hYN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hYcat : IsUniversallyCatenary B S hS Y) (δ : DimensionFunction (points B S hS Y))
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hXdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    ∃ d : DimensionFunction (points B S hS X), ∀ x : points B S hS X,
      d x = inducedDimensionValue B S hS δ f x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushout_isPushout_algebraicSpaces
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDP.** In the standing situation of [Stacks Project, Tag 0ECI], the scheme pushout
`Y ⨿_Z X` of [Stacks Project, Tag 0E25] is also a pushout in the category of algebraic spaces
over `S`: the square formed by the four schemes and the four canonical morphisms, regarded
through the Yoneda embedding as a square of algebraic spaces over `S`, is a pushout square.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushout_isPushout_algebraicSpaces :
    IsPushout
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (yoneda.map (fppfOverI s B hS hX hZ)) :
        (⟨yoneda.obj (fppfOverZ s B hS hZ),
          isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B s.S hS (fppfOverZ s B hS hZ)⟩ :
          AlgebraicSpaces B s.S hS) ⟶
        (⟨yoneda.obj (fppfOverX s B hS hX),
          isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B s.S hS (fppfOverX s B hS hX)⟩ :
          AlgebraicSpaces B s.S hS))
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (yoneda.map (fppfOverJ s B hS hY hZ)) :
        (⟨yoneda.obj (fppfOverZ s B hS hZ),
          isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B s.S hS (fppfOverZ s B hS hZ)⟩ :
          AlgebraicSpaces B s.S hS) ⟶
        (⟨yoneda.obj (fppfOverY s B hS hY),
          isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B s.S hS (fppfOverY s B hS hY)⟩ :
          AlgebraicSpaces B s.S hS))
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (yoneda.map (fppfOverInl s B hS hX hP)) :
        (⟨yoneda.obj (fppfOverX s B hS hX),
          isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B s.S hS (fppfOverX s B hS hX)⟩ :
          AlgebraicSpaces B s.S hS) ⟶
        (⟨yoneda.obj (fppfOverPushout s B hS hP),
          isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B s.S hS (fppfOverPushout s B hS hP)⟩ :
          AlgebraicSpaces B s.S hS))
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (yoneda.map (fppfOverInr s B hS hY hP)) :
        (⟨yoneda.obj (fppfOverY s B hS hY),
          isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B s.S hS (fppfOverY s B hS hY)⟩ :
          AlgebraicSpaces B s.S hS) ⟶
        (⟨yoneda.obj (fppfOverPushout s B hS hP),
          isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B s.S hS (fppfOverPushout s B hS hP)⟩ :
          AlgebraicSpaces B s.S hS))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.IsGood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDT.** An algebraic space over the fixed base is *good* when its structure
morphism is quasi-separated and locally of finite type.
declarations.comment: good_space

registrations.comment: induced_delta

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.stacksSober_points_of_isGood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDU.** The point space of a good algebraic space over the base of Situation 0EDT
is sober: every irreducible closed subset of it has a unique generic point.

A good algebraic space is decent, and the point space of a decent algebraic space is
Kolmogorov by Stacks 03K3 and quasi-sober by Stacks 03K6.
declarations.statement:
theorem BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.stacksSober_points_of_isGood (f : X ⟶ D.space)
    (hgood : D.IsGood f) :
    StacksSober (points D.site D.base D.base_mem X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIntegralSpace_iff_isReduced_and_irreducibleSpace_of_isGood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDV.** A good algebraic space over the fixed base is integral exactly when it is
reduced and its space of points is irreducible: the third condition of integrality, decency,
holds for every good algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIntegralSpace_iff_isReduced_and_irreducibleSpace_of_isGood (f : X ⟶ D.space)
    (hf : D.IsGood f) :
    IsIntegralSpace D.site D.base D.base_mem X ↔
      HasEtaleLocalProperty D.site D.base D.base_mem X (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced Y) ∧
        IrreducibleSpace (points D.site D.base D.base_mem X)
declarations.comment: integral iff reduced and irreducible

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_integralClosedSubspace_isGenericPoint_of_isGood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDV.** Every point of a good algebraic space over the fixed base is the generic
point of the set of points of exactly one integral closed subspace.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_integralClosedSubspace_isGenericPoint_of_isGood (f : X ⟶ D.space)
    (hf : D.IsGood f) (ξ : points D.site D.base D.base_mem X) :
    ∃! Z : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X,
      IsGenericPoint ξ
        (Set.range (pointsMap D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor Z.subspace.ι))
declarations.comment: unique integral closed subspace with a given generic point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.deltaDimension_eq_inducedDimensionValue
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDW, part (1).** The common value is `δ(ξ) = δ_{X/B}(ξ)`, for `ξ` the generic point
of `|Z|`: the δ-dimension of `Z` is the value at `ξ` of the dimension function `δ_{X/B}` of
Stacks 0EDN, the value of `δ` at the image of `ξ` plus the transcendence degree of `ξ` over that
image, and it is a nonnegative integer.
declarations.statement:
theorem deltaDimension_eq_inducedDimensionValue :
    0 ≤ deltaDimension D sX Z ∧
      deltaDimension D sX Z = inducedDimensionValue D.site D.base D.base_mem D.delta sX
        (pointsMap D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor Z.subspace.ι
          (Z.genericPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem))
declarations.comment: part (1): the common value is the induced delta function at the generic point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.codimension_singleton_eq_deltaDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDW, parts (1) and (3).** Over a Jacobson base whose dimension function vanishes
at closed points, the codimension of a closed point of the set of points of an integral closed
subspace `Z` of a good algebraic space is the δ-dimension of `Z`, the value of `δ_{X/B}` at the
generic point of `Z`; in particular that integer is nonnegative.
declarations.statement:
theorem codimension_singleton_eq_deltaDimension
    (z : points D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor)
    (hz : IsClosed ({z} : Set (points D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor))) :
    0 ≤ deltaDimension D sX Z ∧
      codimension (⟨{z}, isIrreducible_singleton, hz⟩ :
          IrreducibleCloseds (points D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor)) =
        ((deltaDimension D sX Z).toNat : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment:
part (3): the codimension of a closed point of the integral closed subspace is
  the value of the induced delta function at its generic point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.topologicalKrullDim_points_eq_deltaDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDW, parts (1) and (2).** Over a Jacobson base whose dimension function vanishes
at closed points, the dimension of the set of points of an integral closed subspace `Z` of a
good algebraic space is the δ-dimension of `Z`, a nonnegative integer.
declarations.statement:
theorem topologicalKrullDim_points_eq_deltaDimension :
    0 ≤ deltaDimension D sX Z ∧
      topologicalKrullDim (points D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor) =
        (((deltaDimension D sX Z).toNat : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment:
part (2): the dimension of the set of points of the integral closed subspace is
  the value of the induced delta function at its generic point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.localRingDimension_eq_deltaDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDW, parts (1) and (4).** Over a Jacobson base whose dimension function vanishes
at closed points, the dimension of the local ring of an integral closed subspace `Z` of a good
algebraic space at a closed point of `|Z|` is the δ-dimension of `Z`, a nonnegative integer.
declarations.statement:
theorem localRingDimension_eq_deltaDimension
    (z : points D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor)
    (hz : IsClosed ({z} : Set (points D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor))) :
    0 ≤ deltaDimension D sX Z ∧
      localRingDimension D.site D.base D.base_mem z = ((deltaDimension D sX Z).toNat : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment:
part (4): the dimension of the local ring at a closed point is the value of the
  induced delta function at the generic point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ringKrullDim_etaleLocalRing_eq_deltaDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDW, parts (1) and (5).** Over a Jacobson base whose dimension function vanishes
at closed points, the Krull dimension of the étale local ring of an integral closed subspace `Z`
of a good algebraic space at a geometric point above a closed point of `|Z|` is the δ-dimension
of `Z`, a nonnegative integer.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_etaleLocalRing_eq_deltaDimension
    (z : points D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor)
    (hz : IsClosed ({z} : Set (points D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor)))
    (zbar : GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor)
    (hzbar : zbar.LiesOver z) :
    0 ≤ deltaDimension D sX Z ∧
      ringKrullDim (etaleLocalRing D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.subspace.toFunctor zbar) =
        (((deltaDimension D sX Z).toNat : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment:
part (5): the dimension of the étale local ring at a geometric point above a
  closed point is the value of the induced delta function at the generic point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.deltaDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDX, for an integral closed subspace.** The *δ-dimension* of an integral closed
subspace `Z` of a good algebraic space `X/B` is the value of `δ_{X/B}` at the generic point of
`|Z|`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deltaDimension (D : BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.{u})
    {X : (BigFppfOver D.site D.base D.base_mem)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (sX : X ⟶ D.space)
    (Z : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X) : ℤ
declarations.comment: the δ-dimension of an integral closed subspace

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.deltaDimensionIrreducible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDX.** The `δ`-dimension of an irreducible closed subset of the space of points
of a good algebraic space: the induced dimension function at the generic point of the
subset.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deltaDimensionIrreducible (f : X ⟶ D.space) (hf : D.IsGood f)
    (T : IrreducibleCloseds (points D.site D.base D.base_mem X)) : ℤ
declarations.comment: irreducible closed subsets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.deltaDimensionClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDX.** The `δ`-dimension of an arbitrary closed subset of the space of points of
a good algebraic space: the supremum, among the extended integers, of the `δ`-dimensions of its
irreducible components.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deltaDimensionClosed (f : X ⟶ D.space) (hf : D.IsGood f)
    (T : Set (points D.site D.base D.base_mem X)) (hT : IsClosed T) : EInt
declarations.comment: closed subsets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.deltaDimensionSubspace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDX.** The `δ`-dimension of a closed subspace of a good algebraic space: the
`δ`-dimension of its set of points.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deltaDimensionSubspace (f : X ⟶ D.space) (hf : D.IsGood f) (Z : Subfunctor X)
    (hZ : IsClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Z) : EInt
declarations.comment: closed subspaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cyclesOfDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDZ, parts (1) and (2).** The subgroup `Z_k(X)` of integer coefficient families
on the integral closed subspaces of a good algebraic space `X/B` which are *cycles* — the point
sets of the subspaces with nonzero coefficient form a locally finite collection of subsets of
`|X|` — and are *of δ-dimension `k`* — every subspace with nonzero coefficient has δ-dimension
`k`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cyclesOfDimension (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (k : ℤ) :
    AddSubgroup (IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X → ℤ)
declarations.comment: parts (1) and (2): cycles and k-cycles

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CycleGroup
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EDZ, part (3).** The abelian group `Z_k(X)` of `k`-cycles on a good algebraic
space `X/B`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev CycleGroup (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (k : ℤ)
declarations.comment: part (3): the abelian group of k-cycles

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_iff_forall_etaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE1, conditions (1) and (3).** The length of a quasi-coherent `F` at a geometric
point `x̄` is `d` exactly when the length of the Zariski stalk of `φ^* F` is `d` at the point of
the chart under the chosen lift, for *every* small étale neighbourhood of `x̄` whose chart is a
scheme.

Every neighbourhood computes the same length
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_chartZariskiLength`), and there is one
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.nonempty_smallEtaleNeighborhood`).
declarations.statement:
theorem geometricLength_eq_iff_forall_etaleChart {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (d : ℕ∞) :
    geometricLength B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ x F = d ↔
      ∀ V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x,
        chartZariskiLength.{u, u} B S hS hX V.chart (chartPoint B S hS X V) F = d
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_iff_exists_etaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE1, conditions (1) and (2).** The length of a quasi-coherent `F` at a geometric
point `x̄` is `d` exactly when the length of the Zariski stalk of `φ^* F` is `d` at the point of
the chart under the chosen lift, for *some* small étale neighbourhood of `x̄` whose chart is a
scheme.

Together with `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_iff_forall_etaleChart` this is the
exchange of quantifiers which Stacks 0EE1 asserts: the length agrees on some étale scheme
chart exactly when it agrees on every one.
declarations.statement:
theorem geometricLength_eq_iff_exists_etaleChart {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (d : ℕ∞) :
    geometricLength B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ x F = d ↔
      ∃ V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x,
        chartZariskiLength.{u, u} B S hS hX V.chart (chartPoint B S hS X V) F = d
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_of_image_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE1: the length at a geometric point does not depend on the geometric point.**
Let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let `x̄` and `ȳ` be geometric points of `X` lying
over the same point `x` of `|X|`.  Then `F` has the same length at `x̄` as at `ȳ`.  So the
length of Stacks 0EE2 is a function of `x`, which is what makes that definition well posed.

The two points are dominated by a common third
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GeometricPoint.exists_common_extension`), and the length is
unchanged along a domination
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_of_dominates`).
declarations.statement:
theorem geometricLength_eq_of_image_eq (x y : GeometricPoint B S hS X)
    (h : x.image = y.image) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX)
    [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    geometricLength B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ x F = geometricLength B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ y F
declarations.comment: independence of the chosen geometric point above a point of the space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.length_etaleLocalRing_eq_length_chartLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE1 for the structure sheaf.** The étale local ring of an algebraic space at a
geometric point has the same length as the local ring of any étale scheme chart at a point over
it. Since the chart is arbitrary, the two readings of Stacks 0EE1 — some chart and every chart —
agree, and the common value is the length of `𝒪_{X, x̄}`.

This is the case `N = 𝒪_{U, u}` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.length_chartStalkBaseChange_obj`, the base change
`𝒪_{X, x̄} ⊗_{𝒪_{U, u}} 𝒪_{U, u}` being `𝒪_{X, x̄}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem length_etaleLocalRing_eq_length_chartLocalRing {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) :
    Module.length ↥(etaleLocalRing B S hS X x) ↥(etaleLocalRing B S hS X x) =
      Module.length ↥(chartLocalRing B S hS X V) ↥(chartLocalRing B S hS X V)
declarations.comment: the structure sheaf: lengths agree on an étale scheme chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.tfae_hasLengthAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE1 at a point `x` of `|X|`: conditions (1), (2) and (3) are equivalent.** For a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F`, a point `x ∈ |X|` and `d ∈ ℕ∞`, the following are
equivalent:

1. `length_{𝒪_{X, x̄}} F_{x̄} = d` for a geometric point `x̄` above `x`;
2. for some étale morphism `U → X` with `U` a scheme and `u ∈ U` mapping to `x`,
   `length_{𝒪_{U, u}} (F|_U)_u = d`;
3. for every étale morphism `U → X` with `U` a scheme and `u ∈ U` mapping to `x`,
   `length_{𝒪_{U, u}} (F|_U)_u = d`.

Condition (1) is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasLengthAt` by definition, so this is the
statement that `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasLengthAt` is "the equivalent conditions of
Lemma 0EE1", as Stacks 0EE2 has it. Together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_of_image_eq` (condition (1) does not depend on the
geometric point chosen above `x`) this is the whole of Stacks 0EE1.
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_hasLengthAt (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (x : points B S hS X) (d : ℕ∞) :
    List.TFAE
      [∃ xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X,
          xbar.LiesOver x ∧ geometricLength B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ xbar F = d,
        ∃ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X) (u : chartScheme W), chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X W u = x ∧
          Module.length ((chartScheme W).presheaf.stalk u)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
              (restrictToChart B S hS hX F W).val.presheaf u) = d,
        ∀ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X) (u : chartScheme W), chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X W u = x →
          Module.length ((chartScheme W).presheaf.stalk u)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
              (restrictToChart B S hS hX F W).val.presheaf u) = d]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength
declarations.doc:
**The length of an `𝒪_X`-module at a geometric point.** For an algebraic space `X` over a
scheme `S`, a geometric point `x̄` of `X` and an `𝒪_X`-module `F`, this is the length of the
stalk `F_{x̄}` of Stacks 05VQ as a module over the étale local ring `𝒪_{X, x̄}` of
Stacks 04KG, a value in `ℕ∞ = {0, 1, 2, …, ∞}`.

This is the quantity of condition (1) of Stacks 0EE1; Stacks 0EE2 defines "`F` has length `d`
at a point `x` of `|X|`" to mean that this value is `d` for a geometric point above `x`, which
by Stacks 0EE1 does not depend on the choice — proved, for a quasi-coherent `F`, as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_of_image_eq` in
`GeometricLengthPointIndependence.lean`.
declarations.statement:
def geometricLength (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1)
    (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) : ℕ∞
declarations.comment:
at a geometric point; no declaration packages a chosen geometric point above a
point of `|X|` together with the independence of Lemma 0EE1
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_of_image_eq`) into the definition at a point of
`|X|`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasLengthAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE2: `F` has length `d` at `x`.** For a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F`, a point
`x` of `|X|` and `d ∈ ℕ∞`, this says that the stalk `F_{x̄}` has length `d` over the étale local
ring `𝒪_{X, x̄}` for a geometric point `x̄` of `X` lying over `x`.

Stacks 0EE2 defines this as the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0EE1; the definition uses
condition (1), which by that lemma does not depend on the choice of `x̄`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_of_image_eq`, so the condition holds for some
`x̄` above `x` iff for every one: `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasLengthAt_iff_forall_geometricPoint`)
and is equivalent to conditions (2) and (3), the length of `(F|_U)_u` over `𝒪_{U, u}` for some,
respectively every, étale `U → X` from a scheme and `u ∈ U` over `x`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.tfae_hasLengthAt`).
declarations.statement:
def HasLengthAt (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (x : points B S hS X) (d : ℕ∞) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_chartDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE3 for algebraic spaces, at a geometric point.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a closed
immersion of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, let `G` be an `𝒪_X`-module and let `x̄` be a
geometric point of `X`. Then `f_*G` has the same length at `f(x̄)` as `G` has at `x̄`.

The germ map `𝒪_{Y, f(x̄)} → 𝒪_{X, x̄}` of a closed immersion is surjective
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.surjective_etaleLocalRingMap_of_isClosedImmersion`) and the stalk of
`f_*G` at `f(x̄)` is the stalk of `G` at `x̄` semilinearly over it
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricStalkPushforwardAddEquiv`), so
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_of_surjective_of_addEquiv` applies: restriction of
scalars along a surjection does not change the lattice of submodules, hence not its length.

No quasi-coherence of `G` is assumed. The direct image is the one along base change of étale
scheme charts; see the implementation notes of this file.
declarations.statement:
theorem geometricLength_chartDirectImage (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsClosedImmersion B S hS f.hom)
    (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1) (G : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    geometricLength B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f.hom x)
        ((smallBaseChangeModulePushforward B S hS f hf.rep).obj G) =
      geometricLength B S hS X x G
declarations.comment:
at a geometric point of the source, and for the direct image of modules along
  base change of étale scheme charts; the form at a point of the space is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.lengthAtPoint_chartDirectImage_iff` of
  `StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/ClosedImmersionLengthAtPoint.lean`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_chartDirectImage_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE3 for algebraic spaces, at a geometric point**, in the iff form of the source:
for every `d` in `ℕ∞ = {0, 1, 2, …, ∞}`, the module `G` has length `d` at the geometric
point `x̄` of `X` exactly when `f_*G` has length `d` at `f(x̄)`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_chartDirectImage` read as an equivalence.
declarations.statement:
theorem geometricLength_chartDirectImage_iff (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsClosedImmersion B S hS f.hom) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1)
    (G : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) (d : ℕ∞) :
    geometricLength B S hS X x G = d ↔
      geometricLength B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f.hom x)
        ((smallBaseChangeModulePushforward B S hS f hf.rep).obj G) = d
declarations.comment:
at a geometric point of the source, and for the direct image of modules along
  base change of étale scheme charts; the form at a point of the space is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.lengthAtPoint_chartDirectImage_iff` of
  `StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/ClosedImmersionLengthAtPoint.lean`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.lengthAtPoint_chartDirectImage_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE3 at a point of the space.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a closed immersion of algebraic
spaces over a scheme `S`, let `G` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module, let `p` be a point of `|X|`
with image `f(p)` in `|Y|` and let `d` be an element of `ℕ∞ = {0, 1, 2, …, ∞}`. Then `G` has
length `d` at `p` if and only if `f_*G` has length `d` at `f(p)`.

"Has length `d` at a point" is the condition of Stacks 0EE2: the length of the module at that
point of the space, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.lengthAtPoint`, is `d`. Both sides are therefore
`= d` for one and the same number, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.lengthAtPoint_chartDirectImage`.
declarations.statement:
theorem lengthAtPoint_chartDirectImage_iff (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsClosedImmersion B S hS f.hom) (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    [G.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (p : points B S hS X.1) (d : ℕ∞) :
    lengthAtPoint B S hS X p G = d ↔
      lengthAtPoint B S hS Y (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom p)
        (chartDirectImage B S hS f hf G) = d
declarations.comment:
at a point of the space, for the direct image of modules along base change of
  étale scheme charts

declarations.name: Stacks.ClosedImmersion.length_stalkObj_pushforward_eq_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE3 for a closed immersion of schemes**, in the form the source states: for
`d ∈ {0, 1, 2, …, ∞}`, the module `G` has length `d` at `z` if and only if `i_* G` has length
`d` at the image `i(z)`.

Both sides are read off `Stacks.ClosedImmersion.length_stalkObj_pushforward`, which says the
two lengths are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem length_stalkObj_pushforward_eq_iff {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (G : Z.Modules) (z : Z) (d : ℕ∞) :
    Module.length (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := RingCat.{u}) Z.ringCatSheaf.obj z)
          (SheafOfModules.stalkObj Z.ringCatSheaf z G) = d ↔
      Module.length (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := RingCat.{u}) X.ringCatSheaf.obj (i.base z))
          (SheafOfModules.stalkObj X.ringCatSheaf (i.base z)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj G)) = d
declarations.comment: for a closed immersion of schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDecentSpace_iff_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isLocallyNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**The parenthetical of Stacks 0EE4.**  A locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S` is
decent if and only if it is quasi-separated.

Decency of a quasi-separated algebraic space is the chain of conditions of Stacks 03JX and needs
no finiteness hypothesis; quasi-separatedness of a locally Noetherian decent algebraic space is
Stacks 0BB6.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDecentSpace_iff_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isLocallyNoetherian
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hNoeth : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian Y)) :
    IsDecentSpace B S hS X ↔ IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal X
declarations.comment: decent iff quasi-separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.tfae_isGenericPoint_supp_restrictToChart_geometricLength
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE4, conditions (1), (2) and (3).**  Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic
space over `S`, let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let `x ∈ |X|`.  The following are
equivalent:

1. for some étale morphism `U → X` with `U` a scheme and some `u ∈ U` mapping to `x`, the point
   `u` is a generic point of an irreducible component of `Supp(F|_U)`;
2. for every étale morphism `U → X` with `U` a scheme and every `u ∈ U` mapping to `x`, the
   point `u` is a generic point of an irreducible component of `Supp(F|_U)`;
3. the length of `F` at `x` is finite and nonzero.

The étale morphisms from schemes are the étale scheme charts `W` of `X`, and `u` maps to `x`
when `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartSchemeToPoints` sends it to `x`.  The length of `F` at `x`
is the length of Stacks 0EE2: the length at a geometric point above `x`, which by Stacks 0EE1
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_of_image_eq`) does not depend on the geometric
point; condition (3) is stated at every geometric point above `x`.

Each chart point above `x` satisfies the chart condition exactly when the length is finite and
nonzero (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isGenericPoint_supp_restrictToChart_iff_geometricLength`),
and a chart point above `x` exists.
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_isGenericPoint_supp_restrictToChart_geometricLength
    (hLN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F]
    (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    List.TFAE
      [∃ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (u : chartScheme W),
          chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 W u = x ∧
            ∃ Z : irreducibleComponents
                (SheafOfModules.supp (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F W) : Set (chartScheme W)),
              IsGenericPoint u (Subtype.val '' Z.1),
        ∀ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (u : chartScheme W),
          chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 W u = x →
            ∃ Z : irreducibleComponents
                (SheafOfModules.supp (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F W) : Set (chartScheme W)),
              IsGenericPoint u (Subtype.val '' Z.1),
        ∀ xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1, xbar.LiesOver x →
          geometricLength B S hS X xbar F ≠ ⊤ ∧ 0 < geometricLength B S hS X xbar F]
declarations.comment: conditions (1), (2) and (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.tfae_isGenericPoint_supportOfSheaf_of_isDecentSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE4, conditions (1) to (4), for a decent space.**  Let `X` be a locally Noetherian
algebraic space over `S` which is decent (equivalently, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDecentSpace_iff_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isLocallyNoetherian`,
quasi-separated), let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let `x ∈ |X|`.  The three conditions of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.tfae_isGenericPoint_supp_restrictToChart_geometricLength` are also
equivalent to

4. `x` is a generic point of an irreducible component of `Supp(F)`.

The support of `F` is the support of Stacks 04KA of its underlying sheaf of abelian groups
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportOfSheaf`).  Condition (4) is equivalent to the chart condition
at every chart point above `x`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isGenericPoint_supp_restrictToChart_iff_supportOfSheaf`).
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_isGenericPoint_supportOfSheaf_of_isDecentSpace
    (hLN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X.1) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    [IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F] (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    List.TFAE
      [∃ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (u : chartScheme W),
          chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 W u = x ∧
            ∃ Z : irreducibleComponents
                (SheafOfModules.supp (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F W) : Set (chartScheme W)),
              IsGenericPoint u (Subtype.val '' Z.1),
        ∀ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (u : chartScheme W),
          chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 W u = x →
            ∃ Z : irreducibleComponents
                (SheafOfModules.supp (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F W) : Set (chartScheme W)),
              IsGenericPoint u (Subtype.val '' Z.1),
        ∀ xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1, xbar.LiesOver x →
          geometricLength B S hS X xbar F ≠ ⊤ ∧ 0 < geometricLength B S hS X xbar F,
        ∃ Z : irreducibleComponents
            (supportOfSheaf B S hS X.1 ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F)),
          IsGenericPoint x (Subtype.val '' Z.1)]
declarations.comment: conditions (1) to (4), for a decent space
