declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closedSubspaceCycle
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good, let `Y ⊆ X` be a closed subspace and assume
`dim_δ(Y) ≤ k`. The *`k`-cycle associated to `Y`* is `[Y]_k = ∑ m_{Z, Y} [Z]`, the sum over the
irreducible components `Z` of `Y` of δ-dimension `k`, with `m_{Z, Y}` the multiplicity of `Z` in
`Y`; as an element of `Z_k(X)` it is the coefficient family
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace` at the canonical geometric points.
declarations.comment:
part (2): the k-cycle [Y]_k of a closed subspace; the multiplicity at each point
  is independent of the choice of geometric representative by Lemma 0EE1
  (closedSubspaceMultiplicity_eq_toNat_geometricLength) and positive by Lemma 0EE4
  (closedSubspaceMultiplicity_pos)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closedSubspaceMultiplicity
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EE9, part (1).** The multiplicity `m_{W, Y}` of an integral closed subspace
`W ⊆ Y` in a closed subspace `Y ⊆ X`: the length of `𝒪_Y` at the generic point of `W`, read
inside `Y`, at a geometric representative of that generic point.

This is the coefficient the sum of part (2) attaches to `W`, as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closedSubspaceCycle_apply_eq_finsum` records. The representative used
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.canonicalGeometricPoint`, but by Stacks 0EE1
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closedSubspaceMultiplicity_eq_toNat_geometricLength`) the value does
not depend on this choice.
declarations.comment:
part (1): the multiplicity m_{Z,Y}, together with its positivity
  (closedSubspaceMultiplicity_pos, Lemma 0EE4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleMultiplicity
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEB, part (1).** The *multiplicity of an integral closed subspace `Z ⊆ X` in an
`𝒪_X`-module `F`*: the length of `F` at the generic point `ξ` of `Z`, in the sense of Stacks 0EE2,
read at the geometric point that `γ` assigns to `ξ`.

The source defines this when `|Z|` is an irreducible component of `Supp(F)`, where by Stacks 0EE4
it is a positive integer; the length itself is defined at every integral closed subspace, and the
positivity on a component is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleMultiplicity_pos_of_isIrreducibleComponent_moduleSupport`.
declarations.comment:
part (1): the multiplicity of an integral closed subspace in a module, at a chosen
  geometric representative of its generic point and valued in ℕ∞; the reading at a point of |X|
  additionally needs the equivalence of Lemma 0EE1, and the finiteness asserted by Lemma 0EE4,
  neither of which is proved in this library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.associatedCycle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEB, part (2).** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good, let `F` be a coherent
`𝒪_X`-module and assume `dim_δ(Supp(F)) ≤ k`. The *`k`-cycle associated to `F`* is

`[F]_k = ∑ m_{Z, F} [Z]`,

the sum over the integral closed subspaces `Z ⊆ X` whose set of points is an irreducible component
of `Supp(F)` of δ-dimension `k`, with `m_{Z, F}` the multiplicity of part (1).

As an element of `Z_k(X)` this is the coefficient family
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfModule`, which assigns `m_{Z, F}` to each `Z` of δ-dimension
`k`: off the support the multiplicity already vanishes, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_irreducibleComponents_of_cycleCoeffOfModule_ne_zero`
shows that the subspaces left with a nonzero coefficient are exactly the components of `Supp(F)`
of δ-dimension `k`, so the family is the displayed sum. That it is a `k`-cycle at all is
Stacks 0EE5, by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfModule_mem_cyclesOfDimension`.
declarations.statement:
def associatedCycle (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1)
    [IsCoherent D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1 F] (k : ℤ)
    (γ : points D.site D.base D.base_mem X → GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem X)
    (hγ : ∀ x, (γ x).LiesOver x)
    (hdim : deltaDimensionClosed D sX hX (moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 F)
      (isClosed_moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 F) ≤ (k : EInt)) :
    CycleGroup D sX k
declarations.comment:
part (2): the k-cycle [F]_k of a coherent module, for a chosen geometric
  representative of each point; the reading at a point of |X| additionally needs the equivalence of
  Lemma 0EE1, which is not proved in this library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.associatedCycle_apply_eq_geometricLength
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEC.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good, let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module with
`dim_δ(Supp(F)) ≤ k`, and let `Z` be an integral closed subspace of `X` with `dim_δ(Z) = k` and
generic point `ξ`. Then the coefficient of `Z` in `[F]_k` is the length of `F` at `ξ`.

The generic point is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IntegralClosedSubspace.ambientGenericPoint`, which is
a generic point of `|Z|` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IntegralClosedSubspace.isGenericPoint_ambientGenericPoint`; the length is
read at the geometric point `γ` assigns to it, and is the multiplicity of part (1) of Stacks 0EEB.
No hypothesis asks `|Z|` to be an irreducible component of `Supp(F)`: the source reaches that case
from the dichotomy that `|Z|` is such a component exactly when `ξ` lies in `Supp(F)`, off which the
length vanishes, and both halves of it are already recorded here, as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_irreducibleComponents_of_cycleCoeffOfModule_ne_zero` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_notMem_moduleSupport`.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedCycle_apply_eq_geometricLength (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1)
    [IsCoherent D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1 F] (k : ℤ)
    (γ : points D.site D.base D.base_mem X → GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem X)
    (hγ : ∀ x, (γ x).LiesOver x)
    (hdim : deltaDimensionClosed D sX hX (moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 F)
      (isClosed_moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 F) ≤ (k : EInt))
    {Z : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X}
    (hZ : deltaDimension D sX Z = k) :
    (associatedCycle D sX hX F k γ hγ hdim).1 Z =
      ((geometricLength D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩
        (γ (Z.ambientGenericPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem)) F).toNat : ℤ)
declarations.comment:
the coefficient at a chosen geometric representative of the generic point, valued in
  ℤ through ENat.toNat as cycle coefficients are; the reading at a point of |X| additionally needs
  the equivalence of Lemma 0EE1, which is not proved in this library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_eq_cycleCoeffOfModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EED, at an integral closed subspace contained in `Y`.** In Situation 0EDT let
`X/B` be good, let `Y ⊂ X` be a closed subspace with inclusion `i : Y → X`, assume
`dim_δ(Y) ≤ k`, and let `W` be an integral closed subspace of `Y` with image `Z ⊂ X`. Then the
coefficient of `Z` in `[Y]_k` is the coefficient of `Z` in `[i_*𝒪_Y]_k`.

The chosen geometric representatives `γY` and `γX` are each assumed to lie over the point they
are assigned to, which `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_compatible_geometricRepresentative` shows
is possible; the content is then Stacks 0EE3, by way of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_closedSubspacePushforwardStructureSheaf`, together with
Stacks 0EE1 to move from `γX` at the image of the generic point of `W` to the geometric point
`i(γY(ξ_W))` that the comparison with `𝒪_Y` is stated at.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_eq_cycleCoeffOfModule (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX)
    (Y : Subfunctor X) (hY : IsClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Y) (k : ℤ)
    (_hdim : deltaDimensionSubspace D sX hX Y hY ≤ (k : EInt))
    (γY : points D.site D.base D.base_mem Y.toFunctor →
      GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem Y.toFunctor)
    (γX : points D.site D.base D.base_mem X → GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem X)
    (hγY : ∀ y, (γY y).LiesOver y) (hγX : ∀ x, (γX x).LiesOver x)
    (W : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Y.toFunctor) :
    cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace D sX hX Y hY k γY
        (closedSubspaceComponentImage D sX hX Y hY W) =
      cycleCoeffOfModule D sX hX
        (closedSubspacePushforwardStructureSheaf D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 Y hY) k γX
        (closedSubspaceComponentImage D sX hX Y hY W)
declarations.comment:
the coefficient at an integral closed subspace contained in Y, for a choice of
  geometric representatives above the points they are assigned to, using Lemma 0EE1 to compare
  the two

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_eq_cycleCoeffOfModule_of_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EED.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good, let `Y ⊂ X` be a closed subspace with
inclusion `i : Y → X`, and assume `dim_δ(Y) ≤ k`. Then `[Y]_k = [i_*𝒪_Y]_k`, as an equality of
coefficient families on the integral closed subspaces of `X`.

For an integral closed subspace `Z` with image contained in `|Y|` this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_eq_cycleCoeffOfModule`. Otherwise both sides
vanish: the left by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_eq_zero`, and the right
because `i_*𝒪_Y` is annihilated by the ideal cutting out `Y`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.annihilatedByKerIdeal_closedSubspacePushforwardStructureSheaf`), so its
geometric stalk is trivial at any geometric point over a point of `|X|` outside the image of
`|Y|`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.subsingleton_geometricModuleStalk_of_annihilatedByKerIdeal_of_notMem`);
and the generic point of `Z` is such a point exactly when no integral closed subspace of `Y` has
image `Z`, since `Y` is a decent space
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDecentSpace_of_relativelyRepresentable`) and every integral closed
subspace of `X` contained in the image of `|Y|` is itself such an image
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IntegralClosedSubspace.exists_pushforward_eq`). This is the support
bound of Lemma 07U0, proved rather than taken as a hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_eq_cycleCoeffOfModule_of_eq_zero (sX : X ⟶ D.space)
    (hX : D.IsGood sX) (Y : Subfunctor X)
    (hY : IsClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Y) (k : ℤ)
    (hdim : deltaDimensionSubspace D sX hX Y hY ≤ (k : EInt))
    (γY : points D.site D.base D.base_mem Y.toFunctor →
      GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem Y.toFunctor)
    (γX : points D.site D.base D.base_mem X → GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem X)
    (hγY : ∀ y, (γY y).LiesOver y) (hγX : ∀ x, (γX x).LiesOver x) :
    cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace D sX hX Y hY k γY =
      cycleCoeffOfModule D sX hX
        (closedSubspacePushforwardStructureSheaf D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 Y hY) k γX
declarations.comment:
the equality of the two k-cycles, for a choice of geometric representatives above
  the points they are assigned to

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.associatedCycle_add_of_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEE.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and let `0 → F → G → H → 0` be a short
exact sequence of coherent `𝒪_X`-modules whose three supports have δ-dimension at most `k`. Then

`[G]_k = [F]_k + [H]_k`.

Coefficientwise this is additivity of the multiplicity,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleMultiplicity_add_of_shortExact`, hence additivity of length in a
short exact sequence, Stacks 00IV, at the generic point of each integral closed subspace of
δ-dimension `k`; at the subspaces of other δ-dimension all three coefficients vanish.

Cycle coefficients are integers, reached from the `ℕ∞`-valued multiplicity by `ENat.toNat`, which
is additive only on finite values, so the proof also needs the multiplicities of the middle term to
be finite at the subspaces of δ-dimension `k`. Off its support the multiplicity is zero. On its
support, the generic point of such a subspace attains the δ-dimension bound, so it is a generic
point of an irreducible component of the support by Stacks 0EE6
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isGenericPoint_of_deltaDimensionClosed_le`), and the length there is
finite by Stacks 0EE4
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_ne_top_and_pos_of_isGenericPoint_supportOfSheaf`).

The cycles are read at the geometric points `γ` chooses above the points of `|X|`; by Stacks 0EE1,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricLength_eq_of_image_eq`, the lengths, hence the cycles, do not
depend on that choice.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedCycle_add_of_shortExact (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX)
    (σ : ShortComplex (Modules.{u, u} D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1)) (hσ : σ.ShortExact)
    [IsCoherent D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1 σ.X₁]
    [IsCoherent D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1 σ.X₂]
    [IsCoherent D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1 σ.X₃] (k : ℤ)
    (γ : points D.site D.base D.base_mem X → GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem X)
    (hγ : ∀ x, (γ x).LiesOver x)
    (hdim₁ : deltaDimensionClosed D sX hX
      (moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 σ.X₁)
      (isClosed_moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 σ.X₁) ≤ (k : EInt))
    (hdim₂ : deltaDimensionClosed D sX hX
      (moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 σ.X₂)
      (isClosed_moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 σ.X₂) ≤ (k : EInt))
    (hdim₃ : deltaDimensionClosed D sX hX
      (moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 σ.X₃)
      (isClosed_moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 σ.X₃) ≤ (k : EInt)) :
    associatedCycle D sX hX σ.X₂ k γ hγ hdim₂ =
      associatedCycle D sX hX σ.X₁ k γ hγ hdim₁ +
        associatedCycle D sX hX σ.X₃ k γ hγ hdim₃

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IntegralClosedSubspace.existsUnique_isDominant_hom_of_isGood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEG.** In Situation 0EDT, let `X` and `Y` be good algebraic spaces over the base
and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism over the base. For an integral closed subspace `Z ⊂ X` there
is exactly one integral closed subspace `Z' ⊂ Y` admitting a morphism `Z ⟶ Z'` over `f` — that
is, one making the square with `Z ⟶ X`, `Z' ⟶ Y` and `f` commute — which is dominant; and if
`f` is proper, then every such morphism is proper and surjective. Every morphism making that
square commute is a morphism over the base, so the whole diagram is one over the base.

The subspace is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IntegralClosedSubspace.closureImage` at `f`, the
integral closed subspace of `Y` on the closure of the image of `|Z|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IntegralClosedSubspace.existsUnique_isDominant_hom_of_isGood (pX : X ⟶ D.space)
    (pY : Y ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood pX) (hY : D.IsGood pY) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ pY = pX)
    (Z : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X) :
    (∃! Z' : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Y,
        ∃ g : Z.subspace.toFunctor ⟶ Z'.subspace.toFunctor,
          g ≫ Z'.subspace.ι = Z.subspace.ι ≫ f ∧
            IsDominant D.site D.base D.base_mem g) ∧
      (∀ (Z' : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Y)
          (g : Z.subspace.toFunctor ⟶ Z'.subspace.toFunctor),
          g ≫ Z'.subspace.ι = Z.subspace.ι ≫ f →
            g ≫ Z'.subspace.ι ≫ pY = Z.subspace.ι ≫ pX) ∧
      (IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem f →
        ∀ (Z' : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Y)
          (g : Z.subspace.toFunctor ⟶ Z'.subspace.toFunctor),
          g ≫ Z'.subspace.ι = Z.subspace.ι ≫ f → IsDominant D.site D.base D.base_mem g →
            IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem g ∧
              IsSurjective D.site D.base D.base_mem g)

declarations.name: exists_isJacobsonRing_isUniversallyCatenary_localization_ringKrullDim_one_and_two
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEI.** There is a Jacobson, universally catenary, Noetherian domain `B` with
maximal ideals `𝔪₁` and `𝔪₂` such that `dim B_{𝔪₁} = 1` and `dim B_{𝔪₂} = 2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isJacobsonRing_isUniversallyCatenary_localization_ringKrullDim_one_and_two :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsNoetherianRing B) (_ : IsDomain B),
      IsJacobsonRing B ∧ Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary B ∧
        ∃ m₁ m₂ : MaximalSpectrum B,
          ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime m₁.asIdeal) = 1 ∧
          ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime m₂.asIdeal) = 2

registrations.name: stableUnderSpecialization_iff_exists_sUnion_eq
registrations.comment: stable under specialization iff a union of closed sets

declarations.name: AdicCompletionTor.derivedCompletion_homology_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EET.** Over a Noetherian ring, derived completion has Milnor short exact
sequences. For a module these read
`0 ⟶ R¹ lim Tor_(i+1)(M, A/Iⁿ) ⟶ H^(-i)(M^∧) ⟶ lim Tor_i(M, A/Iⁿ) ⟶ 0`.
For a derived object, the Tor systems are replaced by the cohomology systems of its derived
tensors with `A/Iⁿ`. The latter assertion is valid for every derived object, and in particular
for every object of `D⁻(A)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem derivedCompletion_homology_shortExact
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (T : CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.DerivedTensorProduct A)
    [HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))] :
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      fun K ↦ IsDerivedComplete I K
    ∃ L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ P.FullSubcategory,
      Nonempty (L ⊣ P.ι) ∧
        (∀ K, IsDerivedLimit
          (NoetherianAdicCompletion.idealPowerQuotientSystem I ⋙ T.tensor.obj K)
          ((L ⋙ P.ι).obj K)) ∧
        (∀ (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (i : ℕ),
          let M₀ := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj M
          let Mhat := (L ⋙ P.ι).obj M₀
          let R1limTor := firstDerivedInverseLimit (torIdealPowerSystem I M (i + 1))
          let HminusI := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) (-(i : ℤ))).obj Mhat
          let limTor := limit (torIdealPowerSystem I M i)
          ∃ (a : R1limTor ⟶ HminusI) (b : HminusI ⟶ limTor) (w : a ≫ b = 0),
            (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) ∧
        (∀ (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) (p : ℤ),
          let Khat := (L ⋙ P.ι).obj K
          let H := derivedTensorHomologySystem T I K
          let R1limH := firstDerivedInverseLimit (H (p - 1))
          let Hp := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p).obj Khat
          let limH := limit (H p)
          ∃ (a : R1limH ⟶ Hp) (b : Hp ⟶ limH) (w : a ≫ b = 0),
            (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)

declarations.name: AdicCompletionFlatTensor.derivedCompletion_iso_adicCompletion_of_finite_tensor_flat_and_localization
declarations.doc:
Let `I` be an ideal of a Noetherian ring `A`. Derived `I`-adic
completion agrees with ordinary `I`-adic completion for the tensor product of a finite
module with a flat module, and for the localization of a finite module at one element.
declarations.statement:
public theorem derivedCompletion_iso_adicCompletion_of_finite_tensor_flat_and_localization
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (T : CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.DerivedTensorProduct A)
    [HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))] :
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      fun K ↦ IsDerivedComplete I K
    ∀ (L : Functor (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) P.FullSubcategory),
    Nonempty (L ⊣ P.ι) →
    (∀ K, IsDerivedLimit
      (NoetherianAdicCompletion.idealPowerQuotientSystem I ⋙ T.tensor.obj K)
      ((L ⋙ P.ι).obj K)) →
    let isUsual (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q] : Prop :=
      Nonempty
        ((L ⋙ P.ι).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
              (ModuleCat.of A Q)) ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A (AdicCompletion I Q)))
    (∀ (M N : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
        [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module.Flat A N],
      isUsual (TensorProduct A M N)) ∧
    (∀ (M Mf : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
        [AddCommGroup Mf] [Module A Mf] (f : A) (φ : M →ₗ[A] Mf)
        [IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) φ],
      isUsual Mf)

declarations.name: AdicCompletionPseudoCoherentTensor.derivedCompletion_tensor_iso_of_boundedAbove
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEV.** Derived completion of a bounded-above complex commutes with derived
tensor product by a finite module, and more generally by a pseudo-coherent complex.
declarations.statement:
public theorem derivedCompletion_tensor_iso_of_boundedAbove
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (T : CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.DerivedTensorProduct A)
    [HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))] :
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      fun K ↦ IsDerivedComplete I K
    ∀ (C : Functor (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) P.FullSubcategory),
    Nonempty (C ⊣ P.ι) →
    (∀ K, IsDerivedLimit
      (NoetherianAdicCompletion.idealPowerQuotientSystem I ⋙ T.tensor.obj K)
      ((C ⋙ P.ι).obj K)) →
    ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)),
    DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus K →
      (∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M],
        Nonempty
          ((C ⋙ P.ι).obj
              ((T.tensor.obj K).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
                  (ModuleCat.of A M))) ≅
            (T.tensor.obj ((C ⋙ P.ι).obj K)).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
                (ModuleCat.of A M)))) ∧
      (∀ L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent L →
        Nonempty
          ((C ⋙ P.ι).obj ((T.tensor.obj K).obj L) ≅
            (T.tensor.obj ((C ⋙ P.ι).obj K)).obj L))

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isDerivedLimitWithProjections_completedLocalCohomologyNormalizedProjection_of_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEW, part (1), for the projections normalized against the completion unit.** For a
finite module over a Noetherian ring, `RΓ_{V(J)}(M)^∧` is a derived limit of the tower
`n ↦ RΓ_{V(J)}(M/IⁿM)` *with the normalized projections* — the cone whose composites with the
completion unit are the maps induced by `M ↠ M/IⁿM`.

`Stacks.Algebraization.isDerivedLimitWithProjections_completedLocalCohomologyNormalizedProjection`
reduces this to exhibiting *one* unit-normalized derived-limit cone, and
`Dualizing.exists_isDerivedLimitWithProjections_of_uliftAdicQuotientIso` is one: Stacks 0922
supplies a reflection onto the derived `I`-complete objects whose unit induces the reduction maps
of the tower `n ↦ K ⊗ᴸ A/Iⁿ`, the comparison with the tower of ordinary quotients is normalized,
and two reflections onto the same subcategory agree compatibly with their units, so the cone
transports to the reflection `adicCompletionFunctor`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedLimitWithProjections_completedLocalCohomologyNormalizedProjection_of_finite
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (I J : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    [Module.Finite A M] :
    NoetherianAdicCompletion.IsDerivedLimitWithProjections
      (Dualizing.adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem A I J hJ M)
      ((adicCompletionFunctor A I hI).obj
        ((Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor A J hJ).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj M)).obj)
      (completedLocalCohomologyNormalizedProjection I J hI hJ M)
declarations.comment: part (1) for the projections normalized against the completion unit

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDerivedLimit_adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem
declarations.doc:
The tower `n ↦ RΓ_Z(M/IⁿM)` has a derived limit: countable products exist in `D(A)`, so the
difference map `1 - shift` on the product of the terms sits in a distinguished triangle.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isDerivedLimit_adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem (I J : Ideal A) (hJ : J.FG)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A),
      IsDerivedLimit (adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem A I J hJ M) K
declarations.comment: the tower of local cohomologies has a derived limit

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_milnor_shortExact_of_isDerivedLimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEW, part (2), for an arbitrary derived limit of the tower.** The cohomology of a
derived limit of `n ↦ RΓ_Z(M/IⁿM)` sits in a short exact sequence between the first derived
limit `R¹lim H^{r-1}_Z(M/IⁿM)`, presented as the cokernel of one minus shift, and the inverse
limit `lim Hʳ_Z(M/IⁿM)`. The inclusion is the connecting morphism of the presenting triangle and
the projection is characterized by its composites with the limit projections.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_milnor_shortExact_of_isDerivedLimit (I J : Ideal A) (hJ : J.FG)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hK : IsDerivedLimit (adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem A I J hJ M) K) :
    let F := adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem A I J hJ M
    let X : ℕ → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) := fun n ↦ F.obj (Opposite.op n)
    let d : (∏ᶜ X) ⟶ ∏ᶜ X := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π X n - Pi.π X (n + 1) ≫ F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
    ∃ (a : K ⟶ ∏ᶜ X) (b : (∏ᶜ X) ⟶ K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      let T := Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk a d b
      T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) ∧
        ∀ r : ℤ,
          let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) r
          let H₁ := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) (r - 1)
          let homologySystem : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} A := F ⋙ H
          let shiftedHomologySystem : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} A := F ⋙ H₁
          let P : ModuleCat.{u} A :=
            ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (Opposite.op n)
          let δ : P ⟶ P := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
            Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (Opposite.op n)) n -
              Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (Opposite.op n)) (n + 1) ≫
                shiftedHomologySystem.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
          ∃ (e : H₁.obj (∏ᶜ X) ≅ P)
            (i : cokernel δ ⟶ H.obj K) (q : H.obj K ⟶ limit homologySystem)
            (w : i ≫ q = 0),
            e.hom = piComparison H₁ X ∧
              cokernel.π δ ≫ i = e.inv ≫
                DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.δ T (r - 1) r ∧
              (∀ n : ℕ, q ≫ limit.π homologySystem (Opposite.op n) =
                H.map a ≫ H.map (Pi.π X n)) ∧
              (ShortComplex.mk i q w).ShortExact
declarations.comment: the Milnor short exact sequence for the tower

declarations.name: Dualizing.isZero_homology_of_isDerivedLimit_of_neg
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEW, the negative-degree vanishing, for an arbitrary derived limit of the tower.**
A derived limit of `n ↦ RΓ_Z(M/IⁿM)` has no cohomology in negative degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_homology_of_isDerivedLimit_of_neg (I J : Ideal A) (hJ : J.FG)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hK : IsDerivedLimit (adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem A I J hJ M) K) (i : ℤ) (hi : i < 0) :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj K)
declarations.comment: vanishing in negative degrees

declarations.name: Dualizing.isDerivedLimit_completedLocalCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEW, part (1).** The derived `I`-adic completion of `RΓ_Z(M)` is a derived limit
of the tower `n ↦ RΓ_Z(M/IⁿM)`.

The Čech formula for local cohomology replaces `RΓ_Z` by `C(g) ⊗ᴸ -`, where `C(g)` is the
extended alternating Čech complex of a finite generating family of `J`. Derived `I`-adic
completion of `C(g) ⊗ᴸ M` is the derived limit of the tower `n ↦ (C(g) ⊗ᴸ M) ⊗ᴸ A/Iⁿ`
(Tag 0EET), and associativity of the derived tensor product rewrites that tower as
`n ↦ C(g) ⊗ᴸ (M ⊗ᴸ A/Iⁿ)`. The comparison with the tower of ordinary quotients
`n ↦ C(g) ⊗ᴸ (M/IⁿM)` is a pro-isomorphism, because the fibres only carry the Tor modules
`Torᵢ(M, A/Iⁿ)` and those are pro-zero over a Noetherian ring for a finite module
(Tag 0911).
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedLimit_completedLocalCohomology [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I J : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M] :
    IsDerivedLimit (adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem A I J hJ M)
      (completedLocalCohomology A I J hI hJ M)
declarations.comment: part (1): the derived I-adic completion of RΓ_J(M) is R lim RΓ_J(M/IⁿM)

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_iso_homology_zero_completedLocalCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EEX.** Let `I` and `J` be ideals of a Noetherian ring `A` which is `I`-adically
complete, let `M` be a finite `A`-module and `Z = V(J)`. The degree-zero cohomology of the
derived `I`-adic completion `RΓ_Z(M)^∧` of local cohomology is the filtered colimit of
`H⁰_{V(J')}(M)` over the ideals `J' ⊆ J` with `V(J') ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I)`.

The colimit is realized as the supremum `P` of the `J'`-power-torsion submodules `Γ_{J'}(M)`
of `M` (each `H⁰_{V(J')}(M)` is `Γ_{J'}(M)` by
`Stacks.Duality.supportLocalCohomology_zero_iso_torsion`; the index set is directed and the
supremum is the union of its terms by `Dualizing.iSup_primaryComponent_eq_supportTraceSubmodule`).
The isomorphism is the one induced by the comparison of Tag 0EEW with `lim H⁰_Z(M/IⁿM)`:
composing it with the inclusion into `M` and the projection to `M/IⁿM` gives the `n`-th limit
projection followed by the canonical map `H⁰_Z(M/IⁿM) ⟶ M/IⁿM`. Tag 0EEW part (1),
`Dualizing.isDerivedLimit_completedLocalCohomology`, identifies `RΓ_Z(M)^∧` with the derived
limit of the tower `n ↦ RΓ_Z(M/IⁿM)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_homology_zero_completedLocalCohomology [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I J : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A] (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M]
    (P : Submodule A M)
    (hP : P = ⨆ (J' : Ideal A) (_ : J' ≤ J)
      (_ : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J' : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A)),
      Ideal.primaryComponent M J') :
    ∃ e : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
        (completedLocalCohomology A I J I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing J.fg_of_isNoetherianRing M) ≅
          ModuleCat.of A P,
      ∀ n : ℕ, e.hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom P.subtype ≫
          ModuleCat.ofHom (I ^ n • (⊤ : Submodule A M)).mkQ =
        completedLocalCohomologyToLimit A I J J.fg_of_isNoetherianRing M _
            (isDerivedLimit_completedLocalCohomology A I J I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
              J.fg_of_isNoetherianRing M) 0 ≫
          limit.π (adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem A I J J.fg_of_isNoetherianRing M ⋙
            DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0) (Opposite.op n) ≫
          Stacks.Duality.supportLocalCohomologyToModule.{u, u} A J J.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
            ((adicQuotientModuleSystem A I M).obj
              (Opposite.op n))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.sectionsWithSupportIn_eq_top_iff
declarations.doc:
Degree-zero sections with support in `T` fill `M` if and only if the support of `M` is
contained in `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sectionsWithSupportIn_eq_top_iff (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] :
    sectionsWithSupportIn A T M = ⊤ ↔ Module.support A M ⊆ T
declarations.comment: equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.supportModuleProperty_isSerreClass
declarations.doc: Modules whose support is contained in `T` form a Serre subcategory of `A`-modules.
declarations.statement:
instance supportModuleProperty_isSerreClass (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) :
    (supportModuleProperty A T : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{v} A)).IsSerreClass
declarations.comment: Serre subcategory

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.supportModuleProperty_isClosedUnderCoproducts
declarations.doc: Modules whose support is contained in `T` are closed under arbitrary direct sums.
declarations.statement:
instance supportModuleProperty_isClosedUnderCoproducts (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (J : Type w) :
    (supportModuleProperty A T : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{v} A)).IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape
      (Discrete J)
declarations.comment: closed under direct sums

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.derivedInclusion_adj_derivedSupportedSections
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a Noetherian ring and `T ⊆ Spec A` be stable under specialization. Then
`RH⁰_T : D(A) ⥤ D(Mod_{A,T})` is right adjoint to the functor `D(Mod_{A,T}) ⥤ D(A)` induced by
the inclusion.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedInclusion_adj_derivedSupportedSections (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (_hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) :
    Nonempty
      ((supportModuleProperty A T :
          ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)).ι.mapDerivedCategory ⊣
        derivedSupportedSections.{u, v} A T)
declarations.comment: adjunction

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.derivedSupportedSections_comp_inclusion_iso
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a Noetherian ring and `T ⊆ Spec A` be stable under specialization. Composing
`RH⁰_T : D(A) ⥤ D(Mod_{A,T})` with the derived inclusion recovers the derived sections with
support in `T` taken in `D(A)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedSupportedSections_comp_inclusion_iso (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) :
    Nonempty
      (derivedSupportedSections.{u, v} A T ⋙
        (supportModuleProperty A T :
            ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)).ι.mapDerivedCategory ≅
          derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, v} A T)
declarations.comment: comparison with ambient derived sections

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.colimitClosedSupportComparison_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF1.** For a Noetherian ring `A` and a specialization-stable subset
`T` of its spectrum, the canonical comparison from the filtered colimit of local cohomology with
closed support contained in `T` to the cohomology of derived sections with support in `T` is an
isomorphism, naturally in the derived object.
declarations.statement:
theorem colimitClosedSupportComparison_isIso (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (_hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (i : ℤ) :
    IsIso (colimitClosedSupportComparison.{u, v} A T i)

declarations.name: Module.exists_supportedModulesDerivedPlusEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF2.** For a specialization-closed subset `T` of the spectrum of a
Noetherian ring `A`, the canonical functor from the bounded-below derived category of modules
supported in `T` to the bounded-below derived category with cohomology supported in `T` is an
equivalence.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_supportedModulesDerivedPlusEquivalence
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (_hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) :
    ∃ (e : DerivedCategory.Plus (ModulesSupportedIn A T) ≌
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus
          (supportModuleProperty A T)).FullSubcategory),
      Nonempty
        (e.functor ⋙
            (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus
              (supportModuleProperty A T)).ι ≅
          DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙
            (supportModuleProperty A T).ι.mapDerivedCategory)

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.supportedModulesComparison_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF3.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring of finite Krull dimension and let
`T ⊆ Spec(A)` be stable under specialization. The canonical functor from the derived category of
the modules supported in `T` to the full subcategory of `D(A)` on the objects whose cohomology is
supported in `T` is an equivalence.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportedModulesComparison_isEquivalence (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A))
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ⊤) :
    (supportedModulesComparison.{u, v} A T).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.nonempty_derivedSectionsWithSupportInPlus_comp_inclusion_iso
declarations.doc:
The bounded-below and unbounded right derived functors of sections with support in `T` agree
after including bounded-below complexes in the unbounded derived category.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_derivedSectionsWithSupportInPlus_comp_inclusion_iso :
    Nonempty
      (derivedSectionsWithSupportInPlus.{u, v} A T ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ≅
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, v} A T)
declarations.comment: cohomology_calculation

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.sectionsWithSupportInFunctor
declarations.doc:
Degree-zero sections with support in `T`, functorial in the module: on objects, the
filtered colimit of the `I`-power-torsion submodules over ideals whose zero locus is contained

declarations.statement:
def sectionsWithSupportInFunctor (A : Type u) [CommRing A]

declarations.comment: local_cohomology_with_support_in_t

The total right derived functor of degree-zero sections with support in `T`, on bounded-below
derived objects.

noncomputable def derivedSectionsWithSupportInPlus (A : Type u) [CommRing A]

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus
declarations.doc: The `i`-th local cohomology module with support in `T` of a bounded-below derived object.

noncomputable abbrev localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus

    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isColimitClosedSupportCocone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF4, the colimit formula.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring and
`T ⊆ Spec(A)` stable under specialization. For every `K` in `D(A)` and every `i`, the canonical
cocone on the diagram of local cohomology `H^i_Z(K)` indexed by the closed subsets `Z ⊆ T` is a
colimit cocone with vertex `H^i_T(K) = H^i(RΓ_T(K))`. That is,
`H^i_T(K) = colim_{Z ⊆ T closed} H^i_Z(K)`, the index category being filtered.
declarations.statement:
def isColimitClosedSupportCocone [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (i : ℤ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)) :
    IsColimit (closedSupportCocone.{u, v} A T i K)
declarations.comment: cohomology_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.colimitClosedSupportIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF4, the colimit formula.** The isomorphism
`colim_{Z ⊆ T closed} H^i_Z(K) ≅ H^i_T(K)` for `K` in `D(A)`, induced by the canonical maps
`H^i_Z(K) ⟶ H^i_T(K)`.
declarations.statement:
def colimitClosedSupportIso [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (i : ℤ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)) :
    colimit ((closedSupportDiagram.{u, v} A T i).obj K) ≅
      localCohomologyWithSupportIn A T K i
declarations.comment: cohomology_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.nonempty_colimitClosedSupportIsoPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF4, the colimit formula on `D^+(A)`.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring
and `T ⊆ Spec(A)` stable under specialization. For `K` in `D^+(A)`, local cohomology with support
in `T` computed by the bounded-below derived functor is again the filtered colimit of `H^i_Z(K)`
over the closed subsets `Z ⊆ T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_colimitClosedSupportIsoPlus [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (i : ℤ)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)) :
    Nonempty
      (colimit ((closedSupportDiagram.{u, v} A T i).obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K)) ≅
        localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus A T K i)
declarations.comment: cohomology_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.inclusion_adj_derivedSupportedSectionsComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF4, unbounded adjunction.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring of finite
Krull dimension and `T ⊆ Spec(A)` stable under specialization. The composite of `RH⁰_T` with the
comparison into `D_T(A)` is right adjoint to the inclusion `D_T(A) ⥤ D(A)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem inclusion_adj_derivedSupportedSectionsComparison [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ⊤) :
    Nonempty
      ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (supportModuleProperty A T : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{max u v} A))).ι ⊣
        (derivedSupportedSections.{u, v} A T ⋙
          supportedModulesComparison.{u, max u v} A T))
declarations.comment: unbounded_adjunction

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.inclusion_adj_derivedSupportedSectionsPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF4, bounded adjunction.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring and
`T ⊆ Spec(A)` stable under specialization. The composite of the bounded-below derived functor of
sections with support in `T` with the comparison into `supportedPlusProperty` is right adjoint
to the inclusion of that subcategory into `D^+(A)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem inclusion_adj_derivedSupportedSectionsPlus [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) :
    Nonempty
      ((supportedPlusProperty.{u, v} A T).ι ⊣
        ((supportedSectionsFunctor.{u, v} A T).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
          comparisonPlus.{u, v} A T hT))
declarations.comment: bounded_adjunction

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.nonempty_inclusion_adj_and_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_colimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF4.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring and `T ⊆ Spec(A)` a subset
stable under specialization. Write `RΓ_T` for `RH^0_T` followed by the comparison
`D(Mod_{A,T}) ⥤ D_T(A)`, on `D^+(A)` and on `D(A)`. Then:

* `RΓ_T : D^+(A) ⥤ D_T^+(A)` is right adjoint to the inclusion `D_T^+(A) ⥤ D^+(A)`;
* if `dim(A) < ∞`, then `RΓ_T : D(A) ⥤ D_T(A)` is right adjoint to the inclusion
  `D_T(A) ⥤ D(A)`;
* in both cases `H^i_T(K) = H^i(RΓ_T(K)) = R^iH^0_T(K) = colim_{Z ⊆ T closed} H^i_Z(K)`.

Here `H^i_T(K)` is `localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus` (for `K` in `D^+(A)`) or
`localCohomologyWithSupportIn` (for `K` in `D(A)`), the cohomology of the derived functor of
`H^0_T : Mod_A ⥤ Mod_A`. For each of the two cases the theorem states: the adjunction; that the
adjoint `RΓ_T`, followed by the inclusion of `D_T(A)`, is isomorphic to that derived functor; and,
for every `K` and `i`, that `H^i(RΓ_T(K))`, `R^iH^0_T(K) = H^i(RH^0_T(K))` (the `i`-th
cohomology in `Mod_{A,T}`, viewed as an `A`-module) and the filtered colimit of `H^i_Z(K)` over
the closed subsets `Z ⊆ T` (`closedSupportIdeal_isFiltered`) are each isomorphic to `H^i_T(K)`.
Only the adjunction on `D(A)` uses `dim(A) < ∞`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_inclusion_adj_and_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_colimit
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A))
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) :
    Nonempty
        ((supportedPlusProperty.{u, v} A T).ι ⊣
          ((supportedSectionsFunctor.{u, v} A T).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
            comparisonPlus.{u, v} A T hT)) ∧
      Nonempty
        (((supportedSectionsFunctor.{u, v} A T).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
            comparisonPlus.{u, v} A T hT) ⋙ (supportedPlusProperty.{u, v} A T).ι ≅
          derivedSectionsWithSupportInPlus.{u, v} A T) ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)),
        Nonempty
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) i).obj
                ((supportedPlusProperty.{u, v} A T).ι.obj
                  (((supportedSectionsFunctor.{u, v} A T).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
                    comparisonPlus.{u, v} A T hT).obj K)) ≅
              localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus A T K i) ∧
          Nonempty
            (((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor (ModulesSupportedIn.{u, max u v} A T) i).obj
                ((supportedSectionsFunctor.{u, v} A T).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj K)).obj ≅
              localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus A T K i) ∧
          Nonempty
            (colimit ((closedSupportDiagram.{u, v} A T i).obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K)) ≅
              localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus A T K i)) ∧
      (ringKrullDim A < ⊤ →
        Nonempty
          ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
              (supportModuleProperty A T : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{max u v} A))).ι ⊣
            (derivedSupportedSections.{u, v} A T ⋙
              supportedModulesComparison.{u, max u v} A T))) ∧
      Nonempty
        ((derivedSupportedSections.{u, v} A T ⋙ supportedModulesComparison.{u, max u v} A T) ⋙
            (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
              (supportModuleProperty A T : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{max u v} A))).ι ≅
          derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, v} A T) ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)),
        Nonempty
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) i).obj
                ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
                  (supportModuleProperty A T : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{max u v} A))).ι.obj
                  ((derivedSupportedSections.{u, v} A T ⋙
                    supportedModulesComparison.{u, max u v} A T).obj K)) ≅
              localCohomologyWithSupportIn A T K i) ∧
          Nonempty
            (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModulesSupportedIn.{u, max u v} A T) i).obj
                ((derivedSupportedSections.{u, v} A T).obj K)).obj ≅
              localCohomologyWithSupportIn A T K i) ∧
          Nonempty
            (colimit ((closedSupportDiagram.{u, v} A T i).obj K) ≅
              localCohomologyWithSupportIn A T K i))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.derivedSectionsWithSupportInPlusBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF5, the bounded-below case.** Let `f : A →+* B` be a flat
homomorphism of Noetherian rings, let `T ⊆ Spec A` be stable under specialization and put
`T' = (Spec f)⁻¹(T)`. Then local cohomology with support in `T` of a bounded-below complex
commutes with derived extension of scalars along `f`:
`RΓ_T(K) ⊗ᴸ_A B ≅ RΓ_{T'}(K ⊗ᴸ_A B)`, naturally in `K ∈ D⁺(A)` and compatibly with the
augmentations to the identity. No hypothesis on the Krull dimensions is needed.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSectionsWithSupportInPlusBaseChangeIso (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.Flat)
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) :
    { e : derivedSectionsWithSupportInPlus.{u, max uB v} A T ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙
          (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, v, uB} f).functor ≅
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, v, uB} f).functor ⋙
          derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{uB, max u v} B ((PrimeSpectrum.comap f) ⁻¹' T) //
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory.Plus (ModuleCat.{max u uB v} A),
        e.hom.app K ≫
            (derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{uB, max u v} B
              ((PrimeSpectrum.comap f) ⁻¹' T)).app
              ((derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, v, uB} f).functor.obj
                (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K)) =
          (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, v, uB} f).functor.map
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map
              ((derivedSectionsWithSupportInPlusAugmentation.{u, max uB v} A T).app K)) }
declarations.comment: bounded-below case

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.derivedSectionsWithSupportInBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EF5, the unbounded case.** Let `f : A →+* B` be a flat homomorphism
of Noetherian rings of finite Krull dimension, let `T ⊆ Spec A` be stable under specialization
and put `T' = (Spec f)⁻¹(T)`. Then local cohomology with support in `T` of an arbitrary complex
commutes with derived extension of scalars along `f`:
`RΓ_T(K) ⊗ᴸ_A B ≅ RΓ_{T'}(K ⊗ᴸ_A B)`, naturally in `K ∈ D(A)` and compatibly with the
augmentations to the identity.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSectionsWithSupportInBaseChangeIso (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.Flat)
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (_hA : ringKrullDim A < ⊤) (_hB : ringKrullDim B < ⊤) :
    { e : derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, max uB v} A T ⋙
          (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, v, uB} f).functor ≅
        (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, v, uB} f).functor ⋙
          derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{uB, max u v} B ((PrimeSpectrum.comap f) ⁻¹' T) //
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u uB v} A),
        e.hom.app K ≫
            (derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{uB, max u v} B
              ((PrimeSpectrum.comap f) ⁻¹' T)).app
              ((derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, v, uB} f).functor.obj K) =
          (derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral.{u, v, uB} f).functor.map
            ((derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, max uB v} A T).app K) }
declarations.comment: unbounded case

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_localCohomologySpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EF6.** The Grothendieck spectral sequence for local cohomology with two
supports: for specialization-closed subsets `T` and `T'` of the spectrum of a Noetherian
ring and a bounded-below derived object `X`, there is a spectral sequence with second page
`H^p_T(H^q_{T'}(X))` converging to `H^{p+q}_{T ∩ T'}(X)`.

Two points where this departs from the printed form of the tag. Its hypothesis reads
"let `A` be a ring", but `H^0_T` is introduced in that section only for a Noetherian ring,
every other statement of the section carries the hypothesis, and the tag's own proof invokes
the adjointness of `RΓ_T`, established only over a Noetherian ring (Tags 0EF2, 0EF3, 0EF4).
Noetherianity is what the proof below needs too: it is Baer's criterion that makes sections
with support in `T` of an injective module injective, and that is the acyclicity input of
Tag 015N. Second, the displayed second page of the tag is `H^p_T(H^p_{T'}(K))`, where the
inner `p` is a slip — its own abutment `H^{p + q}` exhibits two independent indices — and the
Grothendieck form `H^q_{T'}` is the one proved here.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_localCohomologySpectralSequence
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (T T' : Set (PrimeSpectrum A))
    (_hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (_hT' : StableUnderSpecialization T')
    (X : DerivedCategory.Plus (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)) :
    ∃ K : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ,
      (∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty (K.X.homology n ≅
        localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus A (T ∩ T') X n)) ∧
      ∀ (Fil : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
        (_ : ∀ p n : ℤ, Fil p n = Subobject.mk ((K.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n))
        (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
        (_ : ∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
          Fil p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (Fil (p + r) (n + 1)))
        (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
        (_ : ∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
          (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1)))
        (FH : ∀ (n _p : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.homology n))
        (_ : ∀ n p : ℤ, FH n p =
          imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)),
      ∃ (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) 0)
        (_ : ∀ (r p q n : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_ : n = p + q), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : D r p n ⊓ Z r p n ≤ Z r p n))),
        (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((E.page 2 zero_le_two).X (p, q) ≅
          localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus A T
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) 0).obj
              (localCohomologyWithSupportInPlus A T' X q)) p)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 0).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ FH n a = ⊤ ∧ FH n b = ⊥) ∧
        (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), b ≤ r →
          (E.page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0) ∧
        (∀ p n : ℤ,
          IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
              Fil p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (Fil (p + r) (n + 1)) ⊔
                Fil (p + 1) n)
            (kernelSubobject (K.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ Fil p n ⊔ Fil (p + 1) n) ∧
          IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
              Fil p n ⊓ (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Fil (p - r) (n - 1)) ⊔
                Fil (p + 1) n)
            (imageSubobject (K.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ Fil p n ⊔ Fil (p + 1) n))

theorem derivedCategoryB_tensor_left (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)

      (supportModuleProperty A T : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{u} A)) K) :

an arbitrary object of `D(A)` with an object of `D_T(A)` again lies in `D_T(A)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryB_tensor_right (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ⊤) (K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hL : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (supportModuleProperty A T : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{u} A)) L) :
