declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_derivedSectionsWithSupportIn_tensorIso_left
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EF7.** Local cohomology with support in `T` of a derived tensor product is the
derived tensor product with local cohomology taken in the left factor, by an isomorphism of
bifunctors carrying the augmentation of the tensor product to the augmentation of the left
factor tensored with the identity.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedSectionsWithSupportIn_tensorIso_left
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ⊤) :
    ∃ e : CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A ⋙
          derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T ≅
        Functor.prod (derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T) (𝟭 _) ⋙
          CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A,
      ∀ K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A),
        e.hom.app (K, L) ≫ (CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A).map
            (((derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, u} A T).app K, 𝟙 L) :
              ((derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T).obj K, L) ⟶ (K, L)) =
          (derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, u} A T).app
            ((CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A).obj (K, L))
declarations.comment: tensor formula, left factor

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_derivedSectionsWithSupportIn_tensorIso_right
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EF7.** Local cohomology with support in `T` of a derived tensor product is the
derived tensor product with local cohomology taken in the right factor, by an isomorphism of
bifunctors carrying the augmentation of the tensor product to the identity tensored with the
augmentation of the right factor.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedSectionsWithSupportIn_tensorIso_right
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ⊤) :
    ∃ e : CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A ⋙
          derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T ≅
        Functor.prod (𝟭 _) (derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T) ⋙
          CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A,
      ∀ K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A),
        e.hom.app (K, L) ≫ (CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A).map
            ((𝟙 K, (derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, u} A T).app L) :
              (K, (derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T).obj L) ⟶ (K, L)) =
          (derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, u} A T).app
            ((CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A).obj (K, L))
declarations.comment: tensor formula, right factor

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_derivedSectionsWithSupportIn_tensorIso_both
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EF7.** Applying local cohomology with support in `T` in both tensor factors agrees
with applying it to the tensor product, again compatibly with the augmentations.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedSectionsWithSupportIn_tensorIso_both
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ⊤) :
    ∃ e : CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A ⋙
          derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T ≅
        Functor.prod (derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T)
          (derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T) ⋙
          CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A,
      ∀ K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A),
        e.hom.app (K, L) ≫ (CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A).map
            (((derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, u} A T).app K,
                (derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, u} A T).app L) :
              ((derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T).obj K,
                (derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T).obj L) ⟶ (K, L)) =
          (derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, u} A T).app
            ((CechFormula.derivedTensorProductBifunctor A).obj (K, L))
declarations.comment: tensor formula, both factors

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_derivedSectionsWithSupportIn_isoTensorUnit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EF7.** Local cohomology with support in `T` is the derived tensor product with the
local cohomology of the ring, by an isomorphism whose inverse is the canonical map
`RΓ_T(A) ⊗^L_A K ⟶ A ⊗^L_A K ⟶ K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedSectionsWithSupportIn_isoTensorUnit
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ⊤) :
    ∃ e : derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T ≅
        (canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor A).obj
          ((derivedSectionsWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T).obj (CechFormula.unitObject A)),
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A),
        e.hom.app K ≫
            (((canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor A).map
                ((derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, u} A T).app
                  (CechFormula.unitObject A))).app K ≫
              (CechFormula.derivedTensorLeftUnitor A).hom.app K) =
          (derivedSectionsWithSupportInAugmentation.{u, u} A T).app K
declarations.comment: tensor formula

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.nonempty_exactSequenceData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EF8, the exact sequence.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `T ⊆ Spec(A)` be
stable under specialization and let `T' ⊆ T` be the set of primes of `T` that are not minimal in
`T`. For every `A`-module `M` and every `i` there is an exact sequence
`0 ⟶ colim_{Z,f} H¹_f(Hⁱ⁻¹_Z(M)) ⟶ Hⁱ_{T'}(M) ⟶ Hⁱ_T(M) ⟶ ⨁_{𝔭 ∈ T ∖ T'} Hⁱ_{𝔭A_𝔭}(M_𝔭)`
where the colimit is over the closed subsets `Z ⊆ T` and the `f ∈ A` with `V(f) ∩ Z ⊆ T'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_exactSequenceData (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (i : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (ExactSequenceData.{u, v} A T M i)
declarations.comment: the exact sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.range_changeOfSupport_eq_localizationKernel
declarations.doc:
**Exactness at local cohomology with support in `T`.** Over a Noetherian ring, a class in
`Hⁱ_T(K)` is the image of a class supported in the nonminimal primes of `T` if and only if it
localizes to zero at every prime that is minimal in `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_changeOfSupport_eq_localizationKernel
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)) (i : ℤ)
    (x : localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, v} A T K i) :
    (∃ y : localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, v} A (PrimeSpectrum.nonminimalPrimes T) K i,
      (changeOfSupport A (PrimeSpectrum.nonminimalPrimes_subset T) K i).hom y = x) ↔
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, p ∈ T \ PrimeSpectrum.nonminimalPrimes T →
        (ModuleCat.localizedModuleMkLinearMap
          (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, v} A T K i) p.asIdeal.primeCompl) x = 0
declarations.comment: exactness at local cohomology with support in T

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.kernel_changeOfSupport_eq_closedSupportImages
declarations.doc:
**Exactness at local cohomology with support in the nonminimal primes.** Over a Noetherian
ring, a class in `Hⁱ_{T'}(K)` dies in `Hⁱ_T(K)` if and only if it is the image of a class with
closed support `V(I) ∩ V(f) ⊆ T'`, where `V(I) ⊆ T`, which already vanishes in
`Hⁱ_{V(I)}(K)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem kernel_changeOfSupport_eq_closedSupportImages
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)) (i : ℤ)
    (x : localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, v} A (PrimeSpectrum.nonminimalPrimes T) K i) :
    (changeOfSupport A (PrimeSpectrum.nonminimalPrimes_subset T) K i).hom x = 0 ↔
      ∃ (I : Ideal A) (f : A) (_hI : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ⊆ T)
        (hadm : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ({f} : Set A) ⊆
          PrimeSpectrum.nonminimalPrimes T)
        (y : localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, v} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ∩
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ({f} : Set A)) K i),
        (changeOfSupport A hadm K i).hom y = x ∧
          (changeOfSupport A Set.inter_subset_left K i).hom y = 0
declarations.comment: exactness at local cohomology with support in the nonminimal primes T'

declarations.name: PrimeSpectrum.stableUnderSpecialization_nonminimalPrimes
declarations.doc:
The nonminimal primes of a subset of the prime spectrum stable under specialization are
again stable under specialization.
declarations.statement:
theorem stableUnderSpecialization_nonminimalPrimes (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) :
    StableUnderSpecialization (nonminimalPrimes T)
declarations.comment: T' is stable under specialization

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyWithSupportIn_map_eq_zero_of_local
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a Noetherian ring of finite Krull dimension, let `T ⊆ Spec(A)` be stable under
specialization and let `{M_n}` be an inverse system of `A`-modules. If for every `m` the
transition maps `Hⁱ_{pA_p}(M_{k,p}) → Hⁱ_{pA_p}(M_{m,p})` vanish for all `p ∈ T` and all
`k ≥ m'(m)`, then `Hⁱ_T(M_k) → Hⁱ_T(M_m)` vanishes for all `k` beyond the `2 ^ dim T`-fold
iterate of `m'` at `m`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localCohomologyWithSupportIn_map_eq_zero_of_local
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ⊤)
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (i : ℕ)
    (m' : ℕ → ℕ) (hm' : ∀ m, m ≤ m' m)
    (hlocal : ∀ (m k : ℕ) (hbound : m' m ≤ k),
      ∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum A), p ∈ T →
      ((ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor.{max u v} p.asIdeal.primeCompl ⋙
        localCohomologyModuleFunctor (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) (i : ℤ)).map
        (F.map (homOfLE ((hm' m).trans hbound)).op) = 0))
    (m k : ℕ)
    (hk : m'^[2 ^ ((topologicalKrullDim (↥T)).unbotD 0).toNat] m ≤ k) :
    (localCohomologyWithSupportInModuleFunctor.{u, v} A T (i : ℤ)).map
      (F.map (homOfLE
        ((Function.id_le_iterate_of_id_le (fun m => hm' m) _ m).trans hk)).op) = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.eventually_injective_image_localCohomologyWithSupportIn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFA.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring of finite dimension, let `T ⊆ Spec(A)` be
stable under specialization and let `{M_n}` be an inverse system of `A`-modules. If for every `m`
there is `c ≥ m` such that at every prime `𝔭 ∈ T` and for every `k ≥ c` the transition map
vanishes on `Hⁱ⁻¹_{𝔭A_𝔭}`, its image on `Hⁱ_{𝔭A_𝔭}` is independent of `k` and that image injects
into `Hⁱ_{𝔭A_𝔭}(M_{0,𝔭})`, then there is `m₀` such that for every `m ≥ m₀` the image of
`Hⁱ_T(M_k) → Hⁱ_T(M_m)` injects into `Hⁱ_T(M_{m₀})` for all large `k`.

The independence of the image from `k` is not needed for the conclusion; see
`eventually_injective_image_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_image_injective`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eventually_injective_image_localCohomologyWithSupportIn
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ⊤)
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (M : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (i : ℕ)
    (hloc : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ c : ℕ, ∃ hmc : m ≤ c, ∀ p ∈ T, ∀ (k : ℕ) (hck : c ≤ k),
      ((M ⋙ ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor.{max u v} p.asIdeal.primeCompl ⋙
        localCohomologyModuleFunctor (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl)
          ((i : ℤ) - 1)).map (homOfLE (hmc.trans hck)).op = 0) ∧
      (LinearMap.range ((M ⋙ ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor.{max u v}
          p.asIdeal.primeCompl ⋙ localCohomologyModuleFunctor
            (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) (i : ℤ)).map (homOfLE (hmc.trans hck)).op).hom =
        LinearMap.range ((M ⋙ ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor.{max u v}
          p.asIdeal.primeCompl ⋙ localCohomologyModuleFunctor
            (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) (i : ℤ)).map (homOfLE hmc).op).hom) ∧
      (∀ x : (M ⋙ ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor.{max u v} p.asIdeal.primeCompl ⋙
          localCohomologyModuleFunctor (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) (i : ℤ)).obj (op k),
        ((M ⋙ ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor.{max u v} p.asIdeal.primeCompl ⋙
          localCohomologyModuleFunctor (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) (i : ℤ)).map
            (homOfLE (hmc.trans hck)).op).hom x ∈
          LinearMap.ker ((M ⋙ ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor.{max u v}
            p.asIdeal.primeCompl ⋙ localCohomologyModuleFunctor
              (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) (i : ℤ)).map
                (homOfLE (Nat.zero_le m)).op).hom →
        ((M ⋙ ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor.{max u v} p.asIdeal.primeCompl ⋙
          localCohomologyModuleFunctor (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) (i : ℤ)).map
            (homOfLE (hmc.trans hck)).op).hom x = 0)) :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm₀m : m₀ ≤ m), ∃ c : ℕ, ∃ hmc : m ≤ c, ∀ (k : ℕ) (hck : c ≤ k),
      ∀ x : (M ⋙ localCohomologyWithSupportInModuleFunctor.{u, v} A T (i : ℤ)).obj (op k),
        ((M ⋙ localCohomologyWithSupportInModuleFunctor.{u, v} A T (i : ℤ)).map
          (homOfLE (hmc.trans hck)).op).hom x ∈
          LinearMap.ker ((M ⋙ localCohomologyWithSupportInModuleFunctor.{u, v} A T
            (i : ℤ)).map (homOfLE hm₀m).op).hom →
        ((M ⋙ localCohomologyWithSupportInModuleFunctor.{u, v} A T (i : ℤ)).map
          (homOfLE (hmc.trans hck)).op).hom x = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_ideal_le_annihilator_localCohomology_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFC, Faltings' annihilator theorem.** For a finite module `M` over a Noetherian
ring with a dualizing complex and nested specialization-closed subsets `T ⊆ T'`, an ideal
supported in `T'` annihilates `H^i_T(M)` for every `i ≤ s` exactly when
`depth_{A_p}(M_p) + dim((A/p)_q) > s` for every `p ∉ T'` and `q ∈ T` with `p ⊆ q`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_ideal_le_annihilator_localCohomology_iff
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (T T' : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hTT' : T ⊆ T')
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (hT' : StableUnderSpecialization T')
    (s : ℤ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (homega : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega)) :
    (∃ J : Ideal A, PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ⊆ T' ∧
        ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s → J ≤ Module.annihilator A
          (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
              (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)) ↔
      (∀ p q : PrimeSpectrum A, p ∉ T' → q ∈ T → p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal →
        Stacks.Algebraization.enatToEInt
            (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
              (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
              (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
          krullDimToEInt
            (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ⧸
              p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))) > (s : EInt))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_iff_depth_add_dim
declarations.doc:
**Faltings' finiteness criterion.** For a finite module `M` over a Noetherian ring `A` with a
dualizing complex and a specialization-stable `T ⊆ Spec(A)`, the local cohomology modules
`H^i_T(M)` are finite for `i ≤ s` if and only if
`depth_{A_p}(M_p) + dim((A/p)_q) > s` whenever `p ⊆ q` with `p ∉ T` and `q ∈ T`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_iff_depth_add_dim
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (T : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (s : ℕ)
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (homega : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega)) :
    (∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ (s : ℤ) → Module.Finite A
        (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)) ↔
      (∀ p q : PrimeSpectrum A, p ∉ T → q ∈ T → p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal →
        enatToEInt (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
          krullDimToEInt (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ⧸
            p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))) > ((s : ℤ) : EInt))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_dualizing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFE, unconditionally.** For `M` finite over a Noetherian ring `A` with a dualizing
complex and `p` a prime outside `V(I)`, if `depth_{A_{p'}}(M_{p'}) + dim((A/p')_q) > s` for all
primes `p' ⊆ p` and all `q ∈ V(I)` with `p' ⊆ q`, then some `f ∈ A` outside `p` annihilates
`H^i_{V(I)}(M)` for every `i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_dualizing
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I : Ideal A) (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (s : ℤ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (homega : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega))
    (hp : p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
    (hdepth : ∀ x y : PrimeSpectrum A, x.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal →
      y ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) → x.asIdeal ≤ y.asIdeal →
      enatToEInt
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule x.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
        krullDimToEInt
          (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal) ⧸
            x.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal)))) > (s : EInt)) :
    ∃ f : A, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
      f ∈ Module.annihilator A
        (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)
declarations.comment:
the lemma unconditionally, the hypothesis `hFaltings` of
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_notMem_and_mem_annihilator_localCohomologyWithSupportIn`
being discharged by Tag 0EFC

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_notMem_and_mem_annihilator_localCohomologyWithSupportIn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFE.** For `M` finite over a Noetherian ring `A` with a dualizing complex and `p`
a prime outside `V(I)`, if `depth_{A_{p'}}(M_{p'}) + dim((A/p')_q) > s` for all primes `p' ⊆ p`
and all `q ∈ V(I)` with `p' ⊆ q`, then some `f ∈ A` outside `p` annihilates `H^i_{V(I)}(M)`
for every `i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_notMem_and_mem_annihilator_localCohomologyWithSupportIn
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I : Ideal A) (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (s : ℤ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (homega : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega))
    (hFaltings : ∀ (T T' : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)), T ⊆ T' →
      StableUnderSpecialization T → StableUnderSpecialization T' →
      ∀ (s₀ : ℤ), 0 ≤ s₀ →
      ∀ (ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)),
        Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := ω) →
        ((∃ J : Ideal A, PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ⊆ T' ∧
            ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s₀ → J ≤ Module.annihilator A
              (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A T
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
                  (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)) ↔
          (∀ x y : PrimeSpectrum A, x ∉ T' → y ∈ T → x.asIdeal ≤ y.asIdeal →
            Stacks.Algebraization.enatToEInt
                (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal)
                  (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal))
                  (LocalizedModule x.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
              krullDimToEInt
                (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal) ⧸
                  x.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal)))) > (s₀ : EInt))))
    (hp : p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
    (hdepth : ∀ x y : PrimeSpectrum A, x.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal →
      y ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) → x.asIdeal ≤ y.asIdeal →
      Stacks.Algebraization.enatToEInt
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule x.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
        krullDimToEInt
          (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal) ⧸
            x.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal)))) > (s : EInt)) :
    ∃ f : A, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
      f ∈ Module.annihilator A
        (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)
declarations.comment: the lemma, on the hypothesis hFaltings carrying Tag 0EFC

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.associatedSubset
declarations.doc:
The primes whose specializations in `V(I)` all belong to `V(J) ∩ V(I)`.

This is the subset denoted by `T` in Stacks Project, Tag 0EFG.
declarations.statement: def associatedSubset (I J : Ideal A) : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_homology_derivedCompletion_localCohomology
declarations.doc:
Let `I` and `J` be ideals of a Noetherian ring `A` with a dualizing complex, let `M` be a
finite `A`-module, and let `p` be a prime outside `V(J) ∩ V(I)` with `cd(A, I) ≤ d`. If
`depth_{A_{p'}}(M_{p'}) + dim((A/p')_q) > s + d` for all primes `p' ⊆ p` and all
`q ∈ V(p') ∩ V(J) ∩ V(I)`, then some `f ∈ A` outside `p` annihilates the degree-`i` cohomology of
the derived `I`-adic completion of `RΓ_{V(J)}(M)` for every `i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_homology_derivedCompletion_localCohomology
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I J : Ideal A) (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (s d : ℤ)
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (homega : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega))
    (hp : p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension A I I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing ≤ d)
    (hdepth : ∀ x y : PrimeSpectrum A, x.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal →
      y ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
      x.asIdeal ≤ y.asIdeal →
      enatToEInt
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule x.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
        krullDimToEInt
          (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal) ⧸
            x.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal)))) >
        ((s + d : ℤ) : EInt))
    {r : ℕ} (gen : Fin r → A) (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range gen) = I) :
    ∃ f : A, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
      f ∈ Module.annihilator A
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
          ((DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A gen).obj
            ((Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A J J.fg_of_isNoetherianRing).ι.obj
              ((Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor.{u, u} A J J.fg_of_isNoetherianRing).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
                  (ModuleCat.of A M))))))
declarations.comment:
the full statement: an element outside `p` annihilating the cohomology of the
derived `I`-adic completion of `RΓ_{V(J)}(M)` in every degree `≤ s`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.prod_smul_id_derivedHom_homology_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**The engine.** For `P` concentrated in degrees `≤ d` and `Q` in degrees `≥ a`, the product
of scalars annihilating `H^j(Q)` for `a ≤ j ≤ s + d` annihilates `H^i(RHom_A(P, Q))` for every
`i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem prod_smul_id_derivedHom_homology_eq_zero {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (f : ℤ → A)
    (a d s : ℤ) (P Q : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) [P.IsLE d] [Q.IsGE a]
    (hQ : ∀ j : ℤ, j ≤ s + d →
      f j • 𝟙 ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) j).obj Q) = 0)
    (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ s) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range ((s + d - a).toNat + 1), f (a + j)) • 𝟙
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
        ((StacksDraft.DerivedHom.derivedHomAdjunction (R := A)).hom.obj
          (Opposite.op P, Q))) = 0
declarations.comment: the quantitative form of the truncation reduction, with the explicit product of per-degree annihilators

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_homology_derivedHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFH, the homological reduction.** Let `P` have cohomology concentrated in degrees
`≤ d` and `Q` in degrees `≥ a`. If for each `j ≤ s + d` some element outside a prime `p`
annihilates `H^j(Q)`, then one element outside `p` annihilates `H^i(RHom_A(P, Q))` for all
`i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_homology_derivedHom {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (a d s : ℤ) (P Q : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) [Q.IsGE a]
    (hP : ∀ i : ℤ, d < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj P))
    (hQ : ∀ j : ℤ, j ≤ s + d → ∃ f : A, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      f ∈ Module.annihilator A
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) j).obj Q)) :
    ∃ g : A, g ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
      g ∈ Module.annihilator A
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
          ((StacksDraft.DerivedHom.derivedHomAdjunction (R := A)).hom.obj
            (Opposite.op P, Q)))
declarations.comment: the homological-algebra reduction: after the two identifications of the first paragraph, the canonical-truncation argument producing an element outside `p` annihilating `H^i(RHom(P, Q))` for `i ≤ s`

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isLE_localCohomologyDerived_single_of_cohomologicalDimension_le
declarations.doc:
A bound `d` on the cohomological dimension of `I` places the local cohomology
`RΓ_{V(I)}(M[0])` of Stacks 0A6Q in degrees `≤ d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLE_localCohomologyDerived_single_of_cohomologicalDimension_le
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (d : ℤ)
    (hcd : cohomologicalDimension A I hI ≤ d) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) :
    ((Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A I hI).ι.obj
      ((Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor A I hI).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj M))).IsLE d
declarations.comment: the use of hypothesis (3): `H^i(RΓ_I(A)) = 0` for `i > d` when `cd(A, I) ≤ d`

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isGE_localCohomologyDerived_single
declarations.doc:
The local cohomology `RΓ_{V(I)}(M[0])` of Stacks 0A6Q of a module placed in degree zero lies
in degrees `≥ 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGE_localCohomologyDerived_single
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) :
    ((Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A I hI).ι.obj
      ((Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor A I hI).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj M))).IsGE 0

the boundedness the truncation reduction needs: `RΓ_{V(I)}(M[0])` lies in
degrees `≥ 0`

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_sup
declarations.doc:
**The per-degree annihilator input of Stacks 0EFH, in the support-indexed model.** For `M`
finite over a Noetherian ring `A` with a dualizing complex and `p` a prime outside
`V(J) ∩ V(I)`, the depth-plus-dimension inequality in the range `s + d` gives one element of `A`
outside `p` annihilating `H^j_{V(I+J)}(M)` for every `j ≤ s + d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_sup
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I J : Ideal A) (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (s d : ℤ)
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (homega : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega))
    (hp : p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
    (hdepth : ∀ x y : PrimeSpectrum A, x.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal →
      y ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
      x.asIdeal ≤ y.asIdeal →
      enatToEInt
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule x.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
        krullDimToEInt
          (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal) ⧸
            x.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal)))) >
        ((s + d : ℤ) : EInt)) :
    ∃ f : A, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ j : ℤ, j ≤ s + d →
      f ∈ Module.annihilator A
        (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A
          (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ((I ⊔ J : Ideal A) : Set A))
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) j)
declarations.comment:
the per-degree annihilator input: a single element outside `p` annihilating
`H^j_{V(I+J)}(M)` for every `j ≤ s + d`

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_sup
declarations.doc:
**The per-degree annihilator input of Stacks 0EFH, in the coreflection model.** The
annihilator of the previous statement, transported to the local cohomology `RΓ_{V(I+J)}` of
Stacks 0A6Q along the comparison of Stacks 0955.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_sup
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I J : Ideal A) (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (s d : ℤ)
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (homega : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega))
    (hp : p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
    (hdepth : ∀ x y : PrimeSpectrum A, x.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal →
      y ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
      x.asIdeal ≤ y.asIdeal →
      enatToEInt
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule x.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
        krullDimToEInt
          (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal) ⧸
            x.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime y.asIdeal)))) >
        ((s + d : ℤ) : EInt)) :
    ∃ f : A, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ j : ℤ, j ≤ s + d →
      f ∈ Module.annihilator A
        (localCohomologyModule A (I ⊔ J) (I ⊔ J).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
          (ModuleCat.of A M) j)
declarations.comment: the per-degree annihilator input, in the `RΓ_{V(I+J)}` coreflection model

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.derivedCompletionLocalCohomologySupIso
declarations.doc:
For ideals `I` and `J` of `A` with `I` generated by the finite family `f`, derived `I`-adic
completion does not distinguish `RΓ_{V(J)}` from `RΓ_{V(J + I)}`: there is a natural isomorphism
`RΓ_{V(J)}(-)^∧ ≅ RΓ_{V(J + I)}(-)^∧`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedCompletionLocalCohomologySupIso (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I J : Ideal A)
    (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) :
    Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor.{u, u} A J hJ ⋙
        (Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A J hJ).ι ⋙
          DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A f ≅
      Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor.{u, u} A (J + I) (Submodule.FG.sup hJ hI) ⋙
        (Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (J + I) (Submodule.FG.sup hJ hI)).ι ⋙
          DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A f
declarations.comment:
the first identification of the proof: `RΓ_J(-)^∧ = RΓ_{I+J}(-)^∧`, which is
what lets `J` be replaced by `I + J`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.derivedCompletionIsoDerivedHomLocalCohomology
declarations.doc:
For a finite family `f` generating `I`, derived `I`-adic completion is derived Hom out of the
local cohomology `RΓ_{V(I)}(A)` of the ring: `K^∧ ≅ RHom_A(RΓ_{V(I)}(A), K)`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedCompletionIsoDerivedHomLocalCohomology (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (hI : I.FG) {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :
    (DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A f).obj K ≅
      (StacksDraft.DerivedHom.derivedHomAdjunction (R := A)).hom.obj
        (Opposite.op ((Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyOnModules.{u, u} A I hI).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A A)), K)
declarations.comment:
the second identification of the proof: derived `I`-adic completion is `RHom`
out of `RΓ_{V(I)}(A)`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.derivedCompletionIsoDerivedHomDerivedPowerTorsion
declarations.doc:
Over a Noetherian ring derived `I`-adic completion is derived Hom out of derived `I`-power
torsion of the ring: `K^∧ ≅ RHom_A(RΓ_I(A), K)`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedCompletionIsoDerivedHomDerivedPowerTorsion (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :
    (DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A f).obj K ≅
      (StacksDraft.DerivedHom.derivedHomAdjunction (R := A)).hom.obj
        (Opposite.op (Stacks.LocalCohomology.derivedPowerTorsionObj.{u, u} A I
          (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing I) (ModuleCat.of A A)), K)
declarations.comment:
the second identification of the proof, written with `RΓ_I(A)` over a
Noetherian ring

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.derivedCompletionLocalCohomologyIsoDerivedHomSup
declarations.doc:
For ideals `I` and `J` of `A` with `I` generated by the finite family `f`, the derived
`I`-adic completion of `RΓ_{V(J)}(K)` is `RHom_A(RΓ_{V(I)}(A), RΓ_{V(J + I)}(K))`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedCompletionLocalCohomologyIsoDerivedHomSup (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I J : Ideal A)
    (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :
    (DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A f).obj
        ((Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A J hJ).ι.obj
          ((Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor.{u, u} A J hJ).obj K)) ≅
      (StacksDraft.DerivedHom.derivedHomAdjunction (R := A)).hom.obj
        (Opposite.op ((Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyOnModules.{u, u} A I hI).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A A)),
          (Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (J + I) (Submodule.FG.sup hJ hI)).ι.obj
            ((Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor.{u, u} A (J + I)
              (Submodule.FG.sup hJ hI)).obj K))
declarations.comment:
the two identifications of the first paragraph of the proof, composed into the
form the truncation reduction consumes

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.stabilizingIdeal_le
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0EFI.** The stabilizing ideal is contained in the ideal it shrinks.
declarations.statement:
public theorem stabilizingIdeal_le :
    stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H ≤ J
declarations.comment: the stabilizing ideal is contained in J

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.zeroLocus_stabilizingIdeal_inter
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFI.** Shrinking `J` to the stabilizing ideal does not change the intersection of
the zero locus with `V(I)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem zeroLocus_stabilizingIdeal_inter :
    PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H : Set A) ∩
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A)
declarations.comment: V(J₀) ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I) for the stabilizing ideal

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_isStabilizingData_of_nonpos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFI for `s ≤ 0`.** Let `I` and `J` be ideals of a Noetherian ring `A` and let `M` be
a finite `A`-module. For every integer `s ≤ 0` there is a pair `(J₀, n)` with the stabilization
property of Stacks 0EFI: `J₀ ≤ J` and `V(J₀) ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I)`, every further ideal `J' ≤ J₀`
with `V(J') ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I)` has `RΓ_{J₀}(M) → RΓ_{J'}(M)` an isomorphism on cohomology in
degrees `≤ s`, and `(J₀ I) ^ n` annihilates all of those cohomology modules.

The ideal is the one the source constructs, `J₀ = J ⊓ I(B)` for `B` the set of primes outside
`V(I)` lying in `T` at which the depth of `M` is at most `s`. In this range the hypotheses
(1)–(4) of the source — a dualizing complex and bounds on depth and relative dimension — are not
needed: the semicontinuity argument of Claim I is replaced by the nonnegativity of depth, and the
annihilator criterion Stacks 0EFC of Claim III by the finiteness of `H⁰_{J₀}(M)`.

For `s ≥ 1` the hypotheses are needed; see
`Stacks.Algebraization.exists_isStabilizingData`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isStabilizingData_of_nonpos
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I J : Ideal A) (s : ℤ) (hs : s ≤ 0) :
    ∃ p : Ideal A × ℕ, IsStabilizingData (M := M) I J s p
declarations.comment: the existence of the stabilizing data, for s ≤ 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_isStabilizingData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFI.** Let `I` and `J` be ideals of a Noetherian ring `A`, let `M` be a finite
`A`-module, and let `s` and `d` be integers with `0 ≤ d`. Under hypotheses (1)–(4) of the source
there is a pair `(J₀, n)` with the stabilization property: `J₀ ≤ J` and
`V(J₀) ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I)`, every further ideal `J' ≤ J₀` with `V(J') ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I)` has
`RΓ_{J₀}(M) → RΓ_{J'}(M)` an isomorphism on cohomology in degrees `≤ s`, and `(J₀ I) ^ n`
annihilates all of those cohomology modules.

The proof is the source's. The ideal is `J ⊓ I(B)` for `B` the set of primes outside `V(I)` lying
in `T` at which the depth of `M` is at most `s`, shrunk once more at the end to absorb the
annihilator ideal; Claim I is the semicontinuity of `depth + δ`, Claim II the comparison criterion
Stacks 0DWV, and Claim III Faltings' annihilator theorem Stacks 0EFC.

`0 ≤ d` belongs to the statement of 0EFI: the source's wording omits it, uses it silently in
Claim III, and is false without it, by the counterexample
`Stacks.Algebraization.not_forall_exists_isStabilizingData_of_neg`
(`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/FormalGeometry/StabilizationCounterexample.lean:451`). It is not
recorded by `Stacks.Algebraization.StabilizationHypotheses` and does not follow from it. See
`Stacks.Algebraization.exists_isStabilizingData_iff_of_neg` for what the conclusion amounts to
when `d < 0`, and the module docstring for the erratum.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isStabilizingData
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I J : Ideal A) (s d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (H : StabilizationHypotheses (M := M) I J s d omega) :
    ∃ p : Ideal A × ℕ, IsStabilizingData (M := M) I J s p
declarations.comment: the existence of the stabilizing data, given hypotheses (1)-(4) and 0 ≤ d

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.finite_localCohomologyModule_stabilizingIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFJ.** Under hypothesis (2') the local cohomology of `M` supported in the
stabilizing ideal `J₀` of Stacks 0EFI is a finite `A`-module in every degree `i ≤ s`.

The annihilation of `H^i_{J₀}(M)` by a power of `J₀ I` for `i ≤ s` is carried as a hypothesis
here; it is the clause `Stacks.Algebraization.IsStabilizingData.pow_mul_le_annihilator` of the
conclusion of Stacks 0EFI. For the form of Stacks 0EFJ in which it is proved rather than
assumed, see
`Stacks.Algebraization.finite_localCohomologyModule_stabilizingIdeal_of_nonneg`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_localCohomologyModule_stabilizingIdeal
    (h2 : DepthAddDimGtOnZeroLocus (M := M) I J s) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hann : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
      ((stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H * I) ^ n : Ideal A) ≤ Module.annihilator A
        (localCohomologyModule A (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H)
          (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H))
          (ModuleCat.of A M) i))
    (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ s) :
    Module.Finite A
      (localCohomologyModule A (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H)
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H))
        (ModuleCat.of A M) i)
declarations.comment: H^i_{J₀}(M) is a finite A-module for i ≤ s, given the annihilation clause of 0EFI

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.finite_localCohomologyModule_stabilizingIdeal_of_nonneg
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFJ.** Under hypotheses (1), (3), (4) of Stacks 0EFI together with hypothesis (2')
in place of its empty hypothesis (2), the local cohomology of `M` supported in the stabilizing
ideal `J₀` of Stacks 0EFI is a finite `A`-module in every degree `i ≤ s`.

Nothing is assumed about `H^i_{J₀}(M)`: the annihilation of those modules by a power of `J₀ I`
for `i ≤ s`, which the source takes from Stacks 0EFI, is proved here from
`Stacks.Algebraization.exists_isStabilizingData`, the existence statement of that lemma. The
only hypothesis beyond those of the source is `0 ≤ d`, which Stacks 0EFI needs and which the
source uses silently when it reads `depth + dim > d + s` as `depth + dim > s`; see the module
documentation. In particular `0 ≤ s` is not assumed: in degrees `i ≤ s < 0` local cohomology
vanishes, so the statement is free there.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_localCohomologyModule_stabilizingIdeal_of_nonneg
    (h2 : DepthAddDimGtOnZeroLocus (M := M) I J s) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ s) :
    Module.Finite A
      (localCohomologyModule A (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H)
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H))
        (ModuleCat.of A M) i)
declarations.comment: H^i_{J₀}(M) is a finite A-module for i ≤ s, for 0 ≤ d

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.IsStabilizingData.finite_localCohomologyModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFJ.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring with a dualizing complex `omega`, let `I`, `J`
be ideals, `M` a finite `A`-module and `s` an integer, and assume hypothesis (2'): for
`𝔭 ∈ V(I)` outside `V(J) ∩ V(I)`, `depth(M_𝔭) + dim((A/𝔭)_𝔮) > s` for every
`𝔮 ∈ V(𝔭) ∩ V(J) ∩ V(I)`. Then for every ideal `J₀` with the conclusion of Stacks 0EFI —
`J₀ ⊆ J`, `V(J₀) ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I)`, stability of `H^i_{J'}(M)` for `i ≤ s` under further
shrinking `J' ⊆ J₀` with the same trace on `V(I)`, and annihilation of these modules by
`(J₀ I) ^ n` — the module `H^i_{J₀}(M)` is finite for every `i ≤ s`.

Hypotheses (3) and (4) of Stacks 0EFI are not needed here: they enter only in producing `J₀`.
No pair `(J₀, n)` need exist when `d < 0`, where Stacks 0EFI fails; there the statement is
vacuous.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsStabilizingData.finite_localCohomologyModule {I J J₀ : Ideal A} {s : ℤ}
    {n : ℕ} (hJ₀ : IsStabilizingData (M := M) I J s (J₀, n))
    (omega : letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (homega : letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
      Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega))
    (h2 : DepthAddDimGtOnZeroLocus (M := M) I J s) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ s) :
    Module.Finite A
      (localCohomologyModule A J₀ J₀.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (ModuleCat.of A M) i)
declarations.comment: H^i_{J₀}(M) is a finite A-module for i ≤ s, for every ideal J₀ with the conclusions of 0EFI

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_stabilizingIdeal
declarations.doc:
Under hypothesis (6) of Stacks 0EFK the local cohomology of `M` supported in the stabilizing
ideal `J₀` of Stacks 0EFI agrees with the local cohomology supported in `J` in all degrees
`i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_stabilizingIdeal
    (h6 : DepthGtOnAssociatedSubset (M := M) I J s) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ s) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).map
      (localCohomologyComparison A J (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H)
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing J)
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H))
        (stabilizingIdeal_le I J s d omega H)
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M))))
declarations.comment: H^i_{J₀}(M) = H^i_J(M) for i ≤ s

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_sup
declarations.doc:
Under hypothesis (6) of Stacks 0EFK the local cohomology of `M` supported in `J` agrees
with the local cohomology supported in `J + I` in all degrees `i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_sup
    (h6 : DepthGtOnAssociatedSubset (M := M) I J s) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ s) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).map
      (localCohomologyComparison A (J ⊔ I) J
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (J ⊔ I)) (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing J) le_sup_left
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M))))
declarations.comment: H^i_J(M) = H^i_{J + I}(M) for i ≤ s

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_sup
declarations.doc:
Under hypothesis (6) of Stacks 0EFK a single power of `I` annihilates `H^i_{J + I}(M)` in
every degree `i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_sup
    (h6 : DepthGtOnAssociatedSubset (M := M) I J s) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
      I ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator A
        (localCohomologyModule A (J ⊔ I) (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (J ⊔ I))
          (ModuleCat.of A M) i)
declarations.comment: H^i_{J + I}(M) is annihilated by a power of I for i ≤ s

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_stabilizingIdeal
declarations.doc:
Under hypothesis (6) of Stacks 0EFK a single power of `I` annihilates the local cohomology
of `M` supported in the stabilizing ideal `J₀` of Stacks 0EFI, in every degree `i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_stabilizingIdeal
    (h6 : DepthGtOnAssociatedSubset (M := M) I J s) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
      I ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator A
        (localCohomologyModule A (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H)
          (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (stabilizingIdeal I J s d omega H))
          (ModuleCat.of A M) i)
declarations.comment: H^i_{J₀}(M) is annihilated by a power of I for i ≤ s

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isAlgebraizationIdeal_of_zeroLocus_inter_eq_empty
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFL when `V(J) ∩ V(I)` is empty.** For an `I`-adically complete Noetherian ring and
ideals with `V(J) ∩ V(I) = ∅`, the ideal `J` itself has the property asserted of `J₀`, in every
degree and for every finite module.

This is the case of the source that the extreme values `δmax` and `δmin` of
`Stacks.Algebraization.AlgebraizationHypotheses` exclude, and it is not vacuous: `J = A` is an
instance. The source's conditions hold in it with no constraint beyond (1), because its condition
(5), the only one mentioning `δ`, is guarded by `V(𝔭) ∩ V(J) ∩ V(I) ≠ ∅`.

Completeness is what makes the case true. Since `I` lies in the Jacobson radical of an
`I`-adically complete ring, every prime has a specialization in `V(I)`, so an admissible
shrinking `J'` has `V(J') ∩ V(I) = ∅` only if `V(J')` is empty — that is, only for `J' = A`.
Then `RΓ_{J'}(M)` is supported on the empty set, hence already derived `I`-complete, so the unit
of derived completion is invertible at it; both sides are in fact zero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAlgebraizationIdeal_of_zeroLocus_inter_eq_empty
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I J : Ideal A) (s : ℤ) (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete I A)
    (hJI : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) = ∅) :
    IsAlgebraizationIdeal (M := M) I J s J
declarations.comment:
existence of J₀ in the case V(J) ∩ V(I) = ∅, which the δmax and δmin fields of
AlgebraizationHypotheses exclude and the source does not: the source's condition (5), the only
one naming δ, is guarded by V(𝔭) ∩ V(J) ∩ V(I) ≠ ∅ and so is vacuous here. J₀ = J serves, for
every s and on I-adic completeness alone. With exists_isAlgebraizationIdeal, which is the
nonempty case, this covers the tag

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_isAlgebraizationIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFL.** Let `I` and `J` be ideals of a Noetherian ring `A`, let `M` be a finite
`A`-module and let `s` and `d` be integers. Under conditions (1), (3), (4) and (5)
of the source there is an ideal `J₀ ⊆ J` with `V(J₀) ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I)` such that for every
further ideal `J' ⊆ J₀` with the same intersection with `V(I)` the canonical map

`RΓ_{J'}(M) ⟶ RΓ_J(M)^∧`

is an isomorphism on cohomology in all degrees `≤ s`.

The proof is the source's induction on `s`; the arrow is
`Stacks.Algebraization.localCohomologyToCompletedLocalCohomology`, the composite of the unit of
derived `I`-adic completion with the identification `RΓ_{J'}(M)^∧ ≅ RΓ_J(M)^∧` of the opening
paragraph of the source, and the latter is invertible, so the assertion is exactly that the unit
is invertible on cohomology in degrees `≤ s`. The case `s < 0`, where both sides vanish in the
relevant degrees and `J₀ = J` serves, is
`Stacks.Algebraization.isAlgebraizationIdeal_of_lt_zero`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isAlgebraizationIdeal
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I J : Ideal A) (s d : ℤ) (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (δ : PrimeSpectrum A → ℤ) (δmax δmin : ℤ)
    (H : AlgebraizationHypotheses (M := M) I J s d omega δ δmax δmin) :
    ∃ J₀ : Ideal A, IsAlgebraizationIdeal (M := M) I J s J₀
declarations.comment:
existence of J₀ in the case V(J) ∩ V(I) ≠ ∅, which is what the δmax and δmin
fields of AlgebraizationHypotheses presuppose; the empty case, where the source's condition (5)
is vacuous, is isAlgebraizationIdeal_of_zeroLocus_inter_eq_empty, and the two together are the
tag. The dualizing complex is taken in the ring's own module universe

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_isAlgebraizationIdeal_of_sourceHypotheses
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFL.** Let `I, J` be ideals of a Noetherian ring `A`, let `M` be a finite
`A`-module, let `s, d` be integers, and let `T = {𝔭 : V(𝔭) ∩ V(I) ⊆ V(J) ∩ V(I)}`. Assume
1. `A` is `I`-adically complete and has a dualizing complex;
2. (no condition at primes of `V(I)`);
3. `cd(A, I) ≤ d`;
4. if `𝔭 ∉ V(I)`, `𝔭 ∉ T`, then `depth(M_𝔭) ≥ s` or `depth(M_𝔭) + dim((A/𝔭)_𝔮) > d + s` for
   all `𝔮 ∈ V(𝔭) ∩ V(J) ∩ V(I)`;
5. for a dimension function `δ`, with `δmax` and `δmin` the maximum and the minimum of `δ` on
   `V(J) ∩ V(I)`: if `𝔭 ∉ V(I)`, `𝔭 ∉ T`, `V(𝔭) ∩ V(J) ∩ V(I) ≠ ∅` and `depth(M_𝔭) < s`, then
   (a) `dim(Supp(M_𝔭)) < s + 2`, or (b) `δ(𝔭) > d + δmax - 1`, or
   (c) `depth(M_𝔭) + dim((A/𝔭)_𝔮) > d + s + δmax - δmin - 2` for all
   `𝔮 ∈ V(𝔭) ∩ V(J) ∩ V(I)`.

Then there is an ideal `J₀ ⊆ J` with `V(J₀) ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I)` such that for every
`J' ⊆ J₀` with `V(J') ∩ V(I) = V(J) ∩ V(I)` the map `RΓ_{J'}(M) → RΓ_J(M)^∧` is an isomorphism
on cohomology in degrees `≤ s` (`Stacks.Algebraization.IsAlgebraizationIdeal`).

The proof is by cases. If `V(J) ∩ V(I)` is empty, `J₀ = J` serves
(`isAlgebraizationIdeal_of_zeroLocus_inter_eq_empty`). Otherwise the extreme values of `δ` on
`V(J) ∩ V(I)` exist (`exists_isGreatest_isLeast_image_dimensionFunction`, using that `A` has
finite Krull dimension by Stacks 0A80), and `exists_isAlgebraizationIdeal` applies.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isAlgebraizationIdeal_of_sourceHypotheses (I J : Ideal A) (s d : ℤ)
    (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete I A)
    (hdual : ∃ ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex ω)
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension A I I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing ≤ d)
    (h4 : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
      p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
      p ∉ associatedSubset I J →
      ((enatToEInt
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) ≥ (s : EInt)) ∨
        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum A,
          q ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p.asIdeal : Set A) ∩
            PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A)) ∩
            PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
          enatToEInt
              (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
                (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
                (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
              krullDimToEInt
                (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ⧸
                  p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))) >
            ((d + s : ℤ) : EInt))))
    (h5 : ∃ δ : TopologicalSpace.DimensionFunction (PrimeSpectrum A),
      ∀ δmax δmin : ℤ,
      IsGreatest (δ.toFun '' (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))) δmax →
      IsLeast (δ.toFun '' (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))) δmin →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
      p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
      p ∉ associatedSubset I J →
      ((PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p.asIdeal : Set A) ∩
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A)) ∩
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A)).Nonempty →
      enatToEInt
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) < (s : EInt) →
      (krullDimToEInt (Module.supportDim (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) < ((s + 2 : ℤ) : EInt) ∨
        (d + δmax - 1 < δ.toFun p) ∨
        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum A,
          q ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p.asIdeal : Set A) ∩
            PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A)) ∩
            PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
          enatToEInt
              (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
                (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
                (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
              krullDimToEInt
                (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ⧸
                  p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))) >
            ((d + s + δmax - δmin - 2 : ℤ) : EInt)))) :
    ∃ J₀ : Ideal A, IsAlgebraizationIdeal (M := M) I J s J₀

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.MittagLefflerFailure.pow_mul_pow_mem_modIdeal
declarations.doc: `xⁿyⁿ = pⁿ` in `M`, so `xⁿyⁿ` lies in `(xy - p, pⁿ)`.
declarations.statement: theorem pow_mul_pow_mem_modIdeal (n : ℕ) : varX p ^ n * varY p ^ n ∈ modIdeal p n
declarations.comment: the containment `(yⁿ) ⊆` the image: `xⁿyⁿ = pⁿ` in `M`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.MittagLefflerFailure.mem_span_of_pow_mul_mem
declarations.doc:
**The `x`-power-torsion of `A/(xy - p, pⁿ⁺¹)` is carried by `(xy - p, yⁿ⁺¹)`.** If
`x^k f ∈ (xy - p, pⁿ⁺¹)` then `f ∈ (p, xy, yⁿ⁺¹)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_span_of_pow_mul_mem (n k : ℕ) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℤ_[p])
    (hf : varX p ^ k * f ∈ modIdeal p (n + 1)) :
    f ∈ Ideal.span {((p : ℕ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℤ_[p]), varX p * varY p,
      varY p ^ (n + 1)}
declarations.comment:
the containment image `⊆ (yⁿ)`: an `x`-power-torsion element mod `(xy - p, pⁿ)`
lies in `(p, xy, yⁿ)`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.MittagLefflerFailure.imageSections_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFM.** The image of `H⁰_J(M/pⁿM) → H⁰_J(M/pM)` is the ideal generated by `yⁿ` in
`M/pM = A/(p, xy)`, for `A = ℤ_p[[x, y]]`, `I = (p)`, `J = (p, x)` and `M = A/(xy - p)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem imageSections_eq (n : ℕ) :
    imageSections p n = Submodule.restrictScalars (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℤ_[p])
      (Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (modIdeal p 1) (varY p ^ (n + 1))})
declarations.comment:
the example: the image of `H⁰_J(M/pⁿM) ⟶ H⁰_J(M/pM)` is the ideal generated by
`yⁿ` in `M/pM = A/(p, xy)`, for `A = ℤ_p[[x,y]]`, `I = (p)`, `J = (p, x)` and `M = A/(xy - p)`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.MittagLefflerFailure.not_mittagLeffler
declarations.doc:
**The inverse system `n ↦ H⁰_J(M/pⁿM)` is not Mittag-Leffler.** The images of its transition
maps into `H⁰_J(M/pM)` never stabilise.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_mittagLeffler :
    ¬ ∃ m : ℕ, ∀ k, m ≤ k → imageSections p k = imageSections p m
declarations.comment:
the point of the example: the inverse system `H⁰_J(M/pⁿM)` does NOT satisfy the
Mittag-Leffler condition, so the hypothesis of Lemma 0EFL cannot be dropped

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
Under hypothesis (6) the local cohomology of `M` supported in any ideal `J` with
`V(J) ∩ V(I) = {𝔪}` agrees with the local cohomology supported in `𝔪` in all degrees `i ≤ s`:
`H^i_J(M) = H^i_𝔪(M)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_maximalIdeal
    (I J : Ideal A) (s : ℤ) (h6 : DepthGtAtMaximalIdeal (M := M) I s)
    (hJ : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
      {closedPoint A})
    (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ s) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).map
      (localCohomologyComparison A (maximalIdeal A) J
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (maximalIdeal A)) (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing J)
        (le_maximalIdeal_of_zeroLocus_inter_eq_closedPoint hJ).1
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M))))
declarations.comment: H^i_J(M) = H^i_𝔪(M) for i ≤ s, for every J with V(J) ∩ V(I) = {𝔪}

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_stabilizingIdeal_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
Under hypothesis (6) the local cohomology of `M` supported in the ideal `J₀` produced by
Stacks 0DXM agrees with the local cohomology supported in `𝔪` in all degrees `i ≤ s`:
`H^i_{J₀}(M) = H^i_𝔪(M)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_stabilizingIdeal_maximalIdeal
    (h6 : DepthGtAtMaximalIdeal (M := M) I s) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ s) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).map
      (localCohomologyComparison A (maximalIdeal A)
        (stabilizingIdeal I (maximalIdeal A) s d omega H.toStabilizationHypotheses)
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (maximalIdeal A))
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
          (stabilizingIdeal I (maximalIdeal A) s d omega H.toStabilizationHypotheses))
        (stabilizingIdeal_le I (maximalIdeal A) s d omega H.toStabilizationHypotheses)
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M))))
declarations.comment: H^i_{J₀}(M) = H^i_𝔪(M) for i ≤ s

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_stabilizingIdeal_of_depthGt
declarations.doc:
Under hypothesis (6) the local cohomology of `M` supported in the ideal `J₀` produced by
Stacks 0DXM agrees with the local cohomology supported in any further ideal `J ⊆ J₀` with
`V(J) ∩ V(I) = {𝔪}`, in all degrees `i ≤ s`: `H^i_{J₀}(M) = H^i_J(M)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_homologyMap_localCohomologyComparison_stabilizingIdeal_of_depthGt
    (h6 : DepthGtAtMaximalIdeal (M := M) I s) (J : Ideal A)
    (hJle : J ≤ stabilizingIdeal I (maximalIdeal A) s d omega H.toStabilizationHypotheses)
    (hJ : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
      {closedPoint A})
    (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ s) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).map
      (localCohomologyComparison A
        (stabilizingIdeal I (maximalIdeal A) s d omega H.toStabilizationHypotheses) J
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
          (stabilizingIdeal I (maximalIdeal A) s d omega H.toStabilizationHypotheses))
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing J) hJle
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M))))
declarations.comment: H^i_{J₀}(M) = H^i_J(M) for i ≤ s

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
Under hypothesis (6), `0 ≤ s` and `0 ≤ d`, a single power of `I` annihilates `H^i_J(M)` in
every degree `i ≤ s`, uniformly in every ideal `J` with `V(J) ∩ V(I) = {𝔪}`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal
    (h6 : DepthGtAtMaximalIdeal (M := M) I s) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ J : Ideal A,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
        {closedPoint A} →
      ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
        I ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator A
          (localCohomologyModule A J (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing J)
            (ModuleCat.of A M) i)
declarations.comment:
the annihilation assertion through Stacks 0EFK, in the numerical range 0 ≤ s and
0 ≤ d in which that lemma is stated

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal_of_depthGt
declarations.doc:
Under hypothesis (6) a single power of `I` annihilates `H^i_J(M)` in every degree `i ≤ s`,
uniformly in every ideal `J` with `V(J) ∩ V(I) = {𝔪}`; this includes `J = 𝔪` and `J = J₀`, by
`zeroLocus_maximalIdeal_inter` and `zeroLocus_stabilizingIdeal_maximalIdeal_inter`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal_of_depthGt
    (h6 : DepthGtAtMaximalIdeal (M := M) I s) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ J : Ideal A,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
        {closedPoint A} →
      ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
        I ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator A
          (localCohomologyModule A J (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing J)
            (ModuleCat.of A M) i)
declarations.comment:
the annihilation assertion: a power of I annihilates H^i_J(M) for i ≤ s, for every
J with V(J) ∩ V(I) = {𝔪}, with no hypothesis beyond the tag's

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_of_eq_closedPoint
declarations.doc:
In the bootstrap situation of Stacks 0EFU with `A` local and `T = {𝔪}`, a single power of
`I` annihilates `Hⁱ_𝔪(M)` in every degree `i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_of_eq_closedPoint
    [IsLocalRing S.A] (hT : S.T = {closedPoint S.A}) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ S.s →
      S.I ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator S.A
        (Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyModule S.A (maximalIdeal S.A)
          (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing _) (ModuleCat.of S.A S.M) i)
declarations.comment: the annihilation assertion: Hⁱ_𝔪(M) is annihilated by a power of I for i ≤ s

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_localCohomologyToAdicQuotientLimit_of_isAdicComplete
declarations.doc:
In the bootstrap situation of Stacks 0EFU with `A` local, `I`-adically complete and
`T = {𝔪}`, the map `Hⁱ_𝔪(M) ⟶ lim Hⁱ_𝔪(M/IⁿM)` is an isomorphism for `i ≤ s` and a single
power of `I` annihilates these modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_localCohomologyToAdicQuotientLimit_of_isAdicComplete
    [IsLocalRing S.A] [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A] (hT : S.T = {closedPoint S.A}) :
    (∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ S.s →
        IsIso (localCohomologyToAdicQuotientLimit S.A S.I (maximalIdeal S.A)
          (maximalIdeal S.A) (ModuleCat.of S.A S.M) rfl i)) ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ S.s →
        S.I ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator S.A
          (Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyModule S.A (maximalIdeal S.A)
            (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing _) (ModuleCat.of S.A S.M) i)
declarations.comment: both assertions, with no carried hypothesis, for I-adically complete A

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_localCohomologyToAdicQuotientLimit_adicCompletion
declarations.doc:
In the bootstrap situation with `A` local and `T = {𝔪}`, over the `I`-adic completion
`A', I', M'`: the map `Hⁱ_{𝔪'}(M') ⟶ lim Hⁱ_{𝔪'}(M'/(I')ⁿM')` is an isomorphism for `i ≤ s`,
and a single power of `I'` annihilates these modules. Nothing is assumed about `A` beyond
Situation 0EFU and the locality of the locus.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_localCohomologyToAdicQuotientLimit_adicCompletion
    [IsLocalRing S.A] (hT : S.T = {closedPoint S.A}) :
    letI : IsLocalRing S.adicCompletion.A :=
      BootstrapSituation.isLocalRing_adicCompletion S hT
    (∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ S.adicCompletion.s →
        IsIso (localCohomologyToAdicQuotientLimit S.adicCompletion.A S.adicCompletion.I
          (maximalIdeal S.adicCompletion.A) (maximalIdeal S.adicCompletion.A)
          (ModuleCat.of S.adicCompletion.A S.adicCompletion.M) rfl i)) ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ S.adicCompletion.s →
        S.adicCompletion.I ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator S.adicCompletion.A
          (Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyModule S.adicCompletion.A
            (maximalIdeal S.adicCompletion.A) (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing _)
            (ModuleCat.of S.adicCompletion.A S.adicCompletion.M) i)
declarations.comment:
both assertions read over the I-adic completion A', I', M' of the situation, for
an arbitrary A: Hⁱ_{𝔪'}(M') → lim Hⁱ_{𝔪'}(M'/(I')ⁿM') is an isomorphism for i ≤ s and a power of
I' annihilates these modules. No completeness assumption on A; this is the statement the
source's proof establishes over the completion

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_localCohomologyToAdicQuotientLimit_closedPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EFR.** In the bootstrap situation of Stacks 0EFU with `A` local and
`T = {𝔪}`, the map `Hⁱ_𝔪(M) ⟶ lim Hⁱ_𝔪(M/IⁿM)` is an isomorphism for `i ≤ s`, and a single power
of `I` annihilates these modules. Nothing is assumed about `A` beyond Situation 0EFU and the
locality of the locus; in particular `A` need not be `I`-adically complete.

The isomorphism is the composite of the two displays of the source's proof. The first,
`Hⁱ_𝔪(M) ≅ Hⁱ(RΓ_𝔪(M)^∧)`, is
`Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_homology_localCohomologyToCompletedLocalCohomology_closedPoint`,
which obtains it over the `I`-adic completion from Stacks 0DXP and Stacks 0EFQ and descends it;
the second, `Hⁱ(RΓ_𝔪(M)^∧) ≅ lim Hⁱ_𝔪(M/IⁿM)`, is Stacks 0DXJ. The annihilation assertion is
`Stacks.Algebraization.exists_pow_le_annihilator_localCohomologyModule_of_eq_closedPoint`, which
needs only Stacks 0EFQ over `A` itself.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_localCohomologyToAdicQuotientLimit_closedPoint
    [IsLocalRing S.A] (hT : S.T = {closedPoint S.A}) :
    (∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ S.s →
        IsIso (localCohomologyToAdicQuotientLimit S.A S.I (maximalIdeal S.A)
          (maximalIdeal S.A) (ModuleCat.of S.A S.M) rfl i)) ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ S.s →
        S.I ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator S.A
          (Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyModule S.A (maximalIdeal S.A)
            (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing _) (ModuleCat.of S.A S.M) i)
declarations.comment:
both assertions over A itself for every Noetherian local ring: in Situation 0EFU
with A local and T = {𝔪}, the map Hⁱ_𝔪(M) → lim Hⁱ_𝔪(M/IⁿM) is an isomorphism for i ≤ s and a
single power of I annihilates these modules

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.BootstrapSituation
declarations.doc:
The standing bootstrap situation for algebraization: a Noetherian ring with a dualizing
complex, an ideal, a finite module, a specialization-stable subset of the adic locus, and the two
integer bounds against which depth and cohomological dimension are measured.
declarations.statement: public structure BootstrapSituation

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.finite_adicCompletion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EFV (completion).** The completed module of a bootstrap situation is
finite over the completed ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_adicCompletion (S : BootstrapSituation.{u, v, w}) :
    Module.Finite (AdicCompletion S.I S.A) (AdicCompletion S.I S.M)
declarations.comment: completion

public theorem stableUnderSpecialization_adicCompletion (S : BootstrapSituation.{u, v, w}) :

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.dualizing_adicCompletion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EFV (completion).** Assumption (1) completes: the adic completion of
