    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)) :
    IsCompletionOfRestriction S F ↔ IsRestrictionOfCompletion S F
declarations.comment: the two restriction conditions agree

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.extendsToX_of_isRestrictionOfCompletion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EIL, condition (5) implies condition (6).** A system that is the restriction of a
completion on `X` extends to `X`: the completion itself is the extension.
declarations.comment: restriction of a completion extends to X

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.ExtendsToX
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIM.** A coherent `I`-adic system on `U` extends to `X` when it is
isomorphic, as an inverse system, to the restriction of a coherent `I`-adic system on `X`.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev ExtendsToX (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.extendsToX_iff_pullback_isCompletion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIN.** A coherent `I`-adic system on `U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞)` extends to
`Spec(A)` if and only if its pullback to `U' = Spec(A') ∖ V(𝔞')`, for `A'` the `I`-adic
completion of `A`, is the completion of a coherent `𝒪_{U'}`-module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendsToX_iff_pullback_isCompletion (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)) :
    ExtendsToX S F ↔
      (completionFunctor (completionMap S ⁻¹ᵁ S.U).toScheme
          ((S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι).comap (completionMap S ∣_ S.U))).essImage
        ((Stacks.Coherent.coherentAdicPullback (completionMap S ∣_ S.U)
          (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.CanonicallyExtends
declarations.doc:
A coherent `I`-adic system on `U` *canonically extends* to `X` when the quasi-coherent
sheaves associated to its global sections are pro-isomorphic to a coherent `I`-adic system on
`X`.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev CanonicallyExtends (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S)) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.Coherent.coherentAdicToPro_fullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
A coherent adic system has exactly the morphisms of its associated
pro-quasi-coherent object.
declarations.statement:
public theorem coherentAdicToPro_fullyFaithful
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : X.IdealSheafData) :
    Nonempty (coherentAdicToPro X I).FullyFaithful

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isMittagLefflerCategorical_of_canonicallyExtends
declarations.doc:
**Part (3) of Stacks Project, Tag 0EIR.** If a coherent `I`-adic system on the open
complement `U` canonically extends to `X`, then the inverse system `{H⁰(U, ℱₙ)}` of its modules
of sections satisfies the Mittag-Leffler condition.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isMittagLefflerCategorical_of_canonicallyExtends (h : CanonicallyExtends S F) :
    IsMittagLefflerCategorical (globalSectionsSystem S F)
declarations.comment: part (3): the inverse system of global sections of a canonically extending coherent adic system on the open complement satisfies Mittag-Leffler

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.limitTopologyAgrees_of_canonicallyExtends
declarations.doc:
**Part (4) of Stacks Project, Tag 0EIR, second half.** The limit topology on
`M = limₙ H⁰(U, ℱₙ)` is the `I`-adic topology.
declarations.statement:
public theorem limitTopologyAgrees_of_canonicallyExtends (h : CanonicallyExtends S F) :
    LimitTopologyAgrees S F
declarations.comment: part (4), the equality of topologies: the limit topology on M is the I-adic topology, for a canonically extending coherent adic system on the open complement

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isAdicComplete_and_finite_adicCompletion_of_canonicallyExtends
declarations.doc:
**Part (4) of Stacks Project, Tag 0EIR, first half.** The module `M = limₙ H⁰(U, ℱₙ)` is
finite over the `I`-adic completion `Â` of `A`: it is `I`-adically complete, so the canonical map
`M ⟶ M^ = limₙ M/IⁿM` (`AdicCompletion.of`) is an isomorphism of `A`-modules, and its completion
`M^`, with its canonical structure of `Â`-module, is a finite `Â`-module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAdicComplete_and_finite_adicCompletion_of_canonicallyExtends
    (h : CanonicallyExtends S F) :
    IsAdicComplete S.I (limitGlobalSections S F) ∧
      Module.Finite (AdicCompletion S.I S.A)
        (AdicCompletion S.I (limitGlobalSections S F : Type u))
declarations.comment: part (4), finiteness: M is finite over the I-adic completion of A, for a canonically extending coherent adic system on the open complement

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.canonicalExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIR.** A coherent adic system on `X` extending `F`, together with
a chosen pro-isomorphism from the sheaves associated to the global sections of `F`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def canonicalExtension
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (h : CanonicallyExtends S F) :
    Σ G : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnX S),
      Stacks.Coherent.diagramToPro (tildeGlobalSectionsSystem S F) ≅
        (Stacks.Coherent.coherentAdicToPro S.X (idealOnX S)).obj G
declarations.comment: unique_extension

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.existsUnique_compatibleIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIR.** Two coherent adic extensions of the same pro-object are
isomorphic by exactly one isomorphism compatible with their chosen pro-isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_compatibleIso
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (P : (Ind (Scheme.QuasicoherentModules S.X)ᵒᵖ)ᵒᵖ)
    (G H : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnX S))
    (φ : P ≅ (Stacks.Coherent.coherentAdicToPro S.X (idealOnX S)).obj G)
    (ψ : P ≅ (Stacks.Coherent.coherentAdicToPro S.X (idealOnX S)).obj H) :
    ∃! e : G ≅ H,
      φ ≪≫ (Stacks.Coherent.coherentAdicToPro S.X (idealOnX S)).mapIso e = ψ
declarations.comment: unique_extension

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.extendsToX_kerComapSystem_of_canonicallyExtends
declarations.doc:
**Part (2) of Stacks Project, Tag 0EIR.** A coherent `I`-adic system on the open complement
`U` which canonically extends to `X` is the restriction to `U` of a coherent `I`-adic system
on `X`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendsToX_kerComapSystem_of_canonicallyExtends (h : CanonicallyExtends S F) :
    ExtendsToX S (kerComapSystem S F)
declarations.comment: part (2): the implication CanonicallyExtends → ExtendsToX, for a coherent adic system on the open complement of an algebraization situation

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.nonempty_pullback_extension_iso
declarations.doc:
For `A → A'` flat, if `(G_n)` in `Coh(X, I 𝒪_X)` is pro-isomorphic to `(H⁰(U, F_n)^~)`, then
`(f^*G_n)` is pro-isomorphic to `(H⁰(U', F'_n)^~)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_pullback_extension_iso
    (G : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnX S))
    (e : Stacks.Coherent.diagramToPro (tildeGlobalSectionsSystem S F) ≅
      (Stacks.Coherent.coherentAdicToPro S.X (idealOnX S)).obj G) :
    Nonempty (Stacks.Coherent.diagramToPro
        (tildeGlobalSectionsSystem (S.baseChange A') (baseChangeAdicSystem S A' F)) ≅
      (Stacks.Coherent.coherentAdicToPro (S.baseChange A').X (idealOnX (S.baseChange A'))).obj
        (baseChangeCanonicalExtension S A' G))
declarations.comment: the extension pulls back

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.canonicallyExtends_base_change
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be an algebraization situation: a Noetherian ring `A`
with ideals `I ⊆ 𝔞`, the affine scheme `X = Spec(A)` and the open complement `U = X ∖ V(𝔞)`. Let
`(F_n)` be a coherent `I`-adic system on `U` and let `A → A'` be a flat ring map with `A'`
Noetherian. Put `X' = Spec(A')`, let `U' ⊆ X'` be the inverse image of `U`, let `g : U' ⟶ U` be
the induced morphism and set `(F'_n) = (g^*F_n)`. If `(F_n)` canonically extends to `X`, then
`(F'_n)` canonically extends to `X'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem canonicallyExtends_base_change (h : CanonicallyExtends S F) :
    CanonicallyExtends (S.baseChange A') (baseChangeAdicSystem S A' F)
declarations.comment: flat base change of the canonical extension

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isCompletion_iff_isCompletion_of_isKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EIU part (2).** In Situation 0EHC, let `α : (F_n) ⟶ (F'_n)` be a morphism of
`Coh(U, I𝒪_U)` whose levelwise kernels and cokernels are annihilated by a power of `I𝒪_U`. Then
`(F_n)` is the completion of a coherent `𝒪_U`-module if and only if `(F'_n)` is.

This is `Stacks.Algebraization.essImage_iff_essImage_of_isKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower` on the
open subscheme `U`, which is Noetherian because `X` is.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCompletion_iff_isCompletion_of_isKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    {F G : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)} (α : F ⟶ G)
    (hα : IsKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι) α.hom) :
    (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)).essImage F ↔
      (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)).essImage G
declarations.comment: part (2): membership in the essential image of the completion functor

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.extendsToX_iff_extendsToX_of_isKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EIU part (1).** In Situation 0EHC, let `α : (F_n) ⟶ (F'_n)` be a morphism of
`Coh(U, I𝒪_U)` whose levelwise kernels and cokernels are annihilated by a power of `I𝒪_U`. Then
`(F_n)` extends to `X` if and only if `(F'_n)` does.

Stacks 0EIN, in the form `Stacks.Algebraization.extendsToX_iff_pullback_isCompletion`, replaces
extendability to `X` by membership in the essential image of the completion functor on the
preimage `U'` of `U` in the spectrum of the `I`-adic completion of the base. The pullback along
that flat morphism carries `α` to a morphism of `Coh(U', I𝒪_{U'})` whose levelwise kernels and
cokernels are still annihilated by a power of the ideal, by
`Stacks.Coherent.isKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower_coherentAdicPullback_map`, so
`Stacks.Algebraization.essImage_iff_essImage_of_isKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower` applies on
`U'`. The flatness of the completion map is
`AdicCompletion.flat_of_isNoetherian` read through `AlgebraicGeometry.Flat.SpecMap_iff`, in the
form in which the restriction to the open `U` inherits it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendsToX_iff_extendsToX_of_isKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    {F G : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)} (α : F ⟶ G)
    (hα : IsKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι) α.hom) :
    ExtendsToX S F ↔ ExtendsToX S G
declarations.comment: part (1): extendability to the whole of X

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.NeighbourhoodHoms.sectionsNearVanishing_internalHomNear
declarations.doc:
**The source of the comparison of Stacks 0EIV is the colimit of the morphisms of the
restrictions.** A section of the internal hom `SheafHom(𝒢, ℱ)` over an open neighbourhood `V`
of the formal locus is, on the nose, a morphism `𝒢|_V ⟶ ℱ|_V` of modules on the site of opens
below `V`. So the source of `nbhdHomComparison` is `colim_{V ∈ 𝒱} Hom_V(𝒢|_V, ℱ|_V)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem sectionsNearVanishing_internalHomNear
    (V : OpensNearVanishing A I a) :
    ToType ((sectionsNearVanishing A I a (internalHomNear A a G F).obj).obj V) =
      ((_root_.restrFun (complementZeroLocus A a : Scheme).sheaf.obj V.openSet).obj
          G.obj.val ⟶
        (_root_.restrFun (complementZeroLocus A a : Scheme).sheaf.obj V.openSet).obj
          F.obj.val)
declarations.comment: at the member V = U: the source is the colimit over the whole family

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.NeighbourhoodHoms.nbhdHomComparison
declarations.doc:
**The map of Stacks 0EIV.** The canonical map from the morphisms `𝒢|_{V'} ⟶ ℱ|_{V'}`
defined on arbitrarily small open neighbourhoods `V'` of the formal locus `U ∩ V(I)` to the
morphisms of the completions `𝒢^∧ ⟶ ℱ^∧` in `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`.

It is the composite of three canonical maps: the comparison of Stacks 0EG2 for the internal
hom `H = SheafHom(𝒢, ℱ)`, which lands in the compatible families of sections of `H / Iⁿ H` on
`U`; the identification of that limit with the limit of the global sections of the completion
of `H`, which is `adicCompletionLimitIso` on the tower and `sectionsAbLimitIso` on sections;
and the identification of Stacks 0882 of the latter with the morphisms of the completions.
declarations.statement:
public def nbhdHomComparison :
    ToType (colimit (C := Ab.{u})
        (sectionsNearVanishing A I a (internalHomNear A a G F).obj)) →
      ((completionFunctor (complementZeroLocus A a : Scheme)
          (idealSheafNearVanishing A I a)).obj G ⟶
        (completionFunctor (complementZeroLocus A a : Scheme)
          (idealSheafNearVanishing A I a)).obj F)
declarations.comment: at V = U: the canonical map from germs of morphisms to the completions

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.nbhdHomComparisonOn_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EIV.** Let `I ⊆ 𝔞` be ideals of a Noetherian ring `A`, put `U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞)` and
let `𝒱` be the set of open subschemes of `U` containing `U ∩ V(I)`, ordered by reverse inclusion.
Let `G`, `F` be coherent `𝒪_V`-modules for some `V ∈ 𝒱`. The map
`colim_{V' ≥ V} Hom_{V'}(G|_{V'}, F|_{V'}) ⟶ Hom_{Coh(V, I𝒪_V)}(G^∧, F^∧)` is bijective if

1. `A` is `I`-adically complete and has a dualizing complex, and
2. whenever `x` is an associated point of `F` outside `V(I)` whose closure meets `V(I)` outside
   `V(𝔞)`, every `z ∈ closure {x} ∩ V(𝔞)` has `dim(𝒪_{closure {x}, z}) > cd(A, I) + 1`.

The target is the category of coherent adic systems on `V` along `I 𝒪_V`; restriction from `U`
to `V` identifies the morphisms of completions there with those in `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`
(`Stacks.Algebraization.bijective_restrictCompletionHom`), the terms being supported in
`U ∩ V(I) ⊆ V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nbhdHomComparisonOn_bijective (hIa : I ≤ a) (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete I A)
    (hdualizing : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (V : OpensNearVanishing A I a)
    (G F : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules V.openSet.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (hdim : AssociatedPointsClosureDimensionBoundOn V F.obj) :
    Function.Bijective (nbhdHomComparisonOn V G F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIX.** The distance from a closed subset of a Noetherian scheme.
It is the minimum weight of all systems of integral closed subschemes from `Z` to `y`, or
infinity if there is no system.
declarations.statement:
public def distanceFunction (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (Z : Closeds Y)
    (y : Y) : ℕ∞
declarations.comment: the distance function

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.nonempty_distanceSystem_of_connectedComponent_inter
declarations.doc:
In a Noetherian scheme, a point connected to the closed subset `Z` admits a finite
zigzag of integral closed subschemes beginning in `Z` and ending at that point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_distanceSystem_of_connectedComponent_inter
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (Z : Closeds Y) (y : Y)
    (h : (connectedComponent y ∩ (Z : Set Y)).Nonempty) :
    Nonempty (DistanceSystem Y Z y)
declarations.comment: existence of a zigzag in a connected component meeting Z

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_le_two_of_zigzag
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIX.** In a Noetherian scheme, if a point `z` of `Z` is an
immediate specialization of `v`, `v` an immediate specialization of `w`, and `w ⤳ c ⤳ y` is a
strict chain of length two, then `δ^Y_Z(y) ≤ 2`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_le_two_of_zigzag (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y]
    (Z : Closeds Y) {z v w c y : Y} (hz : z ∈ (Z : Set Y))
    (hvz : v ⤳ z) (hcovvz : ∀ x, v ⤳ x → x ⤳ z → x = v ∨ x = z)
    (hwv : w ⤳ v) (hcovwv : ∀ x, w ⤳ x → x ⤳ v → x = w ∨ x = v)
    (hwc : w ⤳ c) (hcy : c ⤳ y) (hwc' : w ≠ c) (hcy' : c ≠ y) :
    distanceFunction Y Z y ≤ 2
declarations.comment: a zigzag of weight two

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_max_dimensionFunction_on_closed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIY.** A dimension function has a maximum on a nonempty closed
subset of a Noetherian scheme.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_max_dimensionFunction_on_closed
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (Z : Closeds Y)
    (hZ : (Z : Set Y).Nonempty) (δ : DimensionFunction Y) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, IsGreatest (δ '' (Z : Set Y)) m
declarations.comment: dimension_function_lower_bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_ge_dimensionFunction_sub_max
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIY.** The distance from `Z` is at least the value of a dimension
function minus its maximum value on `Z`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_ge_dimensionFunction_sub_max
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (Z : Closeds Y)
    (δ : DimensionFunction Y) (m : ℤ)
    (hm : IsGreatest (δ '' (Z : Set Y)) m) (y : Y) :
    ((δ y - m).toNat : ℕ∞) ≤ distanceFunction Y Z y
declarations.comment: dimension_function_lower_bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_le_closureLocalDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIY.** The distance to `Z` is at most the local dimension of the
closure of `y` at any specialization `z` lying in `Z`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_le_closureLocalDimension
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (Z : Closeds Y)
    (y z : Y) (hzy : z ∈ closure {y}) (hzZ : z ∈ (Z : Set Y)) :
    (distanceFunction Y Z y : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      Order.coheight (⟨z, hzy⟩ : (closure {y} : Set Y))
declarations.comment: le_local_dimension

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_closedPoint_eq_coheight
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIY.** The distance from the closed point of a catenary Noetherian
local spectrum is the dimension of the closure of the given prime.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_closedPoint_eq_coheight
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hcat : Ring.IsCatenary A) (y : PrimeSpectrum A) :
    distanceFunction (Spec (.of A))
      ⟨{IsLocalRing.closedPoint A}, IsLocalRing.isClosed_singleton_closedPoint A⟩ y =
        Order.coheight y
declarations.comment: local_catenary_eq_dimension

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_le_of_isOpenImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIY.** Restriction to an open subscheme does not
decrease the distance from a closed subset.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_le_of_isOpenImmersion
    {U Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (Z : Closeds Y) (x : U) :
    letI : IsNoetherian U :=
      { toIsLocallyNoetherian := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion j
        toCompactSpace := (j.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace).compactSpace }
    distanceFunction Y Z (j x) ≤ distanceFunction U (Z.preimage j.continuous) x
declarations.comment: open_restriction_ge

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_le_add_one_of_isImmediateSpecialization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIY.** An immediate specialization raises the distance from a
closed subset by at most one when passing from the special point to the generic point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_le_add_one_of_isImmediateSpecialization
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (Z : Closeds Y)
    (hY : IrreducibleClosedsCodim.IsCatenarySpace Y)
    {y' y : Y} (h : IsImmediateSpecialization y' y) :
    distanceFunction Y Z y' ≤ distanceFunction Y Z y + 1
declarations.comment: immediate_specialization_bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_le_of_zigzag_specializations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIY.** In a zigzag starting in `Z`, each immediate leftward
specialization increases the possible distance by at most one.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_le_of_zigzag_specializations
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (Z : Closeds Y)
    (hY : IrreducibleClosedsCodim.IsCatenarySpace Y)
    (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Y) (y' : Fin k → Y)
    (hzero : y ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ k⟩ ∈ (Z : Set Y))
    (hleft : ∀ i : Fin k, IsImmediateSpecialization (y' i) (y (Fin.castSucc i)))
    (hright : ∀ i : Fin k, y' i ⤳ y (Fin.succ i)) :
    distanceFunction Y Z (y (Fin.last k)) ≤ (k : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: zigzag_bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_sublevel_stableUnderSpecialization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIY.** Sublevel sets of the distance from a closed subset of a
Noetherian scheme are stable under specialization.
declarations.comment: sublevel_specialization_stable

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_eq_zero_iff_mem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIY.** A point has distance zero from a closed subset precisely
when it lies in that subset.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_eq_zero_iff_mem (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y]
    (Z : Closeds Y) (y : Y) :
    distanceFunction Y Z y = 0 ↔ y ∈ (Z : Set Y)
declarations.comment: zero_iff_mem

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_add_trdeg_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EIZ.** For a finite type morphism with fibres of dimension at
most `e`, the distance at the image point is at most the distance at the source point
plus `e` minus the residue-field transcendence degree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_add_trdeg_le
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsNoetherian Y]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hY : Scheme.IsUniversallyCatenary Y)
    (I : Y.IdealSheafData) (e : ℕ)
    (he : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber y) ≤ (e : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (x : X) :
    let : IsNoetherian X :=
      { toIsLocallyNoetherian := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
        toCompactSpace := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f }
    let := (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    distanceFunction Y I.support (f x) +
        Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)) ≤
      distanceFunction X (I.comap f).support x + (e : ℕ∞)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_eq_topologicalKrullDim_add_curveChainDistance
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ1, closing sentence.** Let `Y` be of finite type over a field and
`Z = {z}` a closed point. Then `δ_Z(y) = δ(y) + t`, where `δ(y) = dim closure {y}` is the usual
dimension function and `t` is the minimum length of a chain of curves connecting `z` to a closed
point of `closure {y}`.

Both sides may be infinite: `t = ∞` when no chain of curves exists, which happens exactly when
`z` and `y` lie in different connected components, and then `δ_Z(y) = ∞` as well. The equality is
read in `WithBot ℕ∞`, where `dim closure {y}` lives.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_eq_topologicalKrullDim_add_curveChainDistance
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (f : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (z y : Y) (hz : IsClosed ({z} : Set Y)) :
    let : IsNoetherian Y :=
      { toIsLocallyNoetherian := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
        toCompactSpace := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f }
    ((distanceFunction Y (⟨{z}, hz⟩ : Closeds Y) y : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      topologicalKrullDim (closure ({y} : Set Y)) +
        ((curveChainDistance Y z (closure {y}) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment:
A generalization of case (1) is if Y is of finite type over a field and
Z = {z} is a closed point. Then δ_Z(y) = δ(y) + t where t is the minimum length of a chain of
curves connecting z to a closed point of the closure of {y}.

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_eq_sub_of_specializes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ1, case (2b).** If `y ⤳ ζ`, i.e. the subvariety `closure {ζ}` is
contained in `closure {y}`, the distance from `closure {ζ}` to `y` is `δ(y) - δ(ζ)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_eq_sub_of_specializes
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (δ : DimensionFunction Y) (ζ y : Y) (h : y ⤳ ζ) :
    distanceFunction Y (⟨closure {ζ}, isClosed_closure⟩ : Closeds Y) y =
      ((δ y - δ ζ).toNat : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: subvariety_specializes

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_eq_of_isClosed_of_specializes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ1, case (1a).** If `z` is a closed point and `y ⤳ z`, the distance
from `{z}` to `y` is `δ(y)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_eq_of_isClosed_of_specializes
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (δ : DimensionFunction Y) (z y : Y)
    (hz : IsClosed ({z} : Set Y)) (hz0 : δ z = 0) (h : y ⤳ z) :
    distanceFunction Y (⟨{z}, hz⟩ : Closeds Y) y = ((δ y).toNat : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: closed_point_specializes

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_eq_one_of_not_specializes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ1, case (2c).** If `ζ` does not specialize to `y` and
`δ(y) ≤ δ(ζ)`, the distance from `closure {ζ}` to `y` is `1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_eq_one_of_not_specializes
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IrreducibleSpace Y] (δ : DimensionFunction Y) (ζ y : Y)
    (h : ¬ ζ ⤳ y) (hle : δ y ≤ δ ζ) :
    distanceFunction Y (⟨closure {ζ}, isClosed_closure⟩ : Closeds Y) y = 1
declarations.comment: subvariety_codim_small

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_eq_sub_add_one_of_not_specializes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ1, case (2d).** If `y` does not specialize to `ζ` and
`δ(ζ) < δ(y)`, the distance from `closure {ζ}` to `y` is `δ(y) - δ(ζ) + 1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_eq_sub_add_one_of_not_specializes
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IrreducibleSpace Y] (δ : DimensionFunction Y) (ζ y : Y)
    (h : ¬ y ⤳ ζ) (hlt : δ ζ < δ y) :
    distanceFunction Y (⟨closure {ζ}, isClosed_closure⟩ : Closeds Y) y =
      ((δ y - δ ζ).toNat : ℕ∞) + 1
declarations.comment: subvariety_codim_large

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_eq_add_one_of_not_specializes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ1, case (1b).** If `z` is a closed point and `y` does not
specialize to `z`, the distance from `{z}` to `y` is `δ(y) + 1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_eq_add_one_of_not_specializes
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IrreducibleSpace Y] (δ : DimensionFunction Y) (z y : Y)
    (hz : IsClosed ({z} : Set Y)) (hz0 : δ z = 0) (h : ¬ y ⤳ z) :
    distanceFunction Y (⟨{z}, hz⟩ : Closeds Y) y = ((δ y).toNat : ℕ∞) + 1
declarations.comment: closed_point_not_specializes

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.distanceFunction_eq_zero_of_closure_subset
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ1.** The distance to a closed subset containing the closure of a
point is zero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem distanceFunction_eq_zero_of_closure_subset
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (Z : Closeds Y) (y : Y)
    (h : closure ({y} : Set Y) ⊆ (Z : Set Y)) :
    distanceFunction Y Z y = 0
declarations.comment: subvariety_contains_w

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.SatisfiesDepthInequalities
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ3.** A coherent `I`-adic system on `U` satisfies the
`(a, b)`-inequalities when, at every point of `U ∩ Y` and every prime `𝔭` of the completed local
ring not containing `I𝒪_{X,y}^∧`, the depth of the formal stalk at `𝔭` obeys the bound `a`
strictly if `V(𝔭) ∩ V(I𝒪_{X,y}^∧) = {𝔪_y^∧}`, and in the remaining case obeys `a` weakly or
else the bound `b` strictly after adding `dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭)`.
declarations.statement: public abbrev SatisfiesDepthInequalities (a b : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.comment: the (a, b)-inequalities

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ3.** A coherent `I`-adic system on `U` satisfies the strict
`(a, b)`-inequalities when, at every point of `U ∩ Y` and every prime `𝔭` of the completed local
ring not containing `I𝒪_{X,y}^∧`, the depth of the formal stalk at `𝔭` exceeds the bound `a`,
or else exceeds the bound `b` after adding `dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭)`.
declarations.statement: public abbrev SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities (a b : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.comment: the strict (a, b)-inequalities

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_of_annihilated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ4 (1).** A coherent `I`-adic system on `U` annihilated by a fixed
power of `I` satisfies the `(a, b)`-inequalities for every pair of bounds, since every formal
stalk then localizes to zero at a prime outside the adic locus and so has infinite depth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesDepthInequalities_of_annihilated
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (hF : ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ,
      _root_.Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.IdealPower.idealPowerMultiple (idealOnOpen S) c
        (F.obj.obj (op n)) = ⊥)
    (a b : ℤ) :
    SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F a b
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesStrictDepthInequalities_of_succ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ4 (2).** A coherent `I`-adic system on `U` satisfying the
`(a + 1, b)`-inequalities satisfies the strict `(a, b)`-inequalities: in the case distinguished
by the adic closed fibre the weak bound `a + 1` already beats `a` strictly.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesStrictDepthInequalities_of_succ
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (a b : ℤ)
    (hF : SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F (a + 1) b) :
    SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S F a b
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_iff_bootstrapSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ4 (3).** If `cd(A, I) ≤ d` and `A` has a dualizing complex, then a
coherent `I`-adic system on `U` satisfies the `(s, s + d)`-inequalities exactly when, at every
point `y` of `U ∩ Y` with `δ^Y_Z(y)` finite, the completed local ring, the ideal `I𝒪_{X,y}^∧`,
the singleton `{𝔪_y^∧}`, the formal stalk `ℱ_y^∧` and the bounds `s - δ^Y_Z(y)` and `d` form a
bootstrap situation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesDepthInequalities_iff_bootstrapSituation
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (s d : ℤ)
    (hcd : _root_.Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing S.I) ≤ d)
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} S.A),
      Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K) :
    SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F s (s + d) ↔
      ∀ (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
        S.distanceToZ z ≠ ⊤ →
        ∃ B : BootstrapSituation.{u, u, v},
          B.A = completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y ∧
          HEq B.commRing
            (inferInstance : CommRing (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y)) ∧
          HEq B.I (completedLocalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y) ∧
          B.M = completedStalk (idealOnOpen S) F y ∧
          HEq B.addCommGroup
            (inferInstance : AddCommGroup (completedStalk (idealOnOpen S) F y)) ∧
          HEq B.module (inferInstance : Module (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y)
            (completedStalk (idealOnOpen S) F y)) ∧
          HEq B.T {q : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y) |
            q.asIdeal = completedMaximalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y} ∧
          B.s = s - ((S.distanceToZ z).toNat : ℤ) ∧ B.d = d
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_of_strict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ4 (4).** If `cd(A, I) ≤ d` and `A` has a dualizing complex, then
the strict `(s, s + d)`-inequalities imply the ordinary `(s, s + d)`-inequalities: in the case
distinguished by the adic closed fibre the prime is isolated in the adic locus, so
`dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭) ≤ cd(𝒪_{X,y}^∧, I𝒪_{X,y}^∧) ≤ d` and the bound `s + d` on the sum implies
the bound `s` on the depth alone. The isolated-prime bound used for this is
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_cohomologicalDimension'`, which discharges the
local case of Stacks 0BFR on the completion of `𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭` itself rather than taking it as a
hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesDepthInequalities_of_strict
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (s d : ℤ)
    (hcd : _root_.Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing S.I) ≤ d)
    (_hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} S.A),
      Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hF : SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S F s (s + d)) :
    SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F s (s + d)
declarations.comment: part (4)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_elementary_properties
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ4.** The four elementary properties of the depth–distance
inequalities, as one statement about a coherent `I`-adic system `(ℱₙ)` on `U` in an
algebraization situation.

1. If `(ℱₙ)` is annihilated by a power of `I`, it satisfies the `(a, b)`-inequalities for every
   pair of bounds.
2. If `(ℱₙ)` satisfies the `(a + 1, b)`-inequalities, it satisfies the strict
   `(a, b)`-inequalities.

If moreover `cd(A, I) ≤ d` and `A` has a dualizing complex, then

3. `(ℱₙ)` satisfies the `(s, s + d)`-inequalities exactly when, at every point `y` of `U ∩ Y`
   with `δ^Y_Z(y)` finite, the completed local ring, the ideal `I𝒪_{X,y}^∧`, the singleton
   `{𝔪_y^∧}`, the formal stalk `ℱ_y^∧` and the bounds `s - δ^Y_Z(y)` and `d` form a bootstrap
   situation, and
4. the strict `(s, s + d)`-inequalities imply the ordinary `(s, s + d)`-inequalities.

Parts (1) and (2) are stated here under no hypothesis beyond the situation itself, exactly as
the source states them; the hypotheses `cd(A, I) ≤ d` and the existence of a dualizing complex
are carried only by parts (3) and (4), which is where the source introduces them. The four
parts are `Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_of_annihilated`,
`Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesStrictDepthInequalities_of_succ`,
`Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_iff_bootstrapSituation` and
`Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_of_strict`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesDepthInequalities_elementary_properties
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S)) :
    ((∃ c : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ,
        _root_.Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.IdealPower.idealPowerMultiple (idealOnOpen S) c
          (F.obj.obj (op n)) = ⊥) →
      ∀ a b : ℤ, SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F a b) ∧
    (∀ a b : ℤ, SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F (a + 1) b →
      SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S F a b) ∧
    (∀ s d : ℤ,
      _root_.Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
          (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing S.I) ≤ d →
      (∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K) →
      (SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F s (s + d) ↔
          ∀ (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
            S.distanceToZ z ≠ ⊤ →
            ∃ B : BootstrapSituation.{u, u, v},
              B.A = completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y ∧
              HEq B.commRing
                (inferInstance : CommRing (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y)) ∧
              HEq B.I (completedLocalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y) ∧
              B.M = completedStalk (idealOnOpen S) F y ∧
              HEq B.addCommGroup
                (inferInstance : AddCommGroup (completedStalk (idealOnOpen S) F y)) ∧
              HEq B.module (inferInstance : Module (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y)
                (completedStalk (idealOnOpen S) F y)) ∧
              HEq B.T {q : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y) |
                q.asIdeal = completedMaximalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y} ∧
              B.s = s - ((S.distanceToZ z).toNat : ℤ) ∧ B.d = d) ∧
        (SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S F s (s + d) →
          SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F s (s + d)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.one_le_depth_stalk_of_mixed_irreducibleComponents
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ5.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring with ideals `I ⊆ 𝔞`, write
`X = Spec(A)`, `Y = V(I)`, `Z = V(𝔞)`, `U = X ∖ Z`, and suppose `A` is `I`-adically complete,
has a dualizing complex, and has `cd(A, I) ≤ d` with `d ≥ 1`. Let `ℱ` be a coherent
`𝒪_U`-module whose completion along `I𝒪_U` satisfies the strict `(1, 1 + d)`-inequalities of
[Stacks, Tag 0EJ3]. Let `x ∈ U` be a point such that the closed fibre
`\overline{\{x\}} ∩ Y` has an irreducible component contained in `Z` and an irreducible
component not contained in `Z`. Then

  `depth_{𝒪_{U,x}}(ℱ_x) ≥ 1`.

The source states this for `x ∈ X`; a point of `Z` never satisfies the hypothesis, its closure
lying in `Z`, and `ℱ_x` is defined only on `U`, so `x` ranges over `U`.

The components on both sides disconnect the closed fibre once their intersection is removed, so
[Stacks, Tag 0EG5] produces a point `z` of the closed fibre inside `Z` with
`dim(𝒪_{\overline{\{x\}}, z}) ≤ d + 1`; [Stacks, Tag 02IM] produces an immediate generalization
`r` of `z` still in the closed fibre but outside `Z`, whose distance to `Z` is therefore exactly
`1` and whose local dimension is at most `d`. At the point `y ∈ U` that `r` determines the
strict inequalities, evaluated at a prime of `𝒪_{U,y}^∧` minimal over the extension of the prime
of `x`, force `depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) ≥ 1`; and that depth is `depth(ℱ_x)`, by [Stacks, Tag 0338] and
[Stacks, Tag 0EHW].
declarations.statement:
public theorem one_le_depth_stalk_of_mixed_irreducibleComponents
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A]
    (F : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A)) (hK : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      S.I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing ≤ d)
    (hstrict : SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S
      ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj F) 1 (1 + d))
    (x : S.U.toScheme)
    (hmixed :
      let W : Set S.Y := S.Yι.base ⁻¹' closure ({S.U.ι.base x} : Set S.X)
      let Z : Set W := {y | S.Yι.base y.1 ∈ Set.range S.Zι.base}
      (∃ C : Set W, C ∈ irreducibleComponents W ∧ C ⊆ Z) ∧
        (∃ C : Set W, C ∈ irreducibleComponents W ∧ ¬ C ⊆ Z)) :
    1 ≤ Module.depth (S.U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk x)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk x))
      ((stalkModuleFunctor x).obj F.obj)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_globalToFormalSections_of_satisfiesStrictDepthInequalities
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ6.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring with ideals `I ⊆ 𝔞`, write
`X = Spec(A)`, `Y = V(I)`, `Z = V(𝔞)`, `U = X ∖ Z`, and let `ℱ` be a coherent `𝒪_U`-module and
`d ≥ 1`. Assume

1. `A` is `I`-adically complete, has a dualizing complex, and `cd(A, I) ≤ d`,
2. the completion `ℱ^∧` of `ℱ` along `I𝒪_U` satisfies the strict `(1, 1 + d)`-inequalities of
   [Stacks, Tag 0EJ3], and
3. `depth(ℱ_x) ≥ 2` for every `x ∈ U` with `\overline{\{x\}} ∩ Y ⊆ Z`.

Then

  `H⁰(U, ℱ) ⟶ lim H⁰(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)`

is an isomorphism. That arrow is
`Stacks.Algebraization.FormalSectionsII.globalToFormalSections`, whose `n`-th component is
reduction modulo `Iⁿ` by
`Stacks.Algebraization.FormalSectionsII.globalToFormalSections_proj`.

[Stacks, Tag 0EIG] supplies the conclusion from conditions (1), (3) and its own condition (2),
the dimension bound at the associated points of `ℱ`; that bound is
`Stacks.Algebraization.associatedPointsClosureDimensionBound_of_satisfiesStrictDepthInequalities`,
which is where condition (2) here and [Stacks, Tag 0EJ5] are consumed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_globalToFormalSections_of_satisfiesStrictDepthInequalities
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A]
    (F : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A)) (hK : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I S.I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing ≤ d)
    (hstrict : SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S
      ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj F) 1 (1 + d))
    (hdepth : FormalSectionsII.DepthTwoOffFormalLocus S.A S.I S.a F.obj) :
    IsIso (FormalSectionsII.globalToFormalSections S.A S.I S.a F.obj)
declarations.comment: H^0(U,F) = lim H^0(U,F/I^nF) under the strict (1,1+d)-inequalities and depth two off the formal locus

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.completionFunctor_map_bijective_of_satisfiesStrictDepthInequalities
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ7.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring with ideals `I ⊆ 𝔞`, write
`X = Spec(A)`, `Y = V(I)`, `Z = V(𝔞)`, `U = X ∖ Z`, and let `ℱ` be a coherent `𝒪_U`-module and
`d ≥ 1`. Assume

1. `A` is `I`-adically complete, has a dualizing complex, and `cd(A, I) ≤ d`,
2. the completion `ℱ^∧` of `ℱ` along `I𝒪_U` satisfies the strict `(1, 1 + d)`-inequalities of
   [Stacks, Tag 0EJ3], and
3. `depth(ℱ_x) ≥ 2` for every `x ∈ U` with `\overline{\{x\}} ∩ Y ⊆ Z`.

Then

  `Hom_U(𝒢, ℱ) ⟶ Hom_{Coh(U, I𝒪_U)}(𝒢^∧, ℱ^∧)`

is bijective for every coherent `𝒪_U`-module `𝒢`. The map is the action on morphisms of the
completion functor `Stacks.Algebraization.completionFunctor` of [Stacks, Tag 0880].

The hypotheses are those of [Stacks, Tag 0EJ6] —
`Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_globalToFormalSections_of_satisfiesStrictDepthInequalities` — and
that lemma is what is applied: it gives the theorem on formal functions in degree zero for `ℱ`,
which already forces the conclusion for every coherent `𝒢` by
`Stacks.Algebraization.completionFunctor_map_bijective_of_isIso_globalToFormalSections`. The
source instead applies [Stacks, Tag 0EJ6] to `SheafHom(𝒢, ℱ)`, after a transport of conditions
(2) and (3) to that module whose details it omits; no such transport is needed here.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionFunctor_map_bijective_of_satisfiesStrictDepthInequalities
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A]
    (F : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A)) (hK : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I S.I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing ≤ d)
    (hstrict : SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S
      ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj F) 1 (1 + d))
    (hdepth : FormalSectionsII.DepthTwoOffFormalLocus S.A S.I S.a F.obj)
    (G : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) :
    Function.Bijective ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).map :
      (G ⟶ F) →
        ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj G ⟶
          (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj F))
declarations.comment: Hom_U(G,F) = Hom_{Coh(U,IO_U)}(G^∧,F^∧) for every coherent G, under the strict (1,1+d)-inequalities and depth two off the formal locus; 0EJ6 applied to F itself

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.existsUnique_completionCompatibleIso
declarations.doc:
**The uniqueness half of [Stacks, Tag 0EJ8].** In an algebraization situation, let `(ℱ_n)` be a
coherent `I𝒪_U`-adic system and let `d ≥ 1`. Assume

1. `A` is `I`-adically complete, has a dualizing complex, and `cd(A, I) ≤ d`,
2. `(ℱ_n)` satisfies the strict `(1, 1 + d)`-inequalities of [Stacks, Tag 0EJ3].

Let `𝒢` and `ℋ` be coherent `𝒪_U`-modules with `depth(𝒢_x) ≥ 2` and `depth(ℋ_x) ≥ 2` for every
`x ∈ U` with `closure {x} ∩ Y ⊆ Z`, and let `φ : 𝒢^∧ ≅ (ℱ_n)` and `ψ : ℋ^∧ ≅ (ℱ_n)`. Then there
is a unique isomorphism `e : 𝒢 ≅ ℋ` with `e^∧ ≫ ψ = φ`.

Together with the existence half this is the uniqueness of the algebraization asserted by the
source: condition (2) of the source, that `(ℱ_n)` be the completion of a coherent module, is
witnessed by `φ` (or by `ψ`).
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_completionCompatibleIso
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A]
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A)) (hK : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I S.I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing ≤ d)
    (hstrict : SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S F 1 (1 + d))
    (G H : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (hG : FormalSectionsII.DepthTwoOffFormalLocus S.A S.I S.a G.obj)
    (hH : FormalSectionsII.DepthTwoOffFormalLocus S.A S.I S.a H.obj)
    (φ : (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj G ≅ F)
    (ψ : (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj H ≅ F) :
    ∃! e : G ≅ H,
      (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).map e.hom ≫ ψ.hom = φ.hom
declarations.comment: the uniqueness half: two depth-two algebraizations are isomorphic by a unique isomorphism compatible with the identifications of completions

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_completionIso_depthTwoOffFormalLocus
declarations.doc:
**The existence half of [Stacks, Tag 0EJ8].** In an algebraization situation, let `(ℱ_n)` be a
coherent `I𝒪_U`-adic system and let `d ≥ 1`. Assume

1. `A` is `I`-adically complete, has a dualizing complex, and `cd(A, I) ≤ d`,
2. `(ℱ_n)` is the completion of some coherent `𝒪_U`-module,
3. `(ℱ_n)` satisfies the strict `(1, 1 + d)`-inequalities of [Stacks, Tag 0EJ3].

Then `(ℱ_n)` is the completion of a coherent `𝒪_U`-module `ℋ` with `depth(ℋ_x) ≥ 2` at every
`x ∈ U` whose closure meets `Y` only inside `Z`.

These are the source's three conditions: condition (2) is the hypothesis `halg`, which is the
source's "`(ℱ_n)` is the completion of a coherent module", and the depth-two conclusion is
`Stacks.Algebraization.FormalSectionsII.DepthTwoOffFormalLocus`, the transcription of the
source's condition (3) already used by [Stacks, Tag 0EJ7] and by the uniqueness half.

The proof is the source's: the depth-two locus `T = {x ∈ U : \overline{\{x\}} ∩ Y ⊆ Z}` is
stable under specialization, the depth bound
`Stacks.Algebraization.one_le_depth_stalk_of_isImmediateSpecialization_notMem_depthTwoLocus` is
the source's second paragraph, and the existence half of [Stacks, Tag 0EI3] then extends the
given algebraization `𝒢` to a coherent `ℋ` of depth at least two along `T`, by a morphism which
is an isomorphism on the stalks off `T`. Since `T` misses the support of `I𝒪_U`, that morphism
has an isomorphism for its completion
(`Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_completionFunctor_map_of_isIso_stalkMap_on_support`), so `ℋ` is
again an algebraization of `(ℱ_n)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_completionIso_depthTwoOffFormalLocus
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A]
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A)) (hK : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I S.I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing ≤ d)
    (hstrict : SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S F 1 (1 + d))
    (halg : ∃ G : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf,
      Nonempty ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj G ≅ F)) :
    ∃ H : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf,
      Nonempty ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj H ≅ F) ∧
        FormalSectionsII.DepthTwoOffFormalLocus S.A S.I S.a H.obj
declarations.comment: the existence half: a depth-two algebraization exists

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.existsUnique_depthTwoAlgebraization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ8.** In an algebraization situation, let `(ℱ_n)` be a coherent
`I𝒪_U`-adic system, an object of `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`, and let `d ≥ 1`. Assume

1. `A` is `I`-adically complete, has a dualizing complex, and `cd(A, I) ≤ d`,
2. `(ℱ_n)` is the completion of a coherent `𝒪_U`-module,
3. `(ℱ_n)` satisfies the strict `(1, 1 + d)`-inequalities of [Stacks, Tag 0EJ3].

Then there exists a unique coherent `𝒪_U`-module `ℋ` whose completion is `(ℱ_n)` such that
`depth(ℋ_x) ≥ 2` for every `x ∈ U` with `\overline{\{x\}} ∩ Y ⊆ Z`.

"Unique" is read in the only sense in which a module "whose completion is `(ℱ_n)`" can be
unique: the module comes with an isomorphism `ψ : ℋ^∧ ≅ (ℱ_n)`, and any other coherent `𝒢` of
depth at least two off the formal locus, with any `φ : 𝒢^∧ ≅ (ℱ_n)`, is isomorphic to `ℋ` by a
*unique* isomorphism `e : 𝒢 ≅ ℋ` with `e^∧ ≫ ψ = φ`.

The existence is `Stacks.Algebraization.exists_completionIso_depthTwoOffFormalLocus` (the
source's construction through [Stacks, Tag 0EI3]) and the uniqueness is
`Stacks.Algebraization.existsUnique_completionCompatibleIso` (the source's appeal to the mapping
property of [Stacks, Tag 0EJ7]).
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_depthTwoAlgebraization
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A]
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A)) (hK : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I S.I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing ≤ d)
    (halg : ∃ G : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf,
      Nonempty ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj G ≅ F))
    (hstrict : SatisfiesStrictDepthInequalities S F 1 (1 + d)) :
    ∃ (H : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
      (ψ : (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj H ≅ F),
      FormalSectionsII.DepthTwoOffFormalLocus S.A S.I S.a H.obj ∧
      ∀ (G : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf),
        FormalSectionsII.DepthTwoOffFormalLocus S.A S.I S.a G.obj →
        ∀ φ : (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj G ≅ F,
          ∃! e : G ≅ H,
            (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).map e.hom ≫ ψ.hom = φ.hom
declarations.comment: existence and uniqueness, up to unique isomorphism compatible with the identifications of completions, of the depth-two algebraization

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.extendsToX_of_isLocalRing_of_eq_span_singleton
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ9.** In Situation 0EHC let `(ℱₙ)` be an object of `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`.
Assume (1) `A` is local and `𝔞 = 𝔪` is the maximal ideal, (2) `A` has a dualizing complex,
(3) `I = (f)` is a principal ideal, and (4) `(ℱₙ)` satisfies the `(2, 3)`-inequalities. Then
`(ℱₙ)` extends to `X`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendsToX_of_isLocalRing_of_eq_span_singleton
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsLocalRing S.A]
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S)) (f : S.A)
    (ha : S.a = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.A)
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hI : S.I = Ideal.span {f})
    (hineq : SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3) :
    ExtendsToX S (toKerSystem S F)
declarations.comment: first assertion: (ℱₙ) extends to X

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.essImage_completionFunctor_of_isLocalRing_of_eq_span_singleton
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJ9, in-particular clause.** In the situation of
`Stacks.Algebraization.extendsToX_of_isLocalRing_of_eq_span_singleton`, if moreover `A` is
`I`-adically complete then `(ℱₙ)` is the completion of a coherent `𝒪_U`-module.

The system extends to `X`, and over an `I`-adically complete base an extendable system is the
restriction of a completion on `X`, hence the completion of a module restricted from `X`, hence a
completion on `U` ([Stacks, Tag 0EIL]).
declarations.statement:
public theorem essImage_completionFunctor_of_isLocalRing_of_eq_span_singleton
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsLocalRing S.A] [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A]
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S)) (f : S.A)
    (ha : S.a = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.A)
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hI : S.I = Ideal.span {f})
    (hineq : SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3) :
    (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)).essImage (toKerSystem S F)
declarations.comment: in-particular clause: over an I-adically complete A, (ℱₙ) is the completion of a coherent 𝒪_U-module

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.two_lt_depth_add_dim_of_satisfiesDepthInequalities
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJA.** In Situation 0EHC with `A` local, `𝔞 = 𝔪` and `cd(A, I) = 1`,
if `(ℱ_n)` satisfies the `(2, 3)`-inequalities then `depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) + dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭) > 2`
for every `y ∈ U ∩ Y` with `dim({y}‾) = 1` and every prime `𝔭 ⊆ 𝒪_{X,y}^∧` not containing
`I𝒪_{X,y}^∧`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem two_lt_depth_add_dim_of_satisfiesDepthInequalities
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsLocalRing S.A]
    (ha : S.a = maximalIdeal S.A)
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian S.I) = 1)
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (h : SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3)
    (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y) (hyz : S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z)
    (hdim : Order.height (S.U.ι.base y) = 1)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y))
    (hp : ¬ completedLocalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    enatToEInt (completedStalkDepth (idealOnOpen S) F y p) +
        krullDimToEInt (ringKrullDim (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y ⧸ p.asIdeal)) >
      ((2 : ℤ) : EInt)
declarations.comment: necessity of the depth inequality at the points of U ∩ Y of dimension one

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_two_three_iff_two_lt_depth_add_dim
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0EHC let `(ℱ_n)` be an object of `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`. Assume `A` is local with `𝔞 = 𝔪`,
that `cd(A, I) = 1`, and that `A/I` is catenary. Assume also that, at every point `y'` of `U ∩ Y`
with `dim({y'}‾) = 1`, the completed local ring `𝒪_{X,y'}^∧` is universally catenary and has
Cohen--Macaulay formal fibres. Then `(ℱ_n)` satisfies the `(2, 3)`-inequalities if and only if
`depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) + dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭) > 2` for every `y ∈ U ∩ Y` with `dim({y}‾) = 1` and every
prime `𝔭 ⊆ 𝒪_{X,y}^∧` with `𝔭 ∉ V(I𝒪_{X,y}^∧)`.

Without the catenarity of `A/I` and the hypotheses on the completed stalks the statement is false:
see `Stacks.NonCatenaryExample.not_stacks0EJA`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesDepthInequalities_two_three_iff_two_lt_depth_add_dim
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsLocalRing S.A]
    (ha : S.a = maximalIdeal S.A)
    (hcat : Ring.IsCatenary (S.A ⧸ S.I))
    (hcatStalk : ∀ (y' : S.U.toScheme) (z' : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y' = S.Yι.base z' →
      Order.height (S.U.ι.base y') = 1 →
      Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y'))
    (hCMStalk : ∀ (y' : S.U.toScheme) (z' : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y' = S.Yι.base z' →
      Order.height (S.U.ι.base y') = 1 →
      IsPRing Stacks.AdicCompletionFibre.cohenMacaulayRingMapProperty.{u}
        (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y'))
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian S.I) = 1)
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S)) :
    SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3 ↔
      ∀ (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
        Order.height (S.U.ι.base y) = 1 →
        ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y),
          ¬ completedLocalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y ≤ p.asIdeal →
          ((2 : ℤ) : EInt) <
            enatToEInt (completedStalkDepth (idealOnOpen S) F y p) +
              krullDimToEInt
                (ringKrullDim (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y ⧸ p.asIdeal))
declarations.comment: corrected form: the published statement, at hypotheses (1) and (2) alone, is false, by Stacks.NonCatenaryExample.not_stacks0EJA, an example in which A/I is not catenary; this is the equivalence with A/I catenary and the completed local rings of U at the points of U ∩ Y of dimension one universally catenary with Cohen-Macaulay formal fibres

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_two_three_iff_two_lt_depth_add_dim_of_isDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0EHC let `(ℱ_n)` be an object of `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`. Assume `A` is local with `𝔞 = 𝔪`,
that `A` has a dualizing complex, and that `cd(A, I) = 1`. Then `(ℱ_n)` satisfies the
`(2, 3)`-inequalities if and only if `depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) + dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭) > 2` for every
`y ∈ U ∩ Y` with `dim({y}‾) = 1` and every prime `𝔭 ⊆ 𝒪_{X,y}^∧` with `𝔭 ∉ V(I𝒪_{X,y}^∧)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesDepthInequalities_two_three_iff_two_lt_depth_add_dim_of_isDualizingComplex
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsLocalRing S.A]
    (ha : S.a = maximalIdeal S.A)
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian S.I) = 1)
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S)) :
    SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3 ↔
      ∀ (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
        Order.height (S.U.ι.base y) = 1 →
        ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y),
          ¬ completedLocalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y ≤ p.asIdeal →
          ((2 : ℤ) : EInt) <
            enatToEInt (completedStalkDepth (idealOnOpen S) F y p) +
              krullDimToEInt
                (ringKrullDim (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y ⧸ p.asIdeal))
declarations.comment: corrected form: the published statement, at hypotheses (1) and (2) alone, is false, by Stacks.NonCatenaryExample.not_stacks0EJA, an example in which A/I is not catenary; this is the equivalence for A with a dualizing complex, the standing hypothesis of the neighbouring 0EJ9 and 0EJB

declarations.name: Stacks.NonCatenaryExample.not_stacks0EJA
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EJA is false as published.** There is an algebraization situation (Situation 0EHC)
with `A` Noetherian local, `𝔞 = 𝔪`, `cd(A, I) = 1`, and an object `(ℱₙ)` of `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)` such
that `depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) + dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭) > 2` for every `y ∈ U ∩ Y` with `dim({y}‾) = 1` and every
`𝔭 ∉ V(I𝒪_{X,y}^∧)`, but `(ℱₙ)` does not satisfy the `(2, 3)`-inequalities.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_stacks0EJA :
    ¬ ∀ (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsLocalRing S.A], S.a = maximalIdeal S.A →
      Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I (IsNoetherian.noetherian S.I) = 1 →
      ∀ F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S),
        (SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3 ↔
          ∀ (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
            Order.height (S.U.ι.base y) = 1 →
            ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y),
              ¬ completedLocalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y ≤ p.asIdeal →
              ((2 : ℤ) : EInt) <
                enatToEInt (completedStalkDepth (idealOnOpen S) F y p) +
                  krullDimToEInt
                    (ringKrullDim (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y ⧸ p.asIdeal)))
declarations.comment: refutation of the published 'if' direction: at hypotheses (1) and (2) alone, the depth inequality at the points of U ∩ Y of dimension one does not imply the (2, 3)-inequalities; in the example A/I is not catenary

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_of_finiteLocallyFreeOutside
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0EHC let `(ℱ_n)` be an object of `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`. Assume (1) `A` is local with
`𝔞 = 𝔪`, (2) `A` has a dualizing complex, (3) `cd(A, I) = 1`, (4) for `y ∈ U ∩ Y` the module
`ℱ_y^∧` is finite locally free outside `V(I𝒪_{X,y}^∧)`, and (5) either (a) `X \ Y` is `(S₂)` and
every irreducible component of `X` not contained in `Y` has dimension `≥ 4`, or (b) for every prime
`𝔭 ∉ V(I)` with `V(𝔭) ∩ V(I) ≠ {𝔪}` one has `depth(A_𝔭) + dim(A/𝔭) > 3`. Then `(ℱ_n)`
satisfies the `(2, 3)`-inequalities.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesDepthInequalities_of_finiteLocallyFreeOutside
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsLocalRing S.A]
    (hmax : S.a = maximalIdeal S.A)
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian S.I) = 1)
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (hfree : ∀ (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y),
        ¬ completedLocalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y ≤ p.asIdeal →
        Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
          (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl (completedStalk (idealOnOpen S) F y)))
    (hcondition :
      ((∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S.A, ¬ S.I ≤ p.asIdeal →
          PropertySkRing (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) 2) ∧
        (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S.A, IsMinimalPrime p.asIdeal →
          ¬ S.I ≤ p.asIdeal →
          (4 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (S.A ⧸ p.asIdeal))) ∨
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S.A, ¬ S.I ≤ p.asIdeal →
        ({q : PrimeSpectrum S.A | p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal} ∩
          {q : PrimeSpectrum S.A | S.I ≤ q.asIdeal}) ≠
          {⟨maximalIdeal S.A, (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal S.A).isPrime⟩} →
        (3 : WithBot ℕ∞) <
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
            (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) : WithBot ℕ∞) +
            ringKrullDim (S.A ⧸ p.asIdeal))) :
    SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.essImage_completionFunctor_of_hasSerreCompletedStalkConditions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJC.** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring which has a dualizing
complex and is complete with respect to `f ∈ 𝔪`, let `(ℱₙ)` be an object of `Coh(U, f𝒪_U)` where
`U` is the punctured spectrum of `A`, and set `Y = V(f) ⊆ X = Spec(A)`. If for every
`y ∈ U ∩ V(f)` closed in `U`, i.e. with `dim({y}‾) = 1`, the `𝒪_{X,y}^∧`-module `ℱ_y^∧` satisfies

1. `ℱ_y^∧[1/f]` is `(S₂)` as an `𝒪_{X,y}^∧[1/f]`-module, and
2. `dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭) ≥ 3` for every `𝔭 ∈ Ass(ℱ_y^∧[1/f])`,

then `(ℱₙ)` is the completion of a coherent `𝒪_U`-module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem essImage_completionFunctor_of_hasSerreCompletedStalkConditions
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u}) [IsLocalRing S.A] [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A]
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S)) (f : S.A)
    (ha : S.a = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.A)
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hI : S.I = Ideal.span {f})
    (hserre : ∀ (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
      Order.height (S.U.ι.base y) = 1 → HasSerreCompletedStalkConditions S F f y) :
    (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)).essImage (toKerSystem S F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.finite_completedStalk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EJE, finiteness of the completed stalk.**

Let `ℐ` be a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals on a locally Noetherian scheme `X` and let `(ℱ_n)` be
an object of `Coh(X, ℐ)`. At every point `x` the completed stalk `ℱ_x^∧` is a finite module over
the completed local ring `𝒪_{X,x}^∧`.

Each `ℱ_n` is coherent, so `ℱ_{n,x}` is a finite `𝒪_{X,x}`-module, and the transitions are
surjective on stalks with kernel `ℐ_x^{n+1} ℱ_{n+1,x}`; the limit therefore has reduction
`ℱ_{0,x}` modulo `ℐ_x`, which is finite, and [Stacks, Tag 031D] turns a module with finite
reduction into one whose `ℐ_x`-adic completion is finite over `𝒪_{X,x}^∧`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_completedStalk [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (G : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems J) (x : X) :
    Module.Finite (completedLocalRing J x) (completedStalk J G x)
declarations.comment: finiteness of the completed stalk over the completed local ring

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isDepthOneQuotient_toImprovedSystem_app
declarations.doc:
Each component of the canonical map `(ℱₙ) ⟶ (ℱ'ₙ)` is the depth-one quotient of its source:
`ℱ'ₙ` is coherent, the map is surjective and an isomorphism on stalks outside `T`, and `ℱ'ₙ` has
depth at least one at every point of `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDepthOneQuotient_toImprovedSystem_app (n : ℕᵒᵖ) :
    IsDepthOneQuotient T ((toImprovedSystem T hT F).app n)
declarations.comment: the canonical map (ℱₙ) → (ℱ'ₙ) of inverse systems of coherent modules, and its property (1); properties (2) and (3), which identify (ℱ'ₙ) pro-isomorphically with an object of Coh(X, ℐ), are not covered: they rest on Tag 0EIE, which this library does not carry

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_improving_map_of_coherentAdicSystem
declarations.doc:
A coherent adic system along an ideal sheaf admits a map to an inverse system of coherent
modules each of whose terms is the quotient of the corresponding term by its sections supported
on `T`, hence has depth at least one along `T`.
declarations.comment: the canonical map out of an object of Coh(X, ℐ) and its property (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_proIso_coherentAdicSystem_toImprovedSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJE.** Let `X` be a Noetherian scheme, `ℐ` a quasi-coherent sheaf of
ideals with closed subscheme `Y`, `(ℱ_n)` an object of `Coh(X, ℐ)` and `T ⊆ Y` stable under
specialization. Assume that for `y ∈ T` and every nonmaximal prime `𝔭` of `𝒪_{X,y}^∧` with
`V(𝔭) ∩ V(ℐ𝒪_{X,y}^∧) = {𝔪_y^∧}` the module `(ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭` has positive depth. Then the canonical
map `(ℱ_n) → (ℱ'_n)` onto the quotients by the sections supported in `T`
(`Stacks.Algebraization.toImprovedSystem`, each component the depth-one quotient of Stacks,
Tag 0DX3: `ℱ'_n` coherent, the map surjective and an isomorphism on stalks outside `T`) has the
following properties:

1. every `ℱ'_n` has depth at least one at every point of `T`;
2. `(ℱ'_n)` is isomorphic as a pro-system to an object `(𝒢_n)` of `Coh(X, ℐ)`: there is a
   pro-isomorphism `P` whose forward maps are the components of a morphism
   `ψ : (𝒢_n) → (ℱ'_n)`;
3. the induced morphism `φ : (ℱ_n) → (𝒢_n)` of `Coh(X, ℐ)`, the one with `φ ≫ ψ` the canonical
   map, is an epimorphism of `Coh(X, ℐ)` whose kernel in `Coh(X, ℐ)` is annihilated by a power of
   `ℐ`.

The source also assumes that `X` locally has a dualizing complex; the statement holds without
it.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_proIso_coherentAdicSystem_toImprovedSystem (hTY : T ⊆ I.support)
    (h6 : ∀ y ∈ T, ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing I y),
      p.asIdeal ≠ completedMaximalIdeal I y →
      adicClosedFibreThrough I y p = {completedMaximalIdeal I y} →
      0 < completedStalkDepth I F y p) :
    (∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, IsDepthOneQuotient T ((toImprovedSystem T hT F.obj).app n)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (y : X), y ∈ T →
      letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk y) (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
          ((improvedSystem T hT F.obj).obj (op n)).val.presheaf y) :=
        PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
          (R := X.presheaf) ((improvedSystem T hT F.obj).obj (op n)).val y
      (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk y) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y))
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) ((improvedSystem T hT F.obj).obj (op n)).val.presheaf
          y)) ∧
    ∃ (G : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems I) (φ : F ⟶ G)
      (ψ : G.obj ⟶ improvedSystem T hT F.obj)
      (P : InverseSequence.ProIso G.obj (improvedSystem T hT F.obj)),
      φ.hom ≫ ψ = toImprovedSystem T hT F.obj ∧
      (∀ m, P.φ m = InverseSequence.tr G.obj (P.αle m) ≫ ψ.app (op m)) ∧
      Epi φ ∧
      ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, idealPowerMultiple I c ((kernel φ).obj.obj (op n)) = ⊥
declarations.comment:
the canonical map (ℱₙ) → (ℱ'ₙ) and its properties (1), (2) and (3); stated for every
Noetherian scheme, without the dualizing complex of the source

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.depth_stalk_depthTwoImprovedSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJF, conclusions (1) and (2).** Every term of the depth-two improved
system has depth at least one at each point of `T` and depth at least two at each point of
`T'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem depth_stalk_depthTwoImprovedSystem (S : DepthTwoImprovement T T' hT F)
    (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (x : X) :
    letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (S.term n).val.presheaf x) :=
      PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
        (R := X.presheaf) (S.term n).val x
    (x ∈ T → (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (S.term n).val.presheaf x)) ∧
      (x ∈ T' → (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (S.term n).val.presheaf x))
declarations.comment: conclusions (1) and (2), for T' closed and with the termwise depth-two extensions as data; conclusions (3) and (4) rest on the essential-constancy assertion of Tag 0EIE, which this library carries only as a hypothesis

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_proIso_coherentAdicSystem_canonicalImprovedSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJF.** Let `X` be a Noetherian scheme which locally has a dualizing
complex, `ℐ` a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf with support `Y`, `(ℱₙ)` an object of `Coh(X, ℐ)`,
`T' ⊆ T ⊆ Y` subsets stable under specialization and `d ≥ 0` an integer, such that
* (a) every point has an affine neighbourhood `U` with `cd(Γ(X, U), ℐ(U)) ≤ d`,
* (b) for `y ∈ T` and a nonmaximal prime `𝔭` of `𝒪_{X,y}^∧` with
  `V(𝔭) ∩ V(ℐ_y^∧) = {𝔪_y^∧}`, `depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) > 0`,
* (c) for `y ∈ T'` and a prime `𝔭 ∉ V(ℐ_y^∧)` of `𝒪_{X,y}^∧` with
  `V(𝔭) ∩ V(ℐ_y^∧) ≠ {𝔪_y^∧}`, `depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) ≥ 1` or
  `depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) + dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭) > 1 + d`,
* (d) for `y ∈ T'` and a nonmaximal prime `𝔭` of `𝒪_{X,y}^∧` with
  `V(𝔭) ∩ V(ℐ_y^∧) = {𝔪_y^∧}`, `depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) > 1`,
* (e) if `y ⤳ y'` is an immediate specialization of points of `Y` with `y' ∈ T'`, then `y ∈ T`.

Then the canonical map `(ℱₙ) ⟶ (ℱ''ₙ)` (each component the improvement of `ℱₙ` along `T' ⊆ T`
of [Stacks, Tag 0EI4]) satisfies
1. `depth(ℱ''_{n,y}) ≥ 1` for `y ∈ T`,
2. `depth(ℱ''_{n,y'}) ≥ 2` for `y' ∈ T'`,
3. `(ℱ''ₙ)` is pro-isomorphic to an object `(ℋₙ)` of `Coh(X, ℐ)`,
4. the induced morphism `σ : (ℱₙ) ⟶ (ℋₙ)` of `Coh(X, ℐ)` has kernel and cokernel annihilated by
   a power of `ℐ` (both in `Coh(X, ℐ)` and levelwise).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_proIso_coherentAdicSystem_canonicalImprovedSystem {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] {I : X.IdealSheafData} (hdual : HasDualizingComplexOnAffineCover X)
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems I) {T T' : Set X}
    (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T) (hT' : StableUnderSpecialization T')
    (hTY : T ⊆ I.support) (hTT' : T' ⊆ T) (d : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.affineOpens, x ∈ U.1 ∧
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
      Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U)
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing _) ≤ (d : ℤ))
    (hb : ∀ y ∈ T, ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing I y),
      p.asIdeal ≠ completedMaximalIdeal I y →
      adicClosedFibreThrough I y p = {completedMaximalIdeal I y} →
      0 < completedStalkDepth I F y p)
    (hc : ∀ y ∈ T', ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing I y),
      ¬ completedLocalIdeal I y ≤ p.asIdeal →
      adicClosedFibreThrough I y p ≠ {completedMaximalIdeal I y} →
      1 ≤ completedStalkDepth I F y p ∨
        enatToEInt (completedStalkDepth I F y p) +
            krullDimToEInt (ringKrullDim (completedLocalRing I y ⧸ p.asIdeal)) >
          ((1 + d : ℤ) : EInt))
    (hd : ∀ y ∈ T', ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing I y),
      p.asIdeal ≠ completedMaximalIdeal I y →
      adicClosedFibreThrough I y p = {completedMaximalIdeal I y} →
      1 < completedStalkDepth I F y p)
    (himm : ∀ x x' : X, x ∈ I.support → IsImmediateSpecialization x x' → x' ∈ T' → x ∈ T) :
    (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (x : X),
      letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            ((canonicalImprovedSystem hdual F hT hT' hTY himm).obj n).val.presheaf x) :=
        PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
          (R := X.presheaf) ((canonicalImprovedSystem hdual F hT hT' hTY himm).obj n).val x
      (x ∈ T → (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            ((canonicalImprovedSystem hdual F hT hT' hTY himm).obj n).val.presheaf x)) ∧
        (x ∈ T' → (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            ((canonicalImprovedSystem hdual F hT hT' hTY himm).obj n).val.presheaf x))) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, IsNestedImprovement T T'
      ((toCanonicalImprovedSystem hdual F hT hT' hTY himm).app n)) ∧
    ∃ (H : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems I)
      (e : InverseSequence.ProIso (canonicalImprovedSystem hdual F hT hT' hTY himm) H.obj)
      (σ : F ⟶ H),
      (∀ n : ℕ, (toCanonicalImprovedSystem hdual F hT hT' hTY himm).app (op (e.α n)) ≫ e.φ n =
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (e.αle n)).op ≫ σ.hom.app (op n)) ∧
      (∃ c : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, idealPowerMultiple I c ((kernel σ).obj.obj (op n)) = ⊥) ∧
      (∃ c : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, idealPowerMultiple I c ((cokernel σ).obj.obj (op n)) = ⊥) ∧
      IsKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower I σ.hom

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_proIso_coherentAdicSystem_depthThreeImprovedSystem
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EJG].** Let `A` have a dualizing complex, let `d ≥ cd(A, I)` and let
`(ℱₙ)` in `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)` satisfy the `(2, 2 + d)`-inequalities. Then there is a map
`(ℱₙ) ⟶ (ℱ''ₙ)` of inverse systems of coherent `𝒪_U`-modules with
(1) `depth(ℱ''_{n,y}) + δ^Y_Z(y) ≥ 3` on `U ∩ Y`, (2) `(ℱ''ₙ)` pro-isomorphic to an object
`(ℋₙ)` of `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`, compatibly with the maps from `(ℱₙ)`, (3) the induced morphism
`(ℱₙ) ⟶ (ℋₙ)` with kernel and cokernel annihilated by a power of `I`, both in `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`
and termwise, and (4) `Hᵖ(U, ℱ''ₙ)` a finite `A`-module for `p ≤ 1` and all `n`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_proIso_coherentAdicSystem_depthThreeImprovedSystem
    (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (d : ℤ) (hd : cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing S.I) ≤ d)
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (h : SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 (2 + d)) :
    ∃ (F'' : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ S.U.toScheme.Modules) (τ : F.obj ⟶ F''),
      (∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, (F''.obj n).IsCoherent) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
        (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (S.U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk y)
            (maximalIdeal (S.U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk y)) ((F''.obj n).presheaf.stalk y) +
          S.distanceToZ z) ∧
      (∃ (H : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
        (e : InverseSequence.ProIso F'' H.obj) (σ : F ⟶ H),
        (∀ n : ℕ, τ.app (op (e.α n)) ≫ e.φ n =
          F.obj.map (homOfLE (e.αle n)).op ≫ σ.hom.app (op n)) ∧
        (∃ c : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ,
          idealPowerMultiple (idealOnOpen S) c ((kernel σ).obj.obj (op n)) = ⊥) ∧
        (∃ c : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ,
          idealPowerMultiple (idealOnOpen S) c ((cokernel σ).obj.obj (op n)) = ⊥) ∧
        IsKernelCokernelAnnihilatedByPower (idealOnOpen S) σ.hom) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (p : ℕ), p ≤ 1 →
        Module.Finite S.A ((complementSheafCohomology S.A S.a p).obj (F''.obj n)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.canonicallyExtends_of_cd_one_of_proIso_depthThree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJI.** In Situation 0EHC let `(ℱₙ)` be an object of
`Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`. Assume (1) `A` has a dualizing complex and `cd(A, I) = 1`, and (2) `(ℱₙ)` is
pro-isomorphic to an inverse system `(ℱ''ₙ)` of coherent `𝒪_U`-modules with
`depth(ℱ''_{n,y}) + δ^Y_Z(y) ≥ 3` for all `y ∈ U ∩ Y`. Then `(ℱₙ)` extends canonically to `X`.

A point of `U ∩ Y` is a point `y` of `U` together with a point `z` of `Y` with the same image in
`X`; the depth is that of the stalk over the local ring of `U` at `y`, and `δ^Y_Z` is evaluated
at `z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem canonicallyExtends_of_cd_one_of_proIso_depthThree
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian S.I) = 1)
    (G : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ S.U.toScheme.Modules) [∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, (G.obj n).IsCoherent]
    (e : InverseSequence.ProIso F.obj G)
    (hdepth : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
      3 ≤ depthOfStalkOnOpen S (G.obj (op n)) y + S.distanceToZ z) :
    CanonicallyExtends S F

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.extendsToX_of_cd_one_of_satisfiesDepthInequalities
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJJ (algebraization in cohomological dimension one).** In Situation
0EHC let `(ℱₙ)` be an object of `Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`. Assume (1) `A` has a dualizing complex and
`cd(A, I) = 1`, and (2) `(ℱₙ)` satisfies the `(2, 3)`-inequalities. Then `(ℱₙ)` extends to `X`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendsToX_of_cd_one_of_satisfiesDepthInequalities
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian S.I) = 1)
    (hineq : SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3) :
    ExtendsToX S (toKerSystem S F)
declarations.comment: (ℱₙ) extends to X

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isCompletion_of_cd_one_of_satisfiesDepthInequalities
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EJJ, the final clause.** In the situation of Tag 0EJJ, if moreover `A`
is `I`-adically complete, then `(ℱₙ)` is the completion of a coherent `𝒪_U`-module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCompletion_of_cd_one_of_satisfiesDepthInequalities [IsAdicComplete S.I S.A]
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian S.I) = 1)
    (hineq : SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3) :
    (completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (S.Yι.ker.comap S.U.ι)).essImage (toKerSystem S F)
