declarations.comment: the identification of L = Proj B with the relative spectrum of the nonnegative twist algebra is one over P, as morphisms of schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneRelativeSpecIsoTwistAlgebraViaDirectImage
declarations.doc:
`L ≅ Spec_P(⨁_{m ≥ 0} 𝒪_P(m))` over `P`, as the presentation of the cone as the relative
spectrum of its direct-image algebra `π_* 𝒪_L`
(`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneRelativeSpecIso`) followed by the comparison
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneAlgebraSheafIso` of `π_* 𝒪_L` with the algebra of
nonnegative twists.
declarations.statement:
def coneRelativeSpecIsoTwistAlgebraViaDirectImage :
    Over.mk (pi 𝒜) ≅ Over.mk (relativeSpecToBase (nonnegTwistAlgebraSheaf 𝒜))
declarations.comment: L is, over P, the relative spectrum of the nonnegative twist algebra by the route of the diagram: the presentation of L as the relative spectrum of pi_* O_L composed with the comparison of pi_* O_L with the direct sum of the twists O_P(m) over m at least 0

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneRelativeSpecIsoTwistAlgebraViaDirectImage_eq
declarations.doc:
The identification of `L` with `Spec_P(⨁_{m ≥ 0} 𝒪_P(m))` through `π_* 𝒪_L` is
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneRelativeSpecTwistAlgebraIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem coneRelativeSpecIsoTwistAlgebraViaDirectImage_eq :
    coneRelativeSpecIsoTwistAlgebraViaDirectImage 𝒜 = coneRelativeSpecTwistAlgebraIso 𝒜
declarations.comment: the route through pi_* O_L is the one-step identification of L with the relative spectrum of the nonnegative twist algebra

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.puncturedToConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra_left_eq
declarations.doc:
As a morphism of schemes, `Spec_P(⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_P(m)) ⟶ Spec_P(⨁_{m ≥ 0} 𝒪_P(m))` is the
identification `Spec_P(⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_P(m)) ≅ U`, then the open immersion `U ⟶ L`, then the
identification `L ≅ Spec_P(⨁_{m ≥ 0} 𝒪_P(m))`.
declarations.statement:
theorem puncturedToConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra_left_eq :
    (puncturedToConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra 𝒜).left =
      ((Over.forget (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒜)).mapIso
            (puncturedConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebraIso 𝒜)).inv ≫
        (openUInL 𝒜).ι ≫ (coneProjIsoRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra 𝒜).hom
declarations.comment: the top-left arrow of the diagram, as a morphism of schemes, is the open immersion of the punctured cone in L conjugated by the two relative-spectrum identifications

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.isOpenImmersion_puncturedToConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra_left
declarations.doc:
The morphism `Spec_P(⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_P(m)) ⟶ Spec_P(⨁_{m ≥ 0} 𝒪_P(m))` is an open immersion of
schemes.
declarations.statement:
instance isOpenImmersion_puncturedToConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra_left :
    IsOpenImmersion (puncturedToConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra 𝒜).left
declarations.comment: the top-left arrow of the diagram is an open immersion of schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.opensRange_puncturedToConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra_left
declarations.doc:
Read through the identification of `L = Proj B` with `Spec_P(⨁_{m ≥ 0} 𝒪_P(m))`, the
morphism `Spec_P(⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_P(m)) ⟶ L` has image the punctured cone
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjAndSpecTruncation.openUInL`.
declarations.statement:
theorem opensRange_puncturedToConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra_left :
    ((puncturedToConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra 𝒜).left ≫
        (coneProjIsoRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra 𝒜).inv).opensRange = openUInL 𝒜
declarations.comment: the image in L = Proj B of the top-left arrow of the diagram, read through the identification of L with the relative spectrum, is the open punctured cone

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.puncturedToConeProj
declarations.doc:
The morphism `Spec_P(⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_P(m)) ⟶ L = Proj B` of schemes: the morphism of relative
spectra over `P` read on underlying schemes, followed by the identification
`Spec_P(⨁_{m ≥ 0} 𝒪_P(m)) ≅ Proj B` of
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneProjIsoRelativeSpecTwistAlgebra`.
declarations.comment: the top-left arrow of the diagram as a morphism of schemes whose target is the cone L = Proj B

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.puncturedConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebraIsoOpenUOver
declarations.doc:
The identification `Spec_P(⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_P(m)) ≅ U` as an isomorphism of schemes over
`X = Spec A`, the source lying over `X` by the morphism to `L` followed by `σ : L ⟶ X` and the
target by the inclusion `U ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
def puncturedConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebraIsoOpenUOver :
    Over.mk (puncturedToConeProj 𝒜 ≫ toSpecA 𝒜) ≅ Over.mk (ProjAndSpec.openU 𝒜).ι
declarations.comment: the left square as an isomorphism over X: the left identification of Spec_P of the integer twist algebra with U is an isomorphism of schemes over X, its source lying over X by the top-left arrow followed by L → X

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.puncturedToConeProjOverSpecA
declarations.doc:
The morphism `Spec_P(⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_P(m)) ⟶ L = Proj B` as a morphism of schemes over
`X = Spec A`, the source lying over `X` by the identification with `U` followed by the inclusion
`U ⟶ X` and the cone by `σ : L ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
def puncturedToConeProjOverSpecA :
    Over.mk ((puncturedConeRelativeSpecTwistAlgebraIsoOpenU 𝒜).hom ≫
        (ProjAndSpec.openU 𝒜).ι) ⟶
      Over.mk (toSpecA 𝒜)
declarations.comment: the left square as a morphism over X: the top-left arrow of the diagram is a morphism of schemes over X, its source lying over X by the left identification with U followed by the inclusion of U in X

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coe_associatedModuleSheafStandardOpenEquiv_twistMul
declarations.doc:
The standard-open identification `Γ(D₊(f), 𝒪_P(i)) = (A[1/f])_i` carries the product of two
twists to the product of their fractions.
declarations.statement:
theorem coe_associatedModuleSheafStandardOpenEquiv_twistMul {d : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d)
    (i j : ℤ)
    (x : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 i).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)))
    (y : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 j).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f))) :
    ((associatedModuleSheafStandardOpenEquiv 𝒜 (twistGrading (S := A) 𝒜 (i + j)) hf hd
          (twistMulSection 𝒜 i j (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)) x y) :
        LocalizedModule.Away f A)) =
      (associatedModuleSheafStandardOpenEquiv 𝒜 (twistGrading (S := A) 𝒜 i) hf hd x :
          LocalizedModule.Away f A) *
        (associatedModuleSheafStandardOpenEquiv 𝒜 (twistGrading (S := A) 𝒜 j) hf hd y :
          LocalizedModule.Away f A)
declarations.comment: the standard-open identification of the sections of a twisting sheaf with the degree-zero fractions carries the product of two twists to the product of the fractions

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coe_sectionsTwistEquivAwayGrading_mul
declarations.doc:
The identification of the sections of `𝒪_P(i)` over `D₊(f)` with the degree-`i` part of
`A[1/f]` is multiplicative.
declarations.statement:
theorem coe_sectionsTwistEquivAwayGrading_mul {d : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d) (i j : ℤ)
    (x : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 i).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)))
    (y : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 j).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f))) :
    ((Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.sectionsTwistEquivAwayGrading 𝒜 hf hd (i + j)
          (twistMulSection 𝒜 i j (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)) x y) :
        LocalizedModule.Away f A)) =
      (Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.sectionsTwistEquivAwayGrading 𝒜 hf hd i x :
          LocalizedModule.Away f A) *
        (Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.sectionsTwistEquivAwayGrading 𝒜 hf hd j y :
          LocalizedModule.Away f A)
declarations.comment: the identification of the sections of a twisting sheaf over a standard open with a homogeneous part of the localization is multiplicative

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTwistAwayHom_mul
declarations.doc:
The degreewise inclusion `Γ(D₊(f), 𝒪_P(m)) → (B[1/ψ f])₀` is multiplicative: the product
of a section of `𝒪_P(i)` and one of `𝒪_P(j)` goes to the product of their images.
declarations.statement:
theorem coneTwistAwayHom_mul (d : ℕ) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d) (i j : ℕ)
    (x : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 (i : ℤ)).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)))
    (y : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 (j : ℤ)).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f))) :
    coneTwistAwayHom 𝒜 (i + j) d hf hd
        (natTwistMulSection 𝒜 i j (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)) x y) =
      coneTwistAwayHom 𝒜 i d hf hd x * coneTwistAwayHom 𝒜 j d hf hd y
declarations.comment: the degreewise inclusion of the sections of the twisting sheaves over D+(f) into the degree-zero localization of the truncation algebra is multiplicative

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTwistApp_mul
declarations.doc:
The local degreewise inclusion `Γ(D₊(f), 𝒪_P(m)) ⟶ Γ(D₊(f), π_* 𝒪_L)` is
multiplicative.
declarations.statement:
theorem coneTwistApp_mul (d : ℕ) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d) (i j : ℕ)
    (x : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 (i : ℤ)).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)))
    (y : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 (j : ℤ)).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f))) :
    (show (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading 𝒜)).presheaf.obj
          (op (pi 𝒜 ⁻¹ᵁ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f)) from
        (coneTwistApp 𝒜 (i + j) d hf hd).hom
          (natTwistMulSection 𝒜 i j (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)) x y)) =
      (show (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading 𝒜)).presheaf.obj
            (op (pi 𝒜 ⁻¹ᵁ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f)) from
          (coneTwistApp 𝒜 i d hf hd).hom x) *
        (show (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading 𝒜)).presheaf.obj
            (op (pi 𝒜 ⁻¹ᵁ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f)) from
          (coneTwistApp 𝒜 j d hf hd).hom y)
declarations.comment: the local degreewise inclusion of the sections of O_P(m) into the functions on the cone over D+(f) is multiplicative, for the truncation cone

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneAlgebraSectionsRingEquiv_symm_of
declarations.doc:
The inverse of the ring isomorphism `(π_* 𝒪_L)(D₊(f)) ≃+* ⨁_{m ≥ 0} (A[1/f])_m` sends a
degree-`m` element `y` of `(B[1/ψ f])₀`, placed in the `m`-th summand, to `y` read as a function
on `D₊(ψ f)` by `AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayToSection` and transported along
`π⁻¹(D₊(f)) = D₊(ψ f)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem coneAlgebraSectionsRingEquiv_symm_of (m d : ℕ) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d)
    (y : awayGrading 𝒜 d hf m) :
    (coneAlgebraSectionsRingEquiv 𝒜 d hf hd).symm
        (DirectSum.of (fun k : ℕ => ↥(awayGrading 𝒜 d hf k)) m y) =
      (eqToHom (coneAlgebra_sections_basicOpen 𝒜 d hf hd).symm).hom
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayToSection (grading 𝒜) (psi 𝒜 f)).hom
          (y : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading 𝒜) (psi 𝒜 f)))
declarations.comment: the inverse of the standard-open direct-sum decomposition of the functions on the cone carries the m-th summand to the inclusion of a degree-m fraction

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneAlgebraSectionsEquivTwistSections_symm_of
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of the `m`-th summand of the standard-open decomposition
`Γ(D₊(f), π_* 𝒪_L) = ⨁_{m ≥ 0} Γ(D₊(f), 𝒪_P(m))` is the degreewise inclusion
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTwistApp`.
declarations.statement:
theorem coneAlgebraSectionsEquivTwistSections_symm_of (m d : ℕ) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d)
    (s : (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf 𝒜 (m : ℤ)).val.obj
      (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f))) :
    (coneAlgebraSectionsEquivTwistSections 𝒜 d hf hd).symm (DirectSum.of _ m s) =
      (coneTwistApp 𝒜 m d hf hd).hom s
declarations.comment: the m-th summand of the standard-open direct-sum decomposition of the functions on the cone is the local degreewise inclusion of the sections of O_P(m), for the truncation cone

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTotalMap_mul
declarations.doc: **The map is multiplicative.**
declarations.statement:
theorem coneTotalMap_mul (U : Opens (ProjectiveSpectrum.top 𝒜))
    (z w : (nonnegTwistPresheafAlgebra 𝒜).Total (op U)) :
    coneTotalMap 𝒜 U (z * w) = coneTotalMap 𝒜 U z * coneTotalMap 𝒜 U w
declarations.comment: the comparison from the objectwise direct sum of the homogeneous pieces of the nonnegative twist algebra to the functions on the cone is multiplicative, over every open of P

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTotalRingHom
declarations.doc:
**The degreewise inclusions as a ring homomorphism `Γ(U, ⨁_{m ≥ 0} 𝒪_P(m)) →+* Γ(L, π⁻¹U)`.**
The sections of the ungraded realization of the algebra of nonnegative twists over `U` map to the
functions on the part of the cone lying over `U`, degreewise by the inclusion of the homogeneous
piece.
declarations.statement:
def coneTotalRingHom (U : Opens (ProjectiveSpectrum.top 𝒜)) :
    (nonnegTwistPresheafAlgebra 𝒜).Total (op U) →+* coneSections 𝒜 U
declarations.comment: the degreewise inclusions as a ring homomorphism from the sections of the ungraded realization of the nonnegative twist algebra to the functions on the cone, over every open of P, for the truncation cone

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTotalPresheafHom
declarations.doc:
**The degreewise inclusions as a morphism of presheaves of rings** from the ungraded
realization of the algebra of nonnegative twists into `π_* 𝒪_L`. Over an open of `P` it is the
ring homomorphism `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTotalRingHom`; naturality is the
naturality of `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTwistDirectSumHom`.
declarations.statement:
def coneTotalPresheafHom :
    (nonnegTwistPresheafAlgebra 𝒜).totalPresheaf ⟶ (conePushforwardRingSheaf 𝒜).obj
declarations.comment: the degreewise inclusions as a morphism of presheaves of rings from the ungraded realization of the nonnegative twist algebra to pi_* O_L, for the truncation cone

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneUngradedSheafIso
declarations.doc:
**`π_* 𝒪_L` is the ungraded realization of the algebra of nonnegative twists**, as sheaves of
rings. This is the identification of [Stacks, Tag 0EKG] at the level of sheaves of rings, as
opposed to the identification `coneStructureCoproductIso` of the underlying sheaves of
`𝒪_P`-modules.
declarations.statement:
def coneUngradedSheafIso :
    (nonnegTwistAlgebra 𝒜).ungradedSheaf ≅ conePushforwardRingSheaf 𝒜
declarations.comment: the identification pi_* O_L = the ungraded realization of the nonnegative twist algebra, as sheaves of rings, for the cone of the truncation algebra

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coe_sectionsTwistEquivAwayGrading_one
declarations.doc: **The standard-open identification carries the unit section of `𝒪_P(0)` to `1`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem coe_sectionsTwistEquivAwayGrading_one {d : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ((Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.sectionsTwistEquivAwayGrading 𝒜 hf hd 0
          ((twistOne 𝒜).eval (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f))) :
        LocalizedModule.Away f A)) = 1
declarations.comment: the standard-open identification of the sections of the untwisted sheaf with the degree-zero fractions carries the unit section to 1

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTwistAwayHom_one
declarations.doc: **The degreewise inclusion `Γ(D₊(f), 𝒪_P(0)) → (B[1/ψ f])₀` is unital.**
declarations.statement:
theorem coneTwistAwayHom_one (d : ℕ) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d) :
    coneTwistAwayHom 𝒜 0 d hf hd ((twistOne 𝒜).eval
        (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f))) = 1
declarations.comment: the degreewise inclusion of the sections of the untwisted sheaf over D+(f) into the degree-zero localization of the truncation algebra carries the unit section to 1

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneTwistApp_one
declarations.doc:
**The local degreewise inclusion in degree zero carries the unit section to the function
`1`** on the part of the cone over the standard open.
declarations.statement:
theorem coneTwistApp_one (d : ℕ) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (show coneSections 𝒜 (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f) from
        (coneTwistApp 𝒜 0 d hf hd).hom
          ((twistOne 𝒜).eval (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)))) = 1
declarations.comment: the local degreewise inclusion in degree zero carries the unit section of the untwisted sheaf to the function 1 on the cone, over a standard open

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneIota_one
declarations.doc:
**The inclusion of the degree-zero piece of the algebra of nonnegative twists carries the
unit of that algebra to the function `1`**, over every open of `P`. With
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.coneIota_mul` this exhibits the inclusions as a unital
ring homomorphism out of the ungraded realization of the twist algebra.
declarations.statement:
theorem coneIota_one (U : Opens (ProjectiveSpectrum.top 𝒜)) :
    (show coneSections 𝒜 U from
        (coneIota 𝒜 0).val.app (op U) ((twistOne 𝒜).eval (op U))) = 1
declarations.comment: the inclusion of the degree-zero piece of the nonnegative twist algebra carries the unit of the algebra to the function 1, over every open of P, for the truncation cone

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistAwayPiece.coe_sectionsTwistEquivGradedPiece_mul
declarations.doc:
The identification `Γ(D₊(f), 𝒪_X(n)) ≅ (A_f)_n` is multiplicative: the product of a section
of `𝒪_X(i)` and a section of `𝒪_X(j)` over `D₊(f)`, read in `(A_f)_{i + j}`, is the product in
`A_f` of the two underlying elements.
declarations.statement:
theorem coe_sectionsTwistEquivGradedPiece_mul (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 k) (hk : 0 < k) (i j : ℤ)
    (x : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 i).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)))
    (y : (twistingSheaf 𝒜 j).val.obj (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f))) :
    ((sectionsTwistEquivGradedPiece 𝒜 hf hk (i + j)
          (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.twistMulSection 𝒜 i j
            (op (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒜 f)) x y) :
        LocalizedModule.Away f A))
      = (sectionsTwistEquivGradedPiece 𝒜 hf hk i x : LocalizedModule.Away f A) *
        (sectionsTwistEquivGradedPiece 𝒜 hf hk j y : LocalizedModule.Away f A)
declarations.comment: the description of the sections of a twisting sheaf over a standard open as a homogeneous piece of the graded localization is multiplicative

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.instGradedRingGrading
declarations.doc: `B = ⨁_{d ≥ 0} A_{≥ d}` is a graded ring with degree-`d` part `B_d ≃ A_{≥ d}`.
declarations.statement: instance instGradedRingGrading : GradedRing (grading 𝒜)
declarations.comment: the graded ring B = ⨁_{d ≥ 0} A_{≥ d}

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.sigma
declarations.doc: The ring isomorphism `σ : A ≃+* B_0`, `a ↦ a⁽⁰⁾`.
declarations.statement: def sigma : A ≃+* grading 𝒜 0
declarations.comment: the isomorphism σ : A ≃ B₀

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.psi
declarations.doc: The graded ring map `ψ : A → B` with `ψ(a) = a⁽ᵈ⁾` for `a ∈ A_d`.
declarations.statement: def psi : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ grading 𝒜
declarations.comment: the graded ring map ψ : A → B

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.tau
declarations.doc: The surjective graded ring map `τ : B → A` with `τ(a⁽ᵈ⁾) = a_d`.
declarations.statement: def tau : grading 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒜
declarations.comment: the graded ring map τ : B → A

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.truncationAlgebra
declarations.doc: The graded ring `B = ⨁_{d ≥ 0} A_{≥ d}` with its canonical maps `σ`, `ψ` and `τ`.
declarations.statement: def truncationAlgebra : TruncationAlgebra 𝒜
declarations.comment: the graded ring B and the maps σ, ψ, τ

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.tau_comp_psi
declarations.doc: `τ ∘ ψ = id_A`.
declarations.statement: theorem tau_comp_psi : s.tau.comp s.psi = GradedRingHom.id 𝒜
declarations.comment: τ ∘ ψ = id

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.tau_surjective
declarations.doc: `τ` is surjective.
declarations.statement: theorem tau_surjective : Function.Surjective s.tau
declarations.comment: τ is surjective

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.truncationAlgebra_unique
declarations.doc:
Two truncation algebras are isomorphic by a unique ring isomorphism compatible with the
identifications `A_{≥ d} ≃+ B_d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem truncationAlgebra_unique :
    ∃! e : s.B ≃+* t.B, ∀ (d : ℕ) (a : truncation 𝒜 d),
      e ((s.degreeEquiv d a : s.B)) = ((t.degreeEquiv d a : t.B))
declarations.comment: uniqueness of the graded ring B

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.isInternal_awayGrading
declarations.doc:
`(B_{ψ f})₀ = ⨁_{m ≥ 0} (A_f)_m`: the degree-zero part of the localization of the
truncation algebra at `ψ f` is the internal direct sum of its homogeneous pieces, which the
comparison map identifies with the homogeneous parts of `A_f` in nonnegative degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInternal_awayGrading (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (awayGrading 𝒜 d hf)
declarations.comment: the equality of homogeneous parts (B[1/ψ f])_0 = ⨁_{m ≥ 0} (A[1/f])_m, the ring-theoretic form of the identification of π_* O_L with the sum of the nonnegative twists

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.awayGradingEquivAwayPiece
declarations.doc: The degree-`m` piece of `(B_{ψ f})₀` is the degree-`m` part `(A_f)_m` of `A_f`.
declarations.statement:
def awayGradingEquivAwayPiece (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (m : ℕ) :
    awayGrading 𝒜 d hf m ≃+ awayPiece 𝒜 d hf m
declarations.comment: the degree-m piece of (B[1/ψ f])_0 is (A[1/f])_m

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.puncturedRingEquiv
declarations.doc:
`(B[1/σ f · ψ f])₀ = A[1/f]`: the degree-zero part of the localization of the truncation
algebra at `σ f · ψ f` is the whole localization of `A` at `f`, the comparison map
`a⁽ᵏᵈ⁾ / (σ f · ψ f)ᵏ ↦ a / f ²ᵏ` being a ring isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def puncturedRingEquiv (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading 𝒜) (sigmaMulPsi 𝒜 f) ≃+* Localization.Away f
declarations.comment: the equality of rings (B[1/σ f · ψ f])_0 = A[1/f], the functions on the punctured cone over a standard open D₊(f) of P

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.isInternal_puncturedGrading
declarations.doc:
`(B[1/σ f · ψ f])₀ = ⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} (A[1/f])_m`: the degree-zero part of the localization of the
truncation algebra at `σ f · ψ f` is the internal direct sum of its homogeneous pieces, which the
comparison map identifies with the homogeneous parts of `A[1/f]` in all integer degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInternal_puncturedGrading (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (puncturedGrading 𝒜 d hf)
declarations.comment: the equality of homogeneous parts (B[1/σ f · ψ f])_0 = ⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} (A[1/f])_m, the ring-theoretic form of the identification of the direct image of the structure sheaf of the punctured cone with the sum of all the integral twists

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.puncturedGradingEquivAwayGrading
declarations.doc:
The degree-`m` piece of `(B[1/σ f · ψ f])₀` is the degree-`m` part of `A[1/f]`, for every
integer `m`.
declarations.statement:
def puncturedGradingEquivAwayGrading (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (m : ℤ) :
    puncturedGrading 𝒜 d hf m ≃+ Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.awayGrading 𝒜 hf m
declarations.comment: the degree-m piece of (B[1/σ f · ψ f])_0 is (A[1/f])_m, for every integer m

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.awayGradingEquivSectionsTwist
declarations.doc:
The degree-`m` summand of `(B[1/ψ f])₀` is the module of sections of the twisting sheaf
`𝒪_P(m)` over `D₊(f)`, for `m ≥ 0`.
declarations.comment: the degree-m summand of the functions on the cone over D₊(f) is the module of sections of O_P(m) over D₊(f), for m ≥ 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Truncation.puncturedGradingEquivSectionsTwist
declarations.doc:
The degree-`m` summand of `(B[1/σ f · ψ f])₀` is the module of sections of the twisting
sheaf `𝒪_P(m)` over `D₊(f)`, for every integer `m`.
declarations.comment: the degree-m summand of the functions on the punctured cone over D₊(f) is the module of sections of O_P(m) over D₊(f), for every integer m

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjAndSpec.derivedPushforwardPuncturedConeIsoTruncation
declarations.doc:
**`RΓ(U, 𝓕_U) = ⨁_{m ∈ Z} RΓ(P, 𝓕 ⊗_{𝒪_P} 𝒪_P(m))`.** Let `A` be a nonnegatively graded
ring, `P = Proj A` quasi-compact, `π : L ⟶ P` the cone of the truncation algebra
`B = ⨁_{d ≥ 0} A_{≥ d}` and `U ⊆ L` the punctured cone. For a quasi-coherent `𝒪_P`-module `𝓕`
with pullback `𝓕_U = (π|_U)^*𝓕`, the derived global sections of `𝓕_U` decompose as the direct
sum, over all integers `m`, of the derived global sections of the `m`-th twist of `𝓕`; both sides
are read as derived direct images to `Z = Spec A₀`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardPuncturedConeIsoTruncation
    [CompactSpace (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒜)] (F : (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒜).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (Stacks.Duality.derivedPushforward
          (puncturedConeProj (truncationConeData 𝒜) ≫
            AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (puncturedConePullback (truncationConeData 𝒜) F)) ≅
      ∐ fun m : ℤ => (Stacks.Duality.derivedPushforward
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (twistSheafOfModules 𝒜 F m))
declarations.comment: the direct-sum decomposition, with RΓ read as derived direct image to Spec A₀

declarations.name: Stacks.SectionRingProjIso.projAndSpecDiagram_eq_laurentDiagram_of_isProper
declarations.statement:
theorem projAndSpecDiagram_eq_laurentDiagram_of_isProper :
    IsIso (projHomOfIsAmple L hL) ∧
    (puncturedConeIsoLaurentOfIsProper L hL f).inv ≫ openUInLOverOfIsProper L hL f =
      laurentToNonnegLaurentRelativeSpec L hL ≫ (coneIsoNonnegLaurentOfIsProper L hL f).inv ∧
    (coneIsoNonnegLaurentOfIsProper L hL f).hom.left ≫ (nonnegLaurentRelativeSpecOver L hL).hom =
      pi (grading L) ≫ (projIsoOfIsProper L hL f).inv ∧
    (puncturedConeIsoLaurentOfIsProper L hL f).hom.left ≫ (laurentRelativeSpecOver L hL).hom =
      (openUInL (grading L)).ι ≫ pi (grading L) ≫ (projIsoOfIsProper L hL f).inv ∧
    (laurentToNonnegLaurentRelativeSpec L hL).left ≫ (nonnegLaurentRelativeSpecOver L hL).hom =
      (laurentRelativeSpecOver L hL).hom ∧
    IsOpenImmersion (laurentToNonnegLaurentRelativeSpec L hL).left ∧
    IsIso ((puncturedConeIsoLaurentOfIsProper L hL f).inv.left ≫
      (toSpecA (grading L) ∣_ Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjAndSpec.openU (grading L))) ∧
    (laurentToNonnegLaurentRelativeSpec L hL).left ≫
        (coneIsoNonnegLaurentOfIsProper L hL f).inv.left ≫ toSpecA (grading L) =
      ((puncturedConeIsoLaurentOfIsProper L hL f).inv.left ≫
        (toSpecA (grading L) ∣_ Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjAndSpec.openU (grading L))) ≫
        (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjAndSpec.openU (grading L)).ι ∧
    (nonnegLaurentRelativeSpecOver L hL).hom ≫ (projIsoOfIsProper L hL f).hom ≫
        Proj.toSpecZero (grading L) =
      (coneIsoNonnegLaurentOfIsProper L hL f).inv.left ≫ toSpecA (grading L) ≫
        Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjAndSpec.xToZ (grading L)
declarations.comment: the whole statement: P = Proj A and diagram 0EKG becomes, arrow by arrow, the diagram of the relative spectra over P of the Laurent algebras of the ample module: the open immersion U → L is the morphism induced by the inclusion of algebras, the projections to P are the structure morphisms, and the left and right squares commute

declarations.name: Stacks.SectionRingProjIso.coneIsoNonnegLaurentOfIsProper
declarations.doc:
**The diagram clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EKI], nonnegatively graded entry.** For `P` proper over
a ring `R` and `𝓛` an ample invertible `𝒪_P`-module with section ring `A = Γ_*(P, 𝓛)`, the
nonnegatively graded left-hand entry `L` of [Stacks, Tag 0EKG]'s diagram, read over `P` through
the identification `P = Proj A`, is `Spec_P(⨁_{m ≥ 0} 𝓛^{⊗ m})`.

The structure morphism on the left is the cone projection `π` followed by the inverse of the
canonical morphism `r : P ⟶ Proj A` of [Stacks, Tag 01PZ], which is an isomorphism by
`Stacks.SectionRingProjIso.isIso_projHomOfIsAmple_of_isProper`; that is what makes the base
change in `coneBaseChangeIsoNonnegLaurent` the identity, by
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.OverBaseChange.overPullbackIsoOfIsIso`.
declarations.comment: the diagram clause: the nonnegatively graded left-hand entry L of diagram 0EKG becomes Spec_P of the direct sum of the nonnegative tensor powers of the ample module

declarations.name: Stacks.SectionRingProjIso.puncturedConeIsoLaurentOfIsProper
declarations.doc:
**The diagram clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EKI], integer-graded entry.** For `P` proper over a ring
`R` and `𝓛` an ample invertible `𝒪_P`-module with section ring `A = Γ_*(P, 𝓛)`, the
integer-graded left-hand entry `U` of [Stacks, Tag 0EKG]'s diagram, read over `P` through the
identification `P = Proj A`, is `Spec_P(⨁_{m ∈ ℤ} 𝓛^{⊗ m})`.
declarations.comment: the diagram clause: the integer-graded left-hand entry U of diagram 0EKG becomes Spec_P of the direct sum of all integral tensor powers of the ample module

declarations.name: Stacks.SectionRingProjIso.isIso_projHomOfIsAmple_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
Let `P` be a proper scheme over a ring `R` and `𝓛` an ample invertible `𝒪_P`-module with
graded section ring `A = Γ_*(P, 𝓛)`. Then the canonical morphism `r : P ⟶ Proj A` of
[Stacks, Tag 01PZ] is an isomorphism.
declarations.comment: the identification P = Proj(A), for P proper over R

declarations.name: Stacks.SectionRingProjIso.projIsoOfIsProper
declarations.doc:
The isomorphism `P ≅ Proj Γ_*(P, 𝓛)` whose underlying morphism is the canonical one of
[Stacks, Tag 01PZ], for `P` proper over `R` and `𝓛` ample.
declarations.comment: the identification P = Proj(A) as an isomorphism P ≅ Proj Γ_*(P, 𝓛), for P proper over R

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.gradedGmAction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EKJ.** An integer grading defines the multiplicative-group action
on the spectrum whose coordinate map sends a homogeneous element of degree `n` to `a ⊗ Tⁿ`.
declarations.comment: graded_ring_gm_action

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GmEquivariant.gradedDescentMorphism_homogeneous
declarations.doc:
On the canonical pullback of a homogeneous section of degree `n` along the action, the
descent morphism is multiplication by the character `xⁿ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gradedDescentMorphism_homogeneous {n : ℤ} (m : ℳ n) :
    (gradedDescentMorphism 𝒜 ℳ).app ⊤
        (pullbackSection (gradedGmAction 𝒜).action.smul.left (tilde (moduleOf A M))
          (tilde.toOpen (moduleOf A M) ⊤ (m : M))) =
      laurentCoordinate A n • pullbackSection (snd gm.{u} (specAOver A)).left
        (tilde (moduleOf A M)) (tilde.toOpen (moduleOf A M) ⊤ (m : M))
declarations.comment: the descent morphism on homogeneous sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GmEquivariant.gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a `ℤ`-graded ring and let `X = Spec A` carry the `𝐆ₘ`-action attached to the
grading. A graded `A`-module `M` makes the associated quasi-coherent module `M~` a
`𝐆ₘ`-equivariant quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module, whose descent morphism carries the canonical
pullback of a homogeneous section of degree `n` to `xⁿ` times that section.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf : GradedEquivariantModule.{u} 𝒜
declarations.comment: graded_module_equivariant_sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GmEquivariant.gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf_module
declarations.doc:
The underlying quasi-coherent module of the equivariant module attached to a graded module
is `M~`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf_module :
    underlyingModule 𝒜 (gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf 𝒜 ℳ) = tilde (moduleOf A M)
declarations.comment: underlying module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GmEquivariant.gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf_alpha
declarations.doc:
The descent morphism of the equivariant module attached to a graded module is
`gradedDescentMorphism`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf_alpha :
    descentMorphism 𝒜 (gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf 𝒜 ℳ) = gradedDescentMorphism 𝒜 ℳ
declarations.comment: descent morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.gradingOfGmAction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EKK.** An action of the multiplicative group scheme on
an affine scheme determines an integer grading of its coordinate ring, and is
the action associated to that grading.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradingOfGmAction (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
    [X.Over (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))]
    (action : ModObj
      (multiplicativeGroupULift.asOver (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))))
      (X.asOver (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))))) :
    Σ (𝒜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup Γ(X, ⊤)),
      {graded : GradedRing 𝒜 //
        (letI := action
         letI : X.isoSpec.hom.IsOver (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) :=
           ⟨specULiftZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _⟩
         letI : IsMonHom
             (Iso.refl (multiplicativeGroupULift.asOver (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))))).hom :=
           ⟨by exact Category.comp_id _, by simp⟩
         ModObj.ofIso (Iso.refl (multiplicativeGroupULift.asOver (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))))
           (X.isoSpec.asOver (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))))) =
          (letI := graded; (gradedGmAction 𝒜).action)}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GmEquivariant.homogeneousPartDecomposition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EKL.** The canonical grading of the global sections of a
`𝐆ₘ`-equivariant quasi-coherent module on `Spec A`: the canonical homogeneous pieces decompose
the global sections as an internal direct sum.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def homogeneousPartDecomposition (F : GradedEquivariantModule.{u} 𝒜) :
    DirectSum.Decomposition (homogeneousPart 𝒜 F)
declarations.comment: the canonical grading of the global sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GmEquivariant.tildeHomogeneousIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EKL.** For a `𝐆ₘ`-equivariant quasi-coherent module `F` on
`X = Spec A` and `M = Γ(X, F)` with its canonical grading, the canonical comparison `M~ ⟶ F` is
an isomorphism of `𝐆ₘ`-equivariant modules, the equivariant structure on `M~` being the one
attached to the grading of `M`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def tildeHomogeneousIso :
    gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf 𝒜 (homogeneousPart 𝒜 F) ≅ F
declarations.comment: the comparison is an isomorphism of equivariant modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GmEquivariant.tildeHomogeneousIso_hom_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EKL.** The isomorphism of `𝐆ₘ`-equivariant modules above is the
canonical comparison of a quasi-coherent module on an affine scheme with the module associated to
its global sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem tildeHomogeneousIso_hom_hom :
    @EquivariantModule.Hom.hom _ base.{u} gm.{u} (specAOver A)
        AlgebraicGeometry.instGrpObjSpecAsOverSpec (gradedGmAction 𝒜).action
        (gradedModuleEquivariantSheaf 𝒜 (homogeneousPart 𝒜 F)) F
        (@CategoryTheory.Iso.hom _ _ _ _ (tildeHomogeneousIso 𝒜 F)) =
      Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans.app (underlyingModule 𝒜 F)
declarations.comment: the equivariant isomorphism is the canonical comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GmEquivariant.homogeneousPart
declarations.doc:
The canonical degree-`n` piece of the global sections of a `𝐆ₘ`-equivariant quasi-coherent
module on `Spec A`: the sections on which the descent morphism of the equivariant structure
multiplies the canonical pullback section by the character `x ↦ xⁿ` of `𝐆ₘ`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def homogeneousPart (F : GradedEquivariantModule.{u} 𝒜) (n : ℤ) :
    AddSubgroup ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj (underlyingModule 𝒜 F))
declarations.comment: the canonical homogeneous pieces of the global sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GmEquivariant.gradedSMul_homogeneousPart
declarations.doc:
The canonical homogeneous pieces of the global sections of a `𝐆ₘ`-equivariant quasi-coherent
module on `Spec A` are compatible with the grading of `A`: a homogeneous function of degree `i`
carries the degree-`n` piece into the degree-`i + n` piece.
declarations.statement:
theorem gradedSMul_homogeneousPart (F : GradedEquivariantModule.{u} 𝒜) :
    SetLike.GradedSMul 𝒜 (homogeneousPart 𝒜 F)
declarations.comment: compatibility of the canonical homogeneous pieces with the grading of A

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.HigherComplementTower.bijective_toTowerSections
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `f ∈ 𝔞` be an element of a finitely generated ideal of `A`,
let `M` be a finite `A`-module and let `s ≥ 0`. Assume `A` is `f`-adically complete and `H^k_𝔞(M)`
is annihilated by a power of `f` for `k ≤ s + 1`. Then with `U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞)` the canonical map
`H^i(U, M̃) ⟶ lim_n H^i(U, (M/fⁿM)̃)` is a bijection for every `i < s`.

In degree zero the source is complete by the extension argument of Stacks 0EII; in a positive
degree `i < s` it equals `H^{i+1}_𝔞(M)`, which is killed by a power of `f` because `i + 1 ≤ s + 1`,
and a module killed by a power of `f` is complete. In both cases `H^{i+1}(U, M̃) = H^{i+2}_𝔞(M)` is
killed by a power of `f` because `i + 2 ≤ s + 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_toTowerSections {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {I : Ideal A} (hI : I.FG) {r : ℕ} (fam : Fin r → A)
    (hfam : Ideal.span (Set.range fam) = I) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ I) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    [Module.Finite A M] [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) A] (s : ℕ)
    (hann : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ s + 1 →
      ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ x : localCohomologyModule A I hI M (k : ℤ), f ^ c • x = 0)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < s) :
    Function.Bijective (toTowerSections fam f M (i : ℤ))
declarations.comment: with H^i(U, -) the cohomology of derived sections on U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞) in the Čech model of a finite generating family of 𝔞, and the inverse limit taken as the compatible sequences of the tower of the H^i(U, (M/fⁿM)~)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.quasiAffine_sectionsComplete_implies_amplePower_sectionsComplete
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EKP, (1) implies (2).** On a quasi-affine scheme the structure sheaf is itself an
ample invertible module, and every tensor power of it is again the structure sheaf, so section
completeness on the infinitesimal neighbourhoods transports to all powers.
declarations.statement:
public theorem quasiAffine_sectionsComplete_implies_amplePower_sectionsComplete
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsNoetherian X]
    (hX : Scheme.IsQuasiAffine X)
    (h : IsInfinitesimalSectionsComplete i (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) :
    ∃ (L : X.Modules)
      (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
        (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L),
      letI := hL
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X L ∧
        ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, N ≤ m →
          IsInfinitesimalSectionsComplete i
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Invertible.tensorPower X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
              (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L (m : ℤ))
declarations.comment: (1) implies (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.sectionsComplete_chain
declarations.statement:
public theorem sectionsComplete_chain {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [IsNoetherian X] :
    (SectionsCompleteQuasiAffine i → SectionsCompleteAmplePowers i) ∧
      (SectionsCompleteAmplePowers i → SectionsCompleteFiniteLocallyFree i) ∧
      (SectionsCompleteFiniteLocallyFree i →
        CompletionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree X i.ker) ∧
      (CompletionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree X i.ker →
        SectionsCompleteFiniteLocallyFree i)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.completionFullyFaithful_of_associatedPrimes_of_depth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EKQ.** Let `I ⊆ 𝔞` be ideals of a Noetherian ring `A` and let
`U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞)`. Assume

1. `A` is `I`-adically complete and has a dualizing complex,
2. for every associated prime `𝔭` of `A` with `𝔭 ∉ V(I)` and `V(𝔭) ∩ V(I) ⊄ V(𝔞)`, and every
   `𝔮 ∈ V(𝔭) ∩ V(𝔞)`, one has `dim((A/𝔭)_𝔮) > cd(A, I) + 1`,
3. for every prime `𝔭` with `𝔭 ∉ V(I)` and `V(𝔭) ∩ V(I) ⊆ V(𝔞)`, one has `depth(A_𝔭) ≥ 2`.

Then the completion functor `Coh(𝒪_U) ⟶ Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`, `ℱ ↦ ℱ^∧`, is fully faithful on the full
subcategory of finite locally free objects.

The dimension `dim((A/𝔭)_𝔮)` is written as the Krull dimension of `A_𝔮 / 𝔭 A_𝔮`, which is the
same ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem completionFullyFaithful_of_associatedPrimes_of_depth
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I a : Ideal A) (hIa : I ≤ a)
    (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete I A)
    (hdualizing : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hdim : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, p.asIdeal ∈ associatedPrimes A A → ¬ I ≤ p.asIdeal →
      ¬ (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p.asIdeal : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ⊆
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (a : Set A)) →
      ∀ q ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p.asIdeal : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (a : Set A),
        ((cohomologicalDimension A I I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing + 1 : ℤ) : EInt) <
          krullDimToEInt (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ⧸
            p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))))
    (hdepth : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, ¬ I ≤ p.asIdeal →
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p.asIdeal : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ⊆
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (a : Set A) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
        (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) :
    CompletionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree (complementZeroLocus A a : Scheme)
      (idealSheafNearVanishing A I a)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.completionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EKQ, reduced to the theorem on formal functions in degree zero.** For ideals
`I ⊆ 𝔞` of a Noetherian ring `A` and `U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞)`, completion along `I𝒪_U` is fully
faithful on the finite locally free coherent sheaves on `U` exactly when
`Γ(U, ℋ) ⟶ lim_n Γ(U, ℋ / Iⁿ ℋ)` is an isomorphism for every `ℋ = SheafHom(ℱ, 𝒢)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree_iff
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I a : Ideal A) :
    CompletionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree (complementZeroLocus A a : Scheme)
        (idealSheafNearVanishing A I a) ↔
      ∀ P Q : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules
          (complementZeroLocus A a : Scheme).ringCatSheaf,
        AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} P.obj →
        AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} Q.obj →
        IsIso (globalSectionsToLimit (idealSheafNearVanishing A I a)
          (internalHomCoherent (complementZeroLocus A a : Scheme) P Q))

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.completionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree_of_isAdicComplete_of_depth
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EKT].** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `f ∈ 𝔞 ⊆ A` and let
`U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞)`. Assume

1. `A` has a dualizing complex and is complete with respect to `f`, and
2. `depth(A_𝔭) + dim((A/𝔭)_𝔮) > 2` for every prime `𝔭 ⊆ A` with `f ∉ 𝔭` and every
   `𝔮 ∈ V(𝔭) ∩ V(𝔞)`.

Then the completion functor `Coh(𝒪_U) ⟶ Coh(U, (f)𝒪_U)` is fully faithful on the finite locally
free objects.

Hypothesis (1) is `hdual` together with `hcomplete`. In hypothesis (2), `𝔮 ∈ V(𝔭) ∩ V(𝔞)` is
`𝔞 ≤ 𝔮` and `𝔭 ≤ 𝔮`, `(A/𝔭)_𝔮` is `A_𝔮 / 𝔭A_𝔮`, and the inequality is read in the extended
integers through `enatToEInt` and `krullDimToEInt`, as in
`completionFullyFaithful_of_isAdicComplete_of_depth`. The proof is that theorem — Faltings'
annihilator theorem, Stacks 0EFC, followed by Stacks 0EKS — with the chain (1) ⇒ (4) of
Stacks 0EKP supplied by `completionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree_of_bijective_sectionsToLimit`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree_of_isAdicComplete_of_depth
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (a : Ideal A) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ a)
    (hdual : ∃ omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex omega)
    (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) A)
    (hdepth : ∀ p q : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal → a ≤ q.asIdeal →
      p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal →
      enatToEInt
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl A)) +
        krullDimToEInt
          (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ⧸
            p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))) > ((2 : ℤ) : EInt)) :
    CompletionFullyFaithfulOnFiniteLocallyFree (complementZeroLocus A a : Scheme)
      (complementPrincipalIdealSheaf A a f)

`U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞)`. If `A` has a dualizing complex and is `f`-adically complete, and if
`depth(A_𝔭) + dim((A/𝔭)_𝔮) > 2` for every prime `𝔭` with `f ∉ 𝔭` and every
`𝔮 ∈ V(𝔭) ∩ V(𝔞)`, then the completion functor `Coh(𝒪_U) ⟶ Coh(U, (f)𝒪_U)` is fully faithful
on the full subcategory of finite locally free objects.

    (a : Ideal A) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ a)

    (homega : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega))
    (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) A)
    (hdepth : ∀ p q : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal → a ≤ q.asIdeal →
      p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal →

          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl A)) +
        krullDimToEInt
          (ringKrullDim ((Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ⧸
            p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))) > ((2 : ℤ) : EInt)) :

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.completionFullyFaithful_finiteLocallyFree_on
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EKU.** Let `I ⊆ 𝔞 ⊆ A` be ideals of a Noetherian ring `A`, put
`U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞)` and let `𝒱` be the set of open subschemes of `U` containing `U ∩ V(I)`,
ordered by reverse inclusion. Assume

1. `A` is `I`-adically complete and has a dualizing complex, and
2. for every associated prime `𝔭` of `A` with `I ⊄ 𝔭` and `V(𝔭) ∩ V(I) ⊄ V(𝔞)`, and every
   `𝔮 ∈ V(𝔭) ∩ V(𝔞)`, we have `dim((A/𝔭)_𝔮) > cd(A, I) + 1`.

Then the completion functor `colim_𝒱 Coh(𝒪_V) ⟶ Coh(U, I𝒪_U)` is fully faithful on the full
subcategory of finite locally free objects: for every `V ∈ 𝒱` and all finite locally free coherent
`𝒪_V`-modules `G`, `F`, the map
`colim_{V' ≥ V} Hom_{V'}(G|_{V'}, F|_{V'}) ⟶ Hom_{Coh(V, I𝒪_V)}(G^∧, F^∧)` is bijective.

Two objects of the colimit category given on members `V₁`, `V₂` of `𝒱` are compared on
`V₁ ∩ V₂ ∈ 𝒱`, so "for every `V`" is full faithfulness. The target `Coh(V, I𝒪_V)` is
`Coh(U, I𝒪_U)` on morphisms by `Stacks.Algebraization.bijective_restrictCompletionHom`.
The source's condition (2) on the associated primes of `A` gives condition (2) of Stacks 0EIV for
a finite locally free `F`, whose associated points are associated points of `V`
(`Stacks.Algebraization.associatedPointsClosureDimensionBoundOn_of_isFiniteLocallyFree`); the
finite local freeness of `G` is not needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem completionFullyFaithful_finiteLocallyFree_on (hIa : I ≤ a)
    (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete I A)
    (hdualizing : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hdim : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, IsAssociatedPrimeStacks A A p.asIdeal →
      ¬ I ≤ p.asIdeal →
      (∃ y : PrimeSpectrum A, p.asIdeal ≤ y.asIdeal ∧ I ≤ y.asIdeal ∧ ¬ a ≤ y.asIdeal) →
      ∀ z : PrimeSpectrum A, p.asIdeal ≤ z.asIdeal → a ≤ z.asIdeal →
        ((cohomologicalDimension A I I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing + 1 : ℤ) : EInt) <
          krullDimToEInt (closureLocalDimension A p z))
    (V : OpensNearVanishing A I a)
    (G F : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules V.openSet.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (_hG : Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree G.obj)
    (hF : Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree F.obj) :
    Function.Bijective (nbhdHomComparisonOn V G F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.completionFullyFaithfulComplete_principal
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EKV].** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `f ∈ 𝔞 ⊆ A`, put
`U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔞)` and let `𝒱` be the open subschemes of `U` containing `U ∩ V(f)`, ordered by
reverse inclusion. Assume

1. `A` is complete with respect to the `f`-adic topology,
2. `f` is a nonzerodivisor, and
3. `H¹_𝔞(A/fA)` is a finite `A`-module.

Then the completion functor `colim_𝒱 Coh(𝒪_V) ⟶ Coh(U, f𝒪_U)`, `ℱ ↦ ℱ^∧`, is fully faithful on
the full subcategory of finite locally free objects.

An object of `colim_𝒱 Coh(𝒪_V)` is a coherent module on *some* `V ∈ 𝒱`, and a morphism between
two of them is an element of `colim_{W ⊆ V} Hom_{𝒪_W}(𝒢|_W, ℱ|_W)`; so the conclusion is
`Stacks.Algebraization.NeighbourhoodCompletion.CompletionFullyFaithfulComplete`, which quantifies
over every `V ∈ 𝒱` and all finite locally free `𝒪_V`-modules `𝒢`, `ℱ`, and asserts that
`colim_{W ⊆ V} Hom_{𝒪_W}(𝒢|_W, ℱ|_W) ⟶ lim_n Hom_{𝒪_{Y_n}}(𝒢|_{Y_n}, ℱ|_{Y_n})` is bijective.
The quantifier here is the tag's own — an arbitrary member `V` of `𝒱`, not the single member
`V = U` — which matters because a finite locally free module on a small `V` need not extend to
`U`. That is full faithfulness: an object of `Coh(U, f𝒪_U)` is an inverse system of coherent
modules,
`𝒢^∧` is the system `(𝒢|_{Y_n})` of restrictions to the infinitesimal neighbourhoods of
`U ∩ V(f)`, and a morphism `𝒢^∧ ⟶ ℱ^∧` is a compatible family of morphisms of the restrictions.

The source's proof is two citations: by [Stacks, Tag 0EK2] it suffices that
`colim_𝒱 Γ(V, 𝒪_V) = lim_n Γ(U, 𝒪_U / fⁿ 𝒪_U)`, which is [Stacks, Tag 0EIH] at the module `A`.
Both are available: the equality is `Stacks.Algebraization.isQuasiAffineComplete_principal`,
condition (1) of [Stacks, Tag 0EK2], and the chain (1) ⇒ (2) ⇒ (3) ⇒ (4) is
`Stacks.Algebraization.NeighbourhoodCompletion.implications_among_conditions`. No step of the
argument needs the pair `𝒢`, `ℱ` to extend from `V` to `U`: the implication (2) ⇒ (3) embeds a
finite locally free module on `V` into a finite direct sum of restrictions to `V` of high twists
of the ample module `𝒪_U`, which is what carries the comparison from `U` down to `V`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionFullyFaithfulComplete_principal (hf : f ∈ a)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) A] (hnzd : f ∈ nonZeroDivisors A)
    (hH1 : Module.Finite A
      (localCohomologyModule A a (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing a)
        (Quot f (ModuleCat.of A A) 1) 1)) :
    NeighbourhoodCompletion.CompletionFullyFaithfulComplete (principalFormalLocusι A a f)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.satisfiesDepthInequalities_two_three_iff
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0EHC let `(ℱ_n)` be an object of
`Coh(U, I𝒪_U)`. If `cd(A, I) = 1`, then `(ℱ_n)` satisfies the `(2, 3)`-inequalities if and only
if `depth((ℱ_y^∧)_𝔭) + dim(𝒪_{X,y}^∧/𝔭) + δ^Y_Z(y) > 3` for all `y ∈ U ∩ Y` and all primes
`𝔭 ⊆ 𝒪_{X,y}^∧` with `𝔭 ∉ V(I𝒪_{X,y}^∧)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesDepthInequalities_two_three_iff (S : AlgebraizationSituation.{u})
    (F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S))
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension S.A S.I
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian S.I) = 1) :
    SatisfiesDepthInequalities S F 2 3 ↔
      ∀ (y : S.U.toScheme) (z : S.Y), S.U.ι.base y = S.Yι.base z →
        ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (completedLocalRing (idealOnOpen S) y),
          ¬ completedLocalIdeal (idealOnOpen S) y ≤ p.asIdeal →
          depthAddDimAddDistance S F y z p > ((3 : ℤ) : EInt)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.completionEquivalence_local_principal_finiteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EKY].** In Situation 0EHC assume

1. `A` has a dualizing complex and is `I`-adically complete,
2. `I = (f)` is generated by a single element,
3. `A` is local with maximal ideal `𝔞 = 𝔪`,
4. one of the following is true
   * (a) `A_f` is `(S₂)` and for `𝔭 ⊂ A` minimal with `f ∉ 𝔭` we have `dim(A/𝔭) ≥ 4`, or
   * (b) if `𝔭 ∉ V(f)` and `V(𝔭) ∩ V(f) ≠ {𝔪}`, then `depth(A_𝔭) + dim(A/𝔭) > 3`.

Then with `U₀ = U ∩ V(f)` the completion functor
`colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U open} Coh(𝒪_{U'}) ⟶ Coh(U, f𝒪_U)` is an equivalence on the full
subcategories of finite locally free objects. As for [Stacks, Tag 0EKZ]
(`Stacks.Algebraization.completionEquivalence_principal_finiteLocallyFree`), this is three
statements, and they are the three conjuncts below:

1. the functor carries a finite locally free coherent module on an open neighbourhood `V` of `U₀`
   inside `U` to a finite locally free object of `Coh(V, f𝒪_V)`. At the member `V = U` the
   stalkwise form of that conclusion holds too;
2. it is fully faithful there: for every open neighbourhood `V` of `U₀` inside `U` and all
   finite locally free `𝒪_V`-modules `𝒢`, `ℱ` the canonical map
   `colim_{V' ⊆ V} Hom_{V'}(𝒢|_{V'}, ℱ|_{V'}) ⟶ Hom_{Coh(V, f𝒪_V)}(𝒢^∧, ℱ^∧)` is bijective;
3. it is essentially surjective onto them: every finite locally free object of `Coh(U, f𝒪_U)` is
   the completion of a finite locally free coherent module on some open neighbourhood of `U₀`
   inside `U`.

An object of `colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U} Coh(𝒪_{U'})` is a coherent module on one of the
neighbourhoods, so the first two conjuncts quantify over a neighbourhood. Two objects given on
`V₁` and `V₂` are compared on `V₁ ∩ V₂`, which is again a neighbourhood. The target of the second
conjunct is `Coh(U, f𝒪_U)` on morphisms (`Stacks.Algebraization.bijective_restrictCompletionHom`).
A finite locally free object is one whose `n`-th term is a finite locally free
`𝒪/fⁿ⁺¹𝒪`-module: in the first conjunct this is `Stacks.Algebraization.IsFiniteLocallyFreeAdic`,
and in the third its stalkwise content `Stacks.Algebraization.HasFiniteFreeStalks`, which the first
conjunct also delivers. So the conjuncts compose into the equivalence.

Hypothesis (4a) reads "`A_f` is `(S₂)`" as `PropertySkRing (Localization.Away f) 2`, Serre's
condition of [Stacks, Tag 031P] for the ring `A_f`. In (4b), `V(f)` is the set of primes
containing `f`.

The source's proof: full faithfulness is [Stacks, Tag 0EKU]
(`completionFullyFaithful_finiteLocallyFree_of_isLocalRing_of_eq_span_singleton`). Essential
surjectivity is [Stacks, Tag 0EJ9] fed by [Stacks, Tag 0EJB], followed by the passage to the locus
where the module is free
(`isCompletionNearClosedFiniteLocallyFree_of_isLocalRing_of_eq_span_singleton`).
declarations.statement:
theorem completionEquivalence_local_principal_finiteLocallyFree
    [IsLocalRing S.A] {f : S.A} [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} S.A)]
    (hdual : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} S.A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K)
    (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete S.I S.A)
    (hI : S.I = Ideal.span {f})
    (hmax : S.a = maximalIdeal S.A)
    (hcond :
      (PropertySkRing (Localization.Away f) 2 ∧
        ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S.A, IsMinimalPrime p.asIdeal → f ∉ p.asIdeal →
          (4 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (S.A ⧸ p.asIdeal)) ∨
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S.A, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
        ({q : PrimeSpectrum S.A | p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal} ∩
          {q : PrimeSpectrum S.A | f ∈ q.asIdeal}) ≠
          {⟨maximalIdeal S.A, (maximalIdeal.isMaximal S.A).isPrime⟩} →
        (3 : WithBot ℕ∞) <
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
            (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) : WithBot ℕ∞) +
            ringKrullDim (S.A ⧸ p.asIdeal))) :
    ((∀ (V : S.U.toScheme.Opens),
          (S.U.ι.base ⁻¹' Set.range S.Yι.base) ⊆ (V : Set S.U.toScheme) →
          ∀ G : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf,
            AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree G.obj →
            IsFiniteLocallyFreeAdic ((idealOnOpen S).comap V.ι)
              ((completionFunctor V.toScheme ((idealOnOpen S).comap V.ι)).obj G)) ∧
        ∀ G : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf,
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree G.obj →
          HasFiniteFreeStalks S ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj G)) ∧
      (∀ (V : OpensNearVanishing S.A S.I S.a)
        (G F : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules V.openSet.toScheme.ringCatSheaf),
        Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree G.obj → Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree F.obj →
          Function.Bijective (nbhdHomComparisonOn V G F)) ∧
      (∀ F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S),
        HasFiniteFreeStalks S F → IsCompletionNearClosedFiniteLocallyFree S F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.completionEquivalence_principal_finiteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EKZ].** Let `S` be the standing situation of [Stacks, Tag 0EHC] and write
`U₀ = U ∩ V(f)`. Assume

1. `I = (f)` is a principal ideal,
2. `A` is complete with respect to the `f`-adic topology,
3. `f` is a nonzerodivisor of `A`, and
4. `H¹_𝔞(A/fA)` and `H²_𝔞(A/fA)` are finite `A`-modules.

Then the completion functor `colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U} Coh(𝒪_{U'}) ⟶ Coh(U, f𝒪_U)` restricts to an
equivalence on the full subcategories of finite locally free objects. Elementwise this is three
statements, and they are the three conjuncts below:

1. the functor carries a finite locally free coherent module on an open neighbourhood `V` of
   `U₀` inside `U` to a finite locally free object of `Coh(V, f𝒪_V)`, and — at the member
   `V = U` of `𝒱` — the stalkwise form of that conclusion;
2. it is fully faithful there: for every open neighbourhood `V` of `U₀` inside `U` and all finite
   locally free `𝒪_V`-modules `𝒢`, `ℱ` the canonical map
   `colim_{U₀ ⊆ W ⊆ V} Hom_{W}(𝒢|_{W}, ℱ|_{W}) ⟶ Hom_{Coh(U, f𝒪_U)}(𝒢^∧, ℱ^∧)` is bijective;
3. it is essentially surjective onto them: every finite locally free object of `Coh(U, f𝒪_U)` is
   the completion of a finite locally free coherent module on some open neighbourhood of `U₀`
   inside `U`.

The objects of `colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U} Coh(𝒪_{U'})` are the coherent modules on the individual
neighbourhoods, so the second conjunct quantifies over a neighbourhood `V` and a pair of finite
locally free modules on it, and renders `Hom_{Coh(U, f𝒪_U)}(𝒢^∧, ℱ^∧)` as the inverse limit of
the morphisms `𝒢|_{U₀,n} ⟶ ℱ|_{U₀,n}` over the infinitesimal neighbourhoods of `U₀`, which is
what a morphism of the two inverse systems `𝒢^∧`, `ℱ^∧` is. That is
`Stacks.Algebraization.NeighbourhoodCompletion.CompletionFullyFaithfulComplete`.

A *finite locally free object* of `Coh(V, ℐ)` is, by the source's own definition, one whose
`n`-th term is a finite locally free `𝒪_V/ℐ^{n+1}`-module. A term of a coherent adic system is
annihilated by `ℐ^{n+1}`, so over `𝒪_V` itself the only finite locally free such term is zero;
the condition has to be read over the closed subscheme cut out by `ℐ^{n+1}`, and that is
`Stacks.Algebraization.IsFiniteLocallyFreeAdic` — the `n`-th term is the direct image of a
finite locally free module on that subscheme. This is the form the first conjunct takes, for a
module defined on an arbitrary member `V` of `𝒱`, the objects of `colim_𝒱 Coh(𝒪_V)` being the
coherent modules on the individual neighbourhoods. Its second half is the same conclusion read
at the stalks at the member `V = U`, namely `Stacks.Algebraization.HasFiniteFreeStalks`; that is
the hypothesis the third conjunct consumes, so the two halves together let the three conjuncts
compose into the equivalence. The quantification is not vacuous: `V = ⊤` is a member of `𝒱`.

The source's proof is two citations: full faithfulness is [Stacks, Tag 0EKV], which is
`Stacks.Algebraization.completionFullyFaithfulComplete_principal`, and essential
surjectivity is [Stacks, Tag 0DXW], which is
`Stacks.Algebraization.canonicallyExtends_and_isCompletion_of_principal`. The first conjunct is
the statement that the functor lands in the finite locally free objects, by
`Stacks.Algebraization.isFiniteLocallyFreeAdic_completion` and
`Stacks.Algebraization.hasFiniteFreeStalks_completionFunctor_of_isFiniteLocallyFree`, and the
finite local freeness of the module produced in the third is obtained by shrinking the
neighbourhood to the locus where it is free.
declarations.statement:
theorem completionEquivalence_principal_finiteLocallyFree {f : S.A}
    (hI : S.I = Ideal.span {f}) (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) S.A)
    (hnzd : f ∈ nonZeroDivisors S.A)
    (hH1 : Module.Finite S.A (specialFibreLocalCohomology S f 1))
    (hH2 : Module.Finite S.A (specialFibreLocalCohomology S f 2)) :
    ((∀ (V : S.U.toScheme.Opens),
          (S.U.ι.base ⁻¹' Set.range S.Yι.base) ⊆ (V : Set S.U.toScheme) →
          ∀ G : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf,
            AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree G.obj →
            IsFiniteLocallyFreeAdic ((idealOnOpen S).comap V.ι)
              ((completionFunctor V.toScheme ((idealOnOpen S).comap V.ι)).obj G)) ∧
        ∀ G : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules S.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf,
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree G.obj →
          HasFiniteFreeStalks S ((completionFunctor S.U.toScheme (idealOnOpen S)).obj G)) ∧
      NeighbourhoodCompletion.CompletionFullyFaithfulComplete
        (principalFormalLocusι S.A S.a f) ∧
      (∀ F : Stacks.Coherent.CoherentAdicSystems (idealOnOpen S),
        HasFiniteFreeStalks S F → IsCompletionNearClosedFiniteLocallyFree S F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isCompletionNearClosed_of_principal_shortExactSequences
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EKZ, the essential-surjectivity half.** Let `S` be an algebraization
situation whose ideal `I` is generated by `f ∈ A`, let `A` be `f`-adically complete, and let
`(F_n)` be a coherent `I`-adic system on the open complement `U`. If the system has the short
exact sequences `0 → F_n → F_{n+1} → F_1 → 0` of the proof of Stacks 0DXW and if `H⁰(U, F_1)` and
`H¹(U, F_1)` are finite `A`-modules, then `(F_n)` is the completion of a coherent module on an
open neighbourhood of `U ∩ V(f)` inside `U`: it lies in the image of the completion functor
`colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U} Coh(𝒪_{U'}) ⟶ Coh(U, f𝒪_U)` of Stacks 0EKZ.

The system extends canonically to `X` by Stacks 0DXW, and part (2) of Stacks 0EIR turns that into
extendability. Adic completeness then runs the chain of Stacks 0EIL: an extendable system is the
restriction of a completion on `X`, hence the completion of a module restricted from `X`, hence a
completion on `U`, hence a completion near the closed subscheme.

Two properties of the system are asked for in place of conditions (2) and (3) of Stacks 0DXW,
being what its proof draws from them, exactly as in
`Stacks.Algebraization.canonicallyExtends_of_principal_shortExactSequences`. The
full-faithfulness half of Stacks 0EKZ is Stacks 0EKV, and the module produced here is coherent,
with finite local freeness not among the conclusions.

Stacks 0EKZ itself, with the source's own hypotheses and all of its content, is
`Stacks.Algebraization.completionEquivalence_principal_finiteLocallyFree`, which derives the two
hypotheses below from them and produces a finite locally free module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCompletionNearClosed_of_principal_shortExactSequences (f : S.A)
    (hI : S.I = Ideal.span {f}) (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) S.A)
    (h : HasPrincipalShortExactSequences S F f)
    (h0 : Module.Finite S.A ((globalSectionsSystem S F).obj (op 0)))
    (h1 : Module.Finite S.A ((openCohomologyFunctor S 1).obj (systemObj S F 0))) :
    IsCompletionNearClosed S (kerComapSystem S F)
declarations.comment: the essential-surjectivity half: over an f-adically complete A, a coherent I-adic system on U which has the short exact sequences 0 → Fₙ → F₍ₙ₊₁₎ → F₁ → 0 of the proof of Stacks 0DXW and whose H⁰(U, F₁) and H¹(U, F₁) are finite is the completion of a coherent module on an open neighbourhood of U ∩ V(f) in U, i.e. lies in the image of the colimit functor of this tag. Those two properties of the system are what the proof of Stacks 0DXW draws from its conditions (2) and (3), and they are what is asked for here in their place. This declaration does not cover full faithfulness, which is Stacks 0EKV; and finite local freeness of the module produced, and so its invertibility, is not among its conclusions, which give coherence alone — all that the final clause of Stacks 0DXW gives as well

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0EL1.** Let `k` be a field, `P` a proper scheme over `k`, `𝓛` an ample invertible
`𝒪_P`-module, `s ∈ Γ(P, 𝓛)` with zero scheme `Q` and `𝓕` a coherent `𝒪_P`-module. If
`depth(𝓕_p) + dim({p}‾) > σ` at every `p ∈ P ∖ Q`, then the comparison map
`Hⁱ(P, 𝓕) → lim Hⁱ(Qₙ, 𝓕ₙ)` is an isomorphism for `0 ≤ i < σ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_of_isProper (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (π : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper π] (L : X.Modules) [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X L]
    (hL : Stacks.Ample.IsAmple X L) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] (σ : ℤ)
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ ((zeroScheme X L s).support : Set X) →
      enatToEInt (sheafDepthAt F x) + krullDimToEInt (dimClosureAt X x) > (σ : EInt))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : (i : ℤ) < σ) :
    haveI : F.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_of_isCoherent F
    IsIso (zeroSchemeComparison X L s F i)
declarations.comment: The tower Qₙ is indexed from n = 0 and Qₙ is cut out by the n-th power of the ideal sheaf of Q = Z(s), which is the ideal sheaf of Z(sⁿ); the zeroth term is empty and does not change the limit. Depth and dimension are compared in the extended integers.

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_of_depthAddDim_gt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EL1 (Proposition 52.28.1).** Let `P` be a scheme, `L` an invertible
`𝒪_P`-module, `s` a global section of `L` with zero scheme `Q`, let `Qₙ` be the `n`-th
infinitesimal neighbourhood of `Q` in `P`, let `𝓕` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_P`-module with
restrictions `𝓕ₙ` to `Qₙ`, and let `σ` be an integer with

`depth(𝓕_p) + dim({p}‾) > σ`

at every point `p` of `P` outside `Q`. Then `Hⁱ(P, 𝓕) ⟶ lim Hⁱ(Qₙ, 𝓕ₙ)` is an isomorphism for
every `0 ≤ i < σ`.

The depth–dimension hypothesis is `hdepth` and it is the hypothesis of the tag, read with the
depth of a module at a point of [Stacks, Tag 0341] part (1) and the dimension of the closure of
a point. Three inputs are carried; see the module documentation for why each is
unavailable.

* `hsplit`, with `hproj`: the fibre dichotomy of the punctured cone `π|_U`, which rests on
  `π|_U` being smooth of relative dimension one. This is what transports `hdepth` from `P` to
  `Spec A`, and `hproj` says that the primes of `A` outside `V(I)` lie over `P ∖ Q`.
* the section ring data `A`, `I`, `fam`, `f` and `M`, with `A` a Noetherian `k`-algebra of
  finite type which is `f`-adically complete and `M` finite: clause (1) of [Stacks, Tag 0B5T] is
  not in this library, so the finite generation of the section ring cannot be produced here.
* `halg`: the algebraization square identifying the geometric comparison map with the one of
  [Stacks, Tag 0EKM].
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_of_depthAddDim_gt
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules)
    [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X L] (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (σ : ℕ)
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ ((zeroScheme X L s).support : Set X) →
      enatToEInt (sheafDepthAt F x) + krullDimToEInt (dimClosureAt X x) > ((σ : ℤ) : EInt))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) {r : ℕ} (fam : Fin r → A)
    (hfam : Ideal.span (Set.range fam) = I) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ I)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) A]
    (proj : PrimeSpectrum A → X)
    (hproj : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
      proj p ∉ ((zeroScheme X L s).support : Set X))
    (hsplit : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
      ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum A, q ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) →
      p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal →
      (localizedDepth A M p = sheafDepthAt F (proj p) ∧
          relativeDimAt A p q = dimClosureAt X (proj p) + 1) ∨
        (localizedDepth A M p = sheafDepthAt F (proj p) + 1 ∧
          relativeDimAt A p q = dimClosureAt X (proj p)))
    (halg : ∀ i : ℕ, i < σ →
      ∃ (e₁ : Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ i F ≃+
          (complementCohomologyFunctor fam (i : ℤ)).obj (ModuleCat.of A M))
        (e₂ : ↥(limit (IdealTower.cohomologyTower (zeroSchemeTowerIdeal X L s)
            (zeroSchemeTowerIdeal_succ_le X L s) F i)) ≃+
          ↥(Stacks.ProZero.towerSections
            (HigherComplementTower.quotientCohomologyTower fam f (ModuleCat.of A M) (i : ℤ))
            (HigherComplementTower.quotientCohomologyTransition fam f (ModuleCat.of A M)
              (i : ℤ)))),
          ∀ x : Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ i F,
            e₂ (zeroSchemeComparison X L s F i x) =
              HigherComplementTower.toTowerSections fam f (ModuleCat.of A M) (i : ℤ) (e₁ x))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < σ) :
    IsIso (zeroSchemeComparison X L s F i)
declarations.comment: H^i(P,F) -> lim H^i(Q_n,F_n) is an isomorphism for i < sigma, from depth(F_p) + dim(closure{p}) > sigma off the zero scheme of s; carried: the punctured-cone fibre dichotomy (hsplit, hproj), the section ring data A, I, fam, f, M (clause (1) of 0B5T, hence 02O5/02O6, is absent from this library), and the algebraization square halg identifying the comparison map with that of 0EKM via 0EKH

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_openNeighbourhoodComparison_of_depthAddDim_gt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EL2 (Lemma 52.28.2).** Let `k` be a field, `X` a scheme proper over
`k`, `L` an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module, `s` a global section of `L`, `Y = Z(s)` its zero
scheme with `n`-th infinitesimal neighbourhood `Yₙ = Z(sⁿ)`, and `𝓕` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module
with

`depth(𝓕_x) + dim({x}‾) > 1`

at every `x ∈ X ∖ Y`. Then `Γ(V, 𝓕) ⟶ lim Γ(Yₙ, 𝓕ₙ)` is an isomorphism for every open subscheme
`V ⊆ X` containing `Y`.

The displayed hypothesis is the hypothesis of [Stacks, Tag 0EL1] at `σ = 1`, and the conclusion
for `V = X` is that tag in degree `i = 0 < 1`. The map on `V` is `c`, characterized — uniquely,
restriction being bijective — by its composite with restriction from `X` being the comparison
map of [Stacks, Tag 0EL1].

Two things are carried: the input `hin` of [Stacks, Tag 0EL1], and the bijectivity of
`Γ(X, 𝓕) ⟶ Γ(V, 𝓕)`, which is the field
`Stacks.Algebraization.OpenNeighbourhoodSections.isIso_Hrestrict` and is the whole content of
this lemma beyond the proposition; see that structure for the source's argument and for the two
library gaps it runs through.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_openNeighbourhoodComparison_of_depthAddDim_gt
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (fX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [IsProper fX]
    {L : X.Modules} [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X L] (hL : Stacks.Ample.IsAmple X L)
    {s : Γ(L, ⊤)} {F : X.Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ ((zeroScheme X L s).support : Set X) →
      enatToEInt (sheafDepthAt F x) + krullDimToEInt (dimClosureAt X x) > ((1 : ℤ) : EInt))
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    {I : Ideal A} {r : ℕ} {fam : Fin r → A} {f : A} [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) A]
    {proj : PrimeSpectrum A → X}
    (hin : ZeroSchemeAlgebraizationInput k X L s F 1 A M I fam f proj)
    {V : X.Opens} (hV : OpenNeighbourhoodSections k fX L hL s F V)
    (c : Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf V 0 F ⟶
      limit (IdealTower.cohomologyTower (zeroSchemeTowerIdeal X L s)
        (zeroSchemeTowerIdeal_succ_le X L s) F 0))
    (hc : Hrestrict X.ringCatSheaf (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) 0 F ≫ c = zeroSchemeComparison X L s F 0) :
    IsIso c
declarations.comment: Gamma(V,F) -> lim Gamma(Y_n,F_n) is an isomorphism for every open V containing Y = Z(s), from depth(F_x) + dim(closure{x}) > 1 off Y; carried: the input of 0EL1 (hin) and the bijectivity of Gamma(X,F) -> Gamma(V,F) (hV.isIso_Hrestrict)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_openComparison_of_depthAddDim_gt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EL2 (Lemma 52.28.2).** Let `k` be a field, `X` a scheme proper over
`k`, `L` an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module, `s` a global section of `L`, `Y = Z(s)` its zero
scheme with `n`-th infinitesimal neighbourhood `Yₙ`, and `𝓕` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module with
`depth(𝓕_x) + dim({x}‾) > 1` at every `x ∈ X ∖ Y`. Then `Γ(V, 𝓕) ⟶ lim Γ(Yₙ, 𝓕ₙ)` is an
isomorphism for every open subscheme `V ⊆ X` containing `Y`.

For `V = X` this is [Stacks, Tag 0EL1] at `σ = 1` in degree `0`
(`Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_of_isProper`). Restriction from `X` to `V`
followed by the comparison over `V` is the comparison over `X`
(`Stacks.Algebraization.IdealTower.Hrestrict_comp_openComparison`), and restriction is bijective
because every point of `X ∖ V` is closed with `depth ≥ 2` there
(`Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_Hrestrict_zero_of_depthAddDim_gt`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_openComparison_of_depthAddDim_gt (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (fX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [IsProper fX] (L : X.Modules)
    [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X L] (hL : Stacks.Ample.IsAmple X L) (s : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ ((zeroScheme X L s).support : Set X) →
      enatToEInt (sheafDepthAt F x) + krullDimToEInt (dimClosureAt X x) > ((1 : ℤ) : EInt))
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : ((zeroScheme X L s).support : Set X) ⊆ V) :
    haveI : F.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_of_isCoherent F
    IsIso (IdealTower.openComparison (zeroSchemeTowerIdeal X L s)
      (zeroSchemeTowerIdeal_succ_le X L s) F
      (fun n => (support_zeroSchemeTowerIdeal_subset L s n).trans hV))
declarations.comment: Gamma(V,F) -> lim Gamma(Y_n,F_n) is an isomorphism for every open V containing Y = Z(s), for F coherent on X proper over a field with depth(F_x) + dim(closure{x}) > 1 off Y; Gamma is degree-zero cohomology and Y_n is cut out by the n-th power of the ideal of Y

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_zero_of_isCohenMacaulay_surface
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EL3 (Example 52.28.3), clause (2).** Let `k` be a field, `X` a proper
variety over `k`, `L` an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module (the source's `𝒪_X(Y)`), `s` a global
section of `L` with zero scheme `Y` and `n`-th infinitesimal neighbourhood `Yₙ`, and `𝓔` a finite
locally free `𝒪_X`-module. If `X` is a Cohen–Macaulay surface, then

`H⁰(X, 𝓔) ⟶ lim H⁰(Yₙ, 𝓔ₙ)`

is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_zero_of_isCohenMacaulay_surface
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (fX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProperVariety k fX]
    {L : X.Modules} [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X L] (hL : Stacks.Ample.IsAmple X L)
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (E : X.Modules)
    [_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]
    (hCM : IsCohenMacaulay X) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 2) :
    haveI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherenceCriteria.isQuasicoherent_of_isFiniteLocallyFree E
    IsIso (zeroSchemeComparison X L s E 0)
declarations.comment: clause (2): on a Cohen-Macaulay proper surface over k, H^0(X,E) -> lim H^0(Y_n,E_n) is an isomorphism, for E finite locally free and Y the zero scheme of a section of an ample invertible module

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_of_isCohenMacaulay_threefold
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EL3 (Example 52.28.3), clause (3).** In the situation of clause (2),
if `X` is a Cohen–Macaulay threefold then both

`H⁰(X, 𝓔) ⟶ lim H⁰(Yₙ, 𝓔ₙ)` and `H¹(X, 𝓔) ⟶ lim H¹(Yₙ, 𝓔ₙ)`

are isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_of_isCohenMacaulay_threefold
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (fX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProperVariety k fX]
    {L : X.Modules} [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X L] (hL : Stacks.Ample.IsAmple X L)
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (E : X.Modules)
    [_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]
    (hCM : IsCohenMacaulay X) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 3) :
    haveI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherenceCriteria.isQuasicoherent_of_isFiniteLocallyFree E
    IsIso (zeroSchemeComparison X L s E 0) ∧ IsIso (zeroSchemeComparison X L s E 1)
declarations.comment: clause (3): on a Cohen-Macaulay proper threefold over k, H^0(X,E) -> lim H^0(Y_n,E_n) and H^1(X,E) -> lim H^1(Y_n,E_n) are isomorphisms, for E finite locally free and Y the zero scheme of a section of an ample invertible module

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_zero_of_isNormal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EL3 (Example 52.28.3), the normal case.** In the situation of
clause (2), if `X` is normal of dimension at least two, then

`H⁰(X, 𝓔) ⟶ lim H⁰(Yₙ, 𝓔ₙ)`

is an isomorphism. At dimension two this is the source's "for example normal" in clause (2); at
dimension three it is the closing remark that on a normal threefold the result holds for `H⁰`.
A normal scheme satisfies `(S₂)` (Serre's criterion, [Stacks, Tag 031S]), which is the pattern at
`d = 2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_zero_of_isNormal
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (fX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProperVariety k fX]
    {L : X.Modules} [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X L] (hL : Stacks.Ample.IsAmple X L)
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (E : X.Modules)
    [_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]
    [IsNormal X] (hdim : ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim X) :
    haveI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherenceCriteria.isQuasicoherent_of_isFiniteLocallyFree E
    IsIso (zeroSchemeComparison X L s E 0)
declarations.comment: the normal case: on a normal proper variety over k of dimension at least two (the normal surface of clause (2), the normal threefold of the closing remark), H^0(X,E) -> lim H^0(Y_n,E_n) is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_zero_of_cohenMacaulaySurface
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EL3 (Example 52.28.3), clause (2).** Let `k` be a field, `X` a proper
variety over `k`, `L` an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module — the source's `𝒪_X(Y)` — `s` a global
section with zero scheme `Y` and `n`-th infinitesimal neighbourhood `Yₙ`, and `𝓔` a finite
locally free `𝒪_X`-module. If `X` is a Cohen–Macaulay surface, for example a normal one, then

`H⁰(X, 𝓔) ⟶ lim H⁰(Yₙ, 𝓔ₙ)`

is an isomorphism.

This is the general pattern at `d = 2`, hence `σ = 1` and the single degree `i = 0`: the
Cohen–Macaulay condition and the dimension `2` supply the depth–dimension bound through
`Stacks.Algebraization.intCast_le_sheafDepthAt_add_dimClosureAt_of_isCohenMacaulay`. The
remaining hypothesis `hin` is the input of [Stacks, Tag 0EL1].
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_zeroSchemeComparison_zero_of_cohenMacaulaySurface
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (fX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [IsProperVariety k fX]
    {L : X.Modules} [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X L] {s : Γ(L, ⊤)} {E : X.Modules}
