theorem isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_comp (D : BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.{u})
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver D.site D.base D.base_mem)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX) (sY : Y ⟶ D.space) (hY : D.IsGood sY)
    (sZ : Z ⟶ D.space) (hZ : D.IsGood sZ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hfbase : f ≫ sY = sX) (hgbase : g ≫ sZ = sY) (r s : ℕ)
    (hff : IsFlat D.site D.base D.base_mem f)
    (hfr : HasRelativeDimension r D.site D.base D.base_mem f)
    (hgf : IsFlat D.site D.base D.base_mem g)
    (hgs : HasRelativeDimension s D.site D.base D.base_mem g) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType D.site D.base D.base_mem (f ≫ g) ∧
      IsFlat D.site D.base D.base_mem (f ≫ g) ∧
        HasRelativeDimension (r + s) D.site D.base D.base_mem (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: the composite is flat of relative dimension r + s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_comp_and_flatPullbackMap_comp
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0EDT let `X/B`, `Y/B` and `Z/B` be good and let `f : X ⟶ Y`
and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms over the base which are flat of relative dimensions `r` and `s`.
Then

1. `g ∘ f` is flat of relative dimension `r + s` (and locally of finite type), and
2. `f^* ∘ g^* = (g ∘ f)^*` as maps `Z_k(Z) → Z_{k+r+s}(X)`, for every `k`.

The degree of the target is any `n` with `k + (r + s) = n`, which is how
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullbackMap` is graded. The flat pullback along `g ∘ f` in part (2)
is formed with the flatness and relative dimension that part (1) provides.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_comp_and_flatPullbackMap_comp :
    (IsLocallyOfFiniteType D.site D.base D.base_mem (f ≫ g) ∧
      IsFlat D.site D.base D.base_mem (f ≫ g) ∧
        HasRelativeDimension (r + s) D.site D.base D.base_mem (f ≫ g)) ∧
      ∀ (k n : ℤ) (hn : k + ((r + s : ℕ) : ℤ) = n),
        (flatPullbackMap D sX hX sY hY f hfbase r hff hfr (k + (s : ℤ)) n
            (by push_cast at hn; omega)).comp
          (flatPullbackMap D sY hY sZ hZ g hgbase s hgf hgs k (k + (s : ℤ)) rfl) =
        flatPullbackMap D sX hX sZ hZ (f ≫ g)
          (comp_structureMorphism_eq D sX sY sZ f g hfbase hgbase) (r + s)
          (isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_comp D sX hX sY hY sZ hZ f g hfbase hgbase r s
            hff hfr hgf hgs).2.1
          (isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_comp D sX hX sY hY sZ hZ f g hfbase hgbase r s
            hff hfr hgf hgs).2.2 k n hn
declarations.comment:
both assertions: g ∘ f is flat of relative dimension r + s, and
  f^* ∘ g^* = (g ∘ f)^* as maps Z_k(Z) → Z_{k+r+s}(X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullback_closedSubspaceCycle_preimage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPB, part (1).** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` and `Y/B` be good and let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism over the base which is flat of relative dimension `r`. Let `Z ⊆ Y` be
a closed subspace with `dim_δ(Z) ≤ k`. Then `dim_δ(f^{-1}(Z)) ≤ k + r` and

`[f^{-1}(Z)]_{k+r} = f^*[Z]_k` in `Z_{k+r}(X)`.

The cycle of a closed subspace is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closedSubspaceCycle` (Stacks 0EE9)
and the flat pullback is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullbackMap` (Stacks 0EP8).
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullback_closedSubspaceCycle_preimage (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX)
    (sY : Y ⟶ D.space) (hY : D.IsGood sY) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX) (r : ℕ)
    (hflat : IsFlat D.site D.base D.base_mem f)
    (hr : HasRelativeDimension r D.site D.base D.base_mem f) (k : ℤ) (Z : Subfunctor Y)
    (hZ : IsClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Z)
    (hZk : deltaDimensionSubspace D sY hY Z hZ ≤ (k : EInt)) :
    ∃ hdim : deltaDimensionSubspace D sX hX (Z.preimage f)
        (isClosedSubspace_preimage D.site D.base D.base_mem f Z hY.1 hX.1 hZ) ≤
          ((k + (r : ℤ) : ℤ) : EInt),
      closedSubspaceCycle D sX hX (Z.preimage f)
          (isClosedSubspace_preimage D.site D.base D.base_mem f Z hY.1 hX.1 hZ) (k + (r : ℤ))
          hdim =
        flatPullbackMap D sX hX sY hY f hbase r hflat hr k (k + (r : ℤ)) rfl
          (closedSubspaceCycle D sY hY Z hZ k hZk)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullback_associatedCycle_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPB, part (2).** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` and `Y/B` be good and let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism over the base which is flat of relative dimension `r`. Let `F` be a
coherent `𝒪_Y`-module with `dim_δ(Supp(F)) ≤ k`. Then `dim_δ(Supp(f^*F)) ≤ k + r` and

`f^*[F]_k = [f^*F]_{k+r}` in `Z_{k+r}(X)`.

The cycle of a coherent module is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.associatedCycle` (Stacks 0EEB), read at
any choice `γ_X`, `γ_Y` of geometric points over the points of `X` and `Y`; the pullback `f^*F`
is coherent by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherent_modulePullback`, `X` being locally
Noetherian.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullback_associatedCycle_modulePullback (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX)
    (sY : Y ⟶ D.space) (hY : D.IsGood sY) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX) (r : ℕ)
    (hflat : IsFlat D.site D.base D.base_mem f)
    (hr : HasRelativeDimension r D.site D.base D.base_mem f)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} D.site D.base D.base_mem Y hY.1)
    [IsCoherent D.site D.base D.base_mem Y hY.1 F] (k : ℤ)
    (hFk : deltaDimensionClosed D sY hY (moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hY.1 F)
      (isClosed_moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hY.1 F) ≤ (k : EInt))
    (γY : points D.site D.base D.base_mem Y → GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem Y)
    (hγY : ∀ y, (γY y).LiesOver y)
    (γX : points D.site D.base D.base_mem X → GeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem X)
    (hγX : ∀ x, (γX x).LiesOver x) :
    letI : IsCoherent D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1
        ((modulePullback D.site D.base D.base_mem
          (ObjectProperty.homMk f :
            (⟨X, hX.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces D.site D.base D.base_mem) ⟶ ⟨Y, hY.1⟩)).obj F) :=
      haveI : Fact (HasEtaleLocalProperty D.site D.base D.base_mem X
          (fun V : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian V)) :=
        ⟨hasEtaleLocalProperty_isLocallyNoetherian_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType D.site D.base
          D.base_mem hX.1 D.isAlgebraicSpace sX hX.2.2 D.locallyNoetherian⟩
      isCoherent_modulePullback D.site D.base D.base_mem
        (ObjectProperty.homMk f :
          (⟨X, hX.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces D.site D.base D.base_mem) ⟶ ⟨Y, hY.1⟩) F inferInstance
    ∃ hdim : deltaDimensionClosed D sX hX
        (moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1
          ((modulePullback D.site D.base D.base_mem
            (ObjectProperty.homMk f :
              (⟨X, hX.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces D.site D.base D.base_mem) ⟶ ⟨Y, hY.1⟩)).obj F))
        (isClosed_moduleSupport D.site D.base D.base_mem hX.1 _) ≤
          ((k + (r : ℤ) : ℤ) : EInt),
      flatPullbackMap D sX hX sY hY f hbase r hflat hr k (k + (r : ℤ)) rfl
          (associatedCycle D sY hY F k γY hγY hFk) =
        associatedCycle D sX hX
          ((modulePullback D.site D.base D.base_mem
            (ObjectProperty.homMk f :
              (⟨X, hX.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces D.site D.base D.base_mem) ⟶ ⟨Y, hY.1⟩)).obj F)
          (k + (r : ℤ)) γX hγX hdim
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPD, first assertion**, by way of Stacks 04WP. In a cartesian square of algebraic
spaces over `S` the base change `f'` of a proper morphism `f` is proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_of_isPullback
    {X' X Y' Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (hX' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X') (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y') (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (hf : IsProper B S hS f) :
    IsProper B S hS f'
declarations.comment: first assertion: the base change of a proper morphism is proper

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPD, second assertion.** In Situation 0EDT let the four corners of a cartesian
square of algebraic spaces over `B` be good and let `g : Y' ⟶ Y` be a morphism over `B` which is
flat of relative dimension `r`. Then the base change `g' : X' ⟶ X` is flat of relative
dimension `r`: it is locally of finite type, flat, and of relative dimension `r`.

Local finite type of `g'` is goodness of `X'/B` and the cancellation of Stacks 0462 applied to
`g' ≫ sX = sX'`, flatness is Stacks 03MO, and the relative dimension is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasRelativeDimension_of_isPullback`, which is part (1) of
Stacks 04NS.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_of_isPullback
    (sX' : X' ⟶ D.space) (hX' : D.IsGood sX') (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX)
    (sY' : Y' ⟶ D.space) (hY' : D.IsGood sY') (sY : Y ⟶ D.space) (hY : D.IsGood sY)
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (hg'base : g' ≫ sX = sX') (hgbase : g ≫ sY = sY') (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (r : ℕ)
    (hgflat : IsFlat D.site D.base D.base_mem g)
    (hgr : HasRelativeDimension r D.site D.base D.base_mem g) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType D.site D.base D.base_mem g' ∧
      IsFlat D.site D.base D.base_mem g' ∧
        HasRelativeDimension r D.site D.base D.base_mem g'
declarations.comment:
second assertion: the base change of a morphism flat of relative dimension r is
  flat of relative dimension r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullback_properPushforward_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPD, third assertion.** In Situation 0EDT let the four corners of a cartesian
square of good algebraic spaces over `B` be good, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be proper and let
`g : Y' ⟶ Y` be flat of relative dimension `r`. Then for every `k`-cycle `α` on `X`

`g^*f_*α = f'_*(g')^*α`

in `Z_{k+r}(Y')`.

**Nothing is carried.** The pushforward along `f'` is legitimate because `f'` is proper, which is
the first assertion `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_of_isPullback` and appears in the
statement; the pullback along `g'` is legitimate because `g'` is flat of relative dimension `r`,
which is the second assertion
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_of_isPullback` and is written out as the
hypotheses `hg'flat` and `hg'r` so that the degree bookkeeping stays explicit.

The two numerical inputs are proved. One is the degree count at the generic points,
`deg(Z/Z')·m_{T'}(g^{-1}(Z')) = ∑_T m_T((g')^{-1}(Z))·deg(T/T')`, which is
`Space.BaseChangeDegreeCount.properCycleDegree_mul_flatPullbackMult_eq_finsum_of_isProper`
of `StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Spaces.Chow.ProperFlatBaseChangeDegreeCount`: the source's
route (`[Z] = [𝒪_Z]_k`, part (1) of Stacks 0EP3 on both sides, and flat base change in degree
zero, part (1) of Stacks 073K) read at one pair of generic points. The other is that the
left-hand side of the count is the whole coefficient of `g^*f_*[Z]` at `T'`, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finsum_properCycleMult_mul_flatPullbackMult`. The count is bundled into
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ProperFlatBaseChangeComparison` and handed to
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullback_properPushforward` above, which is where the passage from a
prime cycle to an arbitrary cycle is carried out.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullback_properPushforward_of_isPullback (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (hfproper : IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem f)
    (k n : ℤ) (hkn : k + (r : ℤ) = n) (α : CycleGroup D sX k) :
    flatPullbackMap D sY' hY' sY hY g hgbase r hgflat hgr k n hkn
        (properCyclePushforward D sX hX sY hY hfbase hfproper.2.1.2 k α) =
      properCyclePushforward D sX' hX' sY' hY' hf'base
        (isProper_of_isPullback D.site D.base D.base_mem hX'.1 hX.1 hY'.1 hY.1 sq hfproper).2.1.2
        n (flatPullbackMap D sX' hX' sX hX g' hg'base r hg'flat hg'r k n hkn α)
declarations.comment:
third assertion: the identity g^* f_* α = f'_* (g')^* α in Z_{k+r}(Y') for an
  arbitrary k-cycle α, at the source's hypotheses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullback_properPushforward'
declarations.doc:
The identity `g^*f_*α = f'_*(g')^*α` in `Z_{k+r}(Y')`, for a cartesian square of good
algebraic spaces over `B` with `f` proper and `g` flat of relative dimension `r`, and for an
arbitrary `k`-cycle `α` on `X`.
declarations.statement: alias flatPullback_properPushforward'
declarations.comment:
third assertion: the identity g^* f_* α = f'_* (g')^* α in Z_{k+r}(Y') for an
  arbitrary k-cycle α, with no comparison datum and no numerical identity carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullback_properPushforward_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPD, third assertion.**  In Situation 0EDT let

```
X' --g'--> X
|f'        |f
v          v
Y' --g---> Y
```

be a cartesian square of good algebraic spaces over `B`, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be proper and let
`g : Y' ⟶ Y` be flat of relative dimension `r`.  Then for every `k`-cycle `α` on `X`

`g^*f_*α = f'_*(g')^*α`

in `Z_{k+r}(Y')`.

Nothing is assumed: the pushforward along `f'` is legitimate because `f'` is proper, which is the
first assertion `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_of_isPullback`; the pullback along `g'` is
legitimate because `g'` is flat of relative dimension `r`, which is the second assertion
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_of_isPullback`; and both are written out
in the statement rather than carried.  The identity itself is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullback_properPushforward`, whose comparison at the generic points
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properFlatBaseChangeComparison`.

A `CycleGroup` is never transported along an equality of degrees, so the identity is stated at a
pair `k`, `n` with `k + r = n` and the degree equality as an explicit argument, which is the
convention of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullbackMap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullback_properPushforward_unconditional (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (hfproper : IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem f)
    (k n : ℤ) (hkn : k + (r : ℤ) = n) (α : CycleGroup D sX k) :
    flatPullbackMap D sY' hY' sY hY g hgbase r hgflat hgr k n hkn
        (properCyclePushforward D sX hX sY hY hfbase hfproper.2.1.2 k α) =
      properCyclePushforward D sX' hX' sY' hY' hf'base
        (isProper_of_isPullback D.site D.base D.base_mem hX'.1 hX.1 hY'.1 hY.1 sq hfproper).2.1.2
        n (flatPullbackMap D sX' hX' sX hX g' hg'base r
          (isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_of_isPullback D sX' hX' sX hX sY' hY' sY hY hg'base
            hgbase sq r hgflat hgr).2.1
          (isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_of_isPullback D sX' hX' sX hX sY' hY' sY hY hg'base
            hgbase sq r hgflat hgr).2.2 k n hkn α)
declarations.comment:
third assertion: the identity g^* f_* α = f'_* (g')^* α in Z_{k+r}(Y') for an
  arbitrary k-cycle α, at the source's hypotheses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properPushforward_finiteLocallyFreeCyclePullback_eq_zsmul
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` and `Y/B` be good and let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be finite locally free of degree `d`. Then

`f_*f^*α = dα`

for every `α ∈ Z_k(Y)`, with `f^*` the flat pullback of Stacks 0EP8
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finiteLocallyFreeCyclePullback`, whose flatness and
relative-dimension hypotheses are the second conclusion of Stacks 0EPE) and `f_*` the proper
pushforward of Stacks 0EP1 (whose quasi-compactness hypothesis is the first conclusion).
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforward_finiteLocallyFreeCyclePullback_eq_zsmul
    (sX : X.obj ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX) (sY : Y.obj ⟶ D.space) (hY : D.IsGood sY)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hbase : f.hom ≫ sY = sX) (d : ℕ)
    (hf : IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank D.site D.base D.base_mem f d) (k : ℤ)
    (α : CycleGroup D sY k) :
    properPushforward D sX hX sY hY hbase
        (isQuasiCompact_hom_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank D f d hf) k
        ((finiteLocallyFreeCyclePullback D sX hX sY hY f hbase d hf).map k k (by simp) α) =
      (d : ℤ) • α
declarations.comment: f_* f^* alpha = d alpha

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPE, first conclusion.** A finite locally free morphism of degree `d` of algebraic
spaces over `S` is proper.

A finite locally free morphism is finite by Stacks 0416, and a finite morphism is proper by
Stacks 04NZ. The goodness hypotheses of Situation 0EDT are not used, so the conclusion is drawn
for an arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
    (hcross : FiniteLocallyFreeRankChartComparison B S hS)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (d : ℕ)
    (hf : IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank B S hS f d) :
    IsProper B S hS f.hom
declarations.comment: f is proper

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_zero_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPE, second conclusion.** A finite locally free morphism of degree `d` of
algebraic spaces over `S` is flat of relative dimension `0`: it is flat and locally of finite
type, and has relative dimension `0` at every point of its source.

Flatness is Stacks 0416. For the relative dimension, the morphism is finite, hence locally
quasi-finite and locally of finite type, and Stacks 04NV turns local quasi-finiteness into the
vanishing of the relative dimension at every point. The goodness hypotheses of Situation 0EDT
are not used.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_zero_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
    (hcross : FiniteLocallyFreeRankChartComparison B S hS)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (d : ℕ)
    (hf : IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank B S hS f d) :
    IsFlat B S hS f.hom ∧ IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom ∧
      HasRelativeDimension 0 B S hS f.hom
declarations.comment: f is flat of relative dimension 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properPushforward_flatCyclePullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPE, third conclusion.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` and `Y/B` be good and let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be finite locally free of degree `d`. Then `f_*f^*α = dα` for every `α ∈ Z_k(Y)`.

Only the term of the flat pullback at `W'` itself survives in the coefficient of `f_*f^*α` at
an integral closed subspace `W' ⊆ Y`, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_cycleImageSubspace_of_mult_ne_zero`, and what is left is `α_{W'}`
times the degree `hdeg` of the fibre over the generic point of `W'`; at a `W'` of δ-dimension
other than `k` the coefficient of `α` there vanishes and both sides are zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforward_flatCyclePullback
    (hcross : FiniteLocallyFreeRankChartComparison D.site D.base D.base_mem)
    (sX : X.obj ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX) (sY : Y.obj ⟶ D.space) (hY : D.IsGood sY)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hbase : f.hom ≫ sY = sX) (d : ℕ)
    (hf : IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank D.site D.base D.base_mem f d)
    (pb : FlatCyclePullback D sX hX sY hY f.hom 0)
    (k : ℤ)
    (hdeg : ∀ W : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Y.obj,
      deltaDimension D sY W = k →
      ∑ᶠ T ∈ {T : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X.obj |
          cycleImageSubspace D sY hY f.hom T = W},
        pb.mult W T * (cycleResidueDegree D sX hX sY hY f.hom
          (T.ambientGenericPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem) : ℤ) = (d : ℤ))
    (α : CycleGroup D sY k) :
    properPushforward D sX hX sY hY hbase
        (isQuasiCompact_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank D.site D.base D.base_mem hcross f d hf) k
        (pb.map k k (by simp) α) = (d : ℤ) • α
declarations.comment: f_* f^* alpha = d alpha

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPE, first conclusion.** A finite locally free morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S` is proper.

A finite locally free morphism is finite by Stacks 0416, and a finite morphism is proper by
Stacks 04NZ. Neither the rank nor the goodness hypotheses of Situation 0EDT are used, so the
conclusion is drawn for the unranked definition of Stacks 03ZV and an arbitrary morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_of_isFiniteLocallyFree {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsFiniteLocallyFree B S hS f) :
    IsProper B S hS f.hom
declarations.comment: f is proper

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_zero_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPE, second conclusion.** A finite locally free morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S` is flat of relative dimension `0`: it is flat and locally of finite type, and has
relative dimension `0` at every point of its source.

Flatness is Stacks 0416. For the relative dimension, the morphism is finite, hence locally
quasi-finite and locally of finite type, and Stacks 04NV turns local quasi-finiteness into the
vanishing of the relative dimension at every point. Neither the rank nor the goodness hypotheses
of Situation 0EDT are used.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_zero_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFiniteLocallyFree B S hS f) :
    IsFlat B S hS f.hom ∧ IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom ∧
      HasRelativeDimension 0 B S hS f.hom
declarations.comment: f is flat of relative dimension 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properPushforward_flatCyclePullback_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPE, third conclusion.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` and `Y/B` be good and let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be finite locally free, with `hdeg` recording the degree `d` of its fibre over the
generic point of every integral closed subspace of δ-dimension `k`. Then `f_*f^*α = dα` for
every `α ∈ Z_k(Y)`.

Only the term of the flat pullback at `W'` itself survives in the coefficient of `f_*f^*α` at
an integral closed subspace `W' ⊆ Y`, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_cycleImageSubspace_of_mult_ne_zero`, and what is left is `α_{W'}`
times the degree `hdeg` of the fibre over the generic point of `W'`; at a `W'` of δ-dimension
other than `k` the coefficient of `α` there vanishes and both sides are zero.

Finite local freeness enters only through quasi-compactness, which is all the proper pushforward
of Stacks 0EP1 asks for, so the rank of Stacks 03ZV is not imposed on `f`: the degree `d` is
pinned by `hdeg` alone.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforward_flatCyclePullback_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
    (sX : X.obj ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX) (sY : Y.obj ⟶ D.space) (hY : D.IsGood sY)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hbase : f.hom ≫ sY = sX) (d : ℕ)
    (hf : IsFiniteLocallyFree D.site D.base D.base_mem f)
    (pb : FlatCyclePullback D sX hX sY hY f.hom 0)
    (k : ℤ)
    (hdeg : ∀ W : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem Y.obj,
      deltaDimension D sY W = k →
      ∑ᶠ T ∈ {T : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X.obj |
          cycleImageSubspace D sY hY f.hom T = W},
        pb.mult W T * (cycleResidueDegree D sX hX sY hY f.hom
          (T.ambientGenericPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem) : ℤ) = (d : ℤ))
    (α : CycleGroup D sY k) :
    properPushforward D sX hX sY hY hbase
        (isQuasiCompact_of_isFiniteLocallyFree D.site D.base D.base_mem f hf) k
        (pb.map k k (by simp) α) = (d : ℤ) • α
declarations.comment: f_* f^* alpha = d alpha

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.units_map_residueField_tameSymbol_pow_eq_of_factorization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPG for a pair with a simultaneous power factorization over the base.** Let
`(A, 𝔪, κ) → (A', 𝔪', κ')` be a flat local homomorphism of one-dimensional Noetherian local
rings and let `m = length_{A'}(A' / 𝔪A')`. If two nonzerodivisors of `A` are simultaneous unit
multiples of powers of one nonzerodivisor `π` of `A`, `a = u π ^ e` and `b = v π ^ f`, then

`∂_A(a, b) ^ m` maps to `∂_{A'}(a, b)` under `κ → κ'`.

Both symbols are evaluated by
`Stacks.Chow.RegularTameSymbol.apply_eq_of_factorization`: over `A` on the parameter `π`, and
over `A'` on the image of `π`, with the images of `u` and `v` as unit parts and the same
exponents `e` and `f`. The two resulting expressions have the same base, the image in `κ'` of
`(-1) ^ (ef) ū ^ f v̄ ^ (-e)`, and their exponents differ by exactly the factor `m`, because
`length_{A'}(A' / π A') = m · length_A(A / πA)` by
`Stacks.Chow.ord_algebraMap_eq_ord_mul_length_quotient`.

This covers the case the source's proof disposes of first, `a` and `b` both units (take
`π = 1`), and more generally a unit against a nonzerodivisor (take `π = b`, `v = 1`, `f = 1`).
It does not cover a pair for which the finite extension of Stacks 0EAG is genuinely needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem units_map_residueField_tameSymbol_pow_eq_of_factorization
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 A]
    {A' : Type v} [CommRing A'] [IsNoetherianRing A'] [IsLocalRing A'] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 A']
    [Algebra A A'] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A A')] [Module.Flat A A']
    (symb : RegularTameSymbol A) (symb' : RegularTameSymbol A') {m : ℕ}
    (hm : Module.length A' (A' ⧸ extendedMaximalIdeal A A') = m)
    (p a b : nonZeroDivisors A) (u v : Aˣ) (e f : ℕ)
    (ha : (a : A) = u * (p : A) ^ e) (hb : (b : A) = v * (p : A) ^ f) :
    Units.map (ResidueField.map (algebraMap A A')).toMonoidHom (symb a b ^ m) =
      symb' (flatNonZeroDivisor A' a) (flatNonZeroDivisor A' b)
declarations.comment: for a pair of nonzerodivisors admitting a simultaneous power factorization over `A` itself, so that the finite extension of Stacks 0EAG used by the source's proof is not needed; the length multiplier is Stacks 02M1

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_prod_support
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPG for a general pair of nonzerodivisors, over the supports.** Let
`(A, 𝔪, κ) → (A', 𝔪', κ')` be a flat local homomorphism of one-dimensional Noetherian local rings
and let `m = length_{A'}(A' / 𝔪A')`. Let `A ⊆ B` be a finite extension carrying a tame-symbol
preparation of a family `a` of elements of `A` — by Stacks 0EAG one exists for *every* pair of
nonzerodivisors of `A`. Then the value of the formula Stacks 0EAQ for two members of that family,
raised to the power `m` and read in `κ'`, is the value of the same formula over `A'` for the
base-changed data:

`(∏_𝔮 Norm_{κ(𝔮)/κ}(c_𝔮))^m = ∏_𝔮 ∏_𝔭 Norm_{κ(𝔭)/κ'}(c_𝔭)`,

where `𝔮` runs over the maximal ideals of `B` and `𝔭` over the maximal ideals of `A' ⊗_A B_𝔮`
containing the image of the parameter `π_𝔮`.

This differs from `Stacks.Chow.map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_prod` only in asking for the locality
of `A' → (A' ⊗_A B_𝔮)_𝔭` and the finiteness of `κ(𝔭) / κ'` at those `𝔭` alone, and that is the
difference between a statement that applies and one that does not. At a maximal ideal of
`A' ⊗_A B_𝔮` where the image of `π_𝔮` is a unit the local ring need not be local over `A'`, and
such maximal ideals do occur: for `A = ℤ_(5)`, `A' = ℤ₅`, `B` the semilocalization of `ℤ[i]` at
`5` and `𝔮` one of the two maximal ideals of `B`, the ring `A' ⊗_A B_𝔮` is `ℚ₅ × ℤ₅`, whose local
ring at `0 × ℤ₅` is `ℚ₅`, over which `ℤ₅` is not local.

Each factor is `Stacks.Chow.map_norm_factorizationValue_pow_eq_prod_support`, which is the
determinant identity Stacks 0GU1; the only other ingredient is that `κ → κ'` is multiplicative.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_prod_support
    {m : ℕ} (hm : Module.length A' (A' ⧸ extendedMaximalIdeal A A') = m)
    {r : ℕ} {a : Fin r → A} (P : TameSymbolPreparation a B) (i j : Fin r)
    [∀ q : MaximalSpectrum B,
      Fintype (Stacks.Length.tensorSupport A A' (P.parameter q.asIdeal))]
    [∀ (q : MaximalSpectrum B) (p : Stacks.Length.tensorSupport A A' (P.parameter q.asIdeal)),
      IsLocalHom (algebraMap A' (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asIdeal))]
    [∀ (q : MaximalSpectrum B) (p : Stacks.Length.tensorSupport A A' (P.parameter q.asIdeal)),
      Module.Finite (ResidueField A') (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asIdeal))] :
    Units.map (ResidueField.map (algebraMap A A')).toMonoidHom (P.symbolValue i j) ^ m =
      ∏ q : MaximalSpectrum B,
        ∏ p : Stacks.Length.tensorSupport A A' (P.parameter q.asIdeal),
          Units.map (Algebra.norm (ResidueField A') :
              ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asIdeal) →* ResidueField A')
            (factorizationValue (baseChangeLocalizationHom A' p.1 (P.parameter q.asIdeal))
              (Units.map (baseChangeLocalizationHom A' p.1).toMonoidHom
                (P.factorUnit q.asIdeal i))
              (Units.map (baseChangeLocalizationHom A' p.1).toMonoidHom
                (P.factorUnit q.asIdeal j))
              (P.exponent q.asIdeal i) (P.exponent q.asIdeal j))
declarations.comment: for a general pair of nonzerodivisors, in the spelling in which both sides are the formula Stacks 0EAQ: on the left for a tame-symbol preparation over a finite extension `B` of `A`, which Stacks 0EAG provides for every pair, and on the right for the base change of that preparation, with the maximal ideals of the base change presented fibre by fibre over those of `B` and, in each fibre, as those carrying the parameter

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_prod
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪, κ) → (A', 𝔪', κ')` be a flat local homomorphism of one-dimensional Noetherian
local rings and let `m = length_{A'}(A' / 𝔪A')`. Let `A ⊆ B` be a finite extension carrying a
tame-symbol preparation of a family `a` of elements of `A` (by Stacks 0EAG one exists for every
pair of nonzerodivisors of `A`). Then the value of the formula Stacks 0EAQ for two members of
that family, raised to the power `m` and read in `κ'`, is the value of the same formula over `A'`
for the base-changed data:

`(∏_𝔮 Norm_{κ(𝔮)/κ}(c_𝔮))^m = ∏_𝔮 ∏_𝔭 Norm_{κ(𝔭)/κ'}(c_𝔭)`,

where `𝔮` runs over the maximal ideals of `B`, `𝔭` over the maximal ideals of `A' ⊗_A B_𝔮`, and
the local data over `𝔭` is the image of the local data over `𝔮` under `B_𝔮 → (A' ⊗_A B_𝔮)_𝔭`.
The index set of the right-hand side is thus presented fibre by fibre over the maximal ideals of
`B`; in the source it is presented as the set of maximal ideals of `A' ⊗_A B`, whose fibred
decomposition is `Stacks.Chow.baseChangeSigmaEquiv`. The hypotheses below hold only at the maximal
ideals carrying the parameter; `Stacks.Chow.map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_prod_support` is the form
that asks for them there alone.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_prod
    {m : ℕ} (hm : Module.length A' (A' ⧸ extendedMaximalIdeal A A') = m)
    {r : ℕ} {a : Fin r → A} (P : TameSymbolPreparation a B) (i j : Fin r) :
    Units.map (ResidueField.map (algebraMap A A')).toMonoidHom (P.symbolValue i j) ^ m =
      ∏ q : MaximalSpectrum B,
        ∏ p : MaximalSpectrum (A' ⊗[A] Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal),
          Units.map (Algebra.norm (ResidueField A') :
              ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) →* ResidueField A')
            (factorizationValue (baseChangeLocalizationHom A' p (P.parameter q.asIdeal))
              (Units.map (baseChangeLocalizationHom A' p).toMonoidHom (P.factorUnit q.asIdeal i))
              (Units.map (baseChangeLocalizationHom A' p).toMonoidHom (P.factorUnit q.asIdeal j))
              (P.exponent q.asIdeal i) (P.exponent q.asIdeal j))
declarations.comment: for a general pair of nonzerodivisors, in the spelling in which both sides are the formula Stacks 0EAQ: on the left for a tame-symbol preparation over a finite extension `B` of `A`, which Stacks 0EAG provides for every pair, and on the right for the base change of that preparation, with the maximal ideals of `A' ⊗_A B` presented fibre by fibre over those of `B`

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.map_normPushforward_pow_eq_prod_prod
declarations.doc:
For nonzerodivisors `a₁ = a i` and `a₂ = a j` of `A` and a tame-symbol preparation `P` of `a`
over `B`, the tame symbol `∂_A(a₁, a₂)` of Stacks 0EAT, raised to the power `m` and read in `κ'`,
is the value of the formula Stacks 0EAQ over `A'` for the base change of `P`: the right-hand side
of `Stacks.Chow.map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_prod`.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_normPushforward_pow_eq_prod_prod [Module.Finite A B]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : Module.length A' (A' ⧸ extendedMaximalIdeal A A') = m)
    (hass : ¬ IsAssociatedPrime (maximalIdeal A) B)
    (symb : ∀ q : MaximalSpectrum B, RegularTameSymbol (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B))
    (hquot : ∃ n : ℕ, maximalIdeal A ^ n • (⊤ : Submodule A B) ≤
      LinearMap.range (Algebra.linearMap A B))
    {r : ℕ} {a : Fin r → A} (P : TameSymbolPreparation a B) (i j : Fin r)
    (x y : nonZeroDivisors A) (hx : (x : A) = a i) (hy : (y : A) = a j) :
    Units.map (ResidueField.map (algebraMap A A')).toMonoidHom
        (normPushforward hass symb hinj hquot x y) ^ m =
      ∏ q : MaximalSpectrum B,
        ∏ p : MaximalSpectrum (A' ⊗[A] Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal),
          Units.map (Algebra.norm (ResidueField A') :
              ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) →* ResidueField A')
            (factorizationValue (baseChangeLocalizationHom A' p (P.parameter q.asIdeal))
              (Units.map (baseChangeLocalizationHom A' p).toMonoidHom (P.factorUnit q.asIdeal i))
              (Units.map (baseChangeLocalizationHom A' p).toMonoidHom (P.factorUnit q.asIdeal j))
              (P.exponent q.asIdeal i) (P.exponent q.asIdeal j))
declarations.comment: for a general pair of nonzerodivisors, with the symbol on `A` spelled as the norm pushforward of Stacks 0EAT and the symbol on `A'` as the formula Stacks 0EAQ for the base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_maximalSpectrum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPG for a general pair of nonzerodivisors, as a single product over the maximal
ideals of the base change.** Let `(A, 𝔪, κ) → (A', 𝔪', κ')` be a flat local homomorphism of
one-dimensional Noetherian local rings and let `m = length_{A'}(A' / 𝔪A')`. Let `A ⊆ B` be a
finite extension carrying a tame-symbol preparation of a family `a` of elements of `A` — by
Stacks 0EAG one exists for *every* pair of nonzerodivisors of `A`. Then the value of the formula
Stacks 0EAQ for two members of that family, raised to the power `m` and read in `κ'`, is

`(∏_𝔮 Norm_{κ(𝔮)/κ}(w_𝔮)^{m_𝔮})^m = ∏_𝔭 Norm_{κ(𝔭)/κ'}(w_{𝔭 ∩ B})^{m_𝔭}`,

the product on the right running over *all* the maximal ideals `𝔭` of `A' ⊗_A B` and the factor at
`𝔭` being computed in the local ring `(A' ⊗_A B)_𝔭`, from the image of the factorization data at
`𝔮 = 𝔭 ∩ B` under `B_𝔮 → (A' ⊗_A B)_𝔭`. This is the spelling of the source: there the maximal
ideals of `B' = A' ⊗_A B` are listed as `𝔪'_{j,l}`, the maximal ideals above `𝔪_j`, the factor at
`𝔪'_{j,l}` is read in `B'_{j,l}`, and "as factorizations of `a₁` and `a₂` in `B'_{j,l}` we use the
image of the factorizations `a_i = u_{i,j} π_j^{e_{i,j}}` given to us in `B_j`".

`Stacks.Chow.map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_prod_support` is the same identity with the right-hand
side presented fibre by fibre over the maximal ideals of `B` and the factor in each fibre read in
`(A' ⊗_A B_𝔮)_p` rather than in `(A' ⊗_A B)_𝔭`; the two index sets are identified by
`Stacks.Chow.baseChangeSupportSigmaEquiv` and the two factors agree by
`Stacks.Chow.units_map_norm_factorizationValue_baseChange`.

The identification of the index sets holds fibre by fibre at a maximal ideal `𝔮` of `B` whose
parameter lies in the maximal ideal of `B_𝔮`. At a maximal ideal whose parameter is a unit no
identification is needed: the support of the parameter in `A' ⊗_A B_𝔮` is then empty, and over
`𝔮` the order of vanishing in `(A' ⊗_A B)_𝔭` is zero, so both fibre products are `1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_symbolValue_pow_eq_prod_maximalSpectrum
    {m : ℕ} (hm : Module.length A' (A' ⧸ extendedMaximalIdeal A A') = m)
    {r : ℕ} {a : Fin r → A} (P : TameSymbolPreparation a B) (i j : Fin r)
    [∀ q : MaximalSpectrum B,
      Fintype (Stacks.Length.tensorSupport A A' (P.parameter q.asIdeal))] :
    Units.map (ResidueField.map (algebraMap A A')).toMonoidHom (P.symbolValue i j) ^ m =
      ∏ 𝔭 : MaximalSpectrum (A' ⊗[A] B),
        Units.map (Algebra.norm (ResidueField A') :
            ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭.asIdeal) →* ResidueField A')
          (factorizationValue (baseChangeFibreHom 𝔭 (P.parameter (baseChangeUnder 𝔭).asIdeal))
            (Units.map (baseChangeFibreHom 𝔭).toMonoidHom
              (P.factorUnit (baseChangeUnder 𝔭).asIdeal i))
            (Units.map (baseChangeFibreHom 𝔭).toMonoidHom
              (P.factorUnit (baseChangeUnder 𝔭).asIdeal j))
            (P.exponent (baseChangeUnder 𝔭).asIdeal i)
            (P.exponent (baseChangeUnder 𝔭).asIdeal j))
declarations.comment: for a general pair of nonzerodivisors, in the spelling of the source: the formula Stacks 0EAQ over `A` for a tame-symbol preparation on a finite extension `B` of `A`, which Stacks 0EAG provides for every pair, raised to the power `m` and read in `κ'`, is one product over the maximal ideals `𝔭` of `A' ⊗_A B`, the factor at `𝔭` being the norm to `κ'` of the formula Stacks 0EAQ computed in `(A' ⊗_A B)_𝔭` for the image of the factorization data at `𝔭 ∩ B`

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.map_tameSymbolFormula_pow_eq
declarations.doc:
**Flat base change for the tame symbol.** Let `(A, 𝔪, κ) → (A', 𝔪', κ')` be a local
homomorphism of Noetherian local rings, with `A → A'` flat and `dim(A) = dim(A') = 1`, and let
`m = length_{A'}(A' / 𝔪A')` (finite, by `Stacks.Chow.isFiniteLength_closedFibre`). For
nonzerodivisors `a₁, a₂ ∈ A`, the element `∂_A(a₁, a₂)^m` maps to `∂_{A'}(a₁, a₂)` via
`κ → κ'`, where `∂` is the tame symbol `Stacks.Chow.tameSymbolFormula`.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_tameSymbolFormula_pow_eq (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) (hdim' : ringKrullDim A' = 1)
    {a₁ a₂ : A} (ha₁ : IsRegular a₁) (ha₂ : IsRegular a₂) :
    Units.map (ResidueField.map (algebraMap A A')).toMonoidHom
        (tameSymbolFormula hdim a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ ^
          (Module.length A' (A' ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap A A') (maximalIdeal A))).toNat) =
      tameSymbolFormula hdim' (algebraMap A A' a₁) (algebraMap A A' a₂)
        (Stacks.Fitting.isRegular_algebraMap_of_flat ha₁)
        (Stacks.Fitting.isRegular_algebraMap_of_flat ha₂)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.flatPullback_principalDivisor_eq_sum_components
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPH.** Let `C = (S, δ)` be the base situation of chapter 42, let `X` and `Y` be
locally of finite type over `S` with `Y` integral of delta-dimension `k`, and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be
flat of relative dimension `r`. For a nonzero rational function `g` on `Y`,

  `f^* div_Y(g) = ∑_j n_j i_{j,*} div_{X_j}(g ∘ f|_{X_j})`

as `(k + r - 1)`-cycles on `X`, where the sum is over the irreducible components `X_j` of `X`
with their reduced structure and `n_j` is the multiplicity of `X_j` in the fundamental cycle
`[X]_{k + r}`. The identity is read coefficientwise at a point `x` of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullback_principalDivisor_eq_sum_components (C : ChowSituation.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (sY : Y ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] [IsIntegral Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [Flat f]
    (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX) (r : ℕ) (hf : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension f r) {k : ℤ}
    (hY : schemeDeltaDimension C sY = (k : EInt)) (g : Y.functionField) (hg : g ≠ 0) (x : X) :
    (flatPullback C sX sY f hbase r hf (k - 1) (principalDivisorCycle C sY hY g)).1 x =
      ∑ᶠ W : irreducibleComponents X,
        (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C sX (𝟙 X) (k + (r : ℤ))).1 W.2.1.genericPoint *
          (letI : IsIntegral (integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subscheme :=
             isIntegral_integralComponentAt _
           letI := isDominant_subschemeι_integralComponentAt_comp f W
           (properPushforward C ((integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι ≫ sX) sX
             (integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι rfl (k + (r : ℤ) - 1)
             (principalDivisorCycle C _
               (schemeDeltaDimension_integralComponentAt_comp C sX sY f hbase r hf hY W)
               (dominantFunctionFieldMap
                 ((integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι ≫ f) g))).1 x)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.zeroCycle_eq_sum_components
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPI.** Let `(S, δ)` be the base situation of chapter 42, let `Y` be locally of
finite type over `S`, let `L` be an invertible `𝒪_Y`-module and `s` a global section of `L`.
Assume `dim_δ(Y) ≤ k + 1`, `dim_δ(Z(s)) ≤ k`, and that multiplication by `s` is injective on
the stalk at the generic point of every component of `Z(s)` of delta-dimension `k`. Then the
`k`-cycle of `Z(s)` is the sum of the `k`-cycles of the zero schemes of the restrictions of `s`
to the components of `Y` of delta-dimension `k + 1`, weighted by their multiplicities in the
fundamental cycle `[Y]_{k + 1}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem zeroCycle_eq_sum_components (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (L : Y.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible Y.sheaf.obj Y.ringCatSheaf.property L]
    (s : L.sections) (k : ℤ)
    (hY : schemeDeltaDimension C f ≤ (k + 1 : EInt))
    (hD : schemeDeltaDimension C
      ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L (s.eval (op ⊤))).subschemeι ≫ f) ≤ (k : EInt))
    (hs : ∀ ξ : genericPoints (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L (s.eval (op ⊤))).subscheme,
      relativeDimension C.dimensionFunction f
        ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L (s.eval (op ⊤))).subschemeι ξ.1) = k →
      Function.Injective (ConcreteCategory.hom
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L (s.eval (op ⊤))).subschemeι ξ.1)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf Y).map (L.unitHomEquiv.symm s))))) :
    let D := Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L (s.eval (op ⊤))
    ∀ x : Y,
      (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C f D.subschemeι k).1 x =
        ∑ᶠ W : {W : irreducibleComponents Y //
            deltaDimension C f
              ⟨W.1, W.2.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents W.1 W.2⟩ = k + 1},
          (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C f (𝟙 Y) (k + 1)).1 W.1.2.1.genericPoint *
            (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C f
              ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
                ⟨W.1.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents W.1.1 W.1.2⟩ ⊔ D).subschemeι)
              k).1 x

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.flatPullback_meromorphicDivisor_eq_sum_components
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPJ.** Let `C = (S, δ)` be the base situation of chapter 42, let `X` and `Y` be
locally of finite type over `S` with `Y` integral of delta-dimension `n`, and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be
flat of relative dimension `r`. For an invertible module `L` on `Y` and a *nonzero* meromorphic
section `s` of `L`,

  `f^* div_L(s) = ∑_i n_i i_{i,*} div_{f^*L|_{X_i}}(s_i)`

as `(n + r - 1)`-cycles on `X`. The sum runs over the irreducible components `X_i` of `X` taken
with their reduced structure — each of these has delta-dimension `n + r` by
`Stacks.Chow.schemeDeltaDimension_integralComponentAt_comp`, so this is the sum over the
components of delta-dimension `n + r` that the source writes — `i_i : X_i ⟶ X` is the inclusion,
`s_i` is the pullback of `s` along `f|_{X_i}`, and `n_i` is the multiplicity of `X_i` in `X`,
read as the coefficient of `X_i` in the fundamental cycle `[X]_{n + r}`.

The identity is read coefficientwise at a point `x` of `X`, because the irreducible components
of a locally Noetherian scheme need not form a finite set: neither side is a finite sum of
cycles, and at a fixed point of `X` only finitely many components contribute.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullback_meromorphicDivisor_eq_sum_components (C : ChowSituation.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (sY : Y ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] [IsIntegral Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [Flat f]
    (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX) (r : ℕ) (hf : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension f r) {n : ℤ}
    (hY : schemeDeltaDimension C sY = (n : EInt)) (L : Y.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible Y.presheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (s : L.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)) (hs : s ≠ 0) (x : X) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sY
    (flatPullback C sX sY f hbase r hf (n - 1)
        (meromorphicDivisorCycleOfInvertible C sY hY L s).val).1 x =
      ∑ᶠ W : irreducibleComponents X,
        (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C sX (𝟙 X) (n + (r : ℤ))).1 W.2.1.genericPoint *
          (letI : IsIntegral (integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subscheme :=
             isIntegral_integralComponentAt _
           letI : IsLocallyNoetherian (integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subscheme :=
             LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian
               ((integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι ≫ sX)
           letI := isDominant_subschemeι_integralComponentAt_comp f W
           letI := isInvertible_presheaf_pullback L
             ((integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι ≫ f)
           (properPushforward C ((integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι ≫ sX) sX
             (integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι rfl (n + (r : ℤ) - 1)
             (meromorphicDivisorCycleOfInvertible C
               ((integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι ≫ sX)
               (schemeDeltaDimension_integralComponentAt_comp C sX sY f hbase r hf hY W)
               ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
                 ((integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι ≫ f)).obj L)
               (genericStalkPullback
                 ((integralComponentAt W.2.1.genericPoint).subschemeι ≫ f) L s)).val).1 x)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isProper_bivariantPushforwardBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPK.** The base change of a proper morphism along a test scheme is proper, so the
rule of Stacks 0EPK can push forward along it.
declarations.statement:
instance isProper_bivariantPushforwardBaseChange {X Y Z T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) (t : T ⟶ Z) : IsProper (bivariantPushforwardBaseChange f g t)
declarations.comment: properness of the base change of the proper morphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantProperPushforwardCap_proper_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPK.** The proper-pushforward axiom of Stacks 0B76 for the rule of Stacks 0EPK: the
cap operation `α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)` commutes with proper pushforward along a morphism of test
schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantProperPushforwardCap_proper_naturality {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ Z)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (h : T' ⟶ T) [IsProper h]
    (h' : pullback g (h ≫ t) ⟶ pullback g t)
    (sq : IsPullback (pullback.snd g (h ≫ t)) h' h (pullback.snd g t))
    (hfst : h' ≫ pullback.fst g t = pullback.fst g (h ≫ t)) (k : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroup C ((h ≫ t) ≫ sZ) k) :
    letI : IsProper h' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq (P := @IsProper) inferInstance
    bivariantProperPushforwardCap C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg hpp p c t k
        (properChowPushforward C ((h ≫ t) ≫ sZ) (t ≫ sZ) h (by simp [Category.assoc]) k
          (hpp _ _ _ _ _) α) =
      properChowPushforward C (pullback.fst g (h ≫ t) ≫ sY) (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) h'
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, hfst]) (k - p) (hpp _ _ _ _ _)
        (bivariantProperPushforwardCap C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg hpp p c (h ≫ t) k α)
declarations.comment: the proper-pushforward axiom of the pushed-forward class

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.eq_of_isBivariantProperPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPK.** The rule of Stacks 0EPK determines the pushed-forward class: two bivariant
classes that both push `c` forward along `f` are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_isBivariantProperPushforward
    (h : IsBivariantProperPushforward C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg hpp p c d)
    (h' : IsBivariantProperPushforward C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg hpp p c d') : d = d'
declarations.comment: uniqueness of the pushed-forward class

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.canonicalBivariantProperPushforwardCap_gysin_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPK, the Gysin axiom.** For `c ∈ A^p(X ⟶ Z)` and `f` proper, the rule
`α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)` commutes with the Gysin map `i^*` of Stacks 02TO of the zero scheme of a section
of an invertible module on a test scheme: pushing `f'_*(c ∩ i^* α)` to the zero scheme of the
pulled-back section on `T ×_Z Y` gives `i'^* f'_*(c ∩ α)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem canonicalBivariantProperPushforwardCap_gysin_naturality
    (c : CanonicalBivariantClass C sX sZ (f ≫ g) (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq hf hg) p)
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ Z) [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (L : T.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible T.sheaf.obj T.ringCatSheaf.property L]
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (k : ℤ) :
    let D := Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme T L s
    let L' := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd g t)).obj L
    let s' := AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections (pullback.snd g t) L s
    let E := Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme (pullback g t) L' s'
    ∀ (e : pullback g (D.subschemeι ≫ t) ≅ E.subscheme)
      (_he : e.hom ≫ E.subschemeι = bivariantBaseChangeMap g t D.subschemeι)
      (hbase : e.hom ≫ (E.subschemeι ≫ pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) =
        pullback.fst g (D.subschemeι ≫ t) ≫ sY)
      (α : chowGroup C (t ≫ sZ) (k + 1)),
      properChowPushforward C (pullback.fst g (D.subschemeι ≫ t) ≫ sY)
          (E.subschemeι ≫ pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) e.hom hbase (k - p)
          (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _)
          (bivariantProperPushforwardCap C (canonicalGysinSystem C) sX sY sZ f g hf hg
            (properPushforwardDescends C) p c (D.subschemeι ≫ t) k
            (gysinChowOfInvertible C (t ≫ sZ) k L s α)) =
        gysinChowOfInvertible C (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) (k - p) L' s'
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (chowGroup C (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY))
              (by omega : (k + 1) - p = (k - p) + 1))
            (bivariantProperPushforwardCap C (canonicalGysinSystem C) sX sY sZ f g hf hg
              (properPushforwardDescends C) p c t (k + 1) α))
declarations.comment: the Gysin axiom of Stacks 0B76 for the rule α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.canonicalBivariantProperPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPK.** For `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, `g : Y ⟶ Z` and `c ∈ A^p(X ⟶ Z)`, the rule which to
a test scheme `t : T ⟶ Z` assigns `α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)`, with `f' : T ×_Z X ⟶ T ×_Z Y` the base change
of `f`, is a bivariant class `f_* ∘ c ∈ A^p(Y ⟶ Z)`. Its cap formula is
`Stacks.Chow.canonicalBivariantProperPushforward_cap`.
declarations.statement:
def canonicalBivariantProperPushforward
    (c : CanonicalBivariantClass C sX sZ (f ≫ g) (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq hf hg) p) :
    CanonicalBivariantClass C sY sZ g hg p

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.existsUnique_canonicalBivariantProperPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPK.** For `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, `g : Y ⟶ Z` and `c ∈ A^p(X ⟶ Z)` there is exactly one
bivariant class `f_* ∘ c ∈ A^p(Y ⟶ Z)` whose cap operation is `α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)` on every test
scheme `t : T ⟶ Z`, with `f' : T ×_Z X ⟶ T ×_Z Y` the base change of `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_canonicalBivariantProperPushforward
    (c : CanonicalBivariantClass C sX sZ (f ≫ g) (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq hf hg) p) :
    ∃! d : CanonicalBivariantClass C sY sZ g hg p,
      ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ Z) [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (k : ℤ)
        (α : chowGroup C (t ≫ sZ) k),
        d.cap t k α =
          properChowPushforward C (pullback.fst (f ≫ g) t ≫ sX) (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY)
            (bivariantPushforwardBaseChange f g t)
            (bivariantPushforwardBaseChange_comp_structure hf g t) (k - p)
            (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _) (c.cap t k α)
declarations.comment: existence and uniqueness of f_* ∘ c with its cap formula

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantProperPushforwardCap_flat_naturality_of_factors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPK.** The flat-pullback axiom of Stacks 0B76 for the rule of Stacks 0EPK: the cap
operation `α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)` commutes with flat pullback of fixed relative dimension along a
morphism of test schemes.

The degrees are `(k + r) - p` on the left and `(k - p) + r` on the right, the same integer written
two ways, which is why the conclusion is an `HEq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantProperPushforwardCap_flat_naturality_of_factors {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ Z)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (h : T' ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [Flat h] (r : ℕ)
    (hr : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension h r)
    (h' : pullback g (h ≫ t) ⟶ pullback g t)
    (sq : IsPullback (pullback.snd g (h ≫ t)) h' h (pullback.snd g t))
    (hfst : h' ≫ pullback.fst g t = pullback.fst g (h ≫ t)) (k : ℤ)
    (hr' : letI : LocallyOfFiniteType h' :=
        MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType) inferInstance
      AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension h' r)
    (hfac : FlatPullbackFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C ((h ≫ t) ≫ sZ) (t ≫ sZ) h
      (by simp [Category.assoc]) r hr k)
    (hfac' : letI : LocallyOfFiniteType h' :=
          MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType) inferInstance
        letI : Flat h' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq (P := @Flat) inferInstance
      FlatPullbackFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C (pullback.fst g (h ≫ t) ≫ sY)
        (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) h' (by rw [← Category.assoc, hfst]) r hr' (k - p))
    (α : chowGroup C (t ≫ sZ) k) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType h' :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType) inferInstance
    letI : Flat h' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq (P := @Flat) inferInstance
    bivariantProperPushforwardCap C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg hpp p c (h ≫ t) (k + (r : ℤ))
        (flatPullbackChow C ((h ≫ t) ≫ sZ) (t ≫ sZ) h (by simp [Category.assoc]) r hr k
          hfac α) ≍
      flatPullbackChow C (pullback.fst g (h ≫ t) ≫ sY) (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) h'
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, hfst]) r hr' (k - p) hfac'
        (bivariantProperPushforwardCap C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg hpp p c t k α)
declarations.comment: the flat-pullback axiom of the pushed-forward class

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantProperPushforwardCap_proper_naturality_unconditional
declarations.doc:
The proper-pushforward axiom of Stacks 0B76 for the rule of Stacks 0EPK, with proper
pushforward on Chow groups taken along the descent `Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardDescends`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantProperPushforwardCap_proper_naturality_unconditional {T T' : Scheme.{u}}
    (t : T ⟶ Z) [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (h : T' ⟶ T) [IsProper h]
    (h' : pullback g (h ≫ t) ⟶ pullback g t)
    (sq : IsPullback (pullback.snd g (h ≫ t)) h' h (pullback.snd g t))
    (hfst : h' ≫ pullback.fst g t = pullback.fst g (h ≫ t)) (k : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroup C ((h ≫ t) ≫ sZ) k) :
    letI : IsProper h' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq (P := @IsProper) inferInstance
    bivariantProperPushforwardCap C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg (properPushforwardDescends C) p c t k
        (properChowPushforward C ((h ≫ t) ≫ sZ) (t ≫ sZ) h (by simp [Category.assoc]) k
          (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _) α) =
      properChowPushforward C (pullback.fst g (h ≫ t) ≫ sY) (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) h'
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, hfst]) (k - p) (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _)
        (bivariantProperPushforwardCap C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg (properPushforwardDescends C) p c
          (h ≫ t) k α)
declarations.comment: the proper-pushforward axiom of the pushed-forward class, with NOTHING ASSUMED: the descent of Stacks 02S2 is the theorem Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardDescends

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantProperPushforwardCap_flat_naturality_unconditional
declarations.doc:
The flat-pullback axiom of Stacks 0B76 for the rule of Stacks 0EPK, with flat pullback and
proper pushforward on Chow groups taken along the descents `Stacks.Chow.flatPullbackDescends` and
`Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardDescends`, and the relative dimension of the base change given by
Stacks 02NK.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantProperPushforwardCap_flat_naturality_unconditional {T T' : Scheme.{u}}
    (t : T ⟶ Z) [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (h : T' ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [Flat h] (r : ℕ)
    (hr : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension h r)
    (h' : pullback g (h ≫ t) ⟶ pullback g t)
    (sq : IsPullback (pullback.snd g (h ≫ t)) h' h (pullback.snd g t))
    (hfst : h' ≫ pullback.fst g t = pullback.fst g (h ≫ t)) (k : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroup C (t ≫ sZ) k) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType h' :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType) inferInstance
    letI : Flat h' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq (P := @Flat) inferInstance
    HEq
      (bivariantProperPushforwardCap C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg (properPushforwardDescends C) p c
        (h ≫ t) (k + (r : ℤ))
        (flatPullbackChow C ((h ≫ t) ≫ sZ) (t ≫ sZ) h (by simp [Category.assoc]) r hr k
          (flatPullbackDescends C _ _ _ _ _ _ _) α))
      (flatPullbackChow C (pullback.fst g (h ≫ t) ≫ sY) (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) h'
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, hfst]) r
        (AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension.of_isPullback sq hr) (k - p)
        (flatPullbackDescends C _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
        (bivariantProperPushforwardCap C G sX sY sZ f g hf hg (properPushforwardDescends C) p c t k
          α))
declarations.comment: the flat-pullback axiom of the pushed-forward class, with NOTHING ASSUMED: Stacks 02RG on Chow groups is the theorem Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardFlatPullbackBaseChange, and the two descents are Stacks.Chow.flatPullbackDescends and Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardDescends

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantProperPushforwardCap_gysin_naturality_ofInvertible
declarations.doc:
The Gysin axiom of Stacks 0B76 for the rule of Stacks 0EPK at the Gysin system
`Stacks.Chow.gysinSystemOfInvertible` of the first Chern class rule, with proper pushforward on
Chow groups taken along the descent `Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardDescends`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantProperPushforwardCap_gysin_naturality_ofInvertible {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ Z)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (L : T.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible T.sheaf.obj T.ringCatSheaf.property L]
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (k : ℤ)
    (e : pullback g ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme T L s).subschemeι ≫ t) ≅
      (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme (pullback g t)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd g t)).obj L)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections (pullback.snd g t) L s)).subscheme)
    (he : e.hom ≫ (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme (pullback g t)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd g t)).obj L)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections (pullback.snd g t) L s)).subschemeι =
      bivariantBaseChangeMap g t (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme T L s).subschemeι)
    (hbase : e.hom ≫ ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme (pullback g t)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd g t)).obj L)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections (pullback.snd g t) L s)).subschemeι ≫
        pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) =
      pullback.fst g ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme T L s).subschemeι ≫ t) ≫ sY)
    (α : chowGroup C (t ≫ sZ) (k + 1)) :
    properChowPushforward C
        (pullback.fst g ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme T L s).subschemeι ≫ t) ≫ sY)
        ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme (pullback g t)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd g t)).obj L)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections (pullback.snd g t) L s)).subschemeι ≫
          pullback.fst g t ≫ sY) e.hom hbase (k - p)
        (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _)
        (bivariantProperPushforwardCap C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX sY sZ f g hf hg
          (properPushforwardDescends C) p c
          ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme T L s).subschemeι ≫ t) k
          ((gysinSystemOfInvertible C).onChow (t ≫ sZ) L s k α)) =
      (gysinSystemOfInvertible C).onChow (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd g t)).obj L)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections (pullback.snd g t) L s) (k - p)
        (Eq.mp (congrArg (chowGroup C (pullback.fst g t ≫ sY))
          (by omega : k + 1 - p = k - p + 1))
          (bivariantProperPushforwardCap C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX sY sZ f g hf hg
            (properPushforwardDescends C) p c t (k + 1) α))
declarations.comment: the Gysin axiom of the pushed-forward class at the Gysin system of the first Chern class rule, with NOTHING ASSUMED: Stacks 02TA for that Gysin system is a pair of theorems here, the identification is Stacks 0B6Y, and the descent of Stacks 02S2 is Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardDescends

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantProperPushforwardOfInvertible
declarations.doc:
The proper pushforward `f_* ∘ c ∈ A^p(Y ⟶ Z)` of a bivariant class `c ∈ A^p(X ⟶ Z)` along a
proper `f : X ⟶ Y`, at the Gysin system of the first Chern class rule: the bivariant class whose
cap operation is the rule `α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)` of `Stacks.Chow.bivariantProperPushforwardCap`.
declarations.statement:
def bivariantProperPushforwardOfInvertible :
    BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sY sZ g hg p
declarations.comment: the pushed-forward class f_* ∘ c itself, at the Gysin system of the first Chern class rule, with NOTHING ASSUMED: the rule of the lemma IS a bivariant class, so the three axioms of Stacks 0B76 for it are the three fields of this term, and Stacks 02RG, Stacks 02TA for this Gysin system and Stacks 02S2 are all theorems of this repository

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isBivariantProperPushforward_bivariantProperPushforwardOfInvertible
declarations.doc:
The class `Stacks.Chow.bivariantProperPushforwardOfInvertible` caps by the rule
`α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)`, so it is the proper pushforward of `c` in the sense of
`Stacks.Chow.IsBivariantProperPushforward`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isBivariantProperPushforward_bivariantProperPushforwardOfInvertible :
    IsBivariantProperPushforward C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX sY sZ f g hf hg
      (properPushforwardDescends C) p c
      (bivariantProperPushforwardOfInvertible C sX sY sZ f g hf hg p c)
declarations.comment: the constructed class satisfies the characterization Stacks.Chow.IsBivariantProperPushforward of the same tag, with NOTHING ASSUMED, so the uniqueness statement is about a nonempty collection

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_isBivariantProperPushforward_ofInvertible
declarations.doc:
For a proper `f : X ⟶ Y`, a morphism `g : Y ⟶ Z` and a bivariant class `c` of degree `p` for
`f ≫ g` against the Gysin system of the first Chern class rule, there is a bivariant class of
degree `p` for `g` whose cap operation is `α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isBivariantProperPushforward_ofInvertible :
    ∃ d : BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sY sZ g hg p,
      IsBivariantProperPushforward C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX sY sZ f g hf hg
        (properPushforwardDescends C) p c d
declarations.comment: existence of the pushed-forward class at the Gysin system of the first Chern class rule, with NOTHING ASSUMED

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantProperPushforwardExistsOfInvertible
declarations.doc:
The bundled existence statement `Stacks.Chow.BivariantProperPushforwardExists` of
Stacks 0EPK holds at the Gysin system of the first Chern class rule.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantProperPushforwardExistsOfInvertible (C : ChowSituation.{u}) :
    BivariantProperPushforwardExists C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C)
declarations.comment: the bundled existence statement at the Gysin system of the first Chern class rule, with NOTHING ASSUMED: Stacks 02RG on Chow groups and Stacks 02TA for this Gysin system are both theorems of this repository

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.eq_of_isBivariantProperPushforward_unconditional
declarations.doc:
Two bivariant classes that both push `c` forward along `f`, with proper pushforward on Chow
groups taken along the descent `Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardDescends`, are equal.
declarations.comment: uniqueness of the pushed-forward class, with NOTHING ASSUMED: the descent of Stacks 02S2 is the theorem Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardDescends

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_point_over_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `X` decent, let `x` be a point
of `X` and let `V` be an elementary étale neighborhood of the image of `x`. The fibre product
`V ×_Y X` has exactly one point lying above the distinguished point of `V` and above `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_point_over_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsDecentSpace B S hS X.1)
    (x : points B S hS X.1)
    (V : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS Y.1 Y.property
      (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom x)) :
    ∃! x' : points B S hS (pullback V.toSpace f.hom),
      pointsMap B S hS (pullback V.toSpace f.hom) (pullback.fst V.toSpace f.hom) x' =
          presheafPoint B S hS V.scheme V.point V.residueField_contained ∧
        pointsMap B S hS (pullback V.toSpace f.hom) (pullback.snd V.toSpace f.hom) x' = x
declarations.comment: the unique point above the two distinguished points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.yoneda_map_neighborhoodOver_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPL.** The two charts form a commutative square over `f`: the chart of the upper
elementary étale neighborhood maps to the chart of the lower one compatibly with `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem yoneda_map_neighborhoodOver_comp :
    yoneda.map (neighborhoodOver B S hS f V U) ≫ V.toSpace =
      neighborhoodToSource B S hS f V U ≫ f.hom
declarations.comment: the square of charts over f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.neighborhoodOver_point
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPL.** The morphism of chart schemes carries the distinguished point of the upper
elementary étale neighborhood to that of the lower one.
declarations.statement:
theorem neighborhoodOver_point
    (hx' : pointsMap B S hS (pullback V.toSpace f.hom) (pullback.fst V.toSpace f.hom) x' =
      presheafPoint B S hS V.scheme V.point V.residueField_contained) :
    (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (neighborhoodOver B S hS f V U) U.point = V.point
declarations.comment: the morphism of charts is pointed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.neighborhoodOverSource
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPL.** An elementary étale neighborhood of a point `x'` of `V ×_Y X` lying over
the distinguished point of `V` and over `x` is an elementary étale neighborhood of `x` in `X`.

This is what makes the identifications of the remark available at `(U, u)`: Stacks 0EMY and
Properties of Spaces, Lemma 04KF both ask for an elementary étale neighborhood of the point of
the space whose local rings are being computed.
declarations.statement:
def neighborhoodOverSource
    (hfst : pointsMap B S hS (pullback V.toSpace f.hom) (pullback.fst V.toSpace f.hom) x' =
      presheafPoint B S hS V.scheme V.point V.residueField_contained)
    (hsnd : pointsMap B S hS (pullback V.toSpace f.hom) (pullback.snd V.toSpace f.hom) x' = x) :
    ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X.1 X.property x
declarations.comment: the upper neighborhood is one of the source

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_henselianLocalRingMap_of_neighborhood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPL.** Let `(U, u)` be an elementary étale neighborhood of a point `x` of a decent
algebraic space `X`, let `(W, w)` be one of a point `y` of a decent algebraic space `Y` and let
`j : U ⟶ W` be a morphism of the chart schemes carrying `u` to `w`. Then there is a local
homomorphism `𝒪^h_{Y, y} ⟶ 𝒪^h_{X, x}` over the map `𝒪_{W, w} ⟶ 𝒪_{U, u}` of neighborhood
stalks.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_henselianLocalRingMap_of_neighborhood
    (j : U.scheme ⟶ W.scheme) (hj : j.left.1 U.point = W.point) :
    letI := isLocalRing_henselianLocalRing B S hS hX hXdec x
    letI := isLocalRing_henselianLocalRing B S hS hY hYdec y
    ∃ φ : (henselianLocalRing B S hS Y hY y hYdec : Type (u + 1)) →+*
        (henselianLocalRing B S hS X hX x hXdec : Type (u + 1)),
      IsLocalHom φ ∧
      φ.comp (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS Y hY y hYdec W) =
        (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS X hX x hXdec U).comp
          ((W.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hj.symm)).hom ≫
            j.left.1.stalkMap U.point).hom
declarations.comment: the square of henselian local rings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_diagram_of_neighborhood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPL, the commutative diagram.** For a pointed morphism `k : (N, n) ⟶ (M, m)` of
elementary étale neighborhoods over `g : X ⟶ Y`, the rows

`𝒪_{M, m} ⟶ 𝒪^h_{Y, y} ⟶ 𝒪_{Y, w̄}`  and  `𝒪_{N, n} ⟶ 𝒪^h_{X, z} ⟶ 𝒪_{X, z̄}`

are joined by local homomorphisms making both squares commute, over the map `𝒪_{M, m} ⟶ 𝒪_{N, n}`
of neighborhood stalks; and the étale and henselian local rings of the two spaces are the strict
henselization and the henselization of the respective neighborhood stalks.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_diagram_of_neighborhood (hzbar : zbar.LiesOver z)
    (hwbar : wbar.LiesOver (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z)) :
    letI := isLocalRing_henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.property hXd z
    letI := isLocalRing_henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.property hYd
      (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z)
    letI := isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property zbar
    letI := isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property wbar
    ∃ (algN : Algebra (N.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk N.point : Type u)
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)))
      (algM : Algebra (M.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk M.point : Type u)
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)))
      (algHX : Algebra (henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd : Type (u + 1))
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)))
      (algHY : Algebra (henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
            (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd : Type (u + 1))
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)))
      (φ : (henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
            (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd : Type (u + 1)) →+*
          (henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd : Type (u + 1)))
      (ψ : (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) →+*
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1))),
      IsLocalHom φ ∧ IsLocalHom ψ ∧
      φ.comp (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
            (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd M) =
          (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd N).comp
            ((M.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hk.symm)).hom ≫
              k.left.1.stalkMap N.point).hom ∧
      (@algebraMap (henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd : Type (u + 1))
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algHX).comp
          (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd N) =
        @algebraMap (N.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk N.point : Type u)
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algN ∧
      (@algebraMap (henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
              (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd : Type (u + 1))
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algHY).comp
          (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
            (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd M) =
        @algebraMap (M.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk M.point : Type u)
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algM ∧
      ψ.comp (@algebraMap (henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
              (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd : Type (u + 1))
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algHY) =
        (@algebraMap (henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd : Type (u + 1))
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algHX).comp φ ∧
      @IsHenselization (N.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk N.point : Type u) _ _ κN _ _
        (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algN ∧
      @IsHenselization (M.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk M.point : Type u) _ _ κM _ _
        (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algM
declarations.comment: the commutative diagram, as a diagram of ring homomorphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_diagram
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPL.** Let `g : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of decent algebraic spaces over `S`, let `z`
be a point of `X` with image `y` in `Y`, and let `z̄` and `w̄` be geometric points of `X` and of
`Y` lying over `z` and over `y`. Then there are an elementary étale neighborhood `(M, m)` of
`y`, an elementary étale neighborhood `(N, n)` of `z` and a morphism `k : N ⟶ M` of chart
schemes over `g` carrying `n` to `m`, for which the two rows

`𝒪_{M, m} ⟶ 𝒪^h_{Y, y} ⟶ 𝒪_{Y, w̄}`  and  `𝒪_{N, n} ⟶ 𝒪^h_{X, z} ⟶ 𝒪_{X, z̄}`

are joined by local homomorphisms making both squares commute, the étale local rings being
strict henselizations and the henselian local rings henselizations of the two neighborhood
stalks.

Both choices of the remark are made here: `(M, m)` by Stacks 0BBP, and `(N, n)` together with
`k` by base change of `(M, m)` along `g`, which runs through the fibre product `M ×_Y X` and
chooses an elementary étale neighborhood of the point of it above `m` and `z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_diagram (hzbar : zbar.LiesOver z)
    (hwbar : wbar.LiesOver (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z)) :
    letI := isLocalRing_henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.property hXd z
    letI := isLocalRing_henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.property hYd
      (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z)
    letI := isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property zbar
    letI := isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property wbar
    ∃ (M₀ : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
          (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z))
      (N₀ : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z)
      (k₀ : N₀.scheme ⟶ M₀.scheme) (hk₀ : k₀.left.1 N₀.point = M₀.point)
      (algN : Algebra (N₀.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk N₀.point : Type u)
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)))
      (algM : Algebra (M₀.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk M₀.point : Type u)
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)))
      (algHX : Algebra (henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd : Type (u + 1))
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)))
      (algHY : Algebra (henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
            (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd : Type (u + 1))
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)))
      (φ : (henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
            (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd : Type (u + 1)) →+*
          (henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd : Type (u + 1)))
      (ψ : (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) →+*
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1))),
      yoneda.map k₀ ≫ M₀.toSpace = N₀.toSpace ≫ g.hom ∧
      IsLocalHom φ ∧ IsLocalHom ψ ∧
      φ.comp (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
            (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd M₀) =
          (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd N₀).comp
            ((M₀.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hk₀.symm)).hom ≫
              k₀.left.1.stalkMap N₀.point).hom ∧
      (@algebraMap (henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd : Type (u + 1))
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algHX).comp
          (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd N₀) =
        @algebraMap (N₀.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk N₀.point : Type u)
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algN ∧
      (@algebraMap (henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
              (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd : Type (u + 1))
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algHY).comp
          (stalkToHenselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
            (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd M₀) =
        @algebraMap (M₀.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk M₀.point : Type u)
          (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algM ∧
      ψ.comp (@algebraMap (henselianLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 Ys.property
              (pointsMap B S hS Xs.1 g.hom z) hYd : Type (u + 1))
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algHY) =
        (@algebraMap (henselianLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 Xs.property z hXd : Type (u + 1))
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algHX).comp φ ∧
      @IsHenselization (N₀.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk N₀.point : Type u) _ _ (SeparableClosure
          (ResidueField (N₀.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk N₀.point : Type u))) _ _
        (etaleLocalRing B S hS Xs.1 zbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algN ∧
      @IsHenselization (M₀.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk M₀.point : Type u) _ _ (SeparableClosure
          (ResidueField (M₀.scheme.left.1.presheaf.stalk M₀.point : Type u))) _ _
        (etaleLocalRing B S hS Ys.1 wbar : Type (u + 1)) _ _ algM
declarations.comment: the remark, with both choices made

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPullbackDefined_of_isPullback_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces and let `D ⊆ X` be an effective Cartier
divisor whose structure morphism `D ⟶ Y` is flat.  Then for every morphism `g : Y' ⟶ Y` and
every fibre product square exhibiting `X'` as `Y' ×_Y X`, the pullback of `D` along the
projection `g' : X' ⟶ X` is defined: the inverse image of `D` on `X'` is again an effective
Cartier divisor.

Stacks 0EPN asks `g` to be a morphism of schemes and `X'` to be the chosen fibre product; it is
stated here for an arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces and an arbitrary cartesian square.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullbackDefined_of_isPullback_of_isFlat {X Y Y' X' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (hsq : IsPullback f' g' g f)
    (D : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X.1) (hD : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor B S hS X D)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS (D.1.ι ≫ f.hom)) :
    IsPullbackDefined B S hS g' D

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsRelativeEffectiveCartierDivisor
declarations.doc:
A closed subspace `D ⊆ X` is a *relative effective Cartier divisor* on `X` over `Y`, for a
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces, when `D` is an effective Cartier divisor on `X` and the
structure morphism `D ⟶ Y` is flat.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev IsRelativeEffectiveCartierDivisor {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (D : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X.1) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_isTrivialAtCodimensionZeroPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EPQ.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over a scheme `S` satisfying conditions (a),
(b) and (c) of Stacks 0ENA — every weakly associated point of `X` has codimension `0`, the
irreducible components of `X` are locally finite, and every codimension-zero point of `X` is
representable by a monomorphism from the spectrum of a field.  Then **every invertible
`𝒪_X`-module `ℒ` has a regular meromorphic section.**

The choice of the generators `s_η ∈ ℒ_η` that the source makes is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CodimensionZeroPresentation.nonempty_iso_unit_of_isInvertibleModule`
above, the triviality of an invertible module on the small étale site of `Spec(𝒪_{X, η})`,
composed with `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePullbackInvertible`.  Those trivialisations give
`𝒦_X ≅ 𝒦_X(ℒ)` by `CodimensionZeroPresentation.nonempty_uliftUnit_iso_meromorphicSectionSheaf`,
