(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pullbackDivisor_eq_vanishingLocus`). Then for every `(k+1)`-cycle `α'`
on `X'`

`i^* f_* α' = g_* (i')^* α'` in `CH_k(E)`,

where `i^*` and `(i')^*` are the refined Gysin homomorphisms `Z_{k+1}(·) → CH_k(·)` of
Stacks 0ER1 of the two triples, at their constructed component rules
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionGysinRule`: clause (1)(a) the cycle `[E ∩ W]_k` of Stacks 0EE9,
clause (1)(b) `c₁(ℒ|_W) ∩ [W]`), `f_*` is proper pushforward of cycles (Stacks 0EP1), the Chow
groups are those of Stacks 0EQ6 (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical`, `div(f)` read at
the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK) and `g_*` is proper pushforward on Chow groups,
Stacks 0EQC (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonicalProperPushforward`).
declarations.statement:
theorem sectionGysin_properPushforward_eq_chowGroupCanonicalProperPushforward
    (α' : CycleGroup D p' (k + 1)) :
    chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D ((vanishingLocus D p hp L s).1.ι ≫ p)
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s) k
        (gysinCycleMap D p (vanishingLocus D p hp L s) (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s) k
          (sectionGysinRule D p hp L s k hL)
          (properCyclePushforward D p' hp' p hp hfbase hf.2.1.2 (k + 1) α')) =
      chowGroupCanonicalProperPushforward.{u + 1} D
        ((pullbackSectionVanishingLocus D p hp p' hp' f L s).1.ι ≫ p')
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D p' hp' _ _)
        ((vanishingLocus D p hp L s).1.ι ≫ p) (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s)
        (pullbackVanishingLocusProjection_comp_structure D p hp p' hp' f L s hL hfbase)
        (isProper_pullbackVanishingLocusProjection D p hp p' hp' f L s hL hf) k
        (chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D
          ((pullbackSectionVanishingLocus D p hp p' hp' f L s).1.ι ≫ p')
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D p' hp' _ _) k
          (gysinCycleMap D p' (pullbackSectionVanishingLocus D p hp p' hp' f L s)
            (isGood_vanishingLocus D p' hp' _ _) k
            (sectionGysinRule D p' hp' (pullbackSheaf D p hp p' hp' f L)
              (pullbackGlobalSection D p hp p' hp' f L s) k
              (isInvertibleSheaf_pullbackSheaf D p hp p' hp' f L hL)) α'))
declarations.comment: i^* f_* α' = g_* (i')^* α' in CH_k(D) for f : X' → X proper between good algebraic spaces over B, (L, s, i : D → X) as in 0ER1 and the diagram of 0ER3 (L' = f^*L, s' = f^*s, D' = Z(s') = X' ×_X D): both Gysin maps are 0ER1's at the constructed rules sectionGysinRule, CH_k = chowGroupCanonical of 0EQ6, f_* the proper pushforward of cycles of 0EP1 and g_* the proper pushforward on Chow groups of 0EQC; unconditional

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap_properPushforward_eq_of_genericPointData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ER5, with the non-contained branch of the comparison proved rather than carried.**
In Situation 0EDT let `f : X' ⟶ X` be a quasi-compact morphism of good algebraic spaces over
`B`, let `E ⊆ X` be a closed subspace with closed immersion `i : E → X`, and form the diagram of
Remark 0ER3, with `E'` a closed subspace of `X'` whose point set is `|f|^{-1}|E|`, sitting in a
cartesian square with `g : E' ⟶ E` and `i' : E' ⟶ X'`.  Then for every `(k+1)`-cycle `α'` on
`X'`

`i^* f_* α' = g_* (i')^* α'`,

an identity of `k`-cycles on `E`, hence of classes in `CH_k(E)`, for the refined Gysin maps of
Stacks 0ER1 built on the canonical component rule of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.canonicalGysinComponentRule`.

Two things are carried.  `hdata`, the local dictionary at the generic points of the pairs with
`W' ⊄ E'` — from which **the degree count of the source's first case is proved**, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properCycleDegree_mul_gysinIntersectionMult_eq_finsum`.  And `hchern`,
the source's second case, which compares the cap products of Stacks 0EQJ on `X` and on `X'`:
clause (1)(b) of Stacks 0ER1 is the free parameter
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GysinComponentRule.chernCycle`, so `chern` and `chern'` are unrelated
data and no relation between them is derivable here.  See the implementation notes of
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Spaces.Chow.GysinProperPushforwardGenericPoints`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinCycleMap_properPushforward_eq_of_genericPointData
    (hfbase : f ≫ p = p') (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact D.site D.base D.base_mem f)
    (hgbase : g ≫ (E.1.ι ≫ p) = E'.1.ι ≫ p')
    (hgqc : IsQuasiCompact D.site D.base D.base_mem g)
    (hsq : IsPullback g E'.1.ι E.1.ι f)
    (hpt : subspacePointSet D.site D.base D.base_mem X' E'.1 =
      pointsMap D.site D.base D.base_mem X' f ⁻¹'
        subspacePointSet D.site D.base D.base_mem X E.1)
    (chern : FirstChernComponentCycleRule D p k)
    (chern' : FirstChernComponentCycleRule D p' k)
    (hdata : ∀ (W' : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X')
        (T : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem E.1.toFunctor),
      ¬ W'.subspace ≤ E'.1 →
        Nonempty (GysinProperPushforwardGenericPointDatum.{u, v} D p hp p' hp' f E hE E' hE' g k
            W' T))
    (hchern : ∀ (W' : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X'),
      deltaDimension D p' W' = k + 1 → W'.subspace ≤ E'.1 →
      ∀ T : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem E.1.toFunctor,
        (∑ᶠ W : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X,
            properCycleMult D p' hp' p hp f W' W *
              (gysinComponentCycle D p E hE k
                (canonicalGysinComponentRule D p hp E hE k chern) W).1 T) =
          ∑ᶠ T' : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem E'.1.toFunctor,
            (gysinComponentCycle D p' E' hE' k
                (canonicalGysinComponentRule D p' hp' E' hE' k chern') W').1 T' *
              properCycleMult D (E'.1.ι ≫ p') hE' (E.1.ι ≫ p) hE g T' T)
    (α' : CycleGroup D p' (k + 1)) :
    gysinCycleMap D p E hE k (canonicalGysinComponentRule D p hp E hE k chern)
        (properCyclePushforward D p' hp' p hp hfbase hfqc (k + 1) α') =
      properCyclePushforward D (E'.1.ι ≫ p') hE' (E.1.ι ≫ p) hE hgbase hgqc k
        (gysinCycleMap D p' E' hE' k
          (canonicalGysinComponentRule D p' hp' E' hE' k chern') α')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap_flatPullbackMap_eq_of_comparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ER6.** In Situation 0EDT let `f : X' ⟶ X` be a flat morphism of relative dimension
`r` of good algebraic spaces over `B`, let `(ℒ, s, i : E → X)` be as in Definition 0ER1, and form
the diagram of Remark 0ER3, with `E' = E ×_X X'`, `g : E' ⟶ E` and `i' : E' ⟶ X'`.  Then for every
`(k+1)`-cycle `α` on `X`

  `(i')^* f^* α = g^* i^* α`,

an identity of `(k+r)`-cycles on `E'`, hence of classes in `CH_{k+r}(E')`.

`hsq` is the cartesian square of Remark 0ER3, which makes `E'` the scheme-theoretic base change
`E ×_X X'`.  Flatness of `g` and its relative dimension `r` are hypotheses: the source gets them
from `f` by base change along `i`.
`hkr` is the degree bookkeeping `(k+1) + r = (k+r) + 1`, which is the convention of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullbackMap`.

The single hypothesis beyond the setup is `cmp`, the comparison datum
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GysinFlatPullbackComparison`, whose docstring explains why it does not
follow from the other data.  Everything else — in particular the passage from the
prime cycles of the source's case analysis to an arbitrary cycle, which is not formal because a
cycle is an infinite formal sum — is proved.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinCycleMap_flatPullbackMap_eq_of_comparison
    (hkr : k + 1 + (r : ℤ) = k + (r : ℤ) + 1)
    (cmp : GysinFlatPullbackComparison D p hp p' hp' f hfbase r hflat hr E hE E' hE' g hgbase
      hgflat hgr k rule rule')
    (hsq : IsPullback g E'.1.ι E.1.ι f) (α : CycleGroup D p (k + 1)) :
    gysinCycleMap D p' E' hE' (k + (r : ℤ)) rule'
        (flatPullbackMap D p' hp' p hp f hfbase r hflat hr (k + 1) (k + (r : ℤ) + 1)
          hkr α) =
      flatPullbackMap D (E'.1.ι ≫ p') hE' (E.1.ι ≫ p) hE g hgbase r hgflat hgr k
        (k + (r : ℤ)) rfl (gysinCycleMap D p E hE k rule α)
declarations.comment:
(i')^*f^*α = g^*i^*α at the level of cycles, on the single carried input
GysinFlatPullbackComparison: the source's prime-cycle case analysis read coefficientwise at the
two component parameters of Definition 0ER1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_flatPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ER6.**  In Situation 0EDT let `f : X' ⟶ X` be a morphism over `B` of good algebraic
spaces which is flat of relative dimension `r`, let `(ℒ, s, i : E → X)` be as in Definition 0ER1
(`ℒ` invertible, `s ∈ Γ(X, ℒ)`, `E = Z(s)`), and form the diagram of Remark 0ER3: `ℒ' = f^*ℒ`,
`s' = f^*s`, `E' = Z(s') = X' ×_X E` with `i' : E' → X'` and the projection `g : E' ⟶ E`, which is
flat of relative dimension `r`.  Then for every `(k + 1)`-cycle `α` on `X`

`(i')^* f^* α = g^* i^* α`   in `CH_{k+r}(E')`.

Here `i^*`, `(i')^*` are the Gysin maps on cycles of Stacks 0ER1 at their constructed component
rules, `f^*`, `g^*` the flat pullbacks of cycles of Stacks 0EP8, and `CH_{k+r}(E')` the Chow
group of Stacks 0EQ6 (`div(f_j)` at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK).
declarations.statement:
theorem chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_flatPullbackMap (α : CycleGroup D p (k + 1)) :
    chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D ((pullbackSectionVanishingLocus D p hp p' hp' f L s).1.ι ≫ p')
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D p' hp' _ _) (k + (r : ℤ))
        (gysinCycleMap D p' (pullbackSectionVanishingLocus D p hp p' hp' f L s)
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D p' hp' _ _) (k + (r : ℤ))
          (sectionGysinRule D p' hp' (pullbackSheaf D p hp p' hp' f L)
            (pullbackGlobalSection D p hp p' hp' f L s) (k + (r : ℤ))
            (isInvertibleSheaf_pullbackSheaf D p hp p' hp' f L hL))
          (flatPullbackMap D p' hp' p hp f.hom hfbase r hflat hr (k + 1) (k + (r : ℤ) + 1)
            (by ring) α)) =
      chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D ((pullbackSectionVanishingLocus D p hp p' hp' f L s).1.ι ≫ p')
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D p' hp' _ _) (k + (r : ℤ))
        (flatPullbackMap D ((pullbackSectionVanishingLocus D p hp p' hp' f L s).1.ι ≫ p')
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D p' hp' _ _) ((vanishingLocus D p hp L s).1.ι ≫ p)
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s)
          (pullbackVanishingLocusProjection D p hp p' hp' f L s hL)
          (pullbackVanishingLocusProjection_comp_structure D p hp p' hp' f L s hL hfbase) r
          (isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_pullbackVanishingLocusProjection D p hp p' hp' f L s
            hfbase r hflat hr hL).1
          (isFlat_and_hasRelativeDimension_pullbackVanishingLocusProjection D p hp p' hp' f L s
            hfbase r hflat hr hL).2 k (k + (r : ℤ)) rfl
          (gysinCycleMap D p (vanishingLocus D p hp L s) (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s) k
            (sectionGysinRule D p hp L s k hL) α))
declarations.comment: (i')^* f^* α = g^* i^* α in CH_{k+r}(D') for f : X' → X flat of relative dimension r between good spaces over B, (L, s, i : D → X) as in 0ER1 and D' = Z(f^*s) = X' ×_X D as in 0ER3 (g : D' → D flat of relative dimension r by base change); the Gysin maps of 0ER1 at their constructed rules (sectionGysinRule), the flat pullbacks of cycles of 0EP8, CH = chowGroupCanonical of 0EQ6. Unconditional: the case W ⊄ D is 0EQQ for f^{-1}(W) → W (an identity of cycles), the case W ⊆ D is 0EQR at one integral closed subspace, reassembled by 0EQ8

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap_closedSubspaceCycle_coe_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ER7.**  In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and let `(ℒ, s, i : E → X)` be a triple
as in Definition 0ER1: `ℒ` invertible, `s` a global section of it and `E = Z(s)` its vanishing
locus.  Let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subspace with `dim_δ(Z) ≤ k + 1` whose intersection `E ∩ Z` is an
effective Cartier divisor on `Z`.  Then

  `i^*([Z]_{k + 1}) = [E ∩ Z]_k`.

The left-hand side is the refined Gysin map of Stacks 0ER1 at the component rule
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.canonicalGysinComponentRule`, so clause (1)(a) is the cycle
`[E ∩ W]_k` of Stacks 0EE9 that the source means and only clause (1)(b) — the cap product
`c₁(ℒ|_W) ∩ [W]` of Stacks 0EQJ — is the free parameter `chern` that Definition 0ER1 takes it to
be in this library.  The cycle `[Z]_{k+1}` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closedSubspaceCycle`, which
is Stacks 0EE9 as an element of `Z_{k+1}(X)`, and the identity is stated coefficientwise so that
`[E ∩ Z]_k` needs no δ-dimension bound of its own: both sides are coefficient families on the
integral closed subspaces of `E`.

**Nothing of the source's proof is assumed.**  The first two sentences — that the hypothesis is
the regularity of `s|_Z` and that therefore `E ∩ Z = Z(s|_Z)` — are
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEffectiveCartierDivisor_interOnClosedSubspace_iff_isRegularSection` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.interOnClosedSubspace_eq_zeroScheme`; Lemma 0EQL for `(Z, ℒ|_Z, s|_Z)` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_zeroScheme_eq_componentZeroCycleSumCoeff`,
transported to the ambient `X` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_interOnVanishingLocus_eq_finsum`; the
non-containment `Z_i ⊄ E` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.not_le_vanishingLocus_of_cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_ne_zero`; and the
final matching against the definition of the Gysin map is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinComponentCycle_of_not_le`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinCycleMap_closedSubspaceCycle_coe_eq
    (hL : IsInvertibleSheaf D p hp L)
    (chern : FirstChernComponentCycleRule D p k)
    (hZdim : deltaDimensionSubspace D p hp Z.1 Z.2 ≤ ((k + 1 : ℤ) : EInt))
    (hCartier : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨Z.1.toFunctor, Z.2.1⟩
      (interOnClosedSubspace D p hp L s Z)) :
    (gysinCycleMap D p (vanishingLocus D p hp L s) (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s) k
        (canonicalGysinComponentRule D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L s)
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s) k chern)
        (closedSubspaceCycle D p hp Z.1 Z.2 (k + 1) hZdim)).1 =
      cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace D ((vanishingLocus D p hp L s).1.ι ≫ p)
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s)
        (interOnVanishingLocus D p hp L s Z).1 (interOnVanishingLocus D p hp L s Z).2 k
        (canonicalGeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem
          (interOnVanishingLocus D p hp L s Z).1.toFunctor)
declarations.comment:
i^*([Z]_{k+1}) = [D ∩ Z]_k for a closed subspace Z with dim_δ(Z) ≤ k+1 whose
intersection with D is an effective Cartier divisor on Z, stated coefficientwise on the integral
closed subspaces of D so that no δ-dimension bound on D ∩ Z is needed; the Gysin map is the one
of Stacks 0ER1 at canonicalGysinComponentRule, so clause (1)(a) is the cycle [D ∩ W]_k of
Stacks 0EE9 and only clause (1)(b), the cap product of Stacks 0EQJ, is the free parameter chern
that Definition 0ER1 takes it to be here; Stacks 0EQL for (Z, s|_Z) and the non-containment of
the components of Z in D are proved, not assumed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap_canonical_eq_of_cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ER7, as an equality of cycles.**  In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and let
`(ℒ, s, i : E → X)` be a triple as in Definition 0ER1.  Let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subspace with
`dim_δ(Z) ≤ k + 1` whose intersection `E ∩ Z` is an effective Cartier divisor on `Z`.  Then

  `i^*([Z]_{k + 1}) = [E ∩ Z]_k`

in `Z_k(E)`, for the refined Gysin map of Stacks 0ER1 at the component rule
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.canonicalGysinComponentRule`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap_closedSubspaceCycle_coe_eq` read as an equality of
cycles rather than of coefficient families.  The two cycles are the elements `α` of `Z_{k+1}(X)`
and `β` of `Z_k(E)` whose coefficient families `hα` and `hβ` pin to those of Stacks 0EE9 — on the
left `[Z]_{k+1}`, on the right `[E ∩ Z]_k` for the intersection read inside `E`.  For the left
one that is no restriction, `α` being forced to be
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closedSubspaceCycle`; supplying the right one takes the place of the
bound `dim_δ(E ∩ Z) ≤ k`, which the source gets from the effective Cartier hypothesis and which
has no declaration in this library.  Nothing weakens: both are the coefficient families the
source's two cycles have.

This is the shape in which
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap_eq_of_cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace` states the identity at an
arbitrary component rule, where clause 0ER1(1)(a) is free data; here the rule is the canonical one
of Stacks 0ER1, so that clause is the cycle `[E ∩ W]_k` of Stacks 0EE9 and the two inputs that
lemma takes for it — Stacks 0EQL for `(Z, ℒ|_Z, s|_Z)` and the non-containment `Z_i ⊄ E` — are
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_interOnVanishingLocus_eq_finsum` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.not_le_vanishingLocus_of_cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace_ne_zero`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinCycleMap_canonical_eq_of_cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace
    (hL : IsInvertibleSheaf D p hp L)
    (chern : FirstChernComponentCycleRule D p k)
    (hZdim : deltaDimensionSubspace D p hp Z.1 Z.2 ≤ ((k + 1 : ℤ) : EInt))
    (hCartier : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨Z.1.toFunctor, Z.2.1⟩
      (interOnClosedSubspace D p hp L s Z))
    (α : CycleGroup D p (k + 1))
    (hα : α.1 = cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace D p hp Z.1 Z.2 (k + 1)
      (canonicalGeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem Z.1.toFunctor))
    (β : CycleGroup D ((vanishingLocus D p hp L s).1.ι ≫ p) k)
    (hβ : β.1 = cycleCoeffOfClosedSubspace D ((vanishingLocus D p hp L s).1.ι ≫ p)
      (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s)
      (interOnVanishingLocus D p hp L s Z).1 (interOnVanishingLocus D p hp L s Z).2 k
      (canonicalGeometricPoint D.site D.base D.base_mem
        (interOnVanishingLocus D p hp L s Z).1.toFunctor)) :
    gysinCycleMap D p (vanishingLocus D p hp L s) (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s) k
        (canonicalGysinComponentRule D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L s)
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s) k chern) α = β
declarations.comment:
i^*([Z]_{k+1}) = [D ∩ Z]_k as an equality in Z_k(D), for a closed subspace Z with
dim_δ(Z) ≤ k+1 whose intersection with D is an effective Cartier divisor on Z; the Gysin map is
the one of Stacks 0ER1 at canonicalGysinComponentRule, so clause (1)(a) is the cycle [D ∩ W]_k of
Stacks 0EE9 and only clause (1)(b), the cap product of Stacks 0EQJ, is the free parameter chern
that Definition 0ER1 takes it to be here; the two cycles are elements α and β of the cycle groups
whose coefficient families hα and hβ pin to Stacks 0EE9, which replaces the δ-dimension bound on
D ∩ Z; Stacks 0EQL for (Z, s|_Z) and the non-containment of the components of Z in D are proved,
not assumed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_canonicalDivisorCycleAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ER9 (Lemma 82.23.1).**  In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good, `X` integral with
`n = dim_δ(X) = k + 2`, let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module with a nonzero global section `σ`
and let `i : D = Z(σ) → X` be the closed immersion of its vanishing locus (Stacks 0845) — the
effective Cartier divisor of the source, presented by the pair `(𝒪_X(D), s)` the source
immediately passes to.  Let `𝒩` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and let `t` be a nonzero
meromorphic section of `𝒩`.  Then

`i^*div_𝒩(t) = c₁(𝒩) ∩ [D]_{n-1}`  in  `CH_{n-2}(D)`,

the Chow group being `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical`, which is the source's
`CH_{n-2}(D)`: the embeddings `R(W) → Q(𝒪^h_{W,ξ})` of Stacks 0ENK presenting the rational
equivalences are the canonical ones.

The refined Gysin map is the one of Stacks 0ER1, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap` at the
component rule `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.canonicalGysinComponentRule`, whose free clause (1)(b) is
here the generator rule of the source's own choice `s_i = σ` off `D`; the cap product is the one
of Stacks 0EQJ formed on `D` at the generator rule of an arbitrary family of generators `t_W` of
the `𝒩_{ξ_W}`, which is the choice Section 0EQU leaves free; `[D]_{n-1}` is the cycle of
Stacks 0EE9; and `div_𝒩(t)` is the Weil divisor of Stacks 0EQE at the canonical ratios of
Stacks 0EPR.  Regularity of `t` is derived from `t ≠ 0` rather than assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_canonicalDivisorCycleAt
    (t : MeromorphicSection.{u, u} D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1 N) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (w : GenericUnitFamily D sX hX) :
    chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D ((vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ).1.ι ≫ sX)
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ) k
        (gysinCycleMap D sX (vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ) (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ) k
          (canonicalGysinComponentRule D sX hX (vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ)
            (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ) k
            (generatorChernRule D sX hX hint L hL hn (sectionGeneratorUnit D sX hX hint L hL σ)))
          (canonicalDivisorCycleAt D sX hX hint N hN t
            (isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_ne_zero_of_isGood D sX hX hint N hN ht) hn)) =
      chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D ((vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ).1.ι ≫ sX)
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ) k
        (firstChernCapCycleMap D ((vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ).1.ι ≫ sX)
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ) k
          (closedSubspaceChernRule D sX hX (vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ).1
            (vanishingLocus D sX hX L σ).2 k (generatorChernRule D sX hX hint N hN hn w))
          (vanishingLocusTopCycleAt D sX hX hint L hL hσ hn))
declarations.comment: i^*div_N(t) = c_1(N) ∩ [D]_{n-1} in CH_{n-2}(D), at the hypotheses of 0ER9 itself: X good and integral of δ-dimension n, i : D → X the effective Cartier divisor presented by an invertible L with a nonzero global section σ (so D = Z(σ), as in the proof's own 'Set L = O_X(D)'), N invertible and t a nonzero meromorphic section of N. The Gysin map is 0ER1's, the cap product 0EQJ's formed on D, [D]_{n-1} is 0EE9's and div_N(t) is 0EQE's at the canonical ratios of 0EPR; CH_{n-2}(D) is chowGroupCanonical, the quotient by the rational equivalences of 0EQ6 read at the canonical 0ENK embeddings. Unconditional: the family {Z_i} is constructed by 0EPS, the choice s_i = σ off D by 0845, and the rational equivalence is the key formula 0EQV carried inside |D| and descended along i

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_sectionGysinChowGroupMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERA.**  In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and let `(ℒ, σ, i : E → X)` be as in
Definition 0ER1: `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, `σ ∈ Γ(X, ℒ)` and `i : E = Z(σ) → X` the closed
immersion of its vanishing locus.  The Gysin homomorphism `i^* : Z_{k+1}(X) → CH_k(E)` of
Definition 0ER1 factors through rational equivalence: there is a homomorphism

`i^* : CH_{k+1}(X) ⟶ CH_k(E)`

sending the class of every `(k+1)`-cycle `α` to `i^*α`, i.e. to the class of the cycle
`∑ n_W i^*[W]` of Stacks 0ER1(2).

The Gysin map on cycles is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap` at
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionGysinRule`, the component rule of Stacks 0ER1(1) with every
ingredient constructed, which is the rule of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionRefinedGysin`; the
Chow groups are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical`, Stacks 0EQ6 with `div(f_j)` read at
the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK.  The map is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionGysinChowGroupMap`; nothing is assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_sectionGysinChowGroupMap :
    ∃ F : chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D p hp (k + 1) →+
        chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D ((vanishingLocus D p hp L σ).1.ι ≫ p)
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L σ) k,
      ∀ α : CycleGroup D p (k + 1),
        F (chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D p hp (k + 1) α) =
          chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D ((vanishingLocus D p hp L σ).1.ι ≫ p)
            (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L σ) k
            (gysinCycleMap D p (vanishingLocus D p hp L σ) (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L σ) k
              (sectionGysinRule D p hp L σ k hL) α)
declarations.comment: i^* : CH_{k+1}(X) → CH_k(D) for X/B good and (L, s, i : D → X) as in 0ER1 (L invertible, s a global section, D = Z(s)): the Gysin cycle map of 0ER1 at its own constructed rule sectionGysinRule descends through the Chow groups chowGroupCanonical of 0EQ6 (div(f_j) at the canonical 0ENK embeddings). Unconditional: the member cases are 0EQY on V ⊆ D and the key formula 0EQV (the content of 0ER9 at N = O_V) on V ⊄ D, both carried inside D; 0ER5 and 0EQC are replaced by the carrier-respecting reassembly

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_firstChernCapCycleMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERB.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good, let `(ℒ, s, i : E → X)` be a triple as
in Stacks 0ER1 and let `𝒩` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module. For every `(k+2)`-cycle `α` on `X`,

`i^*(c₁(𝒩) ∩ α) = c₁(i^*𝒩) ∩ i^*α` in `CH_k(E)`.

Here `i^*` is the refined Gysin map of Stacks 0ER1 on cycles,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap` at the rule `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionGysinRule`;
both cap products are the cycle-level operations of Stacks 0EQJ at the canonical choices,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstChernCapCycleMap` at
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.canonicalFirstChernRule`; and the classes are taken in `CH_k(E)` of
Stacks 0EQ6, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical`, whose rational equivalences are sums of
principal divisors at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK. As every class of `CH_{k+2}(X)` is
the class of a cycle, this is the identity of the source on representatives.

The two composites are cycle maps of kernels, and on each `[W]` their difference is a sum of
canonical principal divisors lying over `|W|`
(`isRationallyEquivalentToZeroWithin_gysinCycleMap_firstChernComponentCycle_sub`); the general
case is Stacks 0EQ8 (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCycleFamilySumWithin_sub_of_isCycleMapOfKernel`).
declarations.statement:
theorem chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_firstChernCapCycleMap (k : ℤ)
    (α : CycleGroup D sX (k + 1 + 1)) :
    chowClassCanonical.{max (u + 1) v} D ((vanishingLocus D sX hX L s).1.ι ≫ sX)
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L s) k
        (gysinCycleMap D sX (vanishingLocus D sX hX L s) (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L s) k
          (sectionGysinRule D sX hX L s k hL)
          (firstChernCapCycleMap D sX hX (k + 1) (canonicalFirstChernRule D sX hX N hN (k + 1))
            α)) =
      chowClassCanonical.{max (u + 1) v} D ((vanishingLocus D sX hX L s).1.ι ≫ sX)
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L s) k
        (firstChernCapCycleMap D ((vanishingLocus D sX hX L s).1.ι ≫ sX)
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L s) k
          (canonicalFirstChernRule D _ (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L s)
            ((modulePullback D.site D.base D.base_mem (vanishingLocusInclusion D sX hX L s)).obj N)
            (modulePullbackInvertible (vanishingLocusInclusion D sX hX L s) N hN) k)
          (gysinCycleMap D sX (vanishingLocus D sX hX L s) (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX L s)
            (k + 1) (sectionGysinRule D sX hX L s (k + 1) hL) α))
declarations.comment: i^*(c₁(N) ∩ α) = c₁(i^*N) ∩ i^*α in CH_k(E), for every (k+2)-cycle α on X representing a class of CH_{k+2}(X); i^* is the refined Gysin map of Stacks 0ER1 on cycles (gysinCycleMap at sectionGysinRule), both cap products the cycle-level operations of Stacks 0EQJ at the canonical choices, the classes taken in the Chow group of Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK (chowGroupCanonical); nothing carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_gysinCycleMap_comm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERC: the two refined Gysin maps of a pair of sections commute.** In Situation 0EDT
let `X/B` be good and let `(ℒ, s, i : E → X)`, `(ℒ', s', i' : E' → X)` be two triples as in
Stacks 0ER1. Let `j : Z(s'|_E) → E` and `j' : Z(s|_{E'}) → E'` be the closed immersions of the
triples `(ℒ'|_E, s'|_E)` on `E` and `(ℒ|_{E'}, s|_{E'})` on `E'`, both vanishing loci being
`E ∩ E'` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.vanishingLocusIntersectionComparison`). For every
`(k + 2)`-cycle `α` on `X`,

`j^* (i^* α) = (j')^* ((i')^* α)` in `CH_k(E ∩ E')`.

All four Gysin maps are the cycle-level maps of Stacks 0ER1, parts (1) and (2), at the canonical
component cycles (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap` at
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionGysinRule`); the left side is carried to `Z(s|_{E'})` by the
identification of the two vanishing loci, and the classes are taken in the Chow group of
Stacks 0EQ6, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical`, whose rational equivalences are sums of
principal divisors at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK. As every class of `CH_{k+2}(X)` is
the class of a cycle, this is the identity of the source on representatives.

The proof is the source's: the case `α = [W]` is the key formula on `W`
(`isRationallyEquivalentToZeroWithin_comparisonPushforward_gysinCycleMap_sub_integralCycle`),
a sum of canonical principal divisors lying over `|W|`, and the general case follows by
Stacks 0EQ8 (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCycleFamilySumWithin_closedPushforward_gysin_gysin_sub`).
declarations.statement:
theorem chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_gysinCycleMap_comm (k : ℤ)
    (α : CycleGroup D p (k + 1 + 1)) :
    chowClassCanonical.{max (u + 1) v} D
        ((closedSubspaceVanishingLocus D p hp L s (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s')).1.ι ≫
          (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s').1.ι ≫ p)
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D _ (isGood_closedSubspace D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s')) _ _)
        k
        (comparisonPushforward D p (vanishingLocus D p hp L s) (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s') k
          (closedSubspaceVanishingLocus D p hp L' s' (vanishingLocus D p hp L s))
          (closedSubspaceVanishingLocus D p hp L s (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s'))
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D _ (isGood_closedSubspace D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L s)) _ _)
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D _ (isGood_closedSubspace D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s'))
            _ _)
          (isClosedImmersion_vanishingLocusIntersectionComparison D p hp s s' hL hL')
          (vanishingLocusIntersectionComparison_comp_ι D p hp s s' hL hL')
          (gysinCycleMap D _ (closedSubspaceVanishingLocus D p hp L' s' (vanishingLocus D p hp L s))
            (isGood_vanishingLocus D _
              (isGood_closedSubspace D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L s)) _ _)
            k (sectionGysinRule D _ (isGood_closedSubspace D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L s)) _
              (closedSubspaceModuleRestrictSection D p hp L' s' (vanishingLocus D p hp L s)) k
              (isInvertibleSheaf_closedSubspaceModuleRestrict D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L s)
                hL'))
            (gysinCycleMap D p (vanishingLocus D p hp L s) (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L s)
              (k + 1) (sectionGysinRule D p hp L s (k + 1) hL) α))) =
      chowClassCanonical.{max (u + 1) v} D
        ((closedSubspaceVanishingLocus D p hp L s (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s')).1.ι ≫
          (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s').1.ι ≫ p)
        (isGood_vanishingLocus D _ (isGood_closedSubspace D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s')) _ _)
        k
        (gysinCycleMap D _ (closedSubspaceVanishingLocus D p hp L s (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s'))
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D _
            (isGood_closedSubspace D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s')) _ _)
          k (sectionGysinRule D _ (isGood_closedSubspace D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s')) _
            (closedSubspaceModuleRestrictSection D p hp L s (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s')) k
            (isInvertibleSheaf_closedSubspaceModuleRestrict D p hp (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s')
              hL))
          (gysinCycleMap D p (vanishingLocus D p hp L' s') (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L' s')
            (k + 1) (sectionGysinRule D p hp L' s' (k + 1) hL') α))
declarations.comment: j^* i^* α = (j')^* (i')^* α in CH_k(D ∩ D') for every (k+2)-cycle α on X representing a class of CH_{k+2}(X), all four maps the refined Gysin maps of Stacks 0ER1 on cycles at the canonical component cycles, D ∩ D' being Z(s'|_D) identified with Z(s|_{D'}), the classes taken in the Chow group of Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK (chowGroupCanonical); nothing carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_canonicalSection_flatPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERE, first identity.** In Situation 0EDT let `X, Y/B` be good, let `p : X ⟶ Y` be
flat of relative dimension `r + 1` and let `i : D → X` be a relative effective Cartier divisor on
`X/Y` (Stacks 0EPP), with `ℒ = 𝒪_X(D)` and its canonical section `1_D` (Stacks 0841), whose
vanishing locus `Z(1_D)` is `D` (Stacks 0847). Then for every `(k+1)`-cycle `α` on `Y`

`i^* p^* α = (p|_D)^* α` in `CH_{k+r+1}(D)`,

where `p^*` is the flat pullback of cycles of Stacks 0EP8
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullbackMap`), `i^*` the refined Gysin map of Stacks 0ER1 for the
pair `(𝒪_X(D), 1_D)` on cycles (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap` at
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionGysinRule`), and `(p|_D)^*` the flat pullback along
`p|_D : D → Y`, which is flat of relative dimension `r`; the classes are taken in `CH_{k+r+1}(D)`
of Stacks 0EQ6, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical`. The identity holds already on
cycles, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.gysinCycleMap_sectionGysinRule_flatPullbackMap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_canonicalSection_flatPullbackMap (k : ℤ)
    (α : CycleGroup D sY (k + 1)) :
    chowClassCanonical.{v} D (_ ≫ sX) (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX _ _) (k + r + 1)
        (gysinCycleMap D sX (vanishingLocus D sX hX
            (associatedInvertibleSheaf D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1)
            (canonicalSection D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1))
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX _ _) (k + r + 1)
          (sectionGysinRule D sX hX _ _ (k + r + 1)
            (associatedInvertibleSheaf_isInvertible D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1))
          (flatPullbackMap D sX hX sY hY p hbase (r + 1) hflat hr (k + 1) (k + r + 1 + 1)
            (by push_cast; ring) α)) =
      chowClassCanonical.{v} D (_ ≫ sX) (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX _ _) (k + r + 1)
        (flatPullbackMap D (_ ≫ sX) (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX _ _) sY hY (_ ≫ p)
          (comp_structureMorphism_eq D _ sX sY _ p rfl hbase) r
          (isRelativeEffectiveCartierDivisor_vanishingLocus_canonicalSection D sX hX sY hY p Dv
            hDv).2
          (hasRelativeDimension_ι_comp D sX hX sY hY p hbase r hr _
            (isRelativeEffectiveCartierDivisor_vanishingLocus_canonicalSection D sX hX sY hY p Dv
              hDv)) (k + 1) (k + r + 1) (by ring) α)
declarations.comment: first identity: i^* p^* α = (p|_D)^* α in CH_{k+r}(D), on cycles: i^* is the refined Gysin map of Stacks 0ER1 for (O_X(D), 1_D) (gysinCycleMap at sectionGysinRule), p^* and (p|_D)^* the flat pullbacks of Stacks 0EP8, the classes taken in the Chow group of Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK (chowGroupCanonical); the identity holds already in Z(D)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_firstChernCapCycleMap_canonicalSection_flatPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERE, second identity.** In the situation of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_gysinCycleMap_canonicalSection_flatPullbackMap`, for
every `(k+1)`-cycle `α` on `Y`

`c₁(𝒪_X(D)) ∩ p^* α = i_* ((p|_D)^* α)` in `CH_{k+r+1}(X)`,

where `c₁(𝒪_X(D)) ∩ -` is the cycle-level cap product of Stacks 0EQJ at the canonical choices
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstChernCapCycleMap` at
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.canonicalFirstChernRule`), `i_*` the pushforward of cycles along the
closed immersion `i : D → X`, and the classes are taken in `CH_{k+r+1}(X)` of Stacks 0EQ6,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical`. It follows from the first identity and Stacks
0ER4.
declarations.statement:
theorem chowClassCanonical_firstChernCapCycleMap_canonicalSection_flatPullbackMap (k : ℤ)
    (α : CycleGroup D sY (k + 1)) :
    chowClassCanonical.{max (u + 1) v} D sX hX (k + r + 1)
        (firstChernCapCycleMap D sX hX (k + r + 1)
          (canonicalFirstChernRule D sX hX
            (associatedInvertibleSheaf D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1)
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.ofAlgebraicGeometry _ _ _
              (associatedInvertibleSheaf_isInvertible D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv
                hDv.1)) (k + r + 1))
          (flatPullbackMap D sX hX sY hY p hbase (r + 1) hflat hr (k + 1) (k + r + 1 + 1)
            (by push_cast; ring) α)) =
      chowClassCanonical.{max (u + 1) v} D sX hX (k + r + 1)
        (closedSubspaceCyclePushforward D sX hX (vanishingLocus D sX hX
            (associatedInvertibleSheaf D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1)
            (canonicalSection D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1)) (k + r + 1)
          (flatPullbackMap D (_ ≫ sX) (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX _ _) sY hY (_ ≫ p)
            (comp_structureMorphism_eq D _ sX sY _ p rfl hbase) r
            (isRelativeEffectiveCartierDivisor_vanishingLocus_canonicalSection D sX hX sY hY p Dv
              hDv).2
            (hasRelativeDimension_ι_comp D sX hX sY hY p hbase r hr _
              (isRelativeEffectiveCartierDivisor_vanishingLocus_canonicalSection D sX hX sY hY p
                Dv hDv)) (k + 1) (k + r + 1) (by ring) α))
declarations.comment: second identity: c₁(O_X(D)) ∩ p^* α = i_*((p|_D)^* α) in CH_{k+r}(X), on cycles: c₁ ∩ - is the cap product of Stacks 0EQJ at the canonical choices, p^* and (p|_D)^* the flat pullbacks of Stacks 0EP8, i_* the pushforward along the closed immersion, the classes taken in the Chow group of Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK (chowGroupCanonical)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_flatPullbackMap_canonicalSection_eq_zero_of_hasRelativeDimension_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERE in relative dimension zero.** If `p : X ⟶ Y` is flat of relative dimension `0`
and `i : D → X` is a relative effective Cartier divisor on `X/Y`, then `D` has no points
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEmpty_points_of_isRelativeEffectiveCartierDivisor`), so every cycle on
`D` is zero, and for every `(k+1)`-cycle `α` on `Y` both sides of the two identities of Stacks
0ERE vanish: `i^* p^* α = 0` in `CH_k(D)` and `c₁(𝒪_X(D)) ∩ p^* α = i_*(0) = 0` in `CH_k(X)`, the
operations being those on cycles and the classes taken in the Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chowClassCanonical_flatPullbackMap_canonicalSection_eq_zero_of_hasRelativeDimension_zero
    (Dv : ClosedSubspaces D.site D.base D.base_mem X)
    (hDv : IsRelativeEffectiveCartierDivisor D.site D.base D.base_mem
      (ObjectProperty.homMk p : (⟨X, hX.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces D.site D.base D.base_mem) ⟶
        ⟨Y, hY.1⟩) Dv) (k : ℤ) (α : CycleGroup D sY (k + 1)) :
    (∀ (n : ℤ) (β : CycleGroup D ((vanishingLocus D sX hX
        (associatedInvertibleSheaf D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1)
        (canonicalSection D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1)).1.ι ≫ sX) n), β = 0) ∧
    chowClassCanonical.{v} D (_ ≫ sX) (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX _ _) k
        (gysinCycleMap D sX (vanishingLocus D sX hX
            (associatedInvertibleSheaf D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1)
            (canonicalSection D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1))
          (isGood_vanishingLocus D sX hX _ _) k
          (sectionGysinRule D sX hX _ _ k
            (associatedInvertibleSheaf_isInvertible D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1))
          (flatPullbackMap D sX hX sY hY p hbase 0 hflat hr₀ (k + 1) (k + 1) (by simp) α)) = 0 ∧
    chowClassCanonical.{max (u + 1) v} D sX hX k
        (firstChernCapCycleMap D sX hX k
          (canonicalFirstChernRule D sX hX
            (associatedInvertibleSheaf D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv hDv.1)
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.ofAlgebraicGeometry _ _ _
              (associatedInvertibleSheaf_isInvertible D.site D.base D.base_mem ⟨X, hX.1⟩ Dv
                hDv.1)) k)
          (flatPullbackMap D sX hX sY hY p hbase 0 hflat hr₀ (k + 1) (k + 1) (by simp) α)) = 0
declarations.comment: the case of relative dimension r = 0, where D is empty: every cycle on D is zero, and i^* p^* α = 0 in CH_k(D) and c₁(O_X(D)) ∩ p^* α = 0 in CH_k(X), on cycles, the classes taken in the Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK (chowGroupCanonical)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlatPullbackSurjective_of_isQuasiCompact_of_hasAffineSpaceFibres
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERG.** In Situation 0EDT let `X, Y/B` be good and let `f : X → Y` be a
quasi-compact morphism over the base, flat of relative dimension `r`, with
`X_y ≅ 𝐀^r_{κ(y)}` for every `y ∈ |Y|`. Then `f^* : CH_k(Y) → CH_{k+r}(X)` is surjective: for
every `k ∈ ℤ` and every `α ∈ Z_{k+r}(X)` there is `β ∈ Z_k(Y)` with `f^*β - α` rationally
equivalent to zero, as a locally finite sum of principal divisors at the canonical embeddings of
Stacks 0ENK.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlatPullbackSurjective_of_isQuasiCompact_of_hasAffineSpaceFibres
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompact D.site D.base D.base_mem f) (hfib : HasAffineSpaceFibres D sY hY f r)
    (k : ℤ) : IsFlatPullbackSurjective D sX hX sY hY f hbase r hflat hr k

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.bijective_flatPullbackChowMapCanonical_vectorBundle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERH.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good, let `ℒ` be a finite locally free
`𝒪_X`-module of rank one and let `p : L = \underline{Spec}(Sym^*(ℒ)) → X` be its line bundle,
flat of relative dimension one. Then the flat pullback `p^* : CH_k(X) → CH_{k+1}(L)` of
Stacks 0EQB, on the Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK, is an
isomorphism for every `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_flatPullbackChowMapCanonical_vectorBundle (k : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (flatPullbackChowMapCanonical.{u + 1} D _
      (isGood_vectorBundle D W F sW hW) sW hW
      (vectorBundleProjection D.site D.base D.base_mem W F).hom rfl 1
      (isFlat_vectorBundleProjection D.site D.base D.base_mem W F)
      (hasRelativeDimension_vectorBundleProjection D.site D.base D.base_mem W F 1) k (k + 1)
      (by push_cast; rfl))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BivariantClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERJ.** A bivariant class of degree `p` for a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of good
algebraic spaces over the base: a rule assigning to every good `Y' ⟶ Y` over the base and every
`k` an additive map `CH_k(Y') ⟶ CH_{k-p}(Y' ×_Y X)`, natural for proper pushforward, for flat
pullback of fixed relative dimension, and for the refined Gysin maps of Stacks 0ER1. The group
of all of them is denoted `A^p(X ⟶ Y)`.

Stated against an `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowGroupSystem`, which supplies the Chow groups of
Stacks 82.15 and the three operations on them that the axioms quantify over, none of which this
repository constructs; see the implementation notes of
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Spaces.Chow.Bivariant`.
declarations.statement:
structure BivariantClass (D : BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.{u}) (G : ChowGroupSystem D)
    {X Y : D.Ambient} (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX) (sY : Y ⟶ D.space)
    (hY : D.IsGood sY) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ sY = sX) (p : ℤ)
declarations.comment: over the parameterized Chow groups of 82.15 and Gysin maps of 82.22

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BivariantClassCanonical
declarations.doc:
A bivariant class of degree `p` for a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of good algebraic spaces over the
base: a rule assigning to every good `g : Y' ⟶ Y` over the base and every `k` an additive map
`CH_k(Y') ⟶ CH_{k-p}(Y' ×_Y X)`, natural for proper pushforward, for flat pullback of fixed
relative dimension, and for the refined Gysin maps of Stacks 0ER1. The group of all of them is
denoted `A^p(X ⟶ Y)`.

The Chow groups are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical` of Stacks 0EQ6, and the three
operations are the operations on cycles of Stacks 0EP1, Stacks 0EP8 and Stacks 0ER1; each axiom
asserts the source's equation through cycle representatives.
declarations.statement:
structure BivariantClassCanonical {X Y : D.Ambient} (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX)
    (sY : Y ⟶ D.space) (hY : D.IsGood sY) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ sY = sX) (p : ℤ)
declarations.comment: the group A^p(X → Y) of bivariant classes of degree p, over the constructed Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6 and the constructed proper pushforward, flat pullback and refined Gysin maps of Stacks 0EP1, 0EP8 and 0ER1; the three naturality axioms are stated through cycle representatives, equivalently to the source's equations, because the descent of those three operations to Chow groups is Stacks 0EQC, 0EQB and 0ERA and is not proved here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowCohomologyComponent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERK.** The degree `p` part `A^p(X)` of the Chow cohomology of a good algebraic
space `X/B`: the group `A^p(X ⟶ X)` of bivariant classes of degree `p` for the identity morphism
of `X`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev chowCohomologyComponent (D : BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.{u}) (G : ChowGroupSystem D)
    {X : D.Ambient} (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX) (p : ℤ) : Type (u + 1)
declarations.comment: the degree p part

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERK.** The Chow cohomology `A^*(X)` of a good algebraic space `X/B`: the graded
group whose degree `p` part is the group `A^p(X ⟶ X)` of bivariant classes of degree `p` for the
identity morphism of `X`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev chowCohomology (D : BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.{u}) (G : ChowGroupSystem D)
    {X : D.Ambient} (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX) : Type (u + 1)
declarations.comment: the graded group, not the ℤ-algebra: composition is absent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowCohomologyClass
declarations.doc:
The group `A^p(X) = A^p(X ⟶ X)` of bivariant classes of degree `p` (Stacks 0ERJ) for the
identity of a good algebraic space `X/B`: a rule assigning to every good test space `g : Y' ⟶ X`
over the base and every `k` an additive map `c ∩ - : CH_k(Y') ⟶ CH_{k-p}(Y')` (the fibre product
`Y' ×_X X` being `Y'`), such that

1. for `h : Y'' ⟶ Y'` proper, `c ∩ h_*α'' = h_*(c ∩ α'')` for all `α''` on `Y''`;
2. for `h : Y'' ⟶ Y'` flat of relative dimension `r`, `c ∩ h^*α' = h^*(c ∩ α')` for all `α'`;
3. for `(ℒ', s', i' : D' → Y')` as in Definition 0ER1, `c ∩ (i')^*α' = (i')^*(c ∩ α')` for all
   `α'` on `Y'`.

The Chow groups are the constructed `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical` of Stacks 0EQ6;
`h^*` is the flat pullback of Stacks 0EQB, `(i')^*` the Gysin map of Stacks 0ERA, and `h_*` the
proper pushforward of cycles of Stacks 0EP1, axiom (1) being read through cycle representatives.
The cap operation in degree `k` is indexed by its target degree `l`, with `l + p = k`. See the
implementation notes of `StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Spaces.Chow.ChowCohomologyAlgebra`.
declarations.statement: structure ChowCohomologyClass (hX : D.IsGood sX) (p : ℤ)
declarations.comment: the degree p component A^p(X) = A^p(X → X): bivariant classes of degree p for id_X over the constructed Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6, with the fibre product Y' ×_X X taken to be Y'; flat pullback and Gysin maps are the descended ones of Stacks 0EQB and 0ERA, the proper axiom is stated through cycle representatives

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowCohomologyClass.instGRing
declarations.doc:
The graded ring structure on `p ↦ A^p(X) = A^p(X ⟶ X)`: the product of the degree `p` and `q`
components is the composition `A^p(X ⟶ X) × A^q(X ⟶ X) ⟶ A^{p+q}(X ⟶ X)` of bivariant classes,
associative and bilinear, with unit `1 ∈ A^0(X)`; the integers act through the multiples of `1`.
declarations.statement: instance instGRing : DirectSum.GRing (ChowCohomologyClass D sX hX)
declarations.comment: the graded Z-algebra structure on A^*(X): the product of the degree p and q components is the composition A^p(X → X) × A^q(X → X) → A^{p+q}(X → X) of bivariant classes, associative and bilinear, with unit 1 ∈ A^0(X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowCohomologyAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The Chow cohomology `A^*(X)` of a good algebraic space `X/B`: the graded `ℤ`-algebra
`⊕_p A^p(X)` whose degree `p` component is the group `A^p(X ⟶ X)` of bivariant classes of degree
`p` for `id_X` over the constructed Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6, with multiplication the composition
of bivariant classes (`DirectSum.ring` of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowCohomologyClass.instGRing`)
and its `ℤ`-algebra structure the one of any ring.
declarations.statement: abbrev ChowCohomologyAlgebra : Type _
declarations.comment: the Chow cohomology A^*(X): the graded Z-algebra ⊕_p A^p(X → X), with multiplication the composition of bivariant classes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowCohomologyComponentCanonical
declarations.doc:
The degree `p` part `A^p(X)` of the Chow cohomology of a good algebraic space `X/B`: the
group `A^p(X ⟶ X)` of bivariant classes of degree `p` for the identity morphism of `X`, over the
constructed Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6.
declarations.statement:
abbrev chowCohomologyComponentCanonical (D : BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.{u}) {X : D.Ambient}
    (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX) (p : ℤ)
declarations.comment: the degree p part A^p(X) = A^p(X → X), over the constructed Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowCohomologyCanonical
declarations.doc:
The Chow cohomology `A^*(X)` of a good algebraic space `X/B`: the graded group whose degree
`p` part is the group `A^p(X ⟶ X)` of bivariant classes of degree `p` for the identity morphism
of `X`, over the constructed Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6.

This is the graded group and not the graded `ℤ`-algebra, whose product is composition of
bivariant classes.
declarations.statement:
abbrev chowCohomologyCanonical (D : BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.{u}) {X : D.Ambient}
    (sX : X ⟶ D.space) (hX : D.IsGood sX)
declarations.comment: the graded group A^*(X) = ⊕_p A^p(X → X) over the constructed Chow groups of Stacks 0EQ6, not the ℤ-algebra: the product is composition of bivariant classes, which needs proper pushforward along an isomorphism to respect rational equivalence (Stacks 0EQC)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowCohomologyRestrictionCap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERL.** The cap operations of the pullback `f^*c` of a Chow cohomology class
`c ∈ A^p(Y)` along a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of good algebraic spaces over the base: on a good
test space `g : X' ⟶ X` it is the cap operation of `c` on `X'` viewed over `Y`, carried to
`X ×_X X'` along the comparison isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def chowCohomologyRestrictionCap (c : chowCohomologyComponent D G sY hY p)
    (hg : D.IsGood (g ≫ sX)) (hpbY : D.IsGood (pullback.fst (𝟙 Y) (g ≫ f) ≫ sY))
    (hpbX : D.IsGood (pullback.fst (𝟙 X) g ≫ sX))
    (hκ : IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem (restrictionComparisonIso D f g).hom) (k : ℤ) :
    G.chow (g ≫ sX) hg k →+ G.chow (pullback.fst (𝟙 X) g ≫ sX) hpbX (k - p)
declarations.comment: the cap operations of the pullback f^*c

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowCohomologyRestrictionCapHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERL.** The pullback along `f : X ⟶ Y` of the cap operation of a Chow cohomology
class on a fixed good test space over `X`, as an additive map in the class.
declarations.statement:
def chowCohomologyRestrictionCapHom (hg : D.IsGood (g ≫ sX))
    (hpbY : D.IsGood (pullback.fst (𝟙 Y) (g ≫ f) ≫ sY))
    (hpbX : D.IsGood (pullback.fst (𝟙 X) g ≫ sX))
    (hκ : IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem (restrictionComparisonIso D f g).hom) (k : ℤ) :
    chowCohomologyComponent D G sY hY p →+
      (G.chow (g ≫ sX) hg k →+ G.chow (pullback.fst (𝟙 X) g ≫ sX) hpbX (k - p))
declarations.comment: the pullback of cap operations is additive in the class

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowCohomologyAlgebra.comap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERL.** The canonical `ℤ`-algebra map `f^* : A^*(Y) ⟶ A^*(X)` attached to a
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of good algebraic spaces over the base. On the degree `p` component it is
the pullback `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowCohomologyClass.comap`: given `c ∈ A^p(Y)` and a test
space `X' ⟶ X`, the class `f^*c` caps on `CH_k(X') ⟶ CH_{k-p}(X')` as `c` does, `X'` being
thought of as an algebraic space over `Y` through `X' ⟶ X ⟶ Y`.
declarations.statement:
def comap (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ sY = sX) :
    ChowCohomologyAlgebra D sY hY →ₐ[ℤ] ChowCohomologyAlgebra D sX hX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstChernBivariantClass
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module. Then the
rule that to `f : X' ⟶ X` assigns `c₁(f^*ℒ) ∩ - : CH_k(X') ⟶ CH_{k-1}(X')` is a bivariant class
of degree `1`, in the sense of Stacks 0ERJ (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BivariantClassCanonical` for
`𝟙 X`, over the constructed Chow groups `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical` of
Stacks 0EQ6). The cap operation is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstChernBivariantCap`.
declarations.statement:
def firstChernBivariantClass :
    BivariantClassCanonical.{u + 1} D sX hX sX hX (𝟙 X) (Category.id_comp sX) 1
declarations.comment:
the rule f : X' → X ↦ c_1(f^*L) ∩ - : CH_k(X') → CH_{k-1}(X'), for X/B good and
L an invertible O_X-module, is a bivariant class of degree 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatPullbackBivariantClassCanonical
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0EDT let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of good algebraic spaces over `B` which is
flat of relative dimension `r`. Then the rule that to `g : Y' ⟶ Y` assigns the flat pullback
`(f')^* : CH_k(Y') ⟶ CH_{k+r}(X')` of Stacks 0EQB along the base change
`f' : X' = X ×_Y Y' ⟶ Y'` is a bivariant class of degree `-r`, in the sense of Stacks 0ERJ
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BivariantClassCanonical`, over the constructed Chow groups
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical` of Stacks 0EQ6).
declarations.statement:
def flatPullbackBivariantClassCanonical :
    BivariantClassCanonical.{u + 1} D sX hX sY hY f hf (-(r : ℤ))
declarations.comment:
the rule g : Y' → Y ↦ (f')^* : CH_k(Y') → CH_{k+r}(X'), X' = X ×_Y Y', for f
flat of relative dimension r between good spaces over B, is a bivariant class of degree -r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_bivariantClassCanonical_gysin
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERP.**  In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and `(ℒ, σ, i : E → X)` a triple as in
Stacks 0ER1: `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, `σ` a global section and `E = Z(σ)` its vanishing
locus.  Then the rule that to `g : X' ⟶ X` assigns the Gysin map
`(i')^* : CH_k(X') ⟶ CH_{k-1}(E')`, `E' = E ×_X X'`, is a bivariant class of degree `1` for
`i : E ⟶ X` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BivariantClassCanonical`, Stacks 0ERJ).

The cap operation of the class is pinned down on the class of every `k`-cycle `α` on every test
space: it is the class of the Gysin cycle of Stacks 0ER1 of the pulled-back triple
`(g^*ℒ, g^*σ, Z(g^*σ) → X')` (Stacks 0ER3) at its own rule, carried to `E ×_X X'` along the
identification `e : Z(g^*σ) ≅ E ×_X X'` over `X'` (`chowGroupCanonicalPushforwardOfIso`).  The
three axioms of Stacks 0ERJ are Stacks 0ER5, Stacks 0ER6 and Stacks 0ERC for the pulled-back
triples, as in the source's proof.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_bivariantClassCanonical_gysin :
    ∃ c : BivariantClassCanonical.{u + 1} D (𝔼.1.ι ≫ p) (isGood_vanishingLocus D p hp L σ) p hp
        𝔼.1.ι rfl 1,
      ∀ {X' : D.Ambient} (g : X' ⟶ X) (hX' : D.IsGood (g ≫ p))
        (hE' : D.IsGood (Limits.pullback.fst 𝔼.1.ι g ≫ 𝔼.1.ι ≫ p))
        (e : (vanishingLocus D (g ≫ p) hX'
            (pullbackSheaf D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g) L)
            (pullbackGlobalSection D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g) L σ)).1.toFunctor ≅
          Limits.pullback 𝔼.1.ι g)
        (_he : e.hom ≫ Limits.pullback.snd 𝔼.1.ι g =
          (vanishingLocus D (g ≫ p) hX'
            (pullbackSheaf D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g) L)
            (pullbackGlobalSection D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g) L σ)).1.ι)
        (hcomp : e.hom ≫ Limits.pullback.fst 𝔼.1.ι g ≫ 𝔼.1.ι ≫ p =
          (vanishingLocus D (g ≫ p) hX'
            (pullbackSheaf D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g) L)
            (pullbackGlobalSection D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g) L σ)).1.ι ≫
            g ≫ p)
        (k : ℤ) (α : CycleGroup D (g ≫ p) k),
        c.cap g hX' hE' k (chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D (g ≫ p) hX' k α) =
          chowGroupCanonicalPushforwardOfIso.{u + 1} D _
            (isGood_vanishingLocus D (g ≫ p) hX' _ _) _ hE' e hcomp (k - 1)
            (chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D _ (isGood_vanishingLocus D (g ≫ p) hX' _ _) (k - 1)
              (gysinCycleMap D (g ≫ p) (vanishingLocus D (g ≫ p) hX'
                  (pullbackSheaf D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g) L)
                  (pullbackGlobalSection D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g) L σ))
                (isGood_vanishingLocus D (g ≫ p) hX' _ _) (k - 1)
                (sectionGysinRule D (g ≫ p) hX' _
                  (pullbackGlobalSection D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g) L σ)
                  (k - 1)
                  (isInvertibleSheaf_pullbackSheaf D p hp (g ≫ p) hX' (ObjectProperty.homMk g)
                    L hL))
                (cycleGroupDegreeCongr D (g ≫ p) (sub_add_cancel k 1).symm α)))
declarations.comment: the rule g : X' → X ↦ (i')^* : CH_k(X') → CH_{k-1}(E'), E' = E ×_X X', for X/B good and (L, s, i : E → X) a triple as in 0ER1, is a bivariant class of degree 1 for i; the cap operation is pinned to the Gysin map of the pulled-back triple carried along Z(g^*s) ≅ E ×_X X'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_bivariantPushforwardBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERQ.** The base change of a proper morphism along a test space is proper, so the
rule of Stacks 0ERQ has a proper morphism to push forward along.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_bivariantPushforwardBaseChange (D : BaseSpaceDimensionSituation.{u})
    {X Y Z Z' : D.Ambient} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (q : Z' ⟶ Z)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace D.site D.base D.base_mem X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace D.site D.base D.base_mem Y)
    (hPX : IsAlgebraicSpace D.site D.base D.base_mem (pullback (f ≫ g) q))
    (hPY : IsAlgebraicSpace D.site D.base D.base_mem (pullback g q))
    (hf : IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem f) :
    IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem (bivariantPushforwardBaseChange D f g q)
declarations.comment: properness of the base change of the proper morphism, so that the rule is defined

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.bivariantProperPushforwardCap_proper_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERQ.** The proper-pushforward condition of Stacks 0ERJ for the rule of 0ERQ:
the cap operation `α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)` commutes with proper pushforward along a morphism of good
test spaces over `Z`. This is the part of the source proof carried by Stacks 0EP2, which enters
as functoriality of the parameterized proper pushforward.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantProperPushforwardCap_proper_naturality
    (hfun : G.HasFunctorialProperPushforward) {Z' Z'' : D.Ambient} (q : Z' ⟶ Z)
    (hZ' : D.IsGood (q ≫ sZ)) (hY' : D.IsGood (pullback.fst g q ≫ sY)) (h : Z'' ⟶ Z')
    (hZ'' : D.IsGood ((h ≫ q) ≫ sZ)) (hY'' : D.IsGood (pullback.fst g (h ≫ q) ≫ sY))
    (hh : IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem h) (h' : pullback g (h ≫ q) ⟶ pullback g q)
    (hsq : IsPullback (pullback.snd g (h ≫ q)) h' h (pullback.snd g q))
    (hfst : h' ≫ pullback.fst g q = pullback.fst g (h ≫ q))
    (hh' : IsProper D.site D.base D.base_mem h') (k : ℤ)
    (α : G.chow ((h ≫ q) ≫ sZ) hZ'' k) :
    bivariantProperPushforwardCap D G sX hX sY hY sZ hZ f g hf hfg hproper hgood p c q hZ'
        hY' k
        (G.properPushforward ((h ≫ q) ≫ sZ) hZ'' (q ≫ sZ) hZ' h (Category.assoc h q sZ).symm
          hh k α) =
      G.properPushforward (pullback.fst g (h ≫ q) ≫ sY) hY'' (pullback.fst g q ≫ sY) hY' h'
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, hfst]) hh' (k - p)
        (bivariantProperPushforwardCap D G sX hX sY hY sZ hZ f g hf hfg hproper hgood p c
          (h ≫ q) hZ'' hY'' k α)
declarations.comment: the proper-pushforward condition of Stacks 0ERJ for the rule, over functoriality of the parameterized proper pushforward

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_isBivariantProperPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERQ.** The rule of Stacks 0ERQ determines the pushed-forward class: two bivariant
classes of degree `p` for `g` that both push `c` forward along `f` are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_isBivariantProperPushforward (hg : g ≫ sZ = sY)
    {d d' : BivariantClass D G sY hY sZ hZ g hg p}
    (hd : IsBivariantProperPushforward D G sX hX sY hY sZ hZ f g hf hfg hproper hgood p c hg d)
    (hd' : IsBivariantProperPushforward D G sX hX sY hY sZ hZ f g hf hfg hproper hgood p c hg
      d') :
    d = d'
declarations.comment: uniqueness of the class defined by the rule

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BivariantClassCanonical.properPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERQ.** In Situation 0EDT let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of good
algebraic spaces over the base, with `f` proper, and let `c ∈ A^p(X ⟶ Z)`.  The rule which to a
test space `Z' ⟶ Z` assigns `α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)`, for `f' : Z' ×_Z X ⟶ Z' ×_Z Y` the base change of
`f`, is a bivariant class of degree `p` for `g`; this is that class `f_* ∘ c ∈ A^p(Y ⟶ Z)`, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BivariantClassCanonical.properPushforward_cap_apply` says that it caps by
the rule.
declarations.statement:
def BivariantClassCanonical.properPushforward :
    BivariantClassCanonical.{max (u + 1) v} D sY hY sZ hZ g hg p
declarations.comment: the rule α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α) is a bivariant class of degree p for g: the class f_* ∘ c ∈ A^p(Y → Z) over the constructed Chow groups and operations, with its three axioms proved from those of c, Stacks 0EP2, 0EPD and 0ER5

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BivariantClassCanonical.properPushforward_cap_apply
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERQ.** The class `f_* ∘ c` caps by the rule of the source: on a test space
`z : Z' ⟶ Z`, `(f_* ∘ c) ∩ α = f'_*(c ∩ α)` in `CH_{k-p}(Z' ×_Z Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem BivariantClassCanonical.properPushforward_cap_apply {Z' : D.Ambient} (z : Z' ⟶ Z)
    (hZ' : D.IsGood (z ≫ sZ)) (hY' : D.IsGood (pullback.fst g z ≫ sY)) (k : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroupCanonical.{max (u + 1) v} D (z ≫ sZ) hZ' k) :
    (BivariantClassCanonical.properPushforward D hY hf hg hfP c).cap z hZ' hY' k α =
      chowGroupCanonicalProperPushforward.{max (u + 1) v} D (pullback.fst (f ≫ g) z ≫ sX)
        (isGood_pullback_fst D hX hZ (f ≫ g) z hZ') (pullback.fst g z ≫ sY) hY'
        (bivariantPushforwardBaseChange_comp_structure D hf g z)
        (isProper_bivariantPushforwardBaseChange D f g z hX.1 hY.1
          (isGood_pullback_fst D hX hZ (f ≫ g) z hZ').1 hY'.1 hfP) (k - p)
        (c.cap z hZ' (isGood_pullback_fst D hX hZ (f ≫ g) z hZ') k α)
declarations.comment: the class caps by the rule α ↦ f'_*(c ∩ α)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstChernBivariantClass_compCap_comm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERR.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and let `ℒ` be an invertible
`𝒪_X`-module.  Then `c₁(ℒ) ∈ A^1(X)` (Stacks 0ERM,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstChernBivariantClass`) commutes with every `c ∈ A^p(X)`: on every
good test space `g : Y' ⟶ X` the composites `c₁(ℒ) ∘ c` and `c ∘ c₁(ℒ)` have the same cap
operation, `c₁(ℒ) ∩ (c ∩ α) = c ∩ (c₁(ℒ) ∩ α)` for every `α ∈ CH_k(Y')`, the two degrees
`k - p - 1` and `k - 1 - p` being identified.
declarations.statement:
theorem firstChernBivariantClass_compCap_comm {p : ℤ}
    (c : BivariantClassCanonical.{u + 1} D sX hX sX hX (𝟙 X) (Category.id_comp sX) p)
    {Y' : D.Ambient} (g : Y' ⟶ X) (hY' : D.IsGood (g ≫ sX)) (k : ℤ)
    (x : chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D (g ≫ sX) hY' k) :
    BivariantClassCanonical.compCap D (firstChernBivariantClass D sX hX L hL) c g hY' k x =
      chowGroupCanonicalDegreeCongr D _ _ (by omega)
        (BivariantClassCanonical.compCap D c (firstChernBivariantClass D sX hX L hL) g hY' k
          x)
declarations.comment: c_1(L) ∈ A^1(X) commutes with every c ∈ A^p(X): the composites c_1(L) ∘ c and c ∘ c_1(L) have the same cap operation on every test space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.zero_capsFundamentalClassesToZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERS, the forward implication.** The zero class of `A^p(X)` caps the fundamental
class of every integral algebraic space locally of finite type over `X` to zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem zero_capsFundamentalClassesToZero :
    BivariantClass.CapsFundamentalClassesToZero D G sX hX p 0
declarations.comment: the forward implication

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cap_integralClosedSubspaceCycle_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERS, the content of the converse.** If `c ∈ A^p(X)` caps the fundamental class of
every integral algebraic space locally of finite type over `X` to zero, then it caps the cycle
of every integral closed subspace of every good test space over `X` to zero: push forward along
the inclusion of the subspace, where the hypothesis applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem cap_integralClosedSubspaceCycle_eq_zero
    (hpp : G.IsInducedByClosedCyclePushforward) (hbc : D.HasGoodSubspaceBaseChanges sX)
    (c : chowCohomologyComponent D G sX hX p)
    (hc : BivariantClass.CapsFundamentalClassesToZero D G sX hX p c)
    {X' : D.Ambient} (g : X' ⟶ X) (hg : D.IsGood (g ≫ sX))
    (hpb : D.IsGood (pullback.fst (𝟙 X) g ≫ sX))
    (Z : IntegralClosedSubspace D.site D.base D.base_mem X') (k : ℤ)
    (hk : deltaDimension D (g ≫ sX) Z = k) :
    c.cap g hg hpb k
      (G.cycleClass (g ≫ sX) hg k (integralClosedSubspaceCycle D (g ≫ sX) Z k)) = 0
declarations.comment: the converse on the cycle of an integral closed subspace

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_zero_iff_capsFundamentalClassesToZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERS.** A class `c ∈ A^p(X)` is zero if and only if `c ∩ [Y] = 0` in `CH_*(Y)` for
every integral algebraic space `Y` locally of finite type over `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_zero_iff_capsFundamentalClassesToZero
    (hpp : G.IsInducedByClosedCyclePushforward) (hbc : D.HasGoodSubspaceBaseChanges sX)
    (hfin : ∀ {X' : D.Ambient} (g : X' ⟶ X) (hg : D.IsGood (g ≫ sX)) (k : ℤ)
      (α : G.chow (g ≫ sX) hg k), ∃ β : CycleGroup D (g ≫ sX) k,
        (Function.support β.1).Finite ∧ G.cycleClass (g ≫ sX) hg k β = α)
    (c : chowCohomologyComponent D G sX hX p) :
    c = 0 ↔ BivariantClass.CapsFundamentalClassesToZero D G sX hX p c
declarations.comment: for Chow classes of cycles of finite support, over a cycle-induced pushforward

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowCohomologyClass.eq_zero_iff_capsFundamentalClassesToZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERS.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and let `c ∈ A^p(X)`. Then `c` is zero if
and only if `c ∩ [Y] = 0` in `CH_*(Y)` for every integral algebraic space `Y` locally of finite
type over `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem ChowCohomologyClass.eq_zero_iff_capsFundamentalClassesToZero
    (c : ChowCohomologyClass D sX hX p) : c = 0 ↔ c.CapsFundamentalClassesToZero D sX hX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_properCyclePushforward_firstChernCapPowCycleMap_flatPullbackMap_projectiveBundle_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERU, the vanishing, in the Chow group at the canonical embeddings.** Let `ℰ` be a
finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module of rank `n + 1` on a good algebraic space `X/B` and
`(π : P → X, 𝒪_P(1))` its projective bundle. For `s < n` and every `k`-cycle `α` on `X`, the class
of `π_*(c₁(𝒪_P(1))^s ∩ π^*α)` in `CH_{k+n-s}(X)` is zero, the Chow group being that of Stacks 0EQ6
at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK.
declarations.statement:
theorem chowClassCanonical_properCyclePushforward_firstChernCapPowCycleMap_flatPullbackMap_projectiveBundle_eq_zero
    (s : ℕ) (hs : s < n) (k m : ℤ) (h : k + n = m + s) (α : CycleGroup D sX k) :
    chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D sX hX m
        (properCyclePushforward D _ (isGood_projectiveBundleProj_comp D sX hX E hfree) sX hX rfl
          (isProper_projectiveBundleProj (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E hfree).2.1.2 m
          (firstChernCapPowCycleMap D _ (isGood_projectiveBundleProj_comp D sX hX E hfree)
            (projectiveBundleTwist (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E hfree).obj
            (isInvertibleModule_projectiveBundleTwist (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E hfree) s m
            (flatPullbackMap D _ (isGood_projectiveBundleProj_comp D sX hX E hfree) sX hX
              (projectiveBundleProj (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E hfree).hom rfl n
              (isFlat_projectiveBundleProj (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E n hr hfree)
              (hasRelativeDimension_projectiveBundleProj (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E n hr hfree) k
              (m + s) h α))) = 0
declarations.comment: the vanishing for s < r - 1, read on a cycle representing α, in the Chow group of Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowClassCanonical_properCyclePushforward_firstChernCapPowCycleMap_flatPullbackMap_projectiveBundle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERU, the top power, in the Chow group at the canonical embeddings.** Let `ℰ` be a
finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module of rank `n + 1` on a good algebraic space `X/B` and
`(π : P → X, 𝒪_P(1))` its projective bundle. For every `k`-cycle `α` on `X`, the class of
`π_*(c₁(𝒪_P(1))^n ∩ π^*α)` in `CH_k(X)` is the class of `α`, the Chow group being that of
Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK.
declarations.statement:
theorem chowClassCanonical_properCyclePushforward_firstChernCapPowCycleMap_flatPullbackMap_projectiveBundle
    (k : ℤ) (α : CycleGroup D sX k) :
    chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D sX hX k
        (properCyclePushforward D _ (isGood_projectiveBundleProj_comp D sX hX E hfree) sX hX rfl
          (isProper_projectiveBundleProj (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E hfree).2.1.2 k
          (firstChernCapPowCycleMap D _ (isGood_projectiveBundleProj_comp D sX hX E hfree)
            (projectiveBundleTwist (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E hfree).obj
            (isInvertibleModule_projectiveBundleTwist (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E hfree) n k
            (flatPullbackMap D _ (isGood_projectiveBundleProj_comp D sX hX E hfree) sX hX
              (projectiveBundleProj (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E hfree).hom rfl n
              (isFlat_projectiveBundleProj (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E n hr hfree)
              (hasRelativeDimension_projectiveBundleProj (X := ⟨X, hX.1⟩) E n hr hfree) k
              (k + n) rfl α))) =
      chowClassCanonical.{u + 1} D sX hX k α
declarations.comment: the top power s = r - 1, read on a cycle representing α, in the Chow group of Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.bijective_projectiveBundleFormulaMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERV: the projective space bundle formula.** Let `X` be a good algebraic space over
the base of the theory of cycles, `ℰ` a finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module of rank `r` and
`(π : P = 𝐏(ℰ) → X, 𝒪_P(1))` its projective bundle. The map
`⊕_{i=0}^{r-1} CH_{k+i}(X) → CH_{k+r-1}(P)`,
`(α_0, …, α_{r-1}) ↦ π^*α_0 + c₁(𝒪_P(1)) ∩ π^*α_1 + … + c₁(𝒪_P(1))^{r-1} ∩ π^*α_{r-1}`,
is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_projectiveBundleFormulaMap
    (F : Modules.{u, u} D.site D.base D.base_mem X.1 X.2) (r : ℕ)
    (hF : RingedSite.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
      (smallEtaleRingedSite D.site D.base D.base_mem X.1 X.2) F r) (k : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (projectiveBundleFormulaMap D sX hX F r hF k)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.bijective_flatPullbackChowMapCanonical_vectorBundleProjection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERW.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good, let `ℰ` be a finite locally free
`𝒪_X`-module of rank `r` and let `p : E = Spec(Sym^*(ℰ)) → X` be the associated vector bundle.
Then `p^* : CH_k(X) → CH_{k+r}(E)` is an isomorphism for all `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_flatPullbackChowMapCanonical_vectorBundleProjection (k : ℤ) :
    letI := AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree F r
    Function.Bijective (flatPullbackChowMapCanonical.{u + 1} D
      ((vectorBundleProjection D.site D.base D.base_mem W F).hom ≫ sW)
      (isGood_vectorBundle D W F sW hW) sW hW
      (vectorBundleProjection D.site D.base D.base_mem W F).hom
      rfl r (isFlat_vectorBundleProjection D.site D.base D.base_mem W F)
      (hasRelativeDimension_vectorBundleProjection D.site D.base D.base_mem W F r) k
      (k + (r : ℤ)) rfl)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_chernCap_and_bivariant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERY.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good, `ℰ` a finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module
of rank `r` and `(π : P → X, 𝒪_P(1))` its projective space bundle. For every morphism
`g : X' → X` of good algebraic spaces over `B` there are unique maps
`c_j(ℰ) ∩ - : CH_k(X') → CH_{k-j}(X')`, `j = 0, …, r`, such that `c₀(ℰ) ∩ α = α` and

`∑_{i=0}^{r} (-1)^i c₁(𝒪_{P'}(1))^i ∩ π'^*(c_{r-i}(ℰ) ∩ α) = 0`

for every `α ∈ CH_k(X')`, where `π' : P' = P ×_X X' → X'` is the base change of `π` and
`𝒪_{P'}(1)` the pullback of `𝒪_P(1)` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chernRelationSum`). Moreover these
maps define a bivariant class `c_j(ℰ)` of degree `j` on `X`: there is `C ∈ A^j(X → X)` whose cap
operation on every test space `X'` is `c_j(ℰ) ∩ -`, read on `X ×_X X' ≅ X'` along the flat
pullback of relative dimension `0` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.testSpacePullbackChowMap`).

The Chow groups are those of Stacks 0EQ6 at the canonical embeddings of Stacks 0ENK
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowGroupCanonical`), the bivariant classes those of Stacks 0ERJ over
them (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BivariantClassCanonical`), `c₀ ∩ α = α` is read through the
identification `CH_k = CH_{k-0}`, and the class is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chernClass` (Stacks 0ERZ).
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_chernCap_and_bivariant :
    (∀ {Y : D.Ambient} (g : Y ⟶ X) (hY : D.IsGood (g ≫ sX)),
      ∃! c : ∀ (j : Fin (r + 1)) (k : ℤ), chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D (g ≫ sX) hY k →+
          chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D (g ≫ sX) hY (k - ((j : ℕ) : ℤ)),
        (∀ k α, c 0 k α = ProjectiveBundleRelation.degreeCast
          (fun m => chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D (g ≫ sX) hY m) (by simp) α) ∧
          ∀ k α, chernRelationSum D sX hX E r hE g hY c k α = 0) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (r + 1), ∃ C : chowCohomologyComponentCanonical.{u + 1} D sX hX ((j : ℕ) : ℤ),
        ∀ {Y : D.Ambient} (g : Y ⟶ X) (hY : D.IsGood (g ≫ sX))
          (hXg : D.IsGood (pullback.fst (𝟙 X) g ≫ sX))
          (c : ∀ (j : Fin (r + 1)) (k : ℤ), chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D (g ≫ sX) hY k →+
            chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D (g ≫ sX) hY (k - ((j : ℕ) : ℤ))),
          (∀ k α, c 0 k α = ProjectiveBundleRelation.degreeCast
            (fun m => chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D (g ≫ sX) hY m) (by simp) α) →
          (∀ k α, chernRelationSum D sX hX E r hE g hY c k α = 0) →
          ∀ k α, C.cap g hY hXg k α = testSpacePullbackChowMap D sX hX g hY hXg _ (c j k α)
declarations.comment: existence and uniqueness of c_i(E) ∩ - : CH_k(X') → CH_{k-i}(X'), i = 0..r, with c_0 = id and sum_i (-1)^i c_1(O_{P'}(1))^i ∩ π'^*(c_{r-i}(E) ∩ α) = 0 on P' = P ×_X X', for every morphism X' → X of good spaces over B, E finite locally free of rank r on a good X/B; and the maps c_i(E) ∩ - form a bivariant class of degree i (BivariantClassCanonical, over chowGroupCanonical)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chernClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERZ: the `j`-th Chern class `c_j(ℰ) ∈ A^j(X)`** of a finite locally free module `ℰ`
of rank `r` on a good algebraic space `X/B`, `j = 0, …, r`: the bivariant class of degree `j` of
Stacks 0ERY (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_chernCap_and_bivariant`), in
`A^j(X) = A^j(X → X)` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowCohomologyComponentCanonical`). Its cap
operation on a test space `g : X' → X` is `c_j(ℰ) ∩ -` on `X'`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chernCap`), read on `X ×_X X' ≅ X'`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chernClass_cap`).
declarations.statement:
def chernClass (j : Fin (r + 1)) :
    chowCohomologyComponentCanonical.{u + 1} D sX hX ((j : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.comment: the i-th Chern class c_i(E) ∈ A^i(X), i = 0, ..., r, the bivariant class of degree i of Lemma 0ERY, for E finite locally free of rank r on a good X/B; A^i(X) = A^i(X → X) over the Chow groups chowGroupCanonical

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.totalChernClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ERZ: the total Chern class** `c(ℰ) = c₀(ℰ) + c₁(ℰ) + … + c_r(ℰ)`, the formal sum of
the Chern classes of `ℰ` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chernClass`), a nonhomogeneous class in the
Chow cohomology `A^*(X) = ⊕_p A^p(X)` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chowCohomologyCanonical`).
declarations.statement: def totalChernClass : chowCohomologyCanonical.{u + 1} D sX hX
declarations.comment: the total Chern class c(E) = c_0(E) + c_1(E) + ... + c_r(E), the formal sum of the Chern classes as a nonhomogeneous class in A^*(X) = ⊕_p A^p(X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chernCap_one_eq_firstChernBivariantClass_cap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ES0.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and let `ℒ` be an invertible
`𝒪_X`-module. Then the first Chern class `c₁(ℒ)` of Definition 0ERZ equals the bivariant class of
Stacks 0ERM (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstChernBivariantClass`).

Both are classes in `A^1(X)`, and the equality is that of their operations on the Chow groups of
every good test space `g : Y' ⟶ X`: for every `k` and `α ∈ CH_k(Y')`, the cap operation
`CH_k(Y') ⟶ CH_{k-1}(X ×_X Y')` of the class of Stacks 0ERM, followed by the identification of
`X ×_X Y'` with `Y'` (pushforward along the isomorphism `X ×_X Y' ⟶ Y'`), is
`c₁(g^*ℒ) ∩ α` for the first Chern class of Definition 0ERZ of the rank-one module `g^*ℒ` on `Y'`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PrivateChern.chernCap`, the operation on
`CH_*(Y') = ⨁_k CH_k(Y')`; `chowGroupCanonicalEquivChowGroup` identifies the Chow groups of
Stacks 0EQ6 on which the bivariant classes act with the summands of `CH_*(Y')`).
declarations.statement:
theorem chernCap_one_eq_firstChernBivariantClass_cap
    (L : Modules.{u, u} D.site D.base D.base_mem X hX.1)
    (hL : IsInvertibleModule (⟨X, hX.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces D.site D.base D.base_mem) L)
    {Y' : D.Ambient} (g : Y' ⟶ X) (hY' : D.IsGood (g ≫ sX))
    (hX' : D.IsGood (pullback.fst (𝟙 X) g ≫ sX)) (k : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroupCanonical.{u + 1} D (g ≫ sX) hY' k) :
    properPushforwardChow.{u, u + 1} D (pullback.fst (𝟙 X) g ≫ sX) hX' (g ≫ sX) hY'
        (pullback.snd (𝟙 X) g) (by rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.comp_id])
        (isProper_of_isIso D.site D.base D.base_mem (pullback.snd (𝟙 X) g))
        (DirectSum.of _ (k - 1) (chowGroupCanonicalEquivChowGroup.{u + 1} D _ hX' (k - 1)
          ((firstChernBivariantClass D sX hX L hL).cap g hY' hX' k α))) =
      chernCap.{u, u + 1} (hX := hY') (pullbackLine D (g ≫ sX) hY' sX hX g L) 1
        (isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_one_pullbackLine D sX hX g hY' L hL) 1
        (DirectSum.of _ k (chowGroupCanonicalEquivChowGroup.{u + 1} D _ hY' k α))
declarations.comment: c_1(L) ∈ A^1(X) of Definition 0ERZ (chernCap 1 on every good Y' → X) equals the bivariant class c_1(f^*L) ∩ - of Lemma 0ERM, for X/B good and L invertible

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowCohomologyClass.chernCap_commute_capChowHomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ES1.** In Situation 0EDT let `X/B` be good and let `c ∈ A^p(X)` (Stacks 0ERK,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ChowCohomologyClass`). Then `c` commutes with the Chern classes of
