declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universallySubmersive_sigmaDesc_iff_isHCovering_of_isNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETT.** For a finite family `{X i ⟶ X}` of morphisms of finite type to a Noetherian
scheme `X`, the morphism `∐ X i ⟶ X` is universally submersive if and only if the family is an h
covering.

The implication from the h covering condition is
`AlgebraicGeometry.universallySubmersive_sigmaDesc_of_isHCovering` and needs neither finiteness
nor the Noetherian hypothesis; the converse is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isHCovering_of_universallySubmersive_of_isNoetherian` above.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallySubmersive_sigmaDesc_iff_isHCovering_of_isNoetherian {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] {I : Type v} [Finite I] [Small.{u} I] {Y : I → Scheme.{u}} (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    [∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType (f i)] [∀ i, QuasiCompact (f i)] :
    UniversallySubmersive (Sigma.desc f) ↔ IsHCovering Y f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universallySubmersive_sigmaDesc_of_isHCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETT, (2) implies (1).** The morphism from the disjoint union of the sources of an
h covering to its target is universally submersive.

An h covering is a ph covering, hence a V covering, and the disjoint-union morphism of a V
covering is universally submersive. No Noetherian or finiteness hypothesis is involved.
declarations.comment: (2) implies (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isHCovering_of_universallySubmersive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETT, (1) implies (2)**, granted
`AlgebraicGeometry.UniversallySubmersiveHasPHRefinement`: a finite family of morphisms of finite
type to a Noetherian scheme whose disjoint-union morphism is universally submersive is an h
covering.

The hypothesis supplies a ph covering refining the family; a family of morphisms locally of
finite type refined by a ph covering is a ph covering (Stacks 0ET9), and over a locally
Noetherian base the ph coverings are exactly the h coverings (Stacks 0H45).
declarations.statement:
theorem isHCovering_of_universallySubmersive (H : UniversallySubmersiveHasPHRefinement.{u, v})
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {I : Type v} [Finite I] [Small.{u} I]
    {Y : I → Scheme.{u}} (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) [∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType (f i)]
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (f i)] (hsub : UniversallySubmersive (Sigma.desc f)) :
    IsHCovering Y f
declarations.comment: (1) implies (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universallySubmersive_sigmaDesc_iff_isHCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETT**, granted `AlgebraicGeometry.UniversallySubmersiveHasPHRefinement`: for a
finite family `{X i ⟶ X}` of morphisms of finite type to a Noetherian scheme `X`, the morphism
`∐ X i ⟶ X` is universally submersive if and only if the family is an h covering.

The implication from the h covering condition is unconditional; the hypothesis is used only for
the converse.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallySubmersive_sigmaDesc_iff_isHCovering
    (H : UniversallySubmersiveHasPHRefinement.{u, v}) {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    {I : Type v} [Finite I] [Small.{u} I] {Y : I → Scheme.{u}} (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    [∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType (f i)] [∀ i, QuasiCompact (f i)] :
    UniversallySubmersive (Sigma.desc f) ↔ IsHCovering Y f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finitePresentation_proper_refinement_of_isHCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETU.** An h covering of an affine scheme `T` is refined by a finite family of
affine opens of a single proper surjective morphism `Y ⟶ T` of finite presentation: the opens
cover `Y` and each of them maps to a member of the h covering over `T`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finitePresentation_proper_refinement_of_isHCovering
    {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] {I : Type v}
    (X : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T)
    (hf : IsHCovering X f) :
    ∃ (J : Type u) (Y : Scheme.{u}) (p : Y ⟶ T)
      (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (j : ∀ k, V k ⟶ Y),
      Finite J ∧
        IsProper p ∧
        Surjective p ∧
        FinitePresentation p ∧
        (∀ k, IsAffine (V k)) ∧
        (∀ k, IsOpenImmersion (j k)) ∧
        (⋃ k, Set.range (j k)) = Set.univ ∧
        (∀ k, ∃ i : I, ∃ h : V k ⟶ X i, h ≫ f i = j k ≫ p)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsHCovering.of_fppf_syntomic_smooth_etale_zariski
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0ETV].** An fppf covering is an h covering. Hence syntomic, smooth, étale
and Zariski coverings are h coverings as well.

Here a family `{f i : X i ⟶ T}` is an fppf (resp. syntomic, smooth, étale, Zariski) covering
when its members are flat and locally of finite presentation (resp. syntomic, smooth, étale,
open immersions) and jointly surjective, that is, when `Presieve.ofArrows X f` belongs to the
corresponding precoverage; it is an h covering, `AlgebraicGeometry.IsHCovering` (Stacks 0ETS),
when its members are locally of finite presentation and it is a ph covering (Stacks 0DBG).

The fppf case holds because the members of an fppf covering are locally of finite
presentation and an fppf covering is a ph covering, Stacks 0DBT; the other four follow from it
and Stacks 021N.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsHCovering.of_fppf_syntomic_smooth_etale_zariski {T : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v}
    (X : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T) :
    (Presieve.ofArrows X f ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage T → IsHCovering X f) ∧
    (Presieve.ofArrows X f ∈
      Scheme.precoverage (@Syntomic : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) T → IsHCovering X f) ∧
    (Presieve.ofArrows X f ∈
      Scheme.precoverage (@Smooth : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) T → IsHCovering X f) ∧
    (Presieve.ofArrows X f ∈ Scheme.etalePrecoverage T → IsHCovering X f) ∧
    (Presieve.ofArrows X f ∈ Scheme.zariskiPrecoverage T → IsHCovering X f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.surjective_proper_isHCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETW.** A surjective proper morphism of schemes of finite presentation is an h
covering by itself.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isHCovering_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETX.** A family of morphisms of schemes which are locally of finite
presentation is an h covering if and only if some h covering refines it, if and only if its
disjoint-union morphism is an h covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isHCovering_tfae {T : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v} [Small.{u} I]
    (X : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T)
    (hlfp : ∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f i)) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsHCovering X f,
      ∃ (K : Type v) (Y : K → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ k, Y k ⟶ T),
        IsHCovering Y g ∧
          Nonempty
            (({ I₀ := K, X := Y, f := g } : PreZeroHypercover T).Hom
              ({ I₀ := I, X := X, f := f } : PreZeroHypercover T)),
      IsHCovering (fun _ : Unit ↦ ∐ X) (fun _ ↦ Sigma.desc f)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isHCovering_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETY, part (1).** An isomorphism of schemes, regarded as a family indexed by a
type with exactly one element, is an h covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isHCovering_of_isIso {T' T : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v} [Unique I] (f : T' ⟶ T)
    [IsIso f] : IsHCovering (fun _ : I ↦ T') (fun _ ↦ f)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isHCovering_bind
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETY part (2).** Composing an h covering with an h covering of each of its
members gives an h covering.

Local finite presentation is closed under composition, and the ph-covering condition is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPHCovering_bind`, which is Stacks 0DBI part (2).
declarations.statement:
public theorem isHCovering_bind {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} T) (hE : IsHCovering E.X E.f)
    (F : ∀ i, PreZeroHypercover.{w} (E.X i))
    (hF : ∀ i, IsHCovering (F i).X (F i).f) :
    IsHCovering (E.bind F).X (E.bind F).f
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isHCovering_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETY part (3).** The base change of an h covering along an arbitrary morphism of
schemes is an h covering.

Local finite presentation is stable under base change, and the ph-covering condition is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPHCovering_pullback`, which is Stacks 0DBI part (3).
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ETZ.** A big h site consists of an initial set of schemes and initial h
coverings, a sufficiently large cutoff category containing them, and a bounded collection of
h coverings satisfying the site axioms and representing every h covering.
declarations.statement: public structure BigHSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHSite.exists_isCovering_tautologicallyEquivalent_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU0, part (3).** A Zariski covering of an object of a big h site is
tautologically equivalent to a covering belonging to that site.
declarations.statement:
public theorem BigHSite.exists_isCovering_tautologicallyEquivalent_openCover
    (B : BigHSite.{u}) (T : B.Schemes) (𝒰 : (B.inclusion.obj T).OpenCover.{v}) :
    ∃ 𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} T,
      B.IsCovering ⟨T, 𝒱⟩ ∧
        PreZeroHypercover.TautologicallyEquivalent 𝒰.toPreZeroHypercover
          (𝒱.map B.inclusion)
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isCovering_refinement_of_isHCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU0, part (1).** An arbitrary h covering of an object of a big h site is refined
by one of the site's own covering families.

The affine opens of the target are a Zariski covering, hence by part (3) tautologically
equivalent to a chosen family `G`.  Each member of `G` is isomorphic over the target to an
affine open, so the base change of the given family to it is an h covering of an affine
scheme; Stacks 0ETU refines that base change by a standard h covering, which part (2)
realizes inside the site.  The site's composition axiom assembles the realized families into
the required covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isCovering_refinement_of_isHCovering
    (B : BigHSite.{u}) (T : B.Schemes) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{v} (B.inclusion.obj T))
    (h𝒰 : IsHCovering 𝒰.X 𝒰.f) :
    ∃ 𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} T,
      B.IsCovering ⟨T, 𝒱⟩ ∧ Nonempty ((𝒱.map B.inclusion).Hom 𝒰)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isCovering_tautologicallyEquivalent_standardHCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU0, part (2).** A standard h covering of an affine object of a big h site is
tautologically equivalent to a covering belonging to that site.

Parts (1) and (3) are `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isCovering_refinement_of_isHCovering` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigHSite.exists_isCovering_tautologicallyEquivalent_openCover`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isCovering_tautologicallyEquivalent_standardHCovering
    (B : BigHSite.{u}) (T : B.Schemes) [IsAffine (B.inclusion.obj T)]
    (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{v} (B.inclusion.obj T))
    (hstandard : IsStandardHCovering 𝒰.f) :
    ∃ 𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} T,
      B.IsCovering ⟨T, 𝒱⟩ ∧
        PreZeroHypercover.TautologicallyEquivalent 𝒰 (𝒱.map B.inclusion)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU1, part (1).** The big h category of `S` is the slice of the chosen big h
category over its object `S`.
declarations.statement: public abbrev BigHOver
declarations.comment: part (1), category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.IsCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU1, part (1).** A family in the slice covers precisely when its underlying
family covers in the chosen big h site.
declarations.statement: public abbrev IsCovering (E : Covering (BigHOver B S hS)) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1), coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineH
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU1, part (2).** The big affine h category is the full subcategory of affine
objects in the big h category over `S`.
declarations.statement: public abbrev BigAffineH
declarations.comment: part (2), category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineH.IsCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU1, part (2).** An affine family covers exactly when it covers in the big h
site over `S` and is a standard h covering.
declarations.statement: public abbrev IsCovering (E : Covering (BigAffineH B S hS)) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2), coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineH.isSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU2.** The standard h covering families of the affine objects of the big h
category over `S` satisfy the site axioms.
declarations.statement:
public lemma BigAffineH.isSite (B : BigHSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) :
    IsSite (BigAffineH.IsCovering B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHSites_hasPullbacks_preservesPullbacks_final
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU3.** Let `B` be a big h site containing the scheme `S`. The underlying
categories of the big h site, of the big h site over `S`, and of the big affine h site over `S`
have fibre products; in each case the canonical functor to the category of all schemes
commutes with fibre products; and `S / S` is a final object of the big h site over `S`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigHSites_hasPullbacks_preservesPullbacks_final :
    (HasPullbacks B.Schemes ∧ HasPullbacks (BigHOver B S hS) ∧
        HasPullbacks (BigAffineH B S hS)) ∧
      (PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan B.inclusion ∧
        PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan (BigHOver.toScheme B S hS) ∧
        PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan (BigAffineH.toScheme B S hS)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsTerminal (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj S hS)) : BigHOver B S hS))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineH.isCocontinuous_inclusion
declarations.doc:
Let `B` be a big h site containing a scheme `S`. The inclusion of the big affine h category
over `S` into the big h category over `S` is cocontinuous for the two topologies of Stacks 0EU1.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCocontinuous_inclusion :
    (inclusion B S hS).IsCocontinuous (topology B S hS) (BigHOver.topology B S hS)
declarations.comment: cocontinuity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineH.isDenseSubsite_inclusion
declarations.doc:
Let `B` be a big h site containing a scheme `S`. The inclusion of the big affine h category
over `S` into the big h category over `S` exhibits the big affine h site as a *dense subsite* of
the big h site over `S`, in the sense of `CategoryTheory.Functor.IsDenseSubsite`; consequently
the two halves of the induced morphism of topoi are equivalences of categories and
`Sh((Aff/S)_h) ≃ Sh((Sch/S)_h)`.
declarations.statement:
public instance isDenseSubsite_inclusion :
    (inclusion B S hS).IsDenseSubsite (topology B S hS) (BigHOver.topology B S hS)
declarations.comment: equivalence of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineH.toposEquivInclusion
declarations.doc:
The topos of set-valued sheaves on the big affine h site over `S` is equivalent to the topos
of set-valued sheaves on the big h site over `S`, the equivalence being restriction along the
inclusion.
declarations.comment: equivalence of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.IsProperFinitePresentationSheaf.affine
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU5, (2) implies (2′).** Condition (2′) is the restriction of condition (2) to
an affine target, so it is implied by it with no use of condition (1).
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsProperFinitePresentationSheaf.affine
    (hF : BigHOver.IsProperFinitePresentationSheaf B S hS F) :
    BigHOver.IsAffineProperFinitePresentationSheaf B S hS F
declarations.comment: (2) implies (2′)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.isZariskiSheaf_of_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU5, a sheaf satisfies condition (1).** A sheaf on the big h site over `S`
satisfies the sheaf condition for Zariski coverings.

A jointly surjective family of open immersions is a Zariski covering, hence a ph covering by
Stacks 0DBH; its members are locally of finite presentation, so the family is an h
covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZariskiSheaf_of_isSheaf
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigHOver.topology B S hS) F) :
    BigHOver.IsZariskiSheaf B S hS F
declarations.comment: only if, condition (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.isProperFinitePresentationSheaf_of_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU5, a sheaf satisfies condition (2).** A sheaf on the big h site over `S`
satisfies the sheaf condition for the one-element family attached to a morphism of the site
which is proper, surjective and of finite presentation.

Such a morphism is an h covering all by itself, by Stacks 0ETW.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isProperFinitePresentationSheaf_of_isSheaf
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigHOver.topology B S hS) F) :
    BigHOver.IsProperFinitePresentationSheaf B S hS F
declarations.comment: only if, condition (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.bijective_mapToEqualizer_of_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU5, condition (2) for a sheaf, in equalizer form.** Let `f : V ⟶ U` be a
morphism of the big h category over `S` whose underlying morphism of schemes is proper,
surjective and of finite presentation, and let `p₁, p₂ : W ⟶ V` complete `f` to a cartesian
square, so that `W = V ×_U V`.  Then a sheaf `F` on the big h site over `S` maps `F(U)`
bijectively onto the equalizer of the two maps `F(V) ⟶ F(W)`.

This is the form in which the source states condition (2).  The case of an affine target `U`
is condition (2′).
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_mapToEqualizer_of_isSheaf
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigHOver.topology B S hS) F)
    {V U W : BigHOver B S hS} (f : V ⟶ U) (p₁ p₂ : W ⟶ V)
    (hW : IsPullback p₁ p₂ f f)
    (hproper : IsProper ((BigHOver.toScheme B S hS).map f))
    (hsurj : Surjective ((BigHOver.toScheme B S hS).map f))
    (hfp : FinitePresentation ((BigHOver.toScheme B S hS).map f)) :
    Function.Bijective (regularTopology.mapToEqualizer F f p₁ p₂ hW.w)
declarations.comment: only if, condition (2) in equalizer form

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.isProperFinitePresentationSheaf_of_affine
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU5, (1) and (2′) imply (2).** Given the sheaf condition for Zariski coverings,
the sheaf condition for a proper surjective morphism of finite presentation need only be
checked when its target has affine underlying scheme.

The target `X` is covered by the affine opens of its underlying scheme, a Zariski covering of
the site; the base change of `f` over each of them has affine target, so condition (2′)
applies, and the base change over a fibre product of two of them is separated by
`properFP_pullback_isSeparated`.  The Zariski covering is strongly sheaf for `F` by condition
(1), and `CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.IsStronglySheafFor.isSheafFor_of_pullback` assembles
the local sheaf conditions into the sheaf condition for `{f}` itself.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isProperFinitePresentationSheaf_of_affine
    {F : (BigHOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v}
    (hZ : BigHOver.IsZariskiSheaf B S hS F)
    (hA : BigHOver.IsAffineProperFinitePresentationSheaf B S hS F) :
    BigHOver.IsProperFinitePresentationSheaf B S hS F
declarations.comment: (1) and (2′) imply (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.isProperFinitePresentationSheaf_iff_affine
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU5, the final assertion.** Given the sheaf condition for Zariski coverings,
condition (2) of Stacks 0EU5 is equivalent to its restriction (2′) to morphisms whose target
has affine underlying scheme.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isProperFinitePresentationSheaf_iff_affine
    {F : (BigHOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v}
    (hZ : BigHOver.IsZariskiSheaf B S hS F) :
    BigHOver.IsProperFinitePresentationSheaf B S hS F ↔
      BigHOver.IsAffineProperFinitePresentationSheaf B S hS F
declarations.comment: given (1), (2) is equivalent to (2′)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.isSheaf_of_isZariskiSheaf_of_isProperFinitePresentationSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU5, the sufficiency direction.** Conditions (1) and (2) together force a
presheaf of sets on the big h category over `S` to be a sheaf for the h topology.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSheaf_of_isZariskiSheaf_of_isProperFinitePresentationSheaf
    {F : (BigHOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v}
    (hZ : BigHOver.IsZariskiSheaf B S hS F)
    (hP : BigHOver.IsProperFinitePresentationSheaf B S hS F) :
    Presieve.IsSheaf (BigHOver.topology B S hS) F
declarations.comment: if, (1) and (2) imply the sheaf condition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.isSheaf_iff_isZariskiSheaf_and_isProperFinitePresentationSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU5, the characterization.** A presheaf of sets on the big h category over `S` is
a sheaf for the h topology if and only if it satisfies condition (1), the sheaf condition for
Zariski coverings, and condition (2), the sheaf condition for every morphism of the site which
is proper, surjective and of finite presentation.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.isSheafFor_singleton_iff_bijective_mapToEqualizer` condition (2) is the
source's requirement that the sections over the target map bijectively onto the equalizer of
the two maps to the sections over `V ×_U V`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSheaf_iff_isZariskiSheaf_and_isProperFinitePresentationSheaf
    (B : BigHSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : (BigHOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigHOver.topology B S hS) F ↔
      (BigHOver.IsZariskiSheaf B S hS F ∧
        BigHOver.IsProperFinitePresentationSheaf B S hS F)
declarations.comment: sheaf characterization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCocontinuous_bigHOverMap
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0EU6.** The functor `u : (Sch/T)_h ⥤ (Sch/S)_h`, `V/T ↦ V/S`, is cocontinuous.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCocontinuous_bigHOverMap :
    (Over.map f).IsCocontinuous (B.topology.over T) (B.topology.over S)
declarations.comment: `u : V/T ↦ V/S` is cocontinuous

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isContinuous_bigHOverMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU6**, used in the proof. The functor `u : (Sch/T)_h ⥤ (Sch/S)_h`,
`V/T ↦ V/S`, is continuous.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isContinuous_bigHOverMap :
    (Over.map f).IsContinuous (B.topology.over T) (B.topology.over S)
declarations.comment: `u : V/T ↦ V/S` is continuous

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHOverMapPullbackAdj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU6.** The functor `v : (Sch/S)_h ⥤ (Sch/T)_h` given by base change along `f` is
a right adjoint of `u`: for `U/T` and `V/S` one has `Mor_S(u(U), V) = Mor_T(U, V ×_S T)`.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def bigHOverMapPullbackAdj : Over.map f ⊣ Over.pullback f
declarations.comment: `v : U/S ↦ U ×_S T/T` is a right adjoint of `u`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isContinuous_bigHOverPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU6.** The functor `v : (Sch/S)_h ⥤ (Sch/T)_h`, `U/S ↦ U ×_S T/T`, is
continuous.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isContinuous_bigHOverPullback :
    (Over.pullback f).IsContinuous (B.topology.over S) (B.topology.over T)
declarations.comment: `v : U/S ↦ U ×_S T/T` is continuous

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHMorphismOfTopoi_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU6.** The functors `u` and `v` induce the same morphism of topoi: the direct
image `{}_s u` attached to cocontinuity of `u` is the direct image `v^s` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigHMorphismOfTopoi`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigHMorphismOfTopoi_pushforwardIso :
    (Over.map f).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (B.topology.over T) (B.topology.over S) ≅
      (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B f).pushforward
declarations.comment: `u` and `v` induce the same morphism of topoi `f_big`, direct images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHMorphismOfTopoi_inverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU6.** The inverse image `(u^p -)^#` attached to cocontinuity of `u` is the
inverse image of `AlgebraicGeometry.bigHMorphismOfTopoi`, namely plain restriction along `u`:
the sheafification is unnecessary.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigHMorphismOfTopoi_inverseImageIso :
    (Over.map f).sheafPullbackCocontinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (B.topology.over T) (B.topology.over S) ≅
      (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B f).inverseImage
declarations.comment: `u` and `v` induce the same morphism of topoi `f_big`, inverse images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHMorphismOfTopoi_inverseImage_obj_obj_obj
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0EU6**, the formula `f_big^{-1}(G)(U/T) = G(U/S)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigHMorphismOfTopoi_inverseImage_obj_obj_obj
    (G : Sheaf (BigHOver.topology B S.obj S.property) (Type (u + 1))) (U : Over T) :
    ((bigHMorphismOfTopoi B f).inverseImage.obj G).obj.obj (op U) =
      G.obj.obj (op ((Over.map f).obj U))
declarations.comment: `f_big⁻¹(G)(U/T) = G(U/S)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHMorphismOfTopoi_pushforward_obj_obj_obj
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0EU6**, the formula `f_{big,*}(F)(U/S) = F(U ×_S T/T)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigHMorphismOfTopoi_pushforward_obj_obj_obj
    (F : Sheaf (BigHOver.topology B T.obj T.property) (Type (u + 1))) (U : Over S) :
    ((bigHMorphismOfTopoi B f).pushforward.obj F).obj.obj (op U) =
      F.obj.obj (op ((Over.pullback f).obj U))
declarations.comment: `f_big,*(F)(U/S) = F(U ×_S T/T)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHSheafPushforwardCocontinuousObjIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU6**, the formula `f_{big,*}(F)(U/S) = F(U ×_S T/T)` for the direct image
`{}_s u` attached to cocontinuity of `u`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigHSheafPushforwardCocontinuousObjIso
    (F : Sheaf (BigHOver.topology B T.obj T.property) (Type (u + 1))) (U : Over S) :
    (((Over.map f).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (B.topology.over T) (B.topology.over S)).obj F).obj.obj (op U) ≅
      F.obj.obj (op ((Over.pullback f).obj U))
declarations.comment: `f_big,*(F)(U/S) = F(U ×_S T/T)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHLowerShriekAdj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU6.** The inverse image `f_big^{-1}` has a left adjoint `f_{big!}`, namely the
sheaf pullback along the continuous functor `u`.
declarations.comment: `f_big⁻¹` has a left adjoint `f_big!`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.preservesLimitsOfShape_bigHLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU6.** The left adjoint `f_{big!}` of `f_big^{-1}` commutes with fibre products
and equalizers, and more generally with every finite connected limit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem preservesLimitsOfShape_bigHLowerShriek
    (I : Type t) [SmallCategory I] [FinCategory I] [IsConnected I] :
    PreservesLimitsOfShape I
      ((Over.map f).sheafPullback (Type (u + 1))
        (B.topology.over T) (B.topology.over S))
declarations.comment: `f_big!` commutes with fibre products and equalizers

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.preservesLimitsOfShape_walkingCospan_bigHLowerShriek
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0EU6.** `f_{big!}` commutes with fibre products.
declarations.statement:
public theorem preservesLimitsOfShape_walkingCospan_bigHLowerShriek :
    PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan
      ((Over.map f).sheafPullback (Type (u + 1))
        (B.topology.over T) (B.topology.over S))
declarations.comment: `f_big!` commutes with fibre products and equalizers

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.preservesLimitsOfShape_walkingParallelPair_bigHLowerShriek
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0EU6.** `f_{big!}` commutes with equalizers.
declarations.statement:
public theorem preservesLimitsOfShape_walkingParallelPair_bigHLowerShriek :
    PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair
      ((Over.map f).sheafPullback (Type (u + 1))
        (B.topology.over T) (B.topology.over S))
declarations.comment: `f_big!` commutes with fibre products and equalizers

registrations.name: StacksRelocalization.sheafPushforwardOverMapIso
registrations.comment: same_topos

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHMorphismOfTopoi_comp_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU7.** The direct image of the morphism of big h topoi attached to a composite
is canonically isomorphic to the composite of the direct images.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigHMorphismOfTopoi_comp_pushforwardIso (B : BigHSite.{u})
    {X Y Z : B.Schemes} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    ((bigHMorphismOfTopoi B g).comp (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B f)).pushforward ≅
      (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B (f ≫ g)).pushforward
declarations.comment: direct image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHMorphismOfTopoi_comp_inverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU7.** The inverse image of the morphism of big h topoi attached to a composite
is canonically isomorphic to the composite of the inverse images; the isomorphism is the
adjunction mate of the comparison of direct images.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigHMorphismOfTopoi_comp_inverseImageIso (B : BigHSite.{u})
    {X Y Z : B.Schemes} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    ((bigHMorphismOfTopoi B g).comp (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B f)).inverseImage ≅
      (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B (f ≫ g)).inverseImage
declarations.comment: inverse image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigHMorphismOfTopoi_comp_unit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EU7.** The comparisons of direct and inverse images for a composite respect the
units of the geometric adjunctions, so together they form an isomorphism of morphisms of
topoi.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigHMorphismOfTopoi_comp_unit (B : BigHSite.{u}) {X Y Z : B.Schemes}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (V : Sheaf (BigHOver.topology B Z.obj Z.property) (Type (u + 1))) :
    (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B (f ≫ g)).adj.unit.app V ≫
        (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B (f ≫ g)).pushforward.map
          ((bigHMorphismOfTopoi_comp_inverseImageIso B f g).inv.app V) ≫
        (bigHMorphismOfTopoi_comp_pushforwardIso B f g).inv.app
          (((bigHMorphismOfTopoi B g).comp (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B f)).inverseImage.obj V) =
      ((bigHMorphismOfTopoi B g).comp (bigHMorphismOfTopoi B f)).adj.unit.app V
declarations.comment: compatibility with the adjunction

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.exists_universallySubmersive_not_isVCovering
declarations.doc:
An affine, universally submersive morphism whose singleton family is not a
V covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_universallySubmersive_not_isVCovering :
    ∃ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsAffine X) (_ : IsAffine Y) (f : X ⟶ Y),
      (topologically @Topology.IsQuotientMap : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).universally f ∧
        ¬ AlgebraicGeometry.IsVCovering (fun _ : Unit => X) (fun _ => f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.quasicoherentSectionsEqualizer_iff_isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EUA.** A family of morphisms of affine schemes satisfies the
global-section equalizer condition for every quasi-coherent module if and only if it is a
universal effective epimorphic family in the category of affine schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentSectionsEqualizer_iff_isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily
    {I : Type w} (X : AffineScheme.{u}) (U : I → AffineScheme.{u})
    (f : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X) :
    IsQuasicoherentSectionsEqualizer X U f ↔
      StacksEffectiveEpi.IsUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily U f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.jointlySurjective_of_isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily
declarations.doc:
A universal effective epimorphic family of schemes is jointly surjective
on the underlying spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem jointlySurjective_of_isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily
    {I : Type w} {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : I → Scheme.{u})
    (f : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (h : StacksEffectiveEpi.IsUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily U f) :
    ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (f i)
declarations.comment: schemes_surjective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_preimage_of_isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily
declarations.doc: A universal effective epimorphic family of affine schemes is jointly surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_preimage_of_isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily
    {I : Type w} (X : AffineScheme.{u}) (U : I → AffineScheme.{u})
    (f : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (h : StacksEffectiveEpi.IsUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily U f) :
    ∀ x : X.obj, ∃ (i : I) (y : (U i).obj),
      (AffineScheme.forgetToScheme.map (f i)) y = x
declarations.comment: affine_schemes_surjective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily_of_affine_baseChange
declarations.doc:
A family of morphisms of schemes is universally effective epimorphic if all its
base changes to affine schemes are effective epimorphic families.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily_of_affine_baseChange
    {I : Type w} {X : Scheme.{u}} (X' : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, X' i ⟶ X)
    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (g : Y ⟶ X),
      StacksEffectiveEpi.IsEffectiveEpiFamily
        (fun i => pullback (f i) g) (fun i => pullback.snd (f i) g)) :
    StacksEffectiveEpi.IsUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily X' f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily_of_affine_of_submersive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EUD.** A universally effective epimorphic family of affine
schemes whose every affine base change is submersive is a universally effective
epimorphic family in schemes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily_of_affine_of_submersive
    {I : Type w} (X : AffineScheme.{u}) (U : I → AffineScheme.{u})
    (f : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (h_affine : StacksEffectiveEpi.IsUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily U f)
    (h_submersive : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (g : Y ⟶ X.obj),
      Topology.IsQuotientMap
        (fun p : Σ i : I,
            (pullback (AffineScheme.forgetToScheme.map (f i)) g : Scheme.{u}) =>
          (pullback.snd (AffineScheme.forgetToScheme.map (f p.1)) g).base p.2)) :
    StacksEffectiveEpi.IsUniversalEffectiveEpiFamily
      (fun i => (U i).obj) (fun i => AffineScheme.forgetToScheme.map (f i))

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.exists_infinite_flat_family_moduleDescentEqualizer
declarations.doc:
An infinite family of flat algebra maps satisfies module descent, but no finite subfamily
satisfies it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_infinite_flat_family_moduleDescentEqualizer :
    ∃ (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (I : Type v) (_ : Infinite I)
      (B : I → CommAlgCat.{u} A),
      (∀ i, Module.Flat A (B i)) ∧
        IsModuleDescentEqualizer A B Set.univ ∧
          (∀ J : Set I, J.Finite → ¬ IsModuleDescentEqualizer A B J)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.SpecIntQuasiCompactCounterexample.specInt_not_isQuasiCompactObject_canonicalTopology
declarations.doc:
The spectrum of the integers is not quasi-compact in the canonical topology
on the category of schemes.

declarations.name: PrimeSpectrum.isHomeomorph_comap_and_residueFieldMap_bijective_of_adjoin_sq_cube_eq_top
declarations.doc:
Let `R → S` be a ring map with locally nilpotent kernel such that `S` is generated as an
`R`-algebra by elements whose square and cube lie in the image of `R`. Then `Spec S → Spec R` is a
homeomorphism, the induced residue field extensions `κ(𝔭) → κ(𝔮)` are isomorphisms, and both
hypotheses again hold for the base change `R' → S'` of `R → S` along any ring map `R → R'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isHomeomorph_comap_and_residueFieldMap_bijective_of_adjoin_sq_cube_eq_top
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin R
      {x : S | x ^ 2 ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra R S) ∧ x ^ 3 ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra R S)} = ⊤)
    (hker : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R S) ≤ nilradical R) :
    IsHomeomorph (comap (algebraMap R S)) ∧
      (∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
        (hpq : p = q.comap (algebraMap R S)),
          Function.Bijective (Ideal.ResidueField.map p q (algebraMap R S) hpq)) ∧
      ∀ (R' : Type v) (S' : Type w) [CommRing R'] [CommRing S'] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S']
        [Algebra S S'] [Algebra R' S'] [IsScalarTower R S S'] [IsScalarTower R R' S']
        [Algebra.IsPushout R S R' S'],
          Algebra.adjoin R'
            {x : S' | x ^ 2 ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra R' S') ∧ x ^ 3 ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra R' S')} = ⊤ ∧
            RingHom.ker (algebraMap R' S') ≤ nilradical R'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universalHomeomorphism_spec_quotient_of_pPower_mul
declarations.doc:
If `p` is prime and `p ^ p * x = y ^ p`, adjoining a common prime-power root as in
Stacks Project, Tag 0EUI, induces a universal homeomorphism on spectra.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalHomeomorphism_spec_quotient_of_pPower_mul
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (x y : A) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hxy : (p : A) ^ p * x = y ^ p) :
    let B := Polynomial A ⧸ Ideal.span
      {Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C x,
        Polynomial.C (p : A) * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C y}
    UniversalHomeomorphism
      (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)).op)
declarations.comment: p_power_multiple

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.squareCubeSpecMap_universalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc: The square-cube extension induces a universal homeomorphism on spectra.
declarations.statement:
public lemma squareCubeSpecMap_universalHomeomorphism
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (x y : A) (hxy : x ^ 3 = y ^ 2) :
    UniversalHomeomorphism (squareCubeSpecMap A x y)
declarations.comment: square_cube

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_residueFieldMap_squareCubeSpecMap
declarations.doc: The square-cube extension induces an isomorphism on the residue field at every point.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isIso_residueFieldMap_squareCubeSpecMap
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (x y : A) (hxy : x ^ 3 = y ^ 2)
    (z : Spec (.of (SquareCubeAlgebra A x y))) :
    IsIso ((squareCubeSpecMap A x y).residueFieldMap z)
declarations.comment: square_cube

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFilteredColimit_finitePresentation_universalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc:
A ring map inducing a universal homeomorphism on spectra is a filtered colimit of finitely
presented ring maps which induce universal homeomorphisms on spectra.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFilteredColimit_finitePresentation_universalHomeomorphism
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
    (hf : UniversalHomeomorphism
      (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f).op)) :
    ObjectProperty.ind.{u}
      (fun C : Under (CommRingCat.of A) ↦
        C.hom.hom.FinitePresentation ∧
          UniversalHomeomorphism (Scheme.Spec.map C.hom.op))
      (Under.mk (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
declarations.comment: universal_homeomorphism_filtered_colimit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ind_finitePresentation_residueFieldMap_isIso_universalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc:
A ring map which is a universal homeomorphism on spectra and induces isomorphisms on
residue fields is a filtered colimit of finitely presented ring maps with both properties.
declarations.statement:
public theorem ind_finitePresentation_residueFieldMap_isIso_universalHomeomorphism
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
    (hres : ∀ x : Spec (.of B),
      IsIso ((Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f).op).residueFieldMap x))
    (huh : UniversalHomeomorphism
      (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f).op)) :
    ObjectProperty.ind.{u}
      (fun C : Under (CommRingCat.of A) ↦
        C.hom.hom.FinitePresentation ∧
          (UniversalHomeomorphism (Scheme.Spec.map C.hom.op) ∧
            ∀ x : Spec C.right,
              IsIso ((Scheme.Spec.map C.hom.op).residueFieldMap x)))
      (Under.mk (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
declarations.comment: residue_field_isomorphism_filtered_colimit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_universalHomeomorphism_specMap_of_isColimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUJ.** Let a commutative `A`-algebra of finite type be presented as a filtered
colimit of `A`-algebras of finite presentation with surjective transition maps.  If its morphism
on spectra over `Spec A` is a universal homeomorphism, then so is the one of every sufficiently
late stage of the diagram.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_universalHomeomorphism_specMap_of_isColimit
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {J : Type v} [Category.{w} J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ CommAlgCat.{u} A) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    [Algebra.FiniteType A c.pt]
    (hfp : ∀ i, Algebra.FinitePresentation A (F.obj i))
    (hsurj : ∀ {i j : J} (f : i ⟶ j), Function.Surjective (F.map f))
    [UniversalHomeomorphism (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A c.pt)).op)] :
    ∃ i : J, ∀ {j : J} (_ : i ⟶ j),
      UniversalHomeomorphism
        (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (F.obj j))).op)
declarations.comment: universal homeomorphism at a finite stage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_universalHomeomorphism_and_isIso_residueFieldMap_of_isColimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUJ.** Let a commutative `A`-algebra of finite type be presented as a filtered
colimit of `A`-algebras of finite presentation with surjective transition maps.  If its morphism
on spectra over `Spec A` is a universal homeomorphism which induces isomorphisms on residue
fields, then the same holds at every sufficiently late stage of the diagram.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_universalHomeomorphism_and_isIso_residueFieldMap_of_isColimit
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {J : Type v} [Category.{w} J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ CommAlgCat.{u} A) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    [Algebra.FiniteType A c.pt]
    (hfp : ∀ i, Algebra.FinitePresentation A (F.obj i))
    (hsurj : ∀ {i j : J} (f : i ⟶ j), Function.Surjective (F.map f))
    [UniversalHomeomorphism (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A c.pt)).op)]
    (hres : ∀ x : Spec (.of c.pt), IsIso ((Scheme.Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A c.pt)).op).residueFieldMap x)) :
    ∃ i : J, ∀ {j : J} (_ : i ⟶ j),
      UniversalHomeomorphism
          (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (F.obj j))).op) ∧
        ∀ x : Spec (.of (F.obj j)), IsIso ((Scheme.Spec.map
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (F.obj j))).op).residueFieldMap x)
declarations.comment: universal homeomorphism with equal residue fields at a finite stage

declarations.name: IsSeminormalRing
declarations.doc:
A commutative ring is seminormal if every `x, y` with `x ^ 3 = y ^ 2` are uniquely the
square and cube of a common element.

Use `isSeminormalRing_iff` to rewrite this predicate and
`IsSeminormalRing.existsUnique_of_cube_eq_square` to apply its defining condition.
declarations.statement: def IsSeminormalRing (A : Type*) [CommRing A] : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing
declarations.doc:
A commutative ring is absolutely weakly normal if it is seminormal and, for every prime
number `p`, every solution of `p ^ p * x = y ^ p` uniquely has the prescribed form
`x = a ^ p`, `y = p * a`.

Use `isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing_iff` to rewrite this predicate,
`IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing.isSeminormalRing` for its seminormal part, and
`IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing.existsUnique_of_prime_pow_mul_eq_pow` for its prime-root
condition.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing (A : Type*) [CommRing A] : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: isSeminormalRing_propertyIsLocal
declarations.doc: Seminormality is a local property of commutative rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeminormalRing_propertyIsLocal :
    CommRing.PropertyIsLocal
      (fun (R : Type u) [CommRing R] => IsSeminormalRing R)
declarations.comment: seminormal_local_property

declarations.name: isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing_propertyIsLocal
declarations.doc: Being an absolutely weakly normal commutative ring is a local property of rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing_propertyIsLocal :
    CommRing.PropertyIsLocal
      (fun (R : Type u) [CommRing R] => IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing R)
declarations.comment: absolutely_weakly_normal_local_property

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsSeminormal
declarations.doc:
A scheme is seminormal if every point has an affine open neighbourhood whose ring of
sections is seminormal.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSeminormal (X : Scheme.{u}) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal
declarations.doc:
A scheme is absolutely weakly normal if every point has an affine open neighbourhood
whose ring of sections is absolutely weakly normal.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal (X : Scheme.{u}) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSeminormal_tfae
declarations.doc:
A scheme is seminormal if and only if the section ring of every affine open is seminormal,
if and only if this holds on an affine open covering, if and only if the scheme has an open
covering by seminormal open subschemes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSeminormal_tfae (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsSeminormal X,
      ∀ U : X.affineOpens, IsSeminormalRing Γ(X, U.val),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → X.affineOpens),
        (⨆ i, (U i).val) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ i, IsSeminormalRing Γ(X, (U i).val),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → X.Opens),
        (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ i, IsSeminormal (U i).toScheme]
declarations.comment: seminormal equivalent conditions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSeminormal_open
declarations.doc: Every open subscheme of a seminormal scheme is seminormal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSeminormal_open {X : Scheme.{u}} (hX : IsSeminormal X)
    (U : X.Opens) : IsSeminormal U.toScheme
declarations.comment: seminormal open subschemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal_tfae
declarations.doc:
A scheme is absolutely weakly normal if and only if the section ring of every affine open is
absolutely weakly normal, if and only if this holds on an affine open covering, if and only if
the scheme has an open covering by absolutely weakly normal open subschemes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal_tfae (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal X,
      ∀ U : X.affineOpens, IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing Γ(X, U.val),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → X.affineOpens),
        (⨆ i, (U i).val) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ i, IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing Γ(X, (U i).val),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → X.Opens),
        (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ i, IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal (U i).toScheme]
declarations.comment: absolutely weakly normal equivalent conditions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal_open
declarations.doc: Every open subscheme of an absolutely weakly normal scheme is absolutely weakly normal.
declarations.comment: absolutely weakly normal open subschemes

declarations.name: seminormalRing_isReduced
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 0EUQ.** A seminormal commutative ring is reduced.
declarations.statement:
theorem seminormalRing_isReduced {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (hA : IsSeminormalRing A) : IsReduced A
declarations.comment: seminormal rings

declarations.name: absolutelyWeaklyNormalRing_isReduced
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 0EUQ.** An absolutely weakly normal commutative ring is reduced.
declarations.statement:
theorem absolutelyWeaklyNormalRing_isReduced {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (hA : IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing A) : IsReduced A
declarations.comment: absolutely weakly normal rings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.seminormal_isReduced
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 0EUQ.** A seminormal scheme is reduced.
declarations.statement:
theorem seminormal_isReduced {X : Scheme.{u}} (hX : IsSeminormal X) :
    IsReduced X
declarations.comment: seminormal schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.absolutelyWeaklyNormal_isReduced
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 0EUQ.** An absolutely weakly normal scheme is reduced.
declarations.statement:
theorem absolutelyWeaklyNormal_isReduced {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (hX : IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal X) : IsReduced X
declarations.comment: absolutely weakly normal schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_lift_to_absoluteWeakNormalization_iff_isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing
declarations.doc:
A universally homeomorphic `A`-algebra is the absolute weak normalization of `A`
precisely when its underlying ring is absolutely weakly normal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_lift_to_absoluteWeakNormalization_iff_isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (huniv : UniversalHomeomorphism
      (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)).op)) :
    IsIso ((absoluteWeakNormalizationCategoryObject_isTerminal A).from
      (⟨CommAlgCat.of A B, huniv⟩ :
        AbsoluteWeakNormalizationCategory A)) ↔
      IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing B
declarations.comment: awn_characterization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_absoluteWeakNormalizationMap
declarations.doc:
A ring homomorphism induces a unique compatible homomorphism between absolute weak
normalizations.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_absoluteWeakNormalizationMap
    {A : Type u} {A' : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A') :
    ∃! φawn : AbsoluteWeakNormalization A →+* AbsoluteWeakNormalization A',
      φawn.comp (algebraMap A (AbsoluteWeakNormalization A)) =
        (algebraMap A' (AbsoluteWeakNormalization A')).comp φ
declarations.comment: awn_functoriality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.absoluteWeakNormalizationCategoryObject_isTerminal
declarations.doc:
The absolute weak normalization of `A` is final among `A`-algebras which give universal
homeomorphisms on spectra.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def absoluteWeakNormalizationCategoryObject_isTerminal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] :
    IsTerminal (absoluteWeakNormalizationCategoryObject A)
declarations.comment: awn_final

declarations.name: Algebra.seminormalization
declarations.doc:
The seminormalization `Aˢⁿ` is the colimit of the finitely presented `A`-algebras
which induce a universal homeomorphism on spectra and isomorphisms on residue fields. Its
`A`-algebra structure is the canonical map `A → Aˢⁿ`.
declarations.statement: def seminormalization (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : CommAlgCat.{u} A
declarations.comment: seminormalization_of_a_ring

declarations.name: Algebra.AbsoluteWeakNormalizationIndex
declarations.doc:
A small category of representatives of finitely presented `A`-algebras whose maps on
spectra are universal homeomorphisms.
declarations.statement: abbrev AbsoluteWeakNormalizationIndex (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : Type u
declarations.comment: absolute_weak_normalization_of_a_ring

declarations.name: Algebra.AbsoluteWeakNormalization
declarations.doc:
The absolute weak normalization `Aᵃʷⁿ` is the colimit of all finitely presented
`A`-algebras whose maps on spectra are universal homeomorphisms. Its inherited `A`-algebra
structure supplies the canonical map `A → Aᵃʷⁿ`.
declarations.statement: abbrev AbsoluteWeakNormalization (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : Type u
declarations.comment: absolute_weak_normalization_of_a_ring

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.seminormalizationAlgebraObject_isTerminal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUR.** The seminormalization of `A` is terminal among the `A`-algebras whose
spectrum morphism is a universal homeomorphism inducing isomorphisms on all residue fields.
declarations.statement:
def seminormalizationAlgebraObject_isTerminal :
    IsTerminal (seminormalizationAlgebraObject A)
declarations.comment: sn_final

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_seminormalizationMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUR.** A ring homomorphism induces a unique compatible homomorphism between the
seminormalizations of its source and target.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_seminormalizationMap
    {A : Type u} {A' : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A') :
    ∃! φsn : Algebra.seminormalization A →+* Algebra.seminormalization A',
      φsn.comp (algebraMap A (Algebra.seminormalization A)) =
        (algebraMap A' (Algebra.seminormalization A')).comp φ
declarations.comment: sn_functoriality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_lift_to_seminormalization_iff_isSeminormalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUR.** A subintegral `A`-algebra is the seminormalization of `A` precisely when
its underlying ring is seminormal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_lift_to_seminormalization_iff_isSeminormalRing
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (huniv : UniversalHomeomorphism
      (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)).op))
    (hres : Scheme.Hom.InducesResidueFieldIsomorphisms
      (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)).op)) :
    IsIso ((seminormalizationAlgebraObject_isTerminal A).from
      (⟨CommAlgCat.of A B, huniv, hres⟩ : SeminormalizationAlgebraCategory A)) ↔
      IsSeminormalRing B
declarations.comment: sn_characterization

declarations.name: Algebra.isIso_toAbsoluteWeakNormalization_iff_isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUR.** For an `A`-algebra `B` whose spectrum morphism to `Spec A` is a universal
homeomorphism, the canonical map `B ⟶ Aᵃʷⁿ` is an isomorphism exactly when `B` is absolutely
weakly normal.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_toAbsoluteWeakNormalization_iff_isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (huniv : UniversalHomeomorphism (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))) :
    IsIso ((absoluteWeakNormalizationCandidate_isTerminal A).from
        (⟨CommAlgCat.of A B, huniv⟩ : AbsoluteWeakNormalizationCategory A)) ↔
      IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormalRing B
declarations.comment: awn_characterization

declarations.name: Algebra.absoluteWeakNormalizationCandidate_isTerminal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUR.** The absolute weak normalization of `A` is terminal among the `A`-algebras
whose spectrum morphism to `Spec A` is a universal homeomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def absoluteWeakNormalizationCandidate_isTerminal :
    IsTerminal (absoluteWeakNormalizationCandidate A)
declarations.comment: awn_final

registrations.comment: sn_final

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.seminormalization_inducesResidueFieldIsomorphisms
registrations.comment: sn_final

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasInitialUniversalHomeomorphismOver
declarations.doc:
The category of universal homeomorphisms to a scheme `X` has an initial object, the absolute
weak normalization of `X`, which remains initial over every open subscheme.
declarations.statement:
public instance hasInitialUniversalHomeomorphismOver (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    HasLocallyInitialUniversalHomeomorphismOver X
declarations.comment: absolute_weak_normalization_initial

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_initialMap_iff_isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EUS.** The canonical map from the absolute weak
normalization of `X` to a universal homeomorphism `Y ⟶ X` is an isomorphism
if and only if `Y` is absolutely weakly normal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_initialMap_iff_isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [HasLocallyInitialUniversalHomeomorphismOver X]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : UniversalHomeomorphism f) :
    IsIso ((initial.to (⟨Over.mk f, hf⟩ : UniversalHomeomorphismOver X)).hom.left) ↔
      IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal Y
declarations.comment: absolute_weak_normalization_iso_iff

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_initialTo_iff_isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EUS.** The canonical morphism from the absolute weak normalization of
`X` to a universal homeomorphism `Y ⟶ X` is an isomorphism if and only if `Y` is absolutely
weakly normal.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_initialTo_iff_isAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasLocallyInitialUniversalHomeomorphismOver X] (Y : UniversalHomeomorphismOver X) :
    IsIso ((initial.to Y).hom.left) ↔ IsAbsolutelyWeaklyNormal Y.obj.left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_absoluteWeakNormalization_lift
declarations.doc: Every morphism of schemes has a unique compatible lift to the absolute weak normalizations.

theorem existsUnique_absoluteWeakNormalization_lift {X' X : Scheme.{u}} (h : X' ⟶ X) :

declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EUS.** A morphism of schemes has a unique compatible
lift to their seminormalizations.

theorem existsUnique_seminormalization_lift {X' X : Scheme.{u}}

    [HasInitial (SeminormalizationCategory X)]

induce isomorphisms on all residue fields has an initial object, the seminormalization of that

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isOpenImmersion_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUU.** An open immersion obtained by base change to the inverse limit of an
affine-transition inverse system descends to some stage of the system.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_isOpenImmersion_pullback
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (S : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone S) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (S.map g)]
    (i₀ : I) [CompactSpace (S.obj i₀)] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (S.obj i₀)]
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (S.obj i₀))
    [CompactSpace X₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀.left]
    [CompactSpace Y₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y₀.left]
    (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left]
    (hf : IsOpenImmersion ((Over.pullback (c.π.app i₀)).map f₀).left) :
    ∃ (i : I) (g : i ⟶ i₀), IsOpenImmersion ((Over.pullback (S.map g)).map f₀).left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.extension_hom_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUW.** The extension of `F` to `Sch/S` is unique: a morphism between two extensions
of `F` which both satisfy the analogues of (a) and (b) is determined by its restriction to the
full subcategory.
declarations.statement:
theorem extension_hom_unique {P : ObjectProperty (Over S)}
    (_hP1 : HasAffineOpens P) (hP2 : HasFinitePresentationAffines P)
    {F : P.FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w}
    (_haF : IsZariskiSheafOnSubcategory P F)
    (_hbF : PreservesAffineLimitsOnSubcategory P F)
    {F₁ F₂ : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w}
    (_ha₁ : IsZariskiSheaf F₁) (hb₁ : PreservesAffineLimits F₁)
    (ha₂ : IsZariskiSheaf F₂) (_hb₂ : PreservesAffineLimits F₂)
    {α : P.ι.op ⋙ F₁ ≅ F} {β : P.ι.op ⋙ F₂ ≅ F} (θ θ' : F₁ ⟶ F₂)
    (hθ : Functor.whiskerLeft P.ι.op θ ≫ β.hom = α.hom)
    (hθ' : Functor.whiskerLeft P.ι.op θ' ≫ β.hom = α.hom) :
    θ = θ'
declarations.comment:
uniqueness: a morphism between two extensions satisfying the analogues of (a) and
(b) is determined by the identifications of their restrictions with the original functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.extension_iso_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUW.** The extension of `F` to `Sch/S` is unique: two extensions of `F` which both
satisfy the analogues of (a) and (b) admit at most one isomorphism compatible with the
identifications of their restrictions with `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem extension_iso_unique {P : ObjectProperty (Over S)}
    (hP1 : HasAffineOpens P) (hP2 : HasFinitePresentationAffines P)
    {F : P.FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w}
    (haF : IsZariskiSheafOnSubcategory P F)
    (hbF : PreservesAffineLimitsOnSubcategory P F)
    {F₁ F₂ : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w}
    (ha₁ : IsZariskiSheaf F₁) (hb₁ : PreservesAffineLimits F₁)
    (ha₂ : IsZariskiSheaf F₂) (hb₂ : PreservesAffineLimits F₂)
    {α : P.ι.op ⋙ F₁ ≅ F} {β : P.ι.op ⋙ F₂ ≅ F} (ε ε' : F₁ ≅ F₂)
    (hε : Functor.whiskerLeft P.ι.op ε.hom ≫ β.hom = α.hom)
    (hε' : Functor.whiskerLeft P.ι.op ε'.hom ≫ β.hom = α.hom) :
    ε = ε'
declarations.comment:
uniqueness: two extensions satisfying the analogues of (a) and (b) admit at most
one isomorphism compatible with the identifications of their restrictions with the original
functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.exists_unique_extension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUW.** For a scheme `S` and a full subcategory `𝒞` of `Sch/S` which contains, up to
isomorphism, the affine opens of its objects and the affine schemes of finite presentation over
the affine opens of `S`, a functor `F : 𝒞ᵒᵖ ⥤ Set` which is a Zariski sheaf and takes directed
inverse limits of affine objects to filtered colimits extends to `Sch/S` in a unique way: there
is a functor `F'` on `Sch/S` which is a Zariski sheaf, takes directed inverse limits of affine
schemes over `S` to filtered colimits, restricts to `F` on `𝒞`, and is isomorphic to any other
functor with these three properties.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_unique_extension (hP1 : HasAffineOpens P)
    (hP2 : HasFinitePresentationAffines P)
    {F : P.FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w (u + 1))}
    (haF : IsZariskiSheafOnSubcategory P F)
    (hbF : PreservesAffineLimitsOnSubcategory P F) :
    ∃ (F' : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w (u + 1))) (_ : IsZariskiSheaf F')
      (_ : PreservesAffineLimits F') (_ : P.ι.op ⋙ F' ≅ F),
      ∀ (F'' : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w (u + 1))), IsZariskiSheaf F'' →
        PreservesAffineLimits F'' → (P.ι.op ⋙ F'' ≅ F) → Nonempty (F' ≅ F'')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isZariskiSheaf_extension
declarations.doc:
**The analogue of condition (a) of Stacks 0EUW for the extension.** The extension is a
Zariski sheaf on `Sch/S`: its value at `X` is the limit of the colimit formula over the affine
objects over affine opens of `S` mapping to `X`, and a section is built over each such object by
gluing, using the sheaf condition for the colimit formula on affine objects.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZariskiSheaf_extension (hP1 : HasAffineOpens P)
    (hP2 : HasFinitePresentationAffines P) (haF : IsZariskiSheafOnSubcategory P F) :
    IsZariskiSheaf (extension P F)
declarations.comment:
the analogue of condition (a) for the extension
`AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.extension`: the extension is a Zariski sheaf on `Sch/S`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isCoveringSheaf_zariski_extension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUX for `τ = Zariski`.** Let `S` be a scheme, let `𝒞` be a full subcategory of
`Sch/S` satisfying conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks 0EUW — the big Zariski site `(Sch/S)_Zar` is
such a subcategory — and let `F : 𝒞ᵒᵖ ⥤ Set` be a Zariski sheaf on `𝒞`. Then the extension `F'`
of `F` to all schemes over `S` satisfies the sheaf condition for all Zariski coverings.

Property (b) of Stacks 0EUW, which the source assumes, is not needed for this clause: the
extension is a Zariski sheaf whatever `F` does to directed limits of affines, and a Zariski sheaf
is a sheaf for every Zariski covering. It is property (b) that makes
`AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.extension` deserve the name `F'`, by identifying its
restriction to `𝒞` with `F`; the conclusion below is about that same functor, assumed or not.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoveringSheaf_zariski_extension (P : ObjectProperty (Over S))
    (F : P.FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w (u + 1)))
    (hP1 : HasAffineOpens P) (hP2 : HasFinitePresentationAffines P)
    (hF : IsCoveringSheafOnSubcategory.{max w (u + 1), u, u} .zariski P F) :
    IsCoveringSheaf.{max w (u + 1), u, v} .zariski (extension P F)
declarations.comment: τ = Zariski

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isCoveringSheaf_extension_of_isCoveringSheafOnSubcategory'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUX.** Let `τ` be one of Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic and fppf, let `S` be a
scheme, let `𝒞` be a full subcategory of `Sch/S` satisfying conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks
0EUW — the big site `(Sch/S)_τ` is such a subcategory — and let `F : 𝒞ᵒᵖ ⥤ Set` be a `τ`-sheaf
on `𝒞` satisfying property (b) of Stacks 0EUW. Then the extension `F'` of `F` to all schemes over
`S` satisfies the sheaf condition for all `τ`-coverings.

This is the unconditional form of
`AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isCoveringSheaf_extension_of_isCoveringSheafOnSubcategory`,
which carries the sheaf condition of the extension for the standard `τ`-coverings of the affine
objects of `Sch/S` lying over an affine open of `S` as a hypothesis only because that condition
is proved in this file, which sits above it in the import order. The ingredients are conditions
(a) and (c) of Stacks 0GDW, which a `τ`-sheaf on `𝒞` satisfies by
`AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isZariskiSheafOnSubcategory_of_isCoveringSheafOnSubcategory`
and `ExtendingFunctors.isStandardAffineSheafOnSubcategory_of_isCoveringSheafOnSubcategory`, and
Stacks 0GDW itself,
`ExtendingFunctors.isCoveringSheaf_extension_of_isStandardAffineSheafOnSubcategory`.

Condition (a) is read on open coverings indexed by the points of a scheme, so the `τ`-sheaf
condition is asked of `F` for index types of `Type (max u v)`, where `u` is the universe of the
objects of `Sch/S` and `Type v` is the universe of the index types for which the conclusion is
drawn. For `v = u` — the case of the big site `(Sch/S)_τ`, whose coverings are indexed in the
universe of its objects, which is the situation of the source — hypothesis and conclusion are
both read on index types of `Type u`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoveringSheaf_extension_of_isCoveringSheafOnSubcategory'
    (τ : CoveringTopology) (P : ObjectProperty (Over S))
    (F : P.FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w (u + 1)))
    (hP1 : HasAffineOpens P) (hP2 : HasFinitePresentationAffines P)
    (hF : IsCoveringSheafOnSubcategory.{max w (u + 1), u, max u v} τ P F)
    (hbF : PreservesAffineLimitsOnSubcategory P F) :
    IsCoveringSheaf.{max w (u + 1), u, v} τ (extension P F)
declarations.comment: all five topologies: Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic and fppf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isCoveringSheaf_extension_of_isCoveringSheafOnSubcategory_of_univ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUX for the big site.** Let `τ` be one of Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic and
fppf, let `S` be a scheme, let `𝒞` be a full subcategory of `Sch/S` satisfying conditions (1)
and (2) of Stacks 0EUW, and let `F : 𝒞ᵒᵖ ⥤ Set` be a `τ`-sheaf on `𝒞` satisfying property (b)
of Stacks 0EUW. Then the extension `F'` of `F` to all schemes over `S` satisfies the sheaf
condition for all `τ`-coverings.

This is
`ExtendingFunctors.isCoveringSheaf_extension_of_isCoveringSheafOnSubcategory'`
read on index types of `Type u`, the universe of the objects of `Sch/S`. That is the situation
of the source: the subcategory it takes is the big site `(Sch/S)_τ`, whose covering families are
indexed in the universe of its own objects, so the `τ`-sheaf condition hypothesis and the sheaf
condition concluded are read on the same index types.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoveringSheaf_extension_of_isCoveringSheafOnSubcategory_of_univ
    (τ : CoveringTopology) (P : ObjectProperty (Over S))
    (F : P.FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w (u + 1)))
    (hP1 : HasAffineOpens P) (hP2 : HasFinitePresentationAffines P)
    (hF : IsCoveringSheafOnSubcategory.{max w (u + 1), u, u} τ P F)
    (hbF : PreservesAffineLimitsOnSubcategory P F) :
    IsCoveringSheaf.{max w (u + 1), u, u} τ (extension P F)
declarations.comment:
all five topologies, for coverings indexed in the universe of the objects of
Sch/S, which is the big site of the source

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsStandardHCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EUY, part (1).** A family `fᵢ : Xᵢ ⟶ T` over an affine scheme `T` is a
**standard h covering** when its index type is finite, every `Xᵢ` is affine, every `fᵢ` is of
finite presentation, and some standard ph covering of `T` refines the family.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def IsStandardHCovering {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] {I : Type v}
    {X : I → Scheme.{u}} (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.not_isSheafFor_isHCovering_gamma
declarations.doc:
The structure sheaf is not a sheaf for the h topology: the presheaf of global sections on
schemes fails the sheaf condition for some h covering family.
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_isSheafFor_isHCovering_gamma :
    ¬ ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type t) (X : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T),
        IsHCovering X f →
          (Presieve.ofArrows X f).IsSheafFor (Scheme.Γ.{u} ⋙ forget CommRingCat.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigHOver.not_subcanonical_topology
declarations.doc:
On a big h site over a nonempty base scheme `S` the h topology is not subcanonical: not every
representable presheaf on `(Sch/S)_h` is a sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_subcanonical_topology [Nonempty S] :
    ¬ (topology B S hS).Subcanonical

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isStandardHCovering_model_of_isLimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EV2, part (1).** Let an affine scheme be written as the limit of a cofiltered
inverse system of affine schemes. Then every standard h covering of the limit is isomorphic to
the base change of a standard h covering of one of the stages, with the same index type.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isStandardHCovering_model_of_isLimit {I : Type v} [Category.{w} I]
    [IsCofiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u} I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ i, IsAffine (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} c.pt)
    (hE : letI : IsAffine c.pt := Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit c hc
      IsStandardHCovering E.f) :
    ∃ (i : I) (F : PreZeroHypercover.{v} (D.obj i)), IsStandardHCovering F.f ∧
      Nonempty (F.pullback₂ (c.π.app i) ≅ E)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_hom_isStandardHCovering_model_of_isLimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EV2, part (2).** Let an affine scheme be written as the limit of a cofiltered
inverse system of affine schemes, and let two standard h coverings of a stage be given. Every
morphism between their base changes to the limit is the base change of a morphism between their
base changes to some later stage, compared through the canonical identifications
`AlgebraicGeometry.pullback₂CompIso` of the iterated base changes with the direct ones.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_hom_isStandardHCovering_model_of_isLimit {I : Type v} [Category.{w} I]
    [IsCofiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u} I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ i, IsAffine (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i : I) (E F : PreZeroHypercover.{v} (D.obj i))
    (hE : IsStandardHCovering E.f) (hF : IsStandardHCovering F.f)
    (f : (E.pullback₂ (c.π.app i)).Hom (F.pullback₂ (c.π.app i))) :
    ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i) (g : (E.pullback₂ (D.map e)).Hom (F.pullback₂ (D.map e))),
      (pullback₂CompIso (D.map e) (c.π.app j) (c.π.app i) (c.w e) E).hom ≫ f =
        g.pullback₂ (c.π.app j) ≫
          (pullback₂CompIso (D.map e) (c.π.app j) (c.π.app i) (c.w e) F).hom
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eventually_eq_hom_isStandardHCovering_of_isLimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EV2, part (3).** Let an affine scheme be written as the limit of a cofiltered
inverse system of affine schemes. Two morphisms of standard h coverings of a stage whose base
changes to the limit are equal are already equal after base change to some later stage.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eventually_eq_hom_isStandardHCovering_of_isLimit {I : Type v} [Category.{w} I]
    [IsCofiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u} I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ i, IsAffine (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i : I) (E F : PreZeroHypercover.{v} (D.obj i))
    (hE : IsStandardHCovering E.f) (hF : IsStandardHCovering F.f) (f g : E.Hom F)
    (hfg : f.pullback₂ (c.π.app i) = g.pullback₂ (c.π.app i)) :
    ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i), f.pullback₂ (D.map e) = g.pullback₂ (D.map e)
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isHSheaf_extension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EV3, the sheaf condition for all h coverings.** Let `S` be a scheme contained in a
big h site, let `𝒞 = (Sch/S)_h` be a full subcategory of `Sch/S` satisfying conditions (1) and (2)
of Stacks 0EUW and let `F : 𝒞ᵒᵖ ⥤ Set` be an h sheaf satisfying condition (b) of Stacks 0EUW.
Then the extension `F' = AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.extension` of `F` to all schemes
over `S` satisfies the sheaf condition for every h covering of every scheme over `S`.

The reduction to the standard h coverings of the affine objects lying over an affine open of `S`
is `AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isHSheaf_of_isStandardAffineHSheaf`, and the restricted
sheaf condition is deduced from the h sheaf property of `F` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isStandardAffineHSheaf_extension`, through the descent of a
standard h covering along a directed limit of affines, Stacks 0EV2.
declarations.statement:
theorem isHSheaf_extension (P : ObjectProperty (Over S))
    (F : P.FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w (u + 1))) (hP1 : HasAffineOpens P)
    (hP2 : HasFinitePresentationAffines P)
    (hF : IsHCoveringSheafOnSubcategory.{max w (u + 1), u, u} P F)
    (hbF : PreservesAffineLimitsOnSubcategory P F) :
    IsHSheaf.{max w (u + 1), u, v} (extension P F)
declarations.comment: the sheaf condition for all h coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.isLimitPreserving_extension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EV3, limit preserving.** For `S` a scheme contained in a big h site, `𝒞 = (Sch/S)_h`
a full subcategory of `Sch/S` satisfying conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks 0EUW and `F : 𝒞ᵒᵖ ⥤ Set`
an h sheaf, the extension `F' = AlgebraicGeometry.ExtendingFunctors.extension` of `F` to all
schemes over `S` is limit preserving in the sense of Limits, Remark 05LX: it carries a directed
inverse limit of affine schemes over `S` to a filtered colimit.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimitPreserving_extension (P : ObjectProperty (Over S))
    (F : P.FullSubcategoryᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w (u + 1))) (hP1 : HasAffineOpens P)
    (hP2 : HasFinitePresentationAffines P)
    (hF : IsHCoveringSheafOnSubcategory.{max w (u + 1), u, u} P F) :
    PreservesAffineLimits (extension P F)
declarations.comment:
limit preserving: the extension carries a directed inverse limit of affine schemes
over the base to a filtered colimit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BlowUpSquare
declarations.doc:
The data fixed by a blowup square: a closed centre of finite presentation in its base
scheme. The other corners and all the arrows are canonically determined.
declarations.statement: public structure BlowUpSquare

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BlowUpSquare.isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EV5.** The blowup square

```
E ⟶ X'
↓    ↓ b
Z ⟶ X
```

commutes and is cartesian: the exceptional divisor `E` is the inverse image `b⁻¹(Z)` of the
centre, hence the fibre product of the blowup morphism `b` and the inclusion of the centre.
Commutativity alone is `AlgebraicGeometry.BlowUpSquare.isPullback.w`.
declarations.comment: the blow up square

registrations.name: Scheme.IdealSheafData.comapIso
registrations.comment: cartesian square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_restrict_compl_support
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EV6.** The modification of an almost blowup square is an isomorphism
over the complement of the centre of the square.
declarations.comment: isomorphism_away_from_center

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlmostBlowUpSquare
registrations.comment: almost_blow_up_square

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.supportedSectionsIdeal_ideal
registrations.comment: almost_blow_up_square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAlmostBlowUpSquare_baseChange
declarations.doc:
An almost blowup square stays an almost blowup square after an arbitrary base change: the new
centre is the inverse image of the old one and the new modification is the base change of the
old one.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_restrict_iff_le_supportedSectionsIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EV8.** The closed subscheme cut out by an ideal sheaf is an
isomorphism over the complement of a closed set exactly when the ideal sheaf is contained in the
ideal of sections supported on that set.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_restrict_iff_le_supportedSectionsIdeal {X : Scheme.{u}} (Z : Set X)
    (hZ : IsClosed Z) (J : X.IdealSheafData) :
    IsIso (J.subschemeι ∣_ (⟨Zᶜ, hZ.isOpen_compl⟩ : X.Opens)) ↔
      J ≤ supportedSectionsIdeal Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.le_supportedSectionsIdeal_iff_isAlmostBlowUpSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EV8.** For a finitely presented closed subscheme of the modification
of an almost blowup square, containing the blowup of the centre is equivalent to the induced
square, with the scheme-theoretic inverse image of the centre, being again an almost blowup
square.
declarations.statement:
public theorem le_supportedSectionsIdeal_iff_isAlmostBlowUpSquare {X X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (b : X' ⟶ X) (h : IsAlmostBlowUpSquare I b)
    (J : X'.IdealSheafData) (hJ : FinitePresentation J.subschemeι) :
    J ≤ supportedSectionsIdeal (I.comap b).support ↔
      IsAlmostBlowUpSquare I (J.subschemeι ≫ b)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFiltered_and_exists_isLimit_blowUpCone
declarations.doc:
Consider an almost blowup square with centre `I.subscheme` and modification `b : X' ⟶ X`,
with `X` quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The closed subschemes `X'ᵢ ⊆ X'` of finite
presentation satisfying the equivalent conditions of Tag 0EV8 — their ideal sheaves `J` are
finitely presented with `J ≤ almostBlowUpIdeal I b`, that is, the blowup `X''` is scheme
theoretically contained in `X'ᵢ` (condition (2)), equivalently `X'ᵢ` contains `X' ∖ E` scheme
theoretically (condition (1), `AlgebraicGeometry.le_almostBlowUpIdeal_iff`) — form a directed
system, and the blowup `X''` of `X` in the centre, identified by `i` over `X` with the closed
subscheme of `X'` cut out by `almostBlowUpIdeal I b`, is its limit `X'' = lim X'ᵢ`, both as
schemes over `X'` and as schemes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiltered_and_exists_isLimit_blowUpCone [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (h : IsAlmostBlowUpSquare I b) :
    IsFiltered (FinitePresentationSubscheme (almostBlowUpIdeal I b)) ∧
      ∃ i : blowUp I ⟶ (almostBlowUpIdeal I b).subscheme, IsIso i ∧
        i ≫ (almostBlowUpIdeal I b).subschemeι ≫ b = blowUpToBase I ∧
        Nonempty (IsLimit (blowUpCone I b i)) ∧
        Nonempty (IsLimit ((Over.forget X').mapCone (blowUpCone I b i)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAlmostBlowUpSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EVA.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and let
`I` be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf of finite type on `X`, cutting out a closed subscheme `Z`.
Then there is an almost blowup square with centre `Z`, that is, a modification `b : X' ⟶ X`
making `(I.comap b, X', Z, X)` an almost blowup square.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isAlmostBlowUpSquare (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hI : Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsFiniteType I) :
    ∃ (X' : Scheme.{u}) (b : X' ⟶ X), IsAlmostBlowUpSquare I b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAlmostBlowUpSquare_closedImmersion_to_both
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let `I` be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf
of finite type on `X`, and let `b₁ : X₁ ⟶ X` and `b₂ : X₂ ⟶ X` be the modifications of two almost
blowup squares with centre `I`. Then there is an almost blowup square with centre `I` and
modification `b : X' ⟶ X` together with closed immersions `i₁ : X' ⟶ X₁` and `i₂ : X' ⟶ X₂` over
`X` for which the exceptional subscheme of `b` is the inverse image of the exceptional subscheme
of `b₁` and of `b₂`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isAlmostBlowUpSquare_closedImmersion_to_both
    {X X₁ X₂ : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
