declarations.comment: weak-system variant (Stacks 00VH finite coverings): the map `F ⟶ H` that a compatible family `g` factors through; its defining property is `pullbackPushforwardDesc_app` and its uniqueness `eq_pullbackPushforwardDesc`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sites.InverseSystem.InverseSystemOfFiniteSites.pullbackPushforwardDesc_app
declarations.doc:
**`pullbackPushforwardDesc` restricts to `g i` at every level**: it is a factorization of the
family `g` through the counits.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pullbackPushforwardDesc_app
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] (D : InverseSystemOfFiniteSites.{u₁, u₂, w}) (u : ∀ i, D.C i ⥤ C)
    (hu : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : i ⟶ j), D.u a ⋙ u i = u j)
    (hobj : ∀ X : C, ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i), (u i).obj Y = X)
    (hhom :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (f : (u i).obj X ⟶ (u i).obj Y),
        ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i) (g : (D.u a).obj X ⟶ (D.u a).obj Y),
          (u j).map g =
            eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) X) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) Y).symm)
    (_hhom_inj :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (g₁ g₂ : X ⟶ Y),
        (u i).map g₁ = (u i).map g₂ → ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i), (D.u a).map g₁ = (D.u a).map g₂)
    (K : Precoverage C)
    (_hK :
      ∀ (X : C) (R : Presieve X),
        R ∈ K X ↔
          ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i) (h : (u i).obj Y = X) (S : Presieve Y),
            S ∈ (D.J i).toPrecoverage Y ∧ S ∈ Precoverage.finite (D.C i) Y ∧ R = h ▸ S.map (u i))
    -- the sheaf `F` on `C`, and the canonical maps `φ_a : f_a^{-1}f_{i,*}F → f_{j,*}F` in
    -- adjoint form: `ψ a` is the identity `f_{i,*}F → f_{a,*}f_{j,*}F`
    (F : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i), (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (D.u a).op ⋙ ((u j).op ⋙ F.obj))
    (hψ :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (ψ a).app (op V) x =
          F.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V).symm)) x)
    -- a sheaf `H` on `C` and a family of maps `f_{i,*}F → f_{i,*}H` compatible with the `φ_a`
    (H : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (g : ∀ i, (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (u i).op ⋙ H.obj)
    (hgcomp :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (g i).app (op V) x =
          H.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V)))
            ((g j).app (op ((D.u a).obj V)) ((ψ a).app (op V) x)))
    (i : D.I) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))) :
    (g i).app (op V) x =
      (pullbackPushforwardDesc D u hu hobj hhom _hhom_inj K _hK F ψ hψ H g hgcomp).hom.app
        (op ((u i).obj V)) x
declarations.comment: weak-system variant (Stacks 00VH finite coverings): `pullbackPushforwardDesc` restricts to `g i` at every level.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sites.InverseSystem.InverseSystemOfFiniteSites.eq_pullbackPushforwardDesc
declarations.doc:
**`pullbackPushforwardDesc` is the only such factorization**: a map of sheaves `F ⟶ H`
restricting to `g i` at every level is `pullbackPushforwardDesc`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eq_pullbackPushforwardDesc
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] (D : InverseSystemOfFiniteSites.{u₁, u₂, w}) (u : ∀ i, D.C i ⥤ C)
    (hu : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : i ⟶ j), D.u a ⋙ u i = u j)
    (hobj : ∀ X : C, ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i), (u i).obj Y = X)
    (hhom :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (f : (u i).obj X ⟶ (u i).obj Y),
        ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i) (g : (D.u a).obj X ⟶ (D.u a).obj Y),
          (u j).map g =
            eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) X) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) Y).symm)
    (_hhom_inj :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (g₁ g₂ : X ⟶ Y),
        (u i).map g₁ = (u i).map g₂ → ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i), (D.u a).map g₁ = (D.u a).map g₂)
    (K : Precoverage C)
    (_hK :
      ∀ (X : C) (R : Presieve X),
        R ∈ K X ↔
          ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i) (h : (u i).obj Y = X) (S : Presieve Y),
            S ∈ (D.J i).toPrecoverage Y ∧ S ∈ Precoverage.finite (D.C i) Y ∧ R = h ▸ S.map (u i))
    -- the sheaf `F` on `C`, and the canonical maps `φ_a : f_a^{-1}f_{i,*}F → f_{j,*}F` in
    -- adjoint form: `ψ a` is the identity `f_{i,*}F → f_{a,*}f_{j,*}F`
    (F : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i), (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (D.u a).op ⋙ ((u j).op ⋙ F.obj))
    (hψ :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (ψ a).app (op V) x =
          F.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V).symm)) x)
    -- a sheaf `H` on `C` and a family of maps `f_{i,*}F → f_{i,*}H` compatible with the `φ_a`
    (H : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (g : ∀ i, (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (u i).op ⋙ H.obj)
    (hgcomp :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (g i).app (op V) x =
          H.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V)))
            ((g j).app (op ((D.u a).obj V)) ((ψ a).app (op V) x)))
    (y : F ⟶ H)
    (hy : ∀ (i : D.I) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
      (g i).app (op V) x = y.hom.app (op ((u i).obj V)) x) :
    y = pullbackPushforwardDesc D u hu hobj hhom _hhom_inj K _hK F ψ hψ H g hgcomp
declarations.comment: weak-system variant (Stacks 00VH finite coverings): uniqueness of the factorization `pullbackPushforwardDesc`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sites.InverseSystem.InverseSystemOfSites.cocycle_pullback_pushforward_of_colimit
declarations.doc:
**The cocycle condition of Stacks 09YN.** The canonical maps
`φ_a : f_a^{-1}f_{i, *}F → f_{j, *}F`, in the adjoint form `ψ`, satisfy
`φ_{b ∘ a} = φ_b ∘ f_b^{-1}φ_a`: each `ψ a` is the transport along `D.u a ⋙ u j = u i`, and the
transports compose.
declarations.statement:
public theorem InverseSystemOfSites.cocycle_pullback_pushforward_of_colimit
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] (D : InverseSystemOfSites.{u₁, u₂, w}) (u : ∀ i, D.C i ⥤ C)
    (hu : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : i ⟶ j), D.u a ⋙ u i = u j)
    (_hobj : ∀ X : C, ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i), (u i).obj Y = X)
    (_hhom :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (f : (u i).obj X ⟶ (u i).obj Y),
        ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i) (g : (D.u a).obj X ⟶ (D.u a).obj Y),
          (u j).map g =
            eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) X) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) Y).symm)
    (_hhom_inj :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (g₁ g₂ : X ⟶ Y),
        (u i).map g₁ = (u i).map g₂ → ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i), (D.u a).map g₁ = (D.u a).map g₂)
    (K : Precoverage C)
    (_hK :
      ∀ (X : C) (R : Presieve X),
        R ∈ K X ↔
          ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i) (h : (u i).obj Y = X) (S : Presieve Y),
            S ∈ (D.J i).toPrecoverage Y ∧ S ∈ Precoverage.finite (D.C i) Y ∧ R = h ▸ S.map (u i))
    -- the sheaf `F` on `C`, and the canonical maps `φ_a : f_a^{-1}f_{i,*}F → f_{j,*}F` in
    -- adjoint form: `ψ a` is the identity `f_{i,*}F → f_{a,*}f_{j,*}F`
    (F : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i), (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (D.u a).op ⋙ ((u j).op ⋙ F.obj))
    (hψ :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (ψ a).app (op V) x =
          F.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V).symm)) x)
    {i j k : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (b : k ⟶ j) (V : D.C i)
    (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))) :
    (ψ (b ≫ a)).app (op V) x =
      ((u k).op ⋙ F.obj).map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (D.comp b a) V).symm))
        ((ψ b).app (op ((D.u a).obj V)) ((ψ a).app (op V) x))
declarations.comment:
the cocycle condition `φ_{b ∘ a} = φ_b ∘ f_b^{-1}φ_a` of Stacks 09YN satisfied by
  the counits `φ_a : f_a^{-1}f_{i,*}F → f_{j,*}F`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sites.InverseSystem.InverseSystemOfSites.pullbackPushforwardDesc
declarations.doc:
**The factorization of a compatible family through the counits.** Writing
`F = colim_i f_i^{-1}f_{i, *}F` with the counits as structure maps, this is the map of sheaves
`F ⟶ H` whose restriction to the level `i` is `g i`. It is built level by level: a presentation
`u_i(V) = X` of an object `X` of `C` carries the section `g i` over `V`, and the compatibility
`hgcomp` makes the result independent of the presentation chosen.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def InverseSystemOfSites.pullbackPushforwardDesc
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] (D : InverseSystemOfSites.{u₁, u₂, w}) (u : ∀ i, D.C i ⥤ C)
    (hu : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : i ⟶ j), D.u a ⋙ u i = u j)
    (hobj : ∀ X : C, ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i), (u i).obj Y = X)
    (hhom :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (f : (u i).obj X ⟶ (u i).obj Y),
        ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i) (g : (D.u a).obj X ⟶ (D.u a).obj Y),
          (u j).map g =
            eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) X) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) Y).symm)
    (_hhom_inj :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (g₁ g₂ : X ⟶ Y),
        (u i).map g₁ = (u i).map g₂ → ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i), (D.u a).map g₁ = (D.u a).map g₂)
    (K : Precoverage C)
    (_hK :
      ∀ (X : C) (R : Presieve X),
        R ∈ K X ↔
          ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i) (h : (u i).obj Y = X) (S : Presieve Y),
            S ∈ (D.J i).toPrecoverage Y ∧ S ∈ Precoverage.finite (D.C i) Y ∧ R = h ▸ S.map (u i))
    -- the sheaf `F` on `C`, and the canonical maps `φ_a : f_a^{-1}f_{i,*}F → f_{j,*}F` in
    -- adjoint form: `ψ a` is the identity `f_{i,*}F → f_{a,*}f_{j,*}F`
    (F : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i), (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (D.u a).op ⋙ ((u j).op ⋙ F.obj))
    (hψ :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (ψ a).app (op V) x =
          F.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V).symm)) x)
    -- a sheaf `H` on `C` and a family of maps `f_{i,*}F → f_{i,*}H` compatible with the `φ_a`
    (H : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (g : ∀ i, (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (u i).op ⋙ H.obj)
    (hgcomp :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (g i).app (op V) x =
          H.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V)))
            ((g j).app (op ((D.u a).obj V)) ((ψ a).app (op V) x)))
    : F ⟶ H
declarations.comment:
the map `F ⟶ H` that a compatible family `g` factors through; its defining property
  is `pullbackPushforwardDesc_app` and its uniqueness `eq_pullbackPushforwardDesc`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sites.InverseSystem.InverseSystemOfSites.pullbackPushforwardDesc_app
declarations.doc:
**`pullbackPushforwardDesc` restricts to `g i` at every level**: it is a factorization of the
family `g` through the counits.
declarations.statement:
public theorem InverseSystemOfSites.pullbackPushforwardDesc_app
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] (D : InverseSystemOfSites.{u₁, u₂, w}) (u : ∀ i, D.C i ⥤ C)
    (hu : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : i ⟶ j), D.u a ⋙ u i = u j)
    (hobj : ∀ X : C, ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i), (u i).obj Y = X)
    (hhom :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (f : (u i).obj X ⟶ (u i).obj Y),
        ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i) (g : (D.u a).obj X ⟶ (D.u a).obj Y),
          (u j).map g =
            eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) X) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) Y).symm)
    (_hhom_inj :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (g₁ g₂ : X ⟶ Y),
        (u i).map g₁ = (u i).map g₂ → ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i), (D.u a).map g₁ = (D.u a).map g₂)
    (K : Precoverage C)
    (_hK :
      ∀ (X : C) (R : Presieve X),
        R ∈ K X ↔
          ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i) (h : (u i).obj Y = X) (S : Presieve Y),
            S ∈ (D.J i).toPrecoverage Y ∧ S ∈ Precoverage.finite (D.C i) Y ∧ R = h ▸ S.map (u i))
    -- the sheaf `F` on `C`, and the canonical maps `φ_a : f_a^{-1}f_{i,*}F → f_{j,*}F` in
    -- adjoint form: `ψ a` is the identity `f_{i,*}F → f_{a,*}f_{j,*}F`
    (F : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i), (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (D.u a).op ⋙ ((u j).op ⋙ F.obj))
    (hψ :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (ψ a).app (op V) x =
          F.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V).symm)) x)
    -- a sheaf `H` on `C` and a family of maps `f_{i,*}F → f_{i,*}H` compatible with the `φ_a`
    (H : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (g : ∀ i, (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (u i).op ⋙ H.obj)
    (hgcomp :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (g i).app (op V) x =
          H.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V)))
            ((g j).app (op ((D.u a).obj V)) ((ψ a).app (op V) x)))
    (i : D.I) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))) :
    (g i).app (op V) x =
      (pullbackPushforwardDesc D u hu hobj hhom _hhom_inj K _hK F ψ hψ H g hgcomp).hom.app
        (op ((u i).obj V)) x
declarations.comment: `pullbackPushforwardDesc` restricts to `g i` at every level.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sites.InverseSystem.InverseSystemOfSites.eq_pullbackPushforwardDesc
declarations.doc:
**`pullbackPushforwardDesc` is the only such factorization**: a map of sheaves `F ⟶ H`
restricting to `g i` at every level is `pullbackPushforwardDesc`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem InverseSystemOfSites.eq_pullbackPushforwardDesc
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] (D : InverseSystemOfSites.{u₁, u₂, w}) (u : ∀ i, D.C i ⥤ C)
    (hu : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : i ⟶ j), D.u a ⋙ u i = u j)
    (hobj : ∀ X : C, ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i), (u i).obj Y = X)
    (hhom :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (f : (u i).obj X ⟶ (u i).obj Y),
        ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i) (g : (D.u a).obj X ⟶ (D.u a).obj Y),
          (u j).map g =
            eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) X) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) Y).symm)
    (_hhom_inj :
      ∀ (i : D.I) (X Y : D.C i) (g₁ g₂ : X ⟶ Y),
        (u i).map g₁ = (u i).map g₂ → ∃ (j : D.I) (a : j ⟶ i), (D.u a).map g₁ = (D.u a).map g₂)
    (K : Precoverage C)
    (_hK :
      ∀ (X : C) (R : Presieve X),
        R ∈ K X ↔
          ∃ (i : D.I) (Y : D.C i) (h : (u i).obj Y = X) (S : Presieve Y),
            S ∈ (D.J i).toPrecoverage Y ∧ S ∈ Precoverage.finite (D.C i) Y ∧ R = h ▸ S.map (u i))
    -- the sheaf `F` on `C`, and the canonical maps `φ_a : f_a^{-1}f_{i,*}F → f_{j,*}F` in
    -- adjoint form: `ψ a` is the identity `f_{i,*}F → f_{a,*}f_{j,*}F`
    (F : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i), (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (D.u a).op ⋙ ((u j).op ⋙ F.obj))
    (hψ :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (ψ a).app (op V) x =
          F.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V).symm)) x)
    -- a sheaf `H` on `C` and a family of maps `f_{i,*}F → f_{i,*}H` compatible with the `φ_a`
    (H : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type w))
    (g : ∀ i, (u i).op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (u i).op ⋙ H.obj)
    (hgcomp :
      ∀ {i j : D.I} (a : j ⟶ i) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
        (g i).app (op V) x =
          H.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (Functor.congr_obj (hu a) V)))
            ((g j).app (op ((D.u a).obj V)) ((ψ a).app (op V) x)))
    (y : F ⟶ H)
    (hy : ∀ (i : D.I) (V : D.C i) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((u i).obj V))),
      (g i).app (op V) x = y.hom.app (op ((u i).obj V)) x) :
    y = pullbackPushforwardDesc D u hu hobj hhom _hhom_inj K _hK F ψ hψ H g hgcomp
declarations.comment: uniqueness of the factorization `pullbackPushforwardDesc`.

declarations.name: piTensorProductEmbeddings
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXL** (the underlying map).
The canonical `F`-algebra map `(⨂[F] _ : K →ₐ[F] L, K) →ₐ[F] L` whose restriction to the tensor
factor indexed by an embedding `f : K →ₐ[F] L` is `f` itself; equivalently, on a pure tensor
`tprod F x` it returns `∏ f, f (x f)`. When `L` is a normal closure of an algebraic extension
`K/F` this map is surjective; see `IsNormalClosure.piTensorProductEmbeddings_surjective`.

declarations.name: range_piTensorProductEmbeddings
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXL** (range).
For an algebraic extension `K/F`, the range of `piTensorProductEmbeddings F K L` as a subalgebra
of `L` is exactly the normal closure of `K/F` inside `L`.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_piTensorProductEmbeddings (F K L : Type*)
    [Field F] [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra F K] [Algebra F L]
    [Fintype (K →ₐ[F] L)] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] :
    (piTensorProductEmbeddings F K L).range = (normalClosure F K L).toSubalgebra

declarations.name: IsNormalClosure.piTensorProductEmbeddings_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXL** (surjectivity).
If `L` is a normal closure of an algebraic extension `K/F`, then the canonical `F`-algebra map
`piTensorProductEmbeddings F K L : (⨂[F] _ : K →ₐ[F] L, K) →ₐ[F] L` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsNormalClosure.piTensorProductEmbeddings_surjective
    (F K L : Type*) [Field F] [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra F K] [Algebra F L]
    [Fintype (K →ₐ[F] L)] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [IsNormalClosure F K L] :
    Function.Surjective (piTensorProductEmbeddings F K L)
declarations.comment: surjective

declarations.name: IsGalois.of_isNormalClosure
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXM** (predicate version, absolute).
If `K/F` is separable and `L/F` is a normal closure of `K/F` (in the sense of
`IsNormalClosure F K L`), then `L/F` is Galois.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsGalois.of_isNormalClosure (F K L : Type*) [Field F] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra F L] [Algebra.IsSeparable F K] [IsNormalClosure F K L] : IsGalois F L
declarations.comment: predicate version (absolute)

declarations.name: IsGalois.normalClosure'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXM** (absolute normal closure).
The (absolute) normal closure `NormalClosure F K` of a separable extension `K/F` is
Galois over `F`.
declarations.statement:
instance IsGalois.normalClosure' (F K : Type*) [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable F K] : IsGalois F (NormalClosure F K)
declarations.comment: absolute normal closure

declarations.name: IsCyclotomicExtension.finrank_dvd_totient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXN**.
For a cyclotomic extension `L = K(ζ_n)` of `K`, the degree `[L : K]` divides Euler's totient
`φ(n)`. This follows from the injection of `Gal(L/K)` into `(ℤ/nℤ)ˣ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsCyclotomicExtension.finrank_dvd_totient
    (K L : Type*) (n : ℕ) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} K L] :
    Module.finrank K L ∣ φ n

declarations.name: IntermediateField.adjoin_pow_finrank_eq_of_kummer
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXP**.
Description of the intermediate fields of a Kummer extension: if `L = K⟮z⟯` with `z^n ∈ K`
(where `n = [L:K]`) and `K` contains a primitive `n`-th root of unity, then every
intermediate field `F` of `L/K` has the form `K⟮z^[L:F]⟯`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IntermediateField.adjoin_pow_finrank_eq_of_kummer
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    {z : L} (hz : z ^ Module.finrank K L ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (hgen : K⟮z⟯ = ⊤)
    (hroots : ∃ μ : K, IsPrimitiveRoot μ (Module.finrank K L))
    (F : IntermediateField K L) :
    K⟮z ^ Module.finrank F L⟯ = F

declarations.name: IntermediateField.adjoin_pow_finrank_eq_of_forall_pow_eq_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXP**.
Description of the intermediate fields of a radical extension: if `L = K⟮z⟯` with `z^n ∈ K`
(where `n = [L:K]`) and every `n`-th root of unity in `L` lies in `K`, then every intermediate field
`F` of `L/K` has the form `K⟮z^[L:F]⟯`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IntermediateField.adjoin_pow_finrank_eq_of_forall_pow_eq_one
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    {z : L} (hz : z ^ Module.finrank K L ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (hgen : K⟮z⟯ = ⊤)
    (hroots : ∀ ζ : L, ζ ^ Module.finrank K L = 1 → ζ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (F : IntermediateField K L) :
    K⟮z ^ Module.finrank F L⟯ = F

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.isUnramifiedWithRespectTo_of_tower_and_exists_isGalois_and_common_extension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXR.** Unramified finite separable extensions of the fraction field of a discrete
valuation ring are closed under passage to intermediate fields, admit finite Galois
overextensions which remain unramified, and any two admit a common finite separable
overextension which remains unramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUnramifiedWithRespectTo_of_tower_and_exists_isGalois_and_common_extension
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] :
    (∀ (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
        [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
        (M : Type x) [Field M] [Algebra L M] [FiniteDimensional L M]
        [Algebra.IsSeparable L M] [Algebra K M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
        [Algebra A M] [IsScalarTower A K M],
      letI : FiniteDimensional K M := FiniteDimensional.trans K L M
      letI : Algebra.IsSeparable K M := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans K L M
      IsUnramifiedWithRespectTo A K M →
        IsUnramifiedWithRespectTo A K L) ∧
    (∀ (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
        [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L],
      IsUnramifiedWithRespectTo A K L →
        ∃ (M : Type (max u v w)) (_ : Field M) (_ : Algebra K M)
          (_ : FiniteDimensional K M) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K M)
          (_ : Algebra A M) (_ : IsScalarTower A K M)
          (_ : Algebra L M) (_ : IsScalarTower K L M),
          IsGalois K M ∧ IsUnramifiedWithRespectTo A K M) ∧
    (∀ (L₁ : Type w) [Field L₁] [Algebra K L₁] [FiniteDimensional K L₁]
        [Algebra.IsSeparable K L₁] [Algebra A L₁] [IsScalarTower A K L₁]
        (L₂ : Type x) [Field L₂] [Algebra K L₂] [FiniteDimensional K L₂]
        [Algebra.IsSeparable K L₂] [Algebra A L₂] [IsScalarTower A K L₂],
      IsUnramifiedWithRespectTo A K L₁ →
        IsUnramifiedWithRespectTo A K L₂ →
        ∃ (L : Type (max u v w x)) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L)
          (_ : FiniteDimensional K L) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
          (_ : Algebra A L) (_ : IsScalarTower A K L)
          (_ : Algebra L₁ L) (_ : IsScalarTower K L₁ L)
          (_ : Algebra L₂ L) (_ : IsScalarTower K L₂ L),
          IsUnramifiedWithRespectTo A K L)

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.isUnramifiedIn_comp
declarations.doc:
If `p` is unramified in `B` and `C` is unramified over every prime of `B` lying over `p`,
then `p` is unramified in `C`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUnramifiedIn_comp
    (A B C : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
    (p : Ideal A) (hAB : Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn B p)
    (hBC : ∀ (q : Ideal B) (_ : q.IsPrime), q.LiesOver p → Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn C q) :
    Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn C p

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.isTamelyRamified_tower
declarations.doc:
Tame ramification composes in a tower of finite separable extensions when
the upper extension is tamely ramified at every maximal localization of the
intermediate integral closure.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTamelyRamified_tower
    (A : Type u) (K : Type v) (L : Type w) (M : Type x)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra K M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
    [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra A M] [IsScalarTower A K M] [IsScalarTower A L M]
    [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [Module.Finite L M] [Algebra.IsSeparable L M]
    (hLK : Stacks.KummerExtension.IsTamelyRamified A K L)
    (hML : ∀ (m : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
      letI : m.IsPrime := hm.isPrime
      letI : IsFractionRing (integralClosure A L) L :=
        integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension K L
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime m) L :=
        IsLocalization.localizationAlgebraOfSubmonoidLe _ _ m.primeCompl
          (nonZeroDivisors (integralClosure A L)) m.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime m) M :=
        ((algebraMap L M).comp (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime m) L)).toAlgebra
      letI : IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime m) L M :=
        IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
      Stacks.KummerExtension.IsTamelyRamified (Localization.AtPrime m) L M) :
    letI : Module.Finite K M := Module.Finite.trans L M
    letI : Algebra.IsSeparable K M := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans K L M
    Stacks.KummerExtension.IsTamelyRamified A K M

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.isTamelyRamified_of_isTamelyRamified_tower
declarations.doc:
Every intermediate extension of a finite separable extension tamely ramified
with respect to a discrete valuation ring is itself tamely ramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTamelyRamified_of_isTamelyRamified_tower
    (A : Type u) (K : Type v) (L : Type w) (M : Type x)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra K M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
    [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra A M] [IsScalarTower A K M] [IsScalarTower A L M]
    [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [Module.Finite L M] [Algebra.IsSeparable L M]
    (hM : letI : Module.Finite K M := Module.Finite.trans L M
      letI : Algebra.IsSeparable K M := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans K L M
      Stacks.KummerExtension.IsTamelyRamified A K M) :
    Stacks.KummerExtension.IsTamelyRamified A K L

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.isTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo_tfae_hasUnramifiedKummerOverfield
declarations.doc:
A finite separable extension of the fraction field of a discrete valuation ring is tamely
ramified if and only if it embeds into an unramified extension after some Kummer base change;
equivalently, such an unramified overfield exists after every prime-to-residue-characteristic
multiple of one fixed exponent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo_tfae_hasUnramifiedKummerOverfield
    (A : Type u) (K : Type v) (L : Type w)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    (π : A) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    List.TFAE
      [ IsTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K L,
        ∃ e : ℕ, HasUnramifiedKummerOverfield A K L π hπ e,
        ∃ e₀ : ℕ, 1 ≤ e₀ ∧ IsUnit (e₀ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ∧
          ∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d → IsUnit (d : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) →
            HasUnramifiedKummerOverfield A K L π hπ (d * e₀) ]

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_isGalois_and_common_extension_isTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXX.** Every finite separable extension of the fraction field of a discrete
valuation ring which is tamely ramified with respect to the ring is contained in a finite
Galois extension with the same property. Any two such extensions are contained in a common
finite separable extension which is again tamely ramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isGalois_and_common_extension_isTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] :
    (∀ (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
        [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L],
      IsTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K L →
        ∃ (M : Type (max u v w)) (_ : Field M) (_ : Algebra K M)
          (_ : FiniteDimensional K M) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K M)
          (_ : Algebra A M) (_ : IsScalarTower A K M)
          (_ : Algebra L M) (_ : IsScalarTower K L M),
          IsGalois K M ∧ IsTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K M) ∧
    (∀ (L₁ : Type w) [Field L₁] [Algebra K L₁] [FiniteDimensional K L₁]
        [Algebra.IsSeparable K L₁] [Algebra A L₁] [IsScalarTower A K L₁]
        (L₂ : Type x) [Field L₂] [Algebra K L₂] [FiniteDimensional K L₂]
        [Algebra.IsSeparable K L₂] [Algebra A L₂] [IsScalarTower A K L₂],
      IsTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K L₁ →
        IsTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K L₂ →
        ∃ (L : Type (max u v w x)) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L)
          (_ : FiniteDimensional K L) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
          (_ : Algebra A L) (_ : IsScalarTower A K L)
          (_ : Algebra L₁ L) (_ : IsScalarTower K L₁ L)
          (_ : Algebra L₂ L) (_ : IsScalarTower K L₂ L),
          IsTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K L)

declarations.name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_algEquiv_pi_field_and_ramification_goes_up
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXY.** A finite separable field extension remains a finite product of fields after
scalar extension along an extension of discrete valuation rings. If the original extension is
unramified, respectively tamely ramified, then every resulting field factor has the same
property over the larger discrete valuation ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_pi_field_and_ramification_goes_up
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (K : Type w) (L : Type x) (K' : Type y)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field K']
    [Algebra A B] [IsExtension A B]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra K K'] [Algebra A K'] [IsScalarTower A K K']
    [Module.Finite K K'] [Algebra.IsSeparable K K'] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (E : Fin n → Type (max u v w x y))
        (_ : ∀ i, Field (E i))
        (_ : ∀ i, Algebra L (E i))
        (_ : ∀ i, Algebra B (E i))
        (_ : ∀ i, IsScalarTower B L (E i))
        (_ : ∀ i, Module.Finite L (E i))
        (_ : ∀ i, Algebra.IsSeparable L (E i)),
      0 < n ∧
        Nonempty ((L ⊗[K] K') ≃ₐ[L] ∀ i, E i) ∧
        (IsUnramifiedWithRespectTo A K K' →
          ∀ i, IsUnramifiedWithRespectTo B L (E i)) ∧
        (IsTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo A K K' →
          ∀ i, IsTamelyRamifiedWithRespectTo B L (E i))

declarations.name: InverseSystemOfFiniteSites.AbelianSheafSystem.exists_mono_to_pointwise_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXZ.** Every system of abelian sheaves on an inverse system of sites admits a
levelwise monomorphism to a system whose sheaf at every index is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mono_to_pointwise_injective {D : InverseSystemOfFiniteSites.{v, u, w}}
    (F : AbelianSheafSystem.{v, u, w, t} D) :
    ∃ (G : AbelianSheafSystem.{v, u, w, t} D) (f : Hom.{v, u, w, t} F G),
      (∀ i, Mono (f.app i)) ∧ ∀ i, Injective (G.obj i)
declarations.comment: weak-system variant (Stacks 00VH finite coverings)

declarations.name: InverseSystemOfSites.AbelianSheafSystem.exists_mono_to_pointwise_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EXZ.** Every system of abelian sheaves on an inverse system of sites admits a
levelwise monomorphism to a system whose sheaf at every index is injective.

The system here is one on an `InverseSystemOfSites`, that is on a system of sites all of whose
covering sieves are finitely generated; see
`InverseSystemOfFiniteSites.AbelianSheafSystem.exists_mono_to_pointwise_injective` for the same
statement over the source-faithful finiteness condition of Stacks 00VH, which is where the
construction of the source's proof is carried out, and of which this is the reading along
`InverseSystemOfSites.toInverseSystemOfFiniteSites`.
declarations.statement:
theorem AbelianSheafSystem.exists_mono_to_pointwise_injective
    {D : InverseSystemOfSites.{v, u, w}} (F : AbelianSheafSystem.{v, u, w, t} D) :
    ∃ (G : AbelianSheafSystem.{v, u, w, t} D) (f : AbelianSheafSystem.Hom.{v, u, w, t} F G),
      (∀ i, Mono (f.app i)) ∧ ∀ i, Injective (G.obj i)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.PushforwardRegularity.isWeaklyRegular_stalk_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EY0] part (5).** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
morphism of schemes and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module flat over `S`. If `a, b` is a
weakly regular sequence on `𝒪_{S,s}`, then it is weakly regular on the stalk of `f_* F` at `s`:
`a` is a nonzerodivisor on `(f_* F)_s` and `b` is a nonzerodivisor on
`(f_* F)_s / a (f_* F)_s`.

The source assumes in addition that `a` and `b` lie in the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{S,s}`; that
hypothesis is used there only to pass to the depth statements, so it is omitted. The conclusion
is weak regularity rather than regularity because the pushforward stalk may be zero.
Quasi-coherence of `F` is recorded because the source assumes it, but the proof does not use it:
see `isWeaklyRegular_stalk_pushforward'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isWeaklyRegular_stalk_pushforward [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (s : S) (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F)
    (a b : S.presheaf.stalk s)
    (hab : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (S.presheaf.stalk s) [a, b]) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf s) [a, b]
declarations.comment: pushforward_two_step

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.PushforwardRegularity.min_depth_le_depth_stalk_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EY0] part (6).** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
morphism of schemes and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module flat over `S`. If the stalk
`(f_* F)_s` is finite over `𝒪_{S,s}`, then

`min(2, depth 𝒪_{S,s}) ≤ depth (f_* F)_s`.

The source assumes `𝒪_{S,s}` Noetherian; that hypothesis is used there only through the
description of the depth of a finite module as the supremum of the lengths of the weakly regular
sequences in the maximal ideal, which holds over any commutative ring, so it is omitted.
declarations.statement:
public theorem min_depth_le_depth_stalk_pushforward [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) (s : S)
    (hfinite : Module.Finite (S.presheaf.stalk s) (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf s)) :
    min (2 : ℕ∞) (Module.depth (S.presheaf.stalk s)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk s)) (S.presheaf.stalk s)) ≤
      Module.depth (S.presheaf.stalk s) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk s))
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf s)
declarations.comment: flat_pushforward_depth

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.OpenStalkExactness.exists_nbhd_openStalkComparison_exact
declarations.doc:
**The step inside the proof of [Stacks, Tag 0EY0] that shrinks the base.** For `f`
quasi-compact and quasi-separated and `F` flat over `S`, every nonzerodivisor `a ∈ 𝒪_{S,s}` is
the germ of a global section `r` of the structure sheaf of an open neighbourhood `U ∋ s`; the
stalk comparison map `c : (f_* F)_s ⟶ (f'_* F')_t` for the square cutting out `X ×_S U` is
semilinear over `U.ι.stalkMap t`; and an element of `(f_* F)_s` dies in `(f'_* (F'/rF'))_t`
exactly when it is divisible by `a`.

This is the clause of Tag 0EY0 that is stated over a shrunken base; part (4) over `S` itself is
`isSMulRegular_stalk_pushforward`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_nbhd_openStalkComparison_exact [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) (s : S) (a : S.presheaf.stalk s)
    (ha : IsSMulRegular (S.presheaf.stalk s) a) :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (hs : s ∈ U) (r : Γ(U.toScheme, (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))),
      let t : U.toScheme := ⟨s, hs⟩
      U.ι.stalkMap t a = U.toScheme.presheaf.germ ⊤ t trivial r ∧
      (∀ (z : S.presheaf.stalk s)
          (x : TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf s),
        openStalkComparison f U F t (z • x) =
          U.ι.stalkMap t z • openStalkComparison f U F t x) ∧
      ∀ (m : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f U.ι)).obj F ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f U.ι)).obj F),
        (∀ (W : (pullback f U.ι).Opens)
          (hW : W ≤ pullback.snd f U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
          (z : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f U.ι)).obj F, W)),
          m.app W z = ((pullback.snd f U.ι).appLE ⊤ W hW r) • z) →
        ∀ x : TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf s,
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} t).map
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f U.ι)).map
                (cokernel.π m)).mapPresheaf
              (openStalkComparison f U F t x) = 0 ↔
            ∃ y, x = a • y
declarations.comment: stalk exactness after shrinking the base

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.PushforwardRegularity.not_isAssociatedPoint_pushforward_of_not_mem_range
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes and let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. A point of `S` outside the image of `f` is not an associated point
of `f_* F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_isAssociatedPoint_pushforward_of_not_mem_range {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (s : S)
    (hs : s ∉ Set.range f) :
    ¬ Stacks.Divisors.IsAssociatedPoint ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) s
declarations.comment: outside_association

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.PushforwardRegularity.two_le_depth_stalk_of_isIso_unit_of_notMem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EY0, part (3), for an open immersion.** Let `X` be a locally
Noetherian scheme, let `V ⊆ X` be open and let `ℋ` be an `𝒪_X`-module of finite type which is
canonically the pushforward of its restriction to `V`. Then the stalk of `ℋ` at a point outside
`V` has depth at least two.

Restriction `Hom(𝒪_{X,y}, ℋ_y) → Hom(𝔪_y, ℋ_y)` is bijective, which is the criterion
`Module.two_le_depth_of_bijective_restrict_maximalIdeal`; its two halves are
`eq_zero_of_germ_smul_eq_zero` and `exists_germ_smul_eq`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem two_le_depth_stalk_of_isIso_unit_of_notMem [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [H.IsFiniteType]
    (hunit : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction V.ι).unit.app H))
    (y : X) (hy : y ∉ (V : Set X)) :
    (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk y)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y))
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) H.val.presheaf y)
declarations.comment: part (3), for an open immersion rather than a general quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism, and with S locally Noetherian in place of the tag's Noetherian 𝒪_{S,s} — which is the form both consumers of hdepthOutside use

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.PushforwardRegularity.two_le_depth_stalk_pushforward_of_notMem_range
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EY0] part (3).** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
morphism of schemes and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. Let `s ∈ S` be a point outside
the image of `f`. If `(f_* F)_s` is a finite `𝒪_{S,s}`-module and `𝒪_{S,s}` is Noetherian, then

`depth ((f_* F)_s) ≥ 2`.

Restriction `Hom(𝒪_{S,s}, (f_*F)_s) → Hom(𝔪_s, (f_*F)_s)` is bijective, which is the criterion
`Module.two_le_depth_of_bijective_restrict_maximalIdeal`; its two halves are
`eq_zero_of_germ_smul_eq_zero` and `exists_germ_smul_eq`, both fed by the covering
`exists_nbhd_mem_basicOpen` that replaces the source's base change to `Spec 𝒪_{S,s}`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem two_le_depth_stalk_pushforward_of_notMem_range [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (s : S) (hs : s ∉ Set.range f)
    (hnoeth : IsNoetherianRing (S.presheaf.stalk s))
    (hfinite : Module.Finite (S.presheaf.stalk s) (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf s)) :
    (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (S.presheaf.stalk s)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk s))
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf s)
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LimitDescent.exists_model_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Essential surjectivity in Stacks Tag 0EY1, at the generality the source states.**

Let `S = lim Sᵢ` be a directed inverse limit of schemes with affine transition morphisms — **no
finiteness hypothesis whatsoever is made on the stages `Sᵢ`** — and let `X` be a quasi-compact,
quasi-separated scheme locally of finite presentation over `S`.  Then `X` is isomorphic, over `S`,
to the base change of a quasi-compact, quasi-separated scheme locally of finite presentation over
one of the stages `Sᵢ`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.LimitDescent.exists_model_of_finitePresentation` with the stage
hypotheses `CompactSpace (D.obj i)` and `QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)` removed, so that that
result is the special case of this one in which the stages are quasi-compact and quasi-separated;
over such a stage the conclusion is `AlgebraicGeometry.FinitePresentation` of the model, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.finitePresentation_of_compactSpace`.  The source assumes nothing about the
stages, which is why the statement is in terms of a quasi-compact, quasi-separated source and a
morphism locally of finite presentation rather than in terms of finite presentation.

The index hypothesis `CategoryTheory.FinallySmall.{u} I` asks that `I` have a `u`-small cofinal
set of objects; it is automatic for the directed *set* of the source, and is needed because the
comparison of the sections of the limit with the sections at the stages is a statement about an
index category at the scheme universe.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_model_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [FinallySmall.{u} I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (X : Over c.pt)
    (hXqc : CompactSpace X.left) (hXqs : QuasiSeparatedSpace X.left)
    (hX : LocallyOfFinitePresentation X.hom) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Xᵢ : Over (D.obj (.op i))),
      CompactSpace Xᵢ.left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace Xᵢ.left ∧
        LocallyOfFinitePresentation Xᵢ.hom ∧
        Nonempty (X ≅ (Over.pullback (c.π.app (.op i))).obj Xᵢ)
declarations.comment: essential surjectivity, arbitrary stages

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LimitDescent.isEquivalence_baseChangeComparison
declarations.doc:
For a scheme `T` let `C_T` be the full subcategory of schemes `W` over `T` such that `W` is
quasi-compact and quasi-separated and such that the structure morphism `W ⟶ T` is locally of
finite presentation. Let `S = lim Sᵢ` be a directed inverse limit of schemes with affine
transition morphisms, indexed by a finally `u`-small `I`, with no finiteness hypothesis on the
stages `Sᵢ`. Then the base change functors induce an equivalence of categories
`colim C_{Sᵢ} ⥤ C_S`.

The colimit is the colimit in `CategoryTheory.Cat` of the strict model
`AlgebraicGeometry.LimitDescent.stageDiagram` of the diagram `i ↦ C_{Sᵢ}`, and the functor is
`AlgebraicGeometry.LimitDescent.baseChangeComparison`, the colimit descent of the base change
functors `C_{Sᵢ} ⥤ C_S`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEquivalence_baseChangeComparison :
    (baseChangeComparison D c hc).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LimitDescent.isEquivalence_baseChangeComparison_of_directedSet
declarations.doc:
Let `S = lim Sᵢ` be the limit of an inverse system of schemes indexed by a directed set `I`
in the universe of the schemes, with affine transition morphisms. Then the base change functors
induce an equivalence of categories `colim C_{Sᵢ} ⥤ C_S`, where `C_T` is the category of
quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes locally of finite presentation over `T`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEquivalence_baseChangeComparison_of_directedSet
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {a b : Iᵒᵖ} (t : a ⟶ b), IsAffineHom (D.map t)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) :
    (baseChangeComparison D c hc).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_relativeDimension_baseChange_of_relativeDimension_limitBaseChange
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Tag 081D, if the base change of `f₀` to the limit has relative
dimension `d` and `f₀` is locally of finite presentation, then the base change of `f₀` to some
later stage has relative dimension `d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_relativeDimension_baseChange_of_relativeDimension_limitBaseChange
    (D : DescentSituation.{u, u} I)
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.system.obj (op D.base))) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    [CompactSpace X₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀.left]
    [CompactSpace Y₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y₀.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left] (d : ℕ)
    (h : RelativeDimension (baseChangeMap (D.limitCone.π.app (op D.base)) X₀ Y₀ f₀) d) :
    ∃ (i : I) (hi : D.base ≤ i),
      RelativeDimension (baseChangeMap (D.system.map (homOfLE hi).op) X₀ Y₀ f₀) d

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GlueingNearPoint.exists_open_isSeparated_baseChange
declarations.doc:
Let `U ⊆ S` be a retrocompact open, let `s` be a point of `S` outside `U` and let `a` be a
morphism of schemes of finite presentation over an open neighbourhood `U'` of `U ∪ {s}`. If `a` is
separated over `U` and over `Spec 𝒪_{S, s}`, then it is separated over some open neighbourhood of
`U ∪ {s}` contained in `U'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_open_isSeparated_baseChange
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (U U' : S.Opens) (s : S) (_hsU : s ∉ U) (hsU' : s ∈ U')
    (_hU : IsRetrocompact (U : Set S)) (hUU' : U ≤ U')
    (X₁ X₂ : Over U'.toScheme) (a : X₁ ⟶ X₂)
    (hX₁ : FinitePresentation X₁.hom) (hX₂ : FinitePresentation X₂.hom)
    (hsepU : IsSeparated (baseChangeMap U.ι ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₁)
      ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₂) ((Over.map U'.ι).map a)))
    (hsepS : IsSeparated (baseChangeMap (S.fromSpecStalk s) ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₁)
      ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₂) ((Over.map U'.ι).map a))) :
    ∃ V : S.Opens, U ≤ V ∧ V ≤ U' ∧ s ∈ V ∧
      IsSeparated (baseChangeMap V.ι ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₁)
        ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₂) ((Over.map U'.ι).map a))
declarations.comment: properties_of_relative_morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GlueingNearPoint.exists_open_isProper_baseChange
declarations.doc:
Let `U ⊆ S` be a retrocompact open, let `s` be a point of `S` outside `U` and let `a` be a
morphism of schemes of finite presentation over an open neighbourhood `U'` of `U ∪ {s}`. If `a` is
proper over `U` and over `Spec 𝒪_{S, s}`, then it is proper over some open neighbourhood of
`U ∪ {s}` contained in `U'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_open_isProper_baseChange
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (U U' : S.Opens) (s : S) (_hsU : s ∉ U) (hsU' : s ∈ U')
    (_hU : IsRetrocompact (U : Set S)) (hUU' : U ≤ U')
    (X₁ X₂ : Over U'.toScheme) (a : X₁ ⟶ X₂)
    (hX₁ : FinitePresentation X₁.hom) (hX₂ : FinitePresentation X₂.hom)
    (hproperU : IsProper (baseChangeMap U.ι ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₁)
      ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₂) ((Over.map U'.ι).map a)))
    (hproperS : IsProper (baseChangeMap (S.fromSpecStalk s) ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₁)
      ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₂) ((Over.map U'.ι).map a))) :
    ∃ V : S.Opens, U ≤ V ∧ V ≤ U' ∧ s ∈ V ∧
      IsProper (baseChangeMap V.ι ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₁)
        ((Over.map U'.ι).obj X₂) ((Over.map U'.ι).map a))
declarations.comment: properties_of_relative_morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GlueingNearPoint.exists_open_isFinite_baseChange

theorem exists_open_isFinite_baseChange

    (_hU : IsRetrocompact (U : Set S)) (hUU' : U ≤ U')
    (X₁ X₂ : Over U'.toScheme) (a : X₁ ⟶ X₂)
    (hX₁ : FinitePresentation X₁.hom) (hX₂ : FinitePresentation X₂.hom)

declarations.comment: properties_of_relative_morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etaleCover_factors_affine_smooth_section
declarations.doc:
A smooth morphism of schemes admits an étale covering of its source each member of which maps
to the base through an étale morphism, the first factor being a smooth morphism of affine schemes
which has a section and has geometrically connected fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCover_factors_affine_smooth_section {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Smooth f] :
    ∃ 𝒰 : X.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      ∃ (Bᵢ : Scheme.{u}) (h : Bᵢ ⟶ S) (g : 𝒰.X i ⟶ Bᵢ) (σ : Bᵢ ⟶ 𝒰.X i),
        Etale h ∧ IsAffine (𝒰.X i) ∧ IsAffine Bᵢ ∧ Smooth g ∧ σ ≫ g = 𝟙 Bᵢ ∧
          GeometricallyConnected g ∧ g ≫ h = 𝒰.f i ≫ f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etaleCover_factors_geometricallyConnected
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EY5.** A flat morphism locally of finite presentation with
geometrically reduced fibres admits an étale covering of its source each member of which
factors through an étale morphism to the base, the first factor being flat of finite
presentation with geometrically connected and geometrically reduced fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCover_factors_geometricallyConnected
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [Flat f]
    [GeometricallyReduced f] :
    ∃ 𝒰 : X.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      ∃ (Sᵢ : Scheme.{u}) (h : Sᵢ ⟶ S) (g : 𝒰.X i ⟶ Sᵢ),
        Etale h ∧ Flat g ∧ FinitePresentation g ∧
          GeometricallyConnected g ∧ GeometricallyReduced g ∧
            g ≫ h = 𝒰.f i ≫ f

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.flatBaseChange_algebraPullback
declarations.doc:
**The base-change clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EY6].**  For a quasi-compact quasi-separated
morphism `f : V ⟶ Y` and a flat morphism `q : Y' ⟶ Y`, the pushed-forward structure sheaf of the
base change is the extension of scalars of the inverse image of `f_* 𝒪_V`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flatBaseChange_algebraPullback {V Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ Y)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (q : Y' ⟶ Y) [Flat q] :
    IsPushout
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullback CommRingCat q.base).map (pushforwardAlgebra f).hom)
      (inverseImageStructureMap q)
      (pushforwardBaseChangeMap q (Over.mk f))
      (pushforwardAlgebra ((Over.pullback q).obj (Over.mk f)).hom).hom
declarations.comment: flat_base_change

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.exists_extendedEtaleAlgebraComparison
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EY6], flat base change of the extension algebra.**  Let `X` be locally
Noetherian, `j : U ⟶ X` an open immersion whose complement carries depth at least two and
`π : V ⟶ U` a finite étale cover, and let `g : X' ⟶ X` be flat with `j'` the base change of `j`
and `π'` the base change of `π`.  Then every extension of scalars of the extension algebra
`𝓑 = (π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V` along `g` is canonically isomorphic to the extension algebra
`(π' ≫ j')_* 𝒪_{V'}` of the base-changed cover, by an isomorphism carrying the canonical map
`g⁻¹𝓑 ⟶ g⁺𝓑` to the base-change morphism transported along the Cartesian comparison of
covers.

This is stated for an arbitrary `Stacks.RelativeSpec.AlgebraPullback`, hence in particular for
any choice of one;  `exists_extendedEtaleAlgebraComparison_algebraPullbackOfFlat` is the
instance at `algebraPullbackOfFlat`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_extendedEtaleAlgebraComparison {U X V U' X' V' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X']
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (g : X' ⟶ X) [Flat g]
    (j' : U' ⟶ X') [IsOpenImmersion j'] (gU : U' ⟶ U)
    (π' : V' ⟶ U') [IsFinite π'] [Etale π'] (gV : V' ⟶ V)
    (hj : IsPullback j' gU g j)
    (hπ : IsPullback π' gV gU π)
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (d : AlgebraPullback (ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth) g) :
    let hdepth' := extendedEtaleDepth_flatBaseChange j g j' gU hj hdepth
    let e : Over.mk (π' ≫ j') ≅ (Over.pullback g).obj (Over.mk (π ≫ j)) :=
      Over.isoMk (hπ.paste_horiz hj).flip.isoPullback (by simp)
    ∃ i : d.algebra ≅
        (ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j' π' hdepth').algebra,
      d.map ≫ i.hom.right =
        pushforwardBaseChangeMap g (Over.mk (π ≫ j)) ≫
          (pushforwardAlgebraMap e.hom).right
declarations.comment: flat_base_change

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.extendedEtaleAlgebraComparison_map
declarations.doc:
**The comparison carries the canonical map of the extension of scalars to the base-change
morphism**, transported along the Cartesian comparison of covers.  This is the property that
specifies `Stacks.FundamentalGroup.extendedEtaleAlgebraComparison`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendedEtaleAlgebraComparison_map {U X V U' X' V' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X']
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (g : X' ⟶ X) [Flat g]
    (j' : U' ⟶ X') [IsOpenImmersion j'] (gU : U' ⟶ U)
    (π' : V' ⟶ U') [IsFinite π'] [Etale π'] (gV : V' ⟶ V)
    (hj : IsPullback j' gU g j)
    (hπ : IsPullback π' gV gU π)
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (d : AlgebraPullback (ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth) g) :
    d.map ≫
        (extendedEtaleAlgebraComparison j π g j' gU π' gV hj hπ hdepth d).hom.right =
      pushforwardBaseChangeMap g (Over.mk (π ≫ j)) ≫
        (pushforwardAlgebraMap
          (Over.isoMk (hπ.paste_horiz hj).flip.isoPullback (by simp) :
            Over.mk (π' ≫ j') ≅ (Over.pullback g).obj (Over.mk (π ≫ j))).hom).right
declarations.comment: flat_base_change

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.extendedEtaleSpectrumComparison_universalMap
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EY6], the universal-map equation for the spectrum comparison.**  Under the
representing bijection of [Stacks, Tag 01LV] the comparison is the structure morphism of the
base-changed relative spectrum together with its universal algebra map precomposed with the
algebra comparison.  This is the defining property of
`Stacks.FundamentalGroup.extendedEtaleSpectrumComparison`, so it holds by
`Equiv.apply_symm_apply`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendedEtaleSpectrumComparison_universalMap {U X V U' X' V' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X']
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (g : X' ⟶ X) [Flat g]
    (j' : U' ⟶ X') [IsOpenImmersion j'] (gU : U' ⟶ U)
    (π' : V' ⟶ U') [IsFinite π'] [Etale π'] (gV : V' ⟶ V)
    (hj : IsPullback j' gU g j)
    (hπ : IsPullback π' gV gU π)
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (d : AlgebraPullback (ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth) g) :
    let e := ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j' π'
      (extendedEtaleDepth_flatBaseChange j g j' gU hj hdepth)
    (relativeSpecRepresentableBy d.situation).homEquiv
        (extendedEtaleSpectrumComparison j π g j' gU π' gV hj hπ hdepth d) =
      ⟨(gluedSpectrum e).toBase,
        algebraHomAsUnder
            (extendedEtaleAlgebraComparison j π g j' gU π' gV hj hπ hdepth d).hom ≫
          universalAlgebraMap e⟩
declarations.comment: flat_base_change

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.isIso_extendedEtaleSpectrumComparison
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EY6], the spectrum comparison is an isomorphism.**  The two relative spectra
represent functors identified by
`Stacks.RelativeSpec.relativeSpecFunctorIsoOfAlgebraIso`, and the comparison is the induced
comparison of representing objects.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_extendedEtaleSpectrumComparison {U X V U' X' V' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X']
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (g : X' ⟶ X) [Flat g]
    (j' : U' ⟶ X') [IsOpenImmersion j'] (gU : U' ⟶ U)
    (π' : V' ⟶ U') [IsFinite π'] [Etale π'] (gV : V' ⟶ V)
    (hj : IsPullback j' gU g j)
    (hπ : IsPullback π' gV gU π)
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (d : AlgebraPullback (ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth) g) :
    IsIso (extendedEtaleSpectrumComparison j π g j' gU π' gV hj hπ hdepth d)
declarations.comment: flat_base_change

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleAlgebra_isCoherent
declarations.doc:
**The extension algebra of a finite étale cover is a coherent module over the base.** Let
`j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion into a locally Noetherian scheme whose complement carries depth at
least two and let `π : V ⟶ U` be finite étale. Then the `𝒪_X`-module underlying
`𝓑 = (π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V` is coherent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendedEtaleAlgebra_isCoherent {U X V : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent
      (AlgebraSheaf.underlyingModule (pushforwardAlgebra (π ≫ j)))
declarations.comment: algebra

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleAlgebra_isReflexive
declarations.doc:
**The extension algebra of a finite étale cover is reflexive as a module over the base.** Let
`j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion into a locally Noetherian scheme whose complement carries depth at
least two and let `π : V ⟶ U` be finite étale. Then the `𝒪_X`-module underlying
`𝓑 = (π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V` is reflexive.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendedEtaleAlgebra_isReflexive {U X V : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    IsReflexive (AlgebraSheaf.underlyingModule (pushforwardAlgebra (π ≫ j)))
declarations.comment: algebra

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation
declarations.doc:
**The extension algebra, with its quasi-coherence, as a relative-spectrum situation.** It is
the pair consisting of `X` and the quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-algebra `𝓑 = (π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V`, whose relative
spectrum `Spec_X(𝓑)` is the extension scheme of the cover.
declarations.comment: algebra

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.extendedEtaleSpectrum_flatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**The `flat_base_change` clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EY6], the Cartesian square of relative
spectra.** Let `X` be locally Noetherian, `j : U ⟶ X` an open immersion whose complement
carries depth at least two and `π : V ⟶ U` a finite étale cover, and let `g : X' ⟶ X` be flat
with `j'` the base change of `j` and `π'` the base change of `π`. Then
`Spec_{X'}((π' ≫ j')_* 𝒪_{V'})` is the fibre product of `Spec_X((π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V)` with `X'` over
`X`.

The morphism exhibiting it is the comparison
`extendedEtaleSpectrumComparison` of the two algebras on `X'` — an isomorphism over `X'`,
because flat base change identifies the extension of scalars of `(π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V` with
`(π' ≫ j')_* 𝒪_{V'}` — followed by the canonical base-change morphism
`Stacks.RelativeSpec.relativeSpectrumBaseChangeMap`, whose square is Cartesian by
[Stacks, Tag 01LX] part (2). Transporting the latter square along the former isomorphism is
`extendedEtaleSpectrum_flatBaseChange_of_isPullback`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendedEtaleSpectrum_flatBaseChange {U X V U' X' V' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X']
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (g : X' ⟶ X) [Flat g]
    (j' : U' ⟶ X') [IsOpenImmersion j'] (gU : U' ⟶ U)
    (π' : V' ⟶ U') [IsFinite π'] [Etale π'] (gV : V' ⟶ V)
    (hj : IsPullback j' gU g j)
    (hπ : IsPullback π' gV gU π)
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    IsPullback
      (gluedSpectrum (ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j' π'
        (extendedEtaleDepth_flatBaseChange j g j' gU hj hdepth))).toBase
      (extendedEtaleSpectrumComparison j π g j' gU π' gV hj hπ hdepth
            (pullbackAlgebra (ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth) g) ≫
        relativeSpectrumBaseChangeMap (ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth) g)
      g (gluedSpectrum (ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth)).toBase
declarations.comment: flat_base_change

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.existsUnique_restrictionIso
declarations.doc:
**The `larger_open` clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EY6].** Let `i : U ⟶ U'` and `k : U' ⟶ X` be
open immersions into a locally Noetherian scheme with `X ∖ (i ≫ k)(U)` of depth at least two,
let `π : V ⟶ U` be a finite étale cover and let `Y = Spec_X(𝓑)` be its canonical extension, for
`𝓑 = (π ≫ i ≫ k)_* 𝒪_V`. Given a finite étale cover `π' : V' ⟶ U'` of the larger open
subscheme, an identification `eY` of the restriction of `Y` to `U` with `π`, and an
identification `eV` of the restriction of `π'` to `U` with `π`, there is exactly one
isomorphism over `U'` between the restriction of `Y` to `U'` and `π'` whose own restriction to
`U` carries `eV` back to `eY`.

Both `Y ×_X U'` and `V'` are finite over `U'`, restrict over `U` to `π`, and have depth at
least two above `U' ∖ i(U)`; so `extendedEtale_unique`, over the base `U'`, identifies each
with the extension of `π` across that complement, and the isomorphism is the composite of those
two identifications. Its uniqueness is the uniqueness in that clause.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_restrictionIso {U U' X V V' : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (i : U ⟶ U') [IsOpenImmersion i] (k : U' ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion k]
    (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π] (π' : V' ⟶ U') [IsFinite π'] [Etale π']
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ ((i ≫ k).opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    let Y := gluedSpectrum (extendedEtaleSituation (i ≫ k) π hdepth)
    ∀ (eY : (Over.pullback (i ≫ k)).obj (Over.mk Y.toBase) ≅ Over.mk π)
      (eV : (Over.pullback i).obj (Over.mk π') ≅ Over.mk π),
      ∃! e : (Over.pullback k).obj (Over.mk Y.toBase) ≅ Over.mk π',
        (Over.pullbackComp i k).hom.app (Over.mk Y.toBase) ≫
          (Over.pullback i).map e.hom ≫ eV.hom = eY.hom
declarations.comment: larger_open

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.etaleAt_iff_isFlatAt_extendedEtale
declarations.doc:
**The `etale_iff_flat` clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EY6].** Let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion
into a locally Noetherian scheme whose complement carries depth at least two and let
`π : V ⟶ U` be finite étale. At every point of the canonical extension `Y = Spec_X(𝓑)`, for
`𝓑 = (π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V`, the structure morphism `Y ⟶ X` is étale if and only if it is flat.

Forwards this is one half of "étale is flat and G-unramified". Backwards, write `W` for the flat
locus of `Y ⟶ X`, an open subscheme by [Stacks, Tag 05IM] since the base has locally finite
weakly associated points, and let `y ∈ W`. If `y` lies over the open `j(U)` then `Y ⟶ X` is
étale at `y` outright, because over `j(U)` it is the finite étale cover `π`
(`extendedEtaleCoverMap_isPullback`). Otherwise the depth clause
(`extendedEtale_depth_ge_two`) gives `depth 𝒪_{Y, y} ≥ 2`, hence `dim 𝒪_{Y, y} ≥ 2`; so `y` is
not a generic point of a component of `W`, and any `z ⤳ y` with `dim 𝒪_{W, z} = 1` must lie over
`j(U)`, where `Y ⟶ X` is étale and so unramified. Those are the hypotheses of
[Stacks, Tag 0BJH], which turns flatness at `y` into étaleness at `y`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem etaleAt_iff_isFlatAt_extendedEtale {U X V : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    let Y := gluedSpectrum (extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth)
    ∀ y : Y.scheme,
      EtaleAt Y.toBase y ↔ IsFlatAt Y.toBase.toLRSHom.toShHom y
declarations.comment: etale_iff_flat

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.etale_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree_extendedEtale
declarations.doc:
**The `etale_iff_free` clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EY6].** The structure morphism of the
canonical extension `Y = Spec_X(𝓑)` is étale if and only if `𝓑 = (π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V` is finite
locally free as an `𝒪_X`-module.

The chain is: étale means étale at every point
(`AlgebraicGeometry.etale_iff_forall_etaleAt`); at every point étale is flat
(`etaleAt_iff_isFlatAt_extendedEtale`); flat at every point means flat
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Flat.iff_flat_stalkMap`); and for a morphism over a locally Noetherian base
finite plus flat is finite locally free ([Stacks, Tag 02KB]), which for an affine morphism is
finite local freeness of the direct image of its structure sheaf ([Stacks, Tag 02KA]). That
direct image is `𝓑` itself, because `Y` is the relative spectrum of `𝓑`
(`Stacks.AffineAlgebraEquivalence.pushforwardAlgebraIso`).
declarations.comment: etale_iff_free

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.isFinite_extendedEtaleToBase
declarations.doc:
The extension of a finite étale cover across a depth-two complement is finite over the base:
the structure morphism of `Spec_X(𝓑)`, for `𝓑 = (π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V`, is a finite morphism.
declarations.statement: public instance isFinite_extendedEtaleToBase : IsFinite (extendedEtaleToBase j π hdepth)
declarations.comment: unique_extension

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtaleCoverMap_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**The comparison morphism identifies the cover with the restriction of the extension to the
open subscheme.** This is the pullback clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EY6]: the square formed by the
cover `π`, the comparison morphism, the open immersion `j` and the structure morphism of the
extension is cartesian.
declarations.comment: unique_extension

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtale_depth_ge_two
declarations.doc:
**The depth clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EY6].** The local rings of the extension
`Spec_X(𝓑)` of a finite étale cover across a depth-two complement have depth at least two above
every point of `X` outside the cover.

The stalk of `𝓑` at such a point has depth at least two over the local ring of the base
(`two_le_depth_stalk_extendedEtaleAlgebra`); the local ring of `Spec_X(𝓑)` at a point above it is
a localization of that stalk at a maximal ideal, so its depth is at least as large
(`depth_stalk_pushforwardAlgebra_le_depth_stalk`). The identification of `𝓑` with the structure
algebra of its own relative spectrum is
`Stacks.AffineAlgebraEquivalence.pushforwardAlgebraIso`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendedEtale_depth_ge_two :
    let Y := (relativeSpectrum (extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth)).scheme
    let f := (relativeSpectrum (extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth)).toBase
    ∀ y : Y, f y ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y))
        (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
declarations.comment: unique_extension

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtaleFold.extendedEtale_unique
declarations.doc:
**The extension of a finite étale cover is the unique finite extension with the same
restriction over the open subscheme and the same depth condition off it.** This is the
uniqueness clause of [Stacks, Tag 0EY6]: for any finite `f' : Y' ⟶ X` whose restriction over
`U` is the given cover and whose local rings off `U` have depth at least two, there is exactly
one isomorphism of `Y'` with the relative spectrum of `(π ≫ j)_* 𝒪_V` commuting both with the
structure morphisms to `X` and with the canonical comparison from the cover.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extendedEtale_unique {U X V Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (π : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (f' : Y' ⟶ X) [IsFinite f'] (g' : V ⟶ Y')
    (hg' : IsPullback π g' j f')
    (hdepth' : ∀ y : Y', f' y ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (Y'.presheaf.stalk y)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y'.presheaf.stalk y))
        (Y'.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    ∃! e : Y' ≅ (gluedSpectrum (extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth)).scheme,
      (e.hom ≫ (gluedSpectrum (extendedEtaleSituation j π hdepth)).toBase = f') ∧
      (g' ≫ e.hom = extendedEtaleCoverMap j π hdepth)
declarations.comment: unique_extension

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.extendedEtaleDepth_flatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0EY6, flat base change: the depth condition.** Depth at least two outside the open
subscheme persists after flat base change: if the local rings of `X` at the points outside the
open `U` have depth at least two and `g : X' ⟶ X` is flat with `U' = g⁻¹(U)`, then the local
rings of `X'` at the points outside `U'` have depth at least two.

This is one of the seven declarations making up tag 0EY6's `flat_base_change` clause. All
seven are now proved — the last was the Cartesian square of relative spectra, in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.FundamentalGroup.ExtendedEtale.FlatBaseChangeSquare` — so each
carries `@[stacks 0EY6 "flat_base_change"]`, the clause string recording which part of the tag
is covered.
declarations.statement:
theorem extendedEtaleDepth_flatBaseChange {U X U' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X']
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (g : X' ⟶ X) [Flat g]
    (j' : U' ⟶ X') [IsOpenImmersion j'] (gU : U' ⟶ U)
    (hj : IsPullback j' gU g j)
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (j.opensRange : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    ∀ x' : X', x' ∉ (j'.opensRange : Set X') →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X'.presheaf.stalk x')
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X'.presheaf.stalk x'))
        (X'.presheaf.stalk x')
declarations.comment: flat_base_change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.essSurj_finiteEtaleBaseChange_of_hasPurity
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0EY7.** Let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion of Noetherian schemes
such that purity holds for `𝒪_{X, x}` at every point `x` outside the image of `j`.  Then every
finite étale cover of `U` is the restriction of a finite étale cover of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem essSurj_finiteEtaleBaseChange_of_hasPurity
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsNoetherian X]
    (h : ∀ x : X, x ∉ j.opensRange → HasPurity (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    (finiteEtaleBaseChange j).EssSurj

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleBaseChange_restrict_mvPowerSeries
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two, let `B = A[[x_1, …, x_d]]`
with `d ≥ 1`, set `Y = Spec B` and let `Y_0 = V(x_1, …, x_d)` be the closed fibre, the image of the
closed immersion `Spec A ⟶ Y` induced by the constant coefficient. For any open `V ⊆ Y` with
`V ∩ Y_0` the punctured spectrum of `A`, the restriction functor `FÉt_V ⟶ FÉt_{V ∩ Y_0}` is fully
faithful.

The condition on `V` is the hypothesis `hV`: the inverse image of `V` under the closed immersion
`Spec A ⟶ Y` is the complement of the closed point of `Spec A`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleBaseChange_restrict_mvPowerSeries (A : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A →+* A)) ⁻¹ᵁ V :
      Set (Spec (.of A))) = {IsLocalRing.closedPoint A}ᶜ) :
    Nonempty (finiteEtaleBaseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A →+* A)) ∣_ V)).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: the full statement under the source's hypotheses; nothing is assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.isEquivalence_finiteEtaleBaseChange_and_hasPurity_mvPowerSeries
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EYA]** (Ramanujam--Samuel for finite étale covers). Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a
Noetherian local ring of depth at least two and let `B = A[[x_1, …, x_d]]` with `d ≥ 1`. Let
`V ⊆ Y = Spec B` be an open which contains every prime `𝔮` of `B` with `𝔮 ∩ A ≠ 𝔪` (`hV₁`)
and contains the prime `𝔪B` (`hV₂`). Then the restriction functor `FÉt_Y ⟶ FÉt_V` is an
equivalence, and purity holds for `B`.

The equivalence is `isEquivalence_finiteEtaleBaseChange_mvPowerSeries` with its two hypotheses
discharged: the density of `V` by `dense_of_comap_ne_maximalIdeal_mem_of_flat`, `B` being flat
over `A` ([Stacks, Tag 059T]) and `A` of positive depth, and essential surjectivity by
`essSurj_finiteEtaleBaseChange_mvPowerSeries`. Purity for `B` is the equivalence for the
punctured spectrum of `B`, which satisfies both conditions on `V`
(`mem_puncturedSpectrum_of_comap_ne_maximalIdeal`, `mem_puncturedSpectrum_of_eq_map_maximalIdeal`;
the latter is where `d ≥ 1` is used).
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEquivalence_finiteEtaleBaseChange_and_hasPurity_mvPowerSeries (A : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth A (maximalIdeal A) A)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV₁ : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A),
      q.asIdeal.comap (MvPowerSeries.C : A →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A) ≠ maximalIdeal A →
        q ∈ V)
    (hV₂ : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A),
      q.asIdeal = Ideal.map (MvPowerSeries.C : A →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A)
        (maximalIdeal A) → q ∈ V) :
    (finiteEtaleBaseChange V.ι).IsEquivalence ∧ HasPurity (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A)
declarations.comment: the full statement under the tag's hypotheses: for every open `V` containing the primes `𝔮` with `𝔮 ∩ A ≠ 𝔪` and the prime `𝔪B`, the restriction `FÉt_Y ⟶ FÉt_V` is an equivalence, and purity holds for `B`.

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.isEquivalence_finiteEtaleBaseChange_mvPowerSeries
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EYA]** (Ramanujam--Samuel for finite étale covers). Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a
Noetherian local ring of depth at least two and let `B = A[[x_1, …, x_d]]` with `d ≥ 1`. Let
`V ⊆ Y = Spec B` be an open which contains every prime `𝔮` of `B` with `𝔮 ∩ A ≠ 𝔪` and contains
the prime `𝔪B`. Then the restriction functor `FÉt_Y ⟶ FÉt_V` is an equivalence.

The two conditions on `V` are `hV₁` and `hV₂`. `hV₂` is phrased as a condition on the points of
`Spec B` rather than on the ideal `𝔪B`, so that the primality of `𝔪B` need not be produced.

The fully faithful half is proved: a point of `Spec B` outside `V` lies over `𝔪` by `hV₁`, so its
local ring has depth at least two by `two_le_depth_stalk_of_notMem_mvPowerSeries`, which is
flatness of `B` over `A` ([Stacks, Tag 059T]) fed to [Stacks, Tag 0337];
`isConnectedPuncturedStrictHenselization_of_two_le_depth` ([Stacks, Tag 0BLR]) turns that into
the local hypothesis of [Stacks, Tag 0BQF], which concludes. That is the source's first
paragraph.

Two hypotheses are carried.

* `hdense` is the density of `V` in `Spec B`, which [Stacks, Tag 0BQF] requires and which the
  source does not verify when it appeals to that tag.
* `hessSurj` is essential surjectivity, the source's second paragraph: the unique finite
  extension `Spec C ⟶ Y` of a finite étale `W ⟶ V` from [Stacks, Tag 0EY6], the isomorphism
  `C ≅ C₀ ⊗_A B` obtained from [Stacks, Tag 0EY9] over `U ×_X Y` through the compatibility of
  that construction with flat base change and with change of opens, and the deduction that
  `A ⟶ C₀` is finite étale — a step at which the source itself writes "small detail omitted".
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEquivalence_finiteEtaleBaseChange_mvPowerSeries (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth A (maximalIdeal A) A)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV₁ : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A),
      q.asIdeal.comap (MvPowerSeries.C : A →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A) ≠ maximalIdeal A →
        q ∈ V)
    (hV₂ : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A),
      q.asIdeal = Ideal.map (MvPowerSeries.C : A →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A)
        (maximalIdeal A) → q ∈ V)
    (hdense : Dense (V : Set (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A)))))
    (hessSurj : (finiteEtaleBaseChange V.ι).EssSurj) :
    (finiteEtaleBaseChange V.ι).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: the fully faithful half unconditionally: a point of `Spec B` outside `V` lies over `𝔪` by the tag's condition (1), hence its local ring has depth at least two, by flatness of `B` over `A` (Tag 059T) fed to Tag 0337, which is the source's first paragraph; Tag 0BLR through `isConnectedPuncturedStrictHenselization_of_two_le_depth` turns that into the local hypothesis of Tag 0BQF, which gives full faithfulness. Two hypotheses are carried. `hessSurj` is the essential surjectivity half, that is the whole of the source's second paragraph, standing for Tag 0EY6 and Tag 0EY9 together with the step the source itself marks `small detail omitted`. `hdense` is the density of `V` in `Spec B`, which Tag 0BQF requires and which the source does not verify. The tag's condition (2) on `V` and its hypothesis `d ≥ 1` are stated; they are used by the purity corollary `hasPurity_mvPowerSeries` below rather than by the equivalence itself.

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.isEquivalence_finiteEtaleBaseChange_of_smooth_of_fibrewise_dense
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EYB].** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes and `U ⊆ X` an open
subscheme. Assume that

1. `f` is smooth,
2. `S` is Noetherian,
3. for every `s ∈ S` with `depth 𝒪_{S, s} ≤ 1` we have `X_s = U_s`, spelled as containment of
   the fibre `f⁻¹(s)` in `U` (`hfib`), and
4. `U_s ⊆ X_s` is dense for every `s ∈ S`, spelled as every point of `f⁻¹(s)` lying in the
   closure of `U ∩ f⁻¹(s)` (`hdense`).

Then the restriction functor `FÉt_X ⟶ FÉt_U` is an equivalence of categories.

Full faithfulness is `nonempty_fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleBaseChange_of_smooth` (the source's first
paragraph, by [Stacks, Tag 0BQF], [Stacks, Tag 0BLR] and [Stacks, Tag 0337]) and essential
surjectivity is `essSurj_finiteEtaleBaseChange_of_smooth` (the source's second paragraph, by
[Stacks, Tag 0EY6] and [Stacks, Tag 0EYA]).
declarations.statement:
